name: GIF Joggen
description: GIF Joggen is a challenging but friendly competition against yourself or others, an accessible race for everyone, or a wonderful walk in the Gressvik forest. This event is for everyone, from children in strollers to seniors nearing 100 years old. That’s how we can make the most of the day.

name: Begbyjoggen
description: Begbyjoggen is a weekly recreational run in Fredrikstad, offering an accessible event for everyone. The race takes place on gravel paths in the lit trail network. The main course is 6.8 km, starting at the Begbyporten clubhouse and passing Bjørneklova, heading down Alleen, going around the golf course, and returning via Bjørneklova. There is also a separate 4.6 km course for those who want to walk or jog. The event takes place every Wednesday at 18:00, and tickets are sold through Strava.com.
course_highlights: 6.8 km course on gravel paths in the lit trail network
Start and finish at the Begbyporten clubhouse
Separate 4.6 km course for walkers and joggers
additional: Weekly recreational run every Wednesday at 18:00. An accessible event for everyone. Tickets are sold through Strava.com. The course follows gravel paths in the lit trail network. Start and finish at the Begbyporten clubhouse. The weekly gathering is listed as Wednesdays at 18:00 at Begbyporten (the “clubhouse”).

name: Karneval-Marathon
description: The Carnival Marathon in Köln-Pesch combines a passion for marathon running with enthusiasm for the Cologne Carnival. The event takes place on 11.11.2026 and is a unique event marking the start of the “fifth season.” The course is measured by the German Athletics Association (DLV) and follows a flat, paved loop around Pescher See, which runners complete multiple times. The field is limited to 50 participants, and costumes are expressly encouraged to add to the fun.
course_highlights: 15 laps of 2.732 km plus a 1.215 km out-and-back section at the start for the marathon distance
Flat loop around Pescher See in a protected landscape area
Refreshment station in the start/finish area, passed every 2.7 km
additional: Race numbers can be collected from 9:30 to 10:30 at the playground at Pescher See. Changing rooms, showers and toilets are available at the nearby clubhouse of FC Pesch 1956 e.V. Timing is manual, with lap numbers clipped off the race bib. After the race, there will be Kölsch and a unique Carnival finisher’s medal. The event is non-commercial, and proceeds will be donated to Cologne Carnival associations. The course is a paved 2.7 km loop; there is no lighting or medical station. The number of race numbers is limited to 50. No refunds are given for non-participation or force majeure. Participation is open to runners aged U20 and older.

name: Poznański Bieg Niepodległości – Kocham Polskę!
location: Strzeszyn, Poznań, Greater Poland Voivodeship, Poland
price_range: 20 zł za koszulkę techniczną, wpisowe na stronie nie jest wyraźnie podane
description: The Poznań Independence Run – I Love Poland! is a cross-country race held in picturesque locations in Poznań, particularly in Strzeszyn near Malibu Beach. The event is part of the activities of a group of running enthusiasts who have been promoting cross-country running in Greater Poland since 2014, with an emphasis on attractive courses and the sporting character of the event. The race has a patriotic dimension and takes place on 11 November, combining sport with a celebration of Poland’s independence. Runners are invited to take part in a range of distances amid beautiful natural surroundings.
course_highlights: Cross-country course around Strzeszyn and Malibu Beach
Picturesque green areas of Poznań
A patriotic race held on 11 November
additional: The organiser is a group of running enthusiasts from Greater Poland, active since 2014 and specialising in cross-country races. The race takes place in the green areas of Strzeszyn, near Malibu Beach. The event has a patriotic character and is part of the Poznań Running Triad. Participant limit: 750; picturesque courses; cross-country races.

name: Gdyński Bieg Niepodległości
description: The Gdynia Independence Run is an annual running event held in Gdynia and part of the 2026 Gdynia Grand Prix. The 10 km main race attracts runners of all ages, and there are also races for children and young people. The event combines sport and recreation, with participants able to expect professional organization and an atmosphere celebrating Poland’s independence. Photos and video footage are taken during the event for the organizers’ promotional purposes.
course_highlights: 10 km main race
Races for children and young people
Part of the 2026 Gdynia Grand Prix
additional: Photos and video footage will be taken during the event to promote events organized by GCS and the Municipality of the City of Gdynia. Registration until October 28, 2026; results, photo galleries, and information about event partners are available.

name: II Bieg Legionów Polskich
description: The 2nd Polish Legions Run commemorates the anniversary of Poland regaining its independence and offers two distances: 5 km and 10 km. The starts take place in scenic coastal locations: Władysławowo, Rozewie and Jastrzębia Góra. The organizer provides transport from Jastrzębia Góra to the start locations and opens the race office on the day before and on race day. The course is available online, allowing participants to familiarize themselves with the route before the start.
course_highlights: The course passes through Władysławowo, Rozewie and Jastrzębia Góra
The 10 km race starts by the General Haller monument on Morska Street in Władysławowo
The 5 km race starts by the bust of Marshal Piłsudski on Garnizonowa Street in Rozewie
additional: Transport from Jastrzębia Góra to the start locations is provided. The race office is open on 10 November 2025 from 14:30 to 15:30 at OSiR Władysławowo, and on 11 November 2025 from 10:20 to 10:50 in Jastrzębia Góra. The course is available online at https://www.traseo.pl/trasa/bieg-legionow-polskich. Registration runs from 22 September to 5 November 2025; the event takes place on routes with moderate elevation gain, starting in Władysławowo and Rozewie.

name: XXXVIII Goleniowska Mila Niepodległości o Puchar Burmistrza Gminy Goleniów
description: The 38th Goleniów Independence Mile is an annual one-mile race held to celebrate Independence Day in Goleniów. The event offers an opportunity to celebrate Poland’s independence together through sport, promoting a healthy lifestyle and the local community. The race takes place in Goleniów and is open to everyone, regardless of age or experience level.
course_highlights: A one-mile race
Held to celebrate Independence Day
Supports the local community and promotes physical activity
additional: The race takes place on 11 November 2026 in Goleniów and is part of the region’s Independence Day celebrations.

name: Mjølner Trail & March 2026
distance_verbose: 248 km, 124 km, 50 km, 35 km, 25.7 km, Halvmarathon

name: Refleksløpet Kristiansand
description: The Reflective Run in Kristiansand invites you to a magical evening run with headlamps on Thursday, November 13. The start and finish are at Fant Olsen in Baneheia, with registration opening at 16:30. Participants can start from 17:00, while the mass start with timing is at 18:00. The course is 4.1 km long and follows the outer edge of Baneheia, marked with reflective markers. Participants must bring a headlamp, and mulled juice and porridge will be served after the finish.

name: Amersfoort Night Run
description: The Amersfoort Night Run is a new running event taking place on Friday evening, 13 November 2026. During this unique night run, you’ll run through an atmospheric, illuminated city, past light installations, live music and surprising entertainment. The route follows the River Eem and passes through Amersfoort city centre, with views of historic landmarks such as the medieval city wall, Monnikendam, the Onze Lieve Vrouwetoren and the Koppelpoort. The event combines sport with an immersive experience and is officially timed, making it a genuine race too. After the run, there’s a lively afterparty at the KAdE Café on Eemplein to celebrate your achievement.
course_highlights: An atmospheric, illuminated course through Amersfoort city centre
Past historic landmarks such as the medieval city wall, Monnikendam, the Onze Lieve Vrouwetoren and the Koppelpoort
Entertainment along the route, including live music, bands and light installations
additional: The start and finish are at the KAdE Café on Eemplein. The event is timed, so it is an official race. After the run, there’s an afterparty where you can celebrate with other participants. Multiple distances, including a kids’ run; an illuminated route through the city; live music; entertainment; and an afterparty. Proceeds support ALS.

name: Jigler - Run by Night Barneveld

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Het bedrijvenarrangement kost 350 euro en bestaat uit: 5 startbewijzen, inclusief gratis huur chip Hardloopshirts met eigen bedrijfslogo voor jouw team Gezamenlijk pastabuffet vooraf Hapjes en drankjes na afloop (5 consumpties p.p.) Jouw merk zichtbaar tijdens de run

description: The Jigler Run by Night is Barneveld’s most atmospheric running event, taking place on Friday evening, 13 November 2026. The start and finish are at Sportpark Norschoten, the sports complex of SDV Barneveld. Participants can choose from a 5-kilometre run, a 10-kilometre run or the corporate run. The course passes through the Norschoten neighbourhood and offers an enjoyable, sporty evening, with atmosphere-enhancing accessories such as lights and fluorescent clothing. There is a special corporate run for businesses, with a pasta buffet beforehand and an after-party with a DJ and singer.
course_highlights: 5-kilometre course through the Norschoten neighbourhood
Start and finish at Sportpark Norschoten (SDV Barneveld)
The running course uses public roads, where normal traffic rules apply
additional: Toilets, changing rooms and showers are available. There are no lockers. The organisers are not liable for the loss of valuables. The corporate run requires at least three runners per team. A shared pasta buffet takes place before the corporate run, followed by an after-party with a DJ and singer. Parking is available at Sportpark Norschoten, Aeres, Schaffelaarse Bos and Vetkamp. Cycling is recommended. Parts of the route are not closed to traffic, so please pay attention to road safety. Atmosphere-enhancing accessories such as lights and luminous balloons are encouraged. The run is a nighttime event without official road closures, with parking available at SDVB and nearby. Registration is required.

name: Griseriløbet
description: Griseriløbet is a traditional fun run held by Brande Motion. The race takes place on paths and roads around Brande, and the worse

name: Gränsö Trailrun
description: Gränsö Trailrun is a running event in Gränsö Nature Reserve outside Västervik, offering technical and scenic trails, coastal rocky shorelines, and some of Sweden’s finest oak pastures around Gränsö Castle. Choose between 8 km and 15 km on well-marked courses, or let the children take part in Gränsö Kids Trail (up to age 12). The race offers both timed participation and Fun Run without timing, and encourages an enjoyable experience in nature—why not combine it with a spa visit at Gränsö Castle? Welcome to experience the Västervik archipelago at its best.
course_highlights: Coastal rocky shorelines and the cliffs of Skanvik along the course
Trails through sparse pine forest and valuable oak pastures, with technically varied sections
The 15 km course has a bonus loop on Ekholmen; the 8 km and 15 km courses join at the Kroken aid station
additional: The event center opens at 09:00 at Gränsö Castle. Start times: Gränsö Kids Trail 10:15, 8 km 11:00, 15 km 11:15. The first finishers are expected at approximately 11:35, and the finish closes at 13:45. Courses are marked with hanging red-and-white tape and signs; parts of the course follow existing hiking trails. Surface: mainly trails/hiking paths, with sections of rocky terrain, natural terrain, and short road stretches. Aid stations: one on the 8 km course and two on the 15 km course. All children receive a medal and refreshments after finishing. Registration is online and remains open until one hour before the start. 8 km and 15 km courses; online registration until one hour before the start; aid and hydration stations along the course; timed participation or Fun Run without timing; start times: 11:00 (8 km) and 11:15 (15 km); first finishers at approximately 11:35; finish closes at 13:45; spa option at Gränsö Castle.

name: Pop up Run Svartedalen
location: Bottenstugan parking, Svartedalen Nature Reserve, Sweden

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Pris: 300 kr, lättare lunch, dryck och kaka ingår.

description: Discover the magic of running in Svartedalen on a lovely 12 km trail through wilderness-like landscapes. The run takes you along winding forest paths, past mirror-still lakes and over hilly terrain that offers both a challenge and the joy of running. There are several stops along the way to enjoy the views and the special atmosphere of one of western Sweden’s most beloved natural areas. The run ends with a light lunch, a drink and cake at the shelter, creating a wonderful sense of community and an energizing morning for everyone taking part.
course_highlights: Winding forest paths through deep spruce forests
Mirror-still lakes and moss-covered sections
Hilly terrain with mountain-like landscapes
additional: The run is divided into 2–3 pace groups. Meet at the Bottenstugan parking area. After the run, a light lunch, a drink and cake are served at the shelter. Meet at 10:00 at the Bottenstugan parking area. 2–3 pace groups. A light lunch, a drink and cake are included.

description: Falktrailen is a trail race held at Falkenberg Motor Speedway in Falkenberg. The race offers lovely narrow trails and varied terrain suited to both experienced runners and recreational runners. There are several categories for women and men, as well as youth categories and children’s races. The course is mainly on trails, where trail shoes are recommended, but regular running shoes also work well. After the race, refreshments are available for purchase, and prizes are awarded to the top finishers in each category.
course_highlights: Most of the course runs along lovely narrow trails
Trail running on varied terrain
The race is held at Falkenberg Motor Speedway
additional: The children’s race starts at 10:00, with no timing, and all children receive a prize. Registration for the children’s race closes at 9:45. Refreshments are available during the event. SEK 20 per participant is donated to the Swedish Church’s fundraiser for families with children experiencing financial hardship in Falkenberg. The 2026 race is listed as starting at 10:30 from Falkenberg Motor Speedway. The date November 14, 2026 comes from the race information; another source gives November 15.

name: Mörkertrail
location: Garphyttans nationalpark entrance parking area, Lekeberg Municipality, Sweden
price_range: 250 kr för vuxna; 50 kr för deltagare under 18 år
description: Mörkertrail is a unique 10 km trail race run in total darkness in Garphyttan National Park in Lekeberg Municipality. Participants run along a reflective-marked course featuring both technical and easy-running trails, with the light from their headlamps as the only source of illumination. The race offers an atmospheric and challenging experience, with elevation gain and the quiet of the forest as companions. After finishing, participants can enjoy a grilled sausage by the fire. The start and finish are at the car park by the national park entrance, and the race starts at 17:00 on 14 November 2026.
course_highlights: 10 km trail in total darkness, with a headlamp as the only source of light
Reflective-marked course featuring both technical and easy-running trails
Course with elevation gain on the edge of Kilsbergen
additional: Race bibs can be collected from 16:00. A short briefing takes place 10 minutes before the start. No on-site registration. The national park car park has limited spaces, so please carpool. Outdoor toilets are available, but there are no changing facilities. You must bring your own headlamp with a fully charged battery. The course has muddy sections and a water station halfway. Race bibs can be collected from 16:00; sausage and a drink are included after the finish. Places are limited, and there is no on-site registration.

name: Mustaschmilen Malmö
description:
Mustaschmilen takes place at Jägersro Trotting & Galop, where the horses make way for runners for a day. We’re looking forward to a community celebration on November 14. We’ll fill the stadium with runners of all ages and welcome you whether you’re an elite runner or a recreational runner. Together with the spectators, sponsors and activities, we’ll make it an unforgettable stadium experience.

Mustaschmilen in Malmö has three distances: 5 km, 10 km and 1 km for children. The two longer races will be run on a loop course filled with upbeat music and an encouraging commentator along the 1,000-metre course.
additional:

Make sure to collect your race bib well before the start.
11:00 – 5 km start, all paces
12:15 – Children’s race start, 1 km
12:45 – 10 km start, race category
14:00 – 10 km start, recreational category

Runacademy will lead a group warm-up approximately 10 minutes before each start.

name: Torsdagsløpet
description: The Thursday run in Sarpsborg was a real Easter treat on Maundy Thursday, with glorious weather and a well-deserved break from the long-forecast rain. The run, which takes place on Thursdays until mid-October, offers lovely routes through the extensive network of trails in Kalnesskogen. Although there were a few icy sections, conditions were generally excellent for both runners and organizers.

name: BlåmansLøpene Etappe 2
description: Fjellgeitene organize group training on the courses on the Wednesday before each of this year’s Blåmansløp races. For Stage 2, the training takes place on Wednesday, November 11, starting at Damen (Fjellveien above Varegg’s clubhouse) at 18:00. Bring a headlamp, and note that the sessions are open to everyone.

name: Arborettrimmen 1
description: Arborettrimmen is a wonderful tradition that has been held since Einar Søndeland started it in 1978. It set a participation record in 1983 with 587 participants, including Grete Waitz. The race offers distances for everyone in the beautiful surroundings of the Arboretum, where you can choose to run one (2.7 km), two (5.4 km) or three (8.1 km) laps. A 600 m Mini Run for children starts at 14:00.

images.alt_text: Løpere i gang med Arborettrimmen, et terrengløp for alle aldre.
Løper nærmer seg målstreken i et terrengløp.
Vakkert landskap med innsjø og trær i solnedgang, som passer for løpet i arboretet.

name: Vintarkarusell Eikanger Løp 2
description: The second race in the 2025–26 winter series will take place on Saturday, 15 November, in Eikanger. There will be seven races this season in total, with three before Christmas and four after New Year. The course is the usual route around Eikangervågen, and registration opens at 2:20 p.m.

name: Ronjaløpet
description: Ronjaløpet 2026 is held at Austevoll Sports Facility and takes place on Saturday, November 7, 2026. This race offers a great opportunity to take part in a sporting event amid the scenic surroundings of Austevoll. The event spans two days, and tickets are sold through EQ Timing. The race is suitable for anyone looking for an active and social experience in November.
course_highlights: Held at Austevoll Sports Facility
The race takes place amid the scenic surroundings of Austevoll
The event runs from November 7 to 8, 2026
additional: Tickets are sold through EQ Timing. The event spans two days, from November 7 to 8, 2026. Tickets are sold through EQ Timing. Listings give different dates in November 2026.

name: Vinterkarusellen (Romerike) 2. løp Sørum
organizer: Lørenskog Friidrettsklubb (Sørum IL er teknisk arrangør)
description: Vinterkarusellen på Romerike is a running series organized by Lørenskog Friidrettslag, offering races for different age groups, from children to veterans. The races take place during the winter months and provide a great opportunity for both recreational and competitive runners to compete and stay in shape. The event has a long tradition and includes several distances and classes suited to different levels. Participants aged 13 to 80 must have an athletics license, which also serves as insurance.
course_highlights: Certified 5 km on the Bingenrunden
Asphalt loop course starting at Sørum school
Previous race reports describe the course as flat and suitable for fast times in good conditions
additional: Participants aged 13 to 80 must purchase an athletics license individually. Children under 13 are covered by the children's sports insurance and do not need their own license. Previous editions have offered online registration and race-day registration. Participants aged 13–80 must have an athletics license; children under 13 are covered by the children's sports insurance.

name: BlåmansLøpene - Etappe 3
description: Blåmansløpene 2026 consists of three spectacular races from Fjellveien to Blåmanen, with the start and finish at the same location, but on different routes featuring trails, nearby mountains and varied running challenges. Stage 3, held on 14 November, follows a demanding, technical course on trails towards Blåmanen, finishing at Tindevann. The race is suited to runners who enjoy challenging terrain and technical sections, and trail shoes are recommended. Varegg IL welcomes everyone to a great running experience in beautiful surroundings in Bergen.
course_highlights: Start at Fjellveien by «Damen» and finish at Tindevann
Technically challenging trails up Blåmanen through varied terrain
The course includes trails such as Permisjonstien, Sandviksbatteriet, Rundemanen and Blåmansveien
additional: Trail shoes are recommended for the technical sections. The course includes challenging climbs and technical trails. The start and finish are at the same location for all three races. Entry fees are paid by bank transfer or VIPPS to Varegg Fleridrett. The organizer recommends trail shoes; the course is technical, and runners accustomed to trail terrain may have an advantage.

tiers.label: tier_1

tiers.label: tier_3

description: Sognefjord Backyard is a unique backyard ultra race held in Sogndal on Saturday, 14 November 2026, starting at 08:00 from Meieriet. The race consists of a 6.7 km loop with approximately 45 metres of elevation gain, run every hour on the hour. Participants have one hour to complete each loop. The competition continues until only one participant remains who has completed one more loop than everyone else. This race challenges both endurance and mental strength, and is suited to runners who want to test themselves in a unique format with no fixed distance.
course_highlights: 6.7 km loop with approximately 45 metres of elevation gain
Start and finish at Meieriet in Sogndal
The course follows pavements and shared pedestrian and cycle paths, in both daylight and darkness
additional: Maximum 100 participants. Minimum age: 18. Start and finish at Meieriet, which also serves as a base with space for drop bags and rest. The café at Meieriet is open for food and drink purchases, but participants must arrange their own provisions. Assistance and provisions are only permitted in the start and finish area. Each participant may have one dedicated support person in the participant area. Registration is binding and non-refundable, but the entry can be transferred to another person via Racetracker. Warnings are given 3 and 1 minute before each start. One winner is declared: the participant who completes one more loop than everyone else; otherwise, there is no winner. Start at Meieriet in Sogndal at 08:00 on Saturday, 14 November 2026. If you cannot complete the loop within the hour, you are out of the race.

name: Hvamrunners Indoor 200m 1 hour
location: Nes Arena, Neskollen, Nes, Akershus, Norway
description: Hvamrunners Indoor 1 hour is an indoor race held on a 200-meter track at Nes Arena, Neskollen. The race lasts one hour, during which participants compete to run as many laps as possible. The event can accommodate up to 30 participants and uses technical solutions for timing and lap updates during the race. This race is part of Hvam Runners’ training and racing activities and offers a unique opportunity to test endurance and speed in a controlled indoor environment.
course_highlights: Indoor 200-meter athletics track
One-hour race to run as many laps as possible
Limited to 30 participants for ample space and a clear overview
additional: Maximum 30 participants per race. Technical solutions for timing and lap updates to participants during the race are being tested. The event can accommodate up to 30 participants. The event is testing technical solutions for timing and lap updates.

name: Alten-Busecker Winterlaufserie - 1. Event
description: The Alten-Buseck Winter Running Series is a long-standing running event held in the Buseck/Alten-Buseck region. It comprises several races over different distances, including 2 km, 5 km, 10 km, 15 km and a half marathon (21.1 km). The races each start at 2:00 p.m. at the Harbig Hall in Alten-Buseck and offer a friendly atmosphere for runners of all ages and ability levels. The series promotes a sense of community with a series classification for participants who take part in all three races. Refreshments and an awards ceremony for the fastest runners follow the finish.
course_highlights: Course profiles for 5 km, 10 km, 15 km and 21.1 km are available on Komoot
Start and finish at the Harbig Hall in Alten-Buseck
Timing with a passive transponder from Raceresult
additional: Timing is provided using passive transponders from Raceresult. There is a series classification for participants who take part in all three races in the series. After finishing, runners receive a complimentary soft drink. Coffee and cake are available for purchase. Toilets, showers and changing facilities are available at the Harbig Hall. The awards ceremony takes place after the races, recognising the three fastest participants (men/women) in each race on the day, as well as the age-group winners at the end of the series. Winter running series, cross-country character, several race distances, community event in November 2026

name: Bezirksmeisterschaften Crosslauf
description: The District Cross-Country Championships in Velpke are a long-standing cross-country running competition organized by the NLV Braunschweig District. The event gives runners of various age groups, from children to Masters, the opportunity to compete in cross-country running. The course crosses varied terrain and offers a challenging test for all participants. Online registration is open until February 1, 2026, and the event takes place on February 8, 2026.
course_highlights: Cross-country course through varied terrain
Competition for children, youth, adults, and Masters
Organized by the NLV Braunschweig District in Velpke
additional: Online registration is open until February 1, 2026, at 23:59. The organizer is the NLV Braunschweig District. The event category is 6.4.2 District Championships. Cross-country terrain; registration deadline is February 1, 2026; various course distances, including children’s and youth categories.

name: Biegerparklauf
location: Biegerpark, Duisburg-Huckingen, Duisburg, North Rhine-Westphalia, Germany
description: The Biegerparklauf in Duisburg-Huckingen is an officially DLV-measured race on asphalt, with distances of 1.2 km for schoolchildren, 5 km for everyone, and 10 km for youth and adults. The races follow a loop through Biegerpark, with the final 300 meters run on the stadium’s cinder track. All participants receive certificates; schoolchildren and Bambinis receive Weckmänner, and the top runners are awarded medals. The event is organized by Sportgemeinschaft Duisburg-Süd 98/20 e.V. and offers a family-friendly atmosphere for runners of all ages.
course_highlights: Loop through Biegerpark on asphalt
10 km runners complete 3 laps; 5 km runners complete 2 laps
The final 300 meters are on the stadium’s cinder track
additional: Late entries are possible in limited numbers on the event day, up to 30 minutes before the start. Certificates are issued online and at the venue, where there may be a wait. Schoolchildren and Bambinis receive Weckmänner at the finish. The event provides sports liability insurance under the NRW sports aid insurance agreement. The final 300 meters are run on the stadium’s cinder track. Course: loop through Biegerpark, paved paths, final 300 m on the cinder track; dates and registration by email; start times for different age groups; medals and Weckmänner for children.

name: Bokeler 6 Stundenlauf
description: The Bokeler 6-Hour Run is an established ultramarathon challenge in northern Germany, held in Bokel, Schleswig-Holstein. Participants run a loop course approximately 3.67 kilometres long, completing as many laps as possible in six hours. The event attracts endurance athletes looking to test their limits and offers a family-friendly atmosphere in scenic surroundings.
course_highlights: 3.67 km loop course
Flat terrain in Schleswig-Holstein
Six-hour run with individually determined distance
additional: The course is a loop that runners complete multiple times. The event is a longstanding tradition and takes place annually. Results from previous years are available on the website. The race is held on a 2,040 m loop course, with a growing number of participants and a legendary refreshment buffet. A participant record was set in 2023, and the event was already fully booked well in advance for 2024. November weather is usually cool and rainy, adding to the challenge.

name: Deutsche Polizeimeisterschaften Crosslauf
description: The German Police Cross-Country Championships are the police’s official cross-country running championships and focus on competition within the police force. The event takes place in Ravensbergerwald in Potsdam and features distances of 3.6 km and 9 km. The races are part of a wider German running series regulated by the German Athletics Association (DLV), with officially measured courses and professional timing. Registration is usually handled through the regional athletics associations. The race offers a challenging cross-country experience in typical November weather, with cool temperatures and frequent rain.
course_highlights: Cross-country running in Ravensbergerwald
Officially measured courses of 3.6 km and 9 km
Part of the DLV-regulated police championships
additional: Typical November weather: around 7 °C, a low of 2 °C, an average of 45 mm of precipitation, and rainy days. Registration is usually handled through the regional athletics associations. The event is not an open road race but is exclusively for police runners. It is not open to the general public and is organized within the police force. The challenging course includes uphill and downhill sections and sandy terrain.

name: Graal-Müritzer Schneckenlauf
description: The Graal-Müritz Schneckenlauf is a long-standing running event held annually at the Graal-Müritz Forest Stadium. Runners and walkers of all ages can choose from several distances, including a Bambini race, 2 km, 5 km and 10 km. The event is known for its friendly atmosphere, good organization, and awards for the strongest classes and best teams. The Streuselschnecken pastries served after the finish are especially popular.
course_highlights: Red course: 2 km run
Blue course: 5 km and 10 km (2 x 5 km laps)
Start and finish at the Graal-Müritz Forest Stadium
additional: Start times: 10:00 a.m. Bambini race, 10:30 a.m. 2 km run, 11:00 a.m. 5 km and 10 km runs. Walkers start 5 minutes after the runners. Training for children takes place on Wednesdays from 4:30–6:00 p.m. in the sports hall at Ostseegrundschule. Traditional awards are given to the strongest class and best team. Streuselschnecken pastries are a popular post-race treat. The race takes place at the Forest Stadium. Advance registration is available, with categories for children and adults as well as team and class competitions.

name: Gudensberger Crosslauf 2026 Hermann Kilian Gedächtnislauf
description: The Gudensberg Crosslauf Hermann Kilian Memorial Run is a long-standing cross-country race in Gudensberg, offering short off-road distances. The start and finish are on a dirt track and meadow below the Terrano swimming pool on Schwimmbadweg. The course runs mostly on unpaved paths, and spikes are allowed, emphasizing its classic cross-country character. The event commemorates Hermann Kilian, a dedicated runner and coach with TSV Obervorschütz.
course_highlights: Start and finish on a dirt track and meadow below the Terrano swimming pool
Course mostly on unpaved paths; spikes allowed
Three distances: 1000m (two small laps), 2000m (two large laps), 4000m (one longer lap)
additional: Depending on the event announcement, district championships may be included. Typical November weather is expected, with temperatures around 7 °C and rainy days. November is usually rainy; the terrain has a cross-country style. The event honors Hermann Kilian for his dedication to running.

name: Landesoffener Crosslauf des KLV Segeberg
description: The KLV Segeberg open cross-country race takes place every November in Kaltenkirchen Leisure Park. It offers races for children, youth, adults and Masters, with distances ranging from approximately 625 m to 7.9 km. The event is open to runners from across Schleswig-Holstein. The course runs across meadows, parks and wooded areas, offering a varied alternative to traditional road or track races. The event is organised by KLV Segeberg and Kaltenkirchener TS, which also hosts it on site.
course_highlights: Distances of approximately 625 m to 7.9 km
The course runs through Kaltenkirchen Leisure Park, across meadows, parks and wooded areas
Open event with categories for children, youth, adults and Masters
additional: Typical November weather, around 7 °C, with rainy days. The event is part of the KLV Segeberg cross-country championship series, which also includes other local club venues in the Segeberg district. Cross-country running in November in typical rainy weather, with temperatures around 2–7 °C, on an outdoor course, suitable for trail running and cross-country fans.

name: Neusser Erftlauf
description: The Neuss Erftlauf is a traditional running event organized annually by DJK Novesia 1919 Neuss e.V. The 53rd edition takes place on 14 November 2026 and offers runners of different ability levels an attractive course along the Erft. The event is known for its friendly atmosphere, good organization, and support from numerous sponsors. The 15 km main race is especially popular and has attracted many more participants in recent years.
course_highlights: 15 km main race with a construction detour; the 5 km loop is eligible for rankings
Course along the Erft with varied terrain
Refreshment stations and drinking water at Durstlöscher
additional: The Erftlauf is supported by numerous volunteers, who help ensure the event runs smoothly along the course, in the start and finish areas, and at refreshment stations. Sponsors include the RheinLand Versicherungsgruppe, Stadtwerke Neuss, and other partners. There is a construction detour on the 15 km course, but the 5 km loop remains eligible for rankings. An extensive photo album is available online. Courses on paved paths and roads; spikes are not allowed; online registration opens on 01.09.2025; start times from 11:30 a.m.; medals for children; prizes in kind for winners; limited parking; showers available.

name: Potsdamer Cross im Rahmen der 22. DPM
description: The 2nd Potsdam Cross, held as part of the 22nd German Police Championships (DPM), takes place on November 14, 2026, in Potsdam. The event is organized and hosted by OSC Potsdam Luftschiffhafen e.V., Athletics Department. It offers runners the opportunity to compete in a challenging cross-country race and take part in a long-standing competition series. Registration is open until November 9, 2026.
course_highlights: Participation in the German Cross Championships (DPM)
Off-stadium course in Potsdam
Event held as part of a national championship
additional: The entry deadline is November 9, 2026; the scenic venue offers a varied cross-country course.

name: Steverlauf
location: Sportpark Senden, Senden, North Rhine-Westphalia, Germany
description: The Steverlauf is an established running event held annually at Sportpark Senden, welcoming runners of all ages. The courses over 5 km and 10 km, officially measured by the DLV, run along park paths and paths beside the canal, offering an attractive running setting. Children and young people have a separate entry option at a reduced entry fee. The event takes place in all weather conditions and offers changing and shower facilities, as well as refreshments including coffee, cake, soup and bratwurst. The organizing team looks forward to welcoming many participants and to a successful event.
course_highlights: Courses over 5 km and 10 km, officially measured by the DLV
Routes run along park paths and paths beside the canal
Changing and shower facilities at Sportpark Senden
additional: Refreshments including coffee, tea, cake, biscuits, soup and bratwurst provided by roterkeil Senden e.V. The event takes place in all weather conditions. No liability for damages. Changing and shower facilities are available. Routes pass through Schloss Senden, along the canal and through Königspark; there is a good supply of cake, drinks and hot food; the event can take place in any weather.

name: Wuppertaler Löwenlauf
description: The Wuppertal Löwenlauf is an exciting running event taking place on November 14, 2026, in Wuppertal. Organized by Leichtathletik-Verband Nordrhein e.V., the race offers a challenging cross-country or forest course in a natural setting. The event is open to runners of all ability levels and promises a sporting experience in a motivating atmosphere. It is a great opportunity to experience the running community in Wuppertal and enjoy nature.
course_highlights: Cross-country/forest run in a natural setting
Challenging terrain for different ability levels
Outdoor event in Wuppertal in November
additional: The race is a forest and cross-country event; details about course distance and registration are not specified.

name: W rytmie biegu, w rytmie jeziora
Vijfhoekparkloop
description: Saturday, October 26 is the first Vijfhoekpark Run of 2024! The other runs are on November 9 and 30. This relaxed fun run takes pla

name: Lage Vuursche Trail
description: The Lage Vuursche Trail is a challenging, varied trail with many single tracks, sandy paths and forest trails, located in the unique area of the U

name: Wine and Dine Buitenpepers
description: Wine and Dine Buitenpepers is a welcoming neighbourhood dinner taking place on Saturday evening, 14 November, in Buitenpepers, a lively neighbourhood in ’s-Hertogenbosch. The event brings local residents together for an unforgettable evening of good company, delicious food and wine, held throughout the neighbourhood. It is a wonderful opportunity to meet one another and strengthen the community in a warm, festive atmosphere.
course_highlights: Neighbourhood meal with a variety of dishes
Friendly and festive atmosphere
Strengthening the community
additional: The event is a neighbourhood dinner held throughout the area, where residents gather to share a meal and wine. It is a social event, not a competition, organised by the De Buitenpepers neighbourhood association. Activities calendar, neighbourhood gatherings, neighbourhood meal, neighbourhood dinner, community support

name: Fakkeltoget Løvstakken
description: The Løvstakken Torchlight Procession is an enjoyable mountain hike for all ages, held every year in support of the Norwegian Cancer Society. No particular level of fitness is required, and you’re welcome to come without children. The hike up Løvstakken begins as darkness falls and the city lights become visible. At the summit, there’s a medal ceremony, a barbecue and other fun activities, before everyone lights their torches for the group hike back down. Pizza, mulled wine and gingerbread are served at the finish.

name: Perseløpet 3km, 10km
description: Perseløpet 3km & 10km is an exciting running race held on a scenic route in Eidsvoll. The course is fast and flat, designed for records, and AIMS-approved. The race is open to both beginners and experienced runners and offers a great opportunity to experience the running community. Results are available immediately after the finish, and free parking is available.

images.alt_text: Løper i Perseløpet. Kvinne i løp. Viser fokus og intensitet.
Illustrasjon av mangfoldige mennesker, som representerer fellesskapet i løpemiljøet.

name: 1. Volkslauf Seelze
description: The ADAC Marathon Hannover offers a varied running experience with distances from 4 to 42 km, including the marathon, half marathon, marathon relay, 10 km run and handbike marathon. The course is one of the flattest in Germany, with just 19 m of elevation difference, making it ideal for fast times. The event combines an urban atmosphere, modern music and green stretches, taking runners through the city centre and past notable Hannover landmarks. In addition to the sporting competition, participants can enjoy a varied programme of events featuring an expo, Power Party and finisher celebration.
course_highlights: Flat course with just 19 m of elevation difference
Route through the city centre and past notable Hannover landmarks
A range of distances from 4 to 42 km, including relay and handbike events
additional: Race packs are distributed at the Marathon Expo over marathon weekend. The course is very flat and therefore ideal for fast times. Live tracking is available via the ADAC Marathon app. Massage facilities and showers are available. The programme includes the ROSSMANN Power Party, the expo and a finisher party at the brewery. Free public transport on the event day is included. Information about the course, registration, results and photos is available on the event website. The race is part of a broad Laufpass programme featuring a variety of events in the Hannover region.

name: Bremer Kuhcross QX
description: The Kuhcross is a challenging and varied cross-country race organised by ATS Buntentor Bremen. It gives runners the opportunity to test themselves on demanding terrain and enjoy the ultimate cross-country experience. The event traditionally takes place in Bremen in November and attracts cross-country enthusiasts from the region.
course_highlights: Challenging and varied cross-country terrain
A traditional event in Bremen
Organised by ATS Buntentor Bremen
additional: The race is open to children, young people and active runners, with various categories and a family-friendly atmosphere.

name: Lila-Eule-Cross
description: The 37th Lila-Eule-Cross in Kappeln is a long-running cross-country race on the Schlei that is very popular with runners. At the most recent edition, 308 runners reached the finish, setting a participation record. The course is known for its autumn atmosphere and for being less muddy than in previous years, making the race especially appealing. The event is organised by the Schleswig-Holstein Athletics Association and offers a sporting challenge in a natural setting.
course_highlights: Traditional cross-country race on the Schlei
Autumn atmosphere and strong performances
Less muddy course than in previous years
additional: Cross-country race on a varied course along the Schlei, including children’s and youth races, with a focus on autumn weather and state championships.

name: Volksbank run Crosslauf Beach Edition
description: The Volksbank run Crosslauf Beach Edition takes place in Xanten, with the 5 km race as the main distance. The race is held on an afternoon in November and promises a cross-country feel on the beach, setting it apart from a regular road race. Alongside the main distance, there are shorter 400 m races and longer 7.5 km races, offering suitable distances for both young and experienced runners. Children’s and youth races are also part of the program. The finish line for all races is at Am Meerend 2 in Xanten.
course_highlights: Cross-country feel on the beach
Distances from 400 m to 7.5 km
Finish line at Am Meerend 2 in Xanten
additional: Typical November weather, with temperatures of around 7 °C, lows of around 2 °C, and rainy weather on most days. Results are linked via RUNME.de. Children’s and youth races, a weather-dependent November event, outdoor atmosphere at Naturbad Xantener Südsee

name: Grand Prix Powiatu Kościerskiego
description: The Kościan County Grand Prix is a series of five 5 km races, organized by all the municipalities in Kościan County under the patronage of the Kościan County Governor. Its aim is to promote physical activity, healthy competition, and community integration. Residents of the county who turn 16 in 2025 may participate. Each race requires a separate entry fee, and the overall standings are based on the total points earned across the races.
course_highlights: A series of five 5 km races
Organized by all the municipalities in Kościan County
Separate standings for women and men, with no age categories
additional: Participation in the Grand Prix is free; only the entry fee for each individual race, set locally, is payable. The races are scheduled from June to December 2025 in various locations across the county. Points from the individual races are added together, with prizes for the top 6 women and top 6 men, as well as additional special prizes from the organizers of the individual races. The series comprises five 5 km races held from June to December, with overall standings and prizes for the top finishers. The main 10 km race is scheduled for 15 November 2026 in Kościerzyna, with typical autumn weather and possible rain.

location: Zajazd Szmaragd, ul. Kopalniana, Szczecin, Poland

description: Grand Prix CITY TRAIL with the Lotto Foundation is a nationwide series of 5 km cross-country races held in 7 locations, including Szczecin. The races take place in beautiful woodland surroundings by Lake Szmaragdowe, with a course suitable for both beginners and advanced runners. Each race is an opportunity to test yourself on the same course, and results from individual races count toward the series standings. The organizers promote outdoor physical activity and a healthy lifestyle.
course_highlights: A 5 km course through woodland beside Lake Szmaragdowe
A varied course profile with climbs and descents, including the most challenging section about 1.7 km from the start
The start and finish are located behind Zajazd Szmaragd, at ul. Kopalniana
additional: The race office opens at 8:30 and closes at 10:30. The main race starts at 11:00. A charity package supporting the Siepomaga Foundation is available for purchase. Participants can collect their race number and timing chip at the race office on race day. A pass for the entire series entitles the holder to one free start in another city in the series, after notifying the organizers by email in advance. The main race is scheduled to start at 11:00. Registration is available online at citytrail.pl/zapisy or at the race office on race day. The main race is open to participants aged 16 or older, or those who turn 16 in 2026; CITY TRAIL Junior is also held alongside the event.

name: Bertusloop
description: The Bertusloop is held on the 3rd Sunday of every month, except in July and August. This recreational fun run

name: Hafkamp Groenewegen De Ronde Venen Marathon
Chocolademelkloop
description: The Chocolademelkloop is a friendly family running event in the forests of Bilthoven, suitable for runners of all levels. On Sunday, November 15, 2026, participants can choose from distances of 1, 2, or 5 kilometers. The event is known for its warm atmosphere, delicious hot chocolate afterward, and the presence of Piets who take part in the run. It is a sporty, accessible event where young and old can enjoy being active in nature together.
course_highlights: Run through the forest of Bilthoven
Mostly unpaved paths
A friendly family run with Piets and hot chocolate
additional: Parents registered for the 2 or 5 km can join their child in the 1 km family run at no extra cost. The 1 km family run is aimed at children aged 3–8 and follows mostly unpaved forest paths. There is a prize draw, with prizes awarded among all participants regardless of their time. The start and finish area is at the Werkplaats in Bilthoven. Distances: 1 km, 2 km, 5 km; no timing; parents can run alongside their children for free; start and finish at the Werkplaats grounds

name: De Knikker Zegerplasloop
location: Zegerplas, Alphen aan den Rijn, South Holland, Netherlands
description: The Knikker Zegerplasloop is a running series consisting of three races in November, January and February, organised by AAV'36 in Alphen aan den Rijn. The races take place around the Zegerplas and offer distances of 5, 10, 15 and 20 km, as well as 400 m and 1,000 m youth races on the athletics track. The course is almost entirely free of traffic and runs through the Zegersloot area and around the Zegerplas, making it suitable for both beginner and experienced runners. The start and finish are on the AAV'36 athletics track, where changing rooms, showers, a canteen and a massage room are also available.
course_highlights: An almost entirely traffic-free course through the Zegersloot area and around the Zegerplas
Distances range from 400 m for children to 20 km for adults
Start and finish on the AAV'36 athletics track, with facilities including changing rooms and showers
additional: Official timekeeping is provided by MyLaps. Walkers can choose 5 km and 10 km routes, with a time limit of 2 hours; they start at the same time as the 20 km running race. There is no drinks station along the Aarkanaal because plastic cups are prohibited, but water is available at the finish and at a drinks station on the track for 15 km and 20 km runners on their second lap. Free leg massages are available in the massage room, provided by Running & Walkingcenter Alphen aan den Rijn. Changing rooms, showers, a canteen and a limited number of lockers are available. Registration is via the website. Free leg massages are provided by Running & Walkingcenter Alphen aan den Rijn. Winter conditions are possible.

name: Sterke Start Loop 2026
description:
Whether you’re going for 5, 10 or 21 kilometres, every route takes you through the beautiful natural area around Zevenhuizen.
You’ll run alongside water, through the forest and on (mostly) paved paths. It’s a varied course, with a different challenge for each distance.
Whichever distance you choose, every step helps give the tiniest babies a strong start.
course_highlights: Routes through nature, alongside water and through the forest
Mostly paved surfaces, with unpaved paths on the 21 km route
1 km Kids Run with obstacles for children
additional:
Stand up for the tiniest babies
On Sunday 15 November, World Prematurity Day, the whole of the Netherlands gets moving during the Sterke Start Loop. The run for everyone who wants to give the tiniest babies a strong start.
The live event takes place in Zevenhuizen, but with your home-entry ticket you can take part wherever and whenever you like during the week leading up to 15 November.
New this year is the Kids Run in Zevenhuizen. Children run 1 km, with a few obstacles at the end. These symbolise the challenges that babies born prematurely have to overcome.
Together, we stand up for the tiniest babies. By taking part, you’ll raise money for research, kangaroo care chairs and parental support, and help give every child the best possible start.
Take part and make a difference.

name: Loetcross
description: The Loetcross in Lekkerkerk is a challenging cross-country race taking place on 15 November 2026. The course crosses varied terrain, including grass, shell paths and ditch edges, offering a varied and natural running experience. Several distances are available, ranging from 1.2 km to 7.2 km, to suit different ages and abilities. The race is known for its rugged character, so shoes are guaranteed not to stay clean. Pre-registration is open until 13 November 2026.
course_highlights: Cross-country course over grass, shell paths and along ditch edges
Distances ranging from 1.2 km to 7.2 km
Natural, varied terrain with challenging sections
additional: Women may enter the 7.2 km long-distance race, but their participation is not included in the women’s competition or prize-giving. Shoes will not stay clean during the race because of the terrain. Fields marked with * are mandatory when registering. The event includes several race categories for different ages and abilities, and registration is required.

name: Bommelasloop
description: The Bommelasloop is a popular recreational trail run that has been organised by Rekreatie Sport Twente for many years. The run takes place in the beautiful Het Buurserzand Natura 2000 area, between Enschede and Haaksbergen. There are four different distances, so every runner can find a suitable challenge. The start is at 11:00, and participants receive a free refreshment afterwards. The atmosphere is relaxed and focused on recreation, with no prize-giving or medals.
course_highlights: Trail run in the Het Buurserzand Natura 2000 area
Four distances: 7.6 km, 11.7 km, 16 km and 20.5 km
Start and finish at Camping Twente in Enschede
additional: Late registration and race-number collection are possible on the day from 09:45 to 10:50, subject to availability. There is no prize-giving or medal, but participants can receive a refreshment by handing in their race number at the bar at the campsite. Cycling is recommended because parking is limited. Trail run in Buurserzand; registration on the day is possible; no prize-giving or medal; free refreshment afterwards; dogs and wheelchairs are not allowed.

name: Sytze Wetting Trail
location: Outdoor centrum Copini, Leeuwarden, Friesland, Netherlands
description: The Sytze Wetting Trail is an annual trail run organised by AV Lionitas in the Lytse en Grutte Wielen nature reserve near Leeuwarden. The trail features an adventurous course made mostly of unpaved paths, grass and narrow trails, with enjoying nature at its heart. There are three distances: 19 km, 7.9 km and a 1 km Kids Run. The race is more challenging than a road race and requires good trail shoes or shoes with grip. Free snert is served to participants afterwards.
course_highlights: Mostly unpaved course through the Lytse en Grutte Wielen nature reserve
Adventurous route over grass and narrow trails
Your feet may get wet; good trail shoes or shoes with lugged soles are recommended
additional: Changing facilities and showers are available. Racks are provided for storing bags. Refreshments are available on the course and after the race. Please park at Kleine Wielen (Groene Ster), not at Restaurant Groote Wielen. After the race, free snert is provided by Restaurant de Groote Wielen. The trail runs through a nature reserve over unpaved terrain, with the start and finish near Outdoor centrum Copini, Leeuwarden, and refreshments and free snert afterwards.

name: Necon Vinterkarusellen Løp 2
description: Necon Winter Series continues today with the season’s second race, which takes place at Fana Stadium. Race numbers can be collected in the gym from 17:00, and a limited selection of Necon Winter Series Craft products will be available for sale. Payment is by Vipps only, and live results from the race will be available after 19:15.

name: Necon Vinterkarusell 26-27 løp 2 (16. nov)
description: Necon Vinterkarusell is a winter race series with 8 races throughout the winter, where participants can choose between 5 or 10 km. The start and finish are at Fana Stadion in Bergen, with races starting at 18:45. The races are held on Mondays from October to April, and discounts are available for members of IL Gneist. Registration is individual through EQ-timing, and members of the athletics groups with a valid license may participate for free.
course_highlights: 5 or 10 km race
Start and finish at Fana Stadion
Evening races starting at 18:45
additional: Discounts for IL Gneist members: free for athletics members with main club membership and training fees (use code Gneist00), 50% off for Gneist recreational members (code Gneist50), and 25% off for other Gneist members (code Gneist25). An annual license must be selected during registration, otherwise a fee of 50 kr will apply. Registration is through individual registration in EQ-timing. Registration is individual via EQ Timing. Without an annual license, 50 kr is charged at registration.

name: Snøkuten Glestadrunden
description: Snøkuten Glestadrunden is a trail race held in Innlandet on February 10. The race offers distances of 7.4 km and 9.5 km and is designed to provide an exciting and challenging experience for participants of all levels. Participants will have the opportunity to experience beautiful scenery and challenging terrain.

name: Hamarkarusellen Vinter Løp 2
description: Hamarkarusellen Vinter is the winter edition of Hamarkarusellen. Unlike the summer version, all races follow the same 5-kilometre course on lit pedestrian and cycle paths in the Prestrud area of Hamar. We keep the same officially measured 5-kilometre course for every race, making it an excellent opportunity to use as a test race. Everyone is welcome, whatever their ambitions: walkers (untimed or timed), runners (untimed or timed), those who want to compete with themselves or beat the neighbour, and active super-runners.

name: Østmarka Trail Challenge
description: Østmarka Trail Challenge organizes tough and challenging trail races in Østmarka. This race, taking place on Saturday, August 23, 2025, is not for the faint-hearted, as it features 37 km of technically demanding terrain and nearly 1,000 metres of elevation gain. Participants will experience trails that cross rough, rocky ground, and after many hours of preparation, they will feel ready for this challenge.

images.alt_text: Kart over Østmarka Trail løp, som viser ruten gjennom skogen.

name: Hodelyktløpet Østmarka
description: Østmarka Trail Challenge – The Headlamp Race is a technically demanding trail race of approximately 12 km, running mainly on blue- and red-marked trails in Østmarka. The route will be marked all the way by the organizers, but there is definitely a chance of taking a wrong turn, so it is important to pay close attention, especially at trail junctions. A good headlamp is essential! From the start at Skullerud, we follow the Flyktningeruta up to Rundvann, before taking the technically challenging blue trail downhill.

name: Hodelyktløpet i Østmarka
description: The Headlamp Run in Østmarka is a technically demanding trail race of approximately 12 km, mainly following blue- and red-marked trails in Østmarka. The race takes place in the evening, starting at 19:30, and a good headlamp is required to navigate in the dark. Runners face challenging terrain with 400 metres of elevation gain. The race offers a nature experience in beautiful surroundings, with demanding trails. There are no food or drink stations along the route, so runners must bring their own drinks.
course_highlights: Approximately 12 km of technically demanding trail running
The course follows blue- and red-marked trails in Østmarka
400 metres of elevation gain and demanding trails, with a risk of going off course
additional: Race numbers can be collected at Skullerud park between 18:15 and 19:00 on race day. There are good parking options and public transport to the start area. Indoor changing facilities and luggage storage are available. The course is marked throughout, but runners are advised to pay close attention to avoid going off course. There are no food or drink stations during the race, so runners must bring their own drinks. Participation is at your own risk. The start and finish are by the entrance towards Østmarkaporten. Start at 19:30, with space for up to 200 participants.

name: Finnensturm
location: Sport- und Solepark Große Wiese, Arnsberg-Hüsten, North Rhine-Westphalia, Germany
description: The Finnensturm is an evening race in November on a joint-friendly Finnish track at the Große Wiese Sports and Saline Park in Arnsberg-Hüsten. The 1,000-metre-long and 2.50-metre-wide track has a soft, springy surface that provides a pleasant running surface, different from asphalt or synthetic tracks. The course is lit in the evening, creating a special atmosphere for runners of all ages. The event attracts several hundred participants each year and is ideal for a November race with a great atmosphere.
course_highlights: Run on a 1,000 m-long, joint-friendly Finnish track
Soft, springy surface instead of asphalt or synthetic track
The course is lit in the evening, creating a special atmosphere
additional: The Finnish track is 2.50 m wide and runs independently of the rest of the path network. It is lit from 5:00 a.m. and in the evening until 11:00 p.m. The Große Wiese Sports and Saline Park is signposted from the Hüsten exit on the A46. The event takes place on a woodchip track at the Hüsten Sports and Saline Park; in November, weather conditions can make it wet and slippery. Refreshments and showers are available on site.

name: USP Night Run - powered by Runnersworld Utrecht
description: The USP Night Run is an atmospheric night run through the illuminated Utrecht Science Park, with distances for both adults and children. The route passes through the beautiful, illuminated Botanical Gardens, creating a unique and spectacular running experience. The event offers an enjoyable and sporty evening, with an atmospheric start and finish area, water stations along the route and at the finish. Teams and companies are also welcome to take part together, with extra options such as running shirts and pasta meals.
course_highlights: Run through the illuminated Utrecht Science Park
Spectacular passage through the illuminated Botanical Gardens
Distances of 5 km, 10 km and 15 km, plus kids’ runs of 800 m and 1.5 km
additional: Start and finish at Sportcentrum Olympos. There are start corrals and water stations along the route and at the finish. Optional extras when registering: USP Night Run shirt, cancellation insurance, pasta meal. Company teams can participate in their own running shirts and with drink tokens. First name on the race bib with registration chip. The event supports charities and offers discounts and extras such as a running shirt and pasta meal.

name: Utrecht Science Park Night Run
description: The Utrecht Science Park Night Run is an atmospheric running race taking place on Friday evening, 20 November 2026. Participants run through the illuminated Utrecht Science Park, including a spectacular passage through the illuminated Botanical Gardens. Several distances are available, including 5 km, 10 km, 15 km and kids’ runs. The event is organised by Central Events and supports the charity Stichting ALS Nederland.
course_highlights: Run through the illuminated Utrecht Science Park
Spectacular passage through the illuminated Botanical Gardens
Distances of 5 km, 10 km and 15 km, plus kids’ runs
additional: Start and finish at Sportcentrum Olympos. There are start waves and a race with a prize ceremony. Optional extras when registering include a running shirt, cancellation insurance and a pasta meal. There is also a special kids’ run of 800 metres and 1.5 km. Registration includes options for shirts, insurance, a pasta meal and donations to ALS; proceeds go to Stichting ALS Nederland.

name: Derko Night Trail
description: The Derko Night Trail is the region of Utrecht’s premier running event in the dark, organized by BodyRun and IJ-run together with many volunteers. The start and finish are at Skipiste Nieuwegein, where a lively afterparty is also held. The trail runs through a beautiful nature area and offers various distances for both trail and paved-surface runners. Participants must use a headlamp because the event takes place in the dark, adding to its unique atmosphere.
course_highlights: Trail runs on unpaved paths through a nature area
Start and finish at Skipiste Nieuwegein with catering facilities
The route is marked with reflectors and ribbons; headlamps are mandatory
additional: All participants must use a headlamp because the event takes place in the dark; it is mandatory for the trails and recommended for the fun run. The route is marked with reflectors and ribbons. Mixed changing facilities and first aid are available. The event aims to reduce the use of cups; participants take their own waste with them. After the event, there is an afterparty at the catering venue by the start/finish. Trail and paved routes, headlamp mandatory, online registration, charities supported

name: 24H Online Running
description: 24H Online Running is a unique race that takes place over 24 hours, where participants can choose to run, walk, or cycle. This event offers the possibi

name: Bislett 24 Hour Indoor
description: Bislett 24-hour is a unique indoor race held at the famous Bislett Stadium in Oslo. Participants have 24 hours to run as far as possible around the 542-meter track. The event attracts both experienced ultrarunners and beginners who want to test their limits in a supportive and motivating environment. The race is sold out, and prizes include a large achievement medal for those who reach 150 km (men) and 130 km (women).
