name: Oudjaarsrun
description: On 31 December 2026, LSV Invictus will organize the second edition of the Oudjaarsrun in Appelscha, a sporting event to end the year actively. Participants can choose between two distances: 5 km and 10 km. The course is fully paved and runs through the beautiful Drents-Friese Wold National Park, with the start and finish in the center of Appelscha. After the finish, there will be an opportunity to celebrate the sporting year with music and a convivial atmosphere in the Steegdenhal.
course_highlights: Fully paved course
Run through Drents-Friese Wold National Park
Start and finish in the center of Appelscha, on Boerestreek
additional: Bib pickup and the awards ceremony will take place in the Steegdenhal. After the event, there will be a festive gathering with music and a convivial atmosphere. Ample parking is available for participants and visitors. Start times are 11:00 and 11:10. Parking is available at Pretpark Duinenzathe and in the center of Appelscha. Participants can choose between 5 km and 10 km. Festive gathering in the Steegdenhal.

name: Oliebollenloop
description: The Oliebollenloop is the final sporting challenge of the year in the north, held on 31 December in and around Gorredijk. The race offers 4-mile and 10 km distances, with separate starts for solo runners and businesses. There is also a kids’ run with three distances for different age groups. The route is safe from traffic and well marked, and a delicious reward awaits afterwards: oliebollen.
course_highlights: 4-mile and 10 km courses through Gorredijk with aid stations
Low-traffic route with traffic marshals for safety
Kids’ run with distances of 600m, 900m and 1600m for different age groups
additional: Kids’ run start times: 600m at 10:45, 900m at 11:00, 1600m at 11:15. 10 km starts at 12:05, 4 miles at 12:20. Business run available for teams of 3–5 participants; finishing time is based on the first 3 finishers. No race-day registration. Register online until 30 December at 22:00 or until the limit is reached. Entries in October and November receive a free Craft Oliebollen running shirt. Bib transfers are possible via the platform until 13 December at 23:59. Registration is online until 30 December; no race-day registration is available. Start times are around 12:00, with the start location at Sportcentrum Kortezwaag. Parking advice: cycle or carpool; road closure from 11:00.

name: Sylvestercross
description: The Sylvestercross is an annual running event in the Lange Duinen of Soest, known as the most beautiful cross-country race in the Netherlands. The event takes place over two days, with atmospheric Sylvester by Night runs on 30 December and various fun runs and official races on 31 December, including cross-country races for different age groups and ability levels. Since 2025, the Sylvestercross has held bronze status in the World Athletics Cross Country Tour, making it an important event for competitive runners. The course features challenging routes through dunes and woodland, with special loops for young runners and recreational runners, as well as a new 21.5 km trail run.
course_highlights: Course in the Lange Duinen of Soest, through dunes and woodland
Four different loops ranging from 400 metres to 3,300 metres
New Sylvester Trail Run of 21.5 km along the former forest marathon course
additional: The Sylvestercross includes various races for different age groups and ability levels, including a relay cross-country race and a G-cross. The relay cross-country race is a team event with 4 participants, each running one 1,900-metre loop. Dogs are not allowed on the course. The Sylvestercross is part of the National Cross-Country Circuit and gives athletes the opportunity to earn points in the World Athletics rankings. Various distances and categories, including a night run and relays; event on 30 and 31 December 2026; registration available via the website.

name: Katerloop
description: The Katerloop is a traditional running race organized by the Limmer IJsclub during the Limmer Kermis. The race attracts both children and adults and offers various distances, including 5 and 10 kilometers. The course passes through, among other places, the garden of the Cornelius Church and is known for its friendly, sporting atmosphere. The race starts in the morning, with the youngest children setting off at 10:00 and adults at 10:30. The Katerloop is an annual event with a warm community and enthusiastic participants.
course_highlights: Course through the garden of the Cornelius Church
Distances of 5 and 10 kilometers
Starts during the Limmer Kermis in Limmen
additional: Registration is handled via email confirmation. After confirmation, the site administrator will get in touch. There are separate start times for children and adults. The organizer is the Limmer IJsclub, founded in 1895. The Katerloop in Limmen is held during the Limmer Kermis and is known for its small-scale, welcoming atmosphere. The edition in Numansdorp on January 1, 2027, offers participants a race bib including a commemorative cup, and registration is open until December 28.

name: Warta Challenge
location: Leśny parking Łysy Młyn, ul. Poznańska 4, Biedrusko, Poland
organizer: SPORT CHALLENGE Fundacja Wspierania Aktywności Fizycznej
description: WARTA CHALLENGE Marathon&Half is a winter tournament consisting of a series of four races and Nordic Walking events, offering both amateur and professional athletes the opportunity to compete over half-marathon and marathon distances. The races take place on forest tracks and trails in the Warta River forests near Biedrusko, with the event hub at the Łysy Młyn forest car park. The courses are challenging, running through natural woodland with varied surfaces, and each race has its own theme. Races start on Saturdays, and race packs can be collected on race morning. Additional races and walks are also held over 5 km and 10 km distances.
course_highlights: The half-marathon course is one 21.3 km loop, while the marathon is two loops totalling 42.6 km.
The course follows forest tracks and trails along the Warta River, with sections of asphalt and natural surfaces that are often slippery.
The marathon has 220 m of total ascent, with the biggest climb gaining 35 m over a 1 km stretch.
additional: Race packs can be collected on race day from 7:45 to 9:30 at the race office. Themed outfits and accessories are encouraged for the individual races. The course is marked with red-and-white tape and “Łysy Młyn” running trail signs. The 21.3 km Nordic Walking event starts together with the half-marathon runners. The New Year’s Run is event no. 2 in the series. The event hub and race office are at the Łysy Młyn forest car park, ul. Poznańska 4, 62-003 Biedrusko. Race-pack collection is scheduled for 7:45–9:30 on race day, with the start at 10:00. Free parking is available by the event hub.

name: Florijn Winterloop
location: Sportpark De Koekel, Woudenberg, Utrecht, Netherlands
description: The Florijn Winter Run is an annual running and walking event in Woudenberg that has marked the athletic start of the new year for more than 30 years. The routes pass through the beautiful Den Treek Estate and the Utrechtse Heuvelrug, combining paved and unpaved paths. The event is suitable for recreational runners and experienced athletes alike, with several distances, including 5 km and 10 km forest runs. The atmosphere is sporty and friendly, with a rich tradition and a true Florijn spirit.
course_highlights: Routes through Den Treek Estate and the Utrechtse Heuvelrug
A mix of paved and unpaved paths
The private ‘Ravensloot’ path is accessible exclusively during the event
additional: Chip timing by ChronoRace; results can be followed live on the website and social media; race bibs can be collected on the day before the start at De Grift Sports Park; same-day registration is not possible; course records and prize money are available; multiple start times by distance (5 km starts at 13:00, 10 km starts at 14:00). The event also includes a winter walk and features an extensive route at the sports park in Woudenberg.

description: The Nieuwjaarsloop De Wilp is a welcoming running event held annually in the picturesque village of De Wilp. With distances ranging from a youth run to a half marathon, it offers a suitable challenge for every level. The route passes through the beautiful Groningen-Frisian countryside, with wide-open views and a warm atmosphere at the start and finish. The event is known for its friendly, sporty character, bringing runners and spectators together to start the new year actively.
course_highlights: Route through the picturesque Groningen-Frisian countryside
Start and finish at the former church on Plantsoen
Aid stations along the route offering sports drink, tea, water and fruit
additional: Registration is open until 3 January at 23:59 via the website, or from 11:45 until half an hour before the start in the canteen of v.v. De Wilper Boys. Collect your race number no later than 15 minutes before the start. Parking is available in the v.v. De Wilper Boys car park near the canteen. First aid is available at the start/finish and from a mobile team along the route. Refreshments include sports drink, tea, water and fruit. Results and a finish video will be available. Distances: 5 km, 10 km, half marathon; advance registration; winter conditions; youth and adults; parking near the sports club; first aid available; memento and refreshments included.

name: Lierløpet
description: Lierløpet is one of Norway’s fastest courses, running along a wide footpath that is popular with runners and recreational exercisers in the Drammen area. The race offers distances of 5 km, 10 km and a half marathon (21 km), and is open to those who want to jog or walk as well as to fit, fast runners. There is also a children’s race, where all participants receive ice cream. Race numbers can be purchased at Lier Station, and the race starts at 12:00.

name: Bieg Noworoczny
description: The New Year’s Run is an annual running event organized by the Wroniecki Running Club. It takes place on scenic routes near Rzecińska Street in Wronki. The event promotes an active, healthy lifestyle among residents of the Wronki municipality and brings the local community together. The route passes through the beautiful forests and landscapes of the Noteć Forest, offering participants a distinctive sporting challenge and the chance to start the new year together. The event is open to runners and Nordic walkers, with chip timing and prizes for the top finishers.
course_highlights: A route of approximately 5.5 km for runners and Nordic walkers
Scenic forests and landscapes of the Noteć Forest
Start and finish near Rzecińska Street in Wronki
additional: Chip timing (a reusable chip attached to the shoelace). The race office is open from 11:30 to 12:45 on Rzecińska Street. Participant limit: 200. The awards ceremony will be held at the Zamość estate community center on Topolowa Street. A refreshment area at the finish will serve hot tea and coffee. Participants under 18 must have written parental consent. The organizer does not allow anyone under 15 to take part. The 2026 edition regulations provided for electronic chip timing and participation from age 15; details of the 2027 edition have not been confirmed.

name: Noworoczny Bydgoszcz FAN Maraton od 2014...
description: Bydgoszcz Fan Marathon is a unique long-distance event held in Bydgoszcz since 2014, mainly at the KS Gwiazda stadium and along the Old Bydgoszcz Canal. The course consists of multiple loops of approximately 4.22 km, following park paths with a gravel-and-asphalt surface and little elevation change. The event is small-scale and friendly, promoting recreational exercise and active leisure while continuing the tradition of similar races in other European cities. Participants time themselves and report their times to the organizers. Both runners and Nordic walkers are welcome. The start is usually in the morning, and the atmosphere is informal and friendly.
course_highlights: The course follows park paths around the Old Bydgoszcz Canal, with 4.22 km loops
Gravel-and-asphalt surface, mostly gravel
Start and finish at the KS Gwiazda stadium; little elevation change (approximately 53 m above sea level at the start and 45.95 m above sea level at the turnaround)
additional: There is no time limit; participants time themselves and report their times by email. People over 18 may take part, including Nordic walkers and walkers. The race office is located on the park path by the KS Gwiazda stadium. No entry fee is planned, except in special circumstances. Participants provide their own drinks and nutrition. The start is usually at 8:00 or 9:00. The course requires completing a multiple of the loop, up to a maximum of 10 loops. Participants arriving after the scheduled start time start together with the first participant. The event has no entry fee and no medals.

name: De Nieuwjaarsloop
location: Leiden Atletiek, Leiden, South Holland, Netherlands
description: The Nieuwjaarsloop in Leiden is an accessible running race and a sporty way to start the new year. Participants can choose from distances of 5, 10 or 15 kilometres, with the start and finish on the athletics track. The race is organised by Leiden Atletiek in collaboration with Currimus and Loopgroep Oegstgeest. It is part of the Zorg & Zekerheid Circuit, but taking part in the circuit is not mandatory. The race focuses above all on the enjoyment of taking part, with prizes for the fastest runners.
course_highlights: Start and finish on the athletics track
Choose from 5, 10 or 15 kilometres
Part of the Zorg & Zekerheid Circuit
additional: The Nieuwjaarsloop is organised by Leiden Atletiek together with Currimus and Loopgroep Oegstgeest. The race is part of the Zorg & Zekerheid Circuit, but taking part in the circuit is not mandatory. Prizes are awarded to the fastest runners. You can register using the registration form on the race page. The race is traditionally held on 3 January, with registration available on the day. The event is part of the Zorg & Zekerheid Circuit and is supported by local sports clubs.

name: Douwe Kleefstra
description: The Douwe Kleefstraloop is a recreational running race starting at Lionitas athletics track in Leeuwarden. It offers several distances: a 1 km kids’ run, 2 km, 5 km, 10 km and 16.1 km (10 English miles), with the routes measured exactly. The 10 km route passes through Goutum and Zuidlanden, while the 16 km route follows the same course with an extra loop via Bredyk, a tunnel under the railway and part of the Elfstedentocht route. After the race, all participants receive a cup of hot chocolate. The Douwe Kleefstra and Sietske Rijpstra trophies are awarded to the fastest man and woman in the 10 English miles, respectively.
course_highlights: Starts at Lionitas athletics track
10 km route through Goutum and Zuidlanden
16.1 km route with an extra loop via Bredyk, a tunnel and part of the Elfstedentocht route
additional: Electronic chip timing using the chip in the race number. Participation is entirely at your own risk and responsibility. After the race, all participants receive a cup of hot chocolate. A discounted combined entry is available for the Douwe Kleefstraloop, Leeuwarden-Marsum-Leeuward and Rondje Goutum, including a special Gouden Leeuw race number and a prize draw. The distance selected when pre-registering for the Douwe Kleefstraloop determines the distance for the other races in the combination. Distances range from 1 km to 16.1 km; advance registration is required; special combination and youth prices; starts at Nijlân athletics track.

name: Oliebollen omloop
location: Sportpark Pelzer, Boxmeer, North Brabant, Netherlands
description: Olympia's Oliebollen Omloop is an annual running event held on the first Sunday of the new year at Sportpark Pelzer in Boxmeer. The race is intended for members, interested participants, and entrants in the Run Competitie Land van Cuijk & Maasduinen. With several distances to choose from, it’s a great opportunity to end the Christmas holidays actively, start the new year in a sporty way, and enjoy team spirit and a friendly atmosphere. The route runs through the sports park and the adjacent Brestbos. There are prizes for the winners—and, of course, eternal glory.
course_highlights: Run through Sportpark Pelzer
Route through the adjacent Brestbos
Several distances available
additional: The run is part of the Run Competitie Land van Cuijk & Maasduinen. Prizes are awarded to the winners, and the event promotes team spirit and a friendly atmosphere. Running race over several distances, through the sports park and Brestbos, with prizes for the winners.

description: The Snertloop is a friendly running race organized by TAV80, held in 't Veld with the start and finish at JT Bloembollen on Koggeweg. The race takes place on public roads and offers several distances: 5 km, 10 km and 16.1 km running, plus a 16 km walking route. After finishing, participants receive a bucket of snert, a traditional treat. Prizes are awarded to the top runners in each distance and age category, and race numbers also serve as raffle tickets. Registration is online only and closes a few days before the event.
course_highlights: Start and finish at JT Bloembollen on Koggeweg in ’t Veld
Distances of 5 km, 10 km and 16.1 km running, plus 16 km walking
Coffee stop for walkers at the Cultuurhuis in Lutjewinkel
additional: Race numbers also serve as raffle tickets. Race numbers can be collected on the Saturday evening before the race or on race day. Timing is recorded using a MyLaps chip in the race number; personal chips are not permitted. Volunteer traffic marshals accompany the race. Participation is at your own risk, and traffic rules must be followed. Walkers can stop for coffee at the Cultuurhuis in Lutjewinkel. Immediately after finishing, participants receive a bucket of snert. The race takes place on public roads near Sportcomplex de Kogge, with the course and registration online, and starts and finishes at JT Bloembollen.

description: The athletics group welcomes you to a new running series in Bjørgene on February 4! The snow is gone and the trails in Bjørgene are in good condition. We hope to see you at the starting line!

name: Vinterkarusellen 5. løp
description: The 5th race of Vinterkarusellen was held at Fana Stadium, where the venue was crowded and 515 runners finished the 5 km, while 247 finished the 10 km. Participation increased considerably after the previous winter race, and conditions were good despite brisk winds in some places. Markus Galleberg and Eli Anne Dvergsdal were the fastest in the 5 km, while Andre Lenningsvik and Renate Galleberg won the 10 km. This race is part of Ålesund Vinterkarusell, which consists of 5 races suited to both beginners and experienced runners.

name: Grand Prix Trójmiasta 1/3
description: The Three Kings Run is the first stage of the 2027 Grand Prix of the Tri-City series, held on the beach in Brzeźno. Participants can take part in a 6 km cross-country run or 6 km Nordic walking. The event is open to various age and gender categories and also features a three-person team competition, with at least one woman on each team. The participant limit is 500, and the run is scheduled to start at 9:00.
course_highlights: The course is 100% on the beach
6 km cross-country run and Nordic walking
Three-person teams may enter, with at least one woman on each team
additional: Race office opens at 07:30. Nordic walking starts at 10:00. Winners’ awards ceremony at 11:30. The participant limit is 500. Three-person teams (including at least one woman) can register at the race office. Choose between the cross-country run and Nordic walking. The limit is 500 participants. A three-person team may be entered, and it must include at least one woman.

name: Sylvesterloppet Göteborg
description: The Sylvesterloppet in Gothenburg is a spectator-friendly 10 km race held on New Year's Eve, starting and finishing at Heden. The flat course covers two loops through central Gothenburg, including Avenyn, Ullevi, Gårda and the area around Svenska Mässan. The race is suitable for all runners who want to end the year with a fast and festive running experience. Everyone who finishes receives a medal and has a chance to win prizes in a draw.
course_highlights: Flat, two-loop 10 km course through central Gothenburg
Passes Avenyn, Ullevi, Gårda and Svenska Mässan
Spectator-friendly, festive atmosphere, with firefighters cheering runners on at Gårda fire station
additional: Start groups are assigned according to expected finish time: elite, start group 1 and start group 2. The warm-up begins 15 minutes before the start. Race bibs can be collected on 29–30 December and on race day from 09:00 to 11:30 at Exercishuset at Heden. Electronic chip timing using the chip on the race bib is used, and net times are shown in the results. The race starts at 12:00 on 31 December. Registration via MittLopp is available until one hour before the start, unless the race is full.

name: Samnanger Vinterkarusell - 3. løp
description: The Samnanger Winter Series is a social and inclusive running series organised by Samnanger IL Athletics. The races take place at Nesodden, with the start and finish in the same place. Participants can choose between 2 km and 5 km distances. The Winter Series is suitable for all levels, whether you want to compete, set a new personal best, maintain your fitness, or simply enjoy a pleasant run with others. Races are held approximately every other Friday throughout the winter, and participants are encouraged to wear reflective gear because of the dark season.
course_highlights: Start and finish at Nesodden
Choice of 2 km and 5 km distances
The 5 km course is officially measured by the Norwegian Athletics Federation (NFIF)
additional: Races are held approximately every other Friday throughout the winter. The running group is beginner-friendly, free, and open to all levels. Wearing a reflective vest is recommended because of the dark season. Samnanger IL Running Group also offers group training every Monday at 18:10 at Hagabotnane. The schedule lists the start time as 18:30. The Winter Series is free; remember your reflective vest.

description: The 5th race in Vinterkarusellen was held at Fana Stadium, where it was crowded, and a total of 515 participants completed the 5 km, while 247 took part in the double distance. Participation has increased sharply since the winter race 3 weeks ago, and the running conditions were good despite brisk winds in exposed areas. Markus Galleberg and Eli Anne Dvergsdal were fastest in the 5 km, while Andre Lenningsvik and Renate Galleberg won the 10 km.

name: Askløpet
description: Askløpet is a long-standing race organized by Ask Friidrett in beautiful surroundings on Askøy in Vestland. The race brings together both local and visiting runners for a friendly and inclusive competition. It is a great opportunity for both recreational runners and competitive athletes to test their fitness early in the year. The event has a long history, and past results are available for those who want to follow previous performances.

description: The Dziewicza Góra Grand Prix Mountain Running Series consists of six races on a scenic course in the Zielonka Forest Landscape Park. The route follows a 5.15 km loop through forest, climbing the highest hill, Dziewicza Góra, twice. The races bring together runners of different ages and abilities across various distances, and also offer Nordic walking and races for children and young people. The organizers provide professional timing and a welcoming atmosphere, creating a unique “Dziewicza Family.”
course_highlights: A 5.15 km loop through the forest
Two climbs to the summit of Dziewicza Góra
The course passes through the event centre, where spectators can cheer on participants
additional: Electronic timing using an ankle-mounted chip band. Race office open from 8:15 to 10:30. Participant limit: 500. The races are held as a series of six stages. Children’s and youth races over 200 m, 500 m, 1,000 m and 1,500 m. The course is marked with orange ribbons and directional arrows. Participants in the 10 km race complete two loops; after the first loop, they cross the finish line and continue onto the second loop. The 2026–2027 season consists of six stages; passes for the whole series were also available.

name: Zimowa Strzyżewska Piątka
description: Zimowa Strzyżewska Piątka is a 10 km race held in Strzyżewo on January 9, 2027. The event has a winter theme and takes place at the Strzyżewo 46A football pitch. It is organized by the Powiatowe Centrum Sportu w Nowym Tomyślu together with local partners, and attracts both recreational and more experienced runners.
course_highlights: 10 km course
Winter weather and running conditions
Start and finish at the Strzyżewo 46A football pitch
additional: The race office and start are at the Strzyżewo 46A football pitch. Participant registration is open from 8:00 to 8:45. The event is organized by local sports and community institutions.

name: Zandstuve Bosloop
description: The Zandstuve Forest Run is a challenging cross-country race that is part of the Prins Sport Vechtdal Cross Competition. The race takes place in the beautiful, wooded Zandstuve forest, managed by Overijssels Landschap, and is organised by Loopgroep de Zandstuve in collaboration with Sportlust Vroomshoop. The event offers different distances for children and adults, in a friendly and sporty atmosphere. The competition consists of five races in the region, with participants competing in various age categories for the overall win.
course_highlights: Run through the wooded Zandstuve forest, managed by Overijssels Landschap
Cross-country race that is part of the Prins Sport Vechtdal Cross Competition
Distances: 1,500 m for children, 5 km and 10 km for adults, with laps of 750 m and 5 km
additional: On-the-day registration for individual participation is available until half an hour before the start at the Sportlust Vroomshoop clubhouse. Children run 1,500 metres (2 laps of 750 m), 5 km participants run 1 lap, and 10 km participants run 2 laps of 5 km. Prizes are awarded in all categories for the 5 km and 10 km, children receive medals for the 1.5 km, and Canicross participants receive a commemorative gift. Individual entrants can make a contribution to Landschap Overijssel. Distances: 1,500 m (children), 5 km, 10 km; advance and on-site registration; option to donate to Landschap Overijssel; prizes in various categories.

name: StardGRL
description: The Stard Grote Rivieren Running Circuit (StardGRL) is a running competition in the Drechtsteden region, consisting of nine running events spread throughout the year. The races take place in a variety of typical Dutch landscapes and range in distance from 5 km to a half marathon. Participants compete in age categories, and standings are based on their best six performances from the nine races. The atmosphere is informal and sociable, with plenty of attention to personal goals and friendly rivalry.
course_highlights: Nine running events through typical Dutch landscapes
Distances range from 5 km to a half marathon
Standings based on the best six performances from nine races
additional: The competition consists of nine races, with standings based on the best six performances. Participants run in age categories and can register for the entire circuit. The races have an informal, sociable atmosphere, with an opportunity to chat and enjoy a drink afterwards. Information about the nine races, registration and standings is available; results are posted on uitslagen.nl

name: Winterlaufserie
description: The Stadthagen Winter Running Series is a relaxed running and Nordic walking event consisting of 10 individual events. Participants can choose from four signposted loop courses of varying difficulty in the scenic Bückeberge hills. There is no mass start or timing, making it a stress-free way to assess your own performance. All participants receive a warm tea at the finish in the sports center.

description: Grand Prix CITY TRAIL with the Lotto Foundation is a nationwide series of 5 km cross-country races held in 7 locations, including Szczecin. The Szczecin course runs through beautiful woodland around Emerald Lake, with the start and finish behind the Szmaragd Inn. The race is open to participants aged 16 and over, as well as younger participants with parental permission. The event aims to promote running and outdoor physical activity, and to offer the opportunity to compete on a permanent course.
course_highlights: A 5 km course through woodland around Emerald Lake
Start and finish behind the Szmaragd Inn at ul. Kopalniana
Varied course profile with uphill and downhill sections
additional: The race office opens at 8:30; race bibs and chips can be collected on race day. Participants can purchase a pass for the entire series or enter a single race. The pass allows one free start in another city, provided the participant registers by email in advance. There is no participant limit. The main race starts at 11:00, with a group warm-up at 10:45. The race-day entry fee is higher (60 zł). The start is at 11:00. Registration is available online through the CITY TRAIL website or at the race office on race day.

description: The 13th Winter Run, held as part of the Great Orchestra of Christmas Charity (WOŚP), will take place on 10 January 2027 in Krajkowo at the Riding Center IDMAR. The main race, approximately 10 km long, starts at 12:00. There will also be races for children and young people over various shorter distances. The start, finish and race village are located inside the hall, ensuring comfortable conditions whatever the weather. A public collection will be held in support of WOŚP, and challenges and competitions will be organised for spectators, so there will be something for everyone.
course_highlights: Main race: approximately 10 km
Start and finish inside the Riding Center IDMAR hall in Krajkowo
Races for children and young people over distances from 150 m to 1,000 m
additional: Race Office opening hours: 8 January 2027 in Mosina (17:00–20:00) and 10 January 2027 in Krajkowo (09:30–11:55). The start, finish and race village are inside the hall. Participants can support WOŚP with voluntary donations when collecting their race packs. Challenges and competitions for spectators will also be organised, along with the HARPAGANA challenge. The main race starts at 12:00. The event includes a collection for WOŚP.

name: VII Żniński Bieg Powstańczy
description: The 7th Żnin Insurrectionist Run is a 5 km race taking place on January 11, 2026, in Żnin. The course is flat and paved, with one small incline and a turnaround halfway through the distance. The start and finish are on Szkolna Street, near the tennis court. The race is organized by the Jedynka Association and has a participant limit of 200.
course_highlights: 5 km course with GPS tracking
Flat paved course with one small incline
Turnaround 2.5 km from the start
additional: The participant limit is 200. The start and finish are on Szkolna Street in Żnin, near the tennis court (property no. 14). The payment reference must include the runner’s first name, last name, and year of birth.

The race takes place at the holiday resort in Nowy Dębiec, offering participants the opportunity to compete in a scenic setting. The event is part of the Kościan Municipality Running Grand Prix, promoting active recreation and bringing the local community together.

Scenic areas by the lake
Organized as part of the Kościan Municipality Running Grand Prix
additional: The event is organized by the Kościan Municipality Sports and Recreation Centre. The race is part of the Kościan Municipality Running Grand Prix series. The resort has a swimming area, a beach and sports courts in Nowy Dębiec. Information about distances and routes is from the 2026 edition; details of the 2027 edition have not been confirmed.

description: The JSC Crossloop Broekland is part of the Sallands Cross Circuit, a winter competition featuring ten unique cross-country races in different villages across Salland. The course in Broekland offers a challenging and atmospheric cross-country running experience in a natural setting. The races are suitable for both competitive runners and recreational runners who enjoy running outdoors. The competition encourages participation in multiple races, with points based on the best performances of the season.
course_highlights: Unique cross-country course in beautiful Salland
Varied terrain with rolling hills, forest trails, meadows and sandy stretches
Suitable for both competitive and recreational runners
additional: The JSC Crossloop Broekland is part of a competition with 10 cross-country races in Salland. The best 6 races count toward the standings (instead of 7). There is a 1 km kids’ run that does not count toward the standings. The organizers place great importance on safety and may decide to cancel a race in poor weather conditions, as happened recently because of slippery conditions and low feels-like temperatures. Race canceled due to bad weather and safety concerns.

name: WoolderEsloop
description: The Wooldereslopen is a running competition organized by MPM in Hengelo for more than 45 years. The competition consists of four races held throughout the first months of the year, with distances of 1.4, 5.1, 10 and 15 kilometres. The course runs through the countryside around Hengelo, with the start and finish at the same location in Woolderes. The races are open to various categories and offer cash prizes and gift vouchers. The organizers provide electronic timing, and showers are available after the race.
course_highlights: Course through the countryside around Hengelo
Start and finish at the same location in Woolderes
Distances of 1.4, 5.1, 10 and 15 kilometres
additional: Pre-registration closes on 3 January 2027; on-the-day registration is available from 9:00 a.m. until half an hour before the start at IKC De Wooldermarke. A race number with chip is issued once for all four races and can be collected on the Saturday beforehand or on race day. A running shirt and medal can be ordered as optional extras and collected. Showers are available at the Gymzaal Woolderesweg. Race numbers must be worn on the chest. Wearing earbuds/headphones is discouraged. Animals, strollers, etc. are not permitted. Start times: 11:00 a.m. for 10 and 15 km, 11:06 a.m. for 5.1 km, and 11:10 a.m. for 1.4 km. Registration on Sunday morning from 9:00 a.m.; start and finish in Woolderes. Weather conditions may affect the race. Prizes consist of cash and gift vouchers.

name: Flevo Fun Run
location: RCN Camping Zeewolde, Zeewolde, Flevoland, Netherlands
description: The Flevo Fun Run is a regionally popular running event held annually at RCN Camping Zeewolde. The event offers several distances, including 1, 2, 5 and 10 kilometres, with the longer distances consisting of multiple laps. The run is open to both recreational and competitive runners and is known for its friendly atmosphere and scenic routes. The Flevo Fun Run is part of TVZ Zeewolde’s activities and attracts runners from the region.
course_highlights: 1, 2, 5 and 10 km routes, with multiple laps for the longer distances
Start and finish at RCN Camping Zeewolde
Varied course suitable for recreational and competitive runners
additional: The 2 km route consists of 2 laps. The 10 km route consists of 2 laps of 5 km. Photos and results from previous editions are available on the organiser’s Facebook page and photo page. Running event for all ages, registration via the website, seasonal events

The departure and return point is Sportpark de Hondsheuvels in Eindhoven. The coach leaves at 07:30 and returns at 16:30. To take part in the race itself, participants must register separately via the official Egmond Half Marathon website.

Coach trip with free food and drinks

The course is quite demanding, but takes you through beautiful scenery, and is suitable for both beginners and experienced runners. This is a popular event on Veldre Friidrett’s calendar.

name: Åsane løpskarusell 2027
description: Åsane Running Series is a recreational running series with weekly 5 km races that start and finish at IKEA in Åsane. The courses are nationally measured and suitable for all levels, led by experienced coaches. The series has a sociable and inclusive atmosphere, and also offers training sessions for those who want to join the running group. Race bibs are collected in the IKEA garage before the races, and family and individual registration are available.
course_highlights: 5 km course measured and certified by NFIF
Start and finish inside IKEA, at the back facing south
The races are held in the evening, with a 19:00 start

The races are held in the evening on selected Thursdays throughout the year. Race bibs are collected in the IKEA garage between 18:00 and 18:45.

name: Vinterkarusellen 6.løp
description: The 6th race of the season in the NECON Winter Series took place on January 20, with 721 participants finishing despite torrential rain. A total of 382 runners completed the 5 km, while 169 finished the double distance. Hector Breivik from Ask was the fastest over 5 km with a time of 18:13, while Miriam Emilie Stensland Donovan from Lerøy won the women’s race in 21:31. The 10 km winners were Magne Knudsen (35:48) and Vanja Flatberg (40:26).

name: 5 Km Sport Glexe
description: Sport 1 Glexe is organizing a 10 km race on October 12 at 11:00! The race starts at MSG car wash, heading toward Gvarv from Bø. The course has been officially measured and is a fast route on new walking and cycling paths. It is easy to run, with an unattended drink station after approximately 3.4 km, 6.6 km, and at the finish. Toilets are available at Circle K, but there are no shower facilities.

name: Bislett Spring 5k
description: Bislett Spring 5K takes place at Bislett Stadium and offers a great opportunity to set a personal best over 5 km. The starting groups are divided by target finish time, and each group has a pacer to help you reach your goal. But remember, you still have to do the running!

description: Hagemanns Hill Mile 2027 is a unique last-man-standing race in Drammen where participants run laps of one English mile (1609 metres) in under 20 minutes. The race starts at 10:00 on 16 January and continues with new starts every 20 minutes. Each lap has approximately 80 metres of elevation gain, and medals are awarded to everyone who completes at least one lap. The start and finish are at Svelvik Sports Association’s clubhouse/football pitch at Solbakken, with the option to rest indoors in the changing rooms between laps.
course_highlights: Run 1609-metre laps with approximately 80 metres of elevation gain per lap
Last-man-standing format with a start every 20 minutes
Start and finish at Svelvik Sports Association’s clubhouse/football pitch at Solbakken
additional: A reflective vest is required when it is dark, but the street is lit, so a headlamp is not mandatory. There is an opportunity to heat food and drinks, and blackcurrant cordial will be available. Buying and selling race bibs is also permitted. A minimum of 50 registrations is required by 16 November 2026 for the race to go ahead. Registration is referred to via the event page.

name: Bergen 3000 Indoor
description: Gneist 3000 Indoor is an indoor 3 km race held at Gneist Arena in Bergen. The race consists of 15 laps on a soft, smooth blue athletics track, and participants may wear running shoes or spikes with blunt pins no longer than 6 mm. To ensure evenly matched heats and a smooth event, start times are assigned based on estimated finishing times, and pacers are planned for several heats. The event also includes a separate children’s race, Gneist 400 Kids, for children aged 6 to 12, covering 400 metres. A café with grandstand seating will be open during the event, and race bibs must be collected no later than one hour before the start.
course_highlights: Indoor 3 km race on a blue athletics track
15 laps on a soft surface at Gneist Arena
Choose between running shoes and spikes with blunt pins (maximum 6 mm)
additional: Race bibs must be collected at Gneist Arena no later than one hour before the start. Athletes must report to the Call Room 10–15 minutes before each heat, where their shoes will be checked. Runners will be allowed onto the track when it is ready for the next heat. Warm-ups must take place outdoors, as there is no space to warm up inside the hall. A café with grandstand seating will be open during the event. Access to the competition area is not permitted without a race bib. Warm-ups take place outdoors. Participants should report to the Call Room 10–15 minutes before their heat. A café and grandstand seating are available. Information for the 2027 date has not been confirmed on the organiser’s website.

name: HOKA Solastranden Halvmaraton
description: HOKA Solastranden Half Marathon offers a unique running experience, with distances of 5 km, 10 km, and 21 km. Half-marathon runners should note that course marshals go home after a target time of 2:40, but timing remains open for up to 3 hours. Pacers are also available for all distances, and aid stations serve both water and sports drinks. The race takes place in a scenic area, with alternative parking options nearby.

name: Gneist 3000 Indoor
description: Gneist 3000 Indoor is an indoor 3 km track race held at Gneist Arena. The race consists of 15 laps on a soft, smooth blue track surface. Participants can choose to run in running shoes or spikes with blunt pins no longer than 6 mm. The race uses eq-timing’s timing system with lap times, and heats are organized according to estimated finish times to ensure evenly matched groups. There is also a separate children’s race, Gneist 400 Kids, for children aged 6 to 12, over 400 metres. The first start is scheduled for 17:00, and a café and seating in the stands will be available during the event.
course_highlights: 3 km indoor track race on a blue athletics track surface
15 laps, timed with lap times via eq-timing
Choice of running shoes or spikes with blunt pins (maximum 6 mm)
additional: Race numbers must be collected at Gneist Arena no later than 1 hour before the start. Callroom check-in is 10–15 minutes before each heat, with shoes checked. Runners are let into the hall when it is ready for the next heat. Warm-ups must take place outdoors, as there is no space to warm up inside the hall. Each heat has approximately 15–20 participants, and pacemakers are planned for as many heats as possible. Warm-ups must take place outdoors, and race numbers must be collected at Gneist Arena no later than one hour before the start. Registration requires an estimated finish time. Gneist 400 Kids, a 400-metre race for children aged 6–12, will also be held.

17 Chrustowski Bieg Zimowy
location: Szkoła Podstawowa im. Bronisława Malinowskiego, Chrustowo, Gmina Oborniki, Poland
description: The Chrustowo Winter Run is the oldest running event in the Oborniki municipality, organized since 2007. The 12 km main race passes through the picturesque villages of Chrustowo, Żukowo, Górka, and Ślepuchowo, while accompanying races for primary school pupils take place on routes adapted to their age. The event promotes physical activity and community spirit, and every participant receives a commemorative medal and a recovery meal. The organizers also provide prizes for the top finishers in the OPEN and age categories.
course_highlights: The 12 km main race route passes through Chrustowo, Żukowo, Górka, and Ślepuchowo
Accompanying races for children and young people on routes adapted to their age categories
Picturesque surroundings and a winter atmosphere make for an active start to the year
additional: The main race is limited to 200 participants. The race pack includes a commemorative medal, a recovery meal, a doughnut, and water. The top finishers receive statuettes or trophies. The accompanying children’s races start at 11:05, immediately after the main race begins. In the 2026 edition, the main race was scheduled to start at the Bronisław Malinowski Primary School in Chrustowo; the limit was 200 participants. The race pack included a medal, a recovery meal, a doughnut, and water. This information refers to the previous edition.

description: Run in Sopot - Stage 1 is the first race in the #RUNinSOPOT 2026 series, taking place on January 17, 2026, on Sopot beach. It’s a unique opportunity to tackle a course on the seaside sand and experience the atmosphere of a sporting celebration in one of the most beautiful resorts on the Baltic Sea. The race series also includes further editions on the beach and a race near the Forest Opera, with participants competing for cash prizes in the overall standings. The organizers invite both recreational and experienced runners to take part in this modern, dynamic running event.
course_highlights: Course on Sopot beach
A race in a seaside resort with a unique microclimate
Overall standings competition with cash prizes
additional: The #RUNinSOPOT 2026 series includes four races: three on the beach and one near the Forest Opera. Participants compete in the overall standings for cash prizes. Sopot residents can receive a discount on the entry fee by using the Sopot Card.

name: WOŚPowa 5
description: WOŚPowa 5 is a 5 km race held in the picturesque town of Dąbki during the Grand Finale of the Great Orchestra of Christmas Charity (WOŚP). The start and finish are at the Water Sports Centre. The event combines sporting competition with a good cause, encouraging participants to support WOŚP through voluntary donations. Shorter races of 200, 400 and 800 metres are planned for children, making the event appealing to the whole family. Everyone is welcome to take part and celebrate sport and helping others together.
course_highlights: Main 5 km race starting and finishing at the Water Sports Centre
Children’s races over 200 m, 400 m and 800 m
Picturesque route in the spa town of Dąbki
additional: The entry fee is a voluntary donation to the WOŚP collection box. The event takes place during the WOŚP Grand Finale, combining sport with charitable support. Shorter races over 200, 400 and 800 metres are planned for children. The start and finish are at the Water Sports Centre in Dąbki. In the previous edition, the donations collected were given to the 33rd WOŚP Grand Finale. Details of the 2027 edition have not been confirmed in the available sources.

name: 3 Meren Gieten Cross
description: The 3 Meren Gieten Cross is a cross-country race taking place on Saturday, 16 January 2027, in Gieten, near Eext. The race is part of the UNESCO Geopark Hondsrug cross-country circuit and is organised by Loopgroep SGO, Gieten and Vomos. The course follows unpaved paths past three forest lakes in the Gieterbos, with woodland trails, sandy paths and steep hills. Distances of 5 km and 9 km are available for different age categories, with timing provided without a chip. The race is limited to 300 participants, and no showers or changing rooms are available.
course_highlights: Unpaved paths past three forest lakes in the Gieterbos
Woodland trails, sandy paths and steep hills
Part of the UNESCO Geopark Hondsrug cross-country circuit
additional: Maximum 300 participants per race. Timing without a chip. No showers or changing rooms available. Juniors run approximately 5 km; seniors and masters run 9 km. Results and photos will be published after the race. Course on unpaved paths; no showers or changing rooms; maximum 300 participants.

description: The Stadtmüller-Udikloop is a forest race in Klijndijk, organised from the Udik village hall. The event offers two distances, 10 km and 4 English miles, and runs mostly along forest trails and quiet roads. The route passes several hunebeds, making for a unique and atmospheric running experience. A cash prize is offered for breaking the course record, providing an extra challenge for participants.
course_highlights: The course passes several hunebeds
Mostly along forest trails and quiet roads
A forest race in the Klijndijk area
additional: There is a €100 cash prize for breaking the course record. The official 10 km course records are 30.59 for men and 35.43 for women. The event lasts approximately 2 hours and 30 minutes. The route passes hunebeds and includes forest and road sections. Registration is available in advance and on the day. Prizes are offered for breaking the course record.

name: Zuurbergcross
description: The Zuurbergcross is a challenging cross-country race organised by Atletiekvereniging Holten and part of the SNS CrossCircuit van het Oosten. The start and finish are at the MAC Stuurhuus, Beusebergerweg 37, in Holten. The varied course includes a few crossings over paved roads and a short stretch of brick paving, which can be avoided by running along the verge. There is ample parking, first aid is available, and a speaker adds to the atmosphere during the event.
course_highlights: Course with a few crossings over paved roads
Around 500 metres of brick paving, which can be avoided by running along the verge
Start and finish at the MAC Stuurhuus, Beusebergerweg 37
additional: Ample parking, first aid and a speaker are available during the event. Participation is entirely at your own risk. The course is suitable for spikes and includes a few crossings over paved roads and brick paving that can be avoided. The race takes place in Beuseberg, Holten, and offers practical facilities including registration at the MAC Stuurhuus, parking, first aid and sound equipment.

name: Sørlandstesten 5
description: Sørlandstesten is an accessible fun run for everyone looking for a positive running experience, whatever their level of ambition. Whether you’re training for a bigger goal, want to experience the excitement of competition, or simply want a social and active day, this is the race for you! There’s room for both beginners and experienced runners. The start and finish are on the opposite side of the road from Gumpens Auto, along Setesdalsveien in Kristiansand. Participants follow a flat, fast route up Setesdalsveien to Strai, then turn around and run back.

description: The Bosmarathon & Minder is a running event in Assen featuring a full marathon and several shorter distances. The routes run mostly along unpaved paths through the Asserbos, a woodland area of approximately 100 hectares. The start, refreshments and finish are at the AAC'61 athletics track. The lap is just over 7 km, with six laps making up the full marathon. Refreshments are available along the route and at the finish, including water, tea, broth and sports drink, and changing rooms are available.
course_highlights: Route mostly along unpaved paths in the Asserbos
Start, refreshments and finish at the AAC'61 athletics track
Lap of just over 7 km; six laps for the marathon
additional: You can register in advance via inschrijven.nl through 15 January, or on the day at the clubhouse, with card payment. Refreshments are available along the route and at the finish, including water, tea, broth and sports drink. Changing rooms are available at the venue at Achterpad 1, 9405 BN Assen. Participation is at your own risk. Results and photos will be published afterwards on the club page. Unpaved paths, registration in advance and on the day, changing rooms available.

name: De Knikker Zegerplasloop
location: Zegerplasgebied, Alphen aan den Rijn, South Holland, Netherlands
description: The Knikker Zegerplasloop is a series of three running races held in November, January and February around the beautiful locations of Zegerplas in Alphen aan den Rijn. The races offer running distances of 5, 10, 15 and 20 km, as well as special youth distances of 400 and 1,000 metres on the athletics track. There are also walking distances of 5 and 10 km, starting at the same time as the 20 km running race. The start and finish are always on the AAV'36 athletics track, where changing rooms, showers and a canteen are also available. The race features official timing and a nearly traffic-free course through the Zegersloot area and around Zegerplas.
course_highlights: Nearly traffic-free course through the Zegersloot area and around Zegerplas
Start and finish on the AAV'36 athletics track, with changing rooms and showers
A range of distances for beginner and experienced runners, including youth races on the track
additional: There is a 2-hour time limit for the walking distances. There is a drinks station on the track for participants in the 15 and 20 km races on their second lap. A free massage is available afterwards in the AAV'36 massage room (bring your own towel). Youth race keepsakes are free; other keepsakes and stamp cards for taking part in all three races are available for a fee. First aid is available on the track and course. The canteen is open and a limited number of lockers are available. Distances for runners and walkers; course through the Zegersloot area and around Zegerplas; traffic-free course; start and finish on the AAV'36 athletics track; changing rooms and showers available; free leg massage by Running & Walkingcenter Alphen aan den Rijn.

name: Goedhart Drechtloop
location: Leimuiden, Kaag en Braassem, South Holland, Netherlands
description: The Goedhart Drechtloop has been organized annually since 1969 by Vereniging S.V. Kickers ‘69 on the third Sunday in January. The event offers several distances: a 1.4 km children’s run, 4 km, 10 km and 10 English miles. The route passes through the villages of Leimuiden and Rijnsaterwoude and along the Drecht, offering a scenic and varied running experience in the Groene Hart.
course_highlights: Run through the villages of Leimuiden and Rijnsaterwoude
Route along the Drecht river
Varied course in the rural Groene Hart
additional: The start and finish are on Beukenlaan in Leimuiden. The event runs from 11:00 to 14:00. Several distances are available, including a 1.4 km children’s run. The event is organized by S.V. Kickers ‘69. It takes place on 17 January 2027 from 11:00 to 14:00, with several running options and a convivial atmosphere for participants of all ages.

location: Berg en Dal, Nijmegen, Gelderland, Netherlands
price_range: Kind- en jeugdcross: € 3,5; Korte- en lange cross: € 7; Na-inschrijving: € 5 en € 10
description: The Leemkuilcross is one of the most beautiful cross-country races in the Netherlands, organised by NSAV ’t Haasje and AV Cifla. It takes place on a hilly, unpaved woodland course in Berg en Dal and is known for its challenging nature, particularly the notorious staircase. The race offers several distances for children, young people and adults, and attracts athletes who enjoy a tough cross-country race. Race bibs can be collected at the Berg en Dal tennis club, and parking is limited. The Leemkuilcross takes place annually on the third Sunday in January.
course_highlights: Hilly, unpaved woodland course in Berg en Dal
Laps around the Leemkuil, with the notorious staircase as a challenge
Distances ranging from 1200m to 8400m
additional: Race bibs can be collected in the canteen of the Berg en Dal tennis club, Molenbosweg 10. Parking is limited. Late registration is possible until just over half an hour before the start of the relevant race, at a higher cost. Prize ceremonies take place immediately after each event. Cancellations are possible up to one week before the event, subject to an administration fee. The course is a hilly, unpaved woodland route with the notorious staircase; registration is possible until one week before the event; prices include registration fees and late registration is available.

name: Watermolenloop
description: The Watermolenloop in Haaksbergen is a popular running race that attracts many sports enthusiasts every year. The race takes place in a welcoming setting, with a varied course that runs through nature and past distinctive places in Haaksbergen. The 2026 edition drew enthusiastic runners early in the morning, despite the chilly weather, which only added to the sporting atmosphere. The event is organised by Atletiekvereniging Haaksbergen (AVH) and is a great opportunity for both recreational and competitive runners.
course_highlights: A varied course through nature and past distinctive places in Haaksbergen
A welcoming start at Atletiekvereniging Haaksbergen (AVH)
A traditional event with a sporting and friendly atmosphere
additional: The Watermolenloop is organised by Atletiekvereniging Haaksbergen (AVH). The event takes place in January and attracts a wide range of runners. It has a sporting and friendly atmosphere, even in cold weather. The race is part of Haaksbergen’s local sporting activities. The Watermolenloop draws sports enthusiasts to Haaksbergen and is known for a route past the Oostendorper Watermill and through the Lankheterbos, with support from volunteers and safety services.

name: Vinterkarusellen Løp 4
description: Vinterkarusellen is an annual running series featuring several distances, with courses officially measured and certified. This means that times achieved in the races will be recognized in statistics for both 5 km and 10 km. Participants have the opportunity to set personal records that will be recognized forever. The series has a rich history dating back to the mid-1980s, and since winter 2023, Ålesundløpene has once again been the organizer.

All races follow the same 5-kilometer course along illuminated walking and cycling paths in the Prestrud area of Hamar. Everyone is welcome, whatever their ambitions—whether you walk or run, with or without a time. There is no registration at the start, and the race offers an excellent opportunity to test your fitness, with 6 races during the winter.

name: Sandsjöbacka Trail 180
description: Sandsjöbacka Trail is one of western Sweden’s most exciting and challenging winter trail races, offering distances of 30k, 60k, 90k and 180k. The races feature varied terrain, from easy-to-run trails to technical trail running in a magical setting. Whether you’re an ultrarunner or a recreational runner, there’s a challenge to suit you. Welcome to experience the community, challenge and joy of Sandsjöbacka!
course_highlights: Terrain ranging from easy-to-run trails to technical trail running
Elevation gain from approx. 1,000 m (30k) up to approx. 5,000 m (180k)
Magical winter scenery in the Gothenburg area
additional: The 180k race is an out-and-back race starting in Skatås and turning around at Tjolöholm. The Friday start time can be chosen freely between 11:00 and 20:00, but all 90k and 180k runners must start together at 06:00 on Saturday morning. Drop bags and a place to rest are available in Tjolöholm. Self-support applies on the Skatås–Tjolöholm section, according to Fastest Known Time rules. A headlamp is recommended for dark sections. There are time limits and several aid stations with closing times along the courses. The event is known for its scenic course and challenging terrain, making it a popular choice for trail runners in the region.

name: Becksvart
description: Becksvart is a unique night race held in total darkness, with headlamps and reflectors as the only guides. Choose between two challenging and varied courses of 6 km or 12 km, taking you over logs and rocks, along narrow trails and across rocky outcrops around Gunnebo Castle, Kallebäck and Lackarebäcksfjället. The races are a perfect Friday activity focused on adventure and experience, with an AfterRun featuring food, drinks and music waiting in the finish area. There is also a secret contest within the race for anyone looking for an extra challenge.
course_highlights: Run in the dark, with headlamps and reflectors as the only guides
The course follows unique trails around Norra Långevattnet, Lackarebäcksfjället and Kallebäck
Gothenburg’s most legendary hill—Hobo Hill, with 80 metres of elevation gain over approximately 200 metres (12 km course)
additional: Start and finish at Gunnebo Castle & Gardens. The courses are marked with reflectors attached to clothespins and trail markers. Bibs and timing chips can be collected at Nordic Wellness Krokslätt the day before and on race day. Unsupervised bag drop is available. There is one water station halfway around the course, and refreshments are provided after the finish. Medical staff will be on site. Bus 754 goes to Gunnebo Park. Parking is available below the castle, but not at the start/finish. AfterRun with food, drinks and music takes place in the finish area. Trail shoes with a substantial sole are recommended; a headlamp is mandatory. A headlamp is strongly recommended and described as mandatory on the race information page; trail shoes are recommended. There is a water station approximately halfway around the course. AfterRun with music, food and drinks awaits after the finish.

name: Bergen Vintermaraton
description: Bergen Winter Marathon will be held for the 5th time on Saturday, January 18, 2025. The start and finish area will be at Fana Stadium. The course is an out-and-back route on paved roads that are either completely free of cars or have very little traffic, and a large part of the route follows a disused railway line through idyllic rural surroundings. Each loop is exactly one half marathon, and the same loop is run twice for the full marathon. The half marathon is one loop, while the marathon is two loops.

name: Botaniczna Piątka
description: Botaniczna Piątka Gdynia – Winter Edition 2026 is a cross-country race organized by a group of running enthusiasts who have been promoting the sport in Wielkopolska and beyond since 2014. The event places particular emphasis on the scenic appeal of its routes, offering picturesque and attractive terrain for runners. It’s a great opportunity to spend time actively and enjoy the beauty of nature during the winter edition of the race. The organizers invite all running enthusiasts to take part and enjoy some sporting fun together.
course_highlights: A cross-country race on picturesque routes
Scenic locations
Route available on Garmin Connect
additional: The race route is available on Garmin Connect. The organizers particularly promote cross-country running and the scenic appeal of their routes. In summer 2026, they celebrate the 10th anniversary of Botaniczna Piątka.

name: Duin Strandloop
description: The Duinloopcircuit in Katwijk is a unique running series along the Dutch coast, with varied courses combining challenging dune trails and fast beach sections. The Duin/Strandloop on 23 January 2027 offers a great atmosphere for both competitive runners and recreational runners who want to enjoy running outdoors. The races are suitable for all ages, with distances ranging from kids’ runs to 10 km. The series encourages participation with a ranking based on each runner’s best four results.

name: Dwumaraton Olęderski
description: The Olęder Double Marathon is a series of running races organized by the Nowotomyski Chyży Runners’ Club and held in a friendly, social-sporting atmosphere. The event is aimed at both experienced runners and beginners who want to stay active outdoors through the challenging autumn and winter months. Participants run a marathon or a multiple of the 10.5 km loop. The races take place in different towns between October and March. The organizers provide a welcoming atmosphere and encourage all running enthusiasts to take part.
course_highlights: The course consists of a 10.5 km loop
Off-road running in autumn and winter conditions
Option to run a marathon or a multiple of the loop
additional: The Olęder Double Marathon takes place on a series of weekends from October to March, each in a different town. Races start at 10:00, and the race office opens an hour earlier. The time limit for the first race is 16:00 and for the second race, 15:00. The minimum distance is 10.5 km. The races are co-financed by Nowy Tomyśl County and are held in accordance with the applicable restrictions. The course runs through the scenic area around Postomino, bringing together the local community and runners from various regions. The event combines sporting competition with an important health and social message.

The finish is in Nowa Wieś Wielka, where the awards ceremony, refreshments and a campfire get-together take place. The organizer provides return transport from the finish to the start locations, and every participant receives a commemorative medal and access to aid stations along the route.

Separate classifications are held for women and men, with awards for the top 5 runners and the top 3 participants in the walking rally. Information in the sources describes earlier editions, including an 11 km run from Plaża Piecki to Nowa Wieś Wielka and bus transport from the finish to the car parks by the beach.

Each location has its own final standings, giving participants the chance to test themselves in a sporting competition. The race is open to participants aged 16 and over, as well as younger participants with parental permission. The event follows a regular schedule and has a friendly atmosphere, encouraging both adults and children to take part.

The races take place in natural surroundings, bringing the city and nature together

The race attracts people from the city and surrounding areas, bringing together a community of kind-hearted people who join forces to help those in need. It is a special opportunity to take an active part in Poland’s largest charitable campaign.

description: The Gewoon COOP Crossloop in Luttenberg is a popular, traditional cross-country race and part of the Sallands Cross Circuit. Since 1976, participants have run through the forests and hills of Luttenberg on a challenging course that is largely unpaved and includes steep climbs, including the famous climb to the bench. Combining a unique atmosphere, a demanding course and a rich history, the race offers an unforgettable experience for all ages.
course_highlights: Course is 70% unpaved
Notorious climb to the famous bench
Route through forests and over hills, with views of the Sallandse Heuvelrug
additional: Race bibs are personal for the entire season and must be brought to every race. Spikes are not allowed because they could damage the timing mats. Participants receive a unique Sallands Cross Circuit running shirt when they register. The cross-country race features several distances, with start times between 10:45 and 12:40. The start and finish are at Gemeenschapscentrum Elckerlyc, Butzelaarstraat 22. The event offers various distances for all ages, including a final stretch past the Lourdes grotto. The event is sponsored by Charlot Jalink of Gewoon Coop and has a strong community atmosphere.

name: Halve Marathon Zoetermeer
description: The Halve Marathon Zoetermeer is a welcoming running event taking place on Sunday, 24 January 2027. The 14th edition offers four distances: the 1.5 km Kids Run, 5 km, 10 km, and the 21.1 km half marathon. The routes pass through Burgemeester Hoekstrapark, Balijbos, and the municipalities of Zoetermeer and Pijnacker, on a fast, straightforward course. The event is suitable for all ages, with a special focus on school competitions and a business run for teams.

Course through the municipalities of Zoetermeer and Pijnacker
Clear, colour-coded kilometre markers for each distance
additional: Running shirts can be ordered for €12.50 each and collected on Saturday, 23 January, between 15:00 and 17:00, or on Sunday, 24 January, from 10:00. There is a school competition for the 1.5 km Kids Run and a business run for teams in the 5 km. The half marathon has mandatory time cut-offs at certain points on the course to allow roads to be reopened to traffic. Parking arrangements are in place, and volunteers are being sought for the event. Multiple distances, registration details, running shirts available to order, a colour-coded course, and timing and pace limits for the half marathon.

The arena is a multifunctional indoor facility with seating for 1,700 spectators, creating a great atmosphere for both participants and spectators. The event is organised by IF Göta Karlstad, one of Sweden’s most successful athletics clubs, and offers a safe and inspiring competition environment.

Multifunctional facility for both competitions and training

description: Winterrun Oslo 2027 is the big winter running festival, taking place on Saturday, 30 January at Rådhusplassen in Oslo. The race offers a unique atmosphere, with fire baskets, torches and music along the course, as thousands of participants gather for a magical running experience through Oslo’s streets. All participants receive a medal and Vitamin Well at the finish, and great prizes are drawn after the race. This is a feel-good race for anyone who wants to test their fitness or simply have fun in the winter cold.

A unique atmosphere with music and marshals providing an extra boost

In Poznań, the course runs around Lake Rusałka, with the start and finish located by the city beach. The races are open to runners of all levels, from beginners to advanced athletes, who can regularly track their results on the same course. Races are held throughout the 2026/2027 season, and participants can compete in both local and national rankings.
course_highlights: A 5 km course through woodland around Lake Rusałka

The course is suitable for both run-walkers and fast runners
additional: The race office opens at 8:30 and closes at 10:30. A group warm-up with CITY TRAIL Ambassadors takes place before the 10:45 start. The event also includes races for children in various age groups. The event is co-funded by the City of Poznań budget. The race on 17 January 2027 is one of four Poznań dates in the 2026/2027 season; the others are scheduled for 11 October and 22 November 2026, and 21 March 2027. The CITY TRAIL program also includes races for children.

The Midwintercross has a long history and has become a regular cross-country race in the region.

The event is open to all levels, from beginners to keen runners, and is known for its friendly, sporting atmosphere. The start and finish are at De Vroolijke Frans in Brummen, where ample parking is also available.

The races are open to various categories and offer a friendly, sporting atmosphere for runners of different levels.

Race numbers can be collected on the preceding Saturday between 3:00 and 5:00 p.m. or on race day. The race number includes a timing chip and is valid for all four races. Shower and changing facilities are available in the small sports hall on Woolderesweg, which closes at 1:15 p.m. A running shirt and medal can optionally be ordered during pre-registration and collected with the race number or after the finish. The standings are based on at least 3 of the 4 races. Wearing earbuds/headphones is discouraged. Bringing pets, strollers, etc. is not allowed. Participants can register for different distances, with the start and finish at Woolderes. The event offers prizes such as cash and gift vouchers. The race takes place on 31 January 2027 and is suitable for both recreational and competitive runners.

description: The Hoessenbosch Cross is part of the AV Oss '78 Cross Competition and takes place near the Hoessenbosch open-air theatre in Berghem. The race offers a challenging course, with a short cross of approximately 5 km, a long cross of approximately 10 km, and several junior cross distances. The short and long cross start at 10:00, followed by the junior cross at 11:10. The race is open to both recreational and competitive runners and is part of a series of cross-country races in the Oss region.
course_highlights: Unpaved course near the Hoessenbosch open-air theatre
Short cross of approximately 5 km and long cross of approximately 10 km
Junior cross with several shorter distances
additional: Registration is open until 30 minutes before the race. The junior cross starts at 11:10. The race is part of a cross-country competition with several events in the Oss region. The location is near the car park of the Hoessenbosch open-air theatre in Berghem. Start times: 10:00 and 11:10; location near the Hoessenbosch open-air theatre in Berghem

name: Necon Vinterkarusellen Bergen - løp 5
description: The Necon Winter Series in Bergen is a winter running series with eight races, where participants can choose between 5 or 10 km. The races start and finish at Fana Stadium, with a start time of 18:45. The series runs on several Mondays from October to April and offers discounts for members of IL Gneist. Registration is individual via EQ-timing, and members of the athletics groups who pay a training fee may participate for free.
course_highlights: 5 km and 10 km races
Start and finish at Fana Stadium
Evening races starting at 18:45
additional: Discounts are available for IL Gneist members, with different codes for free or reduced entry fees. An annual licence is required for participants over 13 and can be selected during registration. Registration is individual via EQ-timing. Participants are responsible for using the correct discount code and paying the correct fee. The series takes place on several Mondays during the winter half of the year. A licence fee of 50 kr may be added if you do not have an annual licence.

name: Necon Vinterkarusell 26-27 løp 5 (1. jan)
description: Necon Vinterkarusell is a winter race series consisting of 8 races held on Mondays throughout the winter, with the start and finish at Fana Stadion in Bergen. Participants can choose between 5 km and 10 km distances. The races start at 18:45, and discounts are available for IL Gneist members. Registration is individual through EQ-timing, with options for both annual-license holders and those without a license.
course_highlights: Start and finish at Fana Stadion
Choice of 5 km and 10 km distances
Evening races starting at 18:45
additional: Discounts for IL Gneist members: free for athletics members who pay the main club membership fee and training fee (code Gneist00), 50% off for Gneist trim members (code Gneist50), and 25% off for other Gneist members (code Gneist25). The annual license must be selected during registration, and a license fee of 50 kr applies to those without a license. Registration is individual through EQ-timing. Registration is individual through EQ Timing. The annual license costs 50 kr if it has not already been paid.

name: Bjørgene løpskarusell - 5. løp
description: Bjørgene Running Series is a long-standing series of races organized by the Athletics Group of Torvastad Sports Club. The 2026/2027 season will be the 19th in the series, with races held on the first Tuesday of each month from October to March. The races take place in the scenic surroundings of Bjørgene, Karmøy, and attract many local runners of all ages. The start is usually at 19:00, and the atmosphere is social and inclusive, with biscuits, squash and fruit served after the race.
course_highlights: Races in the scenic surroundings of Bjørgene, Karmøy
Held on the first Tuesday of each month from October to March
Race numbers can be collected from 18:00, with the start at 19:00
additional: Race numbers can be collected from 18:00. Biscuits, squash and fruit are served to participants after the race. The running series relies on voluntary efforts by coaches, team leaders and parents to take place.

name: Samnanger Vinterkarusell - 4. løp
description: Samnanger Winter Series is an inclusive running series organized by Samnanger IL Running Group, held approximately every other Friday at Nesodden. Participants can choose between 2 km and 5 km courses, with the 5 km course officially measured by NFIF. The races are suitable for all levels, from beginners to experienced runners, and focus on competition, training, and socializing. The event takes place in the evening during the winter darkness, and participants are encouraged to wear reflective vests for safety. Samnanger IL Running Group also offers group training sessions and other running events throughout the year.
course_highlights: Run at Nesodden, with the start and finish in the same place
Choose between 2 km and 5 km courses; the 5 km course is officially measured by NFIF
Races are held approximately every other Friday in the evening during the winter darkness
additional: The running group is informal, free, and open to all levels. Group training sessions are held every Monday at 18:10 in Hagabotnane. Participants are encouraged to wear reflective vests because of the darkness. The races are social and inclusive, with a focus on the joy of running and community. Reflective vests are recommended.
