description: The Midwinter Marathon in Apeldoorn is a three-day running event held on the first weekend of February. It offers several distances, including a marathon with a unique route through the Natura 2000 area and the Kootwijkerzand, a 10 English Miles through wooded, hilly surroundings, and shorter distances such as the Night Run and Kidsrun. The marathon route is partly off-road and passes iconic locations such as Apenheul and Radio Kootwijk. The Midwinter Marathon is known for its welcoming organisation, beautiful natural scenery, and a broad field of participants, from recreational runners to competitive athletes.
course_highlights: Marathon route with 900 metres off-road across the Kootwijkerzand
Route through a Natura 2000 area, passing Apenheul and Radio Kootwijk
10 English Miles through wooded, hilly surroundings, with its highest point at 100 metres above sea level
additional: The marathon starts and finishes at AV’34 in the Orderbos. There is a welcome with coffee or tea and a treat, followed after the race by pea soup with rye bread and bacon, or a vegetarian option. The 10EM starts and finishes on the Loolaan, with changing rooms and showers in nearby gymnasiums. Start corrals for the 10EM are assigned based on expected finish time. The marathon is limited to 700 participants and registration closes once this limit is reached. There is no on-the-day registration. The 10EM has a maximum of 4,200 participants. There are several refreshment stations and medical support. The Midwinter Marathon also offers an app for live runner tracking. Several distances, including the Kidsrun, 8 km and marathon; event in February 2027; registration opens in October 2026.

name: DGI Nordjysk Trail Cup 2026/2027 - Hammer Bakker Trail
BTR Winter 12 km
location: Öströö Fårfarm, Varberg Municipality, Halland County, Sweden
description: Bocksten TrailRun Winter is a winter trail race offering runners a unique opportunity to experience the Åkulla beech forests in their winter dress. With distances of 5, 12 and 24 km, the race features magical trails and a wonderful atmosphere in beautiful natural surroundings. The start and finish are at Öströö Fårfarm, and the event is characterised by community, commitment and respect for nature. Only 600 exclusive starting places are available, making this an intimate and special experience for trail enthusiasts.
course_highlights: Winter trail in the Åkulla beech forests
Start and finish at Öströö Fårfarm
A magical winter landscape experience
additional: A total of 600 starting places are available: 5 km (150 places), 12 km (300 places) and 24 km (150 places). You must help other runners if needed. The start list is available online. Startklar and Startklar Plus insurance are offered for refunds in case of illness or injury. Traffic rules apply at road crossings. Littering will result in disqualification. For urgent assistance, call 076-8159678 or 112. The race starts at 10:00 from Öströö Fårfarm. There is one refreshment station with energy supplies along the course. The final registration date is 2 February 2027.

name: Sormlands Winter Trail
location: Nävekvarns IP, Nävekvarn, Nyköping Municipality, Sweden
description: Sörmlands Winter Trail is a winter race offering three distances: 43 km, 22 km and 10 km, all starting and finishing at Nävekvarns IP in Nävekvarn. The routes pass through varied terrain, including forest trails, hilly landscapes and scenic coastal sections, providing a challenging and picturesque experience. The race uses electronic timing and has several aid stations with food and drinks along the course. After the finish, all participants are served a hot meal and non-alcoholic recovery beer. Safety is a priority, with mandatory equipment and access to showers and changing rooms at the start.
course_highlights: Varied terrain with forest trails, hilly slopes and coastal paths
Several aid stations with food, hot drinks and Umara Energy
Electronic chip timing and clear cut-off times for each distance
additional: Start times: 43 km at 09:00, 22 km at 10:00, 10 km at 11:00. Maximum cut-off times: 8 hours for 43 km, 5 hours for 22 km, 2 hours for 10 km. Mandatory equipment includes, among other things, a mobile phone, windproof jacket, thermal base layer, hat, gloves, water bottle (at least 500 ml), whistle, emergency blanket and headlamp when running in the dark. Showers, changing rooms and toilets are available at Nävekvarns IP. Parking is available for a fee at the start/finish area. After the race, runners are served a hot meal and non-alcoholic Mineral Brewing Recovery Lager. The distances are 10, 22 and 43 km. Race numbers can be collected at the start area at Nävekvarns IP. Aid stations offer food and hot drinks, and a hot meal is served at the finish. Mandatory equipment includes, among other things, a charged phone, wind jacket, water and trail shoes with good grip. Parking is available for a small fee.

description: Winterrun Bergen is Bergen city centre’s big winter running festival, taking place on Saturday, 6 February 2027. The race offers a unique atmosphere with fire baskets, torches and music along the course, and participants can choose between the 5 km and 10 km distances. All participants receive a medal and a drink at the finish, and the race is known for its great atmosphere and excellent prizes. Race numbers can be collected in advance at Løplabbet Bergen or in the start area on race day.
course_highlights: Run through Bergen city centre in an atmospheric winter setting
Fire baskets, torches and music along the course
Everyone receives a medal and Vitamin Well at the finish
additional: Race numbers can be collected at Løplabbet Bergen, Strandkaien 6, from 4 to 6 February, 10:00–19:00, or in the start area from 2 hours before the start. There will be approximately 45 seconds between each start group, with pacers from 4:00 to 6:30 min/km. Outdoor baggage storage is available; bring your own baggage tag. There are no shower or changing facilities in the start and finish area. Public transport is recommended due to limited parking. Start time: 18:00. Race numbers can be collected at Løplabbet Bergen at Strandkaien 6 or in the start area. Participants are encouraged to wear luminous costumes.

name: Grand Prix Dziewiczej Góry w Biegach Gór...
2 Bieg Zwycięskiego Powstania
description: The 3rd Victorious Greater Poland Uprising Run commemorates the 108th anniversary of the victory of the Greater Poland Uprising. The event takes place by Lake Strzeszyńskie in Poznań and offers three competitions: a 5 km run, a 10 km run, and 5 km Nordic walking. Participants can expect a patriotic atmosphere, a commemorative medal, and a hot meal after the event. This sporting and historical event brings together athletes and history enthusiasts.
course_highlights: Running and Nordic walking routes by Lake Strzeszyńskie
A patriotic atmosphere commemorating the Greater Poland Uprising
A commemorative cast medal for every participant
additional: All events start at 11:00 (the 5 km Nordic walking event starts at 11:01). Places are limited. Participants can enjoy a hot meal after the event. The runs are scheduled to start at 11:00, and Nordic walking at 11:01. The entry fee is 75 zł until 10 January 2027, 85 zł from 11 January to 3 February, and 90 zł on race day, subject to availability. Places are limited.

description: WARTA CHALLENGE Marathon&Half is a winter competition consisting of a series of four runs and Nordic Walking events, offering both amateur and professional athletes the opportunity to compete over half-marathon and marathon distances. The races take place on forest tracks and trails in the Warta River forests near Biedrusko, with the event center by the Łysy Młyn forest car park. The courses are challenging, passing through natural woodland with varied surfaces, and each race has its own theme. Races start on Saturdays, and race packs can be collected on race day in the morning.
course_highlights: The course follows forest tracks and trails through the Warta River forests, along the Warta River
The half marathon is one 21.3 km loop; the marathon is two loops (42.6 km)
The course has a natural surface and is slippery and uneven in places, with leaves, puddles, and mud
additional: Race packs can be collected on race day from 7:45 to 9:30. The course is marked with red-and-white tape and “Łysy Młyn” running-trail signs. Themed outfits and accessories are encouraged for the individual races. Nordic Walking events over 21.3 km are also organized, along with 5 km and 10 km runs and walks. The event center is by Lake Łyse, next to the Łysy Młyn forest car park, ul. Poznańska 4, 62-003 Biedrusko. The start is scheduled for 10:00, and race packs can be collected on race day from 7:45 to 9:30. The venue can be reached by car and by municipal and suburban public transport; free parking is available on site.

name: Blaauwbek Marathon
description: The Blaauwbek Marathon is an atmospheric winter marathon around Oldambtmeer in Blauwestad. The half and full marathons start in Bad Nieuweschans and finish at De Rietkraag, with bus transport from the finish to the start. There are also 5 km and 10 km distances that start and finish at De Rietkraag, featuring a unique course across the airfield. In addition to running events, there are 10 km and 20 km walking routes and special distances for children. The organizers provide warm refreshments along the way and a warm welcome at the finish.
course_highlights: Course around Oldambtmeer, with beautiful scenery and trails
Separate start and finish locations, with bus transport for marathon runners
Unique course across the airfield for the 5 km and 10 km distances
additional: The half marathon starts at 11:15 with bus transport from De Rietkraag. The full marathon starts at 9:45 with bus transport from De Rietkraag. The finish closes at 16:30 for both marathon distances. Children start the 5 km at 15:30. Walkers can start independently after receiving their route. The event offers various distances, including youth and walking routes, and bus transport for marathon runners. The event returns after several years’ absence and is marked by a winter theme and a convivial atmosphere.

name: Gletsjerkuil Ees Cross
organizer: Loopgroep SGO, Vomos UNESCO Geopark Hondsrug
description: The Gletsjerkuil Ees Cross is a challenging cross-country race set in the unique landscape of the Hondsrug UNESCO Global Geopark. The race takes place in Ees and offers two distances: a short route of approximately 5 km and a long route of approximately 9 km, both along unpaved paths through woodland and heathland. The route passes along narrow paths, several glacial pits and the storm-damaged forest with fallen trees, making for an adventurous run surrounded by nature. The cross is part of the Hondsrug cross-country circuit and is organised by Loopgroep SGO, Gieten and Vomos.
course_highlights: Entirely unpaved course, except for two crossings of cycle paths
Route through narrow heathland paths and several challenging glacial pits
Passage through the mysterious storm-damaged forest with fallen trees
additional: The cross is run without chip timing. No shower or changing facilities are available. The start location is Land van Bartje, Buinerweg 8, 9536 PG Ees. Public transport is available via Belbus line 59 from Borger. The cross is part of the Hondsrug cross-country circuit and is the 5th race in the circuit. Course through a nature reserve, starts at 11:00 and 11:10, registration via inschrijven.nl, no changing or shower facilities.

name: Kruikenloop
description: The Kruikenloop in Tilburg is an energetic and convivial race that traditionally marks the start of carnival in Kruikenstad. The course runs partly through nearby Stadsbos 013 and offers distances of 5, 10 and 15 kilometres, with the 5-kilometre loop available to run multiple times. There is a special 1,111-metre race for children, with fun and sportsmanship at its heart. After the finish, a festive after-party takes place in the Sarto clubhouse, and prizes are awarded for the best carnival outfits.
course_highlights: The course runs partly through Stadsbos 013
A 5 km loop that can be run 1, 2 or 3 times (5, 10 or 15 km)
Children’s race of 1,111 metres
additional: Bib number changes are possible until 8 February at 18:00 via your personal dashboard. Bib transfers and resales are permitted via the official platform. After the finish, there is a convivial after-party in the Sarto clubhouse. Prizes are awarded to creatively dressed participants, and there is a costume prize for the children’s race. Timing is recorded via a chip in the bib, with results available online shortly afterwards. Registration is via the website; the course runs partly through Stadsbos 013; expect a festive atmosphere with music and costumes; organised during carnival in Tilburg.

Grand Prix CITY TRAIL

description: Grand Prix CITY TRAIL is a nationwide series of 5 km cross-country races held in scenic woodland and parkland. In Bydgoszcz, the route passes through the Myślęcinek Forest Park of Culture and Recreation and the Żołędowo Forest District, with the start and finish at Różopole Clearing. The races are open to runners of all abilities, from beginners to advanced athletes, who can compete on the same course year after year. The event promotes outdoor physical activity and a healthy lifestyle. Races take place throughout the 2026/2027 season, and participants can compete for overall standings and prizes.

Start and finish at Różopole Clearing
The route is suitable for both run-walkers and fast runners

Parking is not available at Różopole Clearing; participants are advised to use car parks approximately 1–1.5 km from the start. The race schedule and race-office location remain the same throughout the season. The main race starts at 11:00. Registration is available online through the Competitor Panel or at the race office on race day.

name: Bydgoszcz na Orientację
description: Bydgoszcz na Orientację is a series of orienteering events organized by the Bydgoszcz na Orientację Foundation, aimed at people of all ages and skill levels. Participants use a map and compass to explore a variety of forest and urban areas around Bydgoszcz. The event promotes outdoor activity, family participation, and the development of navigation skills, offering courses suited to both beginners and experienced runners. The foundation also works to create courses for blind and visually impaired participants, making the event accessible to everyone.
course_highlights: A variety of forest and urban areas around Bydgoszcz
Courses for beginners, experienced runners, and blind and visually impaired participants
A series of several events during the season, with an overall series classification
additional: The Autumn-Winter Series comprises six orienteering rounds in different forests around Bydgoszcz and nearby areas, with courses of varying difficulty. Participants receive a digital badge and a sticker for their collectible card for each completed round. Completing the entire series is rewarded with a special final badge and discounts on the Bydgoszcz and Surrounding Areas Championships. The project is supported by the Ministry of Sport and Tourism and the Kuyavian-Pomeranian Voivodeship Government. Available sources do not confirm details of the edition on 7 February 2027.

name: Bieg Urodzinowy z Portem Gdynia Bieg 1926
description: The Gdynia Birthday Run with the Port of Gdynia is an annual running event held in Gdynia and part of the Gdynia Grand Prix. The races take place on urban routes accessible to different age groups and ability levels. The event combines sport and recreation, promoting physical activity and bringing the local community together. The organizers provide rules for the main race, Nordic walking, and children’s and youth races. The event is well organized and popular with residents and runners from the region.
course_highlights: The 1,926 m distance commemorates the year Gdynia was granted city rights
The race is held as part of the Gdynia Birthday Run with the Port of Gdynia
The event also includes races for children and young people

description: Leeuwarden Marsum Leeuwarden is a classic running race starting on the Lionitas track in Leeuwarden. Alongside the half marathon, there are also 1 km kids’ run, 2 km, 5 km and 10 km distances, all measured exactly. After the race, all participants receive a cup of hot chocolate. Precisely measured distances of 1 km kids’ run, 2 km, 5 km, 10 km and 21.1 km

In 2027, the event will be held for the eleventh time, offering participants not only a sporting challenge but also the opportunity to support a good cause. The start and finish are at Camping de Meene in Buurse, and the event is known for Twentish hospitality.

The start and finish are located at SILGAN Metal Packaging’s premises at 13 Rokicka Street in Tczew. The course runs through Tczew, Rokitki, and Śliwiny; its final route will be announced two weeks before the event. The course has a mix of asphalt and gravel surfaces, and the race takes place with restricted vehicle traffic. The start line will close 15 minutes after the starter’s gun, and the route is marked with horizontal signs every 1 km.
course_highlights: A 10.54 km route through Tczew, Rokitki, and Śliwiny
Mixed asphalt and gravel surfaces
Route marked with horizontal signs every 1 km

name: Snøkuten - Glestadrunden
description: Snøkuten is a traditional series of running races held in Veldre, starting from Kirkekretsen School in Byflaten. The races cover varying distances, including the 9.5 km Nordhagarunden. Nordhagarunden, one of the race routes, is 9.5 km
Both timed and untimed participation options
additional: Untimed start at 17:00; competitive class start at 18:30. A prize is awarded to everyone who completes 4 of the 6 races in the season.

Norna-Salhus and has a long tradition of focusing on community and the joy of running. Race bibs are collected in the IKEA garage before the race, and participants can take part in individual races or the entire series.

Start and finish on the south side of IKEA Åsane

Race bibs are collected in the IKEA garage between 18:00 and 18:45.

The course is nationally certified and suitable for all levels, led by experienced coaches. The series has a friendly and inclusive atmosphere and also offers training sessions for those who would like to join the running group. Race numbers are collected at the venue before the race, and participants can enter individual races or the entire series.

Start and finish inside IKEA, at the rear facing south
The course was measured by a certified course measurer on 19.11.2022

The race is organized by I.L. Norna-Salhus. Participants can enter individual races or the entire series. The race takes place on Thursday evenings. Race numbers are collected in the IKEA garage between 18:00 and 18:45.

name: Bislett Indoor Marathon 12 - 14 februar 2027

description: Bislett Indoor Marathon 2027 takes place from 12–14 February on the heated indoor track beneath the stands at Bislett Stadium in Oslo. The event offers distances from 3 km to 50 km, all on an AIMS-certified course measuring 546.5 metres per lap. Held indoors, the event provides stable conditions without wind, ice or rain. It takes place at a historic venue that has been in use since 1922 and hosted the 1952 Olympic Games. This is a unique opportunity to run long distances during winter in a comfortable environment.
course_highlights: Heated indoor running track measuring 546.5 metres per lap
The course is AIMS-certified, with the finish at the entrance to the track
Historic venue in use since 1922 and an Olympic venue in 1952
additional: All distances are run on the same indoor lap. Time limits vary by distance; for example, 5 hours for the marathon and 50 km. The marathon and 50 km start together. The number of available places is updated daily. The event takes place at Bislett Stadium, known for the Bislett Games and as a historic Olympic venue. All finishers receive a medal. Enter via the Training Entrance at Sofies gate 38. An NFIF one-time licence must be purchased if required.

name: Bocksten TrailRun Winter
location: Öströö Fårfarm, Varberg Municipality, Halland County, Sweden
description: Bocksten TrailRun Winter is a winter trail race held at Öströö Sheep Farm, featuring magical trails in the Åkulla beech forests. The race offers three distances: 5 km, 12 km and 24 km, with the 24 km distance consisting of two laps of the 12 km course. With a total limit of 600 starting places, the organizers aim to give runners a unique experience of the beauty and challenge of the winter landscape. The course offers varied terrain, including trails, off-trail sections and gravel roads in a scenic setting. Safety and respect for nature are key principles of the event.
course_highlights: Magical trails in the Åkulla beech forests amid winter scenery
Varied terrain with trails, off-trail sections and gravel roads
The 24 km distance consists of two laps of the 12 km course, making it spectator-friendly and safe
additional: Start and finish at Öströö Sheep Farm. Maximum of 600 starting places in total. Start times: 12 km at 10:00 (300 places), 5 km at 10:15 (150 places), 24 km at 10:30 (150 places). The option to purchase Startklar insurance for reimbursement in case of illness or injury. The lap course allows runners to change equipment and is spectator-friendly. The event is environmentally friendly, with a focus on not littering. In case of an accident, call 076-8159678 or 112 in an emergency. The lap section allows runners to change equipment and makes the course more spectator-friendly.

name: Snapphane Race
location: Hjortakrokskolans idrottshall, Sölvesborg, Blekinge County, Sweden
description: Snapphaneracet is a challenging trail race that follows in the footsteps of the Snapphanar through the beautiful Ryssberget in Sölvesborg. The race offers several distances from 13 km to 50 km, with plenty of elevation and varied terrain, including beech forests and mossy coniferous forest trails. The winter edition offers an extra-tough challenge, with icy and muddy sections. The organizers look forward to welcoming runners for a tough and scenic experience in February.
course_highlights: Ryssberget, home to one of Sweden’s largest beech forests
Moss-covered, winding coniferous forest trails
Challenging hills and enjoyable downhill stretches
additional: Changing rooms, showers and toilets are available. Sweden Runners members and members of FysKompaniet Träningscenter receive a 15% discount on the entry fee. Startklar insurance can be purchased to receive a refund in the event of illness or injury. Name changes are possible for a fee up to 8 days before the race. Trail race in Ryssberget with distances from 13 km to 50 km, a winter challenge, course updates via GPX, headlamp required for some distances, start and finish at Hjortakrokskolans sports hall, no cups at aid stations.

name: AKVA Robust-løpet 2027
organizer: Robust Trening og Fysioterapi og Undheim IL
description: AKVA Robust-løpet 2027 is a city-centre race in Bryne offering several distances, including 5 km, 10 km in two waves, a half marathon, a relay, a children’s race and a wheelchair race. The event takes place on 13 February, with most distances starting and finishing at Bryne torg. The children’s race is an informal, untimed 800-metre run for children up to 12 years old. Facilities include toilets, changing rooms and bag drop, and good parking and transport options are available in the area.
course_highlights: City-centre race starting and finishing at Bryne torg
10 km race split into two waves based on expected finish time
Relay with 4 legs of 2.5 km each
additional: Race numbers can be collected on race day, no later than 30 minutes before the start. Parking is recommended at Bryne Torg, Time rådhus and Kiwi. Facilities include toilets, changing rooms and bag drop. Children must register for the children’s race, but there is no timing. Den Robuste is a separate registration option that includes the 5 km, 10 km and half marathon. The wheelchair race is approximately 200 metres, but the distance is somewhat uncertain. The children’s race is for children aged 0–12 and is untimed. The 10 km starts in Storgata and finishes at Bryne torg. Registration is through the organiser.

name: Bieg Walentynkowy
description: The Poznań Valentine’s Day Run is an annual running event held by Lake Rusałka, bringing together couples, singles, and families to celebrate Valentine’s Day through physical activity. Traditionally, it features 5 km and 10 km runs, as well as Nordic walking, with individual and pairs categories. The event is inclusive and family-friendly, promoting a healthy lifestyle and the joy of exercising outdoors.
course_highlights: Course around Lake Rusałka in Poznań
5 km and 10 km running distances, plus Nordic walking
Option to participate individually or in pairs
additional: The event also includes runs for children. It is family-friendly and inclusive, and takes place annually around Valentine’s Day by Lake Rusałka. The 12th edition has been announced for 13 February 2027 at 12:00. Prices from the 2026 edition may not apply in 2027.

name: Walentynkowo Szwungiem przez Przyłęk
location: Nowy Tomyśl, Greater Poland Voivodeship, Poland

description: Valentine’s Day Run - Grand Prix of the Tri-City 2/3 - Run in Sopot II is a cross-country race held on the beach in Sopot, starting by the pier. Participants run towards Gdańsk and back, enjoying scenic coastal views. The event is part of the Winter Grand Prix of Cross-Country Races in Sopot and includes age categories for runners and Nordic walking. The race office is located in the concert shell at Skwer Kuracyjny, and the race is scheduled to start at 10:00.
course_highlights: Cross-country beach route with sea views
Start and finish by the pier in Sopot
Run towards Gdańsk and back
additional: The participant limit is 600. The race office is located in the concert shell at Skwer Kuracyjny, before the entrance to the pier. The Nordic walking start is 5 minutes after the race start. The event is part of the Winter Grand Prix of Cross-Country Races in Sopot. Information about the distance, fees, and schedule from the previous edition may not apply in 2027.

name: XVI Bieg Górski
description: The 16th Leszno–Grzybowo Mountain Run is a forest trail race organized by the “Aktywna Trz” Physical Culture Association. The race takes place in the scenic area around Leszno and Grzybowo, offering participants a demanding route through forest terrain. The event is held regularly and is popular with mountain runners. It is a great opportunity to test your abilities on natural trails and spend time outdoors.
course_highlights: A forest route with a mountain-running character
Scenic areas around Leszno and Grzybowo
A demanding race through natural terrain
additional: The edition scheduled for 13 February 2027 is listed as the 17th Leszno–Grzybowo Mountain Run; the 16th edition took place on 14 February 2026.

name: AVT Valentijnscross
description: The AVT Valentine Cross in Wierden is a challenging cross-country race held at Het Lageveld. The course runs over a sandy beach, grass, hills and through the woods of Het Lageveld recreational park. The terrain is mostly unpaved and varied, making for a surprising and diverse running experience. The race is part of the MD Stoffering CrossCircuit van het Oosten and attracts both recreational and competitive runners.
course_highlights: Course over a sandy beach, grass, hills and through the woods
Mostly unpaved, varied terrain
Changing surfaces make for a challenging cross-country race
additional: Pre-registered participants can collect their race number with timing chip at the pickup desk. Circuit participants may keep their race number with timing chip for subsequent races. On-the-day registration is possible until half an hour before the start. Spikes are not permitted because of the timing mats. The race number must be worn visibly on the front. Dogs and unregistered companions may not take part. In extreme weather conditions, the organisers may decide to cancel the race without refunding the entry fee. Cross-country race held at Het Lageveld recreational park in Wierden, with distances of 10 km and youth distances of 1.5 km and 2.5 km, usually in February.

name: Krokusloop
description: The Duinloop Circuit in Katwijk is a unique running series along the Dutch coast, featuring varied courses that combine challenging dune trails with fast beach sections. The Krokusloop, part of this series, offers a great atmosphere for both dedicated runners and recreational runners who enjoy running outdoors. With distances for different ages and ability levels, the event is open to everyone who wants to enjoy running at its best.
course_highlights: Varied courses with dune trails and beach sections
Unique running series along the Dutch coast
Suitable for all ages and ability levels
additional: Start times by distance: 500m Kids Run at 09:30, 1 km Kids Run at 09:35, 2 km Kids Run at 09:45, 5 km and 10 km at 10:00. Rankings are maintained for all distances, separately for girls/women and boys/men, based on the four best results in the circuit. Varied course with dune trails and beach sections, part of a series of running events along the coast.

name: Polderrun
description: The Polderrun is a sporting running event in the heart of Bleskensgraaf, bringing together participants from the region and beyond. The race offers several distances, including 3.5, 7, and 10 English miles, on a fast, fully paved course through the open polder. The Polderrun is known for its atmospheric start and finish in the middle of the village, and for the combination of nostalgia and renewal in the course. The event also supports a good cause, Stichting Moz Kids, making a meaningful contribution to vulnerable children in Mozambique.
course_highlights: Fast, fully paved course through the open polder
Long straight roads and sturdy drainage canal embankments
Start and finish in the middle of Bleskensgraaf
additional: Race numbers can be collected from 08:30 at the meeting area, De Spil. The meeting area also has a cloakroom, toilets, and limited shower facilities. Timing is provided by an Ipico chip in the race number, which measures net running time. There is a drink station at kilometer 8.1 of the 10 English Miles. Parking is available at three locations in Bleskensgraaf, with Melkwegplein and Weideweg preferred. Race-day registration is not possible. Registration for 2027 has not yet been announced, but the event is popular and sells out quickly. Facilities include parking, first aid, and Ipico timing. There is also an option to donate to a good cause.

name: Botaniczna Piątka
location: Ogród Dendrologiczny w Przelewicach, Przelewice, Poland
description: Botaniczna Piątka Przelewice is the winter edition of a popular cross-country race organized by running enthusiasts from Wielkopolska. The event takes place in the picturesque Przelewice Dendrological Garden, where participants can enjoy the beauty of nature and the scenic course. Since 2014, the organizers have focused on promoting cross-country running and exceptional locations, offering runners unforgettable sporting experiences. The event attracts both recreational and more experienced runners who want to spend time actively in a winter setting.
course_highlights: Cross-country course in the Przelewice Dendrological Garden
Picturesque natural surroundings
Winter race edition with a unique atmosphere
additional: Registration for the main distance and children’s race has closed. The organizers emphasize the scenic appeal of the locations they choose and the promotion of cross-country running. The 10th anniversary of Botaniczna Piątka is planned for summer 2026. The previous edition featured a main distance and children’s races.

name: Dinkelcross
price_range: Inschrijving via inschrijven.nl, geen expliciete prijs vermeld
description: The Dinkelcross is a beautiful cross-country race organized by Iphitos in the De Zandbergen woodland and nature area in Losser. The race is part of the Twentse Cross Competitie and offers challenging courses that are entirely off-road, with sandy stretches, tough short hills, and a route along a branch of the River Dinkel. There are several distances for both youth and adults, ranging from 1 km to 10 km. The Dinkelcross is suitable for both competitive runners and recreational participants and embraces the Olympic ideal that taking part is more important than winning. After the race, participants can enjoy a friendly atmosphere and homemade cake at the Zaandhoes, the start and finish location.
course_highlights: Entirely off-road course through the De Zandbergen woodland and nature area
Crossing a sandy stretch and tackling a few tough short hills
Running along a branch of the Dinkel River
additional: A maximum of 150 race-day entrants can take part; registration on the day is not possible. The start and finish are at the Zaandhoes, accessible from Grensweg. Changing rooms and showers are available. Start times for the various distances and age categories are scheduled between 10:30 and 12:45. The Dinkelcross is part of the Twentse Cross Competitie. Off-road course, various distances, start and finish at Zaandhoes, changing rooms and showers available, suitable for all levels.

description: The Noord-Aa Polder Run takes place on Sunday, 14 February 2027, at the Road Runners clubhouse in Zoetermeer. The course runs through the polder landscape around the Noord-Aa and is suitable for both beginners and experienced runners. There are several distances: a 1.5 km kids’ run and 5, 10 and 15 km races, so everyone can choose a suitable goal. Proceeds from the event go to IKC Het Zwanenbos to support the education and well-being of children in the region.
course_highlights: Course through the polder landscape around the Noord-Aa
Route past water, open polder landscape and paved paths
A range of distances from 1.5 km to 15 km
additional: Each distance starts at a different time to keep the course clear: 1.5 km at 12:30, 5 km at 13:00, 10 km at 13:10 and 15 km at 13:20. Registering in advance is recommended to guarantee a starting spot. The event is made possible in part by sponsors; prospective partners can get in touch via the email address provided. The course runs through the polder around Zoetermeerse Plas, not on an athletics track, and is suitable for different ability levels, with a focus on having fun and supporting good causes.

name: Flevo Fun Run
location: RCN Camping Zeewolde, Zeewolde, Flevoland, Netherlands
description: The Flevo Fun Run is a popular regional running event held annually at RCN camping Zeewolde. The event has grown in recent years and attracts runners from the region. It offers a friendly, sporting atmosphere for participants of different levels. Photos and results from previous editions are available via the official Facebook page and website.
course_highlights: Run in the area around RCN camping Zeewolde
Distances of 1 km, 2 km, 5 km and 10 km
Start time of 11:00 for the 5 km and 10 km
additional: The 5 km and 10 km start at 11:00. Photos and results from previous editions are available on the Facebook page and photo page. In previous editions, the 5 km and 10 km filled up quickly, while registration for the 1 km and 2 km remained open until 12:00 on race day. Held on the second Sunday of each month in November, December, January and February at RCN camping Zeewolde. Four distances: 1 km, 2 km, 5 km and 10 km. Medals for kids and participants taking part in multiple races. Minimum ages vary by distance.

description: Hamarkarusellen Vinter is a winter race series in Hamar consisting of six races on a certified 5-kilometer course in the Prestrud area. The course follows lit walking and cycling paths and is suitable for all levels, whether you walk, jog, or run. The event welcomes everyone, from recreational runners to competitive super-runners, and focuses on the joy of running, personal achievement, and socializing throughout the winter. The start and finish are at Prestrudhallen, where light refreshments and facilities are also available. Gun time is used for ranking, while net time is shown in the results list.
course_highlights: Certified 5-kilometer course on lit walking and cycling paths in the Prestrud area
The course runs mainly on segregated walking and cycling paths, with some pavement along low-traffic streets
Start and finish at Prestrudhallen, with access to toilets and a shared area for bib pickup and refreshments
additional: A unique mug is awarded to participants who take part in all 6 races. Juice and often cake are served at the finish area. Some changing facilities and indoor toilets are available at Prestrudhallen, but runners are advised to shower at home. Results service with live split times via EQ Timing. Gun time is used for ranking; net time is shown in the results list. Registration via EQ Timing is open until the start. The course is cleared of snow and gritted as needed; a reflective vest is recommended, but a headlamp is not necessary.

description: The Frikarusellen is a race series organized by IL Fri, with the start and finish at Espeland Sports Ground in Arna, Bergen. The course is 5 km long, officially measured for the first time in 2000 and again in 2018, and runs from north of the Londalskrysset intersection to Gamle Haukeland station and back along the same route. The series consists of several races throughout the winter and early spring, and is suitable for both young people and adults. It is a long-standing event with good opportunities to compare your time with previous records.
course_highlights: Officially measured 5 km course starting and finishing at Espeland Sports Ground
The course passes Gamle Haukeland station and returns along the same route
The race takes place in Arna, Bergen, with several dates in winter/spring
additional: Race bibs can be collected at Espelandshallen on race day between 18:00 and 18:55. Registration is open until 18:55 on race day. A licence fee applies to participants over 13 without an annual licence. A fee of NOK 50 applies if you forget your race bib, for those registered for all races. Results are published at www.eqtiming.no. Registration via EQ Timing is open until 18:55 on race day. Race bibs can be collected at Espelandshallen.

description: Frikarusellen is a race series organized by Idrettslaget Fri, starting and finishing at Espeland sports ground in Arna. The course is 5 km long, first officially measured in 2000 and measured again in 2018. It runs from north of the Londalskrysset junction to Gamle Haukeland station and back the same way. The race is suitable for both young people and adults, and several races are held in the series through the winter and spring. Registration is via EQ Timing, and race numbers are collected on race day at Espelandshallen. The series has a great atmosphere and dedicated members, and offers quality races in beautiful surroundings.
course_highlights: 5 km officially measured course
Starts north of the Londalskrysset junction and returns the same way
Finish inside Espeland sports ground
additional: Race numbers are assigned during online registration and collected at Espelandshallen on race day between 18:00 and 18:55. Registration is available until 18:55 on race day. A license fee is added for participants over 13 without an annual license. A fee of NOK 50 applies if participants who registered for all races forget their race number. Results are published at www.eqtiming.no. Registration via EQ Timing. Stated distance is 5 km.

name: Bislett Distanseserie s3r2 - 5000m/10000m 2027
description: Bislett Distance Series s3r2 is a race held at Bislett Stadium in Oslo, with distances of 5,000 meters and 10,000 meters. It is part of a popular distance series that attracts both recreational and competitive runners. The race takes place on a classic athletics track and offers a great opportunity to test your fitness early in the year in a welcoming environment. The event is well organized and suited to anyone looking for a fast and enjoyable running experience.
course_highlights: The race takes place at Bislett Stadium, an iconic athletics track in Oslo
The distances are 5,000 meters and 10,000 meters on the track
Well suited to both recreational and competitive runners

name: Botaniczna Piątka
location: Ogród Botaniczny Uniwersytetu Zielonogórskiego, Zielona Góra, Poland
description: Botaniczna Piątka is a series of cross-country races organized since 2014 by running enthusiasts who focus on the aesthetic qualities of their routes. The event takes place in scenic locations, such as the University of Zielona Góra Botanical Garden in Zielona Góra. It attracts both recreational and more experienced runners, offering a unique atmosphere and the chance to spend time actively outdoors. The organizers promote running and make cross-country routes appealing.
course_highlights: Cross-country route through the University of Zielona Góra Botanical Garden
Scenic, attractive surroundings along the route
The autumn route follows a two-lap course
additional: The race takes place on a two-lap course. The organizers celebrate the 10th anniversary of Botaniczna Piątka in 2026. The event is part of a series of cross-country races held at various locations in Wielkopolska and beyond.

name: Dwumaraton Olęderski
description: The Olęder Double Marathon is a recurring race organized by the Nowy Tomyśl Chyży Running Club, held on scenic routes around Jastrzębsko Stare. The event is part of an autumn-winter race series that passes through various towns, offering participants varied and challenging courses. It attracts both recreational and more experienced runners looking to test their endurance over the marathon distance. The organizers foster a welcoming atmosphere and support runners at every stage of preparation and competition.
course_highlights: Scenic routes around Jastrzębsko Stare
Varied and challenging running sections
Part of a regional autumn-winter race series
additional: The Olęder Double Marathon is co-financed by the Nowy Tomyśl County. Registration for the races usually opens several months before the event. The event takes place on weekends, and the routes change as the series moves to different locations. It is part of a series held in the autumn-winter period; the available information about the format comes from the 2025/2026 edition.

name: XI Bieg Zaślubinowy
description: The 11th Betrothal Run “From Haller to Haller” is a much-loved race linking the two monuments to Józef Haller in Władysławowo and Puck, and kicking off the running season in the region. Set against a picturesque seaside backdrop, the event offers participants a unique atmosphere and professional organization. It’s a race for everyone who wants to start the season actively, without unnecessary pressure, in a friendly atmosphere. The course is well prepared and accurately measured, as confirmed by numerous positive participant reviews.
course_highlights: A course linking the two monuments to Józef Haller in Władysławowo and Puck
Picturesque seaside scenery
Accurately measured and professionally prepared courses
additional: The event is part of the Puck Running Triad and the STONE TRI & RUN series. Enjoy a relaxed, pressure-free atmosphere, with prizes and additional attractions such as massages and refreshments. This event is for runners of all abilities.

name: Sztafeta Pomocy

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Opłata startowa wynosi: 219 PLN od sztafety.

description: The Sztafeta Pomocy is a charity running event organized by the Sportplus Foundation to support children’s rehabilitation. The race takes place in the scenic Marcelin Forest in Poznań, on a forest route approximately 3.3 km long. Participants compete in teams of four, and the event promotes physical activity and social integration. It is a unique opportunity to combine sport with helping those in need.
course_highlights: A route approximately 3.3 km long along the paths of Marcelin Forest
100% forest surface
Start and finish on the clearing on the side of Strzegomska Street
additional: The limit is 125 teams of four. Participants must be at least 15 years old; those under 18 need parental consent. The time limit for completing the route is 2 hours. The route remains open to pedestrians, and medical staff are on hand to ensure safety. The fundraiser supports the rehabilitation of Oliwier Jabłoński. The route map is available on AllTrails.

name: XI Bieg Zaślubin Polski z Morzem
description: The 11th Run of Poland’s Marriage to the Sea is a historic race connecting the two Józef Haller monuments in Władysławowo and Puck, inspired by events from 1920. The race route runs from Władysławowo to Puck and opens the Puck Running Triad. STONE TRI & RUN has taken over the organization of the race, bringing it new energy while continuing the tradition of this iconic event. Participants can expect a clearly marked route, a route map, and organizational support during the event.
course_highlights: Historic route from Władysławowo to Puck
A race connecting two Józef Haller monuments
Opens the Puck Running Triad
additional: A personal race guide is available, featuring the current route, a map, rules, information about bus departures and parking, the event schedule, and start lists. The 2026 edition also offered an 11.5 km Nordic Walking event. The information provided about the distance and organization refers to the previous edition.

name: De Knikker Zegerplasloop
location: Zegerplas, Alphen aan den Rijn, South Holland, Netherlands
description: The Knikker Zegerplasloop is a running series consisting of three races in November, January and February, held around the beautiful locations of Zegerplas in Alphen aan den Rijn. Participants can choose from distances of 5, 10, 15 and 20 km, with special youth distances of 400 and 1000 metres on the athletics track. The course is almost entirely traffic-free and runs through the Zegersloot area and around Zegerplas, making it suitable for both beginner and experienced runners. The start and finish are always on the AAV'36 athletics track, where changing rooms, showers and a cafeteria are also available. Official timing is provided by MyLaps. Refreshment stations are available on the longer distances, with water at the finish.
course_highlights: Almost entirely traffic-free course through the Zegersloot area and around Zegerplas
Start and finish on the AAV'36 athletics track, with changing rooms and showers
Official timing by MyLaps and refreshment stations on the longer distances
additional: There is a time limit of 2 hours for the 5 and 10 km walking distances. Walkers start at the same time as the 20 km running race. Youth runners have special distances of 400 m and 1000 m on the track, with a free commemorative item. A massage room offers free massages from Running & Walkingcenter Alphen aan den Rijn (bring your own towel). The cafeteria is open, and a limited number of lockers are available. Runners in the 15 and 20 km races pass a refreshment station on the track at the start of their second lap. On race day, registration is available in the cafeteria from 9:30 a.m. The races take place in winter conditions and offer options for walkers and young participants, with a maximum time limit of two hours for the walking distances.

name: WoolderEsloop

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Voor-inschrijving is alleen mogelijk via de website en sluit op 3 januari 2027.

description: The Wooldereslopen is a traditional running competition organised by MPM in Hengelo for more than 45 years. The competition consists of four races held during the first months of the year. Distances range from 1.4 to 15 kilometres, and the course runs through the countryside around Hengelo. The start and finish are at the same location in the Woolderes, creating a clear and friendly atmosphere for participants.
course_highlights: Course through the countryside around Hengelo
Distances of 1.4, 5.1, 10 and 15 kilometres
Start and finish at the same location in the Woolderes
additional: Electronic timing. Race numbers can be collected from 9:00 a.m. on race day or on the preceding Saturday. T-shirts can be ordered as an optional extra. Shower facilities are available at Gymzaal Woolderesweg. Participation is at your own risk. Wearing earbuds/headphones is discouraged. The Wooldereslopen consists of four races held every three weeks during the first months of the year. Participants can enter the 1.4 km, 5.1 km, 10 km and 15 km distances. The organisers emphasise the friendly atmosphere and the course through the countryside around Hengelo.

name: Engbergenloop 2027

Registration is individual via EQ-timing, and members of the athletics groups can participate for free with a valid licence.

Start and finish at Fana Stadium
Evening races start at 18:45

description: Poznań Malta is a recurring running event organized by Kiprun Poznań Runners, held in the picturesque area around Lake Malta in Poznań. The event brings together runners and Nordic walking enthusiasts, offering a friendly atmosphere and an opportunity to spend time outdoors. The route runs along the lake, providing beautiful views and comfortable conditions for both competition and recreation. It is a great opportunity to connect the local running community and promote a healthy lifestyle.
course_highlights: Route around Lake Malta
Picturesque views of the lake and greenery
Friendly atmosphere for runners and Nordic walking enthusiasts
additional: The event is organized by Kiprun Poznań Runners, a group that holds regular running and Nordic walking meetups in Poznań. The event is recurring and community-oriented, promoting physical activity and having fun.

description: Vinterkarusellen på Romerike is a running series organized by Lørenskog Friidrettslag, offering races for all age groups, from children to veterans. Participants must have an athletics license to compete, ensuring insurance coverage and medical assistance if needed. Lørenskog Friidrettslag has training groups for different age groups and ability levels, and organizes several running and athletics events in the area. Participants aged 13 to 80 must have an athletics license; children under 13 are covered by the Child Sports Insurance.

description: The Bergen Marathon Series is a series of six races throughout the year, where participants can run both the half marathon and the full marathon. Bergen is regarded as Norway’s number one marathon city, and the series places great emphasis on quality and runners’ enjoyment, even though the races offer tough challenges. By completing five of the six races in the series, you receive a commemorative plaque. The February Marathon is the second race in the series and is held during the winter months, offering a great opportunity to test your fitness early in the year.

The series consists of six races, with both half-marathon and full-marathon options

description: Maratonkarusellen organizes several races in collaboration with BFG Bergen Løpeklubb, focusing on quality and a great experience for participants. The races include both half and full marathons, as well as other distances such as 10 km and ultramarathons. The February Marathon, held in Bergen, offers a challenging and beautiful course, starting and finishing at Fana Stadium. This race is part of a series of six races held throughout the year and is suitable for both experienced runners and recreational participants.
course_highlights: Course starts and finishes at Fana Stadium in Bergen
Includes both half-marathon and marathon distances
Organized in collaboration with BFG Bergen Løpeklubb, with a focus on quality
additional: Maratonkarusellen organizes three races in the spring and three in the fall each year. The focus is on making sure all participants enjoy themselves despite the tough challenges. Available distances are half marathon (21,097 meters) and marathon (42,195 meters).

Runners start on Droga Leśna - Przylesie Street and run a loop of approximately 2 km, which they can complete as many times as they like, with a minimum of two loops. The race lasts a maximum of 1.5 hours, and a fire siren signals its end. The event combines athletic competition with commemorating the Cursed Soldiers.

1.5-hour time limit; a fire siren signals the end

description: The Grand Prix Dziewicza Góra Mountain Running Series consists of six races on a scenic route in the Zielonka Forest Landscape Park. The course follows a 5.15 km loop entirely through the forest, with two climbs to the summit of Dziewicza Góra. The races attract both recreational and experienced runners, bringing together a unique running community known as the “Dziewicza Family.”
course_highlights: A 5.15 km loop through the forest
Two climbs to the summit of Dziewicza Góra
Passes through the event center, where spectators can cheer on runners
additional: Electronic timing using an ankle-mounted CHIP. The race office is open from 8:15 to 10:30. Participant limit: 500. The event takes place as a series of six stages. Runners in the 10 km race complete two laps of the course. Children’s and youth races are held over 200 m, 500 m, 1,000 m, and 1,500 m. Registration at the race office is available until 10:00 only for adult races and the Nordic Walking event. The 2026–2027 edition program also includes children’s races. The organizer’s website states that registration for individual stages opens successively; a limited number of passes for the whole series are also available.

Participants compete over 800 metres for the youngest runners and 4 kilometres for older participants. Every participant receives a commemorative T-shirt and a medal modelled on the medal of the Kujawy Pomorze 26 World Athletics Indoor Championships. The event promotes physical activity and integration within the local community.
course_highlights: The course runs through the city park on Bema Street
Two distances: 800 m for children and 4 km for adults
Commemorative T-shirts and medals for participants

name: Grand Prix CITY TRAIL
location: Leśny Park Kultury i Wypoczynku Myślęcinek, Bydgoszcz, Poland
organizer: Fundacja Krok do Natury; Stowarzyszenie Sport dla Każdego; Sport & Event Consulting Piotr Książkiewicz
description: Grand Prix CITY TRAIL is a nationwide series of 5 km cross-country races held in picturesque forests and urban parks. In Bydgoszcz, the course runs through Myślęcinek Forest Park of Culture and Recreation and the Żołędowo Forest District, giving participants the chance to compete on a regular, well-established route. The races are open to anyone aged 16 and over and aim to promote running and outdoor physical activity. The start and finish are at Polana Różopole, and the organizers provide professional event support and a recurring race series.
course_highlights: A 5 km course through the woodland setting of Myślęcinek and the Żołędowo Forest District
Start and finish at Polana Różopole
The course is suitable for both beginner and experienced runners
additional: The race office opens at 8:30 and closes at 10:30. A group warm-up with CITY TRAIL Ambassadors takes place before the start at 10:45. Parking is not available at Polana Różopole; parking lots approximately 1–1.5 km from the start are recommended. Races take place regularly during the 2026/2027 season across 7 locations. Four races are scheduled in Bydgoszcz: November 7, 2026; December 12, 2026; January 23, 2027; and March 6, 2027. During the 2026/2027 season, the Bydgoszcz races take place in Myślęcinek Forest Park of Culture and Recreation and the Żołędowo Forest District. Registration is available online through the Participant Panel or at the race office on race day.

name: Tropem Wilczym
description: The Tropem Wilczym Run in Zalesie is an annual running event commemorating the Cursed Soldiers, Polish heroes of the anti-communist underground from 1944 to 1963. Organized by the Ryki Municipality, the World Association of Home Army Soldiers, and the biegusiem.pl group, the event offers two distances: 1,963 meters and 5 kilometers. The run starts at 11:00, giving participants the opportunity to honor the soldiers’ memory while running along a scenic route near Zalesie. The event is open to runners of different ages and abilities.
course_highlights: Two distances to choose from: 1,963 m and 5 km
Route near Zalesie, close to Ryki
A run commemorating the Cursed Soldiers and their historical legacy
additional: The run is organized by the Ryki Municipality, the Ryki branch of the World Association of Home Army Soldiers named after Marian Bernaciak “Orlik,” and the biegusiem.pl group. The event is commemorative and patriotic in nature. A sample consent form for minors is available. Information about the run is published on its Facebook event page. The start and finish are in Zalesie, near Ryki. Information about the 2027 edition in Zalesie, including local distances and registration, has not been confirmed in available sources.

name: Bieg Niezłomnych
description: The Bieg Niezłomnych in memory of Major Zenon Wechmann is an annual running event held in the Babki Forest District in Luboń, in the so-called Lasek Majoński. The event is open to different age groups, from young children to adults, with distances ranging from 250 m for the youngest participants to 5 km for older runners, as well as a Nordic walking event. It has a family-friendly, inclusive atmosphere and promotes physical activity and remembrance of heroes. Participant numbers are limited to ensure comfort and safety during the event.
course_highlights: Routes run through the scenic Babki Forest District (Lasek Majoński)
Distances for different age groups range from 250 m to 5 km
Separate children’s races, as well as races and a Nordic walking event for adults
additional: Participant limits: 100 children in the children’s races and 200 participants in total across the 1963 m race, 5 km race and Nordic walking event. Starts are scheduled from 10:30 to 12:30, divided by age category and distance. The minimum age for the 1963 m race is 14; for the 5 km race and Nordic walking event, it is 16. Fees depend on the distance and registration date.

name: Kołobrzeska Odysea
organizer: Stowarzyszenie Nadmorscy Biegacze oraz Seaside Park Hotel Kołobrzeg
description: Kołobrzeska Odysea is a new race series in Kołobrzeg, bringing together three races held by the Baltic Sea over the course of a year. Participants can take part in a half marathon, a marathon or a 10 km race, earning three unique medals that form a single design. The event offers not only sporting excitement, but also beautiful coastal views and a unique atmosphere. The organizers provide full sanitary facilities, professional timing, attractive prizes and refreshments for finishers. Kołobrzeska Odysea is an event for runners who appreciate sport and the atmosphere of a seaside town.
course_highlights: Half marathon along the Baltic coast — 21.0975 km
Marathon or 10 km race — 42.195 km or 10 km
Beautiful views of coastal Kołobrzeg
additional: Participants receive three unique medals that form a single design. After the races, a finisher zone is available with a hot meal, snacks, isotonic drinks and water. An awards gala is held at Seaside Park Hotel* and includes a quiz and prizes. Full sanitary facilities are provided: bag drop, changing rooms, showers and toilets. Special accommodation discounts at Seaside Park Hotel* are available during the event. The organizers promise professional timing, food and drinks in the finisher zone, prizes and a gala at Seaside Park Hotel. Available sources describe the 2026 edition and do not confirm a race on the stated date of February 28, 2027.

name: Sopocki Bieg Inki
organizer: Miejski Ośrodek Sportu i Rekreacji w Sopocie (MOSiR)
description: The Sopot “Inka” Run commemorates Danuta Siedzikówna “Inka” and is organized by the Municipal Sports and Recreation Centre in Sopot under the patronage of the Mayor of Sopot. The event takes place as part of the National Day of Remembrance of the “Cursed Soldiers” and is symbolic, with no timing. Participants complete a running distance of their choice, and each receives a commemorative medal. After the run, attendees sing soldiers’ songs together and share food from a field kitchen, creating a unique atmosphere of remembrance and fellowship.
course_highlights: A run commemorating Danuta Siedzikówna “Inka”
No timing—the tribute is more important than the result
Group singing of soldiers’ songs and food from a field kitchen
additional: The run is not timed. Every participant receives a commemorative medal. After the run, there is group singing of soldiers’ songs and food served from a field kitchen. In previous editions, participants received a commemorative medal; after the run, there was group singing of soldiers’ songs and food from a field kitchen. Details of the edition on 28 February 2027 are not confirmed by available sources.

name: Omloop van Noordwijkerhout
location: Sportpark De Boekhorst, Noordwijkerhout, South Holland, Netherlands
description: The HomeWizard Omloop van Noordwijkerhout is a welcoming running event held in the beautiful dune area and among the colourful bulb fields around Noordwijkerhout. The race is part of the Zorg en Zekerheid Circuit and offers distances of 5 km, 10 km and a half marathon of 21.1 km, as well as a 1 km family run. The half marathon takes you through woodland and dunes and along paved roads, bringing nature and sport together. The venue is Sportpark De Boekhorst, which has facilities including changing rooms, showers and a bag drop. The event is suitable for both recreational runners and competitive athletes looking to enjoy a challenging and varied course.
course_highlights: Half marathon through dunes and flowering bulb fields
5 km and 10 km on fully paved roads alongside colourful bulb fields
Varied course through woodland, dunes and nature
additional: Start and finish at Sportpark De Boekhorst, Noordwijkerhout. Changing rooms, shower facilities and a bag drop are available. Parking is available at several nearby locations, but cycling is preferred. The race is part of the Zorg en Zekerheid Circuit, with an attractive overall standings competition and prizes in every category. Course through dunes and bulb fields; registration via the website; start and finish at Sportpark De Boekhorst.

name: Berden Voorjaarsloop
description: The Berden Voorjaarsloop in Venlo is a sporting event taking place on Sunday, 28 February 2027. The race offers a wide range of distances, from 500 metres for the youngest participants to 15 kilometres for experienced runners. A special feature is that participants in the 7.5 km and 15 km races run on Scopias’s professional 400-metre athletics track, adding a unique experience. The event is suitable for all ages and abilities and offers a fresh, energetic start to spring.

Distances range from 500 metres to 15 km, including youth races and a race on a professional athletics track; registration via inschrijven.nl; event in Venlo.

The event takes place in the evening and is part of a series of gatherings organized by the Centre for the Development of Physical Culture in Czerwonak. It’s a great opportunity to spend time together outdoors and connect with others.

description: Samnanger IL Running Group invites you to Vinterkarusellen, a friendly and sociable race starting and finishing at Nesodden. name: Warta Challenge
location: Łysy Młyn Forest Parking, Łyse Lake, Biedrusko, Poland
organizer: SPORT CHALLENGE Fundacja Wspierania Aktywności Fizycznej
description: WARTA CHALLENGE Marathon&Half is a winter running tournament consisting of a series of four running events and Nordic Walking walks, held on forest tracks and trails in the forests along the Warta River. The events offer half-marathon (21.3 km) and marathon (42.6 km) distances, as well as Nordic Walking walks over the half-marathon distance. This is a small-scale event for both recreational and professional athletes, featuring themed races and seasonal touches. The start and race office are located by Lake Łyse, next to the Łysy Młyn forest car park in Biedrusko. The gun start for each race is at 10:00.
course_highlights: The course follows forest tracks and trails along the Warta River, with some paved sections and slippery surfaces depending on the weather.
The half-marathon is one 21.3 km loop with 110 m of total elevation gain; the marathon is two loops, covering 42.6 km in total.
The course is marked with red-and-white tape and signs for the “Łysy Młyn” running trail, and passes, among other places, a landmark oak and stream cascades.
additional: Race packs can be collected on race day from 7:45 to 9:30 at the race office. During the 2026/2027 winter season, races and walks over 5 km and 10 km distances are also held. Each race has a theme, with suggested outfits and touches. The course is not officially certified; it is measured using bicycle computers and a Garmin. The start and event centre are by the Łysy Młyn forest car park, beside Lake Łyse, ul. Poznańska 4, Biedrusko. The start is scheduled for 10:00; race packs can be collected on race day from 7:45 to 9:30. Free parking is available, and the venue can also be reached by bus.

name: 3bergenLOOP
description: The 3bergenLOOP is an atmospheric running race in Driebergen, with three challenging courses: 6 km, 10 km and a half marathon. The routes follow unpaved forest trails, cycle paths and bridleways through the beautiful Bornia, Heidestein and Hoog Moersbergen estates. The race is known for its scenic, demanding courses and its focus on sustainability, with participants encouraged to bring their own reusable cups. The start and finish are at RCN Het Grote Bos, with refreshments available along the way and at the finish. The organizers provide a well-run event with chip timing and a welcoming atmosphere.
course_highlights: Routes along unpaved forest trails, cycle paths and bridleways
Half marathon through the Bornia, Heidestein and Hoog Moersbergen estates
Refreshment stations with water and sports drink along the route and at the finish
additional: Race numbers are sent to the home address provided. Start and finish at RCN Het Grote Bos. Refreshments at 9 km, 15 km and after the finish for the half marathon; at 4 km and after the finish for the 10 km; and after the finish for the 6 km. No medals are awarded. Racetimer chip timing is included. Race numbers can be transferred via the registration website. Participants are encouraged to use their own reusable cups to support sustainability. Routes have been adjusted due to area restrictions; registration opens in early December 2026; options are available to transfer race numbers and volunteer; the event takes an environmentally friendly approach with reusable cups and no medals; chip timing is included.

name: ACO van Elderen Crossloop
description: The ACO Van Elderen Crossloop is a challenging cross-country race organised by athletics club ACO Van Elderen in Ommen. The race is part of the Prins Sport-Vechtdalcrosscompetitie and takes place in the nature area around Ommen. The race starts on the athletics track, after which the course runs mostly off-road through the forest. There are three distances: 1.75 km, 5 km and 10 km, with participants running one or more laps through the forest. The cross-country race is known for its natural surroundings and varied course.
course_highlights: Start on the athletics track
Course runs mostly off-road through the forest
Three distances with different laps (blue and red)
additional: Registration is online only and open until 4 March 2027; no on-the-day registration is available. A lead cyclist will ride ahead of the runners during the race. For the 5 km and 10 km, day prizes are awarded to the first three women and men, provided by sponsors. For the youth distance (1.75 km), prizes are awarded to the first three in each category. Forest course, off-road terrain, online registration until 04-03-2027, prizes for the top three and course record

name: Halve Marathon van Haren
description: The RunX Haren Half Marathon is a spring classic, taking place for the 42nd time on Saturday, March 6, 2027, in Haren, Groningen. The event offers a sporty and enjoyable day, with distances of 21.1 km, 10 km, and 5 km recreational runs. The half marathon starts at 11:00 a.m. and the recreational runs at 11:20 a.m. By taking part, you support Jeugdfonds Sport & Cultuur Groningen, which helps children from families with limited means join sports or cultural clubs.
course_highlights: Start and finish at Sporthal Scharlakenhof in Haren
Route through the Felland Zuid industrial estate, 1,000 meters from the finish
Strict time limit of 2.5 hours for the half marathon
additional: Race numbers will be sent by post at the end of February 2026. Changes to distance or participant can be submitted online until March 6, 2026, at 10:00 p.m., for a fee of €2.50. Medals are optional and cost an additional €2.50. The half marathon has a time limit of 150 minutes. The Road Traffic Act applies on the course. Registration opens on October 24, 2026; various routes are available for different levels; the event supports Jeugdfonds Sport & Cultuur Groningen.

name: Rondje Zwolle Marathon
description: Rondje Zwolle 2027 is the second edition of a small-scale marathon around the beautiful city of Zwolle, organised by Zwolselopers. The marathon is all about camaraderie, running together and enjoying the experience, without an emphasis on fast times or personal records. Participants can run the full marathon or sign up together and split the distance. Weekend long runs are organised to help participants train together. Fysiotherapie De Dobbe supports participants in getting fit for the start.
course_highlights: Marathon around the city of Zwolle
Small-scale event with a friendly atmosphere
Option to split the distance and take turns running together
additional: The marathon is intentionally small-scale, with a limited number of race entries. Friendly weekend long runs are organised in preparation. Fysiotherapie De Dobbe is a sponsor and provides support with injuries. The start is at Wijthmenerplas. The marathon is characterised by an informal atmosphere and training and running together with other participants.

description: SANPROBI Women’s Run is an annual sporting event held in Szczecin, dedicated to active women and girls. The race takes place on a scenic route in Kasprowicza Park, with the start and finish at Jasne Błonia. The event promotes a healthy lifestyle, physical activity and women’s strength, while bringing participants together in an atmosphere of joy and support. It includes a 5 km main race, a Nordic walking event and mini-races for younger participants. The organizers provide a varied program of accompanying activities, partner zones and attractions for the whole family.
course_highlights: The main race route consists of two 2.5 km loops along paths in Kasprowicza Park
Start and finish at Jasne Błonia, a beautiful green space in Szczecin
No time limit for the 5 km distance; Nordic walking is also available
additional: The race office is open on 7 March 2026 (10:00–18:00) at the Szczecin Philharmonic and on 8 March 2026 (09:00–10:30) at the Institute of Pedagogy of the University of Szczecin. Mini-races for girls up to 11 years old are held over 200 m and 1 km. The mini-race participant limit is 300; once the limit is reached, registration is possible only at the race office (limited to 20 race numbers). Official race T-shirts are available for both races. There is no time limit for the main race. The running and Nordic walking routes follow paths through Kasprowicza Park. The 2026 edition offered a 5 km race, 5 km Nordic walking and mini-races. The organizers announced that registration for the next edition would open on 12 December 2026 at 12:00.

name: Legendarna Piątka Legendarna Dycha
description: The Legendary Five and Legendary Ten are exciting races held as part of the Toruń Legends Trilogy, taking place in the picturesque Old Town Market Square in Toruń. The events combine professional organization with a friendly, family atmosphere, offering participants fast courses with nationwide appeal. They are a great opportunity to take on the 5 km and 10 km distances while enjoying the beauty of Toruń’s Old Town and its local attractions.
course_highlights: The course runs through Toruń’s Old Town Market Square
Fast and exciting 5 km and 10 km distances
The race takes place in the historic city center, with views of UNESCO-listed landmarks
additional: Children’s races are held at every edition; in March, they take place alongside the main race. Online registration for the first edition of the Trilogy is open until March 1, 2026. After that date, registration is possible only at the race office. The organizer provides professional support and a friendly atmosphere. Available sources describe the edition on March 8, 2026, and do not confirm details of the event planned for March 7, 2027.

description: The Fysio 0512 Run Drachten is a running event held in Drachten, starting and finishing on the athletics track at AV Impala. The 10 km race is the official Open Frisian Championship and takes place on a unique, certified course through the beautiful countryside around Drachten. There are also 5 km and 1.5 km kids’ run distances, making the event suitable for runners of all levels and ages. The race combines a sporting challenge with a friendly atmosphere and offers prizes for the top runners and club champions.
course_highlights: The 10 km is the official Open Frisian Championship
Certified, fast course through the countryside around Drachten
Start and finish on the athletics track at AV Impala
additional: Collect race bibs on 8 March from 9:30 at the AV Impala clubhouse. No on-the-day registration is possible; online registration is open until 1 hour before the start. Limited changing and shower facilities are available. Free parking in the immediate vicinity of Sportlaan. Prizes for the top men and women in the Open Frisian Championship 10 km and for club champions in the 10 km and 5 km (with an Impala race shirt). All participants in the 1.5 km kids’ run receive a reward. A running clinic for 5 km and 10 km runners takes place before the event, with five training sessions led by coaches. Certified course, open to recreational and competitive runners, advance registration required, no on-the-day registration.

name: Halve van Oostvoorne
location: Oostvoorne, Voorne aan Zee, South Holland, Netherlands
description: The Halve van Oostvoorne is a welcoming running event taking place on Sunday, 7 March 2027, in the lively village centre and the scenic dunes of Oostvoorne. Participants can choose from a half marathon of 21.1 km, a fast 8 km, or youth races of 1 and 2 km. The paved course offers a lovely mix of nature and village scenery, with excellent facilities such as changing rooms, showers and parking close to the start. Organised by football club OVV and Voorne Atletiek, the event promises a safe, well-run day full of sporting fun.
course_highlights: Paved course through the scenic dunes and village centre
Music and activities for spectators create a festive atmosphere
Excellent facilities, including changing rooms, showers and parking close to the start
additional: The 1 km youth race starts at 11:00 (up to age 11); the 2 km race starts at 11:15 (up to age 14). The 8 km and half marathon start at 12:00. All participants receive a medal. Minimum age: 14 for the 8 km and 16 for the half marathon. Facilities: unguarded changing rooms and showers, parking, and a canteen serving drinks, sandwiches and snacks. Half-marathon course records: men 01:06.36; women 01:17.41. Parking is available close to the start, with several other parking options within walking distance. Paved course; facilities include changing rooms, showers and parking; registration is open.

description: Rondje Goutum is a running event in Leeuwarden that takes you to the south side of the city. It offers a wide range of distances, from a 1 km Kids Run to a challenging 30 km, making it ideal preparation for other races. The distances are measured exactly, and all participants receive a cup of hot chocolate afterwards. The start and finish are at Atletiekbaan Nijlân, where participants in every distance run one more lap of the track on their return.
course_highlights: Exactly measured distances from 1 km to 30 km
Start and finish at Atletiekbaan Nijlân, with a lap of the track
Aid stations and first aid available, including on the 10 km route
additional: Start times by distance: 30 km at 10:30, 1 km Kids Run at 11:00, 16 km at 11:15, 10 km at 11:25, 5 km at 11:35, and 2 km at 11:40. Registration is online only and remains open until shortly before the start; on-site registration is not available. Routes are available via afstandmeten.nl, with GPX, KML, and TCX downloads. All participants receive hot chocolate afterwards. Participants can register online only. The event takes place at Atletiekbaan Nijlân / Lionitas, Middelzeelaan 20, Leeuwarden.

name: Snøkuten - Kaashagarunden
description: Snøkuten Kaashagarunden is a 6.9-kilometer cross-country race organized by Veldre Friidrett, marking the start of the 42nd season of the Vinterkarusellen Snøkuten. The race takes place in Ringsaker, Hedmark, and attracts around 100 participants despite varying weather conditions. Participants must wear a reflective vest and take care in traffic. Both timed and fitness classes are offered. The event is especially important this year, with many opportunities for exercise and competition having been cancelled.
course_highlights: Cross-country race in Ringsaker, Hedmark
Distance of 6.9 kilometers
Reflective vest required; participants must take care in traffic
additional: Both timed and untimed fitness classes are available. The event attracts around 100 participants each time. The race marks the start of the 42nd season of the Vinterkarusellen Snøkuten. A reflective vest is required; a headlamp and good winter footwear may be useful.

name: Frikarusellen - 6. løp
location: Espeland Idrettsplass, Espeland, Arna, Bergen, Norway
description: The Frikarusellen is a winter running series organized by Idrettslaget Fri in Arna, Bergen. The races take place on a certified 5 km course that starts at Espeland sports ground and runs via Gamle Haukeland station, mainly on walking and cycling paths with little traffic. The series consists of six races throughout the winter and is suitable for both young people and adults, with a friendly atmosphere and a shared love of running. IL Fri has a long tradition as an organizer and also offers discounts for club members.
course_highlights: Certified 5 km course between Espeland and Gamle Haukeland station
The course runs mostly on walking and cycling paths or roads with little traffic
Start and finish at Espeland sports ground
additional: Race numbers can be collected at Espelandshallen on race day between 18:00 and 18:55. Registration is open until 18:55 on race day. A license fee applies in addition for participants over 13 without an annual license. A fee of NOK 50 applies for forgotten race numbers for those registered for all races. Results are published at www.eqtiming.no. Race-number distribution and changing facilities are available from 18:00.
