description: The Frikarusellen is a race series organized by IL Fri, starting and finishing at Espeland sports ground in Arna. The course is 5 km long, first officially measured in 2000 and measured again in 2018. It runs from north of the Londalskrysset intersection via Gamle Haukeland station and back along the same route. The series consists of several races throughout the season and is suitable for both young people and adults. You can register easily via EQ Timing, and race numbers are collected on race day at Espelandshallen.
course_highlights: 5 km officially measured course
Starts north of the Londalskrysset intersection and returns along the same route
Finish inside Espeland sports ground
additional: Race numbers are collected at Espelandshallen between 18:00 and 18:55 on race day. Registration is open until 18:55 on the same day. A licence fee is added for participants over 13 who do not have an annual licence. There is a fee of NOK 50 for a forgotten race number for those registered for all the races. Results are published at www.eqtiming.no. Registration via EQ Timing is available until 18:55 on race day. A licence fee may be added. Series registration is also available, with separate prices for IL Fri members.

location: IL Skade Clubhouse, Kåsa, Nome, Telemark, Norway
description: The Lunde Road Race is a traditional 8 km road race organised by IL Skade’s athletics group. It follows the beautiful, flat route alongside the Telemark Canal, starting and finishing at IL Skade’s clubhouse at Kåsa. The race has a long history and has been held more than 50 times, previously as part of the Vinterkarusellen in Telemark. After the race, participants are invited to socialise over cordial, coffee and waffles, followed by an informal prize-giving at the clubhouse, where changing rooms and showers are also available.
course_highlights: Flat route of approximately 7.8 km alongside the Telemark Canal
Start and finish at IL Skade’s clubhouse at Kåsa
More than 50 years of tradition; one of the oldest races in the area

Changing rooms and showers are available at the clubhouse. After the race, participants can socialise over cordial, coffee and waffles, followed by an informal prize-giving. Registration on race day is at the clubhouse from approximately 11:00 to 12:30, or by SMS.

The race promotes physical activity among people of all ages and is part of the Mogilno County Crown series. The main race route passes through the villages of Dąbrowa, Parlin and Parlinek, and runs on asphalt certified by the Polish Athletics Association. The organizers warmly invite everyone to take part and celebrate their passion for sport together.

Asphalt surface with markers every kilometer
Water stations along the route in Parlin and Parlinek

name: Noordduinloop
description: The Duinloopcircuit in Katwijk is a unique running series along the Dutch coast, featuring varied courses that combine challenging dune trails with fast beach sections. The races offer a great atmosphere for both dedicated runners and recreational runners who enjoy running outdoors. The Noordduinloop, part of this series, takes place on 13 March 2027 and is one of a series of events held throughout the year.
course_highlights: Varied courses with dune trails and beach sections
A unique running series along the Dutch coast
Suitable for all levels and ages
additional: Rankings are kept for all distances, separately for girls/women and boys/men. The rankings are based on the four best results in the series. Distances range from 500m to 10 km, including kids' runs, with rankings based on the four best results.

name: Edsvidsleden Trailrun
price_range: 50 kr för T-shirt från tidigare år
description: Edsvidsleden Trailrun is a classic trail race in Trollhättan, offering a beautiful and challenging 14 km course along the Edsvidsleden trail. The start and finish are at Forngården, and the course follows a marked hiking trail with some sections additionally flagged. The race is open to everyone who wants to experience trail running on lovely paths, with water available at two stations. It is a well-organised race with a long tradition and a friendly atmosphere for both beginners and experienced runners.
course_highlights: 14 km course on the classic Edsvidsleden trail in Trollhättan
The course follows a marked hiking trail, with some sections additionally flagged
Water is available at approximately 9 km and in the start and finish area
additional: The start and finish have been moved to Forngården in Trollhättan. There is no parking at the start; park on the streets in Strömslund or at Torsbovallen. Bring your own water and cup. T-shirts from previous years will be sold on race day for 50 kr each. Course records for men and women are listed for the 14 km, 28 km and 56 km distances from previous years. All participation is at your own risk and permits the publication of photos and videos on social media. The event is a trail race on marked paths, with water stations, no chip timing and a prize ceremony for the top finishers. Participants are advised to bring their own cup and water.

name: Königsforst Marathon
description: One of Germany’s six oldest marathons. With 17 small start groups from 08:45 to 14:00. With prizes for course and age-group records. With a single entry fee for all three distances, so you can switch distances at any time at no extra cost. With a reforestation initiative to offset the environmental impact of travel. With a DLV-certified course through nature.
additional:
The course:
The loop through the Königsforst includes several sections of the original 1973 course. The website has a dynamic GPX map of the course and an option to download the GPX file.

The course has only two longer, steeper climbs:

From km 3 to km 4, the route climbs 28 m to “Monte Troodelöh” (Cologne’s highest point). It then descends to the first aid station at km 5.
After km 15, at the “Wassertretstelle” (water-treading pool), you climb 40 m over a distance of 630 m. The third aid station comes shortly afterwards.

You reach the highest point shortly after the third aid station. From here, the route is flat along the path of the former railway line back to Bensberg. In the final kilometre, it leaves the forest after the underpass. 400 m before the finish, turn right and head up Schloßfeldweg.

name: Grand Prix CITY TRAIL
location: Zajazd Szmaragd, ul. Kopalniana, Szczecin, Poland
description: Grand Prix CITY TRAIL is a nationwide series of 5 km cross-country races held in beautiful woodland surroundings. The Szczecin course is varied and located behind Zajazd Szmaragd, by Emerald Lake, with challenging uphill and downhill sections. The event is open to runners of all levels, from beginners to advanced athletes, who can regularly check their results on the same course. The event promotes outdoor physical activity and a healthy lifestyle.
course_highlights: A 5 km course in woodland surroundings by Emerald Lake
Start and finish behind Zajazd Szmaragd, at the edge of Kopalniana Street
Varied sections with uphills and downhills, including the most challenging section about 1.7 km from the start
additional: The race office opens at 8:30 and closes at 10:30. Before the 11:00 start, there is a group warm-up with CITY TRAIL Ambassadors. The event also includes races for children in different age categories. Races are held regularly during the season, from October to April. The start and finish are behind Zajazd Szmaragd on Kopalniana Street; the race office is next door. According to the official calendar, Szczecin has no race on 14 March 2027—the Szczecin race dates for the 2026/2027 season are 18 October, 15 November, 10 January and 4 April.

name: WoolderEsloop
description: The Wooldereslopen is a running competition organised by MPM in Hengelo for more than 45 years. It consists of four races held during the first months of the year, with distances of 1.4, 5.1, 10 and 15 kilometres. The course runs through the countryside around Hengelo, with the start and finish at the same location in the Woolderes. The races are open to various categories and offer cash prizes and gift vouchers. Electronic timing is provided, and race numbers can be collected in advance or on race day.
course_highlights: Course through the countryside around Hengelo
Start and finish at the same location in the Woolderes
Distances of 1.4, 5.1, 10 and 15 kilometres
additional: Race numbers can be collected from 9:00 at IKC De Wooldermarke, Semmelweisstraat 46, 7555 NT Hengelo. The race number includes a timing chip and must be worn on the chest. A running shirt and medal are available as optional extras when registering in advance. Shower and changing facilities are available at Gymzaal Woolderesweg and close at 13:15. Race numbers can be collected on the preceding Saturday or on race day. Participants use the same race number for all four races. The standings are based on at least 3 of the 4 races. Bringing animals or pushchairs and using earbuds/headphones is discouraged or not permitted. Registration opens at 9:00, and the courses run through the countryside around Hengelo. Results from previous years are available, and the event has been organised for more than 45 years.

name: Necon Vinterkarusell 26-27 løp 7 (15. mar)
description: Necon Winter Series is a winter running series with 8 races, where participants can choose between 5 or 10 km. The races start and finish at Fana Stadium in Bergen, with a start time of 18:45. The series runs over several Mondays from October to April and offers discounts for IL Gneist members. Registration is individual via EQ-timing, and members of the athletics groups who pay the training fee may participate for free.
course_highlights: Races over 5 km or 10 km
Start and finish at Fana Stadium
Evening races starting at 18:45
additional: Discounts are available for IL Gneist members using various discount codes. Members of the athletics groups who pay the main club membership fee and training fee may participate for free. An annual licence incurs a fee of 50 kr if it has not already been paid. Registration is via EQ-timing with individual sign-up. Registration is individual via EQ-timing. Membership discounts are available for various IL Gneist memberships. The annual licence costs 50 kr if it has not already been registered.

name: Hamarkarusellen vinter Løp 6
description: The Hamarkarusellen Winter Series is a running series for everyone, whether you are an experienced runner, a recreational runner, or simply looking to get outside for some fresh air. The series consists of six races over the winter months, all on the same 5 km course, starting and finishing at Prestrudhallen in Hamar. The races focus on activity, achievement, and socializing, and everyone is welcome regardless of pace—you can run, jog, walk, or combine them. Participants who take part in at least four of the six races receive a finisher’s prize. The event offers a friendly atmosphere, with gingerbread and cordial at the finish.
course_highlights: Six races on the same 5 km course, starting and finishing at Prestrudhallen in Hamar
The course is suitable for running, jogging, and walking
A social and motivating winter series focused on achievement and activity
additional: A finisher’s prize is awarded to everyone who takes part in at least four of the six races. Participants are encouraged to wear a Santa hat, and gingerbread and cordial are served at the finish. The member price applies to members of corporate sports clubs and individual members of the Innlandet Regional Corporate Sports Association. Everyone is welcome, with an accessible format and room for all levels. Registration is available for individual races or the entire series.

name: Åsane løpskarusell 2027 | Løp 4
description: Åsane running series is a recreational running series with weekly 5 km races in Åsane, Bergen, starting and finishing at IKEA. The course is nationally certified, suits all levels, and is led by experienced coaches. The series has a social and inclusive atmosphere and also offers training sessions for those who would like to join the running group. Race numbers are collected on site before the races, and family and individual registration are available.
course_highlights: 5 km course, measured and nationally certified
Start and finish inside IKEA, at the rear facing south
The course was measured and certified by Ivar Andreas Sandø
additional: Race numbers are collected in the IKEA garage between 18:00 and 18:45. Race numbers must be worn visibly and must not be folded or damaged. A replacement race number costs 100 kr. The races take place on Thursdays. Start time: 19:00. Race numbers can be collected in the IKEA garage between 18:00 and 18:45. The start and finish are at the rear of the IKEA building, facing south.

name: Åsane Løpskarusell 2027 Løp 4
description: Åsane Running Series is a recreational running series with weekly 5 km races in Åsane, starting and finishing at IKEA. The course is nationally certified and suitable for all levels, with experienced coaches leading the way. The series has a social and inclusive atmosphere and also offers group training sessions for members. Bibs are collected in IKEA’s car park before the race, and participants can enter individual races or the full series.
course_highlights: 5 km course measured and nationally certified
Start and finish inside IKEA, at the rear on the south side
The course was measured by a certified course measurer on 19.11.2022
additional: Bibs are collected in IKEA’s car park between 18:00 and 18:45. Bibs must be worn visibly, and the tags must not be folded or damaged. Participants can enter individual races or the full series. The race is organized by I.L. Norna-Salhus. Runners use their bib at every race. The prices listed on the information page apply to 2026 and are therefore not included as prices for 2027.

name: Equinox Adventure Ultra
description: Equinox Adventure Ultra is a unique trail-running race held during the spring equinox. The race is a long-distance experience in which teams of two runners navigate on their own and are self-sufficient through equal parts daylight and darkness. Participants can choose between a long distance of at least 100 km or a shorter distance of at least 50 km. The race starts on Saturday at 12:00 and runs until Sunday at 18:00, offering a challenging experience immersed in nature over a full day.
course_highlights: Long-distance trail running through forests and nature
Self-sufficient teams of two runners
Navigation through equal parts daylight and darkness during the spring equinox
additional: The race runs from Saturday at 12:00 until Sunday at 18:00. Each team consists of two self-sufficient runners who must navigate on their own during the race. The race is self-sufficient, with participants using a map and compass to navigate through forests, trails and open landscapes. The start location is secret, and the race takes place around the spring equinox in Nyköping, Sweden.

name: Vårtävlingarna
description: Vårtävlingarna is an annual running event held on the second Saturday in March in Skatås, Gothenburg. The classic race course is the “gravel eight,” a course just under 8 km long where participants can choose to run one, two or four laps. Since 2026, Vårtävlingarna Trail has also been held, a new trail race of approximately 16 km in the Skatås and Delsjö area. The event offers a well-organized and varied running experience, with water stations and prize ceremonies for the fastest runners in each category.
course_highlights: The “gravel eight” race course in Skatås, approximately 7.8 km per lap
Vårtävlingarna Trail: approximately 16 km of trail running in the Skatås and Delsjö area
Water stations with water and sports drink on the longer distances
additional: Race bibs can be collected from 08:30 on race day at Solvikingarna’s clubhouse. Timing is recorded using a disposable chip on the back of the race bib. Changing and shower facilities are available at Skatås Motionscentrum for a fee. Prize ceremonies take place in the finish area shortly after each category finishes. Live results are available during race day. Vårtävlingarna Trail premiered in 2026.

name: Frozen Lake Marathon
description: Frozen Lake Marathon is a unique running event held on the frozen surface of Lake Tisleifjorden in Norway, 819 meters above sea level. Participants run entirely on ice, on a course with the flattest elevation profile in the world, making it an unforgettable experience. The race is limited to 500 participants and offers both a half marathon and a full marathon. The entry includes an official long-sleeved race shirt and a medal for all finishers, with warm soup and bread served after the race. The course is carefully monitored and laid out just days before the race to ensure safety on the ice.
course_highlights: 100% ice surface on Lake Tisleifjorden, with ice about 80 cm thick
The flattest elevation profile in the world
Energy stations at several points, offering sports drinks, water, energy bars, dried fruit, and chocolate
additional: Limited to 500 participants. Transfer is included only for participants staying at Oset Fjellhotell; shuttle service is available at a cost from Storefjell Resort. Parking near the race area is very limited; studded tires are recommended for driving. Bag-drop service is available with a bib tag. Basic changing tents and portaloo toilets are provided. Warm soup with bread is served after the race. Arrival by train to Gol is recommended; the official race hotel is Oset Fjellhotell. The entry includes an official long-sleeved race shirt and a medal, and warm soup with bread is served after the race. Transport is included for participants staying at Oset Fjellhotell; parking near the race area is very limited.

name: 6. Ekeberg Backyard Ultra
description: Ekeberg Backyard Ultra is a classic backyard ultra race held in Oslo’s “central park” at Ekeberg. The race takes place during the dark and cold time of year, giving participants the opportunity to run together with the ultra-running family in beautiful surroundings, with views of Oslo’s skyline and the Oslofjord. The event offers a unique atmosphere with live music, good vibes and facilities such as changing rooms and tents. A maximum of 110 participants can take part, and everyone who completes at least one lap receives a medal.
course_highlights: Run through beautiful scenery with views of the Oslofjord and Oslo’s skyline
The event takes place at Bekkelagshøgda Tennis Club, with access to changing rooms and tents
Live music and good vibes with the ultra-running family
additional: Participants receive a race bib and tracker for automatic live recording of lap times. Drinks, snacks and some hot food are provided. Maximum 110 participants. Everyone who completes at least one lap receives a medal. The race starts at 09:00. Registration opens on 1 December 2026 at 00:01. Participants receive a tracker for lap times, access to the venue and changing rooms, drinks, snacks and hot food. Medals are awarded to everyone who completes at least one lap.

name: Grand Prix CITY TRAIL
description: Grand Prix CITY TRAIL is a nationwide series of 5 km cross-country races held in the beautiful woodland setting by Lake Rusałka in Poznań. The races are open to runners of all abilities, from beginners to advanced athletes, who can regularly test themselves on the same course. The event is recreational and competitive in nature, promoting outdoor physical activity and a healthy lifestyle. The start and finish are near Św. Wawrzyńca Street, and the course runs through picturesque woodland and the city beach. The races are part of the Grand Prix CITY TRAIL 2026/2027 series, which includes four races in Poznań, with an overall classification and a separate classification for each city.
course_highlights: A 5 km course in the woodland setting by Lake Rusałka
Start near Św. Wawrzyńca Street, with the finish by the city beach
The course is suitable for both beginner and advanced runners
additional: The race office opens at 8:30 and closes at 10:30. A group warm-up with the CITY TRAIL Ambassadors takes place before the 10:45 start. The event follows a consistent schedule, and the race office remains in the same location throughout the season. Participants can choose charity packages supporting the Siepomaga Foundation. The event receives funding from the budget of the City of Poznań. The series also includes races for children.

name: Alfa Laval Stevensloop
description: The Alfa Laval Stevensloop is Nijmegen’s city run, taking place on 20 March 2027. The start is in the iconic Kronenburgerpark, and the finish is right in the centre of the oldest city in the Netherlands. The different courses offer varied routes through the city centre, past the city island, along Nijmegen’s skyline and through the natural surroundings of the Ooijpolder. The event is organised by Stichting Zevenheuvelenloop, which aims to get as many people as possible moving and provide a great running experience.
course_highlights: Start in Kronenburgerpark and finish at the Grote Markt
Climb up the Voerweg, featuring the Alfa Laval Cheering Zone
Varied routes through the city and nature, passing iconic sights such as the Stevenskerk and the Ooijpolder
additional: A supervised cloakroom for small bags is available at the start in Kronenburgerpark. The Voerweg is a challenging climb towards the end of the 5 km and half marathon, with a special Alfa Laval Cheering Zone where spectators and music provide extra encouragement. The Alfa Laval Hill Challenge rewards the fastest climb up the Voerweg with a €100 gift voucher for Runnersworld. Registration opens on 1 October 2026, race numbers can be collected in March 2027, and the event takes place on 20 and 21 March 2027.

name: Molenloop Vrouwenparochie

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: De online verkoop van startkaarten kan tot en met vrijdag 26 december 2025.

description: The Midseumer Molnkoier is a unique evening walk that invites walkers to enjoy nature and culture in and around Vrouwenparochie. This walking event is made possible in part by many volunteers and sponsors, with the proceeds going to a good cause. The route passes the old grain mill and winds through the beautiful Frisian countryside, offering a special experience for lovers of walking and cultural history.
course_highlights: Evening walk past the old grain mill, De Vrouwbuurtstermolen
Natural and cultural surroundings of Vrouwenparochie
Unique atmosphere during midwinter and a scenic route
additional: Entry tickets can also be purchased at the start desk. The walking event is held at the old grain mill, De Vrouwbuurtstermolen, in Vrouwenparochie. Registration is available for several distances, and participants can enjoy a course through the beautiful countryside and mill surroundings.

name: Monnikenloop
description: The Monnikenloop is an annual running race held on the beautiful island of Schiermonnikoog. The race offers several distances, including a kids’ run, 5 km, 10 km and 10 English Miles, and attracts both recreational and dedicated runners. The event combines sporting spirit with a friendly atmosphere and invites participants to experience the island’s unique nature. The start and finish are centrally located, and there is plenty of opportunity to enjoy an atmospheric weekend with accommodation available on the island.
course_highlights: Routes across the island of Schiermonnikoog, through nature and dunes
Distances ranging from a 1 km kids’ run to 10 English Miles (16.1 km)
Start and finish in the village, in an atmospheric setting
additional: Kids’ runs start from 11:20, the 5 km starts at 12:40, the 10 km at 12:50 and the 10 English Miles at 12:30. The race pack includes a race number with chip and a bus pass for transport on the island. Participants must reserve their own ferry ticket. A running shirt can be ordered. Changes to registration can be made for a fee until the end of March. The start and finish are in the village, with changing and shower facilities. Several distances; registration opens on 1 October 2026; accommodation is available on the island; the event takes place in March.

name: Oldemeijercross
location: Recreatieplas De Oldemeijer, Hardenberg, Overijssel, Netherlands
description: The Oldemeijercross is one of the oldest running races in the region and is organized annually by AV Spurt'88. The race takes place around the De Oldemeijer recreational lake in Hardenberg and offers a challenging course with tough climbs, sand, and mud. This running event is for all ages, with the start and finish on the event hill at Oldemeijer. Spectators can cheer on the runners from several spots, adding to the lively, sporting atmosphere.
course_highlights: Tough climbs along the course
Route around the De Oldemeijer recreational lake
Sandy and muddy terrain
additional: Race-day registration is possible. The start and finish are on the event hill at Oldemeijer. The course is suitable for all ages, and there are several places for spectators to cheer on the runners. The 3 km course around Oldemeijer is challenging, with climbs, sand, and mud; the start and finish are at the event hill; registration via inschrijven.nl; no showers available.

name: Reeuwijkse Plassenloop
description: The Vosplan Reeuwijkse Plassenloop is one of the oldest running events in the Netherlands and has been held for more than 70 years. Each year, the event attracts runners from the region and beyond, who enjoy an active and sociable day. The course is completely flat and has little traffic. It runs through Reeuwijkse Hout and along the distinctive Reeuwijkse Plassen, making it an appealing and fast course. There are distances for all ages, from kids’ runs to 15 kilometres, including supervised youth distances.
course_highlights: Completely flat course with little traffic
Runs through Reeuwijkse Hout and along the Reeuwijkse Plassen
Clear kilometre markers and one lap per distance (5, 10 and 15 km)
additional: MYLAPS BibTag timing is used. The chip is attached to the back of the race number and does not need to be returned. Late registration is available on race day from 10:30 until half an hour before the start. The start and finish area is at Reeuwijkse Houtwal in the De Reeuwijkse Hout recreation area. Ample parking and toilets are available. There are no changing or shower facilities. Every finisher receives a commemorative medal. Cash prizes are awarded for the 5, 10 and 15 km races for men and women, plus an additional prize for a course record. Registration opens on 1 January 2027 via Inschrijven.nl. The event offers prizes and keepsakes for the winners, and preparation training sessions are available. Participants can register for different distances and age groups.

name: Marathon Alblasserwaard 750
description: The Alblasserwaard 750 Marathon is a unique, one-time marathon taking place on 20 March 2027 to celebrate 750 years of Alblasserwaard history. The 42.195-kilometre route runs from the UNESCO World Heritage Site of Kinderdijk, through characteristic polders, windmills, historic waterways and villages, to the finish at AV Typhoon in Gorinchem. The marathon offers runners a special experience through the open peat-meadow landscape and past iconic windmills and duck decoys, with the region’s landscape and history at its heart.
course_highlights: Start at Kinderdijk’s 19 windmills, a UNESCO World Heritage Site
Route along separated cycle paths and roads with limited traffic
Past historic waterways, polder windmills and characteristic villages
additional: Shuttle buses will run between Gorinchem and Kinderdijk for participants. Parking at the start is not possible and is discouraged. Bicycle parking is available at both the start and finish. The organisers aim to be sustainable by using biodegradable cups and cleaning the course after the event. Sweeper vehicles are available for runners who drop out. The minimum age to participate is 18. The marathon is a unique, one-time event celebrating the region’s history and beauty, with a maximum limit of 2,500 runners.

name: Dark Sky Trail Lauwersmeer
location: Activiteitencentrum Lauwersnest, Lauwersoog, Municipality Noardeast-Fryslân, Friesland, Netherlands
description: The Dark Sky Trail Lauwersmeer is a unique nighttime running and walking event held in the official Dark Sky Park Lauwersmeer, one of the darkest areas in Europe. The race offers three events: canicross, trail running and a walking tour, all approximately 10 km long. Participants run in the dark, with headlamps permitted only in emergencies, creating a special experience. Registration raises awareness of light pollution through a donation for each participant.
course_highlights: Nighttime route in the official Dark Sky Park Lauwersmeer
Approximately 10 km for canicross, trail running and the walking tour
Headlamps permitted only in emergencies
additional: The start location and meeting point is Activiteitencentrum Lauwersnest, De Rug 1, 9976VT Lauwersoog. A drink is available at the finish. Estimated duration is approximately 1 hour 45 minutes for trail runners and canicross participants, and approximately 2 hours 45 minutes for walkers. night run, canicross, walking tour, 10 km, start location: Activiteitencentrum Lauwersnest, Lauwersoog

name: De VoorschotenLoop
description: The VoorschotenLoop is a running race organized by Voorschoten '97 Athletics, held in the beautiful village of Voorschoten. The race is part of the Zorg en Zekerheid Circuit and is open to everyone, whatever their level. The course is fast and passes some of the village’s most beautiful spots, with various distances for children and adults. The longest distance runs through the scenic countryside, including Park Rosenburgh and Duivenvoorde Estate. There is also a special Voorschoten Championship for the fastest residents of Voorschoten.
course_highlights: Fast course passing some of Voorschoten’s most beautiful spots
5 km and GeZZinsloop through welcoming neighborhoods
10 km and 10 English miles through the countryside, including Park Rosenburgh and Duivenvoorde Estate
additional: The GeZZinsloop is free and starts at 10:15 for ages 6–9 and 10:35 for ages 10–12. The start and finish are at Sportpark Adegeest, Weddeloop 6, 2253ST Voorschoten. To take part in the Voorschoten Championship, you must live in Voorschoten and wear a green dot on your race bib, which can be collected beforehand in the canteen. There is no race-day registration. Distances range from 1.25 km to 10 English miles; registration is possible on 21 March; prizes for top participants; championship for Voorschoten residents; prepare with a beginners’ course organized by Voorschoten '97.

description: The Moore DRV Half Westland is a popular half marathon in the Westland, Haaglanden and Rotterdam region, held in Naaldwijk. The race is a fitting finale to the Olympus '70 Runners Project and is suitable for both competitive runners and recreational participants. The route passes through the polders and alongside greenhouses, with aid stations along the way and a lively start and finish venue at the Olympus '70 athletics facility. The half marathon is part of the aaff Summer Run Circuit and offers a varied, fast, traffic-free course.
course_highlights: Route through the polders and alongside greenhouses in the Westland
Aid stations at 6.3, 12.7 and 17.5 km with water and sports drink
Start and finish at the Olympus '70 athletics facility, with changing rooms and showers
additional: The use of reusable SAW timing chips is compulsory; a chip can be ordered for €4,50 when registering. Race numbers can be collected on race day at the Van Dijk Flora indoor hall at Olympus '70. The facility has spacious changing rooms and showers. First aid is available at 17 km and at the finish. Prize ceremonies for various categories. The half marathon is part of the aaff Summer Run Circuit. Entries for the half marathon are completely sold out; the event also includes a 10 km, 5 km and a children's walk.

name: Emmy Run
description: De Emmy Run in Slagharen is een gezellig en toegankelijk hardloopevenement voor jong en oud, met afstanden variërend van 1 tot 10 kilometer. De wedstrijd vindt plaats rondom Cafetaria Lunchroom Emmy en biedt voor elk wat wils, van de Kidsrun tot een bedrijven- en verenigingenrun. Het evenement staat in het teken van plezier en samen sporten, zonder prijzengeld maar met leuke attenties voor alle deelnemers. Na afloop is er een bescheiden afterparty in de speciale Emmy tent op het kerkplein.

name: Lillestrøms Høyeste Trappeløp
description: Lillestrøm’s Highest Stair Race takes place at Scandic Lillestrøm, with its 12 floors, and offers a real challenge for anyone who wants to test themselves, their friends, family, or colleagues. The race is suitable for all levels and is open to participants aged 13 and over. The event starts at 18:00, with race bibs and timing chips available for collection from 17:00. EMIT timing chips record start time, split time, and finish time, and results are displayed in real time on a large screen on the 2nd floor.
course_highlights: The race goes up 12 floors at Scandic Lillestrøm
EMIT timing chips record start, split, and finish times
Results are displayed in real time on a large screen on the 2nd floor
additional: Race bibs and timing chips can be collected from 17:00. Warm-up is self-directed, outdoors or indoors where space is available. Luggage can be left in a hotel meeting room at your own risk. Toilets are on the 1st and 2nd floors. Using public transport is recommended, as Scandic Lillestrøm is 50 metres from the train station and 150 metres from the bus station. Parking is limited, but commuter parking in the parking garage or at Varemessen (approx. 200 m away) is recommended if arriving by car. Group registration and a single invoice are available for corporate sports clubs and businesses. Timing is done using EMIT chips.

name: Cross Island Bornholm 2027 - ½ marathon og 10 km
Förslöv Trail
location: Förslövs idrottshall, Förslöv, Båstad Municipality, Skåne County, Sweden
description: Förslöv Trail 2027 is a scenic trail race held at the foot of Hallandsåsen, starting and finishing at Förslöv Sports Hall. Participants can choose between three distances: 5 km, 10 km and 24 km. Everyone runs the same first 2 km and final kilometre. The race features varied terrain, including forest trails and grass, with beautiful views of the small settlement and the natural landscape on the ridge. After finishing, participants can enjoy a medal, fruit, refreshments and the chance to socialise in the sports hall. Race bibs can be collected on race day or in advance in Båstad, where registered runners receive a discount on Sportshopen’s range.
course_highlights: Start and finish at Förslöv Sports Hall
Terrain with forest trails, grass and hills on Hallandsåsen
Sports drink and water available at several stations along the course
additional: Umara sports drink and water are served at several stations, depending on the distance. After the race, participants are offered a medal, fruit, refreshments and the chance to socialise in the sports hall. Race bibs can be collected on race day from 8:30 a.m. or in advance at Sportshopen in Båstad, where registered runners receive a 20% discount. Changing rooms are available in the sports hall. Start times: 24 km at 10:00 a.m., 10 km at 10:30 a.m. and 5 km at 11:00 a.m. Race bibs must be collected on race day at least 20 minutes before the start. Changing rooms are available at the sports hall, and drinks and refreshments are provided along the course and after the finish.

name: Drents Friese Woldmarathon
description: The Drents Friese Wold Marathon is a challenging marathon held in the beautiful Drents-Friese Wold National Park near Diever. The course consists of laps of just over 10 km on paved and semi-paved cycle paths and minor roads, mostly through the forest. The marathon has a rich history, with fast course records, and attracts many runners each year who enjoy its natural surroundings. The start and finish are in Diever, and the organizers provide professional chip timing. The marathon is suitable for runners aged 18 and over, with a shorter distance for young people aged 14 and over.
course_highlights: Laps of just over 10 km on paved and semi-paved cycle paths and minor roads
Mostly through the wooded surroundings of Drents-Friese Wold National Park
Start and finish in Diever
additional: Collect your race number on 27 March from 10:00 to 11:45 at the start location. Registration is also available on the day, during the same hours. Timing is by a chip attached to the race number; returning the race number after finishing is strongly requested. Age limits: 18 years for all distances except 10.1 km; 14 years for the 10.1 km. If you withdraw before 24 March, the entry fee will be refunded minus €1 in administration costs. Registration is open until 24 March; start times vary by distance; age limits follow KNAU guidelines; the event promotes sport and experiencing nature.

name: Hollen door de Bollen

description: Hollen door de Bollen is an annual running and walking event in the beautiful Bollenstreek area around Lisse, organised by Stichting Team Bollenstreek in collaboration with AV De Spartaan. All proceeds from the event go to Stichting Roparun, which supports palliative care for cancer patients. Routes range from short children’s runs to 30 km walks, with music and entertainment along the way and a convivial finish. The event puts taking part for charity ahead of competition, with no official timekeeping.
course_highlights: Walking routes of 6.5 km, 10 km, 21 km and 30 km through the Bollenstreek
Running distances of 5 km, 10 km and 10 English miles
Music and entertainment along the route and a festive finish
additional: The start location is AV De Spartaan, Spekkelaan 8, Lisse. There are various start times for walking and running distances, starting from 07:30. Entries are personal and include a personalised race number; no refunds are available in the event of cancellation. High-visibility vests are recommended on sections of the walking routes that use public roads. A special Shirt Action allows participants to earn a free anniversary shirt by finding sponsors. Routes range from 4.6 km to over 30 km. Advance registration is required; race numbers and shirts can be collected. Volunteers and sponsors are welcome.

description: Påsksmällen is a classic road and cross-country race organized by Enhörna IF, starting and finishing at Enhörna Friluftsgård in Södertälje. The race offers several categories for children, youth and adults, with distances ranging from approximately 600 metres to 10 kilometres. This well-established event will be held for the 49th time in 2027 and offers an enjoyable and challenging running experience in scenic surroundings. Participants can look forward to a family-friendly atmosphere, with on-site late registration available. Swedish Athletics Federation competition rules apply.
course_highlights: Classic road and cross-country race
Start and finish at Enhörna Friluftsgård
Several distances from 600 m to 10 km
additional: On-site late registration is available until 60 minutes before each start, for an additional fee (SEK 100 for adult categories, SEK 50 for youth categories). Start times for children’s and youth categories are between 11:00 and 11:35, while adult categories start at 12:30. Results and start lists will be published on the website. Participation constitutes consent to the publication of names and any photographs on the association’s website and social media. Regular registration closes on 27 March. On-site late registration is available until 60 minutes before each start and costs extra. Everyone is welcome in the recreational category.

name: Hallarydsloppet
description: Hallarydsloppet is an annual race for all ages, from young children to older runners. There are several distances to choose from, ranging from a short 1.3 km children’s race to the 21 km main event, which takes place along the border between Skåne and Småland. The courses offer beautiful scenery, with gravel roads, winding stone walls, meadows and forests. The race starts and finishes at Hallaryd School and offers a well-organized race day with water stations and an awards ceremony.
course_highlights: The 21 km course passes an old stone arch bridge dating from 1870, with four arches
Much of the course follows gravel roads lined with stone walls, meadows and forests
The 21 km course has a challenging climb of approximately 25 metres over 500 metres
additional: Race bibs must be collected at the school no later than 30 minutes before the start. Late entries are accepted on race day until the start for an additional fee of 50 kr (not available for youth and walking classes). Timing is done using a barcode on the race bib. Water stations along the course provide sports drink and water. Changing facilities and showers are available in the school gym and HIF’s clubhouse. Prizes are awarded to the first three finishers in each class, and everyone who finishes receives a medal. The start and finish are at Hallaryd School, Häradsvägen 3. Water stations offer water and sports drink. Register in advance by email no later than 23 March 2027; late entries are accepted on race day for an additional fee of 50 kr, except for the youth and walking classes.

The race offers a varied course with distances of 400 metres, 1, 3, 5, and 10 kilometres, suitable for all ages and levels. The event is known for its friendly atmosphere and the involvement of the local community. The City Run promotes sportsmanship and togetherness in a beautiful urban setting.
course_highlights: Course through the centre of Culemborg
Distances ranging from 400 metres to 10 kilometres
Specific routes for schools and businesses
additional: There are separate categories for schools and businesses. The Roll Run is a special 400-metre race. The event has a varied programme, with different start times for each distance. Attention is given to accessibility and facilities for participants. The event also includes a school run and a business run, along with historical results and sponsors. It is an annual event that brings the community together.

description: The Wielenloop is an annual running event held on Easter Monday in De Groote Wielen, Rosmalen. The event is suitable for all ages, with various distances including a kids’ run, 5 km and 10 km. The routes offer varied terrain and are accessible to both beginner and experienced runners. The atmosphere is friendly, with space for family and supporters along the route.
course_highlights: The 10 km route consists of two laps of the 5 km route
Varied terrain suitable for experienced runners
Kids’ run for the youngest runners; participation is free
additional: You can register through the morning of the race, on Monday, at the start. The kids’ run is free. The 5 km and 10 km start at 10:30. There is a warm-up beforehand, and family members can join the kids’ run. On-site registration is possible; the start time is around 10:30; the routes will be announced soon.

name: Drie Molenloop Aarlanderveen
description: The Drie Molenloop Aarlanderveen is a traditional competitive and recreational race, held for the 60th time on Easter Monday, 29 March 2027. The race offers distances of 5, 10 and 15 km, suitable for both beginner and experienced runners. Participants run through the beautiful polder landscape around Aarlanderveen and receive a medal at the finish. Part of the proceeds go to a local good cause; this year, the playground.
course_highlights: All distances follow paved roads around and through the Aarlanderveen polder
Water stations halfway along the course and at the finish
Kilometre markers are displayed along the course, and a running clock is provided
additional: Race numbers will not be mailed out; they can be collected on 29 March at the Dorpshuis during late registration. Timing is provided using MYLAPS BibTag on the race numbers. Parking, changing facilities and showers are available at the sports hall on Aarlanderveenseweg. Parking is limited, so cycling is recommended. Distances: 5 km, 10 km, 15 km; children's fun run; proceeds go to a good cause (playground); location: Aarlanderveen; organised by AAV'36

description: The Klap tot Klaploop is a unique running race with no laps. You travel by bus to the start in Musselkanaal, then run straight back to the centre of Stadskanaal. The flat, fast course is ideal for setting a personal best, while the enthusiastic crowds and friendly atmosphere along the route make for a special experience. The 35th edition takes place on Easter Monday, 29 March 2027—a day of sport, challenge and fun for everyone.
course_highlights: Flat, fast course from Musselkanaal to Stadskanaal
No laps—just one continuous route
The crowds and atmosphere along the route make for a unique experience
additional: Race numbers can be collected on the Saturday before Easter from 10:00 to 14:00 at De Jonge Sport in Stadskanaal, or on the day of the event until 11:30 at the organisers’ tent. Free bus transport is provided from Europalaan in Stadskanaal to the start locations in Musselkanaal for the 5 km and 10 km runners. Wheelchair racers and handcyclists arrange their own transport. Clothing trucks and portable toilets are available at the start locations. There are no showers. Start in Musselkanaal, finish in Stadskanaal; no transport is provided from Stadskanaal to the start locations. The event is supported by local businesses and has a long history, with the 32nd edition in 2027.

name: Paaspolderloop
description: The Paaspolderloop in Nieuwe Niedorp is a friendly running event held on Easter Monday. The race takes you through the beautiful polder, with several distances for all ages, including a 250-metre fun run for the youngest participants and challenging 2 km, 5 km and 10 km routes. The 10 km is open to participants aged 16 and over and offers a varied course through meadows and over bridges, including a nostalgic stretch along Dorpsstraat. The organisers create a festive atmosphere with a large prize fund and a quick prize-giving after the race.
course_highlights: Beautiful green meadow and sheep path
Several bridges along the course
Nostalgic Dorpsstraat in Nieuwe Niedorp
additional: Race numbers can be collected at Dorpshuis De Prins Maurits. Parking is available at the Winkelcentrum van Nieuwe Niedorp, a 900-metre walk away. There are no changing rooms or showers, but toilets are available in the Dorpshuis. First aid is available at the start/finish. Dogs are not allowed on the course. The event starts at 9:30 a.m. on Easter Monday, with registration opening in January and parking at Winkelhart. There are also fun activities for children alongside the race.

name: Nordens Ark TrailRun
location: Nordens Ark, Hunnebostrand, Varberg Municipality, Sweden
description: Nordens Ark TrailRun is a family-friendly running event held in the Eco Park at Nordens Ark in Hunnebostrand. The race offers several distances, from 1 km for the youngest participants to 30 km for those looking for a serious challenge. The event combines nature experiences with health and outdoor activities in a scenic setting. It is organised by IK Granit and has a tradition of welcoming runners of all ages and abilities.
course_highlights: Scenic trails in the Eco Park
Distance options from 1 km to 30 km
Family-friendly, with activities for all ages
additional: The event is organised by IK Granit. Nordens Ark is a zoo and nature reserve that is open year-round. Parking is free, and there are good bus connections. Participants are encouraged to register well in advance, but current information about registration and prices is not available on the website. The race is cancelled in 2026 but is planned to return in 2027. The event is scheduled to take place on 8 April 2027, with distances from 1 km to 30 km. It is an opportunity for participants to enjoy the arrival of spring in a scenic, family-friendly setting.

name: Sandtangstafetten
description: Sandtangstafetten is a traditional relay held at Sandtangen in Bryne. The race has four legs on varied surfaces, including forest floor, gravel and grass, and offers both a short and a long course for different age groups, from age 7 to seniors. The event starts in the evening and lasts approximately one hour and fifteen minutes, with a focus on team spirit and a great atmosphere. It is a family-friendly race, with many mixed teams as well as all-girls and all-boys teams competing in different categories.
course_highlights: Short course for ages 7–10, with 110 m legs on forest floor, gravel and grass
Long course for ages 11 and older, with 370 m and 420 m legs on varied surfaces
Four legs per relay team, with changeovers at Sandtangen
additional: Start times for the different categories are from 18:00 to 18:36. Participants are advised to arrive 45 minutes before the start for a course and changeover briefing. Parking is available at Vianor Bryne (north) and Storstova (south). Registration is available via a link or by emailing pamelding@brynefriidrett.no. Parking at Vianor Bryne or Storstova.

name: Påskrundan 2026
description: Vänersborgs AIK warmly welcomes you to Påskrundan, a popular trail race suited to both elite runners and recreational runners. The race has quickly become a lovely Easter tradition, attracting participants of all ages. Starting and finishing at the ski lodge in Vänersborg, the course offers approximately 7 kilometres of varied running along gravel roads and trails. The first section is easy to run, while the final section is hillier and more challenging. Påskrundan is a celebration of running with a focus on community, and children’s and youth races make it a day for the whole family. Alongside the race, there’s a wonderful atmosphere, prizes for the top finishers in each category, and prize draws for all participants.
course_highlights: Approximately 7 kilometres of trail running on gravel roads and trails
The first section is easy and fast to run
The final section is hilly and challenging
additional: Children’s and youth races are part of the event. Prizes are awarded to the top finishers in each category, and all participants are entered in prize draws. The start and finish are at the ski lodge in Vänersborg. The race is a celebration of running focused on community, attracting both elite and recreational runners.

name: Ryssbergsloppet
description: Ryssbergsloppet is an annual running event in Sölvesborg organised by Ryssbergets IK. The event offers several distances of varying lengths and difficulty, making it accessible to both beginners and experienced runners. It is part of Skånes VeteranCup and features a scenic, challenging course through beautiful terrain. The organisers welcome runners of all ages and categories to a well-organised and enjoyable race day.
course_highlights: The course is marked with arrows, painted lines and ribbons at every kilometre
Water and sports drink are available at the lap point and finish
The terrain varies, with sections through woodland and hilly stretches
additional: Race numbers must be collected at Sparbankshallen, Bromölla, no later than 30 minutes before the start. All participants must wear their race number on the front of their chest. The prize-giving ceremony takes place at approximately 12:30. Medical assistance is available at the start/finish. Refreshments, including coffee and grilled sausages, are available. Marshals are stationed at junctions to show the way. There are several race distances, with start times between 10:30 and 11:10, and results are published on the club’s website. The event welcomes both recreational and competitive runners.

name: Kanallöpet
location: Bergvallen, Borensberg, Motala Municipality, Östergötland, Sweden
organizer: Borensbergs IF, OK Skogsströvarna, Vreta SoMK
description: Kanallöpet is an annual running event offering both competitive and recreational categories over half-marathon, 10 km and 5 km distances. All races start at 13:00 from three different locations along National Road 34 between Linköping and Motala, and finish at the Bergvallen sports ground in Borensberg. The race is organised by Borensbergs IF, OK Skogsströvarna and Vreta SoMK, and welcomes runners of different ages and abilities. Buses transport participants from the finish area to the start locations before the race. Late registration is available at the start locations for an additional fee.
course_highlights: Mass start from Ljungsbro, Sjöbacka bridge and Brunneby Musteri
Finish at the Bergvallen sports ground in Borensberg
Bus transport from the finish to the start locations before the race
additional: Race bibs can be collected at the respective start location before the start. Late registration takes place at the start locations between 11:30 and 12:30, with a 50% surcharge on the regular fee. Medals are free for participants aged 16 and under; others can buy a medal at the finish. Refreshments are available at the finish area. The distances are suitable for both competitive runners and recreational runners, with membership required for the competitive category. Registration is via the web, with payment by Swish or bank giro. The race has a long tradition and attracts around 360 participants each year.

name: SäterMaran inkl. DM i halvmaraton
description: SäterMaran is an annual running event in Säter that includes the district championships in the half marathon. The event offers several distances, including the half marathon and 10 km, and welcomes runners of different levels. It is organized by Säters IF FIK and is known for its friendly atmosphere, focus on the joy of running, and sense of local community.
course_highlights: Half marathon and 10 km distances
Low participation in the full marathon, with a focus on the half marathon and 10 km
Held in Säter amid scenic surroundings
additional: Late registration for the full marathon is closed due to low participation, but registration for the half marathon and 10 km remains open as usual.

name: Allstarsmilen
description: ALLSTARSMILEN is one of Sweden’s fastest 10 km races, run on a flat, officially measured and sanctioned course. It’s the perfect course for setting a personal best or using as a qualifying result for other races. Welcome to this fast, well-organized race in Skrea-Herting-Hjortsberg.
course_highlights: Flat and fast 10 km course
Officially measured and sanctioned
Suitable for setting a personal best and qualifying for other races

name: Vårruset (Malmö)
description: Vårruset in Malmö is a women’s fun run offering distances of 2.5 km and 5 km in the lovely spring surroundings of Slottsparken. The event is all about the joy of movement and community, and welcomes participants regardless of their fitness background or level of ambition. You can enter individually or as part of a team; registered teams receive a picnic after crossing the finish line. Vårruset is an inclusive and inspiring movement for recreational running that has been promoting women’s health and well-being since 1989.
course_highlights: Certified 5 km course in Slottsparken
Two distances: 2.5 km and 5 km
Picnic after the finish for teams of 5
additional: Race bibs can be collected at Intersport Emporia in the days before the event. You can choose not to have your time recorded. Changing at home is recommended, as there are no changing facilities at the venue. Bag storage is available in a tent at the race bib collection point. The start and finish are on Kung Oscarsväg in Slottsparken. Teams consist of 5 people, and team members can run different distances. Teams receive a picnic after the finish. Registration is binding and can be completed up to one hour before the start on race day.

name: GIF-Joggen Backyard Ultra

description: GIF-Joggen Backyard Ultra takes place in Gressvikmarka, starting Saturday, April 3 at 08:00. The race consists of up to 12 laps on a 6.7 km course through varied and challenging terrain. Participants run one lap every hour and continue for as long as they can, aiming to complete as many laps as possible or all 12. All participants receive a medal, and those who complete every lap can log over 80 km in their training diary. Facilities include a heated shelter, toilets, changing rooms, and some fruit and baked goods.
course_highlights: A 6.7 km course through varied terrain
Up to 12 laps, with over 80 km for those who complete them all
The course is marked with red and white ribbons
additional: Check-in and registration from 07:00 on race day. To continue, participants must be ready for the next lap at the top of each hour. A heated shelter, toilets, and changing rooms are available. Bring a change of clothes, drinks, food, and possibly a headlamp. The course may be wet and muddy; a camping chair is recommended for the break area. The previous edition had a maximum of 77 participants. The race started at 08:00, and runners had to be ready at the start at the top of each hour to continue. A heated shelter, toilets, and changing rooms were available. Sources give conflicting information about the date in 2027.

name: Holmestrand maraton
description: Holmestrand Marathon is a friendly running event that has been a regular fixture on the race calendar since 2013. The race is held every year on the Saturday after Easter and offers beautiful, easy-to-run courses along the Holmestrand Fjord and through the city’s charming streets. Distances are available for all levels, from 5 km to the marathon, and the course has been officially measured and internationally approved by World Athletics. The event is suitable for both beginners and experienced runners, and also includes a free children’s race called Miniton.
course_highlights: Easy-to-run, personal-best-friendly 5 km loop course
Course along the Holmestrand Fjord and through the city streets
Officially measured and internationally approved by World Athletics
additional: All children can take part in the free Miniton children’s race. The race offers the option to run with or without a time. There are food and drink stations, prizes, and opportunities to follow the race along the course. The race is held every year on the Saturday after Easter. Distances: 5 km, 10 km, half marathon, marathon, and the free Miniton for children. For the 5 km, you can choose to run with or without a time. The event also offers the combinations marathon + 10 km and half marathon + 5 km.

name: Drammen 10K
description: Drammen10K is Norway’s fastest 10-kilometer race, taking runners through downtown Drammen on a fast course with only 22 meters of elevation gain. The race is for everyone looking for a fast and enjoyable running experience in an urban setting. The event has an inclusive atmosphere and also offers fun digital competitions beforehand. Welcome to a great race weekend in Drammen!
course_highlights: Norway’s fastest 10K race
Fast course with only 22 meters of elevation gain
The race takes place in downtown Drammen
additional: Green race bibs indicate that a medal was purchased in advance. Children’s races are also held on the same day, including Minimila. There is no telephone contact; all communication takes place via email and the contact form. A digital triathlon with prizes and a live announcement on social media is held beforehand. Transferring a race bib or changing the participant costs 100 NOK.

name: Bergen Ultra - Maratonkarusellen
organizer: Maratonkarusellen i samarbeid med BFG Bergen Løpeklubb

description: Bergen Ultra is a challenging ultramarathon organized by Maratonkarusellen in collaboration with BFG Bergen Løpeklubb. The event offers distances of 63.3 km and 100 km, as well as a half marathon and marathon, and takes place at Fana Stadium in Bergen. Maratonkarusellen places great emphasis on quality and participant enjoyment, despite the event’s tough challenges. The minimum age is 18, and the race is part of a series of long-distance events held in both spring and autumn.
course_highlights: Ultramarathon distances of 63.3 km and 100 km
Organized in collaboration with BFG Bergen Løpeklubb
The races start and take place at Fana Stadium in Bergen
additional: Kondis members receive a NOK 50 discount. A year-round license from the Norwegian Athletics Federation can be provided by giving the license number, and a one-time license does not need to be paid for. Prices increase by NOK 50 two weeks before race day, by a further NOK 50 four days before, and the price on race day is NOK 650. The minimum age for the marathon is 18. The start and finish are at Fana Stadium. The half marathon is one lap, the marathon two laps, and the 63 km race three laps. The listed start times are 09:00 for 63 km, 10:00 for the marathon, and 11:00 for the half marathon. The prices and race details apply to the published 2026 edition; information for 3 April 2027 is not provided in the sources.

name: Solsiå sentrumsløp
description: Solsiå Sentrumsløp 2027 takes place in Sandnes city centre and features a circuit where participants choose how many laps to complete within six hours. There is also a separate children’s race of approximately 600 metres in Langgata. The race has an informal, inclusive character, focusing on local runners and safe preparation. Registration and payment are handled directly by the organiser, not through Førstart.
course_highlights: A 3 km circuit in Sandnes city centre
Choose how many laps to complete within six hours
A separate children’s race of approximately 600 metres in Langgata
additional: The children’s race starts at 11:30, and the circuit race starts at 12:00. Registration and payment are handled by the organiser, not through Førstart. Limited practical information about the race is available on Førstart. Feel free to invite others to the starting line. The circuit race starts at 12:00, and the children’s race starts at 11:30. Registration and payment are handled by the organiser.

distance_verbose: Halbmarathon, 10 km, 7.5 km, 5 km, 2 km, 1.44 km, 0.4 km
