description: Esefjorden Rundt is a beautiful 8.5 km road race on asphalt, with no major elevation changes, around Esefjorden, part of the National Tourist Routes. The race starts at Tjugum Church and finishes at the Balahaugen festival grounds, near the centre of Balestrand. The event has a long tradition and attracts recreational runners and competitive runners of all ages, with a festive atmosphere and beautiful scenery, including the mountains Tjugatoten and Keipen around the fjord. Participants can take a shuttle boat from the centre of Balestrand to the start area, making for a unique experience.
course_highlights: 8.5 km asphalt course with no major elevation changes
Starts at Tjugum Church and finishes at the Balahaugen festival grounds
The course goes around Esefjorden, part of the National Tourist Routes, with beautiful mountain views
additional: Shuttle boats run between Holmen (Balestrand town centre) and Tjugum (the start area) from 09:00 to 16:00. Boat transport ends at 16:00. Shuttle boat tickets cost NOK 80 for adults, NOK 40 for children under 15, and NOK 200 for a family. Parking is available at the finish area, in the town centre, at Tjugum Church and at Bygdahuset. The relay competition has three legs, with a map available. Race numbers must be collected at Tjugum Church within the specified times. A licence is required for participants aged 13 to 80, with a one-time licence available when registering. Recreational and competitive categories. A shuttle boat from Holmen in Balestrand town centre to Tjugum is an option; the finish area at Balahaugen is about 1 km from the town centre.

name: SA-løpet
description: SA-løpet is an open and inclusive running event in the beautiful Kulåsparken in Sarpsborg, suitable for all ages and levels. The event offers several distances, both timed and untimed, and focuses on community, personal achievement, and the joy of running. It is well organized, with dedicated volunteers, good safety measures, and accessibility, and aims to give all participants a positive experience. Welcome to an active day filled with smiles and the true joy of running!
course_highlights: Course in the beautiful Kulåsparken, Sarpsborg
Several distances: 2.5 km, 5 km, and 10 km
Safe, well-organized event with a clear course
additional: The start and finish are in Kulåsparken. The children's race starts at 10:00, the 10 km starts at 10:30, and the 2.5 km and 5 km start at 10:35. Race numbers are handed out only on race day from 08:00. Toilets are available in the Service House in Kulåsparken. Bag storage is provided during the race. Participants must be 11 years or older to take part in the timed races; younger participants may take part without timing. Registration is listed as open from 1 February to 29 April 2027, with late registration on 30 April and until the race starts on 1 May. Timed categories have an age limit of 11; younger participants may take part without timing or in the children's race.

name: Backyard Lampeland Ultra
description: Backyard Lampeland is a unique ultrarace held in Lampeland, Flesberg. The race consists of a gently rolling 6.7 km loop run every hour on the hour, with a maximum of twelve laps in total. Participants must start each lap to continue, and the last runner to start wins the race. The event has a social focus and a low barrier to participation, and offers a rest area, refreshments and changing rooms. Everyone who completes 12 laps receives a cup, and those who run the ultra distance receive a Norwegian-made wooden medal.
course_highlights: Gently rolling 6.7 km loop per lap
Maximum of 12 laps, 80.4 km in total
The race starts every hour on the hour
additional: Bringing your own cup is mandatory. A reflective vest and headlamp are required if visibility is poor on the final lap. Baked goods, snacks, coffee, water and sausages are served after the seventh lap. A rest area and changing rooms are available in the hall. Maximum 500 participants. Race bib collection is Friday 15–20 and Saturday 08–09:15 at Friluftsbua by Lampeland Hotel, or in the hall at the start from 09:30. Using a race belt for the race bib is recommended. The start and finish are at Skattekista, the school and multipurpose hall in Lampeland. Maximum 500 participants. Bringing your own cup is mandatory; a reflective vest and headlamp are required if visibility is poor on the final lap.

name: Perseløpet 50 km, 100 km, maraton
description: Perseløpet is a race in Eidsvoll, starting and finishing at Ås school in Hammerås. It features a flat, accurately measured 2,633-metre loop offering good opportunities for fast times. Participants can choose from seven distances ranging from 3 km to 100 km, including 50 km and the marathon. The race has a unique concept, with a dedicated nutrition table passed on every lap, and a friendly atmosphere where personal records are celebrated by ringing a bell near the finish area.
course_highlights: Flat, accurately measured 2,633-metre loop
Dedicated nutrition table passed on every lap
Distances from 3 km to 100 km, with opportunities to set personal records
additional: Race bibs are collected by self-service at Ås school approximately two hours before the start. Free parking, changing facilities and toilets are available at the venue. At selected races, ninth-graders from Feiring school staff an official refreshment station to raise money for their school trip. The weather forecast is updated four times daily based on satellite data for the area. The race has a lap-time calculator for planning split times. Race-bib collection, changing facilities and toilets are at Ås school, less than 100 metres from the start. Free parking is available.

description: The AH Abe Hunebedloop is an atmospheric running race organised by AV de Sprinter, held in the beautiful surroundings of Havelte. The course runs mostly along paved paths and passes special sights such as the hunebeds, burial mounds and sheepfold. The start and finish are at Toegangspoort Holtingerveld, which also has facilities including changing rooms and toilets. The race offers several distances and categories, suitable for a range of ages and abilities.
course_highlights: Mostly paved paths through the Havelte nature area
Past the hunebeds and burial mounds
Start and finish at the sheepfold (Toegangspoort Holtingerveld)
additional: Race numbers can be collected from 10:00 at the start/finish. Water and fruit are available after the race. Changing facilities are in the Lammerenkooi of the sheepfold. Registration is open until one hour before the start or until the maximum of 750 participants is reached. Late registration opens on 11 January 2027 and costs an additional € 2,00. Registration via inschrijven.nl; start and finish at Toegangspoort Holtingerveld; maximum 750 participants; part of the Univéloopcircuit de Kop van Drenthe.

name: Kanallöpet
location: Bergvallen, Borensberg, Motala Municipality, Östergötland County, Sweden
organizer: Borensbergs IF, OK Skogsströvarna och Vreta SoMK
description: Kanallöpet is a popular running event that welcomes competitive runners, recreational runners and families to run through beautiful Swedish countryside along the Göta Canal between Ljungsbro and Borensberg. The event offers several distances, including a half marathon, a 10 km race and a 5 km recreational race. It is marked by a strong sense of community and scenic views along the canal. Kanallöpet is organised by Borensbergs IF, Vreta SoMK and OK Skogsströvarna, and is a tradition that returns every spring.
course_highlights: Run along the Göta Canal between Ljungsbro and Borensberg
Half marathon, 10 km and 5 km recreational races
Beautiful Swedish countryside and scenic views
additional: The event has competitive and recreational categories, as well as family-friendly distances. The organising clubs are Borensbergs IF, Vreta SoMK and OK Skogsströvarna. Participants receive medals, although medal deliveries may sometimes be delayed. For the 2025 race, buses are reported to be arranged from Borensberg to the starting locations. Competitive categories require membership in a club affiliated with the Swedish Athletics Federation.

name: SäterMaran (inkl. DM i halvmaraton)
description: SäterMaran is a running event organized by Säters IF FIK, offering half-marathon and 10 km distances. The full marathon has been held in the past but is currently closed to late entries due to low participation. The event is a welcome opportunity for runners of different levels to challenge themselves in a beautiful setting in Säter. Säters IF FIK is an active athletics club with dedicated leaders and a strong sense of community.
course_highlights: Half-marathon and 10 km distances are offered
The event takes place in Säter, surrounded by scenic landscapes
Organized by Säters IF FIK, a club with a long tradition in athletics
additional: Late entry for the full marathon is closed due to low participation. Registration for the half-marathon and 10 km remains open as usual. The organizer publishes the invitation, course route, race information, schedule, start list, and results on the club's website.

Voss Løpskarusell 2
description: Voss Running Series is a running series for everyone, with 5 km races held on Mondays in 2027. The course starts and finishes at Idrettsplassen in Voss, and runs through Prestegardsmoen and along the waterfront promenade. The event welcomes recreational participants and runners aged 9 and up to enjoyable fun runs in scenic surroundings. Registration is online, and a discount is offered for registering for all six races before the second race. The races start at 19:00, except for the final race, which starts at 18:30.
course_highlights: 5 km course starting and finishing at Idrettsplassen
Loop through Prestegardsmoen
Race along the waterfront promenade
additional: The races are held on Mondays, starting at 19:00, except for the final race on 20 September, which starts at 18:30. You can register for individual races or for all six together, with a discount for early registration. The course can be viewed virtually in a video on the website. Registration is via EQ Timing. A discount is available for registering for all six races by the second race.

name: Voss Løpskarusell 2027, løp 2
description: Voss Running Series 2027 is a running series for everyone, with races on Mondays at 19:00. The course is 5 km long, starting and finishing at Voss Idrettsplass, and runs through Prestegardsmoen and along the waterfront promenade. The event welcomes recreational runners and runners aged 9 and up to enjoyable fun runs in scenic surroundings. Registration is online, with a discount for registering for all six races by the second race.
course_highlights: 5 km course starting and finishing at Voss Idrettsplass
Loop through Prestegardsmoen
Run along the waterfront promenade
additional: Registration is online only via EQ Timing. You can register for all six races at a discount by the second race. The fifth race starts at 18:30 instead of 19:00. Registration is online via EQ Timing. There is a discount for registering for all six races by race 2; otherwise, you register for each race individually.

name: Charity-Lauf des PSV Grün-Weiß Kassel e. V.
Vårruset (Halmstad)
location: Civila flygfältet vid Aleskogen, Halmstad, Sweden
organizer: Marathongruppen i samarbete med Halmstad OK och andra idrottsklubbar
description: Vårruset in Halmstad is a spring-themed fun run offering 2.5 km and 5 km distances in the scenic Alet Nature Reserve, by the Civil Airfield at Aleskogen. The event is open to everyone. The recommended minimum age is 7 for the shorter distance when accompanied by an adult, and 11 for the 5 km. Participants receive a medal, a finish-line goodie bag and a race bib, with timing available for the 5 km. Teams that register are offered a shared picnic after the finish, making for a pleasant social gathering. Race bibs are distributed in advance at Intersport Halmstad Flygstaden to avoid queues on race day.
course_highlights: The route goes through Alet Nature Reserve/Skepparegatan
Certified 5 km course
Event area at the Civil Airfield by Aleskogen
additional: Race bibs are distributed at Intersport Halmstad Flygstaden in the days before the race. Teams of 5 are offered a picnic after the finish. There is a water station and toilets in the event area. Participants are advised to change at home, as there are no changing facilities at the venue. Valuables can be handed in in an A4 envelope. Parking is available at Kattegattskolan and Skepparegatan, but eco-friendly transport is encouraged. Teams of five receive a picnic after the finish. In 2026, race bibs were collected at Intersport Halmstad Flygstaden; information for 2027 has not yet been provided in the sources.

name: 6. Pallas 67 Ultrameerdaagse
price_range: tot 450 euro voor 5 dagen, 35 euro voor eerste dag, 15 euro voor volgende dagen

description: The Pallas '67 Ultrameerdaagse celebrates its fifth edition with a challenging multi-day ultrarun around Wageningen and Bennekom. The event consists of five days, with four routes of approximately 55 km and one route of over 70 km. The routes pass through beautiful natural areas such as the Veluwe, the Betuwe, the Utrechtse Heuvelrug and the mystical Prattenburgsebos. The base is the grounds of Hoekelum Castle, where luxury accommodation is available. The event starts on Wednesday morning, 13 May, at the Pallas '67 clubhouse in Wageningen, with the remaining starts at the castle grounds in Bennekom.
course_highlights: Routes of approximately 55 km and one route of over 70 km
Natural areas: the Veluwe, the Betuwe, the Utrechtse Heuvelrug and the Prattenburgsebos
Start at the Pallas '67 clubhouse, with Hoekelum Castle as the base
additional: The base is Hoekelum Castle, with luxury accommodation at 'de Schuur' for 4 nights. Participants can also take part for one or more days. People from Wageningen can stay at home overnight. The total cost for 5 days, including 4 nights' accommodation, is expected to be no more than 450 euros. Routes through the Veluwe, the Betuwe, the Utrechtse Heuvelrug and the Prattenburgsebos; starts in Wageningen and Bennekom; 4 routes of approximately 55 km and 1 of over 70 km; 4 nights at Hoekelum Castle.

name: Vårruset Vänersborg
description: Vårruset in Vänersborg is a spring-inspired fun run offering 2.5 km and 5 km distances along Vassbottenleden, with the start and finish at Sanden. The event is open to everyone and welcomes both individual runners and teams of five. After the finish, teams are treated to a picnic, creating a wonderful sense of community and a springtime atmosphere. The event is family-friendly, with a recommended minimum age of 7 when accompanied by an adult. Timing is available for the 5 km course, but participants can also choose not to be timed. Race bibs are distributed in advance to avoid queues on race day.
course_highlights: 2.5 km and 5 km distances along Vassbottenleden
Start and finish at Sanden in Vänersborg
Certified 5 km course with timing
additional: Race bibs are distributed at Intersport Överby in Trollhättan in the days before the event. Teams that register receive a picnic after the finish, and the picnic voucher is on the team leader’s race bib. The event area is easily accessible on foot, by bike, bus and train. There is a facility for leaving warm-up clothing at the venue. Race information is emailed approximately two weeks before the event. Registration is binding and can be made up to one hour before the start. Teams of five are treated to a picnic after the finish. Information about the location and event format is based on details for 2026; details for 2027 have not been confirmed in the sources.

name: Bankvarvet
price_range: 125 kr för vuxna; gratis för barn och ungdomar upp till 16 år

description: Bankvarvet is a popular fun run in Kullaparken, Kisa, focusing on the joy of being active rather than the fastest time or lap. The event offers several distances, including 5 km, 10 km, and a 900-metre Minivarvet for children born in 2016 or later. It’s a community celebration with entertainment, activities, and food, perfect for families, groups of friends, and companies looking to build team spirit. Bankvarvet attracts many participants and is known for its warm and welcoming atmosphere.
course_highlights: The race takes place in Kullaparken in Kisa
A 900-metre Minivarvet for children
5 km and 10 km routes for adults and young people
additional: Kullaparken opens at 16:00, with activities including basketball, football, table tennis, and boules, as well as food and drink. Bankvarvet is a popular company activity for building team spirit. The event runs from 16:00 to 20:00, with the 5 km and 10 km races starting at 18:30. The official information currently available describes the 2026 edition: the race starts at 18:30, and activities in Kullaparken begin at 16:00. Details for the 2027 edition have not been confirmed.

name: Revetal Halvmaraton
description: Revetal Half Marathon is a race offering a fast, officially measured 21.1-kilometer half-marathon course that is almost completely flat, with only 24 meters of elevation gain. The race is suitable for both experienced runners and recreational runners, with a focus on even pacing and negative splits. The start and finish are at Re-torvet, a short distance from changing facilities, parking, and refreshments, making for a compact and pleasant race experience. A 5 km race and a children’s race are also held, giving people of all ages and abilities the opportunity to participate.
course_highlights: An officially measured 21.1 km course that is almost completely flat
Two turnarounds, with a total of 24 meters of elevation gain
Start and finish at the same location, a short distance from facilities
additional: Bib distribution from 09:00 at Sport 1 Revetal and Re-torvet. Children’s race at 10:45, with free entry and a medal for everyone. Maximum of 600 places in total. Early registration is recommended to avoid stress. The course follows Bispeveien to Real Våle and back. Events include a half marathon, 5 km, and free children’s race. Pacers are available for the half marathon and 5 km. Stated capacity is 600 participants, with registration closing one hour before the start.

name: Tjomsevannet Rundt + Backyard 12 timers
description: Tjomsevannet Rundt is held annually on Ascension Day and is a popular race for all ages and levels, starting and finishing at Søgne gamle prestegård. The event offers a social and enjoyable day with several distances, including a children’s race, a youth race, and a 6.5 km fun run. New this year is registration via EQtiming.com with live timing, and the popular Backyard 12-hour race returns, offering the opportunity to run around Tjomsevannet for up to 12 hours. Group training sessions are also held every Monday at Søgne stadium for all levels.
course_highlights: Run around Tjomsevannet, starting and finishing at Søgne gamle prestegård
Off-road races for children and youth over short distances
Backyard 12-hour race, with the opportunity to run every hour for 12 hours
additional: Group training every Monday at 18:00 at Søgne stadium for all levels. Registration for the children’s race, youth race, and untimed race takes place on-site on the day, with payment via Vipps. Live timing via EQtiming.com for the main race and the Backyard race. Start and finish at Søgne gamle prestegård. Prices vary by race, and a license fee may be added.

name: Ekebergstafetten og Ekebergløpet 2027
description: Ekebergløpet and Ekebergstafetten are an annual running festival held at Ekebergsletta in Oslo, with a long tradition and an inclusive atmosphere for runners of all ages and abilities. The event takes place on Ascension Day and offers several distances, including relays for children and youth, a children’s race, 5 km and 10 km. The event is more than just a race, with activities for children and young people, food and drinks from local vendors, as well as music and entertainment that create a lively atmosphere. Bækkelagets Sportsklub is the organizer and welcomes everyone to a day filled with activity, achievement and fun.
course_highlights: Scenic surroundings around Ekebergsletta
Several distances: relays for children and youth, a children’s race, 5 km and 10 km
Recreational race with national age-group categories for adults
additional: Start times: 11:30 Children’s relay, 12:00 Youth relay, 14:00 Children’s race for ages up to 10, 15:00 5 km, 15:10 10 km. The event includes activities for children and young people, food and drinks from local vendors, as well as music and entertainment. Previous editions have featured a children’s race of around 700 metres. Ekebergstafetten has been held as a mixed relay for 7–16-year-olds with five legs. Details for 2027 have not been confirmed in the sources.

name: Putten Power Run
description: The Putten Power Run is the annual running event that makes the vibrant heart of Putten beat. On the Friday after Ascension Day, the town centre turns into a sporting arena, with an atmospheric course through the centre and Putterbos. Participants can choose from various distances, from kids’ runs to a challenging 10 km, and enjoy a fun-filled day with music, food stalls and activities for the whole family. The event celebrates sporting spirit and togetherness, and supports local charities.
course_highlights: An atmospheric course through the town centre and Putterbos
Start and finish on the lively square in the heart of Putten
Water stations along the course and at the finish
additional: Race numbers are available for collection from 15:00 at the race office on Kerkplein. The IPICO timing tag must be attached to your shoelace and returned after the finish; otherwise, a €7.50 charge will apply. Free parking is available at the car park on Brinkstraat. Changing rooms with toilets are available, but there are no showers. Medical support is available along the course and at the finish. Enjoy a lively atmosphere with a DJ, food stalls, a business plaza and children’s activities. The event offers water stations, medical support and parking. Showers are not available in the changing rooms. Registration is available on the day at Kerkplein.

name: Gotaleden Stafett & Ultra
description: Gotaleden Relay & Ultra is a brand-new running and relay event taking place on 9 May 2026. Four races are offered along the scenic Gotaleden trail between Gothenburg and Alingsås: individual distances (35 km and 75 km) and team relays (35/75 km), with stages ranging from approximately 4.5 to 12 km. The races feature varied terrain and beautiful scenery, and the finish at Nolhaga Park will be celebrated with an awards ceremony, food trucks, showers and an After Run. The event is aimed at everyone from recreational runners to experienced ultrarunners.
course_highlights: The course follows the Gotaleden trail between Gothenburg and Alingsås, with beautiful scenery and historic industrial environments
Varied terrain: trails, gravel and asphalt
The ultramarathon has substantial total elevation gain (approx. 1,403 m) and reaches a high point of ~185 m above sea level
additional: Age limits: Relay (35/75) from age 14; Ultra 75 and Sprint 35 from age 17. Relay 75 consists of 9 stages (2–9 people per team), with stages of 4.5–12 km; Relay 35 has 4 stages (2–4 people). Ultra 75: 75 km, asphalt/gravel/trail terrain, 16 aid stations and a food station in Floda; Sprint 35: 35 km, 7 aid stations. Stage start points are located near public transport, and the organizer offers the option to book a bus to the start when registering. The finish at Nolhaga Park offers an awards ceremony, food, showers and an After Run. The races start in Gothenburg (Valhalla IP) and, for the sprint, in Floda (Garveriet), with different start points along the Gotaleden. After the finish, runners can enjoy a finish-line celebration and After Run, as well as a training weekend at Öijared Resort in March 2026 ahead of race weekend.

name: Änggårdsbergen Trailrun
description: Änggårdsbergen Trailrun is a trail race held in Gothenburg’s beautiful Änggårdsbergen nature reserve. The race offers two distances, 7.5 km and 12.5 km, where participants can experience technical trails, hilly terrain and magical viewpoints in the city’s wilderness. The course passes through varied environments such as Vitsippsdalen, Ljungheden and Västerberget, with coniferous forest, heaths and rocky outcrops. It’s an adventure for both beginners and experienced trail runners who want to enjoy nature and challenge themselves.
course_highlights: Technical trails and hilly terrain in Gothenburg’s nature reserve
Fantastic viewpoints overlooking the sea and central Gothenburg
The course passes through varied natural landscapes, including a wood anemone valley, heathland and coniferous forest
additional: Three start waves with friend seeding: the 12.5 km race starts at 11:00, 11:03 and 11:06. There is an aid station only on the 12.5 km course, after approximately 7.5 km. Start and finish at Karlsrofältet, near Linnéplatsen/Botanical Garden. Race bibs can be collected at the venue from 09:30 or at Icebug in Gothenburg. Spiked shoes are prohibited. Everyone who completes the race receives an exclusive wooden medal inspired by Ljungheden. Public transport is recommended; parking is limited. Children aged 8 and up can run with a parent or guardian. Choose between 7.5 and 12.5 km. The organizer recommends trail shoes with a sturdy sole; spiked shoes are not permitted. Public transport is recommended.

name: Koster Trail

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Kostnad för deltagande: 1 250kr inkl. moms. I deltagaravgiften ingår startplats, mat och en god öl/glas vin/alkoholfritt.

tiers.label: tier_2

description: Koster Trail is a challenging trail race through Kosterhavet National Park on Nordkoster. The race features a technically demanding course of approximately 15 kilometres, with stones, cliffs and many beautiful viewpoints along the coast. After crossing the finish line, participants can enjoy craft beer, homemade food and a refreshing saltwater swim. The race is organised by Kosterhavets Ekobod, with a focus on sustainability and care for nature.
course_highlights: Technically demanding course with stones and cliffs
Sections along the coast and sandy beaches
Many magical viewpoints on Nordkoster
additional: The start and finish are at Kosterhavets Ekobod near Västra Bryggan on Nordkoster. There are two aid stations with Koster water and U Sport sports drink from Umara. Race bibs can be collected on Friday from 18:00 to 20:00 or on race day from 10:00. After the race, pizza from Artisan Bread Karlstad and craft beer from Qvänum Brewery will be served. Bag storage is available at the start/finish. There are no shower facilities at the finish. Participants are advised to have personal accident and liability insurance. Travel to Koster can be planned via Västtrafik. A cable ferry runs between Nordkoster and Sydkoster. For 2026, food and a drink of choice were included in the standard entry fee; an option without food and drink cost 950 kr. The race information states a limit of 200 entries, two aid stations and an age limit of 18. Details for the 2027 edition have not been confirmed.

name: Kolmårdstrailen
description: Kolmårdstrailen is one of Sweden’s finest trail races, offering challenging, hilly courses in the scenic Kolmården terrain. Runners can choose between distances of 21 km, 11 km and 6 km, as well as a 500-metre children’s course for the youngest participants. The courses run through forests, over rocky outcrops and along hiking trails, with beautiful views and sections of technical terrain. The focus is on the experience, with a course that combines the beauty of nature with a physical challenge.
course_highlights: Hilly terrain with rocky-outcrop running and forest trails
Passage through Rödgölen Nature Reserve, with soft singletrack
Views from Kolmården’s highest peak, 171 metres above sea level
additional: Race bib collection and late registration take place on race day between 9.00 and 11.00. Payment is by cash or Swish. All courses pass the race centre approximately 1 km before the finish, where the final kilometre is tough and partly off-trail through the forest. There are water stations along the course, including one at 7.5 km by the Scout Hut at Gransjön. Volunteers are needed for race bib collection, serving and water stations.

name: Hoby backyard Ultra 12H
description: The first edition of Hoby Backyard Ultra 12h! The course is 6,706 m, with approximately 50% trail/gravel road and 50% asphalt. 57 meters of elevation gain per lap.

name: Ölands Kyrkstafett
description: Ölands Kyrkstafett is a classic long-distance relay, held for the 47th time, offering a fantastic running experience on Öland in the spring. The start and finish are at Hamnplanen in Färjestaden. The race has two formats: a longer course with eleven legs and a shorter course with six legs, allowing both experienced runners and beginners to take part. During the race, teammates and spectators cheer on the participants. Organizers Högby IF and Ölands idrottskrets aim to provide the best possible service, with course marshals, a race announcer and timing. The race starts at 10:00, preceded by a joint warm-up.
course_highlights: Long course: 11 legs, 67.5 km in total, leg lengths from 2.7 km to 8.5 km
Short course: 6 legs, 23.5 km in total, leg lengths from 2.7 km to 5.4 km
Start and finish at Hamnplanen in Färjestaden, with spectators and teammates cheering on runners
additional: Race bibs can be collected on 8 May from 15:00 to 17:00 and on race day, 9 May, from 08:00 to 09:30 at Hamngrillen in Färjestaden. Changing facilities and showers are available at the sports hall, 200 m north of Ölands Köpstad. Wellness Studio will lead the group warm-up before the start. Course marshals will be stationed along the course, at relay exchanges, and at the start and finish. Individual leg times, split times and team finish times will be provided. The long course has a women’s class and an open class; the short course has an open class. The start and finish are at Hamnplanen in Färjestaden. Start at 10:00. Changing facilities and showers are available at the sports hall, approximately 200 metres north of Ölands Köpstad. At the finish, participants receive a medal and a grill plate.

name: Östgötatidningen Mjölby Stadslopp
organizer: Norrköpings Löparklubb i samarbete med IK Akele och Mjölby Cykelklubb
description: Östgötatidningen Mjölby Stadslopp is a popular running event featuring six enjoyable kilometres through Mjölby, starting and finishing in Stadsparken. The course follows the Svartån and includes both challenging climbs and pleasant downhill sections, with an almost entirely paved surface. In addition to the main race, there is also the approximately 3 km Kyrkundan and a children’s race that is completely free thanks to Bostadsbolaget. All participants receive a medal after crossing the finish line. The race is organised by Norrköpings Löparklubb in collaboration with IK Akele and Mjölby Cykelklubb.
course_highlights: 6 km course starting and finishing in Mjölby Stadspark
Route along the Svartån with a 99% paved surface
Challenging climbs and pleasant downhill sections
additional: Race bibs can be collected at Intersport Mjölby on Friday 8 May from 12:00 to 18:00, with a 25% discount coupon, or on race day from 09:00 in Stadsparken. Fitness4You will lead the warm-up before the start. All participants receive a medal after crossing the finish line. The children’s race has four starts, with timing in eight categories for children up to age 12. Companies can book a tent in Stadsparken for their team and for exposure.

name: SHE Silverlöpet
organizer: IFK Sala i samarbete med Sala-Heby Energi
description: SHE Silverlöpet is a revived running tradition in Sala, organized together with IFK Sala. The race offers a beautiful, officially measured 10 km course through central Sala, starting and finishing in Stadsparken. There are three categories: the children’s race, 5 km and 10 km. The event is a celebration for everyone, whether you run, walk or compete. All participants receive a medal, and prizes are awarded to the top three women and men in the 10 km race, with prize draws for the 5 km race.
course_highlights: Officially measured and sanctioned 10 km course through central Sala
Start and finish in Stadsparken
Running through Sala’s beautiful surroundings
additional: Nordic Wellness leads a warm-up for all participants before each start. Start times are 9:30 for the children’s race, 10:00 for 5 km and 10:20 for 10 km. SHE customers get a 50 kr discount on the entry fee via the “Mitt SHE” mobile app or customer service. All participants receive a medal, and it’s a celebration for everyone, including those with a stroller or who prefer to walk. Categories are available for children, 5 km and 10 km. Prizes are awarded to the top three women and men in the 10 km race; prizes are drawn for the 5 km race.

name: Älmhult Fights Cancer

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Online-anmälan är öppen fram till fredagen den 8 maj 20:00

tiers.label: tier_1

description: Älmhult Fights Cancer is a charity race that brings participants together in Älmhult to support the fight against cancer. The race offers several distances, with both runners and dogs welcome and special start times for dog owners. The event includes inspiring talks by prominent doctors and researchers, as well as a festive after-run at Grillen. It is a community where participants come together to support an important cause and enjoy a great running experience in Älmhult.
course_highlights: Choice of distances, with special start times for dogs in the 2.5 km and 5 km races
After-run party with a barbecue and music at Grillen after the race
Inspiring talks by experts from Lund University
additional: Online registration is open until 8 May at 20:00, with on-site late registration available from 08:00 on race day. No refunds for cancellations, as this is a charity race. Group registration is available. Dogs are welcome during special start times and must be kept on a leash. Älmhult Brukshundsklubb will be on site. The after-run party with a barbecue and music starts at 14:00 at Grillen. Accommodation and breakfast are available at IKEA Hotell during race weekend. Previous editions have offered on-site late registration subject to availability. Dog registration has cost 50 kr and included a scarf.

name: Sommarro Snabbare
description: Sommarro Snabbare is a unique running race held in the beautiful Sommarro cultural reserve in Örebro. The race involves running several laps of a 2.6 km course in a woodland park setting, with each lap to be run faster than the one before. It’s a challenge for everyone, focused on running farther and faster, with a clear time limit for each lap. Lilla Sommarro Snabbare also offers a child-friendly version where the youngest participants can run one untimed lap and feel like winners.
course_highlights: A 2.6 km course through hilly woodland park terrain, with gravel paths, fitness trails and a little off-road running
Start and finish on the lawn by Sommarro Värdshus
A timed challenge with progressively faster laps, focused on endurance and speed
additional: Lilla Sommarro Snabbare is for children born in 2014 or later. The children run one untimed lap and receive a medal at the finish.

name: Humlestafetten
description: Humlestafetten is a relay race with six legs that starts and finishes in Bruksparken in Bromölla. The course is flat and easy to run, with a varied mix of gravel and asphalt, making it suitable for both recreational and more experienced runners. The focus is on community and the joy of running, with prizes for the top three finishers in each category and prize draws. A Mini Race is also held for children, featuring a fun course of approximately 650 metres. All participants receive a medal and a diploma.
course_highlights: Flat, easy-to-run course with gravel and asphalt
Six relay legs, with exchanges at the portal
Water station at the start/finish and after approximately 3.5 km on leg 1
additional: Race numbers can be collected from 09:00 in Bruksparken. Showers and changing facilities are available at Sparbankshallen. Timing is done using data chips, and both total time and each runner’s leg time are recorded. There is a group warm-up before the start. The children’s Mini Race starts below Bruksparken, with a group warm-up at 10:20. After finishing the Mini Race, all children receive a medal, diploma, drink and fruit. Late registration for the Mini Race is available on site between 09:00 and 10:00. Proceeds go to Rotary’s international relief work and Ryssberget IK’s activities.

name: Lundaloppet
description: Lundaloppet is a popular recreational race in central Lund, offering several distances for all ages and abilities, including 2.5 km, 5 km, 10 km, 15 km, and the children’s Little Lundaloppet. The race is a wonderful running celebration through the city’s parks and city centre, with a welcoming atmosphere for both beginners and experienced runners. The event has a long tradition and finishes inside Centrala Idrottsplatsen, where participants can enjoy food and drinks from food trucks. Lundaloppet is a festive event that brings runners and spectators together in a friendly, energetic setting.
course_highlights: 10 km of running fun through springtime Lund
5 km route through parks and the city centre
Child-friendly Little Lundaloppet, approximately 500 metres around Centrala Idrottsplatsen
additional: Race bibs can be collected at IFK-hallen at Centrala Idrottsplatsen the day before and on race day. The warm-up takes place at the start on Svanevägen, led by a running coach on raised platforms. Timing is chip-based, with the chip attached to the race bib, and the finish is filmed. The official T-shirt can be purchased during registration or at the venue. Meal packages and food trucks are available after the finish. It is also possible to add training sessions with a running coach before the race. Official information lists water stations at 5, 10 and 15 km; the 2.5 km course has no water station. These practical details and prices on the information page apply to 2026 and have not been confirmed for 2027.

name: Sunnhordland løpsfest
description: Sunnhordland Running Festival takes place in the centre of Leirvik on Stord and offers a wide range of distances for all runners, including 5 km, 10 km, half marathon, a children’s race and a Super Race for people with disabilities. The event is a community celebration that brings together runners of all ages and abilities for a day of running and camaraderie. The race starts on Borggata and is organised by Stord Athletics, which welcomes everyone to a great running experience in scenic surroundings.
course_highlights: Run in the centre of Leirvik, with the start on Borggata
A great choice of distances from 5 km to half marathon
An adapted Super Race for people with disabilities
additional: The children’s race is approximately 450 metres. Registration for the standard distances and the Super Race is via EQ Timing; the children’s race has its own registration form.

name: Skogvokteren Ultra
description: Skogvokteren Ultra is a demanding 88 km trail ultramarathon with 3,500 metres of elevation gain, passing through varied forest areas in Grenland. The race starts and finishes at the steps of Porsgrunn City Hall and offers a mix of trails, gravel roads and asphalt in scenic, hilly terrain. The event has an accessible, authentic profile, with a focus on personal achievement and the joy of trail running. A six-stage relay is also held, offering teams and companies a great opportunity to take part together. The race includes electronic timing, tracking via intermediate timing points, five aid stations and a Skogvokteren medal.
course_highlights: 88 km with 3,500 metres of elevation gain across varied terrain
80% trail and 20% gravel/asphalt through three municipalities and two cities
The course links Grenland’s two largest cities in a green, winding loop
additional: The race has electronic timing and tracking via approximately 15 intermediate timing points. There are five aid stations along the route. Mandatory equipment includes a GPS device with the route loaded, hydration containers holding at least 1.5 litres, a wool or technical base layer, a reflective vest for running in the dark, a phone with the race director’s number saved, first-aid supplies and an emergency blanket. Accommodation is available with a 20% discount at Comfort Hotel Porsgrunn when booked before 9 April 2027. A pasta party will be held on Friday 7 May from 17:00 to 19:00, alongside race-number collection. The relay class has six stages with handovers in marked areas, and the baton is a timing chip passed between runners. Start at 05:00 from the steps of Porsgrunn City Hall. The course is not marked and must be followed using GPX; there are five aid stations. Mandatory equipment and an age limit of 18 apply. The relay has 25 team places.

name: Fløyen - Knarvik
location: Fløyen, Bergen to AMFI Knarvik, Knarvik, Norway
description: Fløyen-Knarvik is a hiking and running event of approximately 26 km, starting at Fløyen in Bergen and finishing at AMFI Knarvik. The route follows much of the old postal road and crosses the Nordhordland Bridge, Flatøy and the Hagelsund Bridge. There is also a shorter starting option from IKEA in Åsane, covering approximately 13 km. The event is suitable both for families looking for a scenic outing and for runners seeking a challenging distance, with timing and prizes for the top finishers. The route is approximately 50% asphalt, 30% gravel and 20% trail, with a total elevation gain of 800 metres from Fløyen.
course_highlights: The route follows the old postal road and crosses the Nordhordland Bridge, Flatøy and the Hagelsund Bridge
Approximately 26 km with 800 metres of total elevation gain from Fløyen
Varied terrain: asphalt, gravel and trail
additional: The Fløibanen funicular ride up to Fløyen is included in the registration fee. It is not possible to register on the day at the start. The running class starts at 11:00 from Fløyen with a mass start, and at 11:30 from IKEA Åsane. Free buses from Knarvik bus station to Bergen depart at 08:20 and 09:30. Return by regular scheduled bus from AMFI Knarvik. The route is staffed by course marshals and has Red Cross stations. Water and bananas are available at aid stations along the way. The finish area at AMFI Knarvik offers baguettes, bananas, water and coffee. Toilets are available at the start, IKEA Åsane and the finish area. Race numbers can be collected at the lower Fløibanen station or IKEA Åsane before the start. The route is marked with kilometre markers, arrows and tape. Good running shoes that have been worn a few times and weather-appropriate clothing are recommended. The Fløibanen ride up to Fløyen is included in the registration fee. The Fløyen route is approximately 50% asphalt, 30% gravel and 20% trail. It is not possible to register on the day at the start.

name: Hörster Waldlauf im Naturpark Teutoburger Wald
Niedermeiserer Dorflauf
distance_verbose: 18 km, 10 km, 7 km, 5 km, 1 km, 0.4 km

name: Blue Power Run
organizer: Fundacja Pełnoprawni MY i Stowarzyszenie Pomocy Dzieciom z Autyzmem SENSE
description: Blue Power Run is an inclusive race organized for people on the autism spectrum, their families, and friends. The event aims to support social integration through a shared sporting occasion that brings participants together and raises awareness of autism. The race takes place on a paved path beside the Arkonka Swimming Complex in Szczecin. Taking part is above all about the satisfaction of overcoming personal challenges, regardless of finishing position. The event also includes group activities coordinated by therapists and volunteers, further encouraging integration.

name: Czerwona Trasa Nordic Walking Do Najdłuż...
description: The Red Nordic Walking Route in Wilkowo Nowowiejskie is a scenic and challenging 8.2 km route, serving as the first stage of the 14th edition of the Nordic Walking Grand Prix. The event will take place on May 9, 2026, and offers an excellent opportunity for sporting competition and discovering local attractions such as the largest wooden clog and a communal feast table. Participants can prepare using the certified Nordic Walking routes available in the Nowa Wieś Lęborska municipality.

name: IV Płużnicka Piątka
description: The 4th Płużnica Five is a 5-kilometer race held in the picturesque village of Płużnica. The course features a variety of surfaces, making it appealing to both recreational and more experienced runners. Participants start in the village center, and the event also includes children’s races and a formal awards ceremony. The race has a friendly, family atmosphere, as confirmed by positive feedback from participants in previous editions.

name: Silgan Ćwierćmaraton
location: SILGAN Metal Packaging Tczew S.A., ul. Rokicka 13, Tczew, Poland
description: The Silgan Quarter Marathon is a 10.54 km race held in Tczew County. The start and finish are located at the headquarters of SILGAN Metal Packaging Tczew S.A. in Tczew. The route passes through Tczew, Rokitki and Śliwiny and has a mix of asphalt and gravel surfaces. The race takes place with restricted vehicle traffic, and the route is marked every kilometre. The event is small-scale, with a limit of 200 paid participants.
course_highlights: A 10.54 km route through Tczew, Rokitki and Śliwiny
Mixed asphalt and gravel surfaces
The route is marked with road markings every 1 km
additional: The start line will close 15 minutes after the starter’s gun. The number of participants is limited to 200 paid entrants. The start and finish are at the headquarters of SILGAN Metal Packaging Tczew S.A. The race route runs with restricted vehicle traffic. Information about the route and organization is confirmed by the 2025 and 2026 editions; details of the 2027 edition were not available in the sources.

name: KaaienLoop
location: Stadspark en centrum van Oosterhout, North Brabant, Netherlands
description: The Kaaienloop is a lively running event in Oosterhout, starting and finishing at the Heuvel. The 24th edition takes place on Saturday, 8 May 2027, and offers a range of distances for the whole family, from the 550-metre Bambino Run to the challenging 10 kilometres through the city park and town centre. The varied routes are accompanied by live music from bands along the course, creating a festive atmosphere. The Kaaienloop is open to all ages and ability levels, with chip timing and a strong focus on sociability and sportsmanship.
course_highlights: Course through the city park and the atmospheric centre of Oosterhout
Live music from various bands along the course
A range of distances, including a dedicated course for the Bambino Run in the city park
additional: Race numbers can be collected on the day from 15:30 until 15 minutes before the start at the stand in front of Heuvel 7. The Bambino Run is 550 metres through the city park and can be run with a parent accompanying the child. The 5 km consists of 2 laps of 2.5 km, and the 10 km consists of 4 laps of 2.5 km. Timing is recorded via a chip in the race number and start and finish mats. Results will be published on uitslagen.nl. Participants can register for various distances, and the event also includes youth and company races. Photos and results from previous editions are available online.

name: Run van Gieten
distance_verbose: Halve marathon, 10 km, 5 km, 2.05 km, 1 km, 0.5 km, 0.3 km

price_tiers.distance: Loopcircuit de Kop van Drenthe wedstrijdloop 10 kilometer
Magnesium halve marathon Run van Gieten

description: The Run van Gieten is a running and walking event held on the Hondsrug in Drenthe. The 19th edition takes place on Saturday, 8 May 2027, and offers a wide range of distances, from 250 metres for the youngest participants to a half marathon. The event includes various races, such as the Loopcircuit de Kop van Drenthe 10-kilometre race, the Magnesium half marathon and the Magnesium 5.3-kilometre race. There are also youth and wheelchair runs, walking tours and special races for children. Everyone is warmly welcome to join this sporty day full of challenge and fun.
course_highlights: Running and walking event on the Hondsrug in Drenthe
Distances ranging from 250 metres to a half marathon
Loopcircuit de Kop van Drenthe 10-kilometre race with chip timing
additional: Participants in the 10-kilometre race can use the changing and shower facilities at De Goorns sports hall. Valuables can be handed in at the Impuls office on Brink. There are plenty of parking spaces nearby. All participants run with a Loopcircuit de Kop van Drenthe chip. Cash prizes are awarded to the fastest men and women in various age categories, with an additional bonus for breaking the course record. Registration is via QR code and includes the youth and school championships, walks and special runs.

name: SilvercityRUN
description: SilvercityRUN is an annual running event in Schoonhoven, known for its friendly atmosphere and sporting challenge. The race passes through the historic streets of the Silver City and attracts both recreational runners and dedicated athletes. With 5- and 10-kilometer distances and a special Kidsrun, there is a suitable race for everyone. The event is marked by a festive atmosphere, with music and enthusiastic supporters along the course.
course_highlights: Historic streets of Schoonhoven
5- and 10-kilometer distances
Friendly, festive atmosphere with music
additional: SilvercityRUN 2026 sold out, with 1000 participants. A special training group and a running shirt are available. Each year, an amount is raised for the charity 'Het Huis van Noord'. The annual race celebrated its anniversary edition in 2026 and featured various distances, including 5 km, 10 km and a kids’ run, with many volunteers and a lively atmosphere.

name: Oslo Løpsfestival, Bygdøyrunden

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Dagsbillett SOLO Deltakere kr 475,00 kr 332,50 + Adm. gebyr (25 NOK + 3%) -30%

tiers.label: tier_1

description: Bygdøyrunden is one of eight races in the Oslo Running Festival, which follows the capital’s lovely trails and scenic roads. The race has a mass start on Sunday, May 9 at 11:00 from Frognerkilen skatepark in Oslo. Participants can run alone or as part of a team, and it is possible to take part in several races to earn an overall medal. The course is marked only during the mass start, and timing is recorded using a chip on the race bib.
course_highlights: The race follows lovely trails and scenic roads in Oslo
Mass start on Sunday, May 9 at 11:00
The course is marked only during the mass start
additional: Race bibs can be collected at Löplabbet Oslo sentrum at Pilestredet 7 from April 7. Timing is recorded using a chip on the race bib, and participants must pass within five metres of the sensors. The course is marked only during the mass start. Participants can run alone (SOLO) or in teams (DUO, TRIO), with women’s, men’s and mixed categories. Participants who take part in at least five races can compete in the overall series. Start and finish at Frognerkilen skatepark. The race can be completed between April 30 and May 9, 2027; the mass start is on Sunday, May 9 at 11:00. SOLO, DUO and TRIO tickets are available, and the festival pass covers all eight races.

name: Strailøpet
description: Strailøpet is an inclusive spring trail race on the lit trails at Strai, Torridal, Kristiansand, organized by Torridal IL and secondary school students. The race offers four distances: a children’s race, 5 km, 10 km trail, and half marathon, all starting and finishing in the same area at Storemyråsen. The event combines competition with socializing, offers timing for those who want it, and also allows participants to walk in the recreational class. Proceeds go toward the students’ class trip and the Norwegian Cancer Society, and the whole village pitches in to create an enjoyable race day.
course_highlights: Half marathon of 22.2 km with 474 metres of elevation gain, consisting of one 5 km loop and two 10 km loops
5 km and 10 km trail courses on the lit trails at Strai
Children’s race of approximately 1 km, untimed, with a medal and ice cream at the finish
additional: All distances start and finish at Storemyråsen, allowing family and supporters to follow runners across the different distances. The start order is half marathon first, followed by the children’s race, 10 km, and 5 km. There is a group warm-up and an announcer before each start. Race bibs and timing chips are collected on race day in the start and finish area. The children’s race is untimed, but all children receive a medal and ice cream at the finish. NOK 20 of each participant’s entry fee goes to the Norwegian Cancer Society. It is possible to participate in the recreational class without being ranked. The race is organized by volunteers, with support from parents, young people, and sponsors.

name: GVG Volkslauf Rund um den Otto-Maigler-See
Wings for Life 2026 Gdańsk Południe
description: The Wings for Life World Run is a unique global race held simultaneously around the world. Instead of a traditional finish line, participants race against a virtual Catcher Car, which starts 30 minutes after the runners and gradually increases its speed until it catches the last participant. In Gdańsk Południe, the race will take place on May 10, 2026, starting at 13:00 near the Parkrun Gdańsk-Poludnie finish area. The course is an approximately 3 km loop on a paved surface, with a slight uphill section on the connecting path. All entry fees support spinal cord research.

name: Botaniczna Piątka Bydgoszcz – edycja wiosenna 2026
description: Botaniczna Piątka Bydgoszcz – Spring Edition 2026 is a cross-country race organized by running enthusiasts since 2014. The event takes place on scenic routes in Bydgoszcz, with an emphasis on the aesthetic appeal of the locations. It’s a great opportunity to spend time actively and enjoy the beauty of nature during a spring race.

name: Wings for Life World Run 2026 Poznań
description: Wings for Life World Run is a unique global race in which all participants start simultaneously around the world, running away from the Catcher Car. The race has no traditional finish line—participants run until they are caught by the car. All entry fees go toward research into treatments for spinal cord injuries, making this not only a sporting challenge but also a charity event. You can take part locally or via the app, which lets you run from anywhere in the world.

name: Wings for life world run App
description: The Wings for Life World Run App is a unique race held simultaneously around the world on May 10, 2026. Participants start at the same time wherever they choose, with the goal of outrunning a virtual Catcher Car that starts chasing them 30 minutes after the start. All entry fees go toward research into spinal cord injuries, and the mobile app provides motivation and a unique audio experience during the race. It’s a race for everyone—from beginners to professionals, runners, wheelchair users, and amateurs.

name: XXXIII Biegi Żnińskie
description: The 33rd Żnińskie Runs is an annual running event held in Żnin, scheduled for May 10, 2026. The event includes road races over 10 km, 5 km, and 2.5 km, as well as a 5 km Nordic Walking event. The start and finish are located at Freedom Square. The 10 km race counts toward the Pałuki Grand Prix. Participants receive a race pack containing a commemorative medal from the “Great People of Żnin” series, a recovery meal, and souvenirs from Pałuki. The race office is open on race day from 9:00 to 11:45 at Primary School No. 1 in Żnin.

name: Dikke Tien Runn

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: inschrijfkosten voor 10 km is twaalf euro

description: De Dikke Tien Runn is a running race held in the beautiful Middag Humsterland nature area, starting and finishing at the sports park on Valgeweg in Feerwerd. The run is a spin-off of Sportpark De Dikke Tien, an initiative by local residents to make exercise fun, sociable and healthy. There are three routes: 10 kilometres, 5 kilometres and a special 1-kilometre kids’ run. The organisers work with Univé Verzekeringen and support the UMCG Beatrix Children’s Hospital with part of the entry fees.
course_highlights: Run through the Middag Humsterland nature area
Start and finish at Sportpark De Dikke Tien on Valgeweg
Three routes: 10 km, 5 km and a 1 km kids’ run
additional: €2.50 from each ticket sold goes to the UMCG Beatrix Children’s Hospital. The run is an initiative of local village associations and residents from Feerwerd and surrounding villages. The organisers work with Univé Verzekeringen. Routes of 1 km, 5 km and 10 km; start and finish at the Valgeweg sports park; support for the UMCG Beatrix Children’s Hospital.

name: Leiden Marathon
description: The Leiden Marathon is an atmospheric running event held in the historic city centre of Leiden and the surrounding area. The course passes the beautiful canals, cheering crowds, and the green polders and villages around the city. The start is on Koninginnelaan, and the finish is beneath the iconic finish arch at Vismarkt. Marathon weekend offers several distances, including 42 km, 21 km, 10 km, and a 5 km Nightrun, and is an experience for both runners and walkers.
course_highlights: Start on Koninginnelaan
Finish beneath the finish arch at Vismarkt
Course through the historic city centre, along the canals, and across green polders
additional: The 10 km, 21 km, and 42 km walking distances start on Saturday. The 5 km Nightrun takes place on Saturday evening. The 10 km, 21 km, and 42 km running distances start on Sunday. Race numbers can be collected on Saturday and Sunday at Johnson & Johnson Park (Garenmarktplein). There is a supervised bag drop and a tent village with a help desk. The finish is a festive place, with large crowds along the course. Registration opens on 1 October 2023; the event includes several distances and activities, with the start and finish at Garenmarktplein and Johnson & Johnson Park.

name: Rondehoeploop
location: Ouderkerk aan de Amstel, North Holland, Netherlands
description: The Rondehoeploop is a friendly and popular running race in Ouderkerk aan de Amstel, celebrating its 40th anniversary edition in 2027. The race offers challenging courses of 17.2 km and 5 km, plus a 2 km children’s race, with a welcoming start and finish at De Bindelwijk sports hall. The event attracts many participants and spectators each year, thanks in part to the enthusiastic volunteers and the crowds along the course. Every participant receives a medal, and various prizes are awarded across different age categories.
course_highlights: 17.2 km Rondehoeploop course with challenging wind conditions
2 km children’s race, with a dedicated training schedule available
Start and finish at De Bindelwijk sports hall in Ouderkerk aan de Amstel
additional: Race numbers can be collected on the day from 9:30 to 11:00 at De Bindelwijk sports hall. Same-day registration is no longer available for the running distances; it is available only for walking and the children’s race. Timing uses the MYLAPS Bibtag system, with the chip incorporated into the race number. Net time is recorded. The starting gun for the children’s race goes off at 11:42. All participants receive a medal, and various prizes and trophies are awarded across different age categories. The fastest Ouderkerkers receive a dinner/lunch voucher, and a perpetual trophy after three consecutive wins. Anniversary edition; advance registration required; includes route directions and refreshment stations along the course.

name: Schagen City Run
location: Het centrum van Schagen, Schagen, Noord-Holland, Netherlands
description: The Schagen City Run is an annual running event in the centre of Schagen, with the start and finish at the Markt. The event offers several distances, including 5 km, 10 km, a Business Run and a Kids Run, making it suitable for runners of all ages and levels. The City Run is inclusive and accessible to athletes using handbikes or blades. Participants can collect their race numbers in advance at Sport2000 Sportshop Bouwes or on race day at Hotel Marktstad.
course_highlights: Start and finish at the Markt in the centre of Schagen
Several distances: 5 km, 10 km, Business Run and Kids Run
Inclusive of athletes using handbikes and blades
additional: Race numbers can be collected in the week before the race at Sport2000 Sportshop Bouwes in Schagen. On race day, race numbers can also be collected at Hotel Marktstad. Participation with handbikes and blades is possible. A voluntary donation is requested for Stichting ALS, the event’s chosen charity. The race takes place on 9 May 2027 in the centre of Schagen. In addition to the main distances, there are other activities and a great atmosphere focused on inclusion and sportsmanship.

name: Kastelenloop
location: Diepenheim, Hof van Twente, Overijssel, Netherlands

name: Vårruset (Växjö)
description: Vårruset in Växjö is a popular spring running event offering 2.5 km and 5 km distances around the beautiful Lake Växjö, with the start and finish at Strandbjörket. The event is open to everyone and offers both individual and team registration. Teams consist of five people and receive a shared picnic after finishing. The event has a wonderful spring atmosphere, with a medal, finish-line bag, music quiz and prizes for participants. It is a fun run with timing on the 5 km course, but participants can choose to run without timing if they wish. Vårruset is organized by IFK Växjö in collaboration with Marathongruppen and several athletics clubs.
course_highlights: The course goes around Lake Växjö through beautiful natural surroundings
Start and finish at Strandbjörket, near Strandbjörkshallen
A water station and toilets are available at the event area
additional: Race bibs can be collected at Intersport at Grand Samarkand in Växjö a few days before the event. Team leaders receive a picnic voucher on their race bib to collect the picnic after the event. The event area opens at 17:00 with a sponsor village, and light refreshments are served. Participants are encouraged to arrive dressed for the race and to travel to the event area in an environmentally friendly way. The race bib must be clearly visible throughout the race. Participants can run, jog or walk. Individual registration includes a medal, finish-line bag, music quiz and race bib; team registration also includes a picnic. Timing is available for the 5 km distance and can be opted out of. Published local information applies to the 2026 event.

name: Blodomloppet (Uddevalla)

tiers.label: tier_2
tiers.description: 2000kr fr.o.m. 28 april fram till och med 4:e maj

description: Blodomloppet in Uddevalla is a recreational race that highlights the life-saving importance of blood donation and welcomes participants to walk, jog, or run 5 km or 10 km. The event also offers Lilla Blodomloppet for children up to 12 years old. Participants can register individually or as a team, and the event ends with a picnic together. Blodomloppet is a popular workplace wellness activity that brings together companies and individuals in a social, healthy setting while supporting a good cause.
course_highlights: The 5 km and 10 km races start north of the grassy area in Museiparken and follow Kungsgatan eastward
Lilla Blodomloppet starts in the tree-lined avenue north of Museiparken and heads west
The course is suitable for both walking and running, with timing for the 5 km and 10 km races
additional: You can register individually or as a team of 3–5 participants. Team registration includes a picnic bag. Teams can fill vacant places until 1 May. Late registration is available on site from 16:00 on race day. You can pay using your workplace wellness allowance through Epassi, Wellnet, or Benify. T-shirt sizes may sell out, with priority given to those who registered in advance. Blood donors receive a 40 kr discount, and the workplace wellness allowance can be used.

pipeline_log.message: New race date found on official site (https://blodomloppet.se/vara-lopp/uddevalla/): 2027-05-10 — "Välkommen till Blodomloppet 2027! 10 maj 2027" (was estimated 2027-05-10)

name: Vårruset Göteborg
organizer: Marathongruppen tillsammans med Hässelby SK, Spårvägens FK och lokala arrangören IK Vikingen
description: Vårruset Göteborg is a wonderful fitness festival for women, held in Slottsskogen, with the start and finish at Björngårdsvillan. Participants can choose between 2.5 km and 5 km on a course measured for accuracy. The event is all about the joy of movement, community and a fantastic atmosphere, with entertainment and encouragement along the course. Everyone who finishes receives a medal and a finisher’s bag, and teams that register also get a picnic after the finish. Vårruset is part of Sweden’s largest fitness tour for women and welcomes participants of all ages, with a recommended minimum age of 7 when accompanied by an adult.
course_highlights: A 5 km course measured for accuracy
Start and finish at Björngårdsvillan in Slottsskogen
Entertainment and encouragement along the course and in the event area
additional: Registration is binding and can be completed online up to race day, no later than one hour before the start. Participants can opt out of timing when registering, which means their result will not be published in the results list. Teams consist of five people, and team members can run different distances. Teams that register get a picnic after the finish. The recommended minimum age is 13 for the 5 km (11 when accompanied by an adult) and 11 for the 2.5 km (7 when accompanied by an adult). Race bib information is sent out approximately two weeks before the event. Five-person teams get a picnic after the finish. Timing is available for the 5 km and can be opted out of. Information about the course and event format is from the 2026 edition; details for 2027 have not been confirmed in the sources.

name: Chalmersloppet 2026
description: Chalmersloppet is an annual running festival on the Johanneberg campus in Gothenburg, welcoming students, employees, alumni and companies to take part in a community focused on health and wellbeing. The event offers several distances and a walk, so everyone can participate on their own terms, from experienced runners to those who prefer walking. It is a meeting place for networking and exercise in a relaxed, inspiring atmosphere, with a focus on health for all. Students can participate for free, and company participation creates valuable opportunities for future employers and students to meet. Chalmersloppet is organized by Chalmers Student Union’s Teknologbolag and celebrates balance, wellbeing and community.
course_highlights: The race starts and takes place on the Johanneberg campus, with several distances: 9.82 km, 6.28 km, 3.14 km, and a 3.14 km walk
Start groups of runners and walking groups set off one after another from Chalmersplatsen
Runner Zone at Geniknölen features activities, networking and an awards ceremony
additional: Fysiken offers free changing rooms at Mossen. A bag drop is available for runners’ belongings. Bib numbers and T-shirts can be collected from a tent at Teknologgården the day before and on race day. Fysiken leads a group warm-up. The awards ceremony takes place at Chalmersplatsen. Runner Zone is a central meeting place featuring companies and activities. Students participate free of charge. The event includes activities in a Runner Zone.

pipeline_log.evidence_quote: See you on the 11th of May 2027!

name: Kanada Rundt
description: Kanada Rundt is a traditional annual road race in Sylling that has been held since 1981. The race offers 3 km, 6 km, and 12 km distances, with the start and finish at Syllinghallen. The classic 12 km course runs around Kanada and is officially measured by the Norwegian Athletics Association. The event also includes Syllingløpet for children, with no timing, and prizes are awarded for course records, sprints, and youth categories.
course_highlights: Classic 12 km course around Kanada, officially measured at 12,040 metres
The 6 km course follows the main route to Kyllerudsvingen before returning to Syllinghallen
Route: Syllinghallen, Kyllerud, Trolldalen, Kanada, Tronstad, Skjeggerud, Syllinghallen
additional: Start and finish at Syllinghallen, with changing rooms available. Participants in the recreational category can walk or run without timing, with starts between 17:00 and 18:00. Syllingløpet for children aged 0–11 starts at 18:00 without timing; all participants receive a medal. There is a sprint prize at the Learn sprint point, approximately 3 km into the course, as well as course-record prizes and youth prizes. Participants who finish multiple times receive anniversary prizes and mugs. The Lier double prize is for taking part in both Kanada Rundt/Syllingløpet and Lierskogen 6-timers. Previous editions have offered registration through EQ Timing. The start, finish, and changing rooms have been at Syllinghallen.

name: Sørdalskarusellen - Strandtorgetløpet
location: Strandpromenaden, south of Strandtorget, Lillehammer, Norway
description: Strandtorgetløpet is part of Sørdalskarusellen and takes place on the open area south of Strandtorget in Lillehammer, by the red artwork. The race offers an inclusive, accessible atmosphere where both elite runners and recreational runners can take part. The event focuses on the joy of running and togetherness, and is suitable for anyone looking for an enjoyable race experience in scenic surroundings. Race bibs can be collected at the Litrim tent by the art installation, and facilities include toilets on Strandpromenaden.
course_highlights: The race takes place on the open area south of Strandtorget by the red artwork
Race bibs can be collected at the Litrim tent on Strandpromenaden from 17:45
Toilets are available on Strandpromenaden
additional: Registration closes at 18:00 on race day, one hour before the start. Prices increase from 13:00 on race day. Parking at Strandtorget is limited to 2 hours, or 3 hours for shopping centre members. An SMS with information about race bibs and start times will be sent at approximately 16:00. Remember to bring your race bib if you have registered for the whole series. Listed with a start time of 20:00 on 12 May 2027. Virtual participation is listed for 8–11 May.

name: Søreideløpet
description: Søreideløpet is being held for the first time and offers a running festival in Søreide, Bergen. The race follows sidewalks, with a course guide on a bicycle and course marshals at crossings with vehicle traffic. Participants will receive a race bib, and a race medal will be awarded at the finish. Children and young people will also receive a buff from Fjordkraft, and gift cards for Puma products will be drawn among participants. The team with the highest percentage of its members participating will receive NOK 5,000 for its team fund.
course_highlights: The race follows sidewalks in Søreide, marked with white arrows
Course guide on a bicycle and course marshals at crossings with vehicle traffic
Start and finish at Rema 1000 Søreide
additional: Race bibs will be handed out from 18:00. The registration deadline is 18:15 on race day. Rema 1000 Søreide provides bottled water at the finish. All participants receive a race medal. All children and young people receive a buff. The team with the highest percentage of its members participating wins NOK 5,000 for its team fund. Previous editions have awarded medals to all participants. Information about the 4 km distance and price applies to the 2026 edition; information for 2027 is not provided in the sources.

name: Medåkersloppet
location: Parkuddens IP, Medåker, Arboga Municipality, Sweden
description: Medåkersloppet is a classic trail race held annually since 1979 in the beautiful forests around Parkuddens IP in Medåker. The event offers several distances, including a new 14 km race, as well as a children’s race and a mini race for the youngest participants. It is a festival welcoming both runners and walkers, with refreshments and activities in the start and finish area. The mini race and children’s race are untimed and open to all children; participants in the mini race receive a medal.
course_highlights: A trail race through forest terrain, with both wide and narrow paths
The route runs along gravel roads and through the forest
The children’s race follows the exercise trail and is suitable for strollers
additional: The mini race is untimed and requires no registration. The children’s race is also untimed. Refreshments are available in the start and finish area.

name: V Nocny Bieg Parami ze Świetlikami
description: The 5th Night Run in Pairs with Fireflies is a unique nighttime running event held in Reda by the retention reservoir. The runners’ headlamps and the illuminated course create a spectacular visual effect. Participants run in pairs, highlighting the event’s inclusive spirit and setting it apart from other sporting events in the Pomeranian Voivodeship. The run takes place after dark, giving it a distinctive atmosphere and adding to the excitement.

name: Luilakpolderloop
location: Jisp, Wormer- en Jisperveld, North Holland, Netherlands

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: 10 Euro, te betalen tijdens inschrijving, consumptie en bedankje inclusief

description: The Luilakpolderloop is a friendly running race held annually in the beautiful polder landscape of the Wormer and Jisperveld. With distances of 5 km, 10 km and 16.1 km (10 English miles), it offers a suitable challenge for both beginners and experienced runners. Children can take part in a special free 1.1 km youth race. The start and finish are at VV Jisp football club, with a welcoming atmosphere, medals for children, trophies for the winners and a raffle after the race.
course_highlights: Beautiful course through the Wormer and Jisperveld
Distances of 5 km, 10 km and 16.1 km (10 miles)
Free 1.1 km youth race for children
additional: Youth race bibs can be collected on 13 May 2027 from 14:00 to 14:30 at OBS De Harpoen, or on 14 May 2027 at 18:00 at Restaurant De Lepelaar. The youth race starts at 18:30 at Restaurant De Lepelaar and finishes at VV Jisp. Adult race bibs are available from 18:30 at VV Jisp; the adult fun runs start at 19:30. VV Jisp has 4 changing rooms with showers. Bag storage is at your own risk. Parking is limited, and a traffic marshal will be present. Live results are available during the race. The raffle and prize presentation take place after the race, at around 21:15. Registration for 2027 opens in early March, with 350 race bibs available. The event supports charities and offers digital timing with live results. Medals and trophies are available for participants, and registration is mandatory. No refunds are available in the event of cancellation.

name: Skärholmsloppet
price_range: Gratis enligt information om tidigare upplagor
