description: Skärholmsloppet is a family-friendly running festival in Skärholmen, offering races for all ages, from a Mini Race for the youngest participants to a timed 5 km race for participants aged 13 and over. The race is organised by Löparakademin, a non-profit organisation that works with young people in Sweden’s Million Programme suburbs. There is music and entertainment along the course, and all participants receive a specially designed medal at the finish. Skärholmsloppet is an inclusive, uplifting fitness festival that encourages exercise and a sense of community.
course_highlights: Timed 5 km race for participants aged 13 and over
Lilla Skärholmsloppet: approximately 1.6 km for children from preschool class to Year 6
Mini Skärholmsloppet: 500 metres for children aged 0–6
additional: Start and finish at Puckelbollplanen. Music and DJs along the course. A medal for everyone who completes the race. The entry fee includes a race bib, medal, fruit and drink. Lilla Skärholmsloppet has start times divided by school year, with colour-coded start groups. The Mini Race is 500 metres and can be run together with a parent. Late registration may be available at race-bib collection on 15 May and on race day, subject to availability. The race centre at SKHLM offers race-bib collection and bag storage; late registration may be available subject to availability. The recommended route is the red line 13 metro to Skärholmen. Details for the 2027 edition have not been confirmed in the sources provided.

name: Kilsbergen Ut & Tillbaka
description: Kilsbergen Out & Back is a unique and friendly trail run in Ånnaboda, near Örebro, where participants choose their own distance by running one, two or all three out-and-back routes. The race offers hilly trail running through forests and mountains, with technical sections and beautiful trails. Everyone starts at the same time from the same place, creating a social and relaxed atmosphere throughout the day. After finishing, participants are served a simple hot meal, with a vegetarian option.
course_highlights: Three out-and-back routes of 10 km, 26 km and 54 km
Hilly trail running through forests and mountains, with technical sections
The Bergslagsleden Trail, with a turnaround point at the Rusakulan viewpoint
additional: The maximum number of participants is 100. Bibs can be collected from 08:00 at the race centre. The start, finish and race centre are at the warming hut by the artificial snow ski track in Ånnaboda. Toilets are available in the area; changing facilities and showers are at the SM hut by the lower car park. Trail shoes with good grip are recommended. Runners must carry all their own equipment and fuel; there is no support along the course. The race centre will have an aid station with water, sports drink, bananas, sweets, crisps, buns and more. Runners may leave their own drop bags there. Parking is recommended at the lower car park, with signs directing you to the race centre. The organiser’s information lists the start time as 09:00, a maximum of 100 participants and the final registration date as 15 May. Runners are responsible for their own equipment and fuel; support is permitted only at the race centre. Trail shoes with good grip are recommended.

name: TIF Terrängen 2026
description: TIF-terrängen is a traditional cross-country race organized by Trollhättans IF Friidrott. The race has a long history and attracts runners who appreciate challenging terrain and the beautiful natural surroundings of Skidstugan in Trollhättan. After the 2026 race was cancelled, the event is planned to return in 2027, with more information to come later.
course_highlights: The courses start at Skidstugan in Trollhättan.
Distances are 800 metres, 2.3 kilometres, 5.2 kilometres and 10.4 kilometres.
The 10.4-kilometre distance consists of two laps of the 5.2-kilometre course.
additional: The 800-metre race is for children up to 9 years old.

name: Hälleforsterrängen
description: Hälleforsterrängen is a running race organized by Hällefors Running Club and held in Hällefors. The race is part of the club’s annual competition program and welcomes runners of different age groups and ability levels. The club provides financial support to members taking part in running races and encourages carpooling and wearing club clothing. Hälleforsterrängen offers a great opportunity to run in scenic surroundings and take part in a well-organized local running event.
additional: The club reimburses entry fees and mileage expenses for children, young people and juniors at running races, as well as 50% of the entry fee for seniors and veterans in races in Närkes Långloppscup. Wearing club clothing is required to receive reimbursement. Carpooling is recommended. The club also reimburses the entry fee, accommodation, mileage expenses and food for participation in Vasastafetten. Previous editions have included 5 km, 10 km and children’s races. This information applies to 2026 and does not confirm the format for 2027.

name: Ølmedal Rundt
location: Bygdahuset i Ølmedal, Imsland, Vindafjord, Norway
description: Ølmedal Rundt is a traditional race that started in 1984 and attracts 500–600 participants each year. The race follows an approximately 7 km paved route around Ølmedalsvatnet through gently rolling terrain, suitable for runners, recreational participants, wheelchair users and strollers. The event also includes a children’s race, recreational and family classes, and age-group competition classes. The start and finish are at Bygdahuset in Ølmedal, where food is available, along with a drinks station, showers and changing rooms. Ølmedal Rundt is a community celebration with a wide range of participants and good facilities.
course_highlights: Approximately 7 km route around Ølmedalsvatnet on paved roads
Gently rolling terrain suitable for everyone, including wheelchair users and strollers
Children’s course of approximately 400 metres near Bygdahuset
additional: Drinks station after approximately 4 km. Medal for all children’s race participants. Prizes for the top three in the competition classes. Access to showers and changing rooms. A large food sale with grilled food, sveler, cakes and coffee at Bygdahuset. The start and finish are at Bygdahuset in Ølmedal. There is a drinks station after approximately 4 km, and food, showers and changing rooms are available. The race is traditionally held on the second day of Pentecost.

name: Vestmarkaløpet
description: Vestmarkaløpet takes place on May 15, 2027, in Vestmarka in Bærum and offers trail running in beautiful natural surroundings. The race offers two distances, 10 km and 21 km, on trails and forest roads with varied terrain and elevation changes. It is suitable both for those looking for an experience in nature and for those who want to test their fitness early in the racing season. The start and finish are at Vestmarksetra outdoor recreation parking area, with ample parking and public transport nearby.
course_highlights: 10 km course with 219 metres of elevation gain and 1 water station
21 km course with 413 metres of elevation gain and 2 water stations
Trail running on paths and forest roads in Vestmarka
additional: Start and finish at Vestmarksetra outdoor recreation parking area. Parking is available on site, and bus 245 runs to Kattås, about a 1.5 km walk from the race venue. Water, sports drinks and bananas are available at aid stations along the way. Live results will be available on race day. Information about bib collection, baggage storage and awards will be published closer to race day. Start and finish at Vestmarksetra. Parking at the race venue, or take bus 245 to Kattås, about 1.5 km away. Poles and listening to audio are not permitted.

name: XVII Bieg Piastowski - półmaraton Piastowski Festiwal Biegowy
description: The 17th Piast Run is a traditional half marathon held in Inowrocław as part of the Piast Running Festival. The event attracts runners from various regions, offering an appealing course and a sporting atmosphere. It is an excellent opportunity to spend time actively and compete over the 21 km distance. The organizers ensure professional event management and a welcoming atmosphere for participants.

name: 12 Ćwierćmaraton Komandosa
description: The 12th Commandos Quarter Marathon is a uniformed-services race organized by the “Sub ventum” Foundation in Słupsk. The 10.55 km course runs through the grounds of the 650th Anniversary Stadium and the Northern Wood, offering extreme racing conditions for uniformed services and running enthusiasts. The event promotes a healthy lifestyle, competition, and the training of uniformed services. The race is scheduled to start on May 16, 2026, at 12:00, with a participant limit of 999.

name: 3 Mile Dwunastki
organizer: Klub Biegowy Dzik, Wojskowe Centrum Sportu DORSZ, 12 Brygada Zmechanizowana
description: 3 Mile Dwunastki is an extreme trail race organized by the “Dzik” Running Club Association in Szczecin, at the Krzekowo Shooting Range. The 3-mile (4 km and 828 metres) course runs along dirt roads, sand, uphill and downhill sections, concrete and sandy stretches, and forest roads, offering challenging running conditions. The race is free in 2026 and is open to people over 16, with a limited number of places. The start and finish are at the Krzekowo Shooting Range. The event brings people together and promotes outdoor physical activity.

name: 8 Okonińska Pętla
description: The 8th Okonińska Pętla is an annual running event held in the picturesque village of Okoniny Nadjeziorne. The race will take place on May 16, 2026, at 4:00 p.m. It attracts outdoor enthusiasts with an appealing course surrounded by the Tuchola Forests and lakes. The organizers promise a friendly atmosphere and welcome both runners and spectators.

name: Bieg Krokodyla
description: Bieg Krokodyla is an annual running event held by Lake Rusałka in Poznań. The event is scheduled for May 16, 2026, and includes 10 km and 5 km races, a 5 km Nordic Walking event, and children’s and youth races over shorter distances. The main races and walk are scheduled to start at 12:00, while the children’s events begin at 9:00. Participants can choose a basic or extended package with a technical T-shirt. The course follows scenic terrain by the lake, offering attractive views and a pleasant atmosphere.

name: Mariuszowa 5-tka
organizer: Fundacja Mocni na starcie, Biegaj Leszno, Wojewódzki Szpital Wielospecjalistyczny w Lesznie
description: Mariuszowa 5-ka is a race taking place on May 16, 2026, in Leszno, in the Nowy Świat forest district. The course follows unpaved roads and forest tracks, offering distances of 5.3 km (one loop) and 10.3 km (two loops). In addition to the main races, there is a 4 km Nordic walking event, as well as youth and children’s races over shorter distances. The race office is located in the administrative building of the Regional Multi-Specialist Hospital in Leszno, while the start and finish are on Jana Kiepury Street. The event is small-scale, with participant limits for each event.

name: V Szczeciniecka 5-tka
description: The V Szczecinecka 5K is a running event held in Szczecinek, in the West Pomeranian Voivodeship. The event is part of a duathlon and is scheduled for May 16, 2026, at 11:30. Participants can expect professional organization and timekeeping. The event is open to a range of runners and offers a great opportunity for sporting competition and active recreation.

name: XVII Bieg Piastowski - półmaraton z Kruszwicy
description: The 17th Piast Run is a traditional half-marathon held in Inowrocław, attracting runners from across the region. The half-marathon course runs through the city's scenic areas, offering participants both a sporting challenge and the chance to admire local attractions. The event is part of the Piast Running Festival, which also includes other distances, fostering a running tradition and a sense of community.

name: Rundje um ut Hundje
description: Rundje um ut Hundje is an annual running event in Horst aan de Maas, celebrating its 11th edition in 2027. The event offers a wide range of distances for all ages, from the Parent/Child Run to the 10 km race. The routes pass through the centre of Horst, creating a sporty and sociable atmosphere, made possible in part by the local community and sponsors. The organisers aim to provide a well-organised and accessible event for all participants.
course_highlights: Routes ranging from 350 metres to 10 kilometres through the centre of Horst
Start and finish at Lambertusplein, near the statue of ’t Hundje van Hôrs
Various youth and adult races with age-specific distances
additional: Free parking around Lambertusplein. Public transport: the 'Horst Centrum' bus stop is a 2-minute walk away. Prize ceremonies take place at Wilhelminaplein after the youth and adult races. Shirts can be ordered optionally for an additional fee. Multiple race categories, including kids, urban, 5 km and 10 km; location at Lambertusplein; anniversary year with special festivities

name: Adelsö ultra
description: A new ultratrail race on Adelsö on 16 May 2027. Adelsö is one of the Mälaren islands on the outskirts of Stockholm. We have worked hard on the course and are proud to present a scenic marathon-distance XL that combines coastline and technical forest trails with 600 metres of climbing. Beyond the natural experience, the race offers a journey through historically significant landscapes, which we have made an effort to highlight along the route. One of the most exciting ultraraces in Stockholm in spring 2027 for those who love trail running.

name: Perseløpet ¤2 - 2027
description: Perseløpet is a simple, fast race event at Ås School in Eidsvoll, designed to help runners set new personal records. The race takes place on a flat, measured 2,633-metre loop, with seven distances to choose from, ranging from 3 km to 100 km. Participants have their own nutrition table, which they pass each lap, making race nutrition simple and personal. The event offers good facilities, including changing rooms, toilets and free parking, and has a friendly atmosphere where everyone who sets a personal record gets to ring the bell at the finish.
course_highlights: Flat, measured 2,633-metre loop
Your own personal nutrition table along the course
Seven distances from 3 km to 100 km
additional: Race numbers are collected on a self-service basis at Ås School approximately two hours before the start. Free parking, changing rooms and toilets are available at the venue. The race has a lap-time calculator to help plan split times. At selected races, 9th-grade students from Feiring School staff an official aid station, which also raises money for their school trip. The weather forecast is updated four times daily based on satellite data for the area around Ås School. The venue is close to public transport, with live bus departure information and train connections via Entur. The start and finish are at Ås School, Hammerås. Free parking, changing rooms and toilets are available at the venue. Runners can have their own nutrition table.

name: Botaniczna Piątka Przelewice – edycja wiosenna 2026
description: Botaniczna Piątka Przelewice – Spring Edition is a recurring race held in the picturesque Dendrological Garden in Przelewice, an ideal place for nature lovers and those seeking active recreation. The event aims to promote running and physical activity, and participation is open to all ages. Participants can look forward to a unique atmosphere and commemorative medals, awarded after completing the main race or the children’s races. The event is co-organized by the West Pomeranian Voivodeship and is held under the honorary patronage of the Voivodeship Marshal.

name: Ekiden Pragmatiq
description: Ekiden PragmatIQ is a team marathon relay held in Poznań by Lake Malta. Teams of six cover the marathon distance (42.195 km), with each runner completing a designated leg. The course is paved and follows a 5.4 km loop, except for the first leg. The event combines sporting competition with teamwork and support for local charitable organizations. Ekiden Junior is also held as part of the event for the youngest runners.

name: III Półmaraton Brzegiem Bałtyku
organizer: Kołobrzeskie Stowarzyszenie Biegów Ulicznych Nadmorscy Biegacze
description: The 3rd Kołobrzeg Baltic Coast Half Marathon is a flat road race set in the picturesque seaside surroundings of Kołobrzeg. The course follows a granite-paved promenade, a cycle path and asphalt roads, with five refreshment stations along the route. The start and finish are located at Seaside Park Hotel. The race is part of the Kołobrzeg Odyssey series, promoting a healthy lifestyle and bringing the running community together. The time limit for completing the half marathon is 3 hours, and timing is electronic, using disposable chips.

name: Moderska Dwusetka Cross Biegowy
description: Moderska Dwusetka Cross Run is the second edition of a trail running event taking place on May 17, 2026, in Modrze, Poland. Participants can choose from a 5 km run, a 10 km run, or a 5 km Nordic walking event. The route runs through fields and forests between the villages of Modrze and Drożdżyce, offering a chance to connect with nature and enjoy outdoor recreation. The event aims to promote a healthy lifestyle and bring the local community together.

name: Run Toruń Plaza
description: The May edition of the Toruń Legends Trilogy – Run Toruń Plaza, taking place on May 17, 2026, offers two race distances: 5 km and 10 km. It’s a great opportunity to test your fitness in the spring edition of the series and experience the unique atmosphere of running in Toruń. The organizers provide professional event management for a competition with nationwide reach while ensuring a friendly, family-oriented atmosphere. The event is part of a running series promoting a healthy lifestyle and physical activity.

name: Sierakowicka Piętnastka
description: Sierakowicka Piętnastka is an annual race held in Sierakowice as part of the Northern Poland Running Festival. The event takes place at the sports stadium at 7 Kubusia Puchatka Street and attracts runners of all ages, offering a 15 km main race as well as numerous children’s and youth races. The event features electronic timekeeping, an extensive program and prizes for the top competitors. Participants can expect professional organization, including medical and police support, as well as amenities such as a bag drop, showers and a café.

name: Sezon Ogórkowy/Monte Cassino
location: Nowy Tomyśl, Greater Poland Voivodeship, Poland

name: Nobel Run
description: The Nobel Run is a friendly, accessible running event held in the beautiful Almere Hout. The various routes pass through the area’s green, sustainable natural surroundings, giving the event a unique feel. The event aims to make a sustainable and sporting contribution to Almere Hout and is intended as a festive occasion for participants, spectators, and residents of Nobelhorst. The Nobel Run promotes social cohesion and gives the city of Almere a sporting boost.
course_highlights: Routes through the beautiful natural surroundings of Almere Hout
The course has a green and sustainable character
Distances range from a Kids Run to a 15 km run
additional: Race number with a built-in MyLaps timing chip. First name printed on the race number for registrations made before 1 May 2027. Race numbers and shirts can be collected on Saturday 15 May 2027 between 10:00 and 14:00 at the Nobelhorst community hall. Participants may hand in one bag with a numbered label. Entertainment, post-run massage, refreshment stations along the route and at the finish, official results, and personal photos are included. The official Nobel Run shirt, limited-edition socks, and BibBits magnets can be ordered optionally during registration. The event offers merchandise and registration options and emphasizes an environmentally conscious, community-focused approach.

description: Blodomloppet is Sweden’s largest recreational running event, held in 24 locations across the country, including Malmö on May 17, 2027. The event aims to raise awareness of the vital importance of blood donation and promote a healthy lifestyle. Participants can walk, jog, or run 5 or 10 kilometers with friends and coworkers. The event is open to everyone and ends with a group picnic for participants.
course_highlights: 5 km and 10 km routes in an urban setting
Lilla Blodomloppet for children up to 12 years old
A shared picnic bag for all registered teams
additional: Teams of 3–5 participants can register and receive a picnic bag. Blood donors receive a registration discount. Late registration is available on site on the day of the event for an additional fee. The start and finish are in Museiparken in Malmö. You can use your wellness allowance to pay the registration fee.

name: Gerstewitzer Mühlentaglauf
description: The Gerstewitz Mill Day Run is a long-standing running event offering various distances, from 400 m for children to 10 km for adults. After a pandemic-related hiatus, the run has become very popular and combines sporting ambition with regional Pentecost traditions. The event is organized by SFG Nellschütz e.V. and offers runners of all ages an appealing competitive opportunity in the Lützen region.

name: Dortmunder Friedenslauf
description: The Dortmund Peace Run is a traditional race held on Whit Monday, May 25, 2026, in Dortmund-Kirchlinde. The event offers various race distances through the picturesque Rahmer Forest and is known for its friendly, athletic atmosphere. The event features musical entertainment and motivating drummers along the course. The Peace Run is part of a race series organized by the Road Running Working Group and attracts runners of all ages.

name: Blodomloppet Kristianstad
price_range: 350–400 kr för 5 och 10 km; Lilla Blodomloppet gratis för de 250 första, därefter 100 kr

description: Blodomloppet in Kristianstad is a fun run that highlights the vital importance of blood donation and welcomes everyone to walk, jog or run 5 km or 10 km. The event also offers Lilla Blodomloppet for children of different ages, with shorter distances inside Tivoliparken. The course passes through the scenic Vattenriket, with a mix of grass, gravel and asphalt. Participants can take part with colleagues or friends, or on their own, contribute to a good cause and finish with a shared picnic in the event area.
course_highlights: Scenic course extending into Vattenriket
A mix of grass, gravel and asphalt
Lilla Blodomloppet for children aged 0–12 inside Tivoliparken
additional: Registration is available individually or in teams (maximum 5 participants per team). Team members can take part in different distances. The deadline for team registration is 12 May. Late registration is available on site in Tivoliparken from 16:00 on 19 May. Lilla Blodomloppet distances are 100 m (ages 1–3), 550 m (ages 4–7) and 1,100 m (ages 8–12). The 5 km and 10 km courses have a mix of grass, gravel and asphalt. There are several cheer stations along the course. The event area offers picnic facilities, and the event concludes with a shared picnic. Lilla Blodomloppet has distances for children aged 1–12. Teams can have a maximum of five participants.

name: Cytadela by Night # 115 - Wartostrada
description: Cytadela by Night is a series of free, timed races held in Poznań over 5 km and 10 km distances. The races take place in the scenic surroundings of the Citadel, offering participants a unique atmosphere of night racing. The event attracts runners of different age groups and experience levels, promoting physical activity and bringing the local community together.

name: Stafettvarvet
description: Stafettvarvet is an exciting relay race taking place on 19 May 2027 in Slottsskogen, Gothenburg. Each team consists of four runners, all of whom run the same 3.1-kilometre course through beautiful Slottsskogen, finishing at Slottsskogsvallen. The race is popular with companies and friends looking to do something fun and healthy together, with a lovely picnic included after the finish. The race starts at 18:00, with self-seeding to place runners according to pace. Stafettvarvet offers a magical atmosphere before, during and after the race.
course_highlights: 3.1-kilometre course through Slottsskogen
Start, relay exchange and finish at Slottsskogsvallen
A picnic box is included for each team after the finish
additional: The start uses buddy seeding, with runners lining up according to pace. Runners 1 and 2 can enter the start area between 17:00 and 18:00. At the relay exchange, the baton is handed over at exchange barriers divided into zones by race number. Each team receives a picnic box to enjoy after the finish. A corporate village, with tents available to book, is located in the entrance park outside Slottsskogsvallen. One picnic box is included per team. Women's, men's and mixed teams can register; mixed teams must include at least one participant of the opposite sex. It is free to watch the race along the course.

name: Sandbäckens Norrköpingsstafetten
description: Sandbäckens Norrköpingsstafetten takes place on Wednesday, 20 May 2026, in Folkparken in Norrköping. Four people form a team and take turns walking, jogging or running a lively 4 km leg each. There are classes with and without timing, and the race is promoted as an accessible, festive relay for recreational runners and teams. Thanks to HSB, children and young people can take part completely free of charge, and there is special information for schools.

name: Vårruset (Falun)
description: Vårruset is Sweden’s largest recreational running tour for women—a fun and welcoming spring evening where participants can run, jog or walk 2.5 or 5 km. The event tours 19 cities from 4 May to 4 June 2026, and Falun is one of the locations. All participants receive, among other things, a medal and a race bib, while teams of five are rewarded with a picnic after finishing. The race has been held since 1989 and is aimed at recreational runners of different ages, in line with the recommendations for each distance.

description: Blodomloppet in Karlskrona is a fun run that raises awareness of the vital importance of blood donation. Participants can walk, jog or run 5 km or 10 km. There is also an 800-metre children’s race and a dedicated 5 km walking course. The courses are officially measured and approved for competition, and the event ends with a shared picnic for all participants. Blodomloppet is a social, health-promoting activity for individuals and teams, with special discounts for blood donors and ICA members.
course_highlights: Four different courses: 5 km run, 10 km run, 800 m children’s race and 5 km walk
Courses are measured and approved by the Swedish Athletics Association
Walkers have a separate course and start first to make a shared picnic afterwards possible
additional: There is a special discount of SEK 40 per person for blood donors and ICA members, for both individual entries and teams. You can register individually or in a team of up to 5 participants. Team members can take part in different distances/classes. It is possible to register many participants using an Excel template, and larger organisations can use customer portals to manage registrations. Walkers start first on a separate course to make a shared picnic after the race possible. You can take part individually or in a team of up to five people. Blood donors and ICA members receive a SEK 40 discount per person. Prices may be updated ahead of 2027.

name: Västerviksfemman 2026
description: Västerviksfemman is a 5 km running race starting and finishing in Stadsparken in central Västervik. The race offers a pleasant setting and a great atmosphere along the entire course, making it a popular running event. Participants can run individually or in teams of at least five people, with the team result based on the five fastest runners. The 2.5 km lap is run twice, with the start, lap point and finish in Stadsparken. Race bibs are distributed well before the start, with the option to collect them the day before or on race day.
course_highlights: 5 km course in central Västervik, starting and finishing in Stadsparken
The 2.5 km lap is run twice
Pleasant setting and a great atmosphere along the entire course
additional: Race bibs are distributed before 17:30 on race day. Teams receive their race bibs together in one envelope. Race bibs can be collected on Tuesday 18 May at Intersport from 11:00 to 14:00, or on Wednesday 19 May at the stage in Stadsparken from 12:00. You can participate individually or in a team of at least five people; the five fastest times are added together.

name: Potmarge Run
description: The Potmarge Run is an evening race over 5 and 10 kilometres that has been part of the series of runs organised by Lionitas in Leeuwarden since 2012. The routes are measured precisely and offer a unique running experience along the Van Harinxmakanaal and the River Potmarge, where you can enjoy nature in the city. The start is at the MICA/Mediahuis building at Sixmastraat 15. Participation is at your own risk and responsibility, and you can optionally order a medal.
course_highlights: 10 km route along the Van Harinxmakanaal
Run along the River Potmarge
Precisely measured 5 and 10 km routes
additional: Online registration is available until shortly before the start; no on-the-day registration. A medal can be ordered optionally for € 3,50. The start location is MICA/Mediahuis (Leeuwarder Courant building), Sixmastraat 15, Leeuwarden. Routes measured; online registration until shortly before the start; no on-the-day registration; free parking after 18:00.

name: Verkerkloop

tiers.description: De inschrijving is geopend vanaf 1 februari 2027 tot en met 13 mei 2027. Restitutie is niet mogelijk.

description: The Verkerkloop is an annual race through Zwijndrecht, starting and finishing at Verkerk on Molenvliet. The event includes a fast street course with 5 km and 10 km distances for individual runners, a school race for children in various age categories, and a business race for teams. The route passes through the Molenvliet industrial estate and surrounding streets, with a turnaround point halfway through. The Verkerkloop is a sporting event that contributes to a healthy, close-knit community and attracts thousands of participants each year.
course_highlights: Fast street course through Zwijndrecht, starting and finishing at Verkerk on Molenvliet
The 5 km distance consists of one lap; the 10 km distance consists of two laps
The route passes, among other places, along Molenvliet, Munnikensteeg, Klarinetsingel, Beethovenlaan and Develsingel
additional: Start and finish at Verkerk, Molenvliet 1, in the Molenvliet industrial estate in Zwijndrecht. The school race is for children aged 6 and up, with distances from 600 to 1,200 metres. Business race teams consist of 4 or 5 runners; the finish times of the first 4 runners are added together. Every participant receives a commemorative medal. Race numbers can be transferred through a resale platform. A maximum of 3,500 participants are allowed. Registration opens on 1 February 2027. The event is held at Verkerk on Molenvliet and also includes youth and business activities.

name: Blodomloppet Linköping
organizer: IK Akele och Blodtappen i Östergötland

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Ungdomslag (alla fem lagmedlemmar födda 2009 eller senare) deltar för halva startavgiften tack vare samarbete med Lejonfastigheter och Maxi ICA Linköping. Gäller endast till och med 30 april.

tiers.label: tier_2
tiers.description: Sista dag för laganmälan är 14 maj, därefter är det individuell anmälan som gäller.

description: Blodomloppet in Linköping is a recreational race that raises awareness of the life-saving importance of blood donation and welcomes everyone to walk, jog or run 5 km or 10 km. The race is open to both individuals and teams. Teams can consist of 3–5 people, and participants can choose different distances within the same team. Blodomloppet is a social, health-promoting activity that ends with a large picnic and has a strong focus on attracting new blood donors. Youth teams receive a discount, and blood donors are offered a special discount on the entry fee. Participants also have the opportunity to travel free on public transport in Östergötland on race day.
course_highlights: 5 km and 10 km distances for women and men
The race takes place in Linköping, with the start and finish in central areas
Water stations are located along the course
additional: All participants who register by 14 May and provide a mobile phone number will receive a ticket link by text message for 6 hours of free public transport in Östergötland on 21 May. Team registration is for 3–5 people, and teams always pay for 5 even if they have fewer members. Bib pickup and late registration are available at several locations in the days before the race. Blood donors receive a discount of SEK 40 per person, both for individual and team entries. Blood donors receive a discount of SEK 40 per person. Registration for 2027 opens in a few weeks, according to the organizer’s website.

New race date found on official site (https://blodomloppet.se/vara-lopp/linkoping/): 2027-05-20 — "Välkommen till Blodomloppet 2027! ... 20 maj 2027" (was estimated 2027-05-20)

name: Vårruset (Västerås)
description: Vårruset in Västerås is part of Sweden’s largest women’s fitness tour and takes place on Thursday, May 21, 2026, starting at 19:00 at Lögastrand. The event offers distances of 2.5 km and 5 km (the 5 km course is officially measured) and is suitable for both experienced runners and those who want to jog or walk. Everyone who registers individually receives a medal, a finish-line goody bag, and a race number; teams of five are treated to a picnic after finishing. Timing is available for the 5 km distance, but can be opted out of during registration if you do not want your result published.

name: Stigtomtaloppet 2026
location: Stigtomta, Nyköping Municipality, Södermanland County, Sweden

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Lagtävling (3-6 pers) 3,8 km eller 7,6 km inkl picknickkorg (ingen specialkost kan fixas tyvärr) = 1500 kr

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Knatte 350 m köps och anmäls med kort på tävlingsdagen = 100 kr

description: Stigtomtaloppet is a scenic running festival in Stigtomta, welcoming all age groups and runners, from children to adults, including a new dog category. The race offers distances of 3.8 km and 7.6 km on a mix of paved roads, forest trails and residential streets. It is a popular recreational race that also features team competitions with a picnic after the race, bringing participants together. Since starting in 2012, the race has grown to become the largest in the Nyköping region and is known for its friendly, inclusive atmosphere.
course_highlights: Course on paved roads, forest trails and residential streets
Timed hill sprint on the steepest hill
Prizes along the course that participants can take with them to the finish
additional: Start and finish at ICA Nära in Stigtomta. Participant bags with race bibs and timing chips must be collected no later than 30 minutes before the start. Team competitions have a mass start and include a picnic basket (no special diets). The dog category has its own start time and prize table. A refreshment tent serving fika and accepting card payments is available. Parking with guidance and bicycle parking are available. Timed hill sprint on the steepest hill. Prizes along the course that participants can take with them to the finish.

name: XIII Bieg 5 Mil
organizer: Gdyński Dywizjon Okrętów Bojowych, Gdyńskie Centrum Sportu, Stowarzyszenie Oficerów Marynarki Wojennej
description: The 13th 5 MILE Run is a race over 5 nautical miles (9,260 m), organised in Gdynia by the Gdynia Combat Ship Squadron and the Association of Polish Navy Officers, in cooperation with the Gdynia Sports Centre. The course consists of two 4,630 m loops and runs along the waterfront. The start and finish are in front of the ORP “Gen. K. Pułaski”. The race is open to active-duty professional soldiers, civilian military employees and civilian runners who have been verified in advance. The event takes place in a friendly atmosphere, promoting physical activity and sportsmanship.

name: HTB Valestrandsmarka Rundt 3. løp
description: HTB Valestrandsmarka Rundt is a traditional recreational race organized by Osterøy IL Friidrett. The race takes place in Valestrandsmarka on a 4.4 km course, with set start times for walkers and the main field. It is a social and inclusive race series with prizes, refreshments and sveler for participants. The race has a long history, with extensive statistics and records, and several races are held throughout the year, including Christmas and New Year’s races.
course_highlights: 4.4 km course in Valestrandsmarka
Start times: 18:45 for walkers and 19:00 for the main field
Course records are rewarded with NOK 3,000 from HTB
additional: Registration takes place at Furubakken sports ground until the start. Sveler from Toro, cordial from Saftsuse and prizes from Extra Valestrand are provided. The race does not require a license, and payment can be made via Vipps to 121337. A Christmas race is also held on 26.12 at 12:00 and a New Year’s race on 31.12 at 14:00. Race statistics and results are available from 1981 onward. Registration is open until the start. Start times are 18:45 and 19:00. Payment via Vipps 121337.

name: Endless Shore Ultra
description: Endless Shore Ultra Trail is an ultramarathon along the coastal path from Jeløy in Østfold to Nesodden in Akershus, offering an unforgettable journey through varied and scenic terrain. The race offers three distances: 50 km, 50 miles, and 100 miles, with challenging elevation profiles and spectacular views of the Oslofjord. It is organized by a nonprofit, volunteer-run organization that emphasizes sustainability and a great race experience for ultra-running enthusiasts. The start and finish are at Berger Stadium on Nesodden, with bus connections to the start locations and Oslo city center.
course_highlights: Varied coastal terrain with smooth rock, pine forest, and oak forest
Fantastic views of the Oslofjord and towns such as Son and Hvitsten
Run through the night on the 100-mile distance, with historic and scenic stops
additional: Bus transport is available from the finish area at Berger Stadium to the start locations (Drøbak for 50 km, Moss for 50 miles and 100 miles) and can be booked during registration. Medals are made from locally sourced wood, with ribbons made from recycled fabric. The race focuses on environmental responsibility, with no littering on the course and a requirement to bring your own cup to aid stations. The distances award ITRA points (50 km = 2, 50 miles = 3, 100 miles = 5). Registration includes a race bib, timing chip, food and drink stations, and a medal. Bag transport from the start to the finish is available, and a bus from Berger Stadium to the start in Drøbak can be booked for the 50 km distance. Bring your own cup; mandatory safety equipment is required.

name: VfL Ahaus Stadtfestlauf
description: The VfL Ahaus Stadtfestlauf takes place on May 29, 2026, and offers runners a well-reviewed and attractive route through the town of Ahaus. The race is organized by VfL Ahaus 1892 e.V., one of the leading recreational sports clubs in the Münsterland region. The event is open to runners of all ages and offers a friendly atmosphere with a focus on health and community. The route has been carefully explored and approved by the VfL Ahaus running group, so participants can look forward to a great running experience.
course_highlights: Route reviewed and approved by the VfL Ahaus running group
Attractive town route in Ahaus
Event focused on health and community
additional: Registration opens on March 15, 2026. Places are still available. The race takes place as part of the town festival. In cooperation with AOK, VfL Ahaus also offers functional training classes. The routes are not officially measured; registration opens on March 15, 2026; places are still available; the event is part of the town festival, which features a varied accompanying program.

description: The Volksbank Run “Around Offlumer Lake” is a long-standing running event in Neuenkirchen, Lower Saxony, taking place on May 29, 2026. The course runs around Offlumer Lake, with the start and finish at the sports center on Haarweg. A range of races is offered for all age groups, from the Bambini run and student races to the 10 km main race. The event is organized by the SuS 09 Neuenkirchen running group and offers a family-friendly atmosphere, with on-the-day registration available.
course_highlights: Start and finish at the sports center on Haarweg
Course around Offlumer Lake, measured by the DLV for the 10 km main race
Distances range from a 300 m Bambini run to a 10 km main race
additional: On-the-day registration is available until 30 minutes before each start. Race bibs can be picked up from 3:00 p.m. at the registration tent. Timing is provided by Teamsoft-Sportzeit. Races start at staggered times, from 4:00 p.m. (Bambini run) to 7:00 p.m. (main race). Course: around Offlumer Lake. On-the-day registration available. Parking at the outdoor swimming pool and Offlumer Lake.

name: Borgloher Weiherlauf
location: Borgloher Weiherlauf, Hilter am Teutoburger Wald, Germany

name: Göteborgsvarvet
description: Göteborgsvarvet is a well-known 21.0975 km celebration of running in Gothenburg, bringing together tens of thousands of runners and hundreds of thousands of spectators along the course. The race passes through the festival atmosphere of Slottsskogen, continues along Hisingen’s quays and by the buzz of Avenyn. The course has been certified by a World Athletics-licensed course measurer, and the event is complemented by Göteborgsvarvet Expo and numerous spectator and music stations along the route. Information about start groups and other details is sent in the race confirmation approximately two weeks before the race.
course_highlights: Start and festival area around Slottsskogen / Göteborgsvarvet Arena
The course passes Hisingen’s quays and Avenyn
More than 200,000 spectators and numerous music stations along the route
additional: The distance is a half marathon (21,097.5 m), and the course has been certified by a World Athletics-licensed course measurer. There are water stations along the course, and an interactive course map/GPX is published closer to race day. Start groups are assigned according to seeding rules; detailed start times and the location of your start group are sent in the race confirmation approximately two weeks before the race. Göteborgsvarvet Expo and Runners Zone are located at Göteborgsvarvet Arena/Slottskogsvallen. Registration is closed for 2026; seeding rules and start groups are available; the 21 km course passes Slottsskogen, runs along Hisingen’s quays and goes by Avenyn; the race is part of Varvet Week.

name: Ludvika stadslopp
description: Ludvika Stadslopp is an annual running festival that brings together elite runners and recreational runners in Ludvika. The start and finish are at Charlie Normans Square, centrally located between the railway station and the marina. The event is characterized by large crowds, many participants, and a wide range of activities for all ages. Together with partners and volunteers, it creates a wonderful atmosphere of health, exercise, and community.
course_highlights: Start and finish at Charlie Normans Square in Ludvika
A route through the central parts of the town, near the railway station and marina
Large numbers of participants and crowd support create a festive atmosphere
additional: The event has over 1,100 registered participants and offers activities for both young and old. Thanks go to the participants, spectators, volunteers, and partners who make this well-run and popular running festival possible. Information about the start location and event format comes from previous editions and has not been confirmed for 2027.

name: Cityvarvet
description: Cityvarvet is a shorter 4.2-kilometre race that starts at Götaplatsen in central Gothenburg and runs through the city’s tree-lined avenues and cheering crowds before finishing at Slottsskogsvallen. The race is perfect for anyone who finds the Göteborgsvarvet half marathon too long, is a beginner, or wants to experience the festival atmosphere without running the full distance. The course offers a festive running experience, with music and cheer stations along the way. After finishing, participants can access Runners Zone, where they can recover and cheer on the winners of Göteborgsvarvet.
course_highlights: 4.2 kilometres along Gothenburg’s main avenue, Avenyn, and through Slottsskogen
Two water stations with water and sports drink
Music and entertainment stations along the course
additional: Maximum of 1,500 registered participants. Race bib collection takes place at Göteborgsvarvet Expo at Friidrottens Hus from Thursday 20 May to Saturday 22 May. Start at Götaplatsen and finish at Slottsskogsvallen. Access to Runners Zone after finishing, with drinks and snacks. Group registration with invoice payment is available for sports teams and school classes. Participants are recommended to collect their race bib well before the start. Maximum capacity: 1,500 participants. Two water stations with water and sports drink. Registration is open until 12:00 on race day unless the race fills up earlier. Race bibs are collected at Göteborgsvarvet Expo at Friidrottens Hus.

name: Uka Pain
description: Uka Pain is a series of challenging trail races in Älvdalen, offering distances from 12 km up to 100 miles. The races feature spectacular scenery, high mountain peaks and technical trails, making them one of Sweden’s major autumn running experiences. The start and finish are at Hotell Älvdalen, which also serves as the hub for the race and support. The longest distance, 100 miles, features a unique course consisting of three laps of the 50 km course, with spectacular views from several mountain peaks.
course_highlights: The course passes three of Älvdalen’s highest peaks: Hykjeberg, Skärklitt and Väsaberget
Technical trails and varied terrain, with approximately 1,500 metres of elevation gain on the 52 km course
Start and finish at Hotell Älvdalen, with spa and sauna access available to 100-mile participants
additional: Start and finish at Hotell Älvdalen. Bib pickup at The Running Company near Hotell Älvdalen. Drop bags are permitted for the 50 km, 100 km and 100-mile races, with a maximum size of 60x40x40 cm. Mandatory equipment requirements apply to the 50 km, 100 km and 100-mile races. A bus is provided for 100-mile participants from Hotell Älvdalen to the start at Boggberget. Maximum time limits: 28 km – 10 hours, 50 km – 12 hours, 100 km – 22 hours, 100 miles – 34 hours. A T-shirt is included for registrations made by 30 April. A finisher’s medal is exclusive to the 100-mile race. Spa and sauna access for 100-mile participants. The race takes place on 28–29 May 2027. Bibs can be collected at The Running Company, Dalgatan 81F. Bring your own cup for the aid stations; a participant T-shirt is included for those who register by 30 April 2027.

name: VirsboRUN
description: VirsboRUN is a trail race featuring a varied and exciting course in an untouched nature reserve, partly through Hälleskogsbrännan, the site of a 2014 forest fire. The race offers several distances, from 5.3 km up to a challenging half marathon of 21.2 km, with 101 metres of elevation gain per lap. There is also a free children’s race of approximately 800 metres, suitable for the whole family. The start and finish are at Skräddartorpet, where participants can enjoy medals, freshly grilled hamburgers and a wonderful atmosphere. Everyone is welcome to take part and experience the beautiful, challenging terrain, whatever their age or experience.
course_highlights: Trail race in an untouched nature reserve, with sections through Hälleskogsbrännan, the site of a 2014 forest fire
5.3 km loop with 101 metres of elevation gain per lap
Children’s race of approximately 800 metres, starting and finishing at Skräddartorpet
additional: Start and finish at Skräddartorpet. Warm-up with music and a course presentation before the start. Maximum of four laps (21.2 km), with a time limit of 3 hours. An extra water station is located at approximately the halfway point. A relay option is available for families with children. Race numbers are handed out at the start. The children’s race is not officially timed, and all participants receive a medal and a surprise bag. Freshly grilled hamburgers are available in the finish area after the race. A free children’s race of approximately 800 metres is offered.

name: Å-Varvet
description: Å-Varvet is a classic running race in Eskilstuna, offering a scenic and varied course along the water and through the city’s parks. The race is popular with both elite runners and recreational runners, with a great atmosphere and crowd support along the entire route. It’s a perfect event for anyone looking to challenge themselves in beautiful surroundings while enjoying Eskilstuna’s charm.
course_highlights: The course runs along Eskilstuna’s waterways and through its parks
Varied terrain with both asphalt and gravel
Crowd support along the entire course
additional: The distance is 10,549 metres.

name: Schjongs5ern
location: AKA Arena, Hønefoss idrettspark, Hønefoss, Norway
description: Schjonsfemmern is a friendly running event at Femmern, with distances for all levels, from 5 km to children’s races. The event offers scenic, accurately measured courses combining nature trails and asphalt along the beautiful Storelva, with the highest point in Søndre Park. It takes place by the ice hockey arena in Hønefoss Idrettspark and offers a unique atmosphere for both beginners and experienced runners. All participants receive a medal, and there are cash prizes for the 5 km race as well as many prize draws. After the race, participants can easily find photos of themselves through a photo service.
course_highlights: Fast, officially measured course combining nature trails and asphalt
Runs along the beautiful Storelva, with the highest point in Søndre Park
The children’s race starts and finishes at the venue, and all children receive a medal
additional: Race bibs are distributed at the finish area through a self-service system. The 5 km race has electronic timing, with the timing chip integrated into the race bib; the children’s races are not timed. Participants can choose to run the 5 km without timing. Cash prizes are awarded for the 5 km race (women and men). Everyone receives a finisher’s medal at the finish. Results are published on RaceDays. To comply with GDPR, photos from the children’s races are not published. The start and finish are at AKA Arena in Hønefoss Idrettspark. The 5 km can be run with or without electronic timing. The children’s races are untimed, and all children receive a medal.

description: Ulriken Opp is a popular uphill race in Bergen that takes you to the top of Ulriken, the highest of the seven mountains surrounding the city, with spectacular views of Bergen and the North Sea. The race is suitable for all levels, from competitive runners to recreational runners and families, and offers three distances: the Grieg Oppstemten Opp competitive category, the Drevelin Montana Classic recreational and fitness category, and CaniCross, for running with a dog. All start from Montana and finish at the summit of Ulriken, at 605 metres above sea level. The event offers a social and challenging experience, with a mass start and refreshments available in the finish area.
course_highlights: 1.75 km course with 420 metres of elevation gain from Montana to the summit of Ulriken
Start at Montana gravel field, via Johan Blyttsvei and Oppstemten
Finish at Ulriksmasten, at 605 metres above sea level, with views of Bergen and the North Sea
additional: All categories start together from Montana. The competitive category starts at 11:30, the recreational and fitness category at 10:30, and CaniCross at 10:00. The finish area by Skyskraperen Restaurant and Café offers refreshments and outdoor seating for 250 people. Training races are held before the main race, with prizes and an opportunity to socialise. Three categories: Grieg Oppstemten Opp (competitive), Drevelin Montana Classic (recreational and fitness), and CaniCross. CaniCross has a limited number of places. Parking at Bergen Hostel Montana is listed at 55 kr; public transport is recommended.

name: Bjørndalenmila
description: Bjørndalenmila is a World Athletics-certified road race with a measured course that meets international standards. The race offers officially certified results, making it possible to set a personal best. The course is fast and easy to run, making it perfect for runners who want to test their fitness, whether their goal is a new personal best or an enjoyable race experience.
course_highlights: World Athletics-certified, measured course
Fast, easy-to-run asphalt course
Officially certified results for personal bests
