description: Bergensløpet is a traditional race that has returned after almost 30 years, originating in 1976. The race takes place in beautiful surroundings in Bergen, with the start and finish in historic Nygårdsparken. Participants can choose between two distances, 5 km and 10 km, on a fast, scenic course along Store Lungegårdsvann and Møllendal. A free children’s race is also held for the youngest participants in idyllic surroundings around the pond in the park.
course_highlights: Fast course along Store Lungegårdsvann and Møllendal
Start and finish in historic Nygårdsparken
The 10 km course consists of two laps of the 5 km course
additional: Race bibs can be collected from 09:45 at the Vitalitetssenteret by Møhlenpris sports ground. Toilets are available at bib collection and in the clubhouse buildings. The children’s race starts at 12:00, the 5 km at 13:00, and the 10 km at 14:00. The children’s race is approximately 500 metres, with no timing or rankings, and all children receive a medal. The spring edition features a 5 km, a 10 km, and a children’s race. The listed start times for previous editions are 13:00 for the 5 km, 14:00 for the 10 km, and 12:00 for the children’s race.

name: Hurdalsjøen Trail Race
location: Hurdalsjøen Hotell & Spa, Skredderbakkveien 9, 2090 Hurdal, Norway
description: Hurdalsjøen Trail Race is a trail race held at Hurdalsjøen Hotell & Spa in Hurdal, Akershus. The race offers four distances from 5 km to 23 km, across varied terrain featuring technical sections, flowing trails and spectacular viewpoints. Participants get to experience the magical natural surroundings of Hurdalsjøen, with challenges suited to both beginners and experienced runners. The event also emphasizes community, a sense of achievement and nature experiences, with the start and finish at the hotel, which offers facilities such as a spa and good food.
course_highlights: Terrain with technical sections and flowing trails
Spectacular views from Buråsen and Buråskollen (540 m above sea level)
23 km distance with 1,000 metres of elevation gain and views over Hurdal and Hurdalsjøen
additional: All participants in the same distance start at the same time. The courses are marked with colour codes that match the race bibs. Carrying a mobile phone during the race is mandatory. There are 1–3 passes by aid stations, depending on the distance, and runners may refill their own bottles. Parking is recommended at Lundbybakken or Steinerskolen. The start and finish are at Hurdalsjøen Hotell & Spa. The start and finish are at Hurdalsjøen Hotell & Spa, Skredderbakkveien 9, 2090 Hurdal. The courses are marked, and carrying a mobile phone is mandatory. Free parking is recommended at Lundbybakken or Steinerskolen.

name: Konnerudløpet
description: Konnerudløpet 2027 takes place on May 29 in the scenic surroundings of Konnerud in Drammen. The race offers distances for everyone, from a children’s race to 21 km, and is suitable both for those who want to test their speed and those looking for a pleasant run. There will be a great atmosphere, varied courses and experiences for all ages, with free childcare and prizes for all participating children. Konnerud IL looks forward to welcoming runners to a wonderful race celebration marking the club’s 100th anniversary.
course_highlights: Scenic surroundings at Konnerud
Varied courses with distances of 5 km, 10 km and 21 km
Family-friendly, with a dedicated children’s race and prizes for all children
additional: Free childcare is available for the youngest children while their parents run. Every participating child receives a prize. The organizer lists free childcare for the youngest children and a prize for every child who participates. Registration is available via the race website.

name: Kragerø Sommerløp
description: Kragerø Summer Run is a community celebration in the heart of Kragerø, with 5 km and 10 km distances and a free children’s race. The race starts at Jernbanetorget and offers a fast, scenic loop through the town centre, with a great atmosphere and entertainment along the route. This accessible street race is suitable for all levels, whether you take part alone, with family, friends or colleagues. The 700-metre children’s race is free and gives every child a fun experience and a medal. The event also includes activities, stands and socialising before and after the races.
course_highlights: A fast, scenic loop through the heart of Kragerø town centre
A spectator-friendly route with entertainment along the way
A 700-metre children’s race with a medal for every child
additional: Race numbers can be collected at Sport1 Kragerø on Friday 29 May from 16:00 to 18:00, or on race day from 12:00 at Jernbanetorget. Please collect your race number no later than 30 minutes before your start. A relaxed social run (SAYSKY Shake-Out Run) will take place on Friday 29 May at 18:00, followed by sweet buns, coffee and cordial. No registration is required for the children’s race; just show up. Participants are advised not to run with their own music in their ears. Activities and entertainment for children and spectators will be available on race day. The distances are 5 km, 10 km and a free 700-metre children’s race. The children’s race requires no registration and is recommended for children aged 2 to 10. The minimum age for timed results is 12. Prices apply to the information provided for 2026; the date 29 May 2027 is not confirmed in the sources.

name: Kvennstuguløpet 2027
description: Kvennstuguløpet is an annual race organized by Vallset IL in the beautiful surroundings around Kvennstugua in Vallset. The race attracts both young and adult runners and offers a wonderful race-day celebration with strong performances from local athletes. The event has an inclusive atmosphere focused on the joy of sport and community, and it is an important tradition in the local community. Participants can look forward to a range of distances and a great day in scenic surroundings.
course_highlights: Run in the beautiful surroundings around Kvennstugua
A range of distances, with competitions for both women and men
Strong local involvement and a wonderful race-day celebration
additional: The race includes distances such as 2.5 km and 5 km, with separate classes for women and men. The event is supported by many volunteers and has a strong club community. It takes place in glorious summer weather and is a social, inclusive race-day celebration.

name: Vestfold Historic Ultra Trail
description: Vestfold Historic Ultra Trail (VHUT) is a challenging trail ultramarathon through the best terrain in northern Vestfold, with only 6% asphalt on the long course. The race spans two counties and five municipalities, and runners pass many places of local historical significance. The course is unmarked, so participants must navigate using a GPS track, creating an authentic trail experience with the motto “challenging but fair.” Accommodation and transport are offered to make participation easier, along with drop-bag stations and aid stations along the way. VHUT welcomes you to a challenging and scenic ultrarunning experience in a historic setting.
course_highlights: Only 6% asphalt on the long course (147 km)
The course passes through 2 counties and 5 municipalities with local historical significance
Trail race with a challenging but fair course and GPS navigation
additional: Runners use GPS trackers. Accommodation is available from Friday to Saturday, with access to a WC, shower and kitchenette. Transport from Hengsrød to the start is offered for the 50 and 87 km distances. There are drop-bag stations for the 147 km (2 stations) and 87 km (1 station), with food and drinks provided. Aid stations with light refreshments are located at Hajern and Langevann, about 20 km before the finish. Parking is limited at the start/finish and checkpoints, and private support is not permitted at Hajern or Langevann. All runners must download the updated GPX files before the race. GPS trackers are used. Accommodation before the race and transport to the start for the 50 km and 87 km distances are offered; drop-bag stations are listed for the 87 km and 147 km.

description: EcoTrail Oslo is an environmentally conscious trail race offering five distances in the woodland areas near the city, with the finish at Huk, Bygdøy. The race is suitable for both beginners and experienced runners, with distances from 10 km to 80 km, and features scenic surroundings and varied terrain. The courses combine forest roads, technical trails and some paved sections, offering a unique opportunity to experience Oslo’s outdoor areas and cultural history. The event places strong emphasis on sustainability and the environment, and includes services such as baggage transport, timing, and food and drink stations along the way.
course_highlights: Varied terrain with forest roads, technical trails and approximately 9% paved sections
The course passes through Oslo’s woodland areas, including Akerselva, Maridalsvannet and Sognsvann
Panoramic views of Oslo and a stretch along the Oslofjord, with the finish at Huk, Bygdøy
additional: The entry fee includes timing, participant prizes, baggage transport from start to finish, toilet hire, marked courses, an electric bus shuttle to the 31 km start, and food and drink stations along the way. There is no drop bag, and support is only permitted at the stations. Participants receive sports drink, water and light food in the finish area. Merino wool participant shirts are also available at a reduced price. Distances offered are 10, 21, 31, 50 and 80 km, as well as a 21 km walking distance. EcoTrail Oslo is described as an environmentally conscious trail race.

name: Farsund Maraton 2027
description: Farsund Marathon is one of Norway’s most beautiful races, running through spectacular natural and cultural landscapes. The race starts in idyllic downtown Farsund and continues out towards Lista, with distances suited to both recreational and competitive runners. The courses are designed to give participants a unique running experience, with good support from course marshals and refreshment and food stations along the way. The event has a friendly atmosphere and offers prizes to age-category winners and the fastest runners.
course_highlights: Run through spectacular natural and cultural landscapes
Start and finish in idyllic downtown Farsund
Refreshment stations every 5 km on the marathon and half marathon, serving water, cordial, cola and bananas
additional: Race administration is located in the auditorium at Eilert Sundt VGS, approximately 200 m from Torvet. Bib pickup and information hours are Friday 16:00–20:00 and Saturday 08:00–18:00. All participants receive a medal at the finish, and trophies are awarded to age-category winners, with gift prizes for the three fastest times in the marathon, half marathon, 10 km and 5 km for men and women. This year’s T-shirt is given to the first 1,000 people to register. Toilets are located at the start and finish, as well as at Lista Lighthouse and Borshavn on the marathon course. Start times may be adjusted slightly, and time recording ends at approximately 16:00. A registration fee of NOK 15 applies, and a Norwegian Athletics Federation licence is automatically added at registration for those without an annual licence. Registration for 2027 opens on 1 December 2026. A NOK 15 surcharge applies to all registrations.

name: HIT-felder Volkslauf
description: The HIT-felder Volkslauf is a long-standing race in Seevetal, organised by TSV Eintracht Hittfeld. It offers courses for the whole family, from short runs at the Peperdieksberg sports grounds to longer routes along country and forest paths. The event takes place on 30 May 2026 from 13:30 and is known for its friendly atmosphere and extensive supporting programme. All participants receive a finisher’s medal. Team rankings and cash prizes are also awarded to the largest groups of runners who register in advance.
course_highlights: Routes along country and forest paths, as well as partly paved side roads
Races over 600 m, 1000 m, 2.5 km, 4.5 km and 10.6 km, with small and large loops
Electronic timing; spikes are not permitted
additional: Start and finish at Hittfeld School Centre, Peperdieksberg sports grounds. Changing rooms and showers are available at the school centre. Late registration is possible on the day of the event, up to 30 minutes before the start, with cash payment (except for the Roland-Witt family run). Supporting programme with coffee, cake, grilled sausages and drinks. Certificates are available online at www.stgk.de. Team rankings apply to certain races. The group with the most advance registrations receives a challenge trophy and cash prizes. The event takes place in May, with typical temperatures of around 20°C for the low and 10°C for the high, and offers children’s races, walking and Nordic walking alongside the running courses.

name: Johannes-Lauf Lette
location: Ernsting's family Sportpark, Lette, Coesfeld, North Rhine-Westphalia, Germany
description: The Johanneslauf in Lette is a long-standing running event that has been held annually at the Ernsting's family Sportpark since 1998. The race attracts participants from across the region and is a regular fixture on the regional sporting calendar. It is organised by DJK Vorwärts Lette e.V., a club with a long tradition and a strong commitment to grassroots sport. The event offers a sporting challenge in a friendly and inclusive atmosphere.
course_highlights: Start and finish at the Ernsting's family Sportpark
5-kilometre race
A tradition since 1998 with regional significance
additional: The race is part of the Streiflicher running series. Previous events have attracted around 400 participants and included a 5-kilometre walking route.

name: Leegebrucher Straßenlauf am 30.05.2026
price_range: Kinder frei; Jugendliche 3 Euro; Erwachsene 4 Euro
description: The Leegebruch Road Race takes place on May 30, 2026, and is a traditional running event in Leegebruch that welcomes runners of almost all ages. Participants run laps on the sports field and through the streets of Leegebruch. The event promises a lively atmosphere and is open to athletes of all ability levels. Registration is online via an external platform.
course_highlights: Laps on the sports field and through the streets of Leegebruch
Traditional running event with a family-friendly atmosphere
Suitable for runners of almost all ages
additional: Registration is online only; on-site registration is not possible. There are no age categories and no awards ceremony. Changing rooms and showers are not available. Cold and hot drinks and snacks are available at the kiosk. Parking is available at the fairground on Lindenstraße. Run on roads and at the stadium, online registration, no changing rooms or showers, parking on Lindenstraße

name: 08. Dünenfeld Marathon
description: The Dünenfeld Marathon in Augustdorf is a special race held according to the rules of the 100 Marathon Club Germany. The course consists of seven large loops of 6.1 km each, for a total of 42.7 km, and is partly trail-like. The start is at the level of the viewing platform, where runners can enjoy a beautiful view of the large dune fields. This is a private race with self-support and manual timekeeping; a photo of the clock must be submitted by email as proof.

name: 34. Emder Matjeslauf
description: The 34th Emder Matjeslauf takes place on Saturday, May 30, 2026, in Emden city center. This long-standing city race has been organized by Emder Laufgemeinschaft e.V. since 1991 and is known well beyond the region. In addition to the 10 km main race, there are school class and team competitions, making the event suitable for all age groups. The course has been adjusted due to construction work on Neutorstraße but still offers an attractive city loop. Emder Laufgemeinschaft looks forward to welcoming many participants and wishes everyone the best of luck.

name: Aegidius-Lauf
description: The Aegidius Run is a charity run in Hanover that has been established for over 20 years. It takes place on May 30, 2026. The event offers several distances, including children’s races, a wheelchair race, 5 km and 10 km races, and walking options. The start and finish are at Aegidiushaus AUF DER BULT, and all entry fees go exclusively to charity. The course is attractive, and times are recorded using a clock rather than chip timing. All participants receive a certificate, and the best runners are honored with non-cash prizes.

name: Allbaulauf 2026
description: The AllbauLauf 2026 takes place on May 30 around Niederfeldsee and Krupp Park in Altendorf, Essen. The event offers a varied selection of races for schoolchildren, young people, company runners, recreational runners and competitive athletes. The short races for toddlers and schoolchildren are especially popular; they run along the lakeside promenade and over a bridge. The event is a sporting highlight with a wide range of races for all ages and ability levels.

name: Limbacher Marktlauf
description: The Limbach Market Run will take place for the 30th time on May 30, 2026, at the Waldstadion in Limbach-Oberfrohna. The event offers a great running atmosphere, with new courses, new competitions and a finisher medal. In addition to the sporting competition, participants can look forward to an extensive supporting program. The run is organized by LV Limbach 2000 e.V. and is a popular event in the region.

name: Nienburger Spargellauf
description: The Nienburg Asparagus Run is a traditional race taking place on May 30, 2026, in Nienburg, offering various distances for children, teenagers, and adults. The routes are officially measured and follow flat, partly shaded circuits, starting and finishing at the Wesavi parking lot. In addition to individual and children’s races, there is a 10 km relay race, as well as company and club rankings. The event is known for its family-friendly atmosphere and attractive prizes for the top runners.

name: Turm zu Turm Lauf
description: The 21st Turm zu Turm Run on May 30, 2026, in Georgsmarienhütte offers runners a varied and scenic experience. The main 24-kilometer course connects the prominent Hermannsturm and Varusturm viewpoints and passes through forest sections with around 520 meters of elevation gain. There are also races for children, a fun run, a 10-kilometer scenic run, and a walking course. The event is a sporting highlight of the Osnabrück and Westphalia region, with suitable distances for all ages and ability levels.

name: Botaniczna Piątka Zielona Góra – edycja wiosenna 2026
description: Botaniczna Piątka Zielona Góra – Spring 2026 edition is a cross-country race held in the picturesque Botanical Garden of the University of Zielona Góra. The event is part of the Botaniczna Piątka race series, which has been promoting running and the beauty of natural routes in Greater Poland and other regions since 2014. The route in Zielona Góra consists of two loops, allowing participants to enjoy the charms of nature and a challenging yet attractive terrain profile. The organizers are running enthusiasts who emphasize the aesthetics and character of cross-country routes.

name: 8 Borowiacka Dycha
description: Borowiacka Dycha is an annual 10 km race held in the picturesque surroundings of the Tuchola Forest. The event attracts runners who enjoy being close to nature and competing on a moderately challenging course. The organizers, Stowarzyszenie Biegające Śliwice, ensure professional organization and a welcoming atmosphere for participants. The race is part of the Grand Prix Borów Tucholskich, highlighting its importance in the local running calendar.

name: Bieg Tropem Kaszubskiego Stolema
description: The Tropem Kaszubskiego Stolema Run is a 10 km road race taking place on May 30, 2026, in Żelkowo, Kashubia. It’s a great opportunity to test your fitness on a scenic course and prepare for race day with training plans tailored to different experience levels. The organizers encourage runners to use the training plans and expert support to prepare for the race as effectively as possible. The event is part of the TreningBiegacza.pl race calendar, a platform supporting runners across Poland.

name: XI Bieg Memoriałowy
description: The 11th Adam Lewandowski Memorial Run in Orchowo is an annual running event organized by the Orchowo Municipality. The run commemorates Adam Lewandowski and attracts runners from various age categories. The event takes place in Orchowo and offers an opportunity for sporting competition and bringing the local community together. The organizers warmly invite all running enthusiasts to take part.

name: XV Kwidzyński Bieg Papiernika
organizer: MM Kwidzyn sp. z o.o. oraz Fundacja Opiekuńcza MM Kwidzyn
description: The 15th Kwidzyn Paperworkers’ Run is an annual running event established in 2010 out of a passion for running and promoting physical activity for health and fun. The 10 km race runs through the center of Kwidzyn and brings together the local community and runners from all over Poland. The event accompanies Paperworkers’ Day, a celebration for MM Kwidzyn employees, and participation in the race and other attractions is free. It is organized by MM Kwidzyn sp. z o.o. and the MM Kwidzyn Care Foundation.

name: Straumemila 2027

tiers.label: tier_1

description: Straumemila Running Festival is an annual event offering challenging and scenic routes in the beautiful surroundings of Straume. The courses follow walking paths by Skogavatnet and Ebbesvikvatnet, through Sartorlunden park and Straume town centre, combining asphalt and trails. The festival emphasises community, fun and competition, with a wide range of events for children and adults. Events include the 10 km, 5 km and Barnemila, with officially measured courses approved by the Norwegian Athletics Federation.
course_highlights: The routes pass along Skogavatnet and Ebbesvikvatnet
A mix of walking paths and asphalt
The 10 km course consists of two figure-eight-shaped laps, passing through the spectator area five times
additional: Warm-up starts at 10:40. The 10 km and 5 km start together at 11:00. The prize ceremony starts at 12:15. The relay starts at 12:35. Barnemila starts at 13:40, with a group warm-up from 13:10. Barnemila is 2.3 km long and partly follows the same route as the 5 km and 10 km. A licence is required to participate; a one-day licence is available. There is an administration fee of NOK 25 per entry. Barnemila is free to enter before race day; otherwise, it costs NOK 100 plus fees. The event takes place at Idrettsvegen 50, 5353 Straume.

description: Grorudløpet is part of the Oslo Running Festival and offers a varied 12 km course that starts and finishes in Grorudparken. The race follows the Alna River and winds through Lillomarka’s enchanting trails, combining technical trails with gravel and asphalt. In 2027, the course will run in the opposite direction for a better experience, with trail running at the start and a downhill gravel section toward the finish. This race is suited to those looking for a scenic and challenging running experience in Oslo.
course_highlights: A varied 12 km course with trails, gravel and asphalt
Follows the Alna River and runs through Lillomarka
The course is reversed in 2027 for a better trail-running experience at the start
additional: Race bibs can be picked up from Löplabbet Oslo sentrum from 7 April. The same race bib is used throughout the series. The course will only be marked for the mass start. GPX files and course maps are available to download. A replacement race bib can be purchased for NOK 75 if yours is lost or damaged. You can run on your own from 21 to 30 May. The mass start is on Sunday 30 May 2027 at 11:00. The listed day-ticket prices are early-bird prices.

name: Jessheim Halvmaraton
description: Jessheim Half Marathon is a summer race offering both half marathon and 5 km distances, as well as a free children’s race for the youngest participants. The courses are flat and fast, run on asphalt around Jessheim, and start and finish at Jessheim Athletics Stadium. They are certified according to World Athletics criteria. The event is run by volunteers and supports sports for children and young people in Ullensaker/Kisa. It aims to provide an enjoyable experience for both recreational runners and competitive runners, with water stations and pacers for several finish times.
course_highlights: Flat and fast asphalt courses around Jessheim
Certified according to World Athletics criteria
Water stations on the half marathon course at 7 km, 10.5 km, 17 km and at the finish
additional: Children’s race for ages 0–12, approximately 600 metres, with free entry. Race numbers can be collected at Jessheim Ice and Multipurpose Hall on Saturday and Sunday. The half marathon has an early start at 10:00 for runners with an estimated finish time of over 3 hours. Pacers are available for several finish times in both the 5 km and half marathon. All distances finish at Jessheim Athletics Stadium. Distances: half marathon, 5 km, and a free children’s race of approximately 600 metres for children aged 0 to 12. The courses are stated to be certified according to World Athletics criteria. Proceeds go to sports for children and young people in Ullensaker/Kisa.

name: Risørløpet 2027
description: Risørløpet 2027 is organized by Risør idrettslag and is a trail race held at Kjempesteinsmyra in Risør. The race takes place on varied terrain and offers a wonderful nature experience for participants of all ages. The event is a tradition that brings together local and visiting runners for an enjoyable day of sport and community. The race starts on Sunday, May 30 at 11:00.
course_highlights: Trail race through varied scenery
The race takes place in the Kjempesteinsmyra area
A wonderful nature experience in Risør
additional: Organized by Risør idrettslag. The race starts at 11:00. No pricing or registration details were found on the website. No information about start waves, participant capacity, or late registration. Free 400-meter track race for children, with no ranking or timing. The children's race starts at 11:10, and registration takes place on arrival.

name: Vettisløpet

tiers.label: tier_2
tiers.description: 18-39 år og deretter 10 års klasser kr 250

description: Vettisløpet is a traditional race held on the last Sunday in May in the beautiful Utladalen valley, Øvre Årdal. The race offers a challenging and scenic course that attracts both competitive runners and recreational participants. It is a wonderful opportunity to experience the most beautiful race of spring amid spectacular scenery, with a joint start for the competitive categories and a separate start time for the recreational category.
course_highlights: The race takes place in scenic Utladalen, with varied terrain
Joint start for competitive categories at 13:00
Recreational category starts from 11:00 at Skåri
additional: Registration for the recreational category is at Skåri. The latest possible registration is at 12:30 on race day. Prizes are awarded for the fastest time in each competitive category, the fastest time for women and men, and a new course record. The race has recreational and competitive categories. The official website lists this year’s race as starting at 13:00.

name: Elsterlauf
organizer: SG Medizin Bad Liebenwerda e.V. und Lauf- und Walkingverein 05 Bad Liebenwerda e.V.
description: The Elsterlauf in Bad Liebenwerda is a traditional running and walking event, taking place for the 46th time on May 31, 2026. The event offers a variety of distances, including a marathon, half marathon, several walking and hiking routes, and children’s races. The course runs through the spa town of Bad Liebenwerda, with a family-friendly atmosphere and classifications for individual participants, teams, and companies. All participants receive a finisher’s medal and certificate, and awards are presented by age group. The event is organised by SG Medizin Bad Liebenwerda and Lauf- und Walkingverein 05 Bad Liebenwerda e.V.
course_highlights: A variety of distances: marathon, half marathon, 11 km, 5.7 km, 2 km, walking, and hiking
Start and finish at Roßmarkt in Bad Liebenwerda, near the primary school centre with changing rooms and showers
Guided 11 km hike and family-friendly races such as the Bambini and taster runs
additional: Late registration is available on May 30, 2026, from 12:00 to 15:00, and on May 31, 2026, from 07:00 to 09:30. Changing rooms and showers are available at the Bad Liebenwerda primary school centre; baggage storage is available from 7:00 to 14:00. The finish closes for all distances at 13:15. There is a company and club classification, with teams of three participants. Cyclists and hikers start without timing or classification. All participants receive a finisher’s medal and certificate. Results will be published online. Running event with online registration and various categories for runners, walkers, and families, including award ceremonies and finisher’s medals.

name: Urwaldlauf
description: The Urwaldlauf is a six-hour race in which participants can run as many laps as they like on a 1.85 km course through the forest near Saarbrücken within six hours. The start time is flexible from 10 a.m., and participants can enter individually or as part of a team. The course combines wide forest paths with idyllic singletrack trails and offers a challenging 46 metres of elevation gain per lap. The event places great emphasis on flexibility and fun, with an electronic lap counter and refreshments at the Urwaldscheune Neuhaus.
course_highlights: 1.85 km lap through the forest near Saarbrücken
46 metres of elevation gain per lap; more than 1,000 metres over marathon distance
A mix of wide forest paths and idyllic singletrack trails
additional: Bib pickup is available on site from 9 a.m. Flexible start time from 10 a.m.; the finish closes at 4 p.m. Electronic lap counter and refreshment station at the Urwaldscheune Neuhaus. The field is limited to 350 participants. Late registration is possible online or on site; the late-registration fee is payable on site. Team classification available; make sure the team name is spelled consistently. Six-hour race, 1.85 km lap, approximately 46 metres of elevation gain per lap, forest paths and singletrack trails, flexible start time from 10 a.m., finish at 4 p.m., online registration until the Friday before the event, participant limit of 350.

name: ADAC-Tine-Flugplatzlauf
description: The ADAC Tine Airfield Run in Husum is a unique running event held on an actual airfield. The event is for the whole family and offers a special atmosphere for runners of all ages. Experience sporting ambition and a sense of community in the beautiful surroundings of Husum on the North Sea.
course_highlights: Run on an actual airfield
Family-friendly event
Beautiful North Sea surroundings in Husum
additional: Run on the Husum airfield, distances from 500 m to 10 km, family and children’s races, charitable support

name: 10K Hamburg - Elbe
description: The 10K Hamburg - Elbe is an exciting 10-kilometer race held at attractive spots in Hamburg, the city on the Elbe. The course follows fully closed and secured out-and-back routes on paved and asphalt paths. The race is open to runners of all ability levels and is officially measured in accordance with international competition regulations. The event is part of a cup series spanning several 10K Hamburg races, with attractive prizes.

name: 16. Campuslauf Technische Universität Braunschweig
description: The 16th Campus Run of Technische Universität Braunschweig takes place on May 31, 2026, on the university campus. The run gives students and staff the opportunity to get active and spend time together being active on university grounds. The event is part of the university sports program and promotes a sense of community and the health of participants.

name: 32. Tangerlauf
description: The 32nd Tanger Run in Tangerhütte is a traditional race through the Tanger lowlands, organized by SV Germania Tangerhütte. The course follows the River Tanger through the scenic Altmark countryside, which is especially beautiful in spring. The race has a long history dating back to the GDR era and was revived after reunification. The organizers wish all participants good weather and an enjoyable race.

name: 40. Göttinger Frühjahrs-Volkslauf
description: The 40th Göttingen Sparkassen Volkslauf takes place on 31 May 2026 at Jahnstadion Göttingen and offers a varied running program for runners of all ability levels. The event combines tradition and community, inviting both experienced runners and recreational joggers to enjoy an active day of fun and exercise. The distances are 2 km, 5.4 km and 10.8 km; unfortunately, the half marathon is not taking place this year. The event emphasizes health, well-being and community in the region.

name: 5. Urwaldsteig-Ultratrail
description: The Urwaldsteig Ultratrail is a challenging ultratrail race covering approximately 66 km with around 2,000 metres of elevation gain around Lake Edersee. Starting in Waldeck, the route runs counterclockwise through varied natural landscapes, including dense forests, narrow paths, the Kahle Haardt nature reserve and Kellerwald-Edersee National Park. Runners can look forward to impressive views of the lake, historic sites such as Hünselburg, and varied trail sections rich in natural beauty and memorable experiences. The start and finish are at the Schloss Waldeck car park, and the race begins at 8 a.m.

name: 9. Hellmich Parkhauslauf
description: The HELLMICH Parking Garage Run in Lehrte is a unique running event held in the Lehrte parking garage. Participants run a course of about 1 km through the garage, with the inclines and views of the city creating a special running experience. There are three different races with varying numbers of laps, suitable for both children and adults. Each race is limited to 50 participants to ensure safety, and every finisher receives a medal as a keepsake.

name: Erfurtshäuser Lauf
description: The Erfurtshausen Run is a traditional running event in Amöneburg-Erfurtshausen that welcomes runners of all ages. It offers various races, including Bambini, youth, fun run, and main race, as well as walking/Nordic walking. The course is marked, every kilometer is indicated, and refreshment stations are set up along the route. At the finish, the organizer provides food and drink for participants. Times are recorded electronically, with stopwatches as a backup, and certificates can be issued on request.

name: Wandermarathon TSV Bollensen
description: The TSV Bollensen Hiking Marathon warmly invites all fans of recreational sports to enjoy a pleasant hike through the beautiful Solling Vogler forest. The routes are circuits starting and finishing at the TSV Bollensen sports center and run exclusively along forest trails. In 2022, the region was awarded the “Wanderbares Deutschland” quality designation. Refreshment stations along the route, as well as food and drinks at the finish, are provided. The event offers a family-friendly atmosphere and a relaxed get-together after the hike.

name: 13. Bieg 10km Szpot Swarzędz
description: The 13th Szpot Swarzędz 10 km Run is one of the most important 10 km running events in Wielkopolska, held since 2012. It attracts leading Polish athletes as well as runners from abroad, creating a unique atmosphere filled with sporting excitement and energy. The course is interesting and varied, with wooded sections and a route through the streets of Swarzędz. The event also includes a Family Run and a start for athletes using active wheelchairs. In 2026, the Szpot Swarzędz Half Marathon returns, adding even more excitement to the running festival.

name: Festiwal Biegowy Szpot
description: The Szpot Swarzędz Running Festival is a special running event taking place on May 31, 2026. The festival features three races: the 5th Szpot Swarzędz Half Marathon, the 13th Szpot Swarzędz 10K, and the 6th Szpot Swarzędz Family Run. The half-marathon course follows two loops around scenic Lake Swarzędz, while the 10K offers a dynamic route with forest sections and urban stretches. The event brings together sport, education, and charity. Participants can enjoy a well-stocked food zone, a partner expo, a post-race meal, massages, and a charity auction. The festival is open to everyone, including athletes using active wheelchairs and seniors over 70, who can take part free of charge.

name: 5. Półmaraton Szpot Swarzędz
description: The 5th Szpot Swarzędz Half Marathon is a special running event taking place on May 31, 2026, in Swarzędz. The course consists of two loops, covering a total distance of 21.097 km, and runs along a scenic route around Lake Swarzędz. The race combines sporting excitement with professional organization, a unique atmosphere, and support from spectators, creating an unforgettable celebration of running. The Szpot Swarzędz Running Festival also features 10 km races and a Family Run, making the event appealing to different age groups and ability levels.

name: Marceliński Bieg Wiosenny 2026
description: Marceliński Spring Run 2026 is a cross-country race organized in Poznań by running enthusiasts from the Biegi.Wlkp. group. The event takes place on scenic routes that highlight the beauty of the location. Since 2014, the organizers have focused on popularizing cross-country running in Greater Poland, offering participants a unique running experience surrounded by beautiful natural scenery.

name: Szybka Piątka 5K FAST RUN Kupienino 31.05.2026
description: Szybka Piątka 5K FAST RUN is a new running event taking place for the first time on May 31, 2026, in Kupienin near Świebodzin. The race offers a fast 5-kilometre distance, ideal for runners looking for a dynamic challenge. The event is organised for running enthusiasts who want to test their speed on a scenic course.

name: Bieg o Koronę Księżnej Dąbrówki
organizer: Gminny Ośrodek Sportu i Rekreacji w Dopiewie
description: The Run for the Crown of Princess Dąbrówka is the 15th-anniversary edition of a running event traditionally held on the last Sunday of May. The main 10 km race follows forest trails surrounded by greenery, offering pleasant conditions for running on soft ground. Nordic walking enthusiasts can take on a 7.5 km route, while the youngest participants can compete over shorter distances ranging from 200 to 1,000 metres. The start and finish are located at the edge of the Palędzie–Zakrzewo forest, on Parkowa Street in Dąbrówka. The event is family-friendly and inclusive, promoting physical activity among residents of the Dopiewo Municipality.

name: Rio de Janeiro Virtual Challange
description: Rio de Janeiro Virtual Challenge is a virtual challenge that takes you along a route through the vibrant streets and breathtaking landscapes of Rio de Janeiro, known as the Marvelous City. Participants can track their progress using a mobile app by logging different physical activities, which are automatically converted into distance covered. The challenge lets you choose your own pace and timeframe, and take part individually or as a team. In addition, for every milestone in the challenge, the organizers plant trees or prevent plastic bottles from reaching the ocean, supporting environmental protection.

name: XIV Kurdeszowa (Za)Dyszka
organizer: Gminny Ośrodek Sportu, Turystyki i Rekreacji w Kostrzynie
description: The 14th Kurdeszowa (Za)Dyszka in Kostrzyn is an annual race organized by the Municipal Sports, Tourism and Recreation Centre in Kostrzyn. The event offers 10 km and 5 km running races, as well as a 5 km Nordic Walking march, with overall, age-group, and municipality residents’ classifications. The start and finish are on Powstańców Wielkopolskich Street, by Primary School No. 2 in Kostrzyn. The organizer plans a prize draw for participants, and the race office is open for several hours before the start.

name: XXXIX Bieg Stolemów
organizer: Kaszubskie Stowarzyszenie Kultury Fizycznej Żukowo oraz Gminny Ośrodek Turystyki i Sportu w Gniewinie
description: The 39th Stolemów Run is an annual 10 km race held at the “Arena Mistrzów” Sports Stadium in Gniewino. The event also includes races for children and young people, a 5 km Nordic walking event, and a recreational run-walk. Participants can expect electronic timing, medals for everyone, and prizes for the top finishers. For those who want to take part virtually, a virtual race option is available from May 27 to June 4, 2026.

name: Amsterdam UMC Run
description: The Amsterdam UMC Run is a unique running event that takes participants through Amsterdam UMC hospital and the green surroundings of Amsterdam Zuidoost. Participants can choose from the 1.2 km Family Run, 5 km, 10 km, or the challenging hat trick, in which all distances are run separately. Alongside the sporting aspect, the event aims to raise money for research and improvements to patient care at Amsterdam UMC. It offers a fun day with music, food trucks, entertainment, and a kids’ corner, making it suitable for runners of all ages and levels.
course_highlights: Routes go right through Amsterdam UMC hospital
Start corrals for the 5 km and 10 km provide plenty of space on the course
Aid stations with water and fruit along the route
additional: Start corrals for the 5 km (Green and Blue) and 10 km, with groups of around 300 participants starting every 10 minutes. Race numbers will be ready for collection at the event site and will not be mailed. Employees and visitors can collect their race numbers earlier at the AMC site. A unique running shirt can be ordered, with part of the proceeds going to research. Aid stations with water and fruit along the route. First aid will be available. The course is closed to traffic. Registration is online; the event supports various medical research projects, including cancer and dementia research. The event is car-free and suitable for all ages.

name: Halve Marathon Veghel
location: Prins Willem Alexander Sportpark, Veghel, North Brabant, Netherlands
description: The Half Marathon Veghel is an annual running event held on the last weekend of May in Veghel. The course is a 7.09-kilometre loop that participants run three times, with the start and finish at Fit Functional. The event is intended both for recreational runners looking to run their first half marathon and for experienced runners aiming for a fast time. Safety and runner support are central, with first-aid facilities and aid stations along the route. The organiser, Fit Functional, is committed to offering a professional, well-organised event and encouraging sport and health in the region.
course_highlights: A 7.09 km course run three times, for a total of 21.1 km
Start and finish at Fit Functional, with an aid station and split-time recording
Route along footpaths and cycle paths in the countryside around Veghel
additional: First-aid facilities are available at the start and finish. Participants must obey traffic rules and follow the organiser’s instructions. Drink stations are located at Fit Functional. The event is planned for Prins Willem Alexander Sports Park; registration opens on 1 February 2026; a permit application for 2027 has been submitted.

name: Meppel City Run
distance_verbose: 12.9 km, 6.4 km, 3000 meter, 1500 meter, 1 km, 0.2 km
description: The Meppel City Run is a running event through Meppel’s historic city centre, with a choice of 4 or 8 English miles. The fully paved, traffic-free route passes beautiful places such as Wilhelminapark and several lively streets. Alongside the main distances, there are also a Kidsrun, G-Run and Frame-Run, making the event suitable for recreational runners, experienced athletes and athletes with disabilities. The start and finish are in the city centre, making for an atmospheric and sporty day for everyone.
course_highlights: Fully paved, traffic-free route over cobblestones
Start on Grote Oever and finish on Kromme Elleboog
Run through the historic city centre and past Wilhelminapark
additional: The 8-mile race consists of two laps of the 4-mile course, which is extra fun for spectators. All events start on Grote Oever, and the Kidsrun, Frame-Run and G-Run also finish there. There is a warm-up for the G-Run and Kidsrun. All children receive a medal after the event. There is a Business Run for teams of 3 to 5 participants. The course is certified by the Atletiek Unie. The event also includes activities such as warm-up sessions and an awards ceremony, and offers registration by email. The organisers cater to a broad audience, from young runners to experienced athletes.

name: Quintusloop
description: The Quintusloop is a running event in Hengelo where participants can choose between distances of 10 and 21 kilometres. The aim is to raise money for research into multiple sclerosis (MS), driven by a personal wish to offer hope to people living with the disease. The event is organised in support of the MS Research Foundation and highlights the importance of running together for a future with better treatments and more research.
course_highlights: Distances of 10 and 21 kilometres
Running for the cause of MS research
Held in Hengelo
additional: The Quintusloop is a fundraising event where participants run together to raise money for MS research, with a personal motivation to support a friend who has been diagnosed with MS. A newsletter is available to keep people up to date with activities. The website highlights the importance of research and hope for people with MS. The race supports MS research and awareness, with a route that includes both paved and unpaved roads.

name: Rotte Dam Loop
description: The Rotte Dam Loop is a social running and walking event in Rotterdam, where participants enjoy the beautiful surroundings along the Rotte river. There are four distances: a 1 km kids’ run, 5 km through Hoge Bergse Bos, and 10 km and 21 km along the Rotte from the dam to Outdoor Valley. The event is not timed, so everyone can enjoy the activity and atmosphere at their own pace. The race is known for its friendly, accessible character for runners and walkers of all levels.
course_highlights: 1 km kids’ run and 5 km through Hoge Bergse Bos
10 km and 21 km along the Rotte river
Start at the dam and finish at Outdoor Valley
additional: The race is not timed, and both running and walking are possible. There is a Rotte Dam Loop Festival at the finish. The 2026 event was sold out, and a waiting list was available. The event emphasizes enjoyment and togetherness, with a focus on accessibility for everyone. The anniversary edition in 2026 was a great success, and the organizers continue to focus on a friendly, social experience for all participants.

name: The Royal Ten

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: MUNT Hypotheken Business Run €270 per team (ex. btw)

description: The Royal Ten is The Hague’s most sociable running event, organised annually by The Hague Road Runners. The event offers various distances and races, including an officially measured 10-kilometre race that runs through Haagse Bos and past Huis ten Bosch Palace. The course is completely traffic-free and fast, with clear kilometre markers and a water station at 5 km. The organisers are committed to providing a safe and enjoyable running experience for all participants.
course_highlights: 10 km course officially measured and certified by the Atletiekunie
Course runs through Beatrixkwartier and Haagse Bos, and past Huis ten Bosch Palace
Completely traffic-free course with clear kilometre markers and a water station
additional: Race numbers can be collected on race day or on Saturday 30 May. Bag drop is available at the NH Hotel, but there are no changing rooms. A free first-aid station is available in the start/finish area. There is a water station at 5 km, with additional stations in warm weather. Minimum age: 12 for the 5 km and 14 for the 10 km. The organisers accept no liability, and refunds are not available if you are unable to participate. The event takes place on 30 May 2027 and offers various categories for runners of all levels.

name: Blodomloppet
organizer: Stora Tuna OK och Kvarnsvedens GOIF Friidrott

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: ANMÄLNINGSAVGIFT 1750kr Lag (3-5 deltagare, picknickkasse ingår) fr.o.m. 8 maj

description: Blodomloppet in Borlänge is a fun run that raises awareness of the life-saving importance of blood donation and welcomes everyone to walk, jog or run 5 km or 10 km. The event is open to both individual participants and teams. Teams consist of 3–5 people, who can take part in different distances. The event ends with a shared picnic and offers an inclusive, social atmosphere for participants of all ages and abilities. Lilla Blodomloppet is a shorter race of approximately 800 metres for children, held in the area around the event grounds. Blodomloppet is part of Sweden’s largest series of fun runs, focusing on health and blood donation.
course_highlights: The 5 km and 10 km running routes head north across Sportfältet and split at Storsvängen
The walking route has no finish arch and ends at the fruit and medal tables
Lilla Blodomloppet is approximately 800 metres long and takes place in the area around the event grounds
additional: You can register individually or as part of a team (3–5 participants). Team members can take part in different distances. Team members receive a picnic bag. Late registration for teams is not possible after 21 May, but individuals can register late until 28 May at 12:00. Late registration on race day is available between 15:45 and 17:45, with payment by Swish. Name, category or distance changes can be made by email no later than 21 May, or at bib collection on 26 May from 16:30 to 18:30. A basic kiosk is available at the event grounds; payment is by Swish only. Water stations are available along the course. Lilla Blodomloppet is approximately 800 m long and takes place in the area around the event grounds. Teams consist of 3–5 participants and can choose different distances or categories. A picnic bag is included with team registration. Blood donors receive a discount of SEK 40 per person. Registration prices and information for 2027 may be updated.

pipeline_log.message: New race date found on official site (https://blodomloppet.se/vara-lopp/borlange/): 2027-05-31 — "31 maj 2027" (was estimated 2027-05-27)

name: Sørdalskarusellen - SpareBank1 Kanthaugløpet
description: SpareBank1 Kanthaugenløpet is the second-to-last race in the Sørdalskarusellen spring season, starting and finishing at Birkebeineren Ski Stadium in Lillehammer. The race has a long tradition dating back to 1984 and offers a varied route of approximately 5.75 km, including asphalt, trails, grass-covered Olympic trails, and some challenging sections in Lyshaugen. Both a mass-start race and a virtual race are held, and the event attracts a large field of participants each year. The start is usually at 19:00, with a single mass-start wave.
course_highlights: The route is 5.75 km long, with varied surfaces: asphalt, trails, and grass-covered Olympic trails
The route passes through the floodlit trail, crosses bridges, and follows the canal with views of the Mesna River
Challenging sections in Lyshaugen include some forestry work and terrain that requires caution
additional: Registration closes at 18:00 on the day of the mass start. Race numbers can be collected at the tent by the red artwork from 17:45. There is a water station in the finish area and a toilet in Skistua. Lillehammer Red Cross Search and Rescue Corps is present in the finish area. Parking is available at the ski stadium, with the Apcoa flow payment system. A virtual race is also held, starting a few days before the mass start. Listed on 2 June 2027 in the Sørdalskarusellen race calendar. The registration window is listed as 29 May–1 June. The course route may vary from year to year.

name: Münsteraner Urban Run
location: Innenstadt Münster, Münster, North Rhine-Westphalia, Germany

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Startgeld beträgt 19,00 Euro inklusive hochwertigem Laufshirt

description: The 1KOMMA5° Urban Run on June 3, 2026, is a special run through Münster’s city centre, taking place for the third time. The approximately 5-kilometre course passes through several notable buildings, including the city administration, the LWL Museum of Art and Culture, and the youth church, as well as familiar landmarks such as Prinzipalmarkt and Domplatz. This is not a timed race, but a shared experience at a relaxed jogging pace with running guides. The event combines fun, culture, and exercise and is open to runners aged 16 and over. Participation is limited to 1,000 people, and the entry fee includes a high-quality running shirt.
course_highlights: Approximately 5-kilometre loop through the city centre, including several municipal buildings
Past historic landmarks such as Prinzipalmarkt, St. Lamberti Church, and Domplatz
Along the Promenade, Münster’s green belt in the heart of the city centre
additional: This is not a timed race and will be run in several groups with running guides. The minimum age is 16. There are no changing facilities at the start/finish area. The entry fee includes a high-quality running shirt, which will be distributed in the start area from 17:30. Participation is limited to 1,000 people. Registration filled up quickly, and the waiting list is also closed. The course passes through buildings and attractions in Münster. There are no changing facilities; bag storage is limited. The run is not timed, and the minimum age is 16.

name: Crosslauf Offene Kreismeisterschaften 2026
location: Sportplatz Rote Wiese, Wangelnstedt, Lower Saxony, Germany
description: The Open District Cross-Country Championships in Braunschweig are a traditional competition organized by NLV Kreis Braunschweig. The event takes place on February 7, 2026, at the Rote Wiese sports field and gives runners in various age groups the opportunity to compete in cross-country running. The event is open to children, youths, senior athletes, and masters, and promotes regional running in a varied cross-country setting.
course_highlights: Cross-country running at the Rote Wiese sports field in Braunschweig
A wide range of age groups, from children to masters
Traditional district championships with regional significance
additional: Online registration is open until February 1, 2026, at 11:59 p.m. The event offers a great opportunity to compete against other runners and improve your performance in a sporting setting.

name: Alpener Stadtlauf
description: The Alpen City Run takes place on Wednesday before Corpus Christi, June 3, 2026, and is a long-standing running event in the municipality of Alpen. The course follows a loop of around 2.5 kilometers through the heart of Alpen, starting and finishing at the Alpen Sports Center. The program caters to all ages and ability levels, with races ranging from the Bambini race to the 10-kilometer run. The event is known for its lively atmosphere and the support of spectators along the course.

name: Bergen Fjellmaraton
description: Bergen Fjellmaraton is a half marathon from Montana to Skansemyren in Bergen. The course starts with a challenging climb up to Ulriken, followed by rolling terrain across Vidden and on to Vareggen, where there is a drink station. From there, the course continues towards Rundemanen and down Blåmansveien, finishing via the floodlit trail past the upper Fløibanen station to the finish at Skansemyren. The race combines beautiful scenery with challenging terrain, and the route is available to download on ut.no and in Lommekjent apps.
course_highlights: A challenging climb over the first 3 km up to Ulriken
Rolling terrain across Vidden and Vareggen, with a drink station at Vikinghytten
Finish via the floodlit trail past the upper Fløibanen station to the finish at Skansemyren
additional: Race bibs can be collected at Vikinghallen on 2 and 3 June from 10:00 to 18:00, with collection also possible on race day (without the expo). Participants must follow the marked course. All participants receive a finisher's medal. Race bibs can be transferred to another participant until 28 May. The course is marked with signs, flags and course tape. Protecting the environment and the drinking water source is important during the race. Race bibs must be collected at Vikinghallen before or on race day, not at the start in Montana. The recreational class has two start waves, and the competitive class starts at 19:30. Registration for 2027 opens in early December.

name: Berliner Wasserbetriebe 5x5 km TEAM-Staffel
description: The Berliner Wasserbetriebe 5 x 5 km TEAM-Staffel is a unique relay race in Berlin’s Tiergarten, putting team spirit and shared experiences at the heart of the event. Five team members each run 5 km on a scenic course between the Victory Column and the Federal Chancellery. The event is ideal for anyone who wants to take on athletic challenges together and have fun, regardless of ability level. The exchange zone in the start-finish area is a lively gathering place full of motivation and emotion. After the race, all participants receive a special medal symbolizing team unity.

name: Volkslauf Wacker Frohnhausen
description: The Wacker Frohnhausen Volkslauf is a long-standing running event in Gladenbach-Frohnhausen, organized annually by SV Wacker Frohnhausen. The races run around Donnerberg and offer routes for different ability levels. The event is known for its family-friendly atmosphere and involvement of the local community. Participants can look forward to a well-organized event with varied routes.

name: III Ryszewkowy Bieg o Puchar Strażaka
Neveresting Hafjell
description: Neveresting Hafjell is a unique endurance challenge held on the ski slope in Hafjell on 4–5 June 2027. Participants hike or run up the slope, take the gondola back down, and repeat as many times as they can within the allotted time. Each lap covers 590 metres of elevation gain and 3.5 kilometres. The goal is to climb as many metres as possible, with the number of laps offering the chance to match famous mountain heights such as Galdhøpiggen, Elbrus and Mount Everest. The event is open to all ages and levels, with both individual and team competitions that encourage a sense of achievement and team spirit. It’s a festive event with race-number pickup, food stations and a social dinner for teams.
course_highlights: Ski slope with 590 metres of elevation gain per lap
3.5 kilometres per lap, with a gondola ride back down between laps
Opportunity to complete up to 27 laps over 36 hours
additional: Race-number pickup and the athletes’ meeting take place the evening before and early in the morning on race day. The 36-hour event starts Friday at 07:00 and runs until Saturday evening. On Saturday, there is also a 6-hour team competition starting at 10:00, in which teams of 4 work together to complete as many laps as possible. Food stations are available along the way, and teams are invited to a social dinner with a perpetual trophy presentation after the race. Discounted accommodation is offered to participants. Participants decide for themselves how many laps to complete and when to take breaks. A corporate and team competition for teams of four is also mentioned.

name: Borkener Citylauf
description: The Borken City Run is a traditional fun run that has been held annually in Borken’s city centre since 1987. The event offers races for all ages on a closed 2.5 km circuit through the city centre, the town park and across the market square. Starting and finishing at the market square, the City Run is a popular event that appeals to recreational runners and competitive athletes alike. It is organised by the Borken City Sports Association and several local clubs, and offers a family-friendly atmosphere with a range of age groups and awards.
course_highlights: Closed 2.5 km circuit through the city centre, town park and market square
Start and finish at Borken market square
A range of distances for children, young people and adults
additional: Late entries are accepted at the Tourist Information Centre in Borken on the day of the event from 14:00 until 30 minutes before the start of the respective race, for a fee of €2.00. Race packs are available from 14:00. Transponders can be returned after crossing the finish line for a €2.00 refund. Races for various age groups, online registration, on-site late registration available, special support for young runners with children acting as guides

name: 1. Westerwälder Backyard Ultra
description: The Westerwälder Backyard Ultra 2026 is a unique ultramarathon held in Höchstenbach in the Westerwald (Rhineland-Palatinate). Participants run a marked 6.706 km loop with 71 metres of elevation gain per lap, taking in forest, woodland and meadow paths. The event is known for its family-friendly atmosphere, electronic lap counting, refreshments in the start/finish area, and a medal for everyone who completes at least one lap. Part of the entry fee is also donated to local youth work and a tree-planting project.

name: Heider Abend-Stadtlauf
description: The Heider Evening City Run is a long-standing race in Heide, organized by MTV von 1860 e.V. Heide. The event gives runners of various ability levels the opportunity to compete on an attractive route through the city. The race is known for its welcoming atmosphere and the support of the local sports club. The course is well marked and offers a varied running experience in the beautiful surroundings of Heide.

name: Saalfelder Bambini-Schloßparklauf
organizer: Saalfelder Leichtathletik-Verein e.V. und Thüringer Leichtathletik Verband e.V.
description: The Saalfeld Bambini Castle Park Run is a traditional children’s race taking place on June 5, 2026, from 5:00 p.m. in the castle park in Saalfeld. The event is for children born between 2017 and 2023, who run one or two laps depending on their age. Organized by Saalfelder Leichtathletik-Verein e.V., the race offers a child-friendly atmosphere for the youngest runners. Registration is available online, at the start, or by phone.

name: Spargellauf
description: The WERNER Asparagus Run in Deinste is a 5.5 km relay race held annually, celebrating its 20th anniversary in 2026. Teams of five run together through the asparagus fields, using an asparagus spear as the baton. The race is suitable for all fitness levels, from beginners to professionals, and the focus is on fun, as the winning team is selected by drawing lots. In addition to the race, there is a food mile featuring regional specialties and a family program with a bouncy castle and other attractions. A special race shirt will be offered for the anniversary, and a big after-show party will take place.

name: Stapelmoorer Run-Fun-Loop
description: The Stapelmoorer Run Fun Loop is a 10 km DLV-measured race that starts and finishes at the Teutonia Stapelmoor sports field. The course runs through the scenic surroundings of Stapelmoor, with sections along farm tracks, school routes, and village streets. The event is part of the Teutonia Stapelmoor running community and offers runners a well-organized, varied course in a friendly atmosphere.

name: Warnemünder Stapellauf
description: The Warnemünder Stapellauf is a small running event held in June in Rostock, Mecklenburg-Western Pomerania, Germany. It offers short distances of 555 meters and 9.3 kilometers, ideal for runners looking for a straightforward race experience. The courses have local nautical names that reflect Warnemünde’s coastal identity, including the 5 Seemeilen-Lauf (9 km) and the 3 Seemeilen-Lauf (6 km). Results are managed via my.race|result, and the event is listed in the laufen.de calendar.

name: Victorialoppet 2026
description: Victorialoppet is a traditional running festival in Borgholm, held annually on July 15. The event offers several distances for all ages and levels, from Mini for the youngest runners to the 9 km main race. The course is fast and easy to run, with beautiful coastal views and an enthusiastic crowd. The event has a long history, dating back to its first edition in 1981, and donates part of its surplus to Crown Princess Victoria’s Fund.
course_highlights: Fast and easy-to-run course
Beautiful coastal views
Live music at several locations along the course
additional: Race bibs can be collected on race day from 10:00 to 18:00 at Borgholm Sports Hall. Changing rooms and showers are available for men and boys at Borgholm Sports Hall, and for women and girls at Viktoriaskolan’s gymnasium. Water is provided along the 9 km course, and there is live music at several locations. Prizes are awarded in different categories, and participants receive a medal or commemorative plaque, depending on the race. Most races use disposable timing chips; timing is optional for Victoriajoggen and the para-sport categories.

name: Osterøy på tvers 2027
organizer: Osterøy IL, Mjøsdalen IL, Fotlandsvåg IL og Bruvik IL
description: Osterøy på tvers is an annual running event from Bruvik to Hosanger on Osterøy. The race is organised in collaboration between several local sports clubs and offers a great opportunity to experience the island’s varied nature and terrain. Participants can choose between the competitive and recreational classes, and the race attracts both recreational and more experienced runners. The event has a long tradition and is well established in the local community.
course_highlights: The race crosses Osterøy from Bruvik to Hosanger
Varied terrain with both asphalt and gravel
Scenic surroundings on the island
additional: The race has both a competitive class and a recreational class. Results from previous years are published on eqtiming.com. The course map is available via Strava. The event is organised in collaboration between Osterøy IL, Mjøsdalen IL, Fotlandsvåg IL and Bruvik IL. The organiser’s website has a link to the registered participants and participant overview.

name: Hagebyløpet
location: Tennisbanen i Bergsalléen, Ullevål, Oslo, Norway

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Deltakeravgift: 200 kr. for voksne over 20 år

description: Hagebyløpet is an inclusive running festival in the heart of Ullevål, Oslo, with races for all ages and levels. The event offers three distances: a 500-meter children’s race in Halsparken, the 1609-meter Engelskmila, which is open to everyone, and a timed 5 km race for young people and adults. The courses run across grass, trails, and low-traffic streets. It’s a festive event with a great atmosphere, entertainment, and activities for the whole family. All participants receive a medal, and refreshments and various activities are available at Damplassen.
course_highlights: 500 m children’s race on grass in Halsparken, with a few hills
Engelskmila: 1609 m on trails and low-traffic streets, open to everyone
Timed 5 km race on trails and low-traffic streets with sidewalks
additional: All participants receive a medal. Hot dogs, cake, waffles, and drinks will be served at Damplassen. Entertainment and activities include a bouncy castle, a balloon clown, face painting, and a shot-speed radar. There will be stands from event partners. Public transport: Metro and bus 23 to Ullevål stadion, bus 25 to Eventyrveien, and trams 17 and 18 to John Colletts plass. Toilets are available by the start area and at the Seniorsenteret at Damplassen. The start and finish are by the tennis court in Bergsalléen. Food and drinks can be purchased at Damplass, where there will also be activities and stands. The 5 km race offers team registration for teams of at least four participants.

name: Fjellmaraton
description: The Beitostølen Mountain Marathon is a long-standing mountain race, held for the 46th time in 2027. The courses follow the National Tourist Route across Valdresflye, with spectacular views of Jotunheimen, and offer a unique nature experience in the mountains. The event brings together recreational and competitive runners of all ages for a celebration featuring several distances and activities. All finishers receive a medal, and prizes are awarded to the best in each category. The race starts at Sporten Beitostølen, with buses taking participants to the start areas for the longer distances.
course_highlights: The course follows the National Tourist Route across Valdresflye, with views of Jotunheimen
Start at Sporten Beitostølen, with transport to the start area at 960 m above sea level
Varied terrain with mountain scenery and fast asphalt
additional: All finishers receive a medal. Podium prizes for the top three in each category can be collected at Sporten Beitostølen. Course winners receive a free hotel stay at the following year's Fjellmaraton. There are drink stations and medical staff along the route. Baggage storage is provided by a baggage truck that leaves 15 minutes before the start. Toilets are available at the start and finish, as well as along the route. Bus transport to the start for the longer distances begins early from central Beitostølen. The race features a marathon, half marathon, Fjellbukken and Miniton. The 2027 weekend programme has not yet been published.

name: Bystrandløpet Bergen3000
location: Amalie Skram videregående skole, Bergen, Norway
description: Bystrandløpet Bergen3000 is a fast 3,000-metre race that takes place around Bergen’s upcoming city beach. The course follows walking and cycling paths around Store Lungegårdsvannet and is suitable for all levels, from children to elite athletes and people with reduced physical function. The event is family-friendly, with professional timing, medals for children and an awards ceremony. Organised by Sædalen IL, the race features a flat, fast course that is perfect for testing your fitness or setting personal records.
course_highlights: The course follows walking and cycling paths around Store Lungegårdsvannet
Flat, fast course, ideal for setting records and recreational running
AIMS-approved 3,000 metres off the track, with timing at several intermediate points
additional: Starts are staggered at one-minute intervals, with heats of 10–15 runners based on expected finish time. There are children’s races, para races, recreational races, a relay and elite classes, each with separate start times. Results are published on the website, and finish times are sent by SMS. The event includes entertainment, sales stalls, a kiosk and an awards ceremony. Participants are encouraged to join the Bystrandløpet X Torshov running group. The race is inclusive of everyone, including people with reduced physical function. A 300-metre children’s race, BERGEN300, is offered. Timing is provided by EQ Timing, and 3,000-metre runners start in groups based on their expected finish times. Children receive medals, and prizes are awarded for podium places.

name: Sommerløpet
description: Sommerløpet is Southern Norway’s largest running festival, held in Kristiansand with the start and finish at Øvre Torv. The event offers distances for everyone, from a children’s race to a half marathon, and welcomes participants of all ages and fitness levels. The courses pass through some of the city’s most attractive areas, including cultural venues, the city beach and historic Posebyen, creating a festive atmosphere with plenty of participants and spectators. Pacers are available for several distances, and there are well-stocked water stations along the way, making it an inclusive and motivating experience for everyone.
course_highlights: Start and finish at Øvre Torv in central Kristiansand
The course passes Kilden Performing Arts Centre, Kunstsilo, Kanalbyen, Odderøya and the city beach
Water stations by the pedestrian bridge over the Otra and in the finish area
additional: Pacers carrying balloons are available for various finish times in the 3 km, 5 km, 10 km and half marathon. Race bibs can be collected at Løplabbet and Clarion Ernst Hotel. T-shirts can be purchased during registration and collected at the hotel. Maximum of 5,000 participants in total; some distances may sell out. Companions can run for free using a code. The Red Cross provides first aid in the finish area. Distances include the Children’s Race (600 m), 3 km, 5 km, 10 km and half marathon (21 km).

name: Byløpet

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Priser tom 4. april 2027 (50 kr billigere før 5. april)

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Alle barn 0-10 år kan delta gratis

description: Byløpet is Grenland’s largest city race and half marathon, held in central Skien, starting by Arkaden. The 5 km, 10 km and 21 km courses run through scenic surroundings around Hjellevannet and offer a varied paved route with both hills and beautiful viewpoints. The event is open to everyone, from professional runners to families and school classes, and also includes a free children’s race for children up to 10 years old. Byløpet emphasizes the joy of running and public health, and provides accessibility for para-athletes. Race numbers are collected outside Sport 1, and there is plenty of nearby parking.
course_highlights: The course runs along the shore of Hjellevannet, with views of Skien city and Bakkestranda
Paved surface with challenging hills, including after the Falkum River and up towards Klosterøya
Water stations at Herkules and in the pedestrian street, as well as refreshments at the finish
additional: Start times: Half marathon at 11:00, 5 km at 13:00, 10 km at 13:30, Ibsen’s Children’s Race at 10:30. Race numbers are collected outside Sport 1. Free parking at Bygarasjen on race day. Accessibility for para-athletes with a guide or bicycle. Photos are taken during the race and may be published with consent. Ibsen’s Children’s Race is free for children aged 0 to 10. All participants receive a medal. Registration is through EQ Timing.

name: Oppegårdmila
location: Oppegård IL Clubhouse and Stadium, Oppegård, Norway
description: Oppegårdmila is an annual race organised by Oppegård IL, offering distances of 500 metres, 2 km, 5 km and 10 km. The event features varied courses, including the Installatørrunden and The Well route, and is suitable for children, young people and adults. It has a friendly atmosphere, with a warm-up at the stadium, race-number collection at the clubhouse and awards for different age groups. After the race, participants over 18 can enjoy free entry to The Well, providing a pleasant end to the day.
course_highlights: Micromila 500 m course for the youngest participants
Minimila 2 km course
Installatørrunden 5 km and The Well 10 km course (5 km x 2)
additional: Race numbers can be collected at the clubhouse on Friday, 5 June, from 19:00 to 19:30 and on race day from 09:00 to 11:30. There is a warm-up at the stadium before the start. Awards are given to the top three women and men, as well as to the 1st, 2nd and 3rd place girls and boys in the 12–15 and 16–19 age groups. All participants receive a participation prize. Participants over 18 can enter The Well for free after the race, but must sign up for this by Thursday, 4 June, at 12:00. Previous editions have offered the option to run or walk, with timing and a medal at the finish. Details for 2027 have not been confirmed by the sources.

name: Skredløpet
description: Skredløpet is a trail race that started in 2007 and has grown into a popular annual event with around 370 participants. The race is 8.5 km long with 444 metres of elevation gain, and follows a scenic route from the avalanche barrier at Aga via Svartetjødn, Rogdatjødn and Rogdo, up to Kvestadstølane, Måkestadstølane and Herseter, before descending to the finish at Reisæter. The race is suitable for anyone who enjoys walking or running in nature, and includes adult competition classes, a short-legged race for children and a recreational class for those who want to enjoy nature at their own pace. Activities and social events are also held during Skredløpshelga, including an activity day and dancing.
course_highlights: 8.5 km course with 444 metres of elevation gain
Starts at the avalanche barrier at Aga and passes through scenic areas such as Svartetjødn and Rogdo
Highest point at Herseter, with great views, before descending to the finish at Reisæter
additional: The Kortbeintløpet has a bus from the car park at Aga to the start area at Rogdo at 12:00, and a return bus from Reisæter after the event. The recreational class can walk the course at their own pace, with a nature trail along the way. Freshly made waffles, coffee and squash are served at Rogdo and Reisæter. A team competition is held, with a minimum of 5 and a maximum of 10 participants per team. All participants in the Kortbeintløpet receive a participation prize, and prizes are drawn among the children. Participation earns 500 extra exercise points in the Solnuttrimmen app. The Kortbeintløpet is about 5 km and is for ages 7–15. It has not been confirmed that the stated details for the 2026 edition apply to the date 5 June 2027.

name: Graabeinløpet

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Påmelding koster kr. 300,- for både 10km og 5km.

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Påmelding koster kr. 300,- for både 10km og 5km.

tiers.label: tier_2
tiers.description: Prisen for 10km økes med 100,- til 400,- 14 dager før løpsdagen.

description: Graabeinløpet is a family-friendly race held at Sletta athletics track in Sætre. The event offers 5 km and 10 km distances, as well as a free children’s race, and is suitable for children and adults of all ages. The courses are measured and approved by the Norwegian Athletics Association, and run along both gravel and paved roads in scenic surroundings. All participants receive a medal, and prizes are awarded to class winners and the fastest boys and girls under 13. The event also has a kiosk, toilets, and medical personnel on site for a safe and enjoyable race experience.
course_highlights: The course runs along gravel and paved roads through central Sætre and the Chemring Nobel factory area
Start and finish at Sletta athletics track, with one 5 km lap and two laps for the 10 km
The course is measured and approved by the Norwegian Athletics Association
additional: The children’s race starts at 11:30, the 10 km starts at 13:00, and the 5 km starts at 13:25. There is a kiosk and indoor toilets at the stadium. The Red Cross is on site with medical personnel. An announcer makes announcements before the start, and course marshals are stationed along the entire route. Parking is available about 150 metres from the start area, with space for more than 100 cars. All participants receive a medal, and prizes are awarded to class winners in classes with at least 3 participants. The children’s race is free, and all participants receive a medal. The 2027 date has not yet been confirmed; the organizers say it will be set after summer 2026.

name: Skurdalen Trail 2027
description: Skurdalen Trail is a trail race in scenic surroundings near Fagerli Leirskole in Skurdalen. The course offers challenging mountain terrain with spectacular views of Hallingskarvet and Hardangervidda, including the well-known Hovdetrappa. The event offers distances for the whole family, from a fun Kids Trail to a challenging 18 km course with demanding trails and mountain scenery. After the race, participants can enjoy a social gathering with a barbecue buffet, sauna and concert, making it a complete experience for runners and spectators alike.
course_highlights: The course passes via Hovdetrappa, with great views of Hallingskarvet and Hardangervidda
Trail running in challenging mountain terrain with bogs, climbs and mountain farms
Shared start and finish at Fagerli Leirskole, followed by a social get-together and After Trail
