description: The Wiesengrundlauf in Haselbachtal is a regional running event held every year on the Friday evening after the summer solstice. The municipality of Haselbachtal invites runners of all ages to take part in distances ranging from 600 m to 11.6 km. The event is part of the Sachsen Energie Läufer-Cup and offers a family-friendly atmosphere, with awards for overall and age-group winners. The start and finish are at the “Wiesengrund” sports field in Bischheim. The 2025 premiere was a great success, with numerous participants and a varied supporting programme.

name: Osterrönfelder Moorlauf
description: The Osterrönfeld Moor Run takes place on June 26, 2026, in Osterrönfeld and offers runners of all ages a varied running experience. The event includes a 1.17-kilometer children’s run, a 5-kilometer fun run, and the 10-kilometer Moor Run. The course starts at the sports field on Aukamp Street and leads through the scenic moorland. Timing is handled using transponders, and participants receive certificates, medals, and trophies. The event is family-friendly and offers showers and on-site parking.

name: GDYNIA ULTRA WAY
description: Gdynia Ultra Way is a mountain race by the sea, taking place on June 26–27, 2026, in Gdynia and the surrounding Kashubian region. Participants can choose from five distances, ranging from 14 km to 160 km, with varied elevation gain and scenic routes. The start and finish are at different locations, and the organizer provides transport to the start of the longest distance. It is a unique opportunity to take on a challenging course and enjoy the beauty of the coastal landscape.
course_highlights: 160 km distance with +/- 2,502 m of elevation gain, starting in Puck at 10:00
100 km distance with +/- 2,267 m of elevation gain, starting in Gdynia at 21:00
Routes pass through Kashubia and coastal areas, with checkpoints and time limits
additional: For the start of the longest distance (160 km), participants are transported by coach from outside the Gdynia Sports Center – National Rugby Stadium (paid transport). The time limit for the 160 km distance is 31 hours. The course has checkpoints with time limits and drop bags. The event includes both summer and winter editions, with routes passing through different towns in the region and offering unforgettable experiences for runners of all ability levels.

name: Botaniczna Piątka Poznań – edycja nocna 2026
description: Botaniczna Piątka Poznań – Night Edition 2026 is a cross-country race held in the picturesque Dendrological Garden of the Poznań University of Life Sciences. The event is part of a series of races organized since 2014 by a group of enthusiasts who focus on the beauty of the courses and promoting running. After the race, participants will receive unique medals, different from those awarded at the spring edition, making them worth collecting. It’s a special opportunity to run in beautiful surroundings and enjoy the atmosphere of the night.

name: Biegaj z Duchami
description: Run with Ghosts is a unique night trail run taking place on June 26, 2026, in Leśniów. Participants will take on two courses, 15 km and 9 km long, full of dark corners and surprises that create a one-of-a-kind atmosphere filled with thrills. Runners are encouraged to dress up as spectres, ghosts, and other spooky characters, adding magic and atmosphere to the event. It is not just a race, but also a test of endurance and courage in the dark, where participants face their own weaknesses and mysterious figures along the course.

name: Kustmaran (Kristianopel)
location: Kristianopel, Karlskrona Municipality, Blekinge County, Sweden
description: Kustmaran and Kristianopel Runt is a running festival for the whole family, with distances from 0.9 km to the marathon (42.2 km). The race takes place amid the idyllic summer scenery of Kristianopel and offers opportunities to enjoy running and set personal records. Team Blekinge provides enthusiastic support and cheerful encouragement along the course. Make a day of it with some relaxing time in the picturesque town, which has swimming spots, restaurants and cafés. In 2027, the race will also host the Swedish Veteran Championships in the marathon.
course_highlights: Distances from 0.9 km to 42.2 km, including the marathon and half marathon
Courses through idyllic summer scenery around Kristianopel
Children’s races and Sommarlunken, a 4 km untimed event
additional: Late registration is available on race day from 08:00, on a first-come, first-served basis. Standard registration can be paid for by card or Swish; late registration can be paid for by Swish or cash. Distances have assigned bib number series and colour codes, but late registrants may receive a different colour code. Sommarlunken is an untimed 4 km course with no medal; prizes are awarded by draw. Kristianopel offers swimming spots, restaurants, cafés and accommodation for participants and their companions. The Swedish Veteran Championships in the marathon will be held in conjunction with the race in 2027. Registration opens in January 2027; late registration on race day is available from 08:00, subject to availability. Electronic timing is provided by Racetimer.

name: Kalmar Malkars 21 km
description: Kalmar Malkars 21 km is a half marathon offering a fast, single-lap course through many of Kalmar’s beautiful surroundings. Runners pass, among other places, the Tegelviken allotment area, Stensö fishing harbour, Kalmarsund Park with Kalmar Castle in the foreground, and areas around Ängöleden and Skälby. The race is open to both men and women and is known for many runners setting personal records here. There is also a 5 km fun run, Malkars Femman, open to everyone, whether they walk, run or roll. All finishers receive a medal.
course_highlights: Single-lap course through Kalmar’s beautiful surroundings
Passes Kalmarsund Park with Kalmar Castle in the foreground
Refreshment stations at 5 km, 10 km, 15 km, 18 km and the finish
additional: Race bibs can be collected at Kalmar Malkars Västra, Torsåsgatan, on Friday, June 26, from 15:00 to 17:00 and Saturday, June 27, from 12:00 to 15:00. Late registration is possible until June 25 and then at race-bib collection. Everyone who registers for the 21.1 km race by June 20 receives a shirt with the Kalmar Malkars logo at race-bib collection. ICA MAXI provides a drink, fruit and a piece of chocolate after the race. Timing and prize-giving are provided for the men’s and women’s categories. All finishers receive a medal. For 2026, the start is listed as 15:00. Refreshment stations are located after 5, 10, 15 and 18 km, and at the finish. A shirt is included for half-marathon runners who register by the final ordinary registration date. Prices and practical details for 2027 have not been confirmed.

name: Jordgubbslunken
description: Jordgubbslunken is a popular fun run held every year on the first Saturday after Midsummer in Rudskoga. Participants can choose between 6 km and 10 km on winding village roads through a beautiful historic rural landscape, with gravel and grass surfaces. Children can take part in Minilunken, a 500-metre race. The event welcomes everyone from competitive recreational runners to families looking to enjoy a pleasant walk. All participants receive a litre of strawberries at the finish and have a chance to win great prizes.
course_highlights: 6 km loop on gravel roads
10 km loop on gravel roads and well-mown grass
Beautiful winding village roads through the historic rural landscape
additional: Start and finish at Grunnebacka School. Categories for men, women and children. All participants receive a litre of strawberries at the finish. A generous prize table is offered, and a top prize is drawn using the race number. Start and finish at Grunnebacka School. All finishers receive strawberries and a medal; the top prize is drawn using the race number. Prices shown are from previous events and may change for 2027.

name: Silverleden Ultra 100 Miles
location: Silvergruvan, Hällefors Municipality, Örebro County, Sweden
description: Silverleden Ultra is a challenging ultramarathon in Bergslagen, with several distances ranging from 9 km to 100 miles. The races follow the well-marked Silverleden, a hiking trail with hilly terrain and beautiful views. Silverleden Ultra 100M is known as one of Sweden’s toughest 100-mile races, with a high DNF rate, while the shorter distances offer tough but accessible challenges for different runners. The event includes transport to the start for some distances and nearby accommodation options. The race is marked by a love of running and a strong sense of community in a scenic setting.
course_highlights: Hilly, trail-filled terrain with steep climbs
Fantastic views from the hilltops along the trail
Well-marked hiking trail with bridges over marshes and waterways
additional: Bus transport is included in the entry fee for the 33 km and 100-mile races, departing at 13:00 on Friday for 100M and 11:30 on Saturday for 33K. Children and young people can take part in the 9 km race for free when accompanied by a registered adult. A limited number of caravan and motorhome pitches are available at the start and finish; book by email. To have a name and club/town printed on the race bib, register by 31 May. Silverleden Ultra’s program includes distances of 9 km, 33 km, 64 km and 100 miles. The official website lists the race weekend as 2–3 July 2027, which does not match the stated date of 26 June.

name: Kristianopel Runt 10 km
location: Kristianopel, Karlskrona Municipality, Blekinge County, Sweden
description: Kristianopel Runt is part of the running festival in Kristianopel, organised by Team Blekinge LF. The event offers several distances, from a children’s race to a marathon, with 10 km being a popular distance. The courses pass through idyllic summer scenery, with enthusiastic support and cheers from the race marshals. Participants can combine running with relaxing in picturesque Kristianopel, which offers swimming, restaurants and cafés. This year’s event also includes the Swedish Veterans’ Marathon Championships, adding to the competitive excitement.
course_highlights: Running through idyllic summer scenery on the east coast
Several distances from 0.9 km to 42.2 km, including the 10 km Kristianopel Runt
Courses with colour-coded number series and family-friendly races
additional: Late registration is available on race day from 08:00, on a first-come, first-served basis. Payment for regular registration can be made by card or Swish; late registration can be paid for by Swish or cash. Number series and colour codes are used for the different distances. Kristianopel offers swimming, restaurants, cafés and accommodation for participants and their companions. The organiser’s website lists the 10 km start time as 11:00 and says that electronic timing is provided by Racetimer. It also states that the 2027 race will take place on 3 July, which differs from the date in the race metadata.

name: Ottaløpet
description: Ottaløpet is a local recreational race held in the centre of Otta in Gudbrandsdalen. The event offers 10 km, 5 km, an untimed 5 km recreational run, and a 10 km relay, with the start and finish in the park in central Otta. The event has a friendly atmosphere, with prizes for the top three finishers in the 5 km and 10 km, as well as class winners in the 10 km, and a challenge trophy for the male and female 10 km winners. There is also a children’s race for children aged 1 to 12, as well as a company competition to find the fittest company in Nord-Gudbrandsdalen. Ottaløpet has a long history: it began in 1993 and was revived in 2021 with great local enthusiasm.
course_highlights: The course runs mainly on asphalt and gravel
Start and finish in the park in central Otta
The 10 km runners complete two laps of a 5 km course that includes a tartan running track and a riverside promenade
additional: There is a group warm-up in the park led by instructors from Spenst Otta. The relay can be divided into up to five legs. The children’s race is free, and every child receives a prize. The company competition awards a challenge trophy to the company with the most participants finishing. The course is clearly marked, and marshals ensure safety during the race. The 5 km course is one lap, while the 10 km is run over two laps. The relay can be divided into up to five legs of distances chosen by the team. The children’s race is free, and a group warm-up is offered in the park.

name: Ecotrail Bergen
description: EcoTrail Bergen is an environmentally conscious trail race offering four distances through beautiful scenery with spectacular views of the fjord and city. The courses range from 27 km to 91 km and feature challenging terrain, including trails, boggy sections, mountains and cultural landscapes. The race is suitable for both beginners and experienced runners looking to enjoy a sense of achievement and community in scenic surroundings. The event emphasizes the environment and sustainability, and participants receive, among other things, merino wool race shirts from Devold.
course_highlights: Varied terrain with trails, boggy sections and bare rock
Spectacular views of the fjord, city and cultural landscapes
Cultural heritage sites and historic areas along the course
additional: Aid stations provide water, sports drinks, salty and sweet snacks, but no hot food. Mandatory equipment includes a cup or soft flask, an emergency blanket, a mobile phone and a bank card/ID. There are cut-off times along the way on the longer distances. Bib pickup takes place before the race, including at Intersport at Thon Senter Bergen. The organizer states that the courses have drink and food stations. For the 27 km, a cup or soft flask, mobile phone and bank card or ID card are listed as mandatory equipment.

name: Besenbinder Lauf - Rund um Hainrode
description: The 1st Besenbinder Run – Around Hainrode is a running event in the southern Harz, organized by ASV 1902 Sangerhausen. The event takes place on 27 June 2026 in Hainrode and offers runners of various age groups and ability levels the opportunity to take part in a sporting competition. The course runs around Hainrode and promises varied natural surroundings. The event is open to children, young people, adults and masters.
course_highlights: Run around Hainrode in the southern Harz
Event in a natural setting
Suitable for a range of age groups and ability levels
additional: Registration is open until 24 June 2026; the venue is Hainröder Hauptstraße 60A, Hainrode; no specific terrain details are available.

name: Remmers-Hasetal-Marathon
description: The Remmers-Hasetal-Marathon in Löningen is an established running event in northern Germany, taking place for the 24th time on 27 June 2026. The flat, scenic course is a loop through the Hasetal valley, half of it on the Hasetal cycling and walking trail, and is officially measured by the DLV and eligible for the rankings list. In addition to the marathon, the event offers a half marathon, marathon relay, corporate relay, Nordic walking, walking and student races. The event is known for its great atmosphere, support from spectators and volunteers, and the Marathon Night afterwards, featuring a live band on the market square.
course_highlights: Flat course through the Hasetal valley with scenic surroundings
Loop course with 2 laps for the marathon, half of it on the Hasetal cycling and walking trail
Start and finish at Löningen market square, followed by the Marathon Night party
additional: Start and finish at Löningen market square, with information and sales stands as well as an event stage. The course passes through the Werwer Fuhren forest and varied Geest landscapes. There is a Marathon Night party in the evening with a TOP-40 live band. The Bambini run starts separately from the Gelbrink car park. Refreshments are organised by the St. Vitus Löningen altar servers. The event is certified as a “Three-Star Run.” It also includes the charity initiative “Laufend helfen in Löningen,” a marathon brochure, and is usually held in June.

name: Glückstädter City-Lauf
description: The Glückstadt City Run warmly welcomes runners of all ages to experience the picturesque town of Glückstadt. The event offers various distances from 250 m to 10 km, running through the beautiful town centre and along the harbour. Participation is at your own risk. Age-group rankings are provided, with trophies for the top runners in the 5 km and 10 km races. Race materials can be collected on race day from 9:00 a.m., and late entries are possible until 60 minutes before the respective race.
course_highlights: Courses through the picturesque town centre of Glückstadt
Races along the harbour head and past the Legends Park
A range of distances from 250 m to 10 km for all age groups
additional: Race materials can be collected at the harbour head on race day from 9:00 a.m. Late entries are possible until 60 minutes before the respective race, with a late-entry fee of €5. Changing facilities and tents are available; showers are available at Fortunabad. For safety reasons, headphones may not be worn and animals or jogging strollers may not be brought along during the race. The event offers shower and changing facilities, safety and data protection provisions, as well as medals and trophies for the winners.

name: Isselhorster Nacht
description: The Isselhorster Nacht is a traditional running event in Gütersloh-Isselhorst, taking place for the 26th time on June 27, 2026. It offers races for different age groups and ability levels, including a Bambini run, Schoolrunning, a fun run, a corporate run, speed skating and the main race. The event combines sporting commitment with social engagement by supporting the German Stroke Foundation. A special preparation programme, “Fit in 100 Days,” motivates and accompanies participants on their way to the event. The races take place in the centre of Isselhorst, with a lively atmosphere, plenty of spectators and a varied supporting programme.
course_highlights: Various race distances from 500 m to 9,200 m for all age groups
Route through the centre of Isselhorst, with several laps
Popular corporate race featuring team rankings and outlandish costumes
additional: Late entries are possible up to two weeks before the event, subject to a late-entry fee, except for the Bambini and school races. On the day of the event, registration is available on site from 16:00. The event supports the German Stroke Foundation, with the option to donate based on kilometres run. There is an extensive preparation programme, “Fit in 100 Days,” with weekly training sessions and individual support. The races take place in the centre of Isselhorst, with spectators lining the route, and there is a warm-up for children before the first races. A running event with a fundraising campaign against stroke, a varied programme, music and a party.

name: 18. Osteroder Etappenmarathon - Etappe 1
description: The Osterode Stage Marathon divides the classic marathon distance of 42.195 km into seven enjoyable after-work stages of 5 to 7 kilometers each. The first stage starts on Sunday, June 21, 2026, in Förste and leads through the beautiful Söse Valley, with views of Lichtenstein and a route past the famous Lichtenstein Cave. The event is open to runners, walkers, and Nordic walkers, and also offers a 750-meter kids’ stage in Schützenpark. Stages take place daily through June 27, 2026, and are organized by regional clubs.

name: EWE-Nordseelauf 2026 - Spiekeroog (7. Etappe)
description: The EWE North Sea Run is a traditional stage race across seven different East Frisian North Sea islands, attracting running enthusiasts from Germany and other countries for more than two decades. The 7th stage takes place on 27 June 2026 on the car-free island of Spiekeroog, known for its unspoilt nature, endless beaches and relaxed atmosphere. The stage starts and finishes on Gartenweg, level with the Kurpark. The event offers a unique running experience in a distinctive island landscape, combining a sporting challenge with the enjoyment of nature.

name: Fischerhuder Sommerlauf
description: The Fischerhude Summer Run, organized by Sportfreunde Fischerhude e.V., takes place on June 27, 2026, starting at 18:00. Events include a 1 km race for children and 5 km and 10 km races for teenagers and adults, run on an officially measured 5 km loop. There is also a 2x5 km relay for friends, families, and colleagues. The event offers a family-friendly atmosphere, with free hot and cold drinks in the finish area and changing and shower facilities after the race. A DJ provides entertainment, and after the races there is an after-run party with a barbecue, cocktails, and drinks.

name: Berglauf 2026
description: The Kyffhäuser Mountain Run is a traditional running event at the Kyffhäuser Monument in Thomm, attracting numerous runners each year. The route climbs uphill and offers a sporting challenge with impressive views. In addition to the main race, there is also a tower stair race, in which participants climb 306 steps inside the monument tower. The event thrives on the commitment of runners, supporters, and volunteer helpers, and promises an unforgettable running experience in a unique landscape.

name: Brauerschwender Basaltlauf
description: The Brauerschwender Basaltlauf takes place on June 27, 2026, in Brauerschwend and offers runners of all ages an athletic challenge in beautiful surroundings. The courses have gentle elevation changes, are well marked, and display kilometer markers. Drinks are available along the course, and the organizer provides refreshments at the finish. The race is for both competitive runners and anyone who enjoys being active as part of a group.

name: Göllnitz-Schmooksberglauf (LC/NLC)
description: The 2nd Göllnitz-Schmooksberglauf (LC/NLC) takes place on 27 June 2026 in Diekhof (Laage) and is hosted by Sportclub Laage. This athletics event is held away from a stadium and invites runners to take part in a sporting competition. The course runs through the scenic surroundings of Diekhof and offers an attractive challenge for all participants. Registration is open until 24 June 2026.

name: Lubaster Waldlauf
description: The 13th Lubaster Forest Run takes place on June 27, 2026, in Kemberg and offers runners two distances: 1 km and 6.3 km. The event is ideal for anyone looking to experience a short but varied forest route. The race promises pleasant summer weather, with an average temperature of 23 °C and mostly sunny conditions. Participants can look forward to a friendly, family atmosphere and a well-organized event.

name: MÜRITZ-LAUF
description: The MÜRITZ-LAUF is a race around Germany’s largest inland lake, the Müritz, and takes place on 27 June 2026 in Waren (Müritz). The route reflects the full variety of the northern German landscape and has a gently rolling profile, making it ideal for runners who want to enjoy nature while also running fast. The event is organised by ESV Waren e.V., a long-standing sports club that, with the support of numerous sponsors and volunteers, ensures everything runs smoothly.

name: Schöneicher Eichkaterlauf
description: The 14th Eichkater Run on June 27, 2026, in Schöneiche offers a varied running program for all ages and ability levels. From short races for toddlers and children to fun runs and the challenging 12 km premier event, there is something for everyone. The routes pass through the beautiful natural surroundings of Schöneiche and offer an enjoyable sporting experience for the community. The event is family-friendly, and registration is conveniently available online, with late registration also possible on race day.

name: Volksbank-Bever-Lauf
description: The Volksbank-Bever-Lauf takes place on June 27, 2026, at Beverstadion in Ostbevern. The event offers various races, including a half-marathon relay and individual races for runners born in 2012 or earlier. The course is measured by the DLV and is part of the Volksbank-Cup running series. Drinks and refreshments are available in the finish area, and changing rooms and showers are located directly at Beverstadion.

name: EWE Nordseelauf - Etappe 7
description: The EWE North Sea Run is a traditional stage race across seven different East Frisian Islands on the North Sea coast of Lower Saxony. Over eight days, participants run, walk or Nordic walk approximately 10 kilometers per stage, enjoying the unique natural surroundings, maritime atmosphere and healthy sea air. The event attracts running enthusiasts from across Germany and abroad, offering a fair competition in a friendly, family-like atmosphere. Because capacity on the islands is limited, the number of participants is capped, ensuring an exclusive running experience.

name: XXI Dziesiątka Unisławska
description: The 21st Unisław 10K is an annual 10 km race and Nordic walking event held in Unisław as part of the Unisław Days celebrations. The race route follows paved roads through the scenic Chełmno Landscape Park, passing through the towns of Unisław, Stablewice, and Gołoty. The race is certified by the Polish Athletics Association and is part of the 2026 Kuyavian-Pomeranian Voivodeship Grand Prix in Long-Distance Running. All running and Nordic walking enthusiasts are welcome to take part in this sporting event.

name: XXXVII Cross Świętojański
description: The 37th Jan Marek St John’s Cross-Country Race in Pogórze is a traditional race organized by LKS Pogórze, taking place on June 27, 2026, at 6:00 p.m. The event is held in the picturesque town of Pogórze and attracts runners who enjoy competing on off-road courses. The organizers provide professional RFID timing and comprehensive technical support to ensure the event runs smoothly. All running enthusiasts are invited to take part in this special sporting event.

name: Lingewaalloop
price_range: Jeugdlopen en jongeren t/m 15 jaar gratis; 5 km €10 voorinschrijving, €13 op de dag; 10 km €12 voorinschrijving, €15 op de dag
description: The Lingewaalloop is a friendly running race organised by Stichting Lingewaalloop Herwijnen, aimed at residents of Herwijnen and the surrounding area. The race offers several distances, including children’s races and 5 km and 10 km events. The course starts and finishes on Vervoornlaan and follows the Waaldijk. The children’s race takes place on and around Vervoornlaan, while the 5 km and 10 km runners complete a loop along the dike and Achterweg. Facilities include changing rooms and showers, and there is an awards ceremony after the race.
course_highlights: Children’s race on and around Vervoornlaan
5 km loop via Achterweg, Waaldijk and Katerdam
The 10 km consists of two laps of the same 5 km loop
additional: On-the-day registration and collection of children’s race bibs are available from 09:30 at the De Kol football clubhouse. Changing rooms and showers are available at De Kol sports park. The children’s awards ceremony takes place at the finish; the 5 km and 10 km awards ceremonies are held afterwards in the football clubhouse. Parking is along Parallelweg; do not park at nearby shops. There are ten age categories for men and women, regardless of race licence. The race takes place on and around Vervoornlaan, with registration available in advance and on the day, and facilities at De Kol sports park. The 2027 edition has been cancelled due to extreme temperatures.

name: Dahlenburger Moorlauf
description: The Dahlenburg Moor Run is a popular community race with manual timekeeping, attracting around 200 participants each year. The event offers races for children, walking, and two main races over 4,600 m and 8,800 m. The course is flat and mostly paved, and the children’s races take place on the tartan track. The event is known for its friendly atmosphere and picturesque setting in the Dahlenburg Moor.
course_highlights: Flat, mostly paved course
Children’s races on the tartan track
Run through the picturesque setting of the Dahlenburg Moor
additional: Race number pickup from 08:30 at the DSK sports facility/Dornweg in Dahlenburg. Late entries are possible up to 30 minutes before the respective start for an additional fee of €3.00. Manual timekeeping. Showers are available at the swimming pool (admission required) or in the clubhouse. Refreshments include drink stations along the course, as well as coffee, cake, and soft drinks at the sports field. Parking is available in front of the swimming pool and the school. Courses, registration, community spirit, various types of running

name: Tippkötter Sommerlauf in Rheine
location: Bentlager Wald, Rheine, North Rhine-Westphalia, Germany
description: The 11th Tippkötter Summer Run in Rheine takes place on June 28, 2026, in Bentlage Forest and offers scenic, nature-filled routes with views of the salt works and Bentlage Monastery. The spectacular finish is in the FC Eintracht Rheine stadium, where all runners cross the finish line at the penalty spot. Music, professional commentary and surprises make this a special running experience for participants of all ages. Alongside the main race, there is also an elementary school run, making the event a family-friendly sports festival.
course_highlights: Scenic routes through Bentlage Forest
Route passing the salt works and Bentlage Monastery
Finish in the FC Eintracht Rheine stadium at the penalty spot
additional: Electronic timing with a transponder race bib. Race packets can be collected in the VIP room at FC Eintracht Rheine. Headphones are prohibited and may result in disqualification. Bambini run participants receive a participation medal. Trophies for the overall winners of the 2 km, 5 km, 5 km walking and 10 km races. Age-group awards with medals only for the 2 km race. Certificates can be printed via Race Result. Ample changing rooms and showers are available. Food and drink available on site, including drinks, fries, bratwurst, steaks and waffles. Parking is available at Rheine Zoo. The 5 km and 10 km routes are officially measured and eligible for rankings. The event takes place in June 2026 and features various race distances, electronic timing, on-site refreshments and parking at Rheine Zoo; there is no parking directly at the event venue.

name: 19. Muko-Spendenlauf Hannover
description: The 19th Muko Charity Run Hannover is an inclusive race taking place on 28 June 2026 at the VfL Eintracht Hannover sports field. The event is open to all ages and ability levels, whether you run, walk or stroll, with or without a disability. The goal is to raise donations for Haus Schutzengel, a guesthouse for parents and patients from families affected by cystic fibrosis, near Hannover Medical School. Sponsors donate one euro for every lap completed on the 400-metre cinder track. The race promotes community and solidarity in the fight against cystic fibrosis.

name: 32. hella hamburg halbmarathon
description: The hella hamburg half marathon is a major running event in Hamburg, held annually on the last Sunday in June. On an officially measured, flat, paved 21.1 km course, up to 24,000 runners experience a unique running party through the Hanseatic city. The route passes around 50 sights and is accompanied by numerous event zones featuring DJ support and live music. The event is known for its great atmosphere and traffic-free course, secured by police and marshals.

name: 24-Stunden Burginsellauf
description: The 24-hour Burginsel Run in Delmenhorst is a challenging ultramarathon on a flat, approximately 1.3 km loop along Burginsel and the Graftwiesen. The event offers individual and team competitions, as well as a 6-hour run and a 3-hour schoolchildren’s run. The course is closed to traffic, illuminated and mostly shaded, making it ideal for endurance runners who want to test their limits. There is a refreshment station open around the clock during the run, as well as a tent area for rest breaks. The German 24-hour running championships are held as part of this event.

name: BikeNavy Run
description: The BikeNavy! Run is a unique running event held on the grounds of Nordholz Airfield, which is otherwise not open to the public. The course runs within the controlled airspace of the Nordholz Naval Air Base and offers participants a special atmosphere, with views of historic and modern aviation. After the race, participants can visit the AERONAUTICUM Naval Aviation and Airship Museum. The event is ideal for runners looking for an extraordinary and unforgettable running experience.

name: Halderner Volkslauf
description: The Haldern People’s Run is a long-standing event that brings young and old together and fosters a sense of community among friends and families. The event will take place again on June 28, 2026, with the half marathon remaining permanently on the programme following the positive response. The event offers a welcoming atmosphere for runners of all abilities and invites everyone to take part.

name: Ohndorfer Volkslauf
description: The Ohndorf Fun Run is a family-friendly running event held annually in Ohndorf and is part of the Schaumburg Running Series. The event offers a welcoming atmosphere for runners of all ages and ability levels. Online registration is open until race day, with on-site registration available up to 30 minutes before the start. The run is attracting increasing numbers of participants and offers a great opportunity to exercise together and enjoy a sense of community.

name: Seester Sternenlauf
description: The Seester Star Run takes place for the tenth time on June 28, 2026, and is a charity run in support of the Kinder-Hospiz Sternenbrücke in Hamburg. The event offers a range of distances for runners, walkers, Nordic walkers, and Bambinis, including a special 10 km loop through the historic Lindenallee at Gut Seestermühe. Grill sausages, coffee, and cake will be available, and the route will be lined with decorated streets and a wonderful atmosphere. The organizing team looks forward to welcoming many participants and spectators to this cheerful and successful event.

name: Weiner Family Run 2026
description: The Weiner Family Run 2026 is a family-friendly running event organized by the running group of FC Schwarz-Weiß Weiner on June 28, 2026. It is open to runners, walkers, children, and toddlers, and offers various distances ranging from approximately 500 meters to 10 kilometers. The focus is on the joy of exercise and sharing the experience in a relaxed atmosphere. The start and finish area is at Sparkassenpark Weiner, and the routes lead through the Weiner farming community. Participants can also enjoy a family-friendly program with commentary and refreshments.

name: Łabiszyński Bieg Świętojański
organizer: Łabiszyński Dom Kultury, Urząd Miejski w Łabiszynie, F.W. Martex, Uczniowski Klub Sportowy Łabiszynianka
description: The Łabiszyn St. John’s Eve Run is an annual running event taking place on June 28, 2026, at the Municipal Stadium in Łabiszyn. The main 5 km race starts at 10:00, followed by children’s and youth races in four age categories. Participants in the main race will receive a medal and a sweet snack, while younger runners will receive a medal and a surprise. The best runners will be presented with awards after the races. The event is part of a running series and offers starter packages to the first people to register.

name: Montagslauf Rund um Mackenzell
description: The Montagslauf Rund um Mackenzell is a traditional fun run held in the idyllic surroundings of Hünfeld-Mackenzell. The event offers several distances, including a Schülerlauf, 5.3 km, 10 km, and a 14.3 km course with an additional loop. The routes pass through varied landscapes, with refreshment points along the way. The event has a family-friendly atmosphere and medical support from the German Red Cross. Showers are available after the run, and Nordic walking is also offered without timekeeping.

name: Böda Beach Run
location: Böda Sand Beach Resort, Löttorp, Öland, Sweden
description: Böda Beach Run is a challenging and fun race for the whole family, with distances ranging from 500 metres to 10 kilometres. The race takes place on the beautiful, long sandy beach at Böda Sand Beach Resort on Öland, offering a unique and scenic running experience. Everyone who finishes receives a medal as a keepsake. The event is held annually and is part of Böda Sand’s wide range of summer activities and events.
course_highlights: Run on one of Öland’s most beautiful beaches, with almost two miles of white sand
Courses ranging from 500 metres to 10 kilometres
Family-friendly race with a medal for everyone who finishes
additional: The race is part of Böda Sand’s summer programme, with activities for the whole family. There are several distances to choose from, making it accessible to both children and adults. Böda Sand also offers many other sports and leisure activities alongside the event. Everyone who finishes receives a medal. An accommodation offer at Böda Sand has previously been mentioned in the race information.

pipeline_log.message: New race date found on official site (https://www.bodasand.se/evenemang/): 2027-06-30 — "Böda Beach Run — 30 juni 2027" (was estimated 2027-06-23)

name: 36. Göttinger Altstadtlauf
description: The Göttingen Old Town Run is a long-standing running event in downtown Göttingen, taking place for the 36th time in 2026. The event combines running with the special charm of the old town and attracts runners of all ages. In addition to the main race, there are various school races and a popular corporate race with team scoring. The course leads through the historic city center and offers a lively atmosphere full of excitement and activity.

name: Jotunheimen Trail Run
description: Jotunheimen Trail Run offers an unforgettable trail running experience in Norway’s stunning high-alpine landscapes. Participants can choose from several distances, including 12K, 16K, 21K, Marathon, and an epic 73K Ultra that loops around Lake Bygdin. The race features challenging elevation gains, flowing mountain trails, and breathtaking panoramic views, all in a friendly and welcoming atmosphere suitable for runners of all levels. The event includes well-organized check-in, aid stations, and post-race activities such as sauna and swimming at Bygdin.
course_highlights: Ultra: 73 km loop around Lake Bygdin with demanding elevation and runnable high-mountain plateau sections
Marathon: 40 km trail with a scenic detour via Skjetning and a final sprint to the finish line in Bygdin
Half Marathon: 17 km trail with a major climb to panoramic ridge views and a fast downhill finish in Beitostølen
additional: Check-in and bib collection at Beito Resort Hotel and Bygdin Høyfjellshotell. Pre-race pasta dinner at Lodge 900 (booking required). Post-race sauna and swimming available at Bygdin. Shuttle buses provided for Ultra and Marathon runners. Award ceremony for top finishers at Bygdin Høyfjellshotell. Social shake-out run and shoe testing with La Sportiva before race day. The race is part of the Norway Trail Series. The program also includes race briefings, meals, shuttle buses, and award ceremonies; some dinners and bus tickets must be booked in advance.

name: 32. Lippesee Marathon
location: Lippesee, Paderborn-Sande, Paderborn, North Rhine-Westphalia, Germany
description: The 32nd Lippesee Marathon in Paderborn-Sande is a private marathon held in accordance with the rules of the 100 Marathon Club Germany. The course consists of seven large laps of 6.1 km each, for a total of 42.7 km, around Lippesee, a popular recreation area and water sports center. Participants must be self-sufficient, as there are no aid stations, and time themselves manually; a photo of the watch must be submitted by email as proof. The race is open to runners aged 18 and over, with a limit of 18 participants, and takes place only if at least five people register.

name: Byrundan
location: Unos park, Gamleby, Västervik Municipality, Sweden
description: Byrundan is a running race held in Gamleby, starting and finishing in Unos Park. The race offers distances for all ages, from children to adults, on a beautiful summer course through Gamleby. There are several categories and distances, including children’s and youth races, as well as a joint start for the 4 km and 8 km races. All participants receive a medal after finishing, and prizes are awarded to the top finishers in each category, along with sprint prizes in the 4 km and 8 km races. Byrundan is part of TOUR DE RUN and is organised by Gamleby OK.
course_highlights: The course runs through beautiful summer scenery in Gamleby
Start and finish in Unos Park
Water stations at the start/finish and at 4 km
additional: Race numbers can be collected in Unos Park from 15:00 until one hour before the start. Children are offered hamburgers/sausages after the race, sponsored by ICA Supermarket. Medals are sponsored by Metallfabriken Norden AB. Professional timing by Racetimer. The prize ceremony takes place at approximately 19:25 for children and 20:45 for everyone else. A sprint prize at 450 m for the 4 km and 8 km races is a gift card worth 3000 kr. The 8 km course record comes with a 1000 kr prize.

name: Büsumer Volkslauf
description: The Büsum Volkslauf is an annual running event suitable for beginners and experienced runners alike. Various distances are offered, from 400 metres for children to 10 kilometres for experienced runners. The new route follows the waterfront promenade, loops around the Familienlagune and returns, with the start and finish at Büsumer Hauptrand. The event promises a sporty day on the North Sea coast with a beautiful running backdrop.
course_highlights: New route along the waterfront promenade
Loop around the Familienlagune
Start and finish at Büsumer Hauptrand
additional: Three race distances: 400 m Bambini Run at 18:15, 5.5 km health run at 19:00, and 10 km race at 19:00. Registration is also possible by phone at 0176 96204634. Running event on the North Sea coast in Büsum, with routes for Bambini runners, health runners and competitive runners; finish at the swimming pool; registration online and by phone; start and finish at Büsumer Hauptrand; route along the promenade and around the Familienlagune.

name: Drevenacker Volksbank Abendlauf
description: The Drevenacker Volksbank Evening Run is a traditional running event in Hünxe-Drevenack, organized by the TUS Drevenack TL-Abteilung e.V. Various races take place on the event day, a Friday in July, including an officially measured 10 km road race, a 5 km jogging race with a youth category, a 5 km non-competitive walk, and children’s and toddlers’ races. The course runs through the scenic surrounding area, with the start and finish at the sports field on Buschweg. The event offers suitable competitions for all age groups and professional timing by the TAF Timing Team.
course_highlights: Officially measured 10 km course with age groups in five-year increments
5 km jogging race with a separate youth category and an officially measured course
Children’s and toddlers’ races for children and young people, with age-appropriate distances
additional: The start and finish are at the sports field on Buschweg. Women start at the tennis clubhouse, and men start in the gym on Buschweg. A €2.00 deposit is charged for the timing chip for each race number and refunded when it is returned. Late registrations are possible on the event day from 16:30 until 45 minutes before the respective start, subject to capacity. Every participant receives a certificate; prizes are awarded to the top three finishers in each age group. Online registration is available; the event is part of the Lippe-Issel-Cup; results are available online.

name: Marburger Nachtmarathon
description: The Marburg Night Marathon will take place for the 27th time on 3 July 2026 and is the largest running event in the Central Hesse region. The event offers a classic marathon, a half marathon, and a relay marathon with up to four participants. The course passes through Marburg’s picturesque old town and along the Lahn, following a flat, record-eligible loop with views of Landgrave Castle and St. Elizabeth’s Church. The race starts in a special atmosphere at 7 p.m. in the historic market square, and the finish is at the University Stadium. All participants receive a high-quality medal featuring a notable Marburg landmark each year.
course_highlights: Flat, record-eligible loop course
Route passes through the old town and along the Lahn
Views of Landgrave Castle and St. Elizabeth’s Church
additional: The relay marathon consists of four runners, each completing a leg of around ten kilometres. The first relay runner starts in the market square, and the exchange zone is on Frankfurter Straße. Each team receives one race number attached to an elastic race-number belt. Safety pins are provided at registration. The number of participants is limited to ensure safety and an enjoyable running experience. The start and finish are at the University Stadium, about 1 km from the starting point. Course in Marburg’s city area, start at Georg-Gaßman-Stadion, relay exchange on Frankfurter Straße, registration opens on 1 March 2026

name: Rotenburger Strandfestlauf - Rotenburg rennt
location: Rotenburg an der Fulda, Hesse, Germany
price_range: 1 Euro Startgeld für Bambini, vergünstigte Preise für Schüler- und Jugendläufe
description: The Rotenburg Strandfest Run takes place every year on the first Friday in July as part of the traditional Heimat- und Strandfest in Rotenburg an der Fulda. The flat, fast course runs through the town centre and offers various events for young runners, main-race participants, elite runners and teams, as well as walking. New features include precisely measured school and elite races, plus the Beer Mile, where having fun is the main focus. The event combines sporting ambition with a friendly, social atmosphere and is a highlight of the regional running calendar.
course_highlights: Flat, fast course through Rotenburg town centre
School race: exactly 1,248 metres—a tribute to the year Rotenburg was founded
Elite race over 1.609 km (land mile), with entry requirements
additional: No on-site registration is possible; advance registration is available only through specialist portals. The 5 km and 10 km courses are no longer offered; instead, the main race covers a 1.5 km course five times. The Beer Mile has no timing and includes four alcohol-free beer breaks at 400 m intervals. Elite race entry requirements: men, 03:10 min/km; women, 03:30 min/km. Events for young runners, main-race participants, elite runners and teams, plus walking. Preparation through a running group; supported by Sparkasse.

name: Bocksten Trailrun
location: Öströö Fårfarm, Åkulla Bokskogar, Varberg Municipality, Halland County, Sweden
distance_verbose: Marathon, 24 km, Halvmarathon, 12 km, 6.7 km, 5 km
description: Bocksten TrailRun is a nature-focused trail race with its event centre at Öströö sheep farm and courses in the Åkulla beech forests. The event offers four distances (5 km, 12 km, 22 km and Ultra 44 km) through beech and spruce forests, with lake views and varied trails. The races are spectator-friendly, have limited start places, and offer participants a special medal. Welcome to experience the joy of running and a sense of community in a magical forest setting.
course_highlights: Running in the Åkulla beech forests and enchanting spruce forests
Varied terrain: technical trails, off-trail sections and gravel roads with lake views
Plenty of elevation and scenic views; also a 6.7 km loop course for the Vineyard Backyard Ultra
additional: Distances: 5 km (start 10:15, 200 places), 12 km (start 10:00, 400 places), 22 km (start 10:30, 300 places) and Ultra 44 km (start 08:00, 100 places). The total number of start places is limited (only 1000 places). GPS coordinates for the event centre: 57.06881078975495, 12.506526026672418. Only tap water is served during the event (no plastic bottles); Tailwind and squash are available as alternatives. For the Vineyard Backyard Ultra, bringing your own cup is mandatory; a headlamp and personal medication are mandatory, and the headlamp must be worn between 20:00 and 07:00. Bib collection and registration take place in the start area (see the invitation for the specified times); if you need assistance, contact race management on 076-8159678. It is possible to take out Startklar cancellation and accident insurance (see the invitation for prices). The summer edition takes place on 27 June 2026, with distances of 5/12/22/Ultra 44 km; the winter edition is at Öströö Gård, with 5/12/24 km and 500 places. Accommodation can be booked through Åkulla Resort with a discount (code bockstentrailrun). The Backyard Ultra race at Ästad Vingård has a 6.7 km course and starts every full hour.

name: Strömstadmilen
description: Strömstadmilen is a welcoming running event organized by Strömstad Running Club, featuring a runner-friendly 5-kilometer loop through central Strömstad. Participants can choose to run one or two laps, covering 5 km or 10 km, respectively. The event also includes races for children and young people, as well as a walking class along the Strömstad waterfront. The start and finish are at Strömsvallen, and the event has a lovely summer atmosphere, with plenty of spectators and activities creating a real town festival.
course_highlights: Runner-friendly 5 km loop through central Strömstad
Start and finish at Strömsvallen
Clearly marked course with plenty of directional signs
additional: Start times: 11:00 4 km walk, 12:10 Girls 7 years, 12:30 Boys 7 years, 12:50 Girls 9 years and Boys 9 years, 13:20 Girls 11 years and Boys 11 years, 14:00 5 km, 15:00 10 km. Bib pickup and race-day registration are available from 09:30 on race day and also the evening before. All participants who finish receive a specially designed medal. A technical T-shirt featuring a Strömstadmilen design can be purchased when registering. Timekeeping ends at 16:45. Parking at Strömsvallen is limited; parking at Strömstad Upper Secondary School is recommended. Start and finish at Strömsvallen. The information found relates to the 2026 edition and does not confirm details for 2027.

name: Kolmårdsrundan / Kolmården Ultra Trail
description: Kolmården Ultra Trail is a challenging and scenic running experience in the deep forests of Kolmården, with distances of 45 km and 60 km. The course offers varied terrain, with forest trails, mountain ridges featuring spectacular views, sections along the shores of Bråviken, and technical running in nature reserves. The race is suitable for both elite runners and recreational runners seeking a memorable trail experience. At the finish, participants receive a medal and a light meal, included in the entry fee.
course_highlights: Start in Kolmården Forest, with trails through varied terrain
Views from the mountain ridge at Kvarseboklint and running along the shores of Bråviken
Technical and challenging running through Bråviksbranten Nature Reserve
additional: Mandatory equipment: mobile phone, running vest/backpack/belt with at least 0.5 L of fluids, a pressure bandage/blood stopper, and a map with the emergency number (provided at bib collection). Aid stations: the 45K has 4 stations, and the 60K has 5 stations offering sports drink, energy products, and water. The cutoff time for the 45K is 13:30 at 44 km (pace 9:00 min/km). Participants are served a light meal at the finish. Start and finish at Klintvallen in Kvarsebo. Medical services are available on site. After finishing, participants receive a medal and are offered hot vegetarian soup. Mandatory equipment rules apply; aid stations are located along the course.

name: Mörksuggejakten TrailRun

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Startavgift före 1/7 Barn och ungdom upp till 16 år 150 kr

description: Mörksuggejakten is one of Sweden’s most popular events in the long-distance race cup, offering a top-class competition since 1997. The cycling race in Rättvik features a beautiful and varied course covering 74 km, with a shorter 46 km option. The route passes through Rättvik, climbs to heights with breathtaking views over Lake Siljan, follows gravel roads and trails, and passes distinctive locations such as Dalhalla and Springkällan. Younger participants can take part in Lilla Mörksuggejakten, with several spectator-friendly courses in the Jarl area. Mörksuggejakten TrailRun also offers 10 km and 20.8 km runs starting from IK Jarl Rättvik.
course_highlights: The course offers beautiful views over Lake Siljan from the heights around Vidablick and the Hedsåsen summer pastures
The route follows gravel roads and trails, and crosses narrow suspension bridges over the Enån valley
Passes distinctive locations such as Dalhalla, Springkällan and Kungshol
additional: Mass start for all classes at 09:30. Maximum time: 5 hours. Race bibs can be collected on race day from 08:00 at IK Jarl. The courses are marked with red-and-white tape and signs. The course is 95% trail and 5% gravel road. It is permitted to switch to a shorter distance during the race. Parking is available at Rättvik Arena; camping in the parking area is prohibited.

name: Jølster Maraton
description: Jølster Marathon is a popular race that brings runners from all over the country to beautiful Jølster. The race starts and finishes at Jølstrahallen in Vassenden and offers four distances: marathon, half marathon, 10 km and 5 km. The route follows scenic stretches in the area, and places are limited, so early registration is recommended. The event also includes extra activities for the whole family and a music and marathon quiz the evening after the race.
course_highlights: Start and finish at Jølstrahallen in Vassenden
The route follows beautiful stretches in Jølster
Refreshment stations with water, squash, cola, sports drink and bananas
additional: Maximum 1,300 participants. Prize-giving at 13:00 for all distances. 5% of the proceeds go to a good cause. A pink T-shirt can be purchased, partially sponsored by Enivest. Cars are not allowed to drive to the event office on race day. Race numbers should be collected on Friday or well before the start. Extra activities, including a cycling event and a mini race for children, are held. Great prizes from sponsors are drawn among all participants. The top three in each category and distance receive prizes.

name: Bitihorn Opp
price_range: 150 kr under 17 år; 300 kr fra 17 år
description: Bitihorn Opp is an informal, laid-back uphill race up majestic Bitihorn in Øystre Slidre. The race is suitable for everyone, whether you walk or run, fast or slow, and focuses on an enjoyable outing in spectacular nature. The course follows stone steps and trails on the “front side” of Bitihorn, offering a unique nature experience with 450 metres of elevation gain over 2 kilometres. The event supports local sport, and all participants receive a prize, with extra prizes for the fastest man and woman.
course_highlights: The course follows majestic stone steps and trails on the front side of Bitihorn
450 metres of elevation gain over 2 kilometres
A spectacular nature experience in mountain terrain
additional: Bib distribution from 11:30 at the start of the stairs. Parking at Båtskaret, with signs on race day. The proceeds go to Øystre Slidre IL. All participants receive a prize, with extra prizes for the fastest man and woman, as well as fun draw prizes. Registration via EQ Timing. All participants receive a prize, with extra prizes for the fastest woman and man. Parking is listed at Båtskaret or Båtskardstølen.

name: Oberlichtenauer Sommerlauf
description: The 44th Oberlichtenau Summer Run takes place on 27 June 2026 and invites runners of all ages to a sporting event that has brought together the Saxon running community and guests from near and far for over four decades. The day begins with children’s races over 800 metres and 2.2 kilometres for the U12 and U14 age groups. These are followed by the recreational run of approx. 5 kilometres and the challenging 13-kilometre main race, which tests stamina and skill with steep climbs and fast descents over the Keulenberg. The running group of Sportgemeinschaft Oberlichtenau looks forward to welcoming all participants.
course_highlights: Children’s race: 2 laps around the sports field (800 metres)
U12 and U14 children’s race: 2.2 km along Keulenberstraße
Main race: 13 km with challenging climbs and descents over the Keulenberg
additional: Race day starts with the children’s race at 09:45, followed by a new children’s race for U12 and U14 at 09:55. The awards ceremony takes place immediately after the children’s races. The recreational run starts at 10:25 and the main race at 10:30. The running group is led by Patrick Thomschke (department head) and Jens Schäfer (manager). The event usually takes place in summer temperatures of around 23°C. Registration and further details are available on the official website. The race is a great opportunity for runners to achieve personal bests and experience the beautiful Saxon landscape.

name: 10. Hochkippenlauf
description: The 10th Hochkippenlauf takes place on 4 July 2026 at Stadion Profen and is organized by SV Eintracht Profen. Various races are offered for different age groups, from a children’s race to distances for young people and 10 km races for adults. The event is part of a sports festival running from 3 to 5 July 2026. The race is a great opportunity for sports enthusiasts of all ages to compete in a family-friendly atmosphere.
course_highlights: 400 m children’s race (one lap of the stadium)
Distances of 2.1 km, 4.2 km and 5 km for young people
10 km race for U18, U20 and adults
additional: The race is part of a sports festival running from 3 to 5 July 2026. The children’s races take place over one lap of the stadium. The race is held at Stadion Profen, with warm, sunny weather in July. It offers a family-friendly atmosphere and the opportunity to win prizes in various categories.

name: 46. Küstenkanallauf
description: The 46th Küstenkanallauf takes place on 04.07.2026 in Friesoythe. The event offers races over 22 km, 11 km and 5.5 km, as well as walking and hiking routes. The scenic course runs along the Küstenkanal and is suitable for runners of all ability levels. This traditional event is organised by KC Ikenbrügge von 1971 e. V.
course_highlights: Scenic course along the Küstenkanal
Distances of 5.5 km, 11 km and 22 km
Walking and hiking routes available
additional: Start times: Runners in the 5.5 km, 11 km and 22 km races start at 17:00; walking and hiking start at 16:15. Registration is via an online form on the website or through the contact option, providing your name, year of birth, club and town. This is a local event with a friendly atmosphere that attracts numerous runners from the region each year. Registration, results and further details are available on the official website and in the race information.

name: 9. Bremer Brückenlauf
price_range: ab 8,00 € bis 45,00 € je nach Kategorie und Frühbucherstatus
description: The Bremer Brückenlauf on July 4, 2026, invites runners to experience Bremen from a unique perspective. The course crosses bridges spanning the Weser, the Kleine Weser and the Werdersee, offering a maritime atmosphere in the heart of the city. Several distances are available, including a half marathon, 10 km run, 5 km run, a special 5 km underwear run and children’s races. The event promises good spirits, a summery atmosphere and breathtaking views of Bremen and the Weser.
course_highlights: Run across several bridges in Bremen
Course over the Weser, Kleine Weser and Werdersee
Officially measured, record-eligible courses
additional: Optional medal engraving (€10 for adults, €7.50 for children). Start times vary by distance, from 16:30 (underwear run) to 18:15 (5 km and 10 km walking). All main races are measured by the DLV and are record-eligible. Children’s races are measured privately. Walkers and Nordic walkers are listed in alphabetical order in the finish results. Participation rules and age categories are clearly defined. Loop course with official measurement, age categories and competition categories; medal engraving available; Nordic walking included.

name: Benkhauser Schlosslauf
location: Schloss Benkhausen, Espelkamp, North Rhine-Westphalia, Germany
price_range: 600 m Kinderlauf kostenlos, 2 km Schülerlauf 4,00 € (bis 14.06.), 6,5 km 12,00 € (bis 14.06.), 10,8 km 12,00 € (bis 14.06.), 20,8 km 12,00 € (bis 14.06.), Preise steigen nach dem 14.06.
description: The Benkhausen Castle Run is a sporting event taking place for the second time in 2026, set in the unique surroundings of Benkhausen Castle. The event offers varied running routes along paved side roads and footpaths in beautiful Benkhausen. The start and finish are at Benkhausen Castle Square, where race bibs are also distributed. The event is open to running enthusiasts of all ages and includes various distances, including children’s and schoolchildren’s races.
course_highlights: Running routes along paved side roads and footpaths in beautiful Benkhausen
Start and finish at historic Benkhausen Castle Square
Kilometre markers along the route for guidance
additional: Late registration is possible on race day from 12:30 p.m. until 60 minutes before the start, provided the participant limit has not been reached; a late-registration fee of €2 applies. The number of participants is limited to 200 runners per main race (6.5 km, 10.8 km, 20.8 km), with a maximum of 600 registrations in total. Race packs will be available from 30.06.2026 at Drogerie Emmerling and on race day at the castle square. Timing uses disposable-chip technology. Showers and changing facilities are available at Benkhausen Primary School. All participants in the children’s and schoolchildren’s races receive medals; there is no timing or awards ceremony. The well-known announcer Heino Krüger will accompany the races. Registration opens on 01.02.2026; late registration is available on site; the participant limit for the main races is 200 per distance, with a maximum of 600 registrations in total; chip timing; event held as part of a sports festival

name: 01. Okertalsperren Ultra-Marathon
description: The 1st Okertalsperren Ultra-Marathon takes place on July 4, 2026, in Altenau in the Harz. The course covers 47.4 km and consists of three laps of a 15.8 km route, mostly flat, around the main arm of the Okertalsperre. The route runs along the forebay, over the dam and the main dam wall, offering a scenic course with only gentle climbs. The event is suitable for experienced runners. Bringing your own refreshments is recommended, and runners are responsible for their own timekeeping. After the race, participants receive certificates by email, and the results are published on the website.

name: 23. Schneekopflauf
description: The Schneekopflauf is one of the most beautiful and challenging mountain races in Germany, held in the Thuringian Forest. The course runs from Schmiedefeld via Großer Finsterberg to Schneekopf and covers distances of 12.7 and 22.2 kilometers, with plenty of climbs and elevation gain. This race is especially suitable for experienced runners who want to test their limits. Since 2025, there has also been a Schneekopf hike for Nordic walkers and hikers, who are also rewarded with a medal at the summit.

name: 40. Schweriner Fünf-Seen-Lauf
description: The Schwerin Five Lakes Run is a traditional race in northern Germany, taking place for the 40th time on July 4, 2026. The event offers various race distances around Schwerin’s five lakes, including a half marathon, 15 km run, 10 km run, 5 km run, and a children’s one-mile race. Runners can enjoy a scenic course starting and finishing at Bertha-Klingberg-Platz. The event is known for its excellent organization, family-friendly atmosphere, and a variety of rankings, including company and school rankings.

name: Gocher Steintorlauf
description: The 30th Gocher Steintorlauf takes place on July 4, 2026, as part of the Gocher Fußball Sommer. Organized by SV Viktoria Goch, Athletics/Running Group Department, the event is expected to welcome more than 800 runners of various age groups to the city center of Goch. The program ranges from a Bambini run and a 2,000 m run for hobby groups and companies to open races around the Steintor. The event offers suitable distances for both competitive and recreational runners in an open, healthy outdoor atmosphere.

name: Mam Marzenie 12.RAZ 25h RUN
organizer: Fundacja Mam Marzenie oraz Ruchowa Akademia Zdrowia (RAZ Szczecin)
description: 25h RUN is a unique running event organized by the Mam Marzenie Foundation, combining sport with charity. The 10th anniversary edition takes place by Lake Arkonka in Szczecin and aims to make Marlena, one of the foundation’s beneficiaries, dream come true: a trip to the island of Zakynthos. Participants run for 25 hours, and every kilometer brings them closer to achieving this goal. It is not only a sporting challenge, but also an opportunity to work together to support children in need.

name: XI Janikowska ZaDyszka
organizer: Ośrodek Sportu i Rekreacji w Janikowie
description: The 11th Janikowo ZaDyszka is an annual road race held in Janikowo, attracting runners of different ages and ability levels. The race covers 10 km, with professional timekeeping provided using Chronotrack technology. The event is organized by the Janikowo Sports and Recreation Centre, and timing is handled by STS-Timing, ensuring high reliability and organizational support. The race is open and welcoming to everyone who enjoys physical activity.

name: XI Krokowska 10
description: The 11th Krokowska 10 is one of the events in the Kaszuby Biegają 2026 series, taking place on July 4 in Żarnowiec. The race offers a 10 km distance through the scenic landscapes of Kashubia, combining sporting competition with the beauty of the region. Kaszuby Biegają is the largest running event in northern Poland, promoting physical activity and local culture. Participants can expect professional organization and unique medals assembled from pieces awarded at the individual stages.

name: Kadeloop
description: The Moore DRV-Kadeloop in Schipluiden is a traditional running event held annually on the first Saturday of July since 1978. The main distance is 12 km through the green Midden-Delfland area and along the Vlaardingsekade back to Schipluiden. There is also a 5 km run and a 1 km and 2 km junior race. The event is known for its beautiful scenery and friendly atmosphere and is part of the Zomer Runcircuit.
course_highlights: 12 km route through the green Midden-Delfland area
Run along the Vlaardingsekade back to Schipluiden
Junior races of 1 km and 2 km, specially for children
additional: Race bib collection for children: 10:00–11:00; for other distances: 11:00–13:00 at the VV Schipluiden clubhouse. Parking is available at VV Schipluiden. Chip-based electronic timing for the 5 km and 12 km. Water stations along the route and at the finish. Prize-giving immediately after the children's race, for the 5 km at around 15:00, and for the 12 km at around 15:30 at the VV Schipluiden clubhouse. No on-site registration; registration is online only until 2 July 2027 at 23:59. Race bibs may be transferred until 2 July at 21:00 via the registration website. Distances: 12 km, 5 km, junior race (1 km and 2 km); activities include Nordic walking and walking; location: Schipluiden, Midden-Delfland.

distance_verbose: 10 km, 5 km, 2.5 km, 1500 meter, 1 km, 0.5 km

name: Oslo Løpsfestival, Maridalsvannet rundt
