description: Maridalsvannet Rundt is one of eight races in the Oslo Running Festival, which follows the capital’s beautiful trails and roads. The race has a mass start on Sunday, July 4 at 11:00, with the start and finish at Frysja, a lovely area with good facilities and opportunities for swimming, barbecuing, and relaxing after the race. The course is 13.5 km long and offers scenic surroundings around Lake Maridalsvannet. The Oslo Running Festival gives you the flexibility to run alone or with others, and you can take part in several races with a festival pass or day tickets.
course_highlights: The 13.5 km course goes around Lake Maridalsvannet
Start and finish at Frysja, with good facilities such as a café and grocery store
Lovely start and finish area with opportunities for swimming and barbecuing
additional: Race bibs can be picked up at Löplabbet Oslo city centre from April 7. The same race bib is used throughout the series. The course is marked only for the mass start. Timing is recorded by a chip attached to the race bib, which must be visible on your chest. There are good public transport connections and several parking spaces near the start area. The race can be completed at a time that suits you during the period June 25–July 4, 2027. An early-bird price is listed; prices vary by ticket type.

name: Perseløpet 5 km, 10 km, halvmaraton
description: Perseløpet is a simple, fast race event at Ås school in Eidsvoll, featuring a flat, measured 2,633-metre loop. The race offers seven distances from 3 km to 100 km, including 5 km, 10 km and the half marathon, and is suitable for anyone looking to chase a personal best. Participants can set out their own bottles and gels on their personal nutrition table, which they pass each lap, giving them good control over their nutrition during the race. The event has good facilities, with changing rooms, toilets and free parking at the venue.
course_highlights: Flat, measured 2,633-metre loop
Each participant’s own nutrition table at every lap
Good facilities, with changing rooms and toilets inside Ås school
additional: Race numbers are collected at the school using self-service, approximately two hours before the start. Free parking, changing rooms and toilets are available at the venue. The race has a lap-time calculator for planning lap times. At selected races, 9th grade students from Feiring school staff an official drink station and raise money for their school trip. Participants who set a personal best can ring the bell near the finish area. Free parking, changing rooms and toilets are available at the venue. Race numbers are collected at the school using self-service from approximately two hours before the start.

name: Perseløpet ¤5- 2027
description: Perseløpet is a simple, fast race event at Ås School in Eidsvoll, featuring a flat, accurately measured 2,633-meter loop. The race offers seven distances from 3 km to 100 km, giving runners the opportunity to set personal records in a well-equipped setting with a dedicated nutrition table. Bibs are collected via self-service at the venue, which has free parking, changing rooms, and toilets. The race is organized by Feiring IL and has a tradition of many personal records, with a friendly atmosphere where runners can celebrate their personal records by ringing the bell at the finish.
course_highlights: Flat, accurately measured 2,633-meter loop
Dedicated nutrition table passed on every lap
Flat road races with the opportunity to achieve fast times
additional: Bibs are collected via self-service about two hours before the start. Free parking, changing rooms, and toilets are available at the venue. Runners can place their own bottles and gels on the nutrition table before the start. At selected races, 9th-grade students from Feiring School staff an official refreshment station to raise money for their school trip. A lap-time calculator is available to help plan split times. The weather forecast is updated four times daily based on satellite data for the area. Registration via RaceDays. Free parking, changing rooms, and toilets are available at the venue. Bibs are collected via self-service at the school, and runners can place their own drinks and nutrition at the nutrition table.

name: VW - THIEL Rheda-Wiedenbrücker Staffelmarathon
location: Schloss- und Rosengarten, Rheda-Wiedenbrück, North Rhine-Westphalia, Germany
description: The VW - THIEL Rheda-Wiedenbrück Relay Marathon is a long-established relay marathon taking place on July 5, 2026, in the castle and rose gardens in Rheda-Wiedenbrück. The flat, well-maintained course follows a two-kilometre loop through the historic castle park, to be completed 21 times. The event is organised by LG Burg Wiedenbrück, which has been hosting this relay marathon since 2013 and has built a dedicated running community. The relay marathon offers runners an attractive and varied route through beautiful parkland, with no disruptive road crossings.
course_highlights: Flat, well-maintained 2 km loop through the castle park
Start and finish in the rose garden, with a view of the historic castle
No disruptive road crossings on the course
additional: The relay marathon consists of 21 laps of 2 km each, run in Rheda Castle Park. The course is flat and has no road crossings. Registration is available online. The event is organised by LG Burg Wiedenbrück, which also runs other races. Photos and videos of previous relays are available on the website. Registration is via my.raceresult.com; the race is held as a relay marathon, and results are available on the day of the event.

name: Dorflauf TSV Wiera
description: The 6th TSV Wiera Village Run takes place on July 5, 2026, in Schwalmstadt and is officially registered with the German Athletics Association. The event offers races over 600 meters and 10 kilometers. The results are included in the official athletics rankings, making the competition particularly attractive to ambitious runners. The race takes place in typical July weather, with pleasant temperatures and usually sunny conditions.

name: SVE-Steinwiesenlauf
description: The Steinwiesenlauf organised by SV Eidelstedt Hamburg is a popular running event that attracts numerous participants every year. The event offers various races for all age groups, from a kids’ run and school races to the 5 km and 10 km main races. The course includes a motorway bridge and offers exciting competitions in a family-friendly atmosphere. The race traditionally takes place on a weekend and continues to attract more participants.

name: Bieg Wilka Wilkowo 05.07.2026
description: The 7th Bieg Wilka Wilkowo 2026 is an annual running event held in Wilkowo near Świebodzin. The race attracts runners from various categories and offers the chance to compete on a route combining road and off-road sections. The organizers provide professional timing and technical support, while participants can expect efficient organization and a friendly atmosphere. It’s a great opportunity to get active and bring the local community together.
course_highlights: A route combining road and off-road sections
Scenic surroundings of Wilkowo near Świebodzin
Professional electronic timing
additional: The event is organized by Super Sport, a company from Zielona Góra, which provides timing, race bib printing, and technical support. No details are available about start waves, participant limits, or race packages. Registration will be available at super-sport.com.pl, and the event attracts local runners and sports enthusiasts.

name: 34 Bieg po Plaży
organizer: Centrum Kultury i Sportu w Postominie
description: The 34th Beach Run in Jarosławiec is an annual running event organized by the Centre for Culture and Sport in Postomino. The race follows a scenic route along the beach, offering participants a unique seaside running experience. It attracts both recreational and experienced runners, creating a sporting atmosphere and promoting active leisure. The event has a long tradition and is an important sporting occasion in the region.

name: Feriespretten 2027
description: Feriespretten is the most beautiful and fun summer trail race, organized by Hope IL in Risør, Agder. The race offers two distances over varied, hilly terrain, with the start and finish in the same place. The long course of approximately 9 km is suited to those looking for a proper workout in beautiful natural surroundings, while the short course of approximately 5 km is perfect for beginners, children and families, or as an untimed fun run. Feriespretten is a family-friendly event that brings experienced runners and beginners together for an enjoyable race experience.
course_highlights: Two distances over varied, hilly terrain
Start and finish in the same place
The course runs through beautiful natural surroundings on the Sandnes Peninsula
additional: The race takes place on Tuesday, 7 July 2026 at 18:00. The short course can be run untimed as a fun run. The organizer is Hope IL. Results and statistics from previous years are available on the website. Untimed recreational classes are offered for the 5 km and 9 km distances. The time is provided in the organizer’s channels.

name: 41. Flora-Westfalica Marathon
description: The Flora-Westfalica Marathon in Rheda-Wiedenbrück is a private marathon run held according to the rules of the 100 Marathon Club Germany. The course consists of seven large laps of 6.10 km each, around 42.7 km in total, and offers a quiet, self-supported running environment, with refreshments at runners’ own cars after each lap. The event is limited to 22 participants and is open to runners aged 18 and over. Marathon times are recorded with a manual stopwatch, and a voluntary donation to environmental or social projects is requested.

name: Gütersloh Läuft - für den guten Zweck
description: Gütersloh Läuft is a diverse charity running event taking place for the 18th time on July 8, 2026, in Gütersloh City Park. The event offers races for all age groups, from Bambini and school races to Nordic walking, corporate and individual races, as well as a 10 km summer evening run. All participants support the German Stroke Foundation with their entry fee, as €1 is donated for every registration. The routes lead through the beautiful city park and offer a sporty, community atmosphere for recreational and competitive runners.

name: City-Sport-Abendlauf
description: The City-Sport Evening Run in Rostock is a popular summer race held annually in Barnstorfer Wald. Hundreds of runners come together for an evening run that combines the joy of running with a good cause. Proceeds from the race are donated to charitable organizations, most recently to the Rostock hospice at Klinikum Südstadt. The race has become a fixture on Rostock’s running calendar and continues to attract growing numbers of participants.

name: 4. Dorstener 24-Stunden-Lauf
location: Bürgerpark Maria Lindenhof, Dorsten, North Rhine-Westphalia, Germany

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Die Startgebühr beträgt pro Person 12,00 Euro

tiers.label: tier_2
tiers.description: Läuferinnen und Läufer unter 16 Jahren können für 6,00 Euro starten

description: The Dorsten 24-Hour Run is a charity fundraising event held in Dorsten, near the city center, in Bürgerpark Maria Lindenhof. The course is about 1 km long and runs through a scenic park between the Lippe and the Wesel-Datteln Canal. Participants can run, walk or stroll for any amount of time during the 24 hours and complete as many laps as they choose. 100% of the entry fee goes into the donation fund, which supports various social organizations. The event is open to all ages and fitness levels, from a few short laps to a half marathon or marathon.
course_highlights: Loop course of approximately 1 km in Bürgerpark Maria Lindenhof
Scenic route between the Lippe and the Wesel-Datteln Canal
Central location near Dorsten city center
additional: The event is a charity run, with 100% of all entry fees going into the donation fund. Participants are not required to run for 24 hours straight; everyone can decide for themselves how many laps to run, walk or stroll. The event is organized by interevent GmbH and supported by numerous local sponsors. Functional shirts can be ordered for 27,00 EUR. Start and finish are in the park; registration is available online and on site. Parking is available on Kurt-Schumacher-Straße and in the VHS multi-storey car park. Results for performances of 50 km or more are included in the rankings.

name: Borener Meile
description: The Borener Meile is a traditional 1,609.34-meter road race, taking place for the 35th time on July 10, 2026, as part of the Borener Dorftage in Boren. The race is organized by Borener SV, an active sports club on the Schlei with a particular focus on running and triathlon. The event offers runners a short, fast course and is a popular competition in the region. Results and photos from previous races are available on the website.
course_highlights: Road race over exactly 1,609.34 meters (one mile)
Traditional event held as part of the Borener Dorftage
Organized by the regional sports club Borener SV
additional: Road race, registration available, results and photos from previous events available

name: Roruper Abendlauf
description: The Rorup Evening Run is a long-standing running event in Rorup, a district of Dülmen in North Rhine-Westphalia, which has attracted runners every summer for more than three decades. The event offers several distances, including a half marathon as its premier event, as well as 10 km, 3 km, a schoolchildren’s race and a Pampers Run for children. The course is flat and paved, with a ten-kilometre loop that is completed once or twice depending on the distance. The finish is in the SV Brukteria Rorup stadium, where runners complete a lap of the stadium before crossing the finish line. In addition to certificates and trophies, cash prizes are awarded to the top runners in the half marathon and 10 km race.
course_highlights: Flat, paved course
Ten-kilometre loop, with a longer first lap for the half marathon
Stadium lap before the finish at the SV Brukteria Rorup stadium
additional: All races start at the Rorup sports ground. Certificates are awarded to all finishers, trophies to the winners, and special prizes to the top three runners in each age group. Cash prizes are awarded to the top three male and female finishers in the half marathon and 10 km race. Courses are officially measured; online registration is available until 30 minutes before the start; parking is available; refreshments are provided on the course; finish in the SV Brukteria Rorup stadium.

name: Böda Sandsloppet
location: Böda Sand SportCamp, Böda, Öland, Sweden
description: Böda Sandsloppet is a family-friendly running race held at Böda Sand SportCamp on Öland. The race offers several distances for both children and adults, with routes through lovely forest terrain. Adults can choose between 6.5 km and 4 km, while shorter distances are available for children and young people. All participants who finish the race receive a medal as a keepsake. The event has a welcoming atmosphere and is open to runners of all ages and abilities.
course_highlights: Route through lovely forest terrain
Start and finish at Böda Sand SportCamp
Distances available for both children and adults
additional: Late registration is available through 8 July, followed by race-number collection on race day from 15:00. Payment can be made in cash, by card or via Swish. Children and young people under 11 are not timed and there is no prize ceremony for them. Start and finish at Böda Sand SportCamp. Register by 3 July 2027; late registration is available for a higher fee. Children aged 11 and under are not timed and there is no prize ceremony.

name: Musköloppet
description: Musköloppet is a popular running race held in the spectacular archipelago setting of Muskö. The race has a long tradition and celebrated its 30th anniversary in 2022, after being paused during the pandemic. There are several different courses and categories, including children’s races, and the event offers a wonderful nature experience, with the start and finish at Muskö Hembygdsgård. Late registration is available on site up to one hour before the start.
course_highlights: The race takes place in the beautiful archipelago setting of Muskö
Start and finish at Muskö Hembygdsgård
Children’s races over 1.5 km and 2.5 km for different age groups
additional: Late registration is available on site at the start and finish area up to one hour before the race begins. There are water stations along the course, and runners may arrange their own drinks. Race management may decide to restart the race if needed. Pacing assistance from non-competitors is not permitted. The children’s races start at 10:00 for 1.5 km (ages 7–10) and at 10:30 for 2.5 km (ages 11–14). The countdown on the official website indicates 10 July 2027. However, the published times and distances on the website are for 2026. The relay costs 150 kr per team, and the children’s race for ages 4–6 is free, according to the published information.

pipeline_log.message: New race date found on official site (https://www.muskoloppet.se/): 2027-07-10 — "Nedräkning till Musköloppet 10 juli 2027" (was estimated 2027-07-10)

name: H2 Trail
distance_verbose: 50 miles, 50 km, 28 km, 18 km, 10 km, 5 km
description: Umara H2 Trail 2027 is organized by OK Skogsvargarna and takes place on July 10 at Bergagården, Hunneberg. The event offers several distances from 6 km up to 50 km, including a kids’ trail for the youngest participants. The courses cross varied terrain on Hunneberg, with a mix of trails, gravel roads and asphalt, and feature beautiful viewpoints, crofts and swimming spots. All participants in the 11 km to 50 km distances receive their own Umara cup to reduce the use of disposable cups at the aid stations. The club also offers showers, a sauna and changing rooms in its clubhouse at Bergagården.
course_highlights: The 50 km distance crosses Hunneberg and passes attractions such as viewpoints, crofts and swimming spots
The course is marked with arrows and flags, and consists of 23% gravel roads, 73% trails and 4% asphalt
Kids’ trail and mini trail for children, with a medal for every participant
additional: All participants in the 11 km to 50 km distances receive their own Umara cup to use at the aid stations to reduce the use of disposable cups. Aid stations are located along the course, and participants are encouraged to carry their own fluids. Support is available at a designated spot on the course at the lap point at Bergagården (25 km). The kids’ trail and mini trail are untimed, and every participant receives a medal. The clubhouse at Bergagården offers showers, a sauna and changing rooms. Parking is available about 300 metres from the event centre and is signposted. A mobile phone and power bank are recommended for emergencies. Previous editions have had aid stations along the course; participants have needed to bring their own fluids.

name: Gotland Run 511k (2026)
description: Gotland Run 511k is a unique running adventure and a journey to explore your inner landscape. It is not a traditional race, but a self-supported run around the beautiful island of Gotland, including a loop around Fårö, starting and finishing in Visby. Participants have 10 days to complete the approximately 511 km course, with support from four Angel Stations along the way. The organizer provides basic support, while runners are responsible for their own food and accommodation.
course_highlights: Start and finish in Visby, Gotland’s medieval capital
Clockwise loop around the island, including Fårö
Mixed terrain with asphalt, gravel roads, and shorter trails
additional: Participants must check in twice daily using an online tool. Accommodation on the first night is at Visby Fängelse Hostel in shared rooms. A pre-race dinner and briefing are held the evening before the start. Angel Stations offer support, water, rest, and sometimes shower facilities. The ferry to Fårö runs every 30 minutes, but requires a call between 22:00 and 05:30. The run must be completed on foot within 10 days, averaging approximately 51 km per day. Luggage storage is available at the hostel. Parking is available near the ferry terminal, with cheaper options at Visby Airport. This is a self-supported event: participants are responsible for most of their food and logistics. The entire distance must be completed on foot within ten days, with regular position reports.

name: Branäsutmaningen
description: Branäsutmaningen is a summer adventure in Branäs featuring a challenging 6-kilometre course. Branäs is known for its beautiful natural surroundings and family-friendly outdoor activities all year round. In summer, activities include mountain biking, padel and water activities by the Klarälven River. Branäs is investing in family-friendly cycling trails and scenic hiking trails, making it a perfect place for an active and fun summer experience.
course_highlights: A challenging 6-kilometre course
Family-friendly downhill trails and wide cross-country trails
A scenic location by the Klarälven River, with hiking trails and fishing
additional: Branäs offers family-friendly lift-accessed cycling, with the six-seat express lift Sjöexpressen at the heart of its cycling programme. There are barbecue and rest areas with views, miles of gravel and paved roads for training, and cycling tracks for children at Soltorget. Food and drinks are available at Ladan restaurant in the centre. The summer map includes a pump track, zipline, trampoline with a big airbag, and trails in Logläntan. Start at 14:00 at Soltorget. Family Day also includes Björnbuseloppet for children, an after-run and an evening of live music. The first prize in the race is a family ski holiday.

name: Hestane Skyrace
organizer: Lars Øvrebø og Torstein Bolstad Blikra, med Gaular IL
description: Hestane Skyrace is a demanding skyrace over the spectacular peaks of Storehesten and Lisjehesten in Bygstad. The race features technical climbing, an exposed ridge and magnificent panoramic views in dramatic natural surroundings. There are two distances: 32 km with 1,900 metres of elevation gain and 26 km with 1,400 metres of elevation gain, both across challenging mountain terrain. The event is a celebration for the whole village, with activities for participants and spectators alike.
course_highlights: Technical climbing and an exposed ridge over Storehesten and Lisjehesten
Magnificent panoramic views and challenging mountain terrain
Two distances: 32 km (~1,900 m elevation gain) and 26 km (~1,400 m elevation gain)
additional: Mandatory equipment: mobile phone, 1 L of water, emergency ration and wind jacket. Cutoff at Skaraly at 15:30; final finish at 19:00. Parking at Langeland Ski Centre costs 50 kr. Race bibs can be collected on Friday 9 July and on race day from 07:00. There are staffed stations with water and first aid along the route. After-run gathering at Tønna in Bygstad from 20:00, with food and socialising. Start and finish at Langeland Ski Centre. Start at 09:00. Registration via Racedays.

name: Sommerlauf des LSV Porz
location: Gut Leidenhausen, Köln-Porz, Köln, North Rhine-Westphalia, Germany
price_range: Nachmeldung 2 € am Veranstaltungstag, sonst keine expliziten Angaben
description: The LSV Porz Summer Run is a popular race in the Gut Leidenhausen recreation area in Cologne-Porz. Held as the Ingeborg Urbach Memorial Run, it offers distances from 1 km to 5 km for competitive runners and recreational joggers. The 5 km and 10 km courses are measured by the DLV and eligible for official best lists, with the 5 km loop considered one of the fastest running routes in Cologne. The entry fee also supports Brusthilfe Deutschland e.V. and the Leidenhausen Forest School.
course_highlights: Race in the Gut Leidenhausen recreation area
5 km and 10 km courses measured by the DLV and eligible for official best lists
The 5 km loop is considered one of the fastest running routes in Cologne
additional: The registration deadline is 23.06.2026. Late registration is possible on the event day for a fee of €2; school students are exempt from the late registration fee. Timing is provided by time-and-voice.com. Race numbers must be worn on the chest. €1 per participant is donated to Brusthilfe Deutschland e.V. and the Leidenhausen Forest School. Terrain in the Leidenhausen recreation area, registration by SEPA direct debit, race number worn on the chest, medals for all pre-registered participants, awards ceremonies for the top runners, certificates available online

name: Wybelsumer Polderlauf
description: The Wybelsumer Polder Run is a running event for children and adults held at the Wybelsum sports ground in Emden. Organized by SV Frischauf Wybelsum e. V., the event offers a sporting opportunity for the whole family in a friendly and welcoming atmosphere. It is part of Emden’s diverse events calendar and promotes the local community and sport.
course_highlights: Running event for children and adults
Venue: Wybelsum sports ground, Emden
Organized by SV Frischauf Wybelsum e. V.
additional: The event includes various running distances for all age groups and is a popular regional event in the Krummhörn region.

name: Bergheide-Cross 2026
description: SCB Langendamm invites you to the 4th Bergheide Cross 2026. The course runs from the access road to the clubhouse of the local small-bore rifle club through the “Osterberg” recreational and landscape conservation area. The race offers three distances for different competition and age categories, as well as walking on the shorter course. There is also a 1,000-meter race for children and young people. The event is approved by the DLV and takes place on July 11, 2026, from 4:00 p.m.

name: Bukowiecka Dziesiątka
description: Bukowiecka Dziesiątka is a 10 km race held in Bukowiec, attracting runners eager to take on a moderately challenging course. Every participant who crosses the finish line will receive a commemorative medal. The race office is located in the sports hall in Bukowiec, providing convenient event facilities. We invite all running enthusiasts to take part in this event, which combines sporting competition with a local atmosphere.

name: Semesterhalvmaran
location: Torps herrgård, Kumla Municipality, Örebro County, Sweden
description: Semesterhalvmaran is a recurring running event organized by the running club LK Gränslöst, inviting runners to experience the beautiful open landscapes of the Närke Plain. The race starts and finishes at Torps herrgård outside Kumla and offers a lovely running experience on gravel roads among rolling grain fields. After a two-year break, the race returns on July 11, 2027, welcoming runners of all levels to take part in a community filled with the joy of running. LK Gränslöst is an inclusive club that aims to bring runners from across the country together and build a strong community around running.
course_highlights: Start and finish at Torps herrgård outside Kumla
Run on gravel roads among rolling grain fields on the Närke Plain
Beautiful, nature-rich surroundings on the Närke Plain
additional: Registration is planned to open in January. The race is organized by the running club LK Gränslöst, which also organizes other races and group training every Wednesday at 18:00 in Örebro. The club focuses on community and the joy of running for all levels.

organizer: Leichtathletik Gemeinschaft Eder (LG Eder) / TSV Dodenau

description: The Dodenau Volkslauf is a recreational running event open to everyone, starting and finishing at the Dodenau multi-purpose hall in Battenberg-Dodenau. The event offers a range of distances from Bambini races to a half marathon, as well as Nordic walking. To be included in the rankings, participants must belong to an athletics club or an LG. Online registration is available until about one week before the race; late registration is possible at the start.
course_highlights: Start and finish at the Dodenau multi-purpose hall
Distances for Bambini, short, middle and long races, as well as a half marathon
Nordic walking over 5 km and 10 km
additional: Late registration at the start is possible from 07:45 until 45 minutes before the respective start. To be included in the rankings, participants must provide their club or LG on the registration form. Terrain: Dodenau multi-purpose hall, online registration, various running distances, Nordic walking

description: The 41st Pönitz Volkslauf takes place on 12 July 2026 in Pönitz and invites runners, walkers and Nordic walkers to a sporting and social event. The course runs through the scenic Holstein Switzerland, with romantic hedgerows, summer fields and peaceful meadows. Participants can look forward to a friendly atmosphere, refreshments, show performances and an awards ceremony at the Pönitz Sports Park. All participants receive a commemorative medal, and attractive prizes are awarded to the winners.
course_highlights: Scenery of Holstein Switzerland, with hedgerows, fields and meadows
Start and finish at Pönitz Sports Park, with a summer atmosphere
Refreshments and show performances at the venue
additional: All participants receive a commemorative medal. The awards ceremony begins at 11:15, with medals for the overall winners (places 1–3) and trophies and certificates for age-group winners and finishers. Members of SVG Pönitz pay half the entry fee. The event offers refreshments, show performances and a friendly atmosphere for athletes, companions and spectators. Runners can choose between the half marathon, 10 km, 5 km and Nordic walking. Starts are from 8:30. A shared experience of community and nature.

name: 27. Gläserner Mönch Lauf
description: The Gläserner Mönch Run is a traditional trail race in the Harz foothills, returning after a seven-year hiatus. The course is known for its undulating profile, with more than 100 meters of elevation gain per lap, and the legendary climb up 222 steps to the “Gläserner Mönch.” Participants can choose from a range of distances, from the Bambini Run to the 18 km Extreme Run, and enjoy unspoiled nature among rocks and forests. The event combines a sporting challenge with local pride and takes place around the Landhotel Schäferhof in Halberstadt.

name: 8. Barigauer Turmlauf
description: The Barigauer Turmlauf is a traditional race in Oberhain near Königsee, taking place on July 12, 2026. The event offers runners an attractive course with scenic sections around the Barigauer Tower. It is aimed at ambitious runners and running enthusiasts looking for a sporting challenge in a natural setting. The race is organized by Laufverein Königsee, which provides a welcoming atmosphere and smooth event operations.

name: Bajoro 26
description: Bajoro 26 is a 10 km race taking place on July 12, 2026, in Starogard Gdański. It’s a great opportunity to test your fitness on a scenic course and prepare for race day with dedicated training plans tailored to different experience levels. The organizers offer expert support and detailed training instructions, making the event appealing to both beginners and more experienced runners. Bajoro 26 is a moderately challenging event on an asphalt surface, ideal for improving your fitness and competing in a friendly atmosphere.

name: Västervik City Run
description: Västervik City Run is a city race of approximately 6.3 km that takes place in and around central Västervik, starting and finishing at Grönsaks- och Fiskartorget. The race offers a scenic course along the cycle path beside Gamlebyviken, passing landmarks including the Stegeholm Castle ruins and Myntbryggan. After finishing, participants receive a medal as proof of their participation. The race is a popular summer tradition that welcomes runners of all ages.
course_highlights: A city race of approximately 6.3 km in central Västervik
The course follows the cycle path beside Gamlebyviken and passes the Stegeholm Castle ruins
Start and finish at Grönsaks- och Fiskartorget
additional: A children’s race (Sparbanksloppet) of 800 m for children up to 10 years old, with a group start from Fiskaretorget at 18:30. Participants receive medals after finishing. A separate Sparbanksloppet of approximately 700 metres is offered for children up to 10 years old. Registration for the 2027 race opens on 1 May.

name: Victorialoppet
description: Victorialoppet is a traditional running festival held every year in Borgholm on Öland. The event offers several distances for all ages and abilities, including a 9 km main race, the 4 km Victoriajoggen, the 2 km Lilla Victorialoppet, and Mini, a 1.5 km race for the youngest participants. The course is fast and easy to run, with beautiful views along the shore and an enthusiastic crowd creating a wonderful atmosphere. The event is a popular celebration, with music along the course and a strong commitment to the Crown Princess Victoria’s Fund.
course_highlights: Fast, easy-to-run 9 km course with views along the shore
Music at several locations along the course
Courses adapted for all ages and abilities
additional: Bib pickup takes place on race day from 10:00 to 18:00 at Borgholms Sporthall. Changing rooms and showers are available for men and boys at Borgholms Sporthall, and for women and girls at Viktoriaskolan’s gymnasium. Water is provided along the 9 km course, and there is music at several locations. Prizes are awarded in different categories, and participants receive medals, commemorative plaques, ice cream, and drinks, depending on the race. Timing uses disposable chips for most races; timing is optional for Victoriajoggen and the parasport categories. There are also parasport and youth categories. Water is available along the 9 km course, and changing rooms and showers are provided at Borgholms Sporthall and Viktoriaskolan’s gymnasium. Fees vary depending on the race and registration date; an administration fee applies.

name: SUNSET Hamburg 2026
description: Altra Sunset Hamburg takes place on Wednesday, 15 July 2026, at Wilhelmsburger Inselpark. The event features an appealing approx. 5 km loop on asphalt and paths, which can be run 1 to 3 times, allowing distances of approx. 5 km, 10 km or 15 km. Participants can choose how many laps they want to complete on the day, with a checkpoint counting the laps. There is also a relay race in which the course is run four times, with teams of 2 to 4 runners. The event is open to anyone who is fit and has no medical concerns; club membership is not required.

name: Lauf um und am Gartower See
description: The run around and along Gartow Lake is a longstanding running event held on the lake’s north shore in Gartow. The course offers a natural setting with views of the lake and the surrounding Gartow pine forest, making it ideal for runners of all ages. The event is organized by the sports club SV Gartow, which has fostered sporting commitment and community in the region since 1946. The start and finish are centrally located in town, creating a welcoming, family-friendly atmosphere.

name: Kraftprovet
organizer: Trollhättans IF Friidrott och Trollhättans SOK
description: Kraftprovet is a classic city race in Trollhättan, offering a unique running experience along the canal area, with leafy paths, hilly terrain and beautiful views of the Göta älv, the locks and historic power stations. The race is a festival for everyone, with both elite runners and recreational runners taking part, while cheers from the crowd and music along the course add to the atmosphere. With more than 40 years of tradition, Kraftprovet brings the city, nature and people together during Fallens Dagar. There are several races to choose from, ranging from 800 metres to 11.6 kilometres, including a fun costume competition and an untimed Fun Run category.
course_highlights: The course follows the canal area, with varied and hilly terrain
Beautiful views of the Göta älv, the locks and historic power stations
Crowd support, music and a festive atmosphere along the entire course
additional: Start and finish at Hansenplatsen in Trollhättan. A race bib with your first name is available if you register by 30 June. A T-shirt can be ordered when registering by 15 May; it is included in some races and costs extra in others. Runners who finish in under 50 minutes (men) or 55 minutes (women) receive a silver medal. Pacers are available for finish times of 50, 55, 60 and 65 minutes. Costume competition with prizes before the start. Showers and changing facilities are available about 1 km from the finish at Arena Älvhögsborg. Water stations with Umara sports drink and water are available along the course.

pipeline_log.message: New race date found on official site (https://kraftprovet.se/deltagarinfo/): 2027-07-16 — "Datum 16 juli 2027" (was estimated 2027-07-16)

name: Kölner Zoolauf
description: The Cologne Zoo Run is a unique running event at Cologne Zoo, taking place for the 13th time on July 17, 2026. It offers four different races for all age groups, from Bambini and children’s races to challenging 10 km races. The course runs through the zoo and past numerous animal enclosures, making the run a special experience. Official timing and certificates are included for most races, and the event places great emphasis on safety and family-friendliness.
course_highlights: A 1.62 km loop through Cologne Zoo, with views of numerous animal enclosures
Choose to run between 1 and 6 laps (1.6 km to 10.05 km)
Start and finish in front of the main entrance to Cologne Zoo
additional: Start times: BambiniLauf 18:15, KidsLauf 18:30, TopLauf 19:00, FunLauf 20:15. A requested bib number is available for an additional €3. On-site late registration is possible up to and including event day, with a €5 late-registration fee. Participation with dogs, strollers, walking poles, or music devices is not permitted. Official timing is provided for all races except the BambiniLauf. Certificates can be printed online. Safety and supervision of children in the start and finish areas are organized. Four race types (Bambini, Kids, Top, Fun); online registration; no refunds for non-participation; participation requires a bib number and timing chip; participation with dogs or headphones is not permitted.

name: Night Run Gdynia
description: Night Run Gdynia is a 5-kilometer night race held on the shores of the Baltic Sea as part of IRONMAN Poland triathlon weekends. After dark, with city lights reflected on the asphalt and water, hundreds of runners set off on a spectacular route through the streets of Gdynia. The event has become an important and eagerly anticipated part of the city’s sporting calendar, combining athletic competition with the unique atmosphere of a night run.

name: Gårvikloppet
description: Gårvikloppet is a popular running race in Gårvik that began in 2016 and quickly became a success, with over 100 participants of all ages. The race offers several classes and courses, from challenging tough courses to walking classes, making it possible for everyone to take part regardless of ability. The event is run by Badortsföreningen in collaboration with Dreambody gym and is known for its friendly, inclusive atmosphere.
course_highlights: Several courses and classes for different ability levels
Trail running in scenic Gårvik
Course records for 4 km and 8 km for both women and men
additional: The race has classes ranging from walking to elite level and welcomes participants of all ages. Course records are listed for 4 km and 8 km for both women and men. Previous results include 4 km and 8 km classes. Information about registration and the 2027 format is not available in the sources.

name: OYLER Berglauf
description: The 27th Oyler Berglauf takes place on July 18, 2026, as part of Sports Promotion Week in Marklohe. Organized by Jugendgemeinschaft Oyle, the race offers a sporting challenge on Oyler Berg. The event is part of a varied sports program and is aimed at runners looking to experience a hilly course in a friendly club atmosphere. The exact route and further details can be found on the organizer’s website.
course_highlights: Race on Oyler Berg
Venue: Sportplatz Oyle
Part of Sports Promotion Week 2026
additional: The Oyler Berglauf is part of Sports Promotion Week 2026, which takes place from 18.07.2026 to 26.07.2026 at Sportplatz Oyle. The organizer is Jugendgemeinschaft Oyle von 1953 e.V. No pricing or registration details, start times, or wave information have been published on the website. The event is part of Sports Promotion Week 2026 and takes place at Sportplatz Oyle; no specific registration information is available.

name: 1. Stoppelfeld Ultra
description: Stoppelfeld Ultra 2026 is a classic Backyard Ultra race taking place on July 18 and 19, 2026, in Kerpen-Blatzheim. In this special endurance format, speed is not the goal; instead, runners must complete a 6.706-kilometer loop within 60 minutes every hour and be ready to start again on the hour. The course runs mainly along field and farm tracks around Blatzheim, with the start and finish at the Blatzheim sports field. The event is limited to 50 participants and promises a friendly, close-knit atmosphere as well as a major mental and physical challenge.

name: 22. Wiesenlauf
description: The 22nd Wiesenlauf on July 18, 2026, in Klein Meckelsen gives runners the opportunity to compete on officially measured, DLV-approved 5 km and 10 km courses. The event includes district championships over both distances and a regional championship over 5 km, with classifications starting from age group M/W 14. The start and finish are at the Klein Meckelsen sports field, and the event is suitable for both competitive runners and recreational runners.

name: 4. Fachberg 100
description: The Fachberg 100 is a 100 km road race in Northeim, Germany, starting on July 18, 2026, at 6:00 a.m. The course consists of 15 laps and a short out-and-back section, alternating between asphalt and dirt tracks. Each lap includes about 75 meters of elevation gain, for a total elevation difference of 1,125 meters. This is a small ultrarunning event with limited entries and no entry fee. Runners must bring their own refreshments.

name: Spendenlauf Recke
description: The Recke Charity Run on July 18, 2026, is a fundraising event in support of Kinderkrebshilfe Münster. Organised by Andreas Egelkamp Heizung, Lüftung, Sanitär GmbH & Co. KG and the company Lewe from Recke, the run offers two distances: 5 kilometres for beginners and casual runners, and 10 kilometres for experienced runners seeking a greater challenge. The focus is on coming together for a good cause, with the entire entry fee being donated. The event combines sporting commitment with social responsibility and invites everyone to take part and show their support.

name: 12. Nocny Portowy Maraton Szczeciński oraz 7. Nocny Portowy Półmaraton Szczeciński
description: The 12th Szczecin Night Port Marathon and the 7th Szczecin Night Port Half Marathon are night road races held in Szczecin, promoting physical activity and a healthy lifestyle. The marathon course consists of two identical laps measuring 42,195 m, while the half marathon is one 21,097 m lap; both courses are certified by the Polish Athletics Association (PZLA). The start is at 23:00. Participants can expect original T-shirts and a special classification for people connected with the maritime industry. The event is organized by Ruchowa Akademia Zdrowia, Zachodniopomorska Federacja Sportu, and RAZ Event, with support from the City of Szczecin and port partners.

name: Garmin Ultra Race Tolkmicko
description: Garmin Ultra Race Tolkmicko is a unique trail race taking place on July 18, 2026, in the scenic Elbląg Upland area by the Vistula Lagoon. The route follows wild trails through varied elevation and quiet, natural surroundings, offering runners a chance to connect with the region’s nature and history. The event is part of a nationwide mountain running series that promotes physical activity in harmony with nature, and welcomes both beginners and experienced ultramarathon runners. Participants can expect professional organization, medical support, and a comprehensive race pack.

name: 2 Chojnicka Piątka
description: 1. Chojnicka Piątka is a road race held in Chojnice, taking place on July 26, 2026. The event is part of the Grand Prix Borów Tucholskich and attracts runners from various places, offering sporting competition and a friendly atmosphere. The course runs through the city streets, giving participants attractive views and the opportunity to test their fitness over a distance of 5 km.

name: Puchar Polski Nordic Walking - II etap
XIII Półmaraton i Ćwierćmaraton
location: Chrzypsko Wielkie, Greater Poland Voivodeship, Poland

name: Midzomer Marathon Apeldoorn
distance_verbose: Marathon, 28 km, Halve marathon, 14 km, 7.5 km
description: The Midzomer Marathon Apeldoorn is a unique running event held on a summer evening through the shady forests of the Veluwe around Apeldoorn. The race offers five distances, ranging from 7.5 km to the full marathon of 42.195 km, with the start and finish at Sportpark Orderbos. The routes mostly follow wide Veluwe paths and forest trails across varied terrain with around 300 metres of elevation gain, making for a challenging and atmospheric experience. Start times are scheduled so that you run into the evening and finish well before sunset, giving the race a special summer ambience.
course_highlights: Run through the shady forests of the Veluwe
Varied terrain with around 300 metres of elevation gain and one-quarter unpaved
Start and finish at Sportpark Orderbos, with the finish in daylight
additional: All five distances start later in the day so you can run into the summer evening. The marathon has a time limit of 5 hours, and participants may bring their own cycling companion to provide support along the course. Parking is free and within walking distance of the start location. Registration includes a finisher’s medal and a Midzomer shirt. On the day, you can switch your entry to a shorter distance free of charge at the event office. The event also relies on volunteers to help with various tasks. Five distances: 7.5 km, 14 km, half marathon, 28 km and marathon; cycling companions are allowed for the half and full marathons; facilities include water and fruit stations, free parking and public transport connections.

name: Flughafenlauf Barth
description: The Barther Airport Run takes place on July 19, 2026, at Stralsund-Barth Airport on the Baltic Sea and offers a varied program of seven races for runners and walkers of all ages. From short distances for young runners to the half-marathon distance, there is something for everyone. The event promises a morning full of activity, fun, and exciting races in a unique setting right at the airport. Walkers are also very welcome, and refreshments will be available on site.

name: Kaszubski Festiwal Biegowy VII Kaszubski Maraton o Wschodzie Słońca
organizer: Ośrodek Sportu i Rekreacji we Władysławowie
description: The Kashubian Running Festival is a unique running event taking place on July 19, 2026, along a scenic route through the towns of Rozewie, Swarzewo, Jastrzębia Góra, and back to Rozewie. The festival offers a range of distances: a marathon, half marathon, and 15 km, 10 km, and 5 km races, so every runner, regardless of experience level, can find a suitable route. The marathon starts at 04:35, allowing participants to experience the remarkable atmosphere of sunrise over Kashubia. After the races, the organizers provide refreshments and a prize draw, creating a festive, sociable atmosphere.

name: Amsterdam Pride Run
description: The Amsterdam Pride Run is a colorful and inclusive running event held during the Pride Amsterdam festivities. Organized by Rainbow Athletics Amsterdam and Pride and Sports, it offers a sporting celebration of diversity and equality. The run takes place in the city of Amsterdam and attracts a broad range of runners and supporters who come together to support the LGBTQ+ community. The atmosphere is festive and unifying, with an emphasis on sportsmanship and inclusion.
course_highlights: Running route through central Amsterdam
Inclusive and festive atmosphere during Pride Amsterdam
Organized by Rainbow Athletics Amsterdam and Pride and Sports
additional: The Amsterdam Pride Run takes place in the afternoon during Pride Amsterdam, with an entry fee ranging from €8 to €18. The event is part of a broader program of queer sports activities organized by Pride and Sports. It has a festive and safe atmosphere, with an emphasis on inclusion and sportsmanship. Route through Flevopark and along the Amsterdam-Rhine Canal; several race options, including a walk and a business run; a colorful and inclusive event during World Pride

name: 34. Lippesee Marathon
location: Lippesee, Paderborn-Sande, Paderborn, North Rhine-Westphalia, Germany
description: The 34th Lippesee Marathon in Paderborn-Sande is a private marathon run held according to the rules of the 100 Marathon Club Germany. The course consists of seven large laps of 6.1 km each, for a total of 42.7 km, around Lippesee, a popular recreational area and water sports center. Participants must provide their own refreshments, as there are no aid stations, and record their time manually. A photo of the clock must be submitted by email as proof. The event is designed for experienced runners aged 18 and over, with a limit of 18 participants, and takes place only if at least five people register.

name: Blefjells Beste
description: Blefjells Beste is a trail race on Blefjell that passes several of the most beautiful places on Store-Ble. The race offers distances of 92, 53, 24, 10 and 5 km, and is a social, informal event for everyone who enjoys being outdoors in the forest and mountains. The start and finish are at Bestebu, a private cabin at Klengstøl. The courses are mainly on trails and mountain terrain, with the final kilometres on gravel roads. Participants must carry all their own food, drink and equipment, as there are no food or drink stations along the way.
course_highlights: Trail race with distances of 92, 53, 24, 10 and 5 km
The courses are mainly on trails and mountain terrain, with 150 to 3,150 metres of elevation gain
Start and finish at the Bestebu cabin at Klengstøl, along Store-Bleveien
additional: The Storetroll course (92 km) consists of completing the other distances—53+24+10+5 km—in sequence. For the 92 km race, there are time limits for passing through the event area: after 1 lap (53 km) by Saturday at 12:00, and after 2 laps (53 + 24 km) by Saturday at 18:00. The 53 km and 24 km courses are not marked by the organiser, while the 5 km and 10 km courses are well marked. Name changes cost 150 kr for the 92, 53 and 24 km distances, and are free for the 10 and 5 km distances. The race requires participants to respect wild reindeer and leave no litter. There are no food or drink stations along the way, but clean water is normally easy to find in the mountains. Participants must carry their own food, drink and equipment; there are no food or drink stations. The event is listed for 23–24 July 2027, with registration opening on 1 December 2026.

name: Bokeler Windmühlenlauf
description: The 20th Bokeler Windmühlenlauf takes place on 24 July 2026 in Bokel. This long-standing anniversary race is organised by ALG-VfL Bokel. The number of participants is limited to 300, and registration is via the RaceResult platform. The race offers runners a special atmosphere in the region and is a popular event for enthusiasts of endurance sports and athletics.
course_highlights: Various race distances (5 km, 10 km, children's race)
Local club atmosphere
Limited to 300 runners
additional: The number of places is limited to 300. The organisational fee covers provision costs and is non-refundable, including in cases of force majeure. Registration is via RaceResult; places are limited to 300. Date: 24.07.2026

name: Fun-Lauf "Durch den Wewerschen Wald"
description: The 33rd Fun Run “Through the Wewer Forest” in Paderborn is a community run with no timing and no entry fee, taking place on 24 July 2026. The event supports children in need through many thousands of steps and asks participants to donate instead. The races take place on flat loop courses with little elevation gain and are suitable for everyone. There are also races for children and young people.
course_highlights: Flat loop course (one lap)
Little elevation gain (30 to 40 metres uphill)
Distance options: 5 km and 7 km
additional: Run with no timing and no entry fee; donations are requested instead. There are races for children and young people. The finish location is not publicly displayed (RUNME Premium required). Runs on flat loop courses, various distances, no timing, no entry fee, donations for charitable causes.

name: 13. Heilwald Marathon
description: The Heilwald Marathon in Bad Lippspringe is a special race held in the heart of the 200-hectare Heilwald, a unique therapeutic and recreational forest in Europe with a soothing low-mountain climate. The course consists of six large laps of 7.05 km each, for a total of 42.3 km, and has been carefully measured using a measuring wheel and GPS. This is a private, self-supported race. Times are recorded manually, and a photo of the clock must be submitted as proof. Participants take part at their own risk. There is no entry fee; instead, voluntary donations for tree planting are welcome.

name: 38. Heiligenhafen Mitternachtslauf
description: The 38th Heiligenhafen Midnight Run takes place on July 24, 2026, offering runners a special experience with late-evening start times. The main race covers 10 km through the town of Heiligenhafen, along the waterfront promenade and around the inland lake, with plenty of support along the course. Additional events include the Binnenseelauf (approx. 5.5 km), the Midnight Run Double Mile (approx. 3.2 km) for young people, and the Mini Midnight Run (approx. 1 km) for children. The event is organized by TSV Heiligenhafen and is a popular tradition, featuring electronic timing and a lively program on race day.

name: Hornsjön Runt
description: Hornsjön Runt is a traditional running race around Öland’s only inland lake, through beautiful and varied Öland countryside. The race offers several distances for both young people and adults, including a walking class. Along the course, participants pass gravel roads with limestone surfaces, grass, cow pastures, deciduous and coniferous forest, and sand dunes. Everyone who finishes receives a medal, and prizes are awarded to the top three in each class.
course_highlights: The race goes around Öland’s only inland lake
Varied terrain including gravel roads, grass, cow pastures, deciduous and coniferous forest, and sand dunes
Three water stations along the course, as well as at the start/finish
additional: A walking class is available for 5.5 km and 11 km, with start times between 13:00 and 16:00 and no timing. Showers and changing facilities are available at Högby Idrottsplats. Prizes are awarded to the top three in all classes. The start and finish are at Pensionat Hornsjön. Youth classes have different start times between 15:30 and 16:00, depending on age and distance. There are distances for children and young people, as well as an untimed walking class. Everyone who finishes receives a medal.

pipeline_log.message: New race date found on official site (https://olandrunning.se/lopp/hornsjon-runt/): 2027-07-24 — "Tid & datum 24 juli 2027" (was estimated 2027-07-17)

name: Bjäre Trail
price_range: 195–425 kr (2026 års ordinarie tidiga anmälningsavgifter; priser för 2027 ej bekräftade)
description: Bjäre Trail is a challenging trail race featuring varied terrain through grazing pastures, old railway embankments and dense beech forests with rushing waterfalls. Runners face steep hills, including an old ski slope, and are rewarded with spectacular views of Laholmsbukten, the northern side of the Bjäre Peninsula and the Halland coastline. The race is held at Båstad Företagsby and welcomes both experienced trail runners and nature lovers looking for a tough, scenic course.
course_highlights: Highly varied terrain with grazing pastures and an old railway embankment
Dense beech forests with rushing waterfalls
Steep hills with views of Laholmsbukten and the Bjäre Peninsula
additional: Maximum 300 starters. Late entries are accepted on site on race day for an additional fee of 100 kr, payable only in even-numbered cash amounts or by SWISH. Bibs must be collected no later than one hour before the start at the start/finish area, or at Bjäre bär’s farm shop on Friday. Toilets are available at Företagsbyn, but there are no changing rooms or showers. Everyone who finishes receives a wooden plaque; winners in each class receive raspberries sponsored by Bjäre bär. Distances are 12, 17, 34 and 51 km. The 34 km and 51 km races consist of two and three laps respectively of the 17 km loop. The race information states a maximum of 300 participants.

name: ÖTILLÖ Gothenburg
description: ÖTILLÖ Swimrun Gothenburg is a unique swimrun race held at the height of summer in Gothenburg’s beautiful archipelago. The race is rooted in a strong local swimrun tradition and features a spectacular course with numerous swims and varied running terrain across islands and rocks. The event is easy to reach by ferry from the mainland and offers a fantastic combination of nature experiences and spectator support. It is a perfect race for both experienced swimrunners and curious participants who want to experience the sport in a scenic setting.
course_highlights: A combination of fast running sections and intense swims
A course through the West Coast archipelago of Gothenburg, with many islands and islets
Magnificent coastal and archipelago scenery, with plenty of spectators along the course
additional: The race offers three distances: World Series (approx. 39.7 km with 29 running sections and 28 swims), Sprint (approx. 22.8 km with 18 running sections and 17 swims), and Experience. The start and finish are at Styrsö Bratten. Ferries run regularly from Saltholmen and Stenpiren to the event area. Mandatory equipment is available to buy at the start/finish area. A large team of volunteers helps out along the course and at the event. The awards ceremony takes place after the race. Check-in is at Styrsöskolan. The event offers the Experience, Sprint, and World Series distances.

pipeline_log.message: New race date found on official site (https://otilloswimrun.com/races/gothenburg-sweden/gothenburg-world-series/): 2027-07-24 — "saturday, July 24th, 2027 ... 08:11 Start World Series" (was estimated 2027-07-31)

name: Kyststien Trail Ultra

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Preliminärt pris for løpet 2027 er 500 kr pluss eventuelt 100 kr for transport.

description: Kyststien Trail Ultra is an unforgettable 50 km ultramarathon along the Coastal Trail from Helgeroa to Gon Camping. The race offers varied terrain, including idyllic sandy beaches, technical trails along cliffs and coves, and spectacular panoramic views of the sea and lush countryside. It is a challenge that requires good preparation, with demanding climbs and descents, but also offers the joy of running and a wonderful sense of community among participants. The race celebrates nature and a passion for running, and encourages respect for the surroundings.
course_highlights: 50 km along the Coastal Trail over varied terrain: sand, grass, mountains, stairs, rocks, roots and gravel
Spectacular panoramic views of the sea, cliffs and lush countryside
Technical coastal trails with demanding climbs and descents
additional: Race bibs can be collected the evening before or on race day. The finish at Gonhytta offers water, drinks, snacks and hot soup. Prizes for the top 3 women and men, plus a race-bib raffle. All finishers receive a locally made birch medal. There is an opportunity to take a free hot shower and a cold sea swim. The race has 5 staffed aid stations with first aid, toilets, drinks and snacks. The course is marked with blue blazes and additional signs; a GPX file is recommended for navigation. Maximum 180 participants; a waiting list will be available if the race fills up. The start is at Blokkebukta camping, with the finish at Gonhytta at Gon Camping. Participants are provided with refreshments and a free hot shower, and all finishers receive a medal made from local birch.

name: 10. NORDERNEY - meine Insel Lauf
price_range: 25 EUR für Erwachsene, 20 EUR für Kids
description: The NORDERNEY - meine Insel Lauf is a maritime race held annually on the North Sea island of Norderney since 2016. The event offers a unique running experience amid the island’s natural surroundings and special atmosphere. The routes pass through the historic Kurplatz and by landmarks such as Napoleonschanze, Schwanenteich and the island windmill. The race is suitable for all age groups and includes distances from the Bambini Run to the half marathon.
course_highlights: Start and finish at the historic Kurplatz, beside the Conversationshaus and Badehaus
Past Napoleonschanze, the oldest monument on Norderney
Through the lively shopping streets, with spectators cheering runners on
additional: The official technical T-shirt can be ordered during registration and is distributed with the race pack. It costs EUR 25 for adults and EUR 20 for children. Late entries are possible online until 22.07.2026 for a fee, and in person on 24 and 25.07.2026. Timing is by ChampionChip; chip rental costs between EUR 3 and EUR 5, depending on the race. A preferred race number is available for an additional EUR 3. Cut-off times: 1:15h for 10 km and 2:30h for the half marathon. Island and maritime theme, sustainable technical T-shirt, in-person registration, online results, ferry connections for participants, test run on the day before the race, certificates and medals for children

name: 6. GEO-Pfad Ultramarathon
description: The GEO-Pfad Ultramarathon is a 50 km trail run starting in Kaltenweide, Langenhagen, Germany. The route has a modest elevation gain of about 350 meters and must be completed within 8 hours. The course passes through forest and trail sections, by Brelinger Berg with its geological nature trail, and back along Bissendorfer Moor. The event is registered with the German Ultramarathon Association and offers online results, certificates, and finisher medals.

name: FriesenCross
description: The Friesencross in Schillig is one of Germany’s most extraordinary cross-country running events and takes place on July 25, 2026. The course runs right along the beach and offers a unique natural experience along the UNESCO World Heritage Site of the Wadden Sea. Runners cross soft sandy beaches, green meadows and even the muddy seabed, perfectly combining a sporting challenge with a North Sea feel. The event is hosted by running-sports presenter Heino Krüger, who guides the day with extensive experience. The Friesian Festival takes place alongside the race, bringing atmosphere, music and culinary highlights.

name: Mulsumer Speckenlauf
description: The Mulsumer Speckenlauf is a traditional running event held annually by TSV Mulsum. The event takes place at the Mulsum sports ground in the Wurster North Sea Coast municipality and attracts numerous runners. The course offers a sporting challenge in a friendly atmosphere. In addition to the main race, there is also a children’s sports festival featuring classic events, underscoring the family-friendly nature of the occasion.

name: 26. Bieg Dookoła Morynia i Jeziora Morzycko
description: Join us for the 26th edition of the Run Around Moryń and Lake Morzycko, a unique event combining sporting competition with the beauty of Western Pomerania. The course follows a scenic route around Lake Morzycko, offering participants unforgettable views and a sense of sporting community. It’s a great opportunity for runners and fans of an active lifestyle to meet in Moryń and enjoy exercising outdoors. Whatever your experience level, there’s something here for everyone.

name: 24 Bieg Uliczny św. Jakuba
description: The 24th St. James Street Run is an annual sporting event held in Lębork to celebrate the city’s patron saint. The race follows a certified 10 km course through the city streets, with appropriate security provided by the authorities. The ceremonial start takes place at Pokoju Square, and the race start is on Armii Krajowej Street. The finish is at Pokoju Square in front of the stage. Participants must be at least 16 years old and obey traffic regulations.

name: Botaniczna Piątka edycja letnia
description: Botaniczna Piątka Gdynia – Summer Edition is a cross-country race organized by running enthusiasts since 2014. The event takes place on scenic routes that showcase the beauty of the location. The organizers aim to promote running and provide participants with a unique sporting and scenic experience. It’s a great opportunity to spend time actively in the beautiful surroundings of Gdynia.

name: Hel - Rysy
location: Hel, Puck County, Pomeranian Voivodeship, Poland

name: Moore DRV Run Maasdijk

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Inschrijfgeld 10 Km  € 13,- Dit is exclusief SAW chip.

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Inschrijfgeld 5 Km  € 12,- Dit is exclusief SAW chip.

description: The Moore DRV Run Maasdijk is a friendly running race in the Westland, held during the Zomerspektakel in Maasdijk. The main distance is 10 kilometres on a traffic-free, fast asphalt course through the polder and along iconic dikes. There is also a 5 km race, the 5 van DAEL, and a youth run for children up to 12 years old. After the finish, participants receive an original running shirt and excellent refreshments at the atmospheric finish field.
course_highlights: Traffic-free course through the polder and along dikes
Entirely paved, fast asphalt course with water stations
Iconic finish location in the village of Maasdijk
additional: Race numbers can be collected on race day from 10:30 at the canteen of korfbalvereniging Dijkvogels, Lange Kruisweg 44F in Maasdijk. The 5 km starts at 14:00, followed by the 10 km at 14:10. Changing and shower facilities are available at the korfbalvereniging. Results are recorded using a SAW chip, which costs €4.50 as a one-time fee and is not included in the entry fee. The youth run takes place without a chip. The race is held during the Zomerspektakel in Maasdijk and offers a friendly atmosphere for all ages, including youth activities and special keepsakes for participants.

name: Volkswandertag
description: The Volkswandertag in Bollensen is an annual event held on the last Sunday in July, open to hikers of all ages. A range of family-friendly routes takes participants along forest trails through the beautiful Solling region. The marathon and half-marathon hikes are circular routes starting and finishing at the TSV Bollensen sports hall. All routes are marked and have refreshment stations. The event has a relaxed atmosphere, with food and drinks in the finish area and a strong sense of community.

name: 13 Nadmorski Bieg Uzdrowiskowy
description: The Nadmorski Health Resort Run is an annual running event held in the picturesque village of Dąbki in the West Pomeranian Voivodeship. The event promotes physical activity and a healthy lifestyle, as well as the attractions of the Dąbki Health Resort and the Darłowo Municipality. It includes races for children and young people, a 10 km race, and special accompanying events such as the Health Resort Sea Mile. The organizers offer a full program and attractive prizes, and the course runs through charming health resort grounds.

name: Botaniczna Piątka edycja letnia
organizer: Zachodniopomorskie Centrum Kultury Obszarów Wiejskich i Edukacji Ekologicznej
description: Botaniczna Piątka — Summer Edition is a 5 km race held in the picturesque Przelewice Dendrological Garden. It’s a great opportunity to combine physical activity with relaxation amid greenery and nature. The event is part of the Botaniczna Piątka series and is co-organized by the West Pomeranian Voivodeship. Participants receive a commemorative medal shaped like a water lily, and the main race starts at 10:00.

name: V Bursztynowy Półmaraton Jantar
location: Jantar, Gmina Stegna, Pomeranian Voivodeship, Poland

name: 43. Flora-Westfalica Marathon
description: The Flora-Westfalica Marathon in Rheda-Wiedenbrück is a private marathon run held under the rules of the 100 Marathon Club Germany. The course consists of seven large loops of 6.10 km each, for a total of 42.7 km, and is marked with arrows or barrier tape depending on the weather. The event emphasizes self-sufficiency, as runners pass their cars after each loop. Marathon times are recorded with a handheld stopwatch, and a certificate is sent by email. Participants must be at least 18 years old. There is no entry fee, but a voluntary donation of €5 is requested.

name: 4 PolandRockowy Bieg Policz się z cukrzy...
location: Broczyno, Czaplinek, West Pomeranian Voivodeship, Poland

name: 39e Kooyman Polderloop
description: The Kooyman Polderloop is an annual running race in De Kwakel, organized by Atletiek Vereniging Aalsmeer. This popular race takes place during a beautiful summer of sport and attracts many participants, including many AVA members. The event offers an enjoyable, sporty evening with a challenging course through the polder landscape. It is a fixture in the region and is known for its friendly, accessible atmosphere.
course_highlights: Run through the distinctive polder landscape
Evening race with a sporty, welcoming atmosphere
Organized by the local athletics club, AVA Aalsmeer
additional: The start is usually at AVA, Sportlaan 43, Aalsmeer. There is a sociable post-race gathering with coffee or tea in the clubhouse. The club also organizes walking groups and running courses, strengthening the sporting community. Registration is via Inschrijven.nl; the event is part of the Polderfeest, which features activities such as food festivals, performances, and family activities over several days.

name: Kvitfjell Stuttlaup
description: Kvitfjell Stuttlaup is a 13-kilometre trail race featuring technical trails and varied terrain in beautiful Kvitfjell. The race starts at Kvitfjelleggen and finishes at Tyrihanstunet, with approximately 240 metres of elevation gain. Known for its challenging and fun trails, the race is part of Lauparfestivalen, which also includes several other races and activities. Participants can look forward to a great mountain running experience, a lively atmosphere and the option to buy food in the finish area.
course_highlights: 13 km with approximately 8 km of trail and 5 km of gravel road
Technical and fun trail on the west side of Svinåa
240 metres of elevation gain over varied terrain
additional: Race bibs can be collected from 11:00 at the start. There is a drinks and food station at Svinslåvangen after 8.5 km. Parking is not available at the start. Recommended parking locations are Skitorget, by Tyrihans, along the roads towards the top (west side), or at Gudbrandsgard Hotel (east side). Carpooling is organised, with participants meeting at 10:00 in the parking area at the bottom of Vestsideløypa. Food can be purchased from Tyrihanstunet in the finish area. The race does not provide sports drinks or gels, in order to keep the event simple and affordable. The festival website lists the event as 24–25 July, which does not match the stated race date of 30 July 2027.

name: Kvitfjell Langlaup
description: Kvitfjell Running Festival offers three challenging races through varied terrain in Ringebu, Innlandet. Kvitfjell Opp is a brutal uphill race up the Olympic downhill course, climbing 838 metres over 3.2 km. Langlaupet is a 25 km long-distance race with 19 km of trail and 6.5 km of road, offering an extra challenge for those who want more after the uphill race. Stuttlaupet is a 13 km race with technical trails and gravel roads, perfect for those looking for a shorter but challenging mountain run. All races finish at Tyrihanstunet, where good food and a social atmosphere are also on offer.
course_highlights: Kvitfjell Opp: 3.2 km uphill race climbing 838 metres up the Olympic downhill course
Langlaupet: 25 km through varied terrain, with 19 km of trail and 6.5 km of gravel road; highest point approximately 1,100 metres above sea level
Stuttlaupet: 13 km with approximately 8 km of trail and 5 km of gravel road; a technical and enjoyable course
additional: Race bibs are distributed at the start of each race. Kvitfjell Opp starts by the lift at the bottom, while Langlaupet and Stuttlaupet start from Kvitfjelleggen behind the summit café. There are refreshment stations along Langlaupet and Stuttlaupet, as well as a refreshment station on Kvitfjell Opp at the mid-station. For Kvitfjell Opp, parking is recommended at the mid-station; for Langlaupet and Stuttlaupet, parking is recommended at Skitorget or Gudbrandsgard Hotel. A children’s race starts at 13:00 on Saturday during the festival, with a medal and drink at the finish. Talks and an after-run event are also part of the festival. Langlaupet is part of Kvitfjell Running Festival, which also includes Kvitfjell Opp and Stuttlaupet. Weather conditions can change in the mountains.

name: Kvitfjell Lauparfestival 2027
description: Kvitfjell Running Festival 2027 takes place in Kvitfjell from 27 to 31 July 2027. The festival offers a varied programme of sport and culture, with tickets available through EQ Timing. The event starts early in the day and continues until late in the evening, offering participants a great experience in beautiful surroundings.
course_highlights: Kvitfjell Uphill follows the former Olympic downhill course up the mountain.
The approximately 25 km long-distance race traverses varied terrain, including trails and gravel roads.
The short race offers a shorter 13 km trail-running distance.
additional: Tickets are sold through EQ Timing. The event runs from early morning until late evening. It takes place in Kvitfjell, with a map and directions available on the website. The programme also includes an uphill race for children, talks at Tyrihanstunet, and an after-run.

name: 07. Stadtholz Marathon
description: The Stadtholz Marathon in Rheda-Wiedenbrück is a run at Heideteich, with a 6.14 km trail per lap. The event is not competition-focused, but is aimed at runners who enjoy running in nature. The marathon is being held to mark Evi Köppe-Neeb’s linen wedding anniversary and offers a special atmosphere at Heideteich. The course features natural trails and a peaceful setting.

name: Springe-Deister-Sommerlauf
description: The Springe-Deister Summer Run on July 31, 2026, features a measured 5 km loop course at the foot of the Kleiner Deister. The course is approved by the German Athletics Association (DLV), so results can be included in rankings. Kilometer markers are clearly signposted, and the course is gently hilly, with an elevation difference of about 20 meters. The run starts at 5:45 p.m. at Schulzentrum Süd (OHG) in Springe and is aimed at runners looking for an attractive, officially sanctioned race in the region.

name: Falkenbergs Stadslopp

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: 450 kr fram till och med 20:e juli 2027

description: Falkenbergs Stadslopp is a 10 km city race that passes through central Falkenberg and beautiful summer scenery. The race is a community celebration and a running highlight in Halland, welcoming both beginners and experienced runners. The course is fast and easy to run, with fantastic crowd support along the way. The start and finish are both at Falkenbergs Idrottsplats, creating a smooth and enjoyable overall experience for participants.
course_highlights: 10 km through central Falkenberg and beautiful summer scenery
Fast, easy-to-run course with two water stations along the route
Start and finish at Falkenbergs Idrottsplats, with good facilities and crowd support
additional: The start and finish are both at Falkenbergs Idrottsplats. A warm-up with Nordic Wellness takes place at 11:40 in the start area. The awards ceremony takes place at 13:00 in the finish area. Bib numbers can be collected at Team Sportia on the Thursday and Friday before the race, and on race day from 9:00. Changing rooms and bag drop are available on race day. Massage is offered in the finish area after the race. Falkenbergs Stadslopp is the 2027 district championship and is part of Tour de Falkenberg. Start groups are marked with flags according to runners’ estimated pace per kilometre, for safety. The kiosk is open 10:00–14:00. There are two water stations on the course, at 3 km and 8 km, as well as one at the finish.
