tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Sista dag för ordinarie anmälan är fredagen den 17 juli.

description: Bruksleden Trail Marathon is a trail race organised by Fagersta OK, offering two distances: 42 km (Helan) and 21 km (Halvan). The race follows the beautiful Bruksleden trail through forests, winding paths and past lakes, with varied and technically challenging terrain. With a limited number of 200 places, the event has a friendly, welcoming atmosphere. There are aid stations along the course staffed by volunteers, and after the finish, showers and a light meal are available. This is an ideal race for experienced trail runners and curious recreational runners alike who want to enjoy nature and a challenge.
course_highlights: Run through beautiful forests and along winding woodland trails
Pass sparkling lakes
Varied and technically challenging terrain with steep climbs and descents
additional: Places are limited to 200 to preserve a friendly atmosphere. There are aid stations along the course staffed by volunteers. Showers and a light meal are available after the finish. Previous editions have started and finished in the area around Fageråsen/Fagersta; the arrangements, distances and practical information for 2027 have not been confirmed.

name: PRB (Växjö)
description: PRB is a challenging and tactical running race where participants run a 6,706-metre course, with a start every hour on the hour. To continue in the race, runners must start each lap, in accordance with last-man-standing rules and Backyard Ultra standards. The course is easy to run and varied, with asphalt and gravel/trail sections. It is located on the southern shore of Lake Trummen in Växjö, with good opportunities to rest and access services in the lap area. Participants can enjoy a scenic setting close to a playground, skatepark, swimming area and café. After completing at least one lap, runners receive a medal and a finisher beer as a reward.
course_highlights: 6,706-metre course with approximately 35 metres of elevation gain
Each lap has approximately 3 km of asphalt, with the rest on gravel/trail
Starts every hour on the hour, with all participants starting together
additional: The lap area offers an energy table with sports drink, water, Coca-Cola, coffee, sweets, crisps and fruit. A cooked meal is served every six hours, starting after four hours. There is space to set up a reclining chair and a small tent. Recommended parking costs 10 kr/day and is located at ICA Kvantum Teleborg. Littering results in immediate disqualification. The nearest bus stop is Trummenvägen by ICA, served by route 3. Backyard Ultra format, with a start every hour on the hour and last-man-standing rules. A previous edition was described as a Silver Ticket event.

name: HTV-SPARDA-Rheinuferlauf, 46. Int. Volkslauf mit HM
description: The HTV-SPARDA-Rheinuferlauf in Duisburg is a traditional road race with a flat course along the Rhine. On 25 July 2026, events will be held over 5 km, 7.5 km walking, 10 km and the half marathon (21.1 km). The flat course makes the race appealing to runners of all abilities. All events share the same finish line, and the event offers a pleasant atmosphere for recreational and competitive runners.
course_highlights: Flat course along the Rhine
Events over 5 km, 7.5 km walking, 10 km and the half marathon
All events finish at the same location
additional: Start times: 7.5 km walking at 15:00, 5 km run at 16:50, 10 km run at 17:40, half marathon at 17:30. All events take place on a flat course. Results will be published on the RUNME results page. The event takes place on 25 July 2026 and offers start times for various events. Results will be available shortly after the races finish. The event is particularly appealing in good weather.

name: Sechs-Std.-Lauf am Förderturm Bönen
location: Ehemaliges Zechengelände, Bönen, North Rhine-Westphalia, Germany
description: The Six-Hour Run at the Bönen Headframe is a unique ultrarunning event held on an officially measured loop course at a former colliery site. The course is traffic-free, gently undulating, and consists of asphalt and compact gravel. The event offers comprehensive refreshments, including vegan options, and professional lap counting via race result. With a minimum age of 20, the run is aimed at experienced ultrarunners who want to test their endurance in a friendly, well-organized atmosphere.
course_highlights: Loop course at a former colliery site, traffic-free
Lap length: 1,340 m; surface: asphalt and compact gravel
Officially measured course with gentle undulations
additional: Race bib pickup on event day from 07:00 to 08:30. Showers and changing facilities are available at the nearby Goethe Sports Hall and in the Förderturm Shaft Hall (not supervised; no liability is accepted). A variety of food and drinks, including vegan options, will be provided before and during the run. Laps are counted electronically via race result, with measurement of the remaining distance. First aid is provided by the German Red Cross local branch in Bönen (DRK-Ortsverein Bönen e.V.). Awards ceremony at approximately 16:00. Minimum age: 20. Maximum 200 participants; on-site registration is possible for a €10 fee. Loop course at a former colliery site, vegan refreshments, race bib pickup 07:00–08:30, minimum age 20.

name: Markttagelauf
description: The Markttage Run in Bredstedt is an international charity run, with entry fees donated to a good cause. There are different distances for children, beginners and experienced runners, taking them through Bredstedt’s town centre. The event fosters community spirit and offers a sporting challenge for all age groups. Registration is online, and the entry fees are moderate to make it accessible to as many people as possible.
course_highlights: Different routes for children, beginners and experienced runners
Run through Bredstedt’s town centre
International charity run
additional: Registration is online only, until 30.07., at www.my.raceresult.com. Entry fees are donated. Note: The event information PDF is currently not accessible. Several distances for different ability levels; event in August 2026; children participate for free, adults pay up to 5 euros.

name: 18. Ottonenlauf
description: The Ottonenlauf is a scenic race in the Harz that brings runners from three different villages to a shared finish in Quedlinburg, a UNESCO World Heritage city. The 21.1 km, 42.2 km, and 69 km routes start in Stiege, Alexisbad, and Meisdorf, respectively. The route runs mostly along forest and woodland trails through the Selke Valley, with shaded forests, rural sections, and moderate climbs that call for a good pace. Walking and Nordic walking options are also available, making the event open to a wide range of participants. Electronic timing and finisher medals round out the event.

name: 24. Hella Marathon Nacht
description: The hella marathon night rostock is an atmospheric sunset run set against the picturesque backdrop of the Haedgehalbinsel in Rostock’s city harbor. The event offers races over the marathon, half marathon, Rostocker 7 km, and a children’s race. All start at dusk and finish in a brightly lit finish area. The route passes through the Warnow Tunnel and IGA Park, among other places, and is kept traffic-free. The event combines a sporting challenge with Northern German hospitality and a holiday atmosphere.

name: adidas Runners City Night
description: The adidas Runners City Night Berlin is a unique summer event that combines running and inline skating with a big party on the famous Kurfürstendamm. The event offers 5 km and 10 km routes for runners, as well as a 10 km inline skating route through the vibrant City West. Live bands, cheering zones, and enthusiastic fans create an electrifying atmosphere that makes the race an unforgettable experience. The finish at the Kaiser Wilhelm Memorial Church, with its illuminated finish arch, rounds off the sporting night perfectly.

name: hella marathon nacht rostock
description: The hella marathon nacht rostock is an atmospheric sunset run along the Warnow, with a maritime flair and Hanseatic hospitality. The event takes place in August in Rostock and offers races over the marathon, half marathon, Rostocker 7 and a students’ run. The start and finish are at Rostock’s city harbor, where runners set off at dusk and finish beneath bright lights. The course passes through the Warnow Tunnel and IGA Park, among other places, making for a unique running experience.

name: Hemfurth-Edersee-Abendlauf
description: The Hemfurth-Edersee Evening Run is a traditional late-summer race that brings runners of all ages together in the beautiful surroundings of Edertal-Hemfurth. In pleasant temperatures and as the sun sets, the focus is on the joy of movement and a sense of community. At the finish, participants can enjoy refreshments, good music, and a sociable get-together in a relaxed atmosphere. The race is organized by volunteers from TSV 08 Hemfurth-Edersee e.V. and is a popular event for ambitious runners, recreational joggers, and families.

name: 32. Bieg św. Dominika
description: The St. Dominic’s International Run is a prestigious running event held annually in Gdańsk since 1994, and an integral part of St. Dominic’s Fair. The race attracts more than 1,200 participants and tens of thousands of spectators, offering a unique atmosphere in the city’s historic centre. The course runs through the picturesque streets of Gdańsk’s Old Town, and the event promotes a healthy lifestyle and social integration. The running festival features several races, including the 5 km Women’s Run, the 5 km Men’s Run, and the Polish 10 km Championships.

name: Arm Race Kamień
description: ARM Race Kamień is an extreme OCR obstacle course race that welcomes both professionals and amateurs looking for an adrenaline rush. It’s a challenge for the whole family, including children, offering unusual entertainment and the opportunity to overcome personal weaknesses. The race is among the elite events of its kind in Poland and continues to grow, giving participants unforgettable experiences.

name: TGS - Trail Genom Skåne
description: TGS - Trail Genom Skåne is a trail race offering several distances, with the start and finish at Trädhuset in Hovdala, Hässleholm. The races follow beautiful trails in the Göinge and Hovdala nature reserves, with a focus on minimizing asphalt and traffic exposure for a more immersive and technical running experience. TGS 60 consists of two laps (35+25 km), while TGS 35 and TGS 25 correspond to the first and second laps of the 60 km race, respectively. TGS 10 is a shorter distance that follows approximately the final 10 km of the longer races. Runners of all levels are welcome to enjoy the forest and the challenges of trail running.
course_highlights: Run on beautiful trails in the Göinge and Hovdala nature reserves
Less than 3 km on asphalt and only one major road crossing
Technical, nature-focused course with varied terrain
additional: TGS 60 has a lap point at 35.1 km, with a cutoff time of 13:30. Aid stations with food, water, cola and sports drink are located at several points along the course. The maximum time limit for TGS 60 is 9 hours and 15 minutes. The finish closes at 17:00 for TGS 35 and TGS 25. TGS 10 starts at 13:45. All distances start and finish at Trädhuset in Hovdala. The race offers a technical, nature-focused experience with minimal asphalt and traffic exposure. The distances are approximately 10.2 km, 26.6 km, 35.1 km and 61.7 km. For the 2026 edition, free parking near the start and finish is listed, and a post-race meal is included in the entry fee.

name: Nordkirchener Halbmarathon

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: 15 EUR bei Anmeldungen bis zum 15. Juni

tiers.label: tier_2
tiers.description: 17 EUR bei Anmeldung vom 16. Juni bis 27. Juli

description: The Nordkirchen Half Marathon takes place on August 2, 2026, and offers a scenic course through Nordkirchen Castle Park and the Obsen farming community. Runners start at the stadium in Castle Park, complete two laps of the stadium, and then run a nearly 10-kilometer loop through picturesque parkland and villages. Several aid stations along the route provide refreshments for participants. The finish is back at the stadium, where spectators can cheer on the runners and enjoy a lovely time together.
course_highlights: Start and finish at the stadium in Nordkirchen Castle Park
Run through the expansive castle park with views of the castle
Loop through the Obsen farming community, where enthusiastic neighbors cheer runners on
additional: Personal refreshments can be dropped off before the start (8:00–8:45 a.m.). Water stations are located at km 4.5, 7, 9, 10.5, 14, 16.5, and 18.5. On-site late registration is available until 8:00 a.m. for an additional fee of EUR 3. Bibs with timing chips for electronic timekeeping will be issued and collected after the race, but participants may keep them as souvenirs. The course goes through Castle Park and Obsen, with the start and finish at the stadium in Castle Park. Registration is available online and on race day. Live results are available. Parking is available at the stadium, Nordkirchen Comprehensive School, and the Sundern car park.

name: 10. Charity-Lauf Koldingen
description: The Koldingen Charity Run is part of the Sparkassen Laufpass of the Hanover Region, one of Germany’s largest running series, with 43 events in 2026. Runners can explore the Hanover Region on foot and collect stamps in their running pass each time they take part. The run offers a varied course in the beautiful surroundings of Pattensen and promotes recreational sport in the region. The event is open to everyone who wants to be active while doing good.

name: 55. Volkslauf Rund um Wellen
description: The 55th Rund um Wellen Fun Run will take place on August 2, 2026, in Beverstedt-Wellen. It is one of Germany’s oldest marathon races and has a family-friendly atmosphere. The event offers challenging courses over four distances: the marathon, half marathon, 11 km and 5 km, some of which are officially measured by the German Athletics Association (DLV). The route passes through varied landscapes, including forest paths and surfaces of different types. The event is organized by TSV Wellen and is supported by many volunteers from the village.

name: Voss Løpskarusell 4
description: Voss Running Series is a running series for everyone, with 5 km races that start and finish at Idrettsplassen in Voss. The course goes through Prestegardsmoen and along the waterfront promenade, and is suitable for both recreational runners and runners aged 9 and up. The races are held on Mondays, starting at 19:00, and you can sign up for individual races or all six races together. This is a friendly recreational race that welcomes everyone to take part and enjoy Voss’s running community.
course_highlights: 5 km course starting and finishing at Idrettsplassen
Route through Prestegardsmoen
Run along the waterfront promenade
additional: Registration is online via EQ Timing. A discount is available when registering for all six races by the second race; otherwise, you can register for each race individually. The fifth race starts at 18:30 instead of 19:00. Search for “Voss Løpskarusell 2027” on EQ Timing to register.

name: Voss Løpskarusell 2027, løp 4
description: Voss Running Series 2027 is a running series for everyone, with races on Mondays at 19:00. The course is 5 km long, starting and finishing at Voss Sports Ground, and runs through Prestegardsmoen and along the promenade. The event welcomes recreational runners and runners aged 9 and up to enjoyable fun runs in scenic surroundings. Registration is online, with a discount for signing up for all six races by the second race.
course_highlights: 5 km course starting and finishing at Voss Sports Ground
Loop through Prestegardsmoen
Run along the promenade
additional: Registration is online only via EQ Timing. You can register for all six races together at a discounted rate if you sign up by the second race. The fifth race starts at 18:30, while the others start at 19:00. You can register for individual races or get a discount by signing up for all six races by race 2.

name: Esenser Volksbanklauf - 31. Stadtlauf
description: The 31st Esens City Run, held as the 6th Esenser Volksbank Run, takes place on Friday, July 31, 2026, in Esens. The traditional “Around St. Magnus” run offers exciting races in the city center for runners of all ages. The event begins with the 670-meter Bambini run, followed by student races over 1,340 meters. Adults can compete over five and ten kilometers, with both races starting at the same time. The awards ceremonies take place immediately after the races.
course_highlights: “Around St. Magnus” run in Esens city center
670-meter Bambini run
Adult races over 5 and 10 kilometers
additional: Start times: Bambini run at 18:10, student race at 18:30, and adult 5 km and 10 km races at 19:30. Awards ceremonies take place immediately after the races. Online registration is available. Start and finish at Esens Market Square; online registration available; July weather: approx. 25°C, sunny

name: Berglauf
description: TuS Ovenhausen 1924 e.V. warmly invites you to the hill run in Höxter, which features a challenging course with varied terrain. The event includes a children’s hill run of approx. 1 km and a main race of approx. 3.2 km, with a steady climb and an elevation gain of about 170 meters. The course starts at the sports field and runs over grassy areas, asphalt paths, meadow trails, and narrow gravel and forest paths, finishing in the woods. This long-standing running event welcomes runners of all ages.

name: Gifhorner Friedhofslauf
description: The Gifhorn Cemetery Run is a special event held at the St. Nicolai Protestant Lutheran Cemetery in Gifhorn. Runners can choose between 4- and 8-kilometer routes. After the run, participants gather for a relaxed barbecue and drinks under the apple trees. Traditionally held in the evening, the event combines sporting activity with a relaxed atmosphere in a historic setting.

name: Stora Stöten Run
description: Stora Stöten Run is a trail race in the heart of the Falun Mine World Heritage Site, offering a historic and varied running experience. The course passes medieval smelting sites, mining farmsteads, dams and dam houses, following old routes known as Vattnets Väg till Gruvan (The Water’s Way to the Mine). The race has three distances (21.6 km, 13.6 km and 5.6 km) and welcomes both competitive runners and recreational participants, with the option to run timed or untimed. The event is organised by the orienteering club OK Kåre, which welcomes participants to the start and finish at Falun Mine.
course_highlights: Three courses: 21.6 km, 13.6 km and 5.6 km, starting and finishing at Falun Mine
The course passes medieval smelting sites, mining farmsteads, dams and dam houses along Vattnets Väg
Varied terrain: gravel, grass, trail tracks, nature paths and short paved sections; an initial climb and clearly marked downhill sections
additional: Start and finish at Falun Mine; warm-up begins at 12:10 on Falu Rödfärg’s paved area (approximately 7 minutes), led by Friskis & Svettis; all courses start at the same time, and runners are divided into two optional groups based on target pace (group 1: women ≤6 min/km, men ≤5 min/km). Runners can choose to run with or without timing; prizes go to the first three finishers on each course, with raffle prizes for other participants; teams can be registered (teams of 3), and registrations can be transferred free of charge through the registration system. The race information mentions aid stations/water stops, parking, race office, showers/changing facilities and course markings. All three courses start and finish at Falun Mine; results from previous years are available.

name: Ölands Marathon
description: Öland Marathon is a flat, easy-to-run marathon starting and finishing in the square in Löttorp. The course consists of a 2.1 km loop in Löttorp, followed by an 11.2 km loop run three times, for a total distance of 42,195 metres, entirely on asphalt. During the race, runners have views of Blå Jungfrun and pass three aid stations per lap offering sports drink, cola and water. All finishers receive a unique medal made of Öland limestone, and the women’s and men’s winners each win dinner for two at Kalk in Löttorp.
course_highlights: Flat, easy-to-run course
100% asphalt
Three aid stations per lap offering sports drink, cola and water
additional: Bib numbers can be collected from 12:00 on race day. Personal energy supplies must be handed in at least one hour before the start. Accommodation is available in four-bed cabins at Högby IP. Prizes are awarded to all age-group winners and the top overall finishers.

name: Svartåloppet
location: Svartå Folkets hus, Svartå, Degerfors Municipality, Örebro County, Sweden
description: Svartåloppet is a fun run held on the second Saturday in August, starting and finishing at Svartå Folkets hus. The race offers three distances: 2.5 km on flat roads, and 5.5 km and 14 km on hilly forest roads and trails. Timing is handled by Racetimer, providing a modern and reliable system. The race is open to all ages and has a long tradition in Svartå, dating back to the 20th century.
course_highlights: The 5.5 km and 14 km courses are hilly forest routes on forest roads and trails
The 2.5 km course is a flatter road route
Start and finish at Svartå Folkets hus
additional: Timing is handled by Racetimer using a modern and reliable timing system. Svartå IF is the organizer and has its own facilities, including a floodlit trail and club cabin at Hyttvallen. Results from several past years are available via Racetimer. The start and finish are at Svartå Folkets hus. Timing is handled by Racetimer.

name: Bunketorp Backyard Ultra Trail
description: Bunketorp Backyard Ultra Trail is a challenging last-person-standing competition held in scenic Bunketorp in Lindome, south of Gothenburg. Participants run a 6,706-metre course on pleasant, well-trodden forest trails and exercise tracks, with a start every hour on the hour. Each lap must be completed within the hour to continue, and the runner who completes the most laps wins. The course is hilly, with around 140 metres of elevation gain per lap, and offers beautiful forest scenery and varied terrain. The event provides a welcoming atmosphere with good service and support for both runners and their companions.
course_highlights: A 6,706-metre course on soft forest exercise tracks and trails
A hilly course with around 140 metres of elevation gain per lap and three major climbs
Beautiful, varied terrain with no asphalt or gravel roads
additional: The race starts every hour on the hour, with all participants starting at the same time. Participants must be in the starting pen at the start and may not cross the start line and then go back. The venue has changing rooms with showers and a sauna, toilets, a participant tent for storage and rest, an aid station, refreshments for companions, secure storage for valuables, and first aid. There is no age limit; participation is at your own risk. Prizes are awarded to the top three women, the top three men, and the best team (3 runners).

name: Istrun - Skaras snabba halvmara
description: Istrun is a fast, flat half marathon in Skara with approximately 70 metres of elevation gain, making it a perfect course for setting personal records. The race is organised by Istrums SK - Friidrott and welcomes both recreational and competitive runners. The distance is 21.1 km, and the course is designed to be fast and easy to run. Runners who are not members of a club affiliated with the Swedish Athletics Association can register through M Motion or K Motion.
course_highlights: Flat and fast course
Approximately 70 metres of elevation gain
Suitable for personal records
additional: The race is listed as fully booked. For questions or to join the waiting list: istrun@istrumssk.se.

description: Häv & Gräv Vikbovändan is a recreational race held on Vikbolandet in Östergötland during the summer. The main event is approximately 45 km long and features a scenic route with both gravel and asphalt sections. Along the way, participants can enjoy local delicacies at several aid stations. The event offers running, cycling and duo categories, as well as a children's race in the forest on illuminated trails. It is a welcoming, nature-oriented experience focused on community and local flavours.
course_highlights: Approximately 45 km, with a 50/50 mix of gravel and asphalt
Aid stations with locally produced delicacies and the opportunity to visit production facilities and a shop
Children's race in the forest on illuminated trails, with a medal and ice cream afterwards
additional: Start times: Children's race 10:30, Running + duo 11:30, Cycling 12:30. The children's race is free and does not require advance registration. Helmets are mandatory for cycling. All participants who register in advance receive a collapsible cup to use at the aid stations to avoid disposable cups. On-site registration may be available if places remain, up until 30 minutes before the start. Participants who register in advance receive a collapsible cup, which they should bring along during the race to reduce the use of disposable cups.

name: Storå 6 timmars och 3 timmars
description: Storå 6 Hours is a challenging ultrarace organised by Storådalens SK at Hagabacken School in Guldsmedshyttan. The race offers two distances, 6 hours and 3 hours, with participants running a 2,130-metre course featuring approximately 50 metres of elevation gain per lap. Sports drink and energy products are served at the lap point, and sausage rolls are available halfway through. All participants receive a T-shirt after finishing, and honorary prizes are awarded to the top three in each category. Results are published live on race day at hug-timing.se.
course_highlights: 2,130-metre laps with approximately 50 metres of elevation gain
After 20 laps, runners reach marathon distance with a total elevation gain of 1,000 metres
During the final 30 minutes, runners complete a shorter lap
additional: The start, lap point and race centre are at Hagabacken School, which has showers, toilets, services and medical care. Parking for the 6-hour race is on the gravel football pitch behind the school; for the 3-hour race, parking is at Guldsmedshyttebruk, 500 m away, or at the start. Timing is by ankle chip, which must be returned after the race. Umara sports drink and other products are served at the lap point. Sausage rolls are available halfway through the race. All runners receive a T-shirt after completing the race. Honorary prizes go to the top three in each category. The race has been cancelled due to too few participants. The planned start times were 11:00 for the 6-hour race and 14:00 for the 3-hour race. Timing was to be by chip.

name: Fjällmaraton Sälen by EQPE
description:
Fjällmaraton Sälen by EQPE is the trail-running adventure for anyone looking to combine the joy of running, a challenge and spectacular scenery. Choose between 42 km, 21 km or 10 km—and bring the whole family! Children up to 12 years old can run for free in Barnens Fjällmaraton.
The course takes you over rugged mountain trails, boardwalks and winding paths all the way to the finish and the lively After Run party at Experiumtorget in Lindvallen. Fjällmaraton Sälen is a deluxe running experience. Secure your place and experience the mountains with us!

name: 16. Piesauer Glasmacherlauf
description: The 16th Piesauer Glasmacherlauf takes place on 1 August 2026 in Piesau, Thuringia. The event offers 2 km races for children and a 10 km race for adults, as well as a 10 km Nordic walking competition on forest paths. It is part of the Sparkassen-Cup and the TLV Running and Nordic Walking Cup, and offers a family-friendly atmosphere with changing and shower facilities and refreshments on site. Trophies and awards are presented to the fastest runners and by age group.
course_highlights: 2 km children's race
10 km main race exclusively on forest paths
10 km Nordic walking with poles; running is prohibited
additional: Changing, washing and shower facilities are available. Food, drinks and cake are available for purchase on site. Trophies go to the fastest runners on each course (places 1–3 in each gender category), with awards for the top three in each age group. Team classification for the 10 km race, based on the 2 fastest women or 3 fastest men from a club. Forest paths, team classification, trophies for the fastest on each course, awards, registration until 29.07.2026

name: Frontrun - Janus Queer Games 2026
organizer: Janus Queer Games / SC Janus e.V.

description: The Frontrun is an inclusive running event held as part of the Janus Queer Games 2026 in Cologne, welcoming runners of all genders. Events include a 5 km run, a 10 km run, and a 5 km partner run. The start and finish are on the Jahnwiesen beneath a large rainbow. The course is clearly marked and supported by encouraging course marshals. The event values community, diversity, and the joy of sport in an open and supportive environment.
course_highlights: Start and finish on the Jahnwiesen beneath a large rainbow
5 km loop for the shorter runs; 2 loops for the 10 km run
Alphabetically marked course with friendly course marshals
additional: Race bibs can be collected until 11:30 a.m.; group warm-up at 11:45 a.m. Manual timekeeping with +/- 3 seconds’ precision. Free water stations during the run; after the run, fruit and a cake buffet are available for donations benefiting Anyway e.V. There are no age-group rankings; rankings are in the female, male, and all-genders categories. The 5 km partner run is ranked in the All Gender category. Race-day registration is possible if places are available. The course is flat and runs on the Jahnwiesen. Registration is available online and on the event day, with refreshments and rankings in several categories.

name: CJ Schmidt Hafentagelauf
description: The CJ Schmidt Harbour Day Run takes place in Husum, a city on the North Sea in Schleswig-Holstein, as part of the Husum Harbour Days festival. The event offers flat road races over various distances, including children’s and youth races, a 5 km race, a 10 km race, and a 4 x 2.5 km relay. There is also the Husum Corporate Cup, in which company teams of four compete. The course runs through the city centre and along the harbour, combining urban streets with waterfront paths, accompanied by the fresh North Sea breeze.
course_highlights: Flat road races through Husum’s city centre and harbour
Course along the North Sea coast with a fresh sea breeze
A range of distances for children, young people and relay teams
additional: The organiser is Husumer Sportverein seit 1875 e.V. Timing is provided by Race Result, and registration is managed by LAV Husum. Typical August weather in Husum is around 25 °C, with mostly sunny days and average precipitation of 60 mm. The event also includes team and corporate races as well as family races, with a festive atmosphere in the harbour area. August weather is usually sunny, at around 25°C.

name: Volkslauf um den Mittelpunkt Deutschlands
description: The Volkslauf around the geographical center of Germany is a sporting running event on August 8, 2026, in Krebeck, suitable for young and old as well as both competitive and recreational runners. The event offers various running and walking routes with changing elevation profiles, some of which are challenging and run along paved or asphalt paths. The races start and finish at the Krebeck sports field, and all participants receive fruit and drinks during and after the competition. Medals and prizes are awarded to the top finishers, and there is an age-group classification as well as on-site medical support.

name: Volkslauf um den Auesee
description: The 5th race in the Mühlenkreis Series takes place on 08.08.2026 at ATSV Espelkamp, by Auesee. The course follows paved and partly asphalted paths around Auesee and is almost flat, with no significant elevation changes. The race is part of a popular regional running series with a total of nine events. The organizer is ATSV Espelkamp, which provides a well-organized and pleasant race atmosphere.

name: 10 Śliwicka Dyszka
description: Śliwicka Dyszka is an annual race organized by the Biegające Śliwice association to promote an active lifestyle and running. The event takes place in the scenic surroundings of Śliwice and offers participants an attractive 10 km course. The race attracts both amateur and experienced runners, creating a friendly atmosphere of sporting competition and bringing the local community together.

name: 12 eXtremalny Bieg Godzinny
description: The 12th eXtremalny Bieg Godzinny is a unique one-hour race held in Koszalin on a challenging, approximately 1-kilometre loop through forest terrain, featuring significant elevation changes and varied surfaces, including sandy sections. Participants compete to complete as many laps as possible within one hour, and must start their final lap before the hour is up. The race promotes sport, recreation, volunteering and active tourism. At the finish, runners receive an exceptionally heavy medal and a drink. The event is organised by the „SFX” Association and Rozbiegany Koszalin.

name: Botaniczna Piątka edycja letnia
description: Botaniczna Piątka Poznań – Summer Edition is a cross-country race held in the picturesque UAM Botanical Garden in Poznań. The event is part of a race series that has promoted running and the beauty of natural routes in Greater Poland since 2014. It attracts running enthusiasts who appreciate the scenic appeal and character of cross-country routes. The alternative location is Lake Rusałka, just 500 metres from the Botanical Garden, offering additional scenic appeal.

name: Kullamilen
organizer: Höganäs Friidrott tillsammans med lokala föreningar
description: Kullamilen is an annual fun run on the Kullahalvön peninsula, welcoming runners, joggers and walkers of all ages and abilities. The races start and finish at the athletics stadium in Höganäs, with distances for children and young people of 2.4 km, as well as 5 km and 10 km for recreational and competitive runners. The courses run largely along the coast, with beautiful sea views, and are sanctioned by the Skåne Athletics Federation. The event is marked by a sense of community, cheerful volunteers and a friendly atmosphere, with the joy of movement at its heart.
course_highlights: The 10 km course follows much of the Kullahalvön coastline and offers sea views
The 5 km and 10 km courses run on asphalt and gravel and are marked and staffed by volunteers
The children’s and youth races take place on the athletics track, covering 6 laps of the 400-metre track
additional: Late registration is available on race day between 09:30 and 11:30 at the race office at the athletics stadium, and no later than 30 minutes before each participant’s start. Bib numbers can be collected from 09:30 on race day. Water stations are located at approximately 3.5 km, 6.2 km and at the finish. All participants receive a medal, and prizes are awarded to the fastest runners in the 5 km and 10 km races. The 10 km is offered in both competitive and recreational categories. The veterans’ competitive categories are part of the Skåne Veterans Cup.

pipeline_log.message: New race date found on official site (https://www.kullamilen.se/kullamilen-2027-preliminart-sondagen-den-8-augusti/): 2027-08-08 — "Vi siktar preliminärt på söndagen den 8 augusti 2027. Sanktion är sökt men datumet är ännu inte slutligt bekräftat." (was estimated 2027-08-08)
pipeline_log.evidence_quote: Vi siktar preliminärt på söndagen den 8 augusti 2027. Sanktion är sökt men datumet är ännu inte slutligt bekräftat.

name: Oslo Løpsfestival, Østmarka halvmaraton

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Dagsbillett SOLO Deltakere kr 332,50 + Adm. gebyr (25 NOK + 3%) -30%

tiers.label: tier_2
tiers.description: Dagsbillett SOLO Deltakere kr 475,00 + Adm. gebyr (25 NOK + 3%)

description: Østmarka Half Marathon is part of the Oslo Running Festival and offers an exceptional nature experience through some of the most beautiful areas of Oslomarka. The race follows scenic forest roads through varied terrain and past idyllic lakes, and is suitable both for those looking to run a good time and for those who want to enjoy a fantastic day outdoors in the forest. This is the first-ever half marathon in the Oslo Running Festival, with a mass start on August 8 at 11:00 at Rustadsaga Sportsstue in Oslo.
course_highlights: Course through beautiful areas of Oslomarka
Scenic forest roads and varied terrain
Idyllic lakes and nature experiences all the way to the finish
additional: Race bibs can be collected from Löplabbet Oslo sentrum from April 7. The same race bib is used throughout the series. A new race bib can be purchased for 75 kr. Courses will only be marked for the mass start. GPX files and Strava links for the course are available to download. Registration is binding, with no refunds or transfer of race bibs. The race can be completed during the festival period from July 30 to August 8; the mass start is on August 8 at 11:00. Early-bird prices are listed and may increase on January 1.

name: Perseløpet 5 km, 10 km, halvmaraton
description: Perseløpet is a simple, fast race event at Ås School in Eidsvoll, featuring a flat, officially measured 2,633-metre loop. The event offers seven distances from 3 km to 100 km, including 5 km, 10 km and the half marathon, and helps runners achieve fast times with a dedicated nutrition table along the course. Race bibs are collected using self-service at the venue, which has free parking, changing rooms and toilets. The race is known for its great atmosphere and the many runners who set personal records; it is a tradition to ring the bell at the finish to celebrate a new PB.
course_highlights: Flat, officially measured 2,633-metre loop
Dedicated nutrition table passed on every lap
Venue at Ås School with free parking, changing rooms and toilets
additional: Race bibs are collected using self-service approximately two hours before the start. Free parking, changing rooms and toilets are available at the venue. The race has a dedicated nutrition table where runners can leave their own bottles and gels. At selected races, ninth-graders from Feiring School staff an official drinks station, which also raises money for their school trip. It is a tradition to ring the bell at the finish area to celebrate a new personal record. Free parking, changing rooms and toilets are available at the venue. Registration is via RaceDays; half-marathon runners can arrange their own drinks and nutrition.

name: Perseløpet ¤6 - 2027
description: Perseløpet is a race in Eidsvoll, starting and finishing at Ås School in Hammerås. The event features a flat, officially measured 2,633-metre loop and offers seven distances from 3 km to 100 km, designed for fast times. Participants can set up their own nutrition table, which they pass each lap, giving them easy access to their own supplies without the need for aid-station logistics. The event has a friendly atmosphere where personal bests are celebrated by ringing the bell near the finish area.
course_highlights: Flat, officially measured 2,633-metre loop
Seven distances from 3 km to 100 km
Own nutrition table passed each lap
additional: Race bibs are self-service pickup at Ås School from around two hours before the start. Free parking, changing facilities and toilets are available at the venue. At selected races, ninth graders from Feiring School staff an official drinks station, which also raises money for their school trip. The weather forecast is updated four times daily using satellite data for the area around Ås School. Runners can have their own nutrition table.

name: Brunnenlauf
location: Iburg-Stadion, Bad Driburg, North Rhine-Westphalia, Germany
description: The Bad Driburg Brunnenlauf is an annual running event organized by TV "Jahn" Bad Driburg e.V., welcoming runners of all ages. The challenging course runs along the Sachsenring, through the spa gardens and the town, and finishes at Iburg Stadium. The event emphasizes fairness and sportsmanship and uses timing with a reusable chip. Registration is online only; late entries are not possible.
course_highlights: Challenging out-and-back course with hills
The course runs along the Sachsenring, through the spa gardens and the town
Finish at Iburg Stadium, Bad Driburg
additional: Timing is provided exclusively with the reusable race result chip, worn on the foot using a chip strap. The chip deposit is 10€ and is refunded when the chip is returned. Late entries are not possible. Participants may be disqualified for violations of fairness and good conduct. Online registration only; no late entries. Participation from age 18; children and school students participate free of charge.

name: Diekseelauf
description: The Sparkassen Diekseelauf is a traditional fun run around Lake Dieksee in Bad Malente-Gremsmühlen. The event takes place on August 9, 2026, and offers runners an attractive course with modern transponder timing. Participants can conveniently view and download their results and certificates online. The race is organized by TSV Malente and is open to runners of all ability levels.

name: v-office-Europalauf
description: The 39th vOffice Europalauf on 9 August 2026 is an international race connecting the Baltic seaside resorts of Neustadt, Pelzerhaken and Rettin over the half-marathon distance. The course offers a wonderful view across Neustädter Bucht and returns to Neustadt along the beach promenade, parallel to the beach. In addition to the half-marathon, there are races over 10 km, 5 km and 2.5 km, as well as a Bambini run. The event is a popular sporting occasion in the region and is organised by TSV Neustadt.

name: Stomperudkarusellen- løp nr 3
location: Stomperud Stadion, Lørenvegen 2, Sørum, Lillestrøm, Norway
price_range: Enkeltløp: 220 kr for voksne og 110 kr for barn, med lisens i tillegg
description: Stomperudkarusellen is a long-established series of races organized by Sørum IL since 1981. The series consists of four races with varying distances from 800 meters to 9 kilometers, including shorter options for children and young people. The races take place in scenic surroundings, with the start and finish at Stomperud Stadion and nearby areas. Participants use the same race number throughout the series, and the event is open to both adults and children. Children who are members of Sørum IL can take part for free when they register.
course_highlights: Race 3: Lysløypa, 6 km with a shorter option
Start and finish at Stomperud Stadion, Lørenvegen 2, Sørum
Varied terrain with gravel roads, trails, and an athletics track for shorter distances
additional: Participants use the same race number in all races in the series. Children who are members of Sørum IL can take part for free if they register no later than one week before race day. The races have shorter options for the youngest participants. Start locations vary between Sørum Skole and Stomperud Stadion depending on the race. Race no. 3 meets at Stomperud Stadion, Lørenvegen 2, Sørum. The prices listed by the organizer apply to 2026.

name: Stomperudkarusellen 2027. Bare løp 3 (Lysløypa)
description: Stomperudkarusellen is a long-running race series organized by Sørum IL since 1981. The series consists of four races over varying distances, including Lysløypa, a 6 km race that is part of this year’s Race 3. The races are suitable for both adults and children, with shorter options for the youngest participants. Participants use the same bib number for all the races, which take place at Stomperud Stadion and in the surrounding areas of Sørum.
course_highlights: Race 3 Lysløypa: 6 km, with a shorter 500 m option
Traditional routes in the local area around Stomperud Stadion
Shorter distances for children and young people
additional: Participants use the same bib number for all races in the series. Children who are members of Sørum IL can participate for free if they register no later than one week before race day. The races offer shorter options for the youngest participants. The events take place at Stomperud Stadion and in the surrounding areas, which have a well-maintained network of walking trails and running routes. The prices and race dates listed on the organizer’s website apply to 2026 and do not confirm the 2027 edition. In 2026, the same bib number is used for all races in the series.

name: Vetlanda Citylopp

price_tiers.distance: Dam, herr och motion (5 km och 10 km)

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Dam-, herr- och motionsklassen (10 km och 5 km)

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Kids F8/P8 - F12/P12 (1 km till 1,7 km) och Funkis (1 km)

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Föreningar kan anmäla i F/P8-F/P12 samt Junior 5km

description: Vetlanda Citylopp is a welcoming urban race for all ages and ability levels. The start and finish are on Storgatan in the heart of Vetlanda, and participants can choose between 5 km and 10 km on a fast, spectator-friendly loop course. Younger participants can choose shorter distances from 400 metres up to 1.7 km. The event is a community celebration, with activities and food service in the square, where runners and spectators alike can enjoy a great day together.
course_highlights: Fast loop course in central Vetlanda
Start and finish on Storgatan in the heart of town
Spectator-friendly, with activities and food service in the square
additional: Race bib collection and on-the-day registration take place at Stortorget from 12:00 on race day. On-the-day registration is available until 30 minutes before the start of each class. Timing is provided by a chip in the race bib, and results are published live and on the OK Njudung website. Changing rooms and showers are available at Hövdingen sports hall near the start/finish. Previous editions have included children’s and youth classes as well as a Funkis class. Race-day bib collection, on-the-day registration and activities have previously been held at Stortorget.

name: HTB Valestrandsmarka Rundt 7. løp
description: HTB Valestrandsmarka Rundt is an annual recreational race organised by Osterøy I.L. Friidrett. The race takes place in Valestrand and covers a distance of 4.4 km. It is a social and inclusive event, with evening start times for walkers and the main field. Traditionally, sveler, cordial and prizes are served, and course records are rewarded with cash prizes from HTB.
course_highlights: A 4.4 km course in Valestrand
Start times: 18:45 for walkers and 19:00 for the main field
Course records are rewarded with NOK 3,000
additional: Start times are 18:45 for walkers and 19:00 for the main field. Times in the walking field are recorded as 30 minutes or more. Traditionally, sveler from Toro, cordial from Saftsuse and prizes from Extra Valestrand are provided. The race is part of a series of races held throughout the year, including a Christmas race and a New Year’s race. Registration takes place at Furubakken sports ground, and payment can be made via Vipps 121337 or to account 3632.54.56676. In 2026, the start times were 18:45 and 19:00, with payment via Vipps. Participants received sveler, cordial and prizes.

name: 8. Wisent-RUN
location: Wisentgehege Springe, Springe, Lower Saxony, Germany
description: The Wisent-RUN is a popular race at Wisentgehege Springe, taking place for the eighth time on August 7, 2026. The event offers various race distances, including children’s races and timed competitions, set in a natural environment. With a family-friendly atmosphere and free admission to Wisentgehege from 15:00, the race is a sporting highlight for all ages. The event is organised by VfV Concordia Alvesrode e.V. and is known for its friendly atmosphere and dedicated volunteers.
course_highlights: Start and finish at the Köhlerhütte in Wisentgehege Springe
Race routes through the natural surroundings of Wisentgehege
Children’s races with timing and an awards ceremony
additional: Free admission to Wisentgehege from 15:00. The 500 m children’s race “Frischlingsrennen” is untimed and open to children born in 2021 or later. The 1 km children’s race is timed and includes an awards ceremony for children born from 2016 to 2021. Ample parking is available. The event is open to everyone, with free admission for visitors. It offers an opportunity to explore the wildlife at Wisentgehege while getting active.

name: 24. Dammer Stadtlauf
description: The 24th Damme City Run is an evening road race through the center of Damme, organized by OSC Damme in cooperation with the City of Damme. The program includes three starts: a schoolchildren’s race, a general race for all participants, and the main evening race. After a two-year pandemic-related break, the race returns with an expected field of over 500 runners. The event is characterized by an open, local atmosphere, with on-site registration available, as runners fill the streets of the town center.
course_highlights: Evening road race through Damme city center
Three starts: schoolchildren’s race, general race, and main race
The course stays in the city center, with a lively atmosphere
additional: On-site registration is available, encouraging open, local participation. August weather is typically sunny, with temperatures between 14 and 25 °C. The event includes several categories, including children’s races and the main race, on a route through the city, with a relaxed, welcoming atmosphere.

name: 24. Knesebecker Einhornlauf
description: The Knesebecker Unicorn Run is a traditional running event in the Isenhagen region, held annually in August. The event gives runners of various ability levels the opportunity to test themselves on varied courses. Online registration is conveniently available via the RaceResult platform, where all results and certificates can also be accessed. The race takes place in the beautiful surroundings of Wittingen and attracts numerous running enthusiasts from the region.
course_highlights: 10 km course
Nordic walking option
Event held on the school grounds in Knesebeck
additional: Registration is online via RaceResult. Results and certificates are also available via RaceResult. The race takes place on Friday evening. Participant numbers are limited to 100; registration and results are available online; the event is held on the school grounds in Knesebeck.

name: 17. VSB Dresdner Nachtlauf
description: The VSB Dresden Night Run offers a beautifully illuminated route with views of the Dresden skyline. Torches and glow sticks create a special atmosphere. The 11.5 km route follows the Elbe to the Blue Wonder and returns along the Neustadt side of the river, while the 6.2 km route also runs along the Elbe and crosses the Albert Bridge to the finish. Alongside the sporting experience, there are children’s races and a special team competition for clubs and organizations. The event takes place at Heinz-Steyer-Stadion and is a highlight of the region’s running calendar.

name: 35. Speller Sparkassen-Sommernachtslauf
description: The 35th Speller Sparkassen Summer Night Run is a traditional race in Spelle, organized by SC Spelle-Venhaus. The event offers runners an attractive course in the beautiful surroundings of Wählehof. The race is suitable for all ages and ability levels and takes place in a relaxed atmosphere. Participants can look forward to a well-organized event with a friendly, family atmosphere.

name: Bringebærløpet 2027
description: The Raspberry Run in Vollen is a family-friendly race offering distances for all ages and ability levels. The start and finish are at Vollenhallen, and the course runs through a scenic area, with only minor changes from previous years. The youngest runners complete a lap of approximately 1 km on the roller-ski track, while older participants run 2.5 km or 5 km. The event focuses on participation and enjoyable sporting experiences, and participants can also attend the Raspberry Festival held in conjunction with the race.
course_highlights: The course follows the roller-ski track at Arnestad through scenic surroundings
A race of approximately 1 km for the youngest participants
A 2.5 km and 5 km race course with a mass start
additional: Schedule: 11:00 bib number collection opens; 13:00 mass start for 5 km; 13:30 mass start for 2.5 km; 14:00 start of the 1 km children’s race, with multiple starts; 15:00 awards ceremony for competition classes aged 11 and up. The listed distances and start/finish area apply to the 2026 edition; details for 2027 have not been confirmed.

name: Grue Backyard 2027
description: Grue Backyard is a unique endurance race featuring 6.7 km loops through technical forest terrain. The race starts a new wave every hour, continuing until only one runner remains standing. Participants can complete one loop to earn a medal or push further for the finisher cap and the win. The event also includes the Grue Half Marathon, known as one of Norway's fastest half marathon courses, and the Gruemila 10 km race.
course_highlights: 6.7 km loops through technical forest terrain
New start every hour until one runner remains
Flat and fast 21.1 km half marathon course
additional: The race features hourly starts for the backyard loops, with medals awarded for completing one loop and a finisher cap for those who continue until the end. Previous editions have had up to 12 rounds, and participants who completed at least seven rounds have been able to receive a Grue Backyard Ultra Finisher T-shirt. This information is from previous editions and does not confirm details for 2027.

name: Ringeriksmaraton
description: Ringeriksmaraton is an annual running festival that began in 1995 and has grown to become Norway’s largest marathon relay. The race runs through the beautiful municipalities of Hole, Ringerike and Jevnaker, and offers distances and categories for everyone, including 8-person and 4-person relays, a pair marathon, half marathon and marathon. The event attracts recreational runners from all over the country and offers a sociable, active experience in beautiful surroundings. Children’s Ringeriksmaraton is also a popular part of the event, making it a family-friendly occasion.
course_highlights: The course runs through the municipalities of Hole, Ringerike and Jevnaker
Beautiful natural scenery, including Norway’s largest apple orchard
Varied terrain with asphalt, footpaths, forest roads and residential areas
additional: A mass start for all categories at Vik at 11:00, with an early start at 10:00 for runners using technical aids or with a finish time over 5 hours. Drink stations with squash and water at each relay exchange, as well as a muesli bar with salt at exchanges 3 and 6 for the half marathon and marathon. Toilets are available at several locations, but there are no shower facilities at Jevnakerhallen due to renovation. Løperbanken makes it possible to find a team if you are missing teammates. Race numbers and relay batons are handed out together. Registration is final, with no refund if you withdraw. Course maps, GPX files and practical information are available on the organizer’s website.

name: Bergen Skogsmaraton - Maratonkarusellen
description: Bergen Forest Marathon is an annual forest race held in Hordnesskogen, with the start and finish at the parking lot. The race features a loop of approximately 5.3 km, run multiple times depending on the distance: 8 laps for the marathon, 4 for the half marathon, and 2 for the 10 km. The event is suitable for both experienced runners and recreational runners, offering a wonderful nature experience in the forest and good facilities, including changing rooms, water stations, and food in the finish area. The focus is on enjoyment and quality for all participants.
course_highlights: Loop course in Hordnesskogen, starting and finishing at the parking lot
Each lap is approximately 5.3 km long
Two water stations, passed three times per lap
additional: Race headquarters opens at 08:00 for race-number collection and bag drop. Start times: 10 km at 09:00, marathon at 10:00, half marathon at 11:00. Food and drink for everyone who finishes. Changing rooms and toilets are at Bjarghallen, approximately 250 metres from the start. Parking is available at Bjarghallen, but capacity is limited; public transport or carpooling is recommended. Clothing can be stored in a tent in the start area at your own risk. Late registration is possible up to the start, subject to availability. The start and finish are at the parking lot in Hordnesskogen. Bjarghallen is approximately 250 metres from the start. Registration is through EQ Timing, and late registration is possible up to the start if places are available.

name: Level-løp
description: Level Løp is a trail race for everyone, held in beautiful surroundings in Hommersåk. The race offers distances of 5 km, 10 km and 23 km, as well as a 1000-metre children's race, with varied terrain and elevation changes suited to both recreational and experienced runners. The race starts at Riska Church and features scenic trails, forest and challenging climbs. After finishing, participants can enjoy hot food and drinks, and prizes are awarded to the top men and women in all main distances.
course_highlights: Trail race through the varied and beautiful terrain of Hommersåk
23 km with 1100 metres of elevation gain, 10 km with 246 metres, and 5 km with 87 metres
Aid stations on the 10 km and 23 km distances
additional: Bib collection is on Friday, 14 August, from 15:00 to 19:00 at Amboltveien 9, and on race day from 08:00 at the start area. Registration at the start area is open from 08:00 to 12:45 on race day. The children's race is divided into age-based waves. Hot food and drinks are provided for all participants in the 23 km race. A kiosk offers hot food, snacks and drinks. Parking is at Riska Church, not at the start area. Toilets and changing rooms are available at the start/finish. Live results with finish times are available. Prizes are awarded on an ongoing basis after runners finish. One prize is drawn at random from the bib numbers. Parking is at Riska Church. The stated start times are 09:00 for 23 km, 10:00 for 10 km, 10:20 for 5 km and 13:30 for the children's race. The 10 km and 23 km races are for participants born in 2012 or earlier.

name: Skånevik Skyrace
description: Skånevik Skyrace is a spectacular mountain race on a challenging 24-kilometre circular course with 1,600 metres of elevation gain across varied and technical terrain. The race offers fantastic views of fjords and mountains, combining raw nature with the joy of running for both recreational runners and elite athletes. The start and finish are in Skånevik town centre, where activities create a lively atmosphere both on the course and in town. The event features official timing, several drink stations, and a wide range of participant amenities, including access to a pool, sauna and massage after the race.
course_highlights: 24 km circular course with 1,600 metres of elevation gain
Steep climbs and technical terrain with flowing trail sections
Fantastic panoramic views from Håfjellet (932 m above sea level) and Nepo (610 m above sea level)
additional: Start and finish at Skånevik Fjordhotell, with a Base Camp for race-number collection, information, music, food and a great atmosphere. Three drink stations along the course and several timing checkpoints. Free access to Sjøkanten Trivsel, including a pool, sauna and massage after the race. Minimum age: 16; runners must pass Juraskar by 3:00 p.m. Accommodation is available at Skånevik Fjordhotell and nearby Airbnb properties, camping and boat moorings. Registration for 2027 is sold out, but places may become available in May 2027. The 2027 edition is sold out; any available places may be released in May 2027. Minimum age: 16, and runners must pass Juraskar by 3:00 p.m. Participants receive food and drinks at 3–4 drink stations, a medal and a buff.

name: Kniveåsen Rundt
location: Pumpehuset ved Solumstrand renseanlegg, Drammen, Norway
description: Kniveåsen Rundt is a forest race around Kniveåsen in Drammen that welcomes everyone to participate. The race is free and suitable for both recreational and experienced runners looking for an outdoor experience in forest terrain. The event has an inclusive atmosphere and is held annually, offering great opportunities to enjoy running in beautiful surroundings.
course_highlights: Forest race around Kniveåsen in Drammen
Natural terrain with varied surfaces
Suitable for all levels
additional: The race is free to enter. Results from previous years and event videos are available on the website. The race is open to everyone. Registration is linked from the official website.

name: Budor løpefest 2027
description: Budor Running Festival 2027 takes place on Saturday, August 14, at Budor Gjestegård and offers 5 km, 10 km, and half-marathon distances. The race offers an inclusive atmosphere for both experienced runners and beginners, with the start and finish at Gjestegården. The courses pass through scenic surroundings on trails and gravel roads, offering a spectacular running experience with beautiful panoramic views. The event also includes a free children’s race, Koiedalen Rundt, with a medal for participants. Prizes are awarded to the three fastest runners in each category in the 5 km, 10 km, and 21 km races.
course_highlights: The courses run mainly on trails and gravel roads through scenic surroundings
Start and finish at Budor Gjestegård, with panoramic views
The half marathon has only 250 places and offers a memorable running experience
additional: Race numbers can be collected between 09:00 and 10:30 at Gjestegården. The half marathon starts at 10:00, the 10 km at 10:30, and the 5 km at 10:40. Toilets and a few showers are available in the basement of Gjestegården, and swimming is possible in Koiedalsvannet near the finish area. The children’s race, Koiedalen Rundt, starts at 13:00 and is free. You can sell your place by contacting the organizer by email. All distances start and finish at Budor Gjestegård. Published schedule: half marathon at 10:00, 10 km at 10:30, and 5 km at 10:40. Race numbers can be collected at Gjestegården. The half marathon has 250 places, and the children’s race, Koiedalen Rundt, is free.

name: Backyard ultra Golsfjellet

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Backyard Deltakere kr 750,00 + Adm. gebyr (25 NOK + 3% transaksjonsgebyr)

description: Backyard Ultra Golsfjellet is a unique trail race with no asphalt, offering participants a full experience of fresh mountain air and scenic surroundings. The race is based at Oset Fjellhotell, which is exclusively booked for the event and filled with runners, supporters, and a great backyard atmosphere throughout the weekend. This is more than just a race; it is also a social weekend experience focused on food and spending time together, with all meals for runners prepared by the hotel’s renowned kitchen. The race is suitable for anyone looking for a challenging and social experience in the mountains.
course_highlights: The race takes place entirely on mountain terrain with no asphalt
Start and finish at Oset Fjellhotell, exclusively booked for the event
Delicious refreshments and food prepared by Oset Fjellhotell’s kitchen during breaks
additional: Race bibs and ankle chips can be collected at Oset Fjellhotell on Friday, August 14, from 19:00 to 21:00 and Saturday, August 15, from 07:30 to 08:30. The entire hotel is booked for the event, and a 20% discount is available for a two-night stay with discount code BYOSET. A pasta party is held on Friday evening and a gala dinner on Saturday evening, but neither is included in registration. A hotel buffet on Saturday evening is available to participants for 495 kr when reserved. Food and drink are central to the race, with easy access to refreshments during breaks. Accommodation and some meals are not included in the entry fee. The 2027 registration is listed with an Early Bird price.

name: Schierker Sommerlauf
description: The Schierker Sommerlauf is a traditional race in the Harz Mountains, taking place for the 24th time on 8 August 2026. The event offers varied distances from 1 km to 16 km, running through the impressive landscape around Schierke. Runners can enjoy breathtaking views, a unique atmosphere and great support in the finish area at the Schierker Feuersteinarena. The race is part of the new Harzer Laufcup 2026 and is open to runners of all abilities.
course_highlights: Run on paved forest roads, with two laps for the 8 km main race
Breathtaking views of the Brocken and the Harz landscape
Start and finish at the Schierker Feuersteinarena, with a great atmosphere
additional: The start and finish are at the Schierker Feuersteinarena, which has changing rooms and showers. The course runs along paved forest roads. There is a refreshment point at the newly built toboggan run. Registration is online, with personalised race numbers for those who register in advance. Use of the showers is included in the entry fee. The event is part of the Harzer Laufcup 2026. Courses on paved forest roads, online registration, personalised race numbers, refreshments included, electronic timing, certificates and trophies for the winners.

name: Dülmener Wasserlauf mit 5 km Walking
location: Sportzentrum Nord, Dülmen, North Rhine-Westphalia, Germany
description: The 11th Dülmen Water Run with 5 km walking takes place on August 15, 2026, in Dülmen. The event gives runners and walkers the opportunity to participate in 5 km and 10 km races. It takes place at Sportzentrum Nord and promises pleasant conditions in typical August weather, with temperatures around 25 °C and mostly sunny skies. Please note that the exact event details should be verified with the organizer before registering.
course_highlights: Distances: 5 km and 10 km
Venue: Sportzentrum Nord, Dülmen
Typical August weather, around 25 °C and mostly sunny
additional: Please check the event details with the organizer before registering. The event offers a team competition in which four runners start together, and places special emphasis on water and environmental protection. It is family-friendly and open to runners of all abilities.

name: Hambacher Volkslauf
description: The Hambach People’s Run takes place on 15 August 2026 in Niederzier-Hambach and offers races over 2 km, 5 km, 10 km, and a half marathon. There are also 10 km walking and Nordic walking routes. The courses are measured by the DLV, and the event is part of the Regio Aachen Running Cup. The event welcomes runners of all ability levels and looks forward to a large turnout.
course_highlights: Measured courses over 2 km, 5 km, 10 km, and a half marathon
10 km walking and Nordic walking routes
Part of the Regio Aachen Running Cup
additional: Registration is now open via the website. Course maps and the race information are available as PDFs. The event is part of the Regio Aachen Running Cup. Courses measured, online registration, part of the Regio Aachen Running Cup

name: 100MeilenBerlin - Der Mauerweglauf
description: The 100MeilenBerlin – The Wall Trail Run is a historically significant ultramarathon that follows the route of the former Berlin Wall around western Berlin. The course of approximately 161 kilometers runs mostly on paved paths, but also includes trail-like and sometimes uneven sections. The start and finish are at Friedrich-Ludwig-Jahn-Sportpark in Berlin-Prenzlauer Berg. The race commemorates the victims of the division of Germany and is held annually, with the running direction alternating.

name: 2. Backyard Ultra-Marathon Tharandter Wald
description: The 2nd Backyard Ultra Marathon in the Tharandt Forest is organized by SC Freital e.V. and takes place in one of Saxony’s most beautiful forest regions. The course is a 6.7 km loop, mostly on forest trails, run alternately clockwise and counterclockwise. The start and finish area is at the Jugendfreizeithof Grillenburg. A total of 100 starting places are available, and registration is via RaceResult.

name: Josef Kaderhandt-Waldlauf Plus
description: The 42nd Josef Kaderhandt Forest Run in Menden is a long-established running event organized by Marathon-Club Menden e.V. The course follows paved forest trails through the scenic Sauerland and offers a sporting challenge with demanding sections. In addition to the classic 20 km forest run, runners can take part in the 20 km Plus Marathon and extend their distance to an ultramarathon of up to 50 km by completing additional laps. The race starts in Waldemei near the Kolping Memorial Stone and finishes at Bürgerbad Leitmecke. There is also a 7.8 km fun run for everyone who enjoys running.

name: WoKiMen
distance_verbose: Halbmarathon, 10 km, 5 km, 2 km, 1 km, 0.5 km
description: WoKiMen is a family-friendly running day at Parc de Tarbes in Altenkirchen, offering a variety of running and activity options for children, adults, teams, walkers, Nordic walkers, and even dog owners. Children can run 0.5 km or 2 km, while adults can choose between 5 km, 10 km, and 21 km. The TeamChallenge is a relay race with three 1 km legs. In addition to the races, there is a varied program featuring yoga, Zumbathlon, and an adventure course. The day ends with a relaxing Chill & Grill event featuring Nepalese specialties, Italian wood-fired pizza, popcorn, coffee, and cake.

name: Botaniczna Piątka edycja letnia
description: Botaniczna Piątka Bydgoszcz – Summer Edition is a cross-country race organized by running enthusiasts since 2014. The event takes place on scenic routes that showcase the beauty of the locations. The organizers’ goal is to popularize running and provide participants with a unique sporting and scenic experience. Join this friendly and dynamic running event.

name: XII Rozłaziński Bieg po radość z życia
Rubjerg Knude løbet 2027
distance_verbose: Halvmarathon, Halvmarathon, 15 km, 10 km, 5 km, 2.5 km

name: Volkslauf Rund um den Beerster See
location: Kurpark am Kanal, Bad Bederkesa, Lower Saxony, Germany
description: The Volkslauf Rund um den Beerster See is a running event for participants of all ages and abilities, held on the third Sunday in August in Bad Bederkesa. The course passes through a natural setting and offers a motivating challenge for both competitive runners and recreational athletes. The event promotes community and the joy of being active, making it a special experience for both race participants and recreational runners. The start and finish are in Kurpark am Kanal, and timing is by transponder.
course_highlights: Scenic course around Beerster See
Start and finish in Kurpark am Kanal
Free drinks on the opposite side of the lake and at the finish
additional: Race packs are distributed in the Amtsscheune opposite the castle. Showers are available at the Moortherme upon presentation of your race number. Timing is by transponder, which must be returned after the race. The cut-off time for the main races is 1 hour 45 minutes. The event takes place in all weather conditions. Course distances: 7.6 km; hiking, walking and Nordic walking: 1.1 km, 0.5 km and 14.6 km. Race packs are distributed in the Amtsscheune. The event takes place in all weather conditions. Timing is by transponder.

name: Breitunger Pleßlauf
location: Sporthalle am Riegelsweg, Breitungen/Werra, Thuringia, Germany

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Start- incl. Chip­ - Gebühren 6 Km Lauf: 9€

description: The Breitunger Pleßlauf takes place on 23 August 2026 in Breitungen/Werra and offers running distances from 1 km to 30 km, as well as 10.7 km Nordic walking. The event is organised by SV Lauftreff Breitungen e.V. and starts and finishes at the sports hall on Riegelsweg. The varied courses are suitable for both children and experienced runners. Alongside the sporting challenge, the event offers timing with a single-use chip, trophies and non-cash prizes for the fastest participants, and finisher medals for the main distances.
course_highlights: Running distances from 1 km to 30 km
10.7 km Nordic walking
Start and finish at the sports hall on Riegelsweg in Breitungen
additional: Late entries are possible up to 45 minutes before the respective start, with a late-entry fee of €5 for the main distances and Nordic walking. Timing is provided using a single-use chip from GO timing. Race packs can be collected at the sports hall on 22.08.2026 from 12:00 to 15:30 and on race day from 07:00. Changing rooms, showers and toilets are available at the sports hall. Trophies are awarded to the three fastest finishers in the main distances, along with non-cash and cash prizes for the winners. All finishers in the main distances receive a laser-engraved medal. Course profiles, mountain run, online registration, results, photos, videos, dates in 2024–2026

name: Run´n Roll for Help
description: Run’n Roll for Help is a long-standing city race in Giessen that has been inspiring runners for over 28 years. Every year, the city-centre streets are transformed into a sporting highlight, where the charitable cause is just as important as the competition. With over 1,200 participants in 2025 and more than €19,000 raised for Lebenshilfe and Aidshilfe, the event is a major charity running festival in the region. The event offers a great atmosphere and warmly welcomes all running enthusiasts to take part in August 2026.

name: Wohldenberger Waldlauf
description: The 21st Wohldenberger Forest Run on August 16, 2026, offers runners of all ability levels varied courses through the Wohldenberg Forest. For more than two decades, this event has been one of the most popular in the Hildesheim region, attracting 200 to 300 participants each year. The route follows natural forest trails with changing surfaces and hilly sections, making it a true trail-running experience. There are suitable distances for beginners, families, walkers, and ambitious runners, from short children’s races to the challenging half marathon.

name: Wolfsburg Staffellauf powered by VfL Wob e.V.
description: The Wolfsburg Relay Race, organized by VfL Wolfsburg e.V., is a special team experience that brings together runners of all ages and backgrounds. On August 16, 2026, the second edition of this relay marathon will take place, giving teams from schools, clubs, and companies the chance to experience team spirit through sport. The course runs through the green city forest, with the start and finish at VW-Bad, where music will also create a lively atmosphere. Children’s relay teams are supported by Förderkreis Leichtathletik VfL Wolfsburg e.V., making participation especially appealing.

name: Marceliński Bieg Letni 2026
description: Marceliński Summer Run 2026 is a cross-country race organized in Poznań by running enthusiasts from the Biegi.Wlkp. group. The event takes place on scenic routes that highlight the location’s aesthetic appeal. Since 2014, the organizers have focused on promoting cross-country running in Greater Poland, offering participants a unique running experience amid beautiful natural surroundings.

name: XXI Bieg Lesoków
description: The 21st Lesoków Run is an annual race held in Szemud as part of the Kaszuby Biegają series. The event offers two routes, 5 and 10 km long, through the picturesque Kashubian countryside, encouraging participants to enjoy the outdoors. It attracts runners of different ages and experience levels, promoting a healthy lifestyle and local running culture.

name: Blodomloppet (Jönköping)

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Lilla Blodomloppet för barn upp till 12 år kostar 100 kr och kan anmälas till denna avgift ända fram tills dagen loppet går.

description: Blodomloppet in Jönköping is a recreational event that raises awareness of the vital importance of blood donation and welcomes participants to walk, jog or run 5 km or 10 km. There is also a children’s race, Lilla Blodomloppet, for children up to 12 years old, with shorter courses. The event is a social and health-promoting activity where teams and individual participants can take part, and each team receives a picnic bag as part of the entry fee. Blodomloppet is part of Sweden’s largest recreational race series, with a strong focus on health and the importance of blood donation.
course_highlights: Timed 5 km and 10 km runs
Untimed 5 km walk
Lilla Blodomloppet for children up to 12 years old, with 400/800 m courses
additional: Teams can consist of 3–5 participants, and vacant places can be filled at no extra cost until 5 August by email. Registered blood donors receive a 40 kr discount when registering. A picnic bag from ICA is included with team registration and can be ordered separately for 250 kr each. Wellness allowances can be used via Wellnet, Epassi or Benify. Lilla Blodomloppet is for children up to 12 years old, with shorter 400/800-metre courses. The event raises awareness of the need for blood donation. Participants can form teams, and the event usually ends with a picnic.
