name: Västgötaloppet Trail 2026
description: Västgötaloppet Trail is a challenging and scenic trail run through the forests and countryside around Dammen in Tvärred, just south of Ulricehamn. Participants can choose from three distances: 7 km, 17 km and 27 km, all starting and finishing in the same beautiful area. The course features narrow forest trails, moss-covered rocky sections and magical views over Åsunden, making the race an adventure filled with camaraderie and the joy of running. Hot food is served after the finish, and all participants receive a medal. The youngest runners can take part in a free mini race focused on fun and play.
course_highlights: Narrow forest trails and hilly terrain
Moss-covered rocky sections and exposed rock slabs
Beautiful views over Åsunden
additional: All distances start and finish at Dammen in Tvärred. Parking is available nearby. Food and drinks, music and sun loungers are available on site. Volunteers and an announcer help spectators follow the highlights of the race. Hot food is included for all participants after the finish. The free mini race for children starts at 10:45, with registration on site. Maximum 300 participants. The entry fee is the same for all distances. Reduced fees for children and young people. The Västgötaloppet website lists 5 September 2026 as race day, which differs from the date 4 September 2027 in the competition information.

name: Knarvikmila Halvmaraton
location: Knarvik Stadion, Knarvik, Alver, Vestland, Norway
description: Knarvikmila Half Marathon is being held for the 17th time and offers a beautiful, traffic-free course consisting of four laps of a 5.275 km route, with the start and finish at Knarvik Stadium. The course runs on asphalt and gravel, through the beautiful natural surroundings of Brekkeløypa and around Knarvik. There are 12 drink stations along the way, clear course markings, around 20 course marshals and Red Cross personnel on site. After finishing, participants receive water and bananas. Prizes are awarded to class winners, with cash prizes for the top finishers.
course_highlights: Traffic-free course, starting and finishing at Knarvik Stadium
Asphalt and gravel course through Brekkeløypa
12 drink stations along the way
additional: Race numbers can be collected at Nordhordlandshallen, which is open Friday at 16:00, Saturday at 09:30 and Sunday at 09:00. Late registration is possible but should be avoided. It takes place at Nordhordlandshallen on Friday, Saturday and Sunday during the specified hours. Free parking is available at several locations in Knarvik, with parking attendants on site. Changing rooms and toilets are available at Nordhordlandshallen. The Red Cross and an event doctor will be on site for emergencies. Waste and recycling stations are available. Knarvikmila T-shirts are also available for purchase when registering and at the hall. Drink stations are provided along the course. The half marathon has a minimum age of 15 and is part of FjordViking.

name: Numedalsløpet 2027
organizer: Lyngdal IL, Svene IL og Flesberg IL
description: Numedalsløpet 2027 is a traditional race first held in 1936, making it one of the oldest sporting events in Numedal. The race follows easy forest terrain for approximately 12 km from Høgheim in Lyngdal to Flesberg community centre. It is an inclusive event for both competitive runners and recreational participants, organised in cooperation by Lyngdal IL, Svene IL and Flesberg IL. The race offers opportunities to enjoy nature and community, and has grown into a popular event attracting participants from across the region.
course_highlights: 12 km route on easy forest terrain
Start at Høgheim in Lyngdal and finish at Flesberg community centre
384.4 metres of elevation gain on the course
additional: The untimed recreational run starts from 11:30. The race and timed recreational run start at 13:00. The event is organised in cooperation by Lyngdal IL, Svene IL and Flesberg IL. The race and timed recreational run start at 13:00. The untimed recreational run starts from 11:30. The registration deadline is Thursday, 2 September 2027.

name: Vestfold Maraton
description: Vestfold Marathon is an inclusive running event that encourages recreational runners of all ages to be physically active, starting in Larvik and finishing at Jahn Teigens plass in Tønsberg. The event offers both a full and half marathon, as well as a relay with multiple legs, and emphasizes physical activity and social interaction. The courses are officially measured by Kondis, and the relay format allows everyone to take part, regardless of ability. The event creates a running celebration from Larvik to Tønsberg, with beautiful natural scenery along the way.
course_highlights: Start at Hegdal industrial area in Larvik and finish at Jahn Teigens plass at Tønsberg brygge
Relay with 8 legs for the marathon and 4 legs for the half marathon
The courses are officially measured by Kondis and include varied legs through urban and natural areas
additional: Relay teams can be women’s, men’s, or mixed teams, with at least one woman per team. Wheelchair racing with spiked wheels is permitted when registering. Water, bananas, and sports drinks are available at several aid stations. Changing rooms with showers are available at Tønsberg guest harbor. Race numbers can be collected in advance at Nortura Tønsberg or at the start venue on race day. No refunds are given for withdrawals or failure to finish. Photographers document the race, and images may be used for marketing. Anti-doping rules apply. The course and leg details provided refer to the 2026 information and may change for 2027. Registered participants can take part individually or as a relay team.

name: Jentemila
organizer: Jentemila, Christiania Glasmagasin og Anton Sport
description: Jentemila is a long-running, accessible girls’ race held at Bislett Stadium in Oslo on the first weekend of September. The race brings together thousands of girls of all ages and fitness levels for a weekend of running, walking or jogging 5 or 10 km, alongside entertainment, shopping, gifts and a well-stocked goodie bag for all participants. The event offers a unique running festival with music, competitions and socialising, and wraps up with bubbles and a lively atmosphere after the finish. Jentemila welcomes everyone to an inclusive and magical experience at Bislett Stadium.
course_highlights: A route on asphalt, gravel and trails, with challenging and varied sections
Choose between 5 km and 10 km distances
Start and finish at iconic Bislett Stadium, with Oslo streets closed to traffic
additional: Participants are divided into waves based on their expected finish time and distance. Waves start two minutes apart. It is possible to collect race bibs for several people by showing a QR code or giving their names. Goodie bags are handed out after the finish in exchange for a voucher. Medals are available to pre-order or buy at the stadium. Bag storage is available; luggage tags are attached to race bibs. After-run drinks are available to participants over 18. Discounts are offered for registering without a T-shirt and for group registrations (more than 4 people). A 15% student discount is available by sending proof of student status to the organiser after registering. Race bibs can be selected with or without a T-shirt; choosing no T-shirt gives a 100 kr discount. Groups of more than four get a 50 kr discount per participant. The 10 km is listed as starting at 14:00, and the 5 km and 10 km waves start two minutes apart.

name: Drammen Halvmaraton
description: Drammen Half Marathon is a spectacular running adventure that takes participants around a lightning-fast 10-kilometer loop twice. The race takes place in Drammen, Buskerud, and offers a fast, scenic course suitable for both experienced runners and recreational runners. The event has a limited number of race bibs to ensure a good experience for all participants. In addition to the half marathon, a children’s race and other running activities are held under the same umbrella.
course_highlights: The course consists of a fast 10-kilometer loop run twice
The race goes through central Drammen and the surrounding areas
A limited number of race bibs ensures a good running experience
additional: A green race bib indicates that a medal was purchased in advance. A maximum of 8,000 race bibs are available for the Drammen Half Marathon. A children’s race, Minimaraton, is also held on the same day. No phone number is provided for contact, but inquiries are answered by email and through the contact form. The organizer states that a maximum of 8,000 race bibs are available for 2026. Race times can be followed live via Ultimate Sport Service LIVE.

name: Balestrand Trailrun
description: Balestrand Trailrun is a race run on a circular course starting and finishing at Kreklingen Stadium in Balestrand. The race follows beautiful trails and offers a scenic experience in the area. There are both competitive and recreational categories, so both fast runners and recreational runners can take part. The distance is 5.4 km, and the race is suitable for anyone looking for a challenging and enjoyable trail run.
course_highlights: Circular course on beautiful trails in Balestrand
Start and finish at Kreklingen Stadium
Terrain with maintained trails and scenic surroundings
additional: The race has both competitive and recreational categories. The start and finish are at Kreklingen Stadium. The race is a 5.4 km circular trail course. Previous races such as Balestrand Opp and Rundt are now combined under Balestrand Trailrun, with a new route from 2025. Previous editions have had a competitive course, a recreational course, and a free mini-run. Course distances and practical information may vary from year to year.

name: Fløymila
description: Fløymila is a fun run held on Flekkerøy in Kristiansand, with distances suited to both children and adults. The event includes a 600-metre children’s race, as well as 5 km and 10 km distances. It is a popular event that brings together many participants for an enjoyable running experience in scenic surroundings. Fløymila welcomes everyone to take part and enjoy running on Flekkerøy.
course_highlights: Run on Flekkerøy amid scenic surroundings
Distances for children and adults: 600 m, 5 km and 10 km
A fun run with a great atmosphere and broad participation
additional: Distances include a 600 m children’s race, 5 km and 10 km Fløymila. Race bib collection and registration take place at the event. The race attracts many participants and is a fun run focused on community and enjoyment.

name: Nordmarkstravern
description: Nordmarkstravern is a traditional forest race in Nordmarka, Oslo, offering several distances for different ages and ability levels. The courses follow trails and gravel roads through some of Nordmarka’s most beautiful areas, with start points at Stryken, Skar, Hammeren and Nordberg school. The event offers everything from short, child-friendly routes to challenging ultra-distances, with an emphasis on clear course marking, refreshment stations and safety, including medical personnel and first aid. The race has an inclusive atmosphere, with categories for runners, people with strollers and wheelchair users.
course_highlights: Heltravern 30 km on trails and gravel roads from Stryken to Kringsjå by Sognsvann
Dobbeltravern 60 km, following the Heltravern course out and back
Kvarttravern 7 km, with 2.5 km on trails and the rest on gravel roads, suitable for children and families
additional: Start times: Dobbeltravern 60 km at 07:30; all other distances at 11:00. Prices include a race bib with timing, marked courses, prizes and category prizes. Bus transport to start areas is provided except for the 30 km, 60 km and 1.2 km distances. Bag transport from start to finish is available for all distances. Food and drink stations along the route. A mandatory NOK 50 licence fee for the Norwegian Athletics Association applies to participants without an annual licence. Registration is binding, but race bibs may be sold or transferred to another participant. Registration prices vary by distance and date. A mandatory one-time licence fee of NOK 50 is added for participants without an annual licence. The entry fee includes timing, marked courses, prizes, bag transport, and food and drink stations. Bus transport to the start areas is included for several distances.

name: Furusjøen Rundt-løpet/marsjen
description: Furusjøen Rundt-løpet is a traditional race that has been held since 1966, offering beautiful natural surroundings near Rondane. The event offers several distances, including a half marathon, a 9 km walk and a children’s obstacle race, making it family-friendly. The course starts at Rudland Fjellsenter and crosses varied terrain, including gravel roads, trails, forest roads and asphalt, as well as scenic areas such as Frydalen Landscape Protection Area. Welcome to the mountains and to the Adventure in Rondane!
course_highlights: The course passes through Frydalen Landscape Protection Area, with beautiful scenery and reindeer habitat
The course’s longest uphill stretch is approximately 1.3 km long, with 35 m of elevation gain
Varied surfaces include gravel roads, trails, forest roads, marshland and asphalt
additional: The half marathon starts at 12:00, and the 9 km walk starts at 12:20. Late registration is available at the stadium until the start. There are age categories from 11 years old, as well as a family category. There are several aid stations along the course. The terrain includes wet marshland; stepping on tussocks and rocks is recommended for better grip. The start and finish are at Rudland Fjellsenter on Kvamsfjellet. The event also includes the Snipp-Snapp children’s obstacle race. Registration is through the organizer’s website.

name: Herdla Backyard Ultra
description: Herdla Backyard Ultra is an ultramarathon that challenges both beginners and experienced runners to test their limits in a unique community. The race is organized by an experienced ultrarunner and focuses on safe participation, good facilities, and a course that gives participants the best possible conditions for success. Participants run a 6.7 km loop every hour, and the race continues until only one runner remains. Herdla Backyard Ultra is not just about winning, but about challenging yourself and sharing the experience with others.
course_highlights: The course is 6.7 km, with varied terrain and 135 metres of elevation gain
The start and finish area are the same for every loop
Each loop must be completed in under an hour, and the next loop starts on the hour, exactly
additional: Each participant receives a bib number and a timing chip for tracking. A reflective vest and headlamp are mandatory in the dark. Support is only allowed in the finish area between loops. The winner receives NOK 5,000, and prizes are drawn based on bib numbers. The race does not end until the last runner completes the final loop. All participants receive a medal. Timing and tracking are provided by Racetracker Norge.

name: Toughest
description: Toughest Oslo 2027 offers an unforgettable obstacle course racing experience in the spectacular terrain of Holmenkollen. The main race covers approximately 8 km with 30–40 varied obstacles, including the iconic Holmenkollen ski slope as the grand finale. Participants can choose between the full main race, a lighter 4 km Xplore course designed for fun and beginners, or a 2 km family-friendly course. The event welcomes everyone from amateurs to elite athletes, with options for fast lanes and penalty rounds to tailor the challenge.
course_highlights: Varied and challenging terrain in Holmenkollen
Approximately 30–40 obstacles of varied size and difficulty
Finish on the legendary Holmenkollen ski slope
additional: Fast lanes are available on selected obstacles for an extra challenge. Penalty rounds allow participants to skip difficult obstacles with a short jog penalty. Registration closes about one week before the event or when capacity is reached. Health care benefits can be used for registration via Benifex & Epassi. The main race has an optional Double Distance add-on of approximately 16 km. Registration closes about one week before the race or when capacity is reached, and prices vary depending on when you register.

name: Jentemila
description: Jentemila is a long-standing, accessible race for girls and women of all ages and fitness levels, held at Bislett Stadium on the first weekend of September. The event offers both 5 km and 10 km distances, and participants can choose to run, walk or jog. There are two days of entertainment, shopping, gifts, competitions and a well-stocked goodie bag for every participant. After crossing the finish line, participants can enjoy sparkling drinks and celebrate in an inclusive, festive atmosphere. Known as Norway’s friendliest women’s race, Jentemila brings together thousands of participants for a unique running festival.
course_highlights: The courses run on asphalt, gravel and trails, with a challenging and varied profile
Start and finish at Bislett Stadium, with streets in Oslo closed to traffic for the event
Wave starts every 2 minutes, based on the chosen distance and expected finish time
additional: Participants can choose a race bib with or without a T-shirt; choosing no T-shirt gives a discount of NOK 100. Groups of more than 4 people receive a discount of NOK 50 per participant. Bag storage is available, with baggage tags included. Medals can be pre-ordered or purchased at the stadium. After the race, participants over 18 can attend an after-run with alcoholic or non-alcoholic drinks. Wave starts are 2 minutes apart, and participants can submit the same expected finish time to run together in the same wave. Goodie bags are handed out after the finish line in exchange for the coupon attached to the race bib. Race bibs can be ordered with or without a T-shirt; choosing no T-shirt gives a discount of NOK 100. Groups of more than four receive a discount of NOK 50 per participant. The 5 km and 10 km waves start 2 minutes apart.

name: Stordløpet
description: Stordløpet is a long-standing race organized by Stord Friidrett, a subgroup of Stord Idrettslag, which has a history dating back to 1914. The race takes place at Stord Stadium and brings together runners of various ages and abilities for a running festival in central Leirvik. The event is an important part of local sporting life and offers a great opportunity to take part in a well-organized race with a welcoming atmosphere.
course_highlights: The race takes place at Stord Stadium and in central Leirvik
Suitable for runners of all ages and abilities
Part of a local running festival with a great atmosphere
additional: Stord Friidrett also organizes other races, such as Parkløpet, with distances suited to children and young people. The club has members of all ages and offers a broad range of athletics events. A fun run and children's races of 400 or 800 metres have also been held. Information about distances and the course is from previous editions and does not confirm the details for 2027.

name: Lyderhorn Opp 2027
description: Lyderhorn Opp is an annual uphill race organized by Laksevåg Turn og Idrettslag, finishing at the summit of Lyderhorn, 396 meters above sea level. The course is approximately 3.8 km long and suitable for both competitive and recreational runners. The event takes place in scenic surroundings in Bergen, and everyone who finishes receives a medal and a T-shirt. It is a traditional autumn event that brings together runners of all ages and ability levels.
course_highlights: Uphill race finishing at the summit of Lyderhorn, 396 meters above sea level
Course length: approximately 3.8 km
Scenic surroundings in Bergen
additional: Race bibs and T-shirts can be collected at Sport1 at Vestkanten on Friday, September 4, from 16:00 to 21:00, with a 10% discount on any product. Race bibs can also be collected at the start, but collection in advance is recommended. There is ample parking, but using public transport, walking, or cycling is recommended. First-aid personnel and defibrillators are available along the course. Cash prizes are awarded to the three fastest men and women. Many gift prizes are drawn by race bib number. The organizer says Lyderhorn Opp will return in 2027. Distance and course details are based on previous editions; details for 2027 have not been provided.

name: Felsburglauf
description: The Felsburglauf is a traditional running event held annually since 2013 on the last Sunday in August at the stadium below Felsburg in Felsberg. The event offers races over 400 m, 1,000 m, 5,000 m and 10,000 m and attracts runners of all ages from the region. Its family-friendly atmosphere and beautiful setting make it a popular event in the Schwalm-Eder district. As a licensed race in the KSK-Schwalm-Eder-Cup, participants can also earn points toward the overall standings.
course_highlights: Races over 400 m, 1,000 m, 5,000 m and 10,000 m
Start and finish at the stadium below historic Felsburg
Family-friendly atmosphere in beautiful surroundings
additional: The race is part of the KSK-Schwalm-Eder-Cup. The youngest participants are often born in 2020 or later, and the oldest runner was born in 1937. The event is organized by TSV Eintracht 1863 Felsberg and partner TSV Jahn Gensungen. Distances: 400 m, 1 km, 5 km, 10 km; terrain: stadium and the area around Felsburg; registration not explicitly mentioned

name: Herbstwaldlauf (Volksbank Sauerland Lauf Cup) inkl. Hobby-Mountainbike-Rennen
location: Finnentrop-Fretter, Finnentrop, Märkischer Kreis, North Rhine-Westphalia, Germany
description: The 62nd Herbstwaldlauf (Volksbank Sauerland Lauf Cup) in Finnentrop-Fretter is a short running event taking place on September 5, 2026. There is also a hobby mountain bike race alongside the run. The event offers runners and mountain bikers an attractive opportunity to experience the autumn scenery of the Sauerland and enjoy an active day.
course_highlights: Short 0.4 km running course
Includes a hobby mountain bike race
Autumn woodland scenery in the Sauerland
additional: The event offers a varied course route, including a trail run, hill run, and mountain biking, with mostly changeable weather in the Sauerland.

name: Volkslauf in St.Vit Laufen und Gutes tun
location: St. Vit, Rheda-Wiedenbrück, North Rhine-Westphalia, Germany
description: The charity run “Laufen und Gutes tun” takes place on September 5, 2026, in St. Vit, Rheda-Wiedenbrück. The races follow flat loop courses through St. Vit, starting and finishing at the Küsterhaus. The event supports various social causes, including pediatric outpatient palliative care, the Malteser Herzenswunsch ambulance, DKMS, and families in need. Alongside the runs, the event features an inline skating race for the first time, as well as a charity tattoo campaign to encourage participants’ social commitment.
course_highlights: Flat loop courses through St. Vit
Start and finish at the Küsterhaus
9.1 km inline skating race (5 laps), helmets required
additional: Timing is provided by a disposable chip attached to the running shoe. Race bibs and materials can be collected on event day from 13:30 in the registration tent next to the Küsterhaus. Water is available along the course, with tea and fruit at the finish area. Changing facilities are available at the local youth center. Helmets are required for the inline skating race. A charity tattoo campaign and DKMS registration will be available on site. Participation through membership is possible; donations support children’s hospices, DKMS, and families in need. Races are offered over various distances, including a Bambini run and inline skating.

name: Werler Kurpark Crosslauf - Hindernislauf für Groß und Klein
location: Werl Kurpark, Werl, North Rhine-Westphalia, Germany
description: The Werler Kurpark Crosslauf is an obstacle race for all ages, held in the picturesque Kurpark in Werl. The event offers races for different age groups and ability levels, from short courses for children to a challenging 6.4 km course for endurance runners. New in 2026 is the relay cross, which encourages team spirit and fun. The varied course features numerous exciting obstacles that make the race a special experience.
course_highlights: A variety of obstacles, including Climb the Wall, Waterlagoon and Mountainclimber
Distances from 480 metres to 6.4 kilometres
New for 2026: Project S as an additional obstacle
additional: On-site late registration is available up to 60 minutes before the respective start (except for the relay). Race numbers use electronic timing via Racersult. An exclusive Kurparkcross shirt can be pre-ordered only until 30.06.2026. Spikes, barefoot running and costumes are not permitted for safety reasons. Accompaniment on the course is permitted only for the U6 Bambini race. Obstacles, courses for children and adults, family-friendly, team spirit, fun

name: Wiehler AggerEnergie- und Sparkasse Gummersbach Sommerlauf
location: Wiehltalstadion, Wiehl, Oberbergischer Kreis, North Rhine-Westphalia, Germany
description: The Wiehl AggerEnergie and Sparkasse Gummersbach Summer Run is a varied running event for all age groups and ability levels. Starting at Wiehltal Stadium, the routes pass through the redesigned parks in the center of Wiehl and offer a scenic setting. Whether you run individually or as part of a team, the Summer Run invites you to get active, enjoy a sense of community, and have fun. The motto “We in Wiehl are sporty!” underscores Wiehl’s vibrant sporting culture.
course_highlights: Start and finish at Wiehltal Stadium
Route through redesigned parks in the city center
Scenic and varied course
additional: The run takes place on Saturday, 05 September 2026. The event is open to individual runners and teams. Contact: Nicole Woberschal (Tel. 02262 99-206). Routes start at Wiehltal Stadium and offer a scenic setting. Registration available.

name: Wildman Harz
description: WILDMAN Harz is a challenging trail-running event around the mountain town of Wildemann in the Harz Mountains. The course features tough climbs, technical downhills, spruce forests and alpine meadows, offering an authentic trail-running experience in the Upper Harz. With distances from 1.5 km to 55 km, there is a suitable challenge for every trail runner. The event also features a varied program, including a pasta party and a barbecue party, making the weekend a special experience.
course_highlights: Tough climbs and technical downhills
Spruce forests and alpine meadows
Singletrack trails over rugged terrain around Wildemann
additional: Late registration is possible online up to 30 minutes before the respective start, with a late-registration fee of EUR 10. Age limits are defined for each course. The program includes a pasta party on Friday and a barbecue party on Saturday. There are race categories, mandatory equipment and aid stations. Registration is through the partner myRacePartner.com. Courses have up to 2,100 metres of elevation gain. Aid stations, timing, environmental and fair-play rules, a program including pasta and barbecue parties, and registration are required.

name: Borkumer Meilenlauf und Nordic Walking
location: Borkum, Nordseeinsel Borkum, Lower Saxony, Germany

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Anmeldungen bis 01.08.2026 mit vollem Leistungspaket inklusive T-Shirt

tiers.label: tier_2
tiers.description: Anmeldungen bis 20.08.2026 mit vollem Leistungspaket inklusive T-Shirt

description: The 20th Borkum Mile Run with Nordic Walking takes place on 5 September 2026 on the North Sea island of Borkum. The varied courses wind through the island’s scenic beaches and dunes, offering a suitable challenge for every aspiring runner, from the junior Pirate Run to the quarter marathon. The offshore climate and fresh sea air make the event a special experience, rounded off by an extensive programme for participants and their companions.
course_highlights: Courses through Borkum’s beaches and dunes
Offshore climate and fresh sea air
A variety of distances, from the Pirate Run to the quarter marathon
additional: Late entries are possible on site on event day up to 45 minutes before the start of the competition, for a late-entry fee of EUR 5.00, but without entitlement to the full package of services or a T-shirt. Refreshments on the course and at the finish, changing rooms, bag storage, showers, and 90 minutes of free access to the Erlebnisdeck at Gezeitenland are included. Discounted ferry fares are also available on the event weekend. Courses along the promenade and beach; no age categories for Nordic Walking; refreshment stations on longer courses.

name: Ederauenlauf
distance_verbose: Halbmarathon, 10 km, 5 km, 2 km, 1 km, 0.4 km
description: The Ederauenlauf in Bergheim is a popular running event offering a variety of distances suitable for runners of all ages and ability levels. The course runs through the picturesque Ederauen and provides ideal conditions on a measured course eligible for record lists. The event is known for its family-friendly atmosphere, numerous volunteers, and great spirit. Alongside the sporting competition, the focus is also on sharing the experience and supporting social projects.
course_highlights: Measured course eligible for record lists through the Ederauen
Distances from the 400 m Bambini race to the half marathon (21.1 km)
Start and finish at the central sports complex of TV08 Bergheim
additional: The event offers various distances, from the 400 m Bambini race to the half marathon (21.1 km). The course is dry and sheltered from the wind, with ideal running weather. There is a family-friendly atmosphere with many volunteers and spectators. The event supports social projects such as the Marburg Children's Cancer Aid. The central sports complex of TV08 Bergheim serves as the start and finish venue. Courses are measured and well marked, including for Nordic walking; donations support children's cancer aid; event in September 2026.

name: Fehmarn Marathon
description: The Fehmarn Marathon takes place annually on the island of Fehmarn and offers runners a varied course through the eastern part of the island. The main races follow roads, dike paths and uneven dirt tracks, providing a diverse running experience. The event starts on 5 September 2026 at 9:30 a.m. at the sports field at Inselschule in Fehmarn. In addition to the marathon, there are other races with award ceremonies, and all participants receive an official marathon shirt. Timing is done with a foot chip attached to the running shoe, and the event takes place in all weather conditions.
course_highlights: Loops along roads, dike paths and uneven dirt tracks
Course through the eastern part of Fehmarn
Start and finish at the sports field at Inselschule
additional: Bib pickup is available the day before the event from 4:00 p.m. to 6:00 p.m. and on the day of the event from 8:00 a.m. Award ceremonies take place at staggered times after the races. Timing is done with a foot chip, which must be returned after the race; a €15 fee applies if it is lost. The event ends at approximately 3:15 p.m. with the arrival of the bicycle escort marking the end of the course. Parking is recommended, with the start area within walking distance. Late entries are possible up to 30 minutes before the respective race. Shirts tend to run small, so larger sizes are recommended. The event takes place in all weather conditions; online registration is available, including running shirts and various categories.

name: Intern. Steinhuder-Meer-Lauf
location: Neustadt am Rübenberge, Lower Saxony, Germany
description: The 46th International Steinhuder Meer Run, organized by TSV Poggenhagen von 1946 e.V., takes place on September 5, 2026. This is a traditional fun run, scored in accordance with the rules of the German Athletics Association (DLO) and recognized for all DLV fun run badges. Certificates are available for all placings and can be downloaded online, and awards are presented to the top three finishers in each category. A special prize is also awarded to the largest registered group. The terms of participation and liability limitations are prerequisites for taking part.

name: Volkslauf Eisbergen 2026
organizer: TuS Eisbergen TURN- UND SPIELVEREIN 1919 EISBERGEN e. V.
description: The Volkslauf Eisbergen is a long-standing running event in Porta Westfalica, offering various distances for children and adults. The course runs around the Eisbergen sports field and offers varied running options, with a 5.7 km Volkslauf and a 17.7 km long-distance race. Refreshments are also provided for participants, and the event is part of the Mühlenkreisserie. The course can also be viewed on Komoot, making it easy to prepare.

name: Volksbank Mitte Kurstadtlauf
description: The VR-Bank Mitte Kurstadtlauf in Heilbad Heiligenstadt is a long-running race taking place for the 27th time on September 5, 2026. The 19-kilometer course crosses the Dün and starts and finishes in the Vitalpark. A tree is planted for each participant to help reforest local woodlands, making the race especially eco-friendly. The event offers a welcoming atmosphere and invites runners of all abilities.

name: 55. Brockenlauf
description: The Brockenlauf is Germany’s oldest mountain race and has been held annually in Ilsenburg in the Harz Mountains since 1927. The main 26.2 km course climbs 890 meters to the Brocken, the highest mountain in northern Germany, and offers a challenging experience with changeable high-mountain weather at the summit. The route passes through picturesque natural scenery and historic places, with impressive views. In addition to the main race, there are other shorter courses that also offer an experience in nature. The event is open to all runners, regardless of club membership.

name: Brokser Volkslauf
description: The Brokser Volkslauf takes place on September 5, 2026, in Bruchhausen-Vilsen and offers running and walking events for all age groups. The event includes distances from 400 m to 20 km, as well as walking and Nordic walking routes. Held in all weather, it offers participants a varied program featuring a bouncy castle, drinks, cake, and bratwurst. The races start at the school and sports center, and children’s and youth races are rewarded with medals.

name: 46. Internationaler Steinhuder-Meer-Lauf
description: The 46th International Steinhuder Meer Run invites running enthusiasts to Poggenhagen on September 5, 2026. The event offers 5 km, 10 km and half-marathon races, all starting together. The scenic course loops around Poggenhagen, passing the air base and continuing to the bathing island in Steinhude. Children can also take part in races over 450 and 850 meters. All races finish at the TSV Poggenhagen sports park.

name: 60. Festiwal Chodu
description: The 60th Race Walking Festival is a prestigious international sporting event held in the port region of Gdańsk on September 5, 2026. The event brings together athletes of different ages and ability levels, offering race-walking competitions over 10 km (women and men, including the Open, U20 and U18 categories), as well as 5 km and 3 km races for younger participants and the Polish Masters Championships over 5 km. The festival also features the Polish U23 Championships over 10 km and accompanying events such as the “Walk with the Postman” Prologue and the Polish Post Office Defenders’ Run – Energa Cup. The organizer, LECHIA Gdańsk Athletics Club, also promotes physical activity among people with disabilities by holding wheelchair races and FrameRunning competitions.

name: XLVI Usedom Marathon
description: The 46th International Usedom Marathon is a unique running event that crosses two countries along Europe’s longest seaside promenade. The 42 km route connects Świnoujście in Poland with Wolgast in Germany, passing through historic seaside resorts and scenic woodland. Runners can enjoy varied surfaces, beautiful views of the Baltic Sea, and the unique atmosphere of Usedom Island.

name: XIV Grand Prix Nordic Walking Nowa Wieś Lęborska
De Mijl van Mares Catch-up Run
Veluwse Trailrun
distance_verbose: 60 km, Marathon, 30 km, Halve marathon, 15 km, 10 km

name: Gå og løb med Støt Brysterne 5. sep. 2027
Ørestad Half Marathon & 10K
description: Flat half marathon and 10K by the sea on Kalvebod Fælled in Copenhagen. AIMS-certified course, starting and finishing at Naturcenter Amager, 5 minutes from Vestamager Metro. The course is flat, with only around 7 metres of elevation gain, and runs along the coast and through the nature reserve. In 2026, 801 runners from 50 nations finished. The entry fee includes chip timing, a medal and a digital diploma. There is room for around 1,000 runners.
additional: Half marathon starts at 10:00, 10K starts at 10:25. Start and finish: Naturcenter Amager, Granatvej 3, 2770 Kastrup. Price: half marathon DKK 495 (DKK 595 from 22/8-2027), 10K DKK 395 (DKK 495 from 22/8-2027).

name: Rødseterpytten Rundt 2027
description: Rødseterpytten Rundt 2027 is a running event for all ages in Asker, Akershus. The main race is a 9 km trail course for adults, with children’s races starting at 400 metres and up. The event is suitable for both recreational and competitive runners, and a kiosk is open during the race. This is an inclusive and enjoyable running experience in scenic surroundings.
course_highlights: 9 km trail course for adults
Children’s races starting at 400 metres and up
Suitable for both recreational and competitive runners
additional: A kiosk is open during the event. The race is organised by Tofte Fremad IF. A kiosk is open.

name: 16. Wardenburger Sommerlauf
description: The Wardenburg Summer Run is a long-standing race in Wardenburg that welcomes runners of all ages. Various distances are offered, from 5 km to the 10-mile race; some start together and split at the Tillysee. The event focuses on fair, well-organized race management with chip timing and offers runners a varied route through the region. Children can take part in special untimed races, and Nordic walking is also on the program. The event is known for its family-friendly atmosphere and the support of a dedicated organizing team.
course_highlights: The 10 km and 10-mile races start together and split at the Tillysee
Varied routes from 5 kilometers through the Wardenburg region
Timing with a chip integrated into the race bib
additional: No on-the-day entries are possible. Race bibs have an integrated chip; race bibs must be returned in the finish area. Running with dogs is not permitted. Baby joggers are allowed; participants with baby joggers should line up at the back. The Bambini run is without a race bib or timing. Toilets and changing rooms are available. Runners who exceed the 16:00 time limit will not be timed. Several distances; some races are not timed; participation is only permitted with a race bib; no on-the-day entries; organized via Laufmanager.

name: 31. Fulda-Marathon

price_tiers.distance: Halbmarathon (Einzel und Team), 5 km, 11 km, Mini-Marathon

description: The Fulda Marathon is a special running experience in the heart of Fulda, Hesse. The route passes the cathedral, runs through the Baroque Old Town and the Fulda floodplains, and finishes in the stadium. The event is organised by volunteers from Leichtathletik-Gemeinschaft Fulda e. V. and offers a well-planned course and professional organisation. In addition to the half marathon, there are other events, including 5 km and 11 km races and a mini marathon for different age groups.
course_highlights: The route passes the cathedral and runs through the Baroque Old Town
A run through the natural landscapes of the Fulda floodplains
Finish in Fulda’s city stadium
additional: Start times for the other races: 10 km at approx. 09:40, 5 km at approx. 10:00, mini marathon at 14:00 (primary school) and 15:00 (lower secondary school). The routes for all events are clearly mapped and can be downloaded. The event is organised by volunteers, with comprehensive support along the course, medical care and refreshments. Fulda Marathon T-shirts and a health check are available. Various events include the half marathon, 11 km, 5 km, team and mini marathon; registration opens on 01.02.2026; check the terms and conditions and cancellation fees; numerous refreshment and support points, an accompanying programme and medical care.

name: 8. Flensburg liebt dich Marathon
description: The Flensburg liebt dich Marathon offers a varied running experience, with routes through Flensburg’s modern and historic city centre, along the Sonwik Marina and by the harbour. The marathon consists of four laps of 10.55 km, with a maritime atmosphere, and finishes at Südermarkt. There is also a half marathon over two laps of the same course, as well as other races, including a marathon relay, 10 km and 5 km runs. The event sends a positive message about community and quality of life in the region and warmly welcomes runners of all abilities.
course_highlights: Four laps of 10.55 km through the city centre, Sonwik Marina and harbour
Flat roads along the Förde with a maritime atmosphere
Finish at Südermarkt in Flensburg
additional: For registrations from 24.08.2026 onwards, race bibs will not be personalised, and medal engraving and shirts will not be offered. Race materials can be collected upon presentation of the digital registration confirmation or an identity document. Participation is limited to 1,000 runners for the marathon and 2,000 for the half marathon. The awards ceremony takes place at Flensburg Galerie. For safety reasons, participation with electronic audio devices, walking poles, jogging strollers, prams and animals is not permitted. Online registration only; race materials can be collected at Flensburg Galerie. Various race distances are available, including a marathon relay, children’s races and practice sessions.

name: DresdenHALF
location: Dresden city center, Dresden, Saxony, Germany

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Die Teilnahme am DresdenHALF KidsRUN kostet 10 Euro.

description: The DresdenHALF is an exciting half marathon that will pass through the heart of Dresden for the first time on September 6, 2026. The 21.1-kilometer course runs along the Elbe and past the city’s most beautiful landmarks, with each mile symbolically dedicated to one of Dresden’s partner cities. The event offers runners a unique experience against a historic backdrop and with an international atmosphere. In addition to the half marathon, there are also other races for children and recreational runners, making the weekend a special running experience.
course_highlights: 21.1 km through the heart of Dresden, along the Elbe
Each mile symbolically dedicated to one of Dresden’s 13 partner cities
Start at the World Trade Center Dresden, finish at the Saxon State Parliament
additional: The DresdenHALF starts at the World Trade Center Dresden and finishes at the Saxon State Parliament. The course is officially measured and eligible for record lists. Participants must be at least 16 years old, and the time limit is 3 hours. Race packets will be distributed on September 4 and 5, 2026, at the World Trade Center Dresden. Every participant receives exclusive arm warmers and a finisher’s medal. The EWG Dresden5K includes an exclusive bobble hat. It is possible to transfer a race entry for a fee. All KidsRUN participants receive a finisher’s medal and certificate. The course is officially measured; participation is open to runners aged 16 and over; the time limit is 3 hours; merchandise and race-entry transfers are available; children’s races and events on the day before the race on September 5 are included.

name: Kasseler Frauenlauf 2026
description: The Kassel Women’s Run is a charity run for women in Kassel-Wehlheiden, traditionally held on the first weekend in September at the Buchenau athletics track. The event focuses on exercise without performance pressure: there is no timing, no ranking and no pressure to set personal bests. Participants can run, jog, walk or stroll, with short children’s races as well as 5 km and 10 km run-walk routes on flat courses. The day supports women in need and fosters a relaxed community atmosphere, with a warm-up program, music, food, a raffle, childcare, applause and participant certificates.
course_highlights: Flat 5 km and 10 km routes
Children’s races of 400 m and 800 m
Finish at the Hessenkampfbahn on Auedamm
additional: There is no timing or ranking. Participants can run, jog, walk or stroll. The event offers a community atmosphere with a warm-up, music, food, a raffle, childcare and participant certificates. It takes place at the Buchenau athletics track in Kassel-Wehlheiden and emphasizes relaxed, inclusive participation for women and children of all ages.

name: Lembecker Galgenberglauf
description: The Lembecker Galgenberglauf is a traditional race with a history spanning more than 40 years, held in Hohe Mark Nature Park. The routes pass through gently hilly woodland and offer runners a special experience in nature. Various distances are offered, from a 400 m Bambini run to the 10 km main race, as well as walking and Nordic walking routes. The event is family-friendly and offers suitable races for all age groups.
course_highlights: Routes pass through gently hilly woodland in Hohe Mark Nature Park
Running routes are entirely on forest paths, some of which are gravel
Gentle climbs along the route
additional: Start times are staggered by distance and age group from 09:30 to 10:40. Tea and water are available in the start and finish area, and breakfast is offered. No showers or changing rooms are available. The late entry fee for in-person registration on the day of the event is €3.00. Race on forest paths with gentle climbs; registration online or on the day of the event; no showers or changing rooms; tea, water and breakfast available.

name: New Balance KÖ MEILE 2026
price_range: kostenlos bis 28 Euro, je nach Kategorie und Meldedatum
description: The New Balance Kö Meile is a unique running event on Düsseldorf’s Königsallee, taking place on September 6, 2026. It offers runners of all abilities a running party with plenty of atmosphere, music, confetti, and a special setting in the heart of the city. The event includes various races over 5 km, the mile (1,609 m), and children’s and youth races. The course is officially measured, paved, and certified by World Athletics, making it eligible for rankings. Whether you’re aiming for a personal best or taking part in your first race, the shared running experience is what matters most.
course_highlights: Officially measured, paved circuit on Königsallee
Official World Ranking Competition with World Athletics certification
Atmosphere with a DJ truck, cheering zone, medal, and donuts
additional: The 5 km races are divided by target finish times to prevent lapping. A limited edition of event performance shirts is available to order only when registering. The Elite Mile for women and men, as well as the REHACARE Inclusion ½ Mile, are invitation-only races. Late registration is available until race day for an additional fee, subject to the participant limit. Officially measured, certified circuit; various race categories; personalized race bibs for registrations through August 30, 2026; event shirts available for purchase; race packs can be collected on September 4 and 5, 2026; shipping options available during registration.

name: Schapener Volkslauf
description: The Schapen Fun Run offers runners and walkers a choice of distances in a natural setting around the village of Schapen and the Riddagshausen ponds. The routes pass through idyllic woodland and pond areas, as well as historic places such as Schapen railway station. The 1.2 km route is especially family-friendly and is intended mainly for children and young people, accompanied by their families. The event features a group warm-up, childcare and massages in exchange for a donation, and warmly welcomes everyone who enjoys running.
course_highlights: The 10.5 km route loops around the Riddagshausen ponds and passes through Buchhorst
The 6.1 km route passes Schäfer’s Ruh and historic Schapen railway station
The 1.2 km route is for children and young people and can be completed once or twice
additional: Start times vary by distance, from 9:15 a.m. to 10:20 a.m. There is a group warm-up, childcare and massages in exchange for a donation. The event is organized by Turn- und Sportverein 1921 Schapen e.V. The event takes place in September 2026 and includes various running and walking distances, as well as activities such as a warm-up, childcare and massages.

name: Sparkassen-Stadtlauf
description: The 20th Sparkassen City Run in Wachtendonk takes place on September 6, 2026, transforming the municipality into a lively running arena. The event welcomes all ages and ability levels, from ambitious runners and recreational joggers to families. The races start at 2:00 p.m. at Friedensplatz, accompanied by an exhilarating atmosphere, a varied supporting program, and dedicated volunteers. The run offers outstanding athletic performances and personal achievements in a community atmosphere.
course_highlights: A variety of races for all ages and ability levels
Start and finish at Friedensplatz in Wachtendonk
An exhilarating atmosphere along the course and a varied supporting program
additional: Registration is easy via the registration button on the website. The event is being held under the leadership and organization of the Municipality of Wachtendonk for the first time. A varied supporting program and dedicated volunteers help create a special atmosphere. Races for all ages and ability levels, online registration, supporting program, at Friedensplatz

name: Stadtwerkelauf Pinneberg

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: 6,00 € für Kinder & Jugendliche bis einschl. Jahrgang 2008

description: The Stadtwerkelauf Pinneberg is a long-standing running event taking place on September 6, 2026, in Pinneberg. The event offers various distances for children, young people, and adults, including a 1 km fun run for kindergarten children, a 2.5 km beginners’ and team race, and 5 km and 10 km courses for older participants. The races follow green loop courses through Pinneberger Fahlt and around Drosteipark, with the start and finish centrally located on Am Drosteipark. The event is family-friendly, and spectators can watch and cheer on the children throughout the fun run.
course_highlights: Green loop course through Pinneberger Fahlt and around Drosteipark
Children’s fun run with 2 laps around Drosteipark
Start and finish centrally located on Am Drosteipark
additional: Race packs (bib numbers including transponders) will be distributed at the VfL-Sportzentrum Fahltskamp on 04.09.2026 from 09:00-19:00 and on 05.09.2026 from 09:00-16:00. Late entries are possible online until one hour before the start for an additional fee of €5.00. The team classification is based on 3 runners, whose individual times are added together; mixed teams are allowed. Online registration is available; bib number pickup is on September 4 and 5 at the VfL-Sportzentrum; late entries are subject to a fee; the start and finish area is at Drosteiwiese.

name: Geithainer Herbstlauf
description: The Geithain Autumn Run is a family-friendly autumn race held at the Geithain Stadium in Geithain, Germany. The event offers various distances for all age groups, including a 300 m Bambini Run, a 2.5 km Chestnut Run for children, a 7 km Fun Run, a 7 km walking route, and a 17 km scenic run for older participants and walkers. The start and finish are at the stadium, and the courses are GPS-measured and approved by the German Athletics Association. In addition to the races, there is a children’s programme, a bouncy castle, certificates, medals and small prizes. Every fifth finisher in races of 7 km or longer is rewarded with a bottle of sparkling wine.
course_highlights: Start and finish at Geithain Stadium
GPS-measured courses ranging from 0.3 km to 17 km
Family-friendly programme with children’s races and walking routes
additional: Every fifth finisher in the 7 km races or longer receives a bottle of sparkling wine. The event is organised by Impact Geithain e. V., with support from FSV Alemannia Geithain e. V. The children’s programme and bouncy castle are part of the event. The event includes children’s races, childcare, certificates, finisher medals, small prizes for children and a special bonus: every fifth finisher in the longer races receives a bottle of sparkling wine.

name: 10. Parchener Fiener-Cross
description: The Parchen Fiener Cross is a long-standing cross-country race in the Jerichower Land district, held in northern Saxony-Anhalt as part of the ELBE-OHRE-CUP running series. The event attracts numerous runners of all ages each year and offers additional competitions, including the Heidel Team Cup and a family classification. The race takes place at the Klapperhalle on Parkstraße in Parchen and is known for its varied cross-country course. The event promotes running in the region and brings together sporting competition and a sense of community.

name: 15. Brunsberglauf
location: Holm-Seppensen, Buchholz in der Nordheide, Lower Saxony, Germany
description: The 15th Brunsberglauf on September 6, 2026, in Buchholz/Holm-Seppensen offers runners a varied program, including main races over 11.7 km, a half marathon, and a 5 km family run. The courses pass through forests and blooming heathland, with highlights such as Höllenschlucht, Brunsberg, Mühlenteich, and Zwergentunnel. There are also four children’s races for different age groups. The whole family can enjoy an attractive program of activities in the finish area. The Brunsberglauf’s motto is “Running and doing good,” and it supports charitable organizations in the region.

name: 23. Schoninger Volkslauf
description: The Schoninger Volkslauf is a long-standing running event in the Solling, held annually by SC Schoningen 04. The event offers runners of different ages and ability levels the opportunity to run varied routes through the beautiful countryside around Schoningen. The race is known for its friendly atmosphere and strong sense of community, promoting both sport and togetherness. Every year, numerous runners take part to compete and enjoy a great running event together.

name: 37. CURREX Alsterlauf
description: The CURREX Alsterlauf is a traditional road race in Hamburg, held on a flat, traffic-free loop around the Inner and Outer Alster lakes. The event offers a unique start and finish atmosphere in Hamburg city center and is one of Europe’s largest 10-kilometer road races. In addition to the main 10 km race, there are also 5 km events, a schoolchildren’s race, and the R5K Tour for young runners. The courses are officially measured and ideal for fast times.

name: 38. Volkslauf des TSV Breuna
description: The 38th Breuna Malsburg Run takes place on 6 September 2026 and is a long-established running event in the Breuna running and hiking park. The race offers an attractive course through the beautiful natural surroundings of Breuna and is open to runners of all ages. The event is organized by TSV Breuna e.V. and is part of the Nordhessencup. Registration is via the RaceResult platform.

name: 6. Tuchmacher Stadtlauf
description: The Tuchmacher City Run in Bramsche is a popular event with several race distances that attracts numerous participants each year. The event is known for its welcoming atmosphere and varied route through the city center. The 10 km main race is particularly popular with competitive athletes, while the schoolchildren’s race draws a large field and creates a lively atmosphere. The Bramscher Rumläufer organize the event with great dedication, supported by local schools and sponsors.

name: Bahndammlauf
description: The Buchholz Bahndamm Run is a varied running event that combines nature and good food. The route leads from the stadium along the railway embankment through the districts of Wahl and Wallau to the Franziskus Cross, with a challenging climb to Mückensee, the highest point on the course. From there, it continues mostly downhill or on flat terrain to Asbach-Walgenbach, with several drink stations along the way. The event takes place at the SV Buchholz 05 sports ground and, in addition to the race, offers an extensive cake buffet and hearty food from the Grillhexen. Participation supports the Förderkreis für krebskranke Kinder und Jugendliche Bonn e.V.

name: Breunaer Volkslauf mit 21,1km Malsburglauf
description: The 38th Breunaer Malsburglauf takes place on September 6, 2026, and is an established running event in Breuna. The race runs through the Breuna Running and Hiking Park and offers an attractive course for runners. The event is organized by TSV Breuna e.V. and is open to runners of different ages and ability levels. Registration is via the RaceResult platform.

name: Gölitztallauf
description: The Gölitztallauf is an annual race in Marktgölitz, celebrating its 44th edition on September 6, 2026. The event features four different race distances, including a 1 km children’s race. It is known for its family-friendly atmosphere and awards across various age groups. Award ceremonies take place soon after the races to keep participants’ wait times short.

name: R5K - 5K Alsterlauf Hamburg 2026
description: The CURREX Alsterlauf Hamburg is a traditional running event featuring officially measured, flat, paved courses along the Outer Alster and on Ballindamm. The event offers various distances, including 10 km, 5 km and children’s races, and is open to runners of different age groups. The races are traffic-free and safely supervised by police and race marshals. The Hamburg 10 km Road Championships are also held as part of the Alsterlauf.

name: Stadtallendorfer Stadtlauf
description: The Stadtallendorf City Run takes place as part of the Heimat- und Soldatenfest in Stadtallendorf and is organized by TSV Stadtallendorf in cooperation with the German Armed Forces. The course is a loop through Heinz-Lang-Park and the adjacent stadium. Races are offered for various ability levels, including a 5-kilometer fun run and a 10-kilometer main race. These are followed by races for young people and children. The event attracts numerous athletes and offers a sporting challenge in a friendly, festive atmosphere.

name: Stadtwerke Halbmarathon Bochum
description: The Stadtwerke Half Marathon Bochum 2026 is a long-standing race that runs through Bochum city center. The course consists of an introductory loop and three large laps, with about 150 meters of elevation gain, making the race varied and challenging. In addition to the half marathon, there are relay races, a 10 km race, a 5 km race, a schoolchildren’s race, and a Bambini run. The event also offers an extensive supporting program and a training group starting in May 2026.

name: Dörverden läuft 2026
description: The run in Dörverden is a versatile running event suitable for all ages and ability levels. The measured courses range from 1.8 km for walking and running to the 10 km main race, which consists of two 5 km laps. The event offers a family-friendly atmosphere and promotes community sport in the Lower Saxony region. Races start in staggered intervals from 10:00 a.m., so every participant can find a suitable event.

name: Glomb City Marathon Bremerhaven
description: The GLOMB City Marathon Bremerhaven is an annual marathon in Bremerhaven, held since 2005. In addition to the marathon, the event includes a half marathon and a 10 km race. The course is a flat loop starting and finishing in front of the Bürgermeister-Smidt-Gedächtniskirche, and runs through the city center and Havenwelten. Runners enjoy an attractive route with many sights and a unique setting along the water and harbor facilities. The event is organized by the event agency Execute Sports Events, which ensures professional organization.

name: 44 Międzynarodowy Otwarty Bieg Przełajowy o Puchar Leśny pamięci Tomasza Hopfera
location: Obliwice, Nowa Wieś Lęborska, Pomeranian Voivodeship, Poland
description: Join the 44th International Open Cross-Country Race for the Forest Cup in memory of Tomasz Hopfer, taking place on September 6, 2026, in Obliwice. The main race course is 6.4 km long and consists of two 3.2 km laps, with the start and finish in the same place. The event offers a unique sporting atmosphere, combining competition with recreation for the whole family amid nature. The race commemorates Tomasz Hopfer, a legend of Polish sports journalism and an athlete, and promotes a healthy lifestyle and physical activity in the local community.

name: 64 Bieg Westerplatte
description: The 64th Westerplatte Run is Poland’s oldest continuously held 10-kilometre road race, taking place in Gdańsk. The race starts at the historic site where World War II began, giving the event a unique character and an atmosphere of reflection on sacrifice and peace. The course is certified and marked every kilometre, and the finish is at Polsat Plus Arena Gdańsk, providing an extra attraction for participants. The event attracts up to 5,000 runners and is both a sporting challenge and a tribute to the Defenders of the Coast in 1939.

name: VII Bieg o Puchar Wójta Gminy Zblewo
location: Twardy Dół, Zblewo, Pomeranian Voivodeship, Poland

name: X Bieg Neptuna
location: Trzebież, Police County, West Pomeranian Voivodeship, Poland

name: Rondje Oude IJsselstreek

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: De kosten per team bedragen € 60,00. Inschrijven kan t/m vrijdag 3 september 2027.

description: The Rondje Oude IJsselstreek is an annual relay race organized by athletics club Atletico’73, in which teams of seven runners cover distances between 4 and 7 kilometers. The start and finish are at the Atletico'73 athletics track in Gendringen. The route passes through a beautiful green setting and several villages in the municipality of Oude IJsselstreek. Participants enjoy the event as a fun, sporty activity to share with their teammates.
course_highlights: 7 stages of between 4 and 7 kilometers through a green setting
Routes through the villages of Ulft, Silvolde, Westendorp, Sinderen and Voorst
A mix of paved and unpaved roads and paths, sometimes with loose sand
additional: Teams consist of 7 people, with at least 1 woman and 1 man. There are two start waves, with the slower wave starting first. Bonus and penalty minutes are awarded based on the team’s gender mix and speed. Prizes are awarded to the fastest team, the last team, and teams that finish in specific places. Cycling routes are available to reach the relay points without crossing the running routes. Untrained runners and participants under 14 are advised not to take part. 7 distances between 4 and 7 km, course on paved and unpaved roads, start and finish at the Atletico’73 Gendringen athletics track

name: Blodomloppet Eskilstuna
price_range: 350 kr för 5 eller 10 km; 100 kr för Lilla Blodomloppet (preliminära uppgifter för 2027)

tiers.label: tier_2
tiers.description: därefter sker en höjning på 50 kr (400 kr)

description: Blodomloppet in Eskilstuna is a fun run that highlights the life-saving importance of blood donation. Participants can choose to walk, jog or run 5 km or 10 km, either individually or as part of a team. The race starts and finishes in Stadsparken and follows a scenic course along the river promenade and the city streets. There is also Lilla Blodomloppet and Specialomloppet for those who want to take part in shorter distances. Blodomloppet is a social and healthy activity that concludes with a shared picnic for participants.
course_highlights: Start and finish in Stadsparken, Eskilstuna
5 km and 10 km courses along the river promenade and the city streets
Certified 5,000 m course measured by an SFIF course measurer
additional: You can register individually or as a team of 3–5 participants; a picnic for 5 people is included. Team members may take part in different distances/classes (except Lilla Blodomloppet). The deadline for team registration is 31/8. Lilla Blodomloppet and Specialomloppet start in Stadsparken and follow shorter courses inside the park. The course is officially measured, and timing is provided for the 5 km and 10 km distances. You can register individually or as a team of 3–5 people. Lilla Blodomloppet is for children up to age 12; Specialomloppet is 1.5–3 km.
