name: Skärblackaloppet 2026
location: Folkets Hus, Skärblacka, Norrköping Municipality, Östergötland County, Sweden

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Early Bird, 250 kr, fram till och med 30 april 23:59.

description: Skärblackaloppet is an annual town race through beautiful Skärblacka in Östergötland. The event offers a festival atmosphere where everyone can take part, whether they choose to run 6 km, walk 4 km or cheer from the sidelines. The course runs on asphalt, cycle paths, gravel and partly on trails, with the start and finish at Folkets Hus. There are great prizes and exciting features such as the Mericon sprint and prize ceremonies for both runners and walkers.
course_highlights: 6 km run through Skärblacka on asphalt, cycle paths, gravel and trails
4 km walking class without timekeeping, starting and finishing at Folkets Hus
Mericon sprint over the final 300 metres, with a chance to win a gift card
additional: Race numbers can be collected at ICA Supermarket in Skärblacka on the Tuesday before the race between 11:00 and 18:00, or at Folkets Hus no later than one hour before the start. Late registration is available at race-number collection and on race day for an additional fee. Prizes are awarded to the fastest runners, gift cards are available for the Mericon sprint, and there are also prizes for picking up trimmers and tyres along the course. The walking class is not timed, and dogs are not allowed. A first-aid volunteer will be on site. There is also a 4 km walking class.

name: Sørdalskarusellen - Tverrløpet
location: Kleivbakken above Håkons Hall, Lillehammer, Norway
description: Sørdalskarusellen - Tverrløpet is the season finale of Sørdalskarusellen, a series of ten recreational races held from April to September. The race is suitable for everyone, regardless of fitness, age or ambitions, and focuses on the joy of running, community and personal achievement. The event offers an enjoyable race experience with a mass start and the option to run virtually. The start is at Kleivbakken above Håkons Hall in Lillehammer, and the distance is approximately 3.9 km.
course_highlights: Approximately 3.9 km course
Start at Kleivbakken above Håkons Hall in Lillehammer
Season finale of Sørdalskarusellen, with a mass start
additional: You can participate virtually from 5 to 8 September. The race is part of a series of ten recreational races suitable for all levels and ages. The organisers are Innlandet Corporate Sports Association and Tele BIL. The event emphasises the joy of running, community and personal achievement. Tverrløpet can also be completed virtually. The listed 2027 event is dated 8 September, but the date and time of the mass start should be confirmed with the organisers’ latest information.

name: Sormlands 100 Trail Run
description: Sörmlands 100 Trail Run is a running event offering a unique experience through one of Sweden’s most biologically diverse regions. The races range from 8 km to 100 miles and cover a mix of forest trails, technical coastal paths, and fast sections. The event welcomes runners of all ages and abilities and offers a memorable weekend in Nävekvarn, surrounded by beautiful nature and challenging terrain.
course_highlights: A mix of forest trails, technical coastal paths, and fast sections
Distances ranging from 8 km to 100 miles
Beautiful, biologically diverse region along the Sörmlandsleden trail
additional: All distances are cupless, so participants must bring their own cup for drinks. After the race, a sauna and Nävekvarn Folkets Park are available. Well-stocked aid stations offer, among other things, Coca-Cola, Umara, coffee, and locally produced food. GPS tracking and live results are available. Mandatory equipment requirements vary by distance and include a mobile phone, navigation tools, a first-aid kit, and a headlamp for longer distances. Transport from the finish is available for the 50 km distance, with a bus to Nyköping Central Station. Race weekend runs from 10–12 September 2027. Registration opens on 1 December.

name: Sörmlands 100 Trail Run
location: Mariefred, Strängnäs Municipality, Södermanland County, Sweden
description: Sörmlands 100 Trail Run is an ultramarathon offering a unique experience through one of Sweden’s most species-rich regions. The race offers several distances from 8 km up to 100 miles, across varied terrain including forest trails, technical coastal paths, and fast sections. The event welcomes runners of all ages and levels and promises a memorable day in beautiful and challenging natural surroundings. After the race, sauna and locally produced food and drinks are available at Nävekvarn Folkets Park.
course_highlights: A mix of forest trails, technical coastal paths, and fast sections
Beautiful and challenging trail sections on the Sörmlandsleden trail
Well-stocked aid stations with a variety of energy options and drinks
additional: All distances are cupless, so participants must bring their own cup for drinks. Mandatory equipment includes a GPS tracker, a mobile phone with important numbers, a first-aid kit, a rain jacket, and a headlamp with extra batteries. Well-stocked aid stations along the course offer Coca-Cola, Umara, coffee, fruit, chips, and local specialties, among other items. After the race, sauna, locally produced food, and non-alcoholic beer are available. Shuttle buses from the finish of the 50 km race to Nyköping Central Station are available.

name: Bergisch Gladbacher Stadtlauf
organizer: SV Blau-Weiß Hand e.V., Stadt Bergisch Gladbach
price_range: Hauptlauf: 11-23 Euro, Erlebnislauf: 9-13 Euro, Gruppenrabatte verfügbar
description: The Bergisch Gladbach City Run is a long-standing running event that has taken place annually since 1996. On September 11, 2026, around 1,000 running enthusiasts will start at 6:30 p.m. on Konrad-Adenauer-Platz in the car-free city center. The event includes an untimed fun run and a main race with rankings in various age groups. The event is accompanied by a colorful program of music, food, and drinks, adding to the atmosphere of the city and culture festival.
course_highlights: Run through the car-free city center of Bergisch Gladbach
Start and finish on Konrad-Adenauer-Platz in the city center
Traditional opening event of the city and culture festival
additional: Late registration for both races is available on September 12, 2025, from 4 p.m. The fun run is untimed and has no age-group categories. The main race includes rankings for all age groups, from birth year 2014 onward, in accordance with the 2025 German Athletics Regulations. Certificates for all participants are available online. The awards ceremony is at around 9 p.m. Special awards go to the largest registered group and the youngest and oldest participants. Distances: 3 km and 9 km; online registration; timing with a MikaTag transponder; program includes music and food.

name: Bergneustädter AggerEnergie- und Sparkassen Nachtlauf
location: Bergneustadt, Oberbergischer Kreis, North Rhine-Westphalia, Germany
description: The Bergneustädter AggerEnergie- und Sparkassen Nachtlauf is an evening running event in Bergneustadt, Germany, held on a Friday after nightfall. The program offers several running and walking options, including a flat 3.7 km course, a 5.4 km relay, a 5.4 km run, and a 10 km run. All races start and finish at the same locations, making the event family-friendly and easy to follow. Children’s and youth competitions round out the program, making the evening appealing to local clubs, young runners, walkers, relay teams, and adults looking for a short but intensive evening run.
course_highlights: Flat 3.7 km course as a gentler option
Hilly 5.4 km and 10 km courses
Shared start and finish area for all races
additional: The event takes place on Friday evening after nightfall. It is designed to be compact, making it easy for families and supporters to follow. Typical September weather is around 19 °C during the day and 10 °C at night, usually cloudy, with an average of 45 mm of precipitation. Family-friendly; children’s and youth competitions; September event with typical weather of around 19 °C high, 10 °C low, and 45 mm of precipitation.

name: Int. ENNI Citylauf Xanten
price_range: 40 Euro (5 km und 10 km), 25 Euro (Jahrgang 2010-2013 5 km), plus Pfand
description: The 31st Int. ENNI Citylauf Xanten takes place on September 11, 2026, in Xanten and offers races over 1.5 km, 5 km, and 10 km. The event is an established running event in the city of Xanten and is open to runners of all ability levels. The race takes place in typical September weather, with mild temperatures and mostly cloudy skies. The course runs through the city and offers varied scenery.
course_highlights: Distances: 1.5 km, 5 km, and 10 km
Course through the city of Xanten
Typical September weather with mild temperatures and cloudy skies
additional: Please check the event details with the organizer before registering. Races in Moers, Sonsbeck, Neukirchen-Vluyn, and Xanten; registration until March 2026; T-shirt included; rankings based on gun times

name: SportScheck RUN Köln
organizer: Motor Presse Hamburg GmbH & Co. KG Verlagsgesellschaft
description: The SportScheck Run Cologne is an atmospheric night run that gives runners the chance to experience Cologne after dark. Participants traditionally start on the Rheinboulevard and run either 5 km or 10 km through the city center, passing historic landmarks such as the Town Hall and enjoying an impressive view of Cologne Cathedral illuminated at night. The event is part of Germany’s largest and longest-running city race series and offers an unforgettable atmosphere, with refreshments at the finish and a finisher’s medal.

name: Emder Sparkassen Delftlauf
description: The Emder Sparkassen Delftlauf takes place on September 11, 2026, at Hafentor in Emden and is organised by Emder Laufgemeinschaft e.V. The event offers 6-kilometre and 10-kilometre runs, as well as 6-kilometre walking/Nordic walking. The course runs through the city of Emden and is conducted in accordance with the International Competition Rules. Timing is provided using a chip supplied by the organiser, and certificates are awarded to the three fastest women and men. The race is open to everyone, including unaffiliated participants.

name: Lauf der Bildung Aschersleben
description: The Lauf der Bildung in Aschersleben is a family-friendly city race on Friday evening, starting and finishing at Augustapromenade. The course passes through the historic city wall area and offers distances of 2.3 km, 4.6 km and 9.2 km for children, recreational runners and ambitious runners completing multiple laps. The event is part of the Solvay Cup and attracts both club runners and local families. The atmosphere is small and welcoming, and the event is well organised by the Kreisvolkshochschule Aschersleben.

name: Den Genfundne Bro Løbet - Cannonball Halvmaraton Løb
MOSSARUN
description: Mossarun is a small, welcoming charity race in southern Sweden, focused on technical singletrack and community rather than prize money. The main format is a 17 km loop used for the 24-hour ultra; there are also 51 km and a children’s race. The course is technical and hilly, with many short, steep climbs and mostly singletrack. The organizers emphasize simplicity and sustainability, and a large portion of the entry fee goes to charity.
course_highlights: 17 km loop — used for the 24-hour ultra (51 km = 3 laps)
Approximately 500 m of elevation gain per lap (according to barometric watches)
90% singletrack, 10% gravel; technical terrain with many short hills
additional: Accommodation: you can sleep in the barn (20–30 places) or camp on site; social activities before and after the race include a campfire and BBQ/pizza. Wood-fired pizza is sold (100–120 kr, 13:00–15:00). 24-hour runners pass the base camp every lap; there are special features for the 24-hour race ("chainsaw segment") — see the race rules. The cut-off for the 24-hour ultra is stated as Sunday 6.09.2026. The event provides separate toilets/changing rooms and access to menstrual products; support is available to help find a night-running buddy for dark laps. Swish donations to WAR Child: 900 55 47 (write "mossarun"); alternatively, donate via the respective NGO’s website. Registration requires proof of a donation to War Child or another NGO; the event offers several distances and a child-friendly course.

name: Bysjöloppet
description: Bysjöloppet is a highly regarded race organized by Åtvidabergs IF since 1983. The race offers a varied course combining asphalt, gravel roads and forest trails through scenic, gently rolling terrain around Lake Bysjön in Åtvidaberg. The start and finish are at Edbergavallen, and the event offers several distances for both children and adults, with timing for most races. It is a family-friendly and inclusive competition, with medals for everyone who finishes and special commemorative medals for loyal participants.
course_highlights: A varied mix of surfaces: asphalt, gravel roads and forest trails
Scenic terrain around Lake Bysjön with moderate elevation changes
The 10 km course includes challenging trail sections and floodlit trails
additional: Start times: 700 m at 11:30, 1.3 km at 11:40, and 5 km and 10 km at 13:00. Race bibs can be collected from 10:00 on race day at Edbergavallen. Changing facilities, showers and toilets are available at Kanonvallen. A kiosk serving hot dogs, drinks and sweets is located at the event venue. Teams consist of 4–6 participants in any categories and receive a picnic bag from ICA Supermarket to share after finishing. Late registration is available on site from 10:00, with payment by Swish or cash; discount codes cannot be used for on-site late registration. The race has traditionally been held on the second Saturday in September and offers distances for children and adults.

name: Hagenloppet
description: Hagenloppet is a traditional running race held at Billingen in Skövde. The race offers several distances, including 8.8 km, 4.4 km, 2.5 km, and a children’s race for the youngest participants. The spectator-friendly course consists of two loops, with the start and finish at the ski stadium. The event is marked by a wonderful spirit of running and has a long history, attracting many participants from different age groups.
course_highlights: The course is 4.4 km long and consists of two loops
Start and finish at the ski stadium on Billingen
Spectator-friendly course with clear markings and course marshals
additional: Race numbers can be collected at the ski stadium from 10:00 and no later than 30 minutes before the start. Timing is done with a chip attached to the race number. Water is available at the lap point and finish. All finishers receive a medal. Prizes are awarded to the fastest runners in different categories. Late registration is available on race day from 10:00 until 45 minutes before the start. Refreshments are available near the finish. Parking is at the main car park in the Billingen Recreation Area.

name: Gränna StadsTrail
description: Gränna StadsTrail is a fun run offering a unique experience in nature and a challenge, with three distances: 5, 10 and 21 km. The race features varied terrain, from asphalt to winding trails through beech forest and up to the summit of Grännaberget. The start and finish are centrally located at Gränna Square, where participants can enjoy beautiful views over Lake Vättern and a mass start. All participants receive a unique medal, and times are recorded for all distances. The race is suitable for both beginners and experienced runners looking to combine performance with an experience in nature.
course_highlights: 21 km course combining asphalt, trails and gravel roads
Route through beech forest and up to the summit of Grännaberget
Start and finish at Gränna Square, with views over Lake Vättern
additional: The mass start is from Gränna Square, going through the town to the harbor, where timing begins. Timing and a unique medal for all participants. The race venue is in the heart of Gränna, close to shops, cafés and accommodation. The courses may change depending on conditions and permits. Timing and a medal at the finish.

name: Bocksten Vineyard Backyard Ultra
location: Ästad Vingård, Tvååker, Varberg Municipality, Halland County, Sweden
description: Bocksten Vineyard Backyard Ultra is a unique trail race held at Ästad Vingård. The race follows a 6.7 km loop through beautiful surroundings, with a start every hour on the hour. Participants run lap after lap until only one runner remains, creating an exciting and challenging race format. The event offers a wonderful atmosphere and the opportunity to enjoy Ästad Vingård’s scenic surroundings over an entire weekend.
course_highlights: A 6.7 km loop through the beautiful surroundings of Ästad Vingård
A start every hour on the hour, with runners completing laps until only one remains
Scenic views of beech forests, spruce forests and bogs
additional: The race starts every hour on the hour from 09:00. Anyone who does not complete the course before the next start is out of the race. The race continues until only one participant remains, and that runner completes a final solo lap. The loop course increases safety, makes the race spectator-friendly and allows runners to change equipment at the end of each lap. The event encourages community and respect for nature. The first start is at 09:00. The race continues until one participant remains, and that runner completes a final lap.

name: USWE Paradiset STHLM
description: USWE Paradiset STHLM is a trail race in the beautiful and rugged Paradiset nature reserve in southern Stockholm. The race offers challenging trail running along winding paths, across bogs and boardwalks, where runners experience forest, mountains and sea. The distances are 26 km, 13 km and 6 km, and the 26 km distance is a leg of the Outnorth Trailtour. The race is known for its strong sense of community and festive atmosphere after the finish.
course_highlights: Beautiful wild terrain with rocky outcrops and open pine forest
Small winding trails, bogs and boardwalks
The 26 km distance is a leg of the Outnorth Trailtour
additional: The race offers three distances: 26 km, 13 km and 6 km. There is a strong sense of community and a festive atmosphere after the finish. The terrain is challenging and gives runners a strong sense of achievement. 26 km. The race is part of the Outnorth Trailtour.

name: Innovationsstafetten
organizer: IFK Lund Friidrott, Ideon Science Park och Medicon Village
description: Innovationsstafetten is a relay race for teams of 2–4 people, held in Nobelparken in Brunnshög, Lund. The course is approximately 5.4 km long and winds through areas including ESS and Kunskapsparken, on a mix of asphalt and gravel. The relay is part of Innovationsloppet & stafetten, where participants kick off autumn together with an energy boost in a welcoming and inclusive atmosphere. The races celebrate Lund as a city of innovation and are organised in partnership by IFK Lund Friidrott and Ideon Science Park.
course_highlights: The course is approximately 5.4 km and runs from Nobelparken via ESS and Kunskapsparken
A mix of asphalt and gravel, with a flat course and approximately 10 metres of elevation difference
Views of northwestern Lund from a hill in Kunskapsparken
additional: Relay teams can be women's, men's or mixed teams of 2–4 people, and runners may run more than one leg. The start and finish are in Nobelparken in Brunnshög. The relay starts 15 minutes before the individual race. After finishing, participants can choose between a medal or a sausage. The competition area is easily accessible by tram and bus. Teams compete in women's, men's or mixed categories. Each runner runs approximately 5 km.

name: Enköpingsloppet
description: Enköpingsloppet is an annual running festival in Enköping that brings together hundreds of runners from across Sweden. The event offers several distances for runners of all levels, from a children’s race to longer 10 km races, and is a celebration for the whole city. The courses are scenic and flat, with beautiful views of Enköping’s parks and waterfront areas. There is a group warm-up, music and cheering along the course, as well as post-race refreshments with recovery drinks and snacks.
course_highlights: A scenic two-lap course around Drömparken (5.5 km)
A flat, scenic 10 km course through Enköping, officially measured by the Swedish Athletics Association
A water station halfway along the 10 km course, with music and cheering along the way
additional: Group warm-up approximately 15 minutes before each race starts. Post-race refreshments with recovery drinks and snacks for all runners. Results and finish times are available online immediately after finishing. The event area at ENA-vallen’s IP opens at 10:00. Start times: 11:00 Ajabaja Cancer Race (children’s race), 12:30 APC Race (5.5 km), 14:00 ICA Maxi Mile (10 km). Prize ceremonies take place after each race. The event area is located at ENA-vallen’s IP. The official website lists a different race date for 2027 than the stated date of 11 September.

name: Hogialoppet 2026

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Deltagaravgiften är 100 kronor per vuxen vid anmälan till klasserna DAM och HERR

description: Hogialoppet is a fun run in Stenungsund that focuses on the joy of movement and community. Participants can choose to run, jog or walk one of two distances, approximately 3.1 km or 6.5 km. Everyone is welcome, including children, dogs, and participants with strollers or walking poles. The event area offers activities and entertainment for the whole family on race day.
course_highlights: The course is approximately 6.5 km long and runs from Hogia, over Hallerna to Kyrkenorum, and back along Ucklumsvägen
A water station is available after approximately 3 km
The finish is in the event area, where participants are offered water and fruit
additional: The starting field is arranged so that participants with walking poles, dogs or strollers line up farther back to avoid congestion. Race bibs can be collected from 09:00. The event area is open 09:30–13:30 and offers a quiz walk with questions for both adults and children. Participants may bring a stroller, dog or walking poles. For the 2026 race, the adult entry fee is stated to go entirely to BRIS. Dogs, strollers and walking poles are allowed. The race has also included a shorter children's race.

name: Innovationsloppet
organizer: IFK Lund Friidrott och Ideon Science Park
description: Innovationsloppet & the relay is a running event held in Nobelparken in Brunnshög, Lund. The event offers an individual 11 km distance or a relay with 4 legs of 5.5 km each. The course winds through areas such as ESS and Kunskapsparken, offering flat, varied terrain with asphalt and gravel. The event celebrates Lund as a city of innovation and is open to women’s, men’s and mixed relay teams, as well as individual runners. The start and finish are centrally located in Nobelparken, with good public transport connections by tram and bus.
course_highlights: The course is approximately 5.4 km per lap, with two laps for individual runners
The terrain is flat, with approximately 10 metres of elevation difference, and consists of asphalt and gravel
Views over northwestern Lund from a hill in Kunskapsparken
additional: Relay teams consist of 2–4 people and can be women’s, men’s or mixed teams. Teams with fewer than 4 members must have runners complete more than one leg. The relay starts 15 minutes before the individual race. After finishing, participants can choose between a medal and a sausage. The entry fee includes a place in the event, a bib with timing, and a medal or sausage after the finish. Participants choose a medal or sausage when registering.

name: Kongskleiva Opp
description: Kongskleiva is Bekkjarvik’s most popular hike, a refreshing and scenic walk that rewards you with 360-degree views from the top of Kongsfjellet. The route passes through beautiful scenery via a fine Sherpa trail and includes a stop at Taushaugen, with views over Bekkjarvik. It is ideal for both exercise and enjoying nature, and offers the chance to spot wildlife from western Norway, such as white-tailed eagles and feral sheep. The official record time is an impressive 05:31.
course_highlights: A fine Sherpa trail through beautiful scenery
360-degree views from the top of Kongsfjellet
A chance to spot white-tailed eagles and feral sheep
additional: Parking is limited at the start of Kongskleivo; parking at Selbjørn Primary School, Bekkjarvik Torg or Leirvikjo is recommended. The hike can start from Bekkjarvik Torg or Leirvikjo and includes steps up to the summit. It suits all levels if you adjust your pace. Kongskleiva Opp is listed as 5 km. A results overview for 2026 lists the race as cancelled; information about the 2027 edition is not available in the sources.

name: Grimstad Maraton
price_range: Gratis barneløp; 250–600 kr for individuelle distanser; maratontrippel 950 kr; stafett 300 kr per deltaker

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Avgift: 250,- Passer for deg som vil løpe eller gå uten tidtaking.

description: Grimstad Marathon is an inclusive running festival taking place on 11 September 2027 in beautiful Grimstad. The event is suitable for all levels, from beginners to experienced runners, and offers distances from a 3 km fun run to a full half marathon, including a relay and a triple challenge. The start and finish are at Grimstad Library in Byhaven, and the course offers scenic surroundings, with sections through the town centre and cheering spectators. All participants receive medals, and there is also a free children’s race, Sparrisløpet.
course_highlights: Start and finish at Grimstad Library – Byhaven
The course passes through beautiful Groos and charming town-centre streets
Pacers are available for the 10 km and half marathon at various finish times
additional: Race numbers can be collected at the Library in Byhaven on Friday from 16:00 to 18:00 and on Saturday from 08:00. Changing facilities and lockers are available; bring your own padlock. EQ Timing handles registration, payment, timing and results. Pacers are available for the 10 km and half marathon at various finish times. The 3 km fun run is suitable for running or walking and is untimed. The 3 km distance is untimed and can be run or walked. All participants receive medals.

name: Nærsnes Backyard
description: Nærsnes Backyard is a social, accessible race held in Nærsnes, Asker. It is suitable for all levels, from beginners to experienced runners, and has both a children’s course and a longer adults’ course. The event focuses on participation and inclusion, and aims to be climate-neutral. It is a pleasant day with activities for the whole family, including a market, bouncy castle and face painting.
course_highlights: The course starts at the sports field and follows footpaths, trails and gravel roads in the area around Nærsnes.
Includes a steep hill of approximately 500 metres leading up to a farm.
Finishes with a lap of the football field and a finish beneath the finish arch.
additional: Race numbers can be collected at Sport1 (Rortunet) in the days before the race. The children’s race starts at 12:15, with a medal and ice cream from Joker Nærsnes. Activities include a market, bouncy castle, face painting and Wipe out for children and adults. The evening ends with lit fire pans from 19:00 to 23:00. Registration for 2027 is mentioned on the organiser’s website.

name: Valdresløpet
description: Valdresløpet is a challenging trail race that truly puts your running fitness and trail skills to the test. The half-marathon course offers varied terrain and a wonderful experience in the traditional mountain-farm region. There are also shorter distances, including a quarter marathon, and several mini-races for children in different age groups, so the whole family can take part and enjoy a sense of achievement.
course_highlights: Half marathon of 21.1 km with 570 m of elevation gain on varied terrain
Quarter marathon of 10.3 km, starting at the same place as the half marathon, but following its own route up Knippesetvegen
Several mini-races for children from 450 m to 3.9 km, adapted to different age groups
additional: The race bib must be attached visibly to the front of the chest, with two timing chips on the back. Race headquarters opens at 10:00 on race day. The Red Cross will be on standby with an ATV patrol and a treatment tent. Awards are given in 10-year age groups, with medals and Valdres Ost for the top three in each group. Refreshment and food stations on the half-marathon course are at 7.3 km, 12.9 km and 17.7 km. The quarter marathon has a refreshment station after 6.7 km. Start location: Vasetgrende 1, 2960 Røn. The event also includes three distances for children.

name: Volvo Tierparklauf
description: The Volvo Tierparklauf takes place on September 12 and 13, 2026, at Tierpark Berlin. It is especially family-friendly and suitable for beginner runners. The route leads through the zoo, past various animals such as monkeys and flamingos, creating a unique atmosphere. Participants and accompanying persons receive free admission. The event is part of the popular Berlin läuft! series and is known for its animal-themed atmosphere and comprehensive race pack.
course_highlights: Route through Tierpark Berlin with views of monkeys, flamingos and other animals
Free admission to Tierpark Berlin for participants and accompanying persons
Running festival for the whole family at the event venue
additional: Timing is recorded using a transponder attached to the shoe. Participants receive a comprehensive starter pack, with refreshment stations, toilets, an online certificate and free admission to the zoo. Groups of 15 or more receive a 10% discount and can collect their race materials together. Late registration is possible up to one hour before the start. Optional extras such as event shirts, medal engraving and HD finish-line videos can be booked. Free admission, run through Tierpark Berlin, family-friendly, route past animals

name: Freiberger Herbstlauf
location: Platz der Einheit, Freiberg, Saxony, Germany
description: The Freiberg Autumn Run is a traditional race through Freiberg’s municipal forest, starting at Platz der Einheit on September 12, 2026, from 10:00 a.m. The varied program offers races for the whole family, including Bambini and children’s races, Nordic walking, several running distances from 2 km to the half marathon, as well as a corporate relay and the Einfach?Mensch!Lauf. The varied routes pass through the surrounding forests and include some climbs, making the race especially appealing.
course_highlights: Route through Freiberg’s municipal forest
Start and finish at the Platz der Einheit sports facility
Varied routes with some climbs
additional: Events for the whole family, including Bambini and children’s races, Nordic walking, a corporate relay and a unicycle race. Various distances from 400 m to the half marathon. Start and finish at the Platz der Einheit sports facility. Multiple events, including the half marathon, 10 km, 5 km, children’s races, Nordic walking, a unicycle race and team competitions; the venue is the municipal forest and Platz der Einheit.

name: Nordhorner Meile
location: Nordhorn, Grafschaft Bentheim, Lower Saxony, Germany
description: The Nordhorner Meile is the largest running event in the County of Bentheim, with over 2,000 participants. The varied 5 km and 10 km courses run along the Verbindungskanal and through Nordhorn city centre, finishing at the Alte Kirche am Markt. Alongside competitive elite runners and recreational athletes, over 1,500 schoolchildren from the region also take part. The event is known for its lively atmosphere, with more than 3,000 spectators cheering on runners along the course.
course_highlights: Varied 5 km and 10 km courses
Route along the Verbindungskanal and through Nordhorn city centre
Finish at the Alte Kirche am Markt
additional: Online registration is available exclusively via the website. The event also includes school races and is part of the new Grafschafter running series. Over 3,000 spectators create a special atmosphere along the course. The event takes place on 12 September 2026 and offers a lively atmosphere in Nordhorn city centre. It is open to runners of all abilities, from recreational runners to competitive athletes.

name: 10-Teiche-Marathon
description: The 10 Ponds Marathon in Hahnenklee is a scenic marathon held in September as part of the HarzerWanderWochen. The course takes runners through the Upper Harz, offering the chance to experience the region’s natural beauty and numerous ponds. The event is part of a ten-day hiking program featuring a variety of activities and live music. The marathon is a special challenge for runners who appreciate combining athletic achievement with enjoying nature.

name: 3. Wunstorfer Citylauf
description: The Wunstorf City Run is a running event in the city center of Wunstorf, organized by TuS Wunstorf. The race starts and finishes in front of the town church, which serves as the event hub. There are various distances, from a 400-meter Bambini run and several children’s and youth races to the 10-kilometer main race. The course is a 1,400-meter loop through the city center, run a different number of times or in a modified format depending on age group and distance. The City Run thus offers suitable races for runners of all ages and ability levels.

name: KlosterLauf Wiedenbrück
description: The KlosterLauf in Rheda-Wiedenbrück is a special running event taking place for the fourth time on September 12, 2026. The start and finish are at Wiedenbrück Monastery, and the races follow two scenic circuits through the city. The event is aimed both at ambitious runners and at everyone who enjoys the camaraderie and fun of running. Community and the joy of running are at the heart of this sporting highlight.

name: Neubrandenburger Staffelmarathon (LC/NLC)
description: The Neubrandenburg Relay Marathon is a long-standing relay event taking place on September 12, 2026, in Neubrandenburg. The event is hosted by SV Turbine Neubrandenburg e.V. and gives runners the opportunity to cover the marathon distance together as teams. The start is at 9:30 a.m., and the event runs until approximately 2:30 p.m. The club’s running group organizes the event and looks forward to welcoming many participants.

name: Rudelsburglauf
description: The Rudelsburglauf is a long-standing running event along the Rudelsburg near Bad Kösen, organized by LG Rudelsburg 1995 Bad Kösen e.V. The race takes place annually and gives runners of all ability levels the opportunity to experience the beautiful local region together. The event is a highlight in the club’s calendar and combines a sporting challenge with an experience of nature. Information about the race details and registration is published in good time before the event.

name: Schledehausener Berglauf
description: The Schledehausener Berglauf is a 10-hour hill-running event in Schledehausen, part of Bissendorf, Germany. The race starts and finishes at the Schledehausen sports hall. The goal is to climb and descend a short hill as many times as possible, accumulating the most elevation gain within the time limit. The course is 700 metres long and has an elevation gain of 32 metres, with an average gradient of 10%. There are individual, relay and team categories. Omas on Tour organises the race as a charity event in support of HelpAge Deutschland e. V.

name: Spiegelsbergelauf
description: The Spiegelsbergelauf on September 12, 2026, in Halberstadt offers varied race distances for all ability levels. The 14 km course leads over the Gläserner Mönch and is a real challenge with its elevation gain and terrain. The 8 km loop around the Jagdschlösschen combines speed and nature, while the 4 km course through the Spiegelsberge is an inviting introduction to competitive running. The youngest participants can take part in a 400 m fun run. The event is organized by SwimBikeRun Halberstadt e.V. and takes place at the Sportanlage Friedensstadion.

name: SÜDTHÜRINGENTRAIL
description: The SÜDTHÜRINGENTRAIL is a welcoming trail race in the beautiful surroundings of Suhl, celebrating its anniversary edition on September 12, 2026. The route follows some winding paths away from the main artery of the Thuringian Forest, passing clear streams, dark valleys and glistening mountain ridges. The event offers an unforgettable experience in nature with spectacular views and is part of the SüHLER BÜCHSEN CUP. Finishers of the longer distances receive ITRA/UTMB® qualifying points.

name: ULTRAMARATHON DM im 100km-Straßenlauf
description: The 38th German 100 km Ultramarathon Championship takes place on September 12, 2026, at Wartenberg Stadium in Berlin-Wartenberg. This road race is a demanding long-distance event that requires endurance and mental strength. The event is aimed at experienced ultrarunners and offers an official championship atmosphere under the auspices of the German Athletics Association. Participants can look forward to professional organization and an athletic challenge.

name: Unstrutlauf
description: The Unstrut Run is a versatile running event in Dingelstädt, offering suitable distances for all ability levels, from 2 km to the half marathon (21.1 km). The varied routes follow the Unstrut and feature scenic highlights, paved cycle paths and short climbs. Drinks, fruit and bratwurst are provided. All proceeds are donated to charitable projects in the region, giving the event a special social character.

name: Niedermeiserer Dorflauf
description: The Niedermeiser Village Run is a running event organized by TSV 1864 Niedermeiser e.V. and takes place on September 12, 2026, in Liebenau/Niedermeiser. The races run around Bodenberg, with distances ranging from 400 meters to 18.5 kilometers. There are also walking and Nordic walking events over various distances. The start and finish are at the sports field in Niedermeiser, where race materials are also distributed. The event is approved by the Hessian Athletics Association and is held in accordance with the applicable regulations.

name: REHAmed Herkules-Berglauf
description: The REHAmed Herkules Mountain Run is a challenging mountain race through Wilhelmshöhe Mountain Park in Kassel, running almost entirely on paved natural trails. The course passes numerous landmarks, including Löwenburg and Steinhöfer Waterfall, and finishes at the Hercules Monument. The race is open to runners and walkers and offers both individual and three-person team relay categories, ideal for families, clubs and companies. Changing rooms and showers are available at the nearby Reform School gym, and transport for clothing to the finish is arranged.

name: II Ćwiartka Drzymały
location: Miasteczko Krajeńskie, Greater Poland Voivodeship, Poland

name: Leszczyński Festiwal Sportu – Półmaraton Leszczyński C&C Partners
Mälarömilen
description: Mälarömilen is a recurring running race on Ekerö that welcomes runners of all levels and the whole family. The event offers four different distances, from a children’s race for the youngest runners to the classic 10-kilometre main race. The courses pass through scenic surroundings on paved footpaths and park trails, with the start and finish at Träkvista sports ground. Mälarömilen is organised by Mälarö SOK, and all proceeds go back to the club’s sporting activities.
course_highlights: Pleasant, runner-friendly courses on paved footpaths and park trails
Signs at every kilometre marker
Start and finish at Träkvista sports ground, in scenic surroundings
additional: Late registration is available on race day, subject to availability. There is a drinks station shortly after the start/lap point. Toilets, showers and changing rooms are available in the KOM building at Träkvista sports ground. A first-aid tent is staffed throughout the event. All races start and finish at Träkvista sports ground. Group registration is available for teams and companies.

name: Rådalunken
description: Rådalunken is an annual running and recreational race organized by Lidköpings VSK since the late 1960s. The race takes place in Råda and offers classes and distances of up to 18 km. It is usually held on the second Saturday in September and is a welcome event for runners of all ages. The Paprikaloppet for children is often held on the same day in partnership with Ica Hjertbergs.
course_highlights: Run in scenic Råda
Classes and distances of up to 18 km
Traditionally held on the second Saturday in September
additional: Rådalunken is held together with the Paprikaloppet for children on the same day. The race offers classes and distances of up to 18 km. The event is part of Lidköpings VSK’s annual competition program. Previous editions have offered the Papricaloppet for younger children. Timing has been handled by C-time, and Umara sports drink has been served.

name: Neskollen løpsfestival 2027
description: Neskollen Running Festival 2027 is Hvam Runners’ signature race, offering a trail run with fantastic views of Romerike. The race is suitable for all levels and includes distances of 4.5 km, 0.5 km, and 1 km for children. The event takes place on September 12, 2027, and offers a great opportunity to enjoy running in scenic surroundings.
course_highlights: Trail run on varied terrain
Fantastic views of Romerike
Races for all levels, including children’s races
additional: The race includes distances of 4.5 km, 0.5 km, and 1 km children’s races. The organizer is Hvam IL Friidrett. The starting point is Neskollen. The race is Hvam Runners’ signature event, with a focus on community and the joy of running. Registration is stated to open on June 1, 2027.

name: Internationaler Altenaulauf
description: The International Altenau Run in Borchen is a traditional running event organised by SC Borchen 1926/32, Athletics Department. The race takes place annually and is part of the Hochstift Cup. Alongside the sporting competition, the event also demonstrates social commitment: coffee and cake are offered free of charge, and donations are collected for Aktion Lichtblicke e.V. The event offers runners of different age groups and ability levels an attractive platform.
course_highlights: Part of the Hochstift Cup
A variety of distances for different age groups
Traditional race with a social commitment
additional: Coffee and cake are offered free of charge at the cake stall. Donations are collected for Aktion Lichtblicke e.V. Runners can register for distances online; the event also includes social activities such as coffee and cake and fundraising for Aktion Lichtblicke e.V.

name: 6. DeisterCrossing Springe
description: DeisterCrossing is a nature-focused extreme experience in the wooded Deister hills near Springe. The event offers running and walking routes of 10 km, 21.1 km (half marathon) and 42.2 km (marathon), with challenging climbs, including the Deisterhölle, with 200 metres of elevation gain in one stretch. Participants enjoy a well-marked course with aid stations, places to sit and filled rolls for walkers. The event is all about consideration for others and enjoying nature, with awards for the fastest runners and a finisher’s gift as a souvenir.
course_highlights: Deisterhölle with 200 metres of elevation gain in one stretch
Marathon walk with an additional climb to Bielstein and the Deister ridge
Aid stations with places to sit and filled rolls
additional: Race bib collection from 7:15 a.m. at IGS Springe. Chip timing with a rental chip; return the chip to receive a wheat beer glass as a finisher’s gift. Showers and changing rooms in the IGS Springe sports hall. Parking at IGS, netto and BZE. Travel by S5 to Springe station, then a 10-minute walk to the Nord school centre. Awards ceremonies: 10 km and half marathon at 12:00, marathon at 14:30. Sew-on patches for walkers. Trail event with challenging terrain, refreshments at aid stations, and options for runners and walkers.

name: Braker hkk Lauf
description: The 19th Braker hkk Run takes place on September 13, 2026, in Brake (Unterweser). It is a short running race with distances of 850 meters and 10 kilometers. The race offers a pleasant opportunity to run in typical September weather, with mild temperatures and mostly cloudy skies. Please check the exact event details directly with the organizer.
course_highlights: Distances: 850 m and 10 km
Typical September weather with approx. 19°C and 45 mm of precipitation
Start location in Brake (Unterweser)
additional: The race offers two distances: 850 meters and 10 kilometers. September weather is typically mild and cloudy, with an average of 45 mm of precipitation. The event usually takes place in pleasant temperatures of around 19°C. Participants should check the latest details with the organizer before registering.

name: Brückenlauf Halbmarathon Köln des ASV Köln
description: The ASV Köln Bridge Run Half Marathon is a long-standing 21.1-kilometre race that takes runners through the heart of Cologne, along the Rhine and across six of the city’s most beautiful bridges. The course offers spectacular views of the cathedral and the city, with an uplifting atmosphere and music along the route. Alongside the half marathon, shorter distances are available: the Kölsche Runde (11.11 km) and the Bambini Run (500 m), for beginners and children. The race combines a sporting challenge with Rhineland joie de vivre and is ideal for both ambitious and recreational runners.
course_highlights: 21.1 km along the Rhine with views of Cologne Cathedral
Cross six Cologne bridges, including the Hohenzollern Bridge and Rodenkirchen Bridge
Start and finish at the Chocolate Museum forecourt, with a lively atmosphere
additional: The Bridge Run is measured by the German Athletics Association (DLV) and is eligible for record lists. The LVN South-East regional championships take place as part of the half marathon. Registration is online, with on-site late registration available on the day of the event. The Kölsche Runde is ideal for beginners and recreational runners; the Bambini Run is for children aged 3–6. The start and finish are both at the Chocolate Museum forecourt. The event features music, commentary and a lively atmosphere along the route. The race starts in the Rheinauhafen and is part of the LVN South-East regional championships. Online registration is available, including a T-shirt for members. Entry fees vary by category.

name: Hattinger Hüttenlauf
description: The Hattinger Hüttenlauf is a traditional race in HenrichsPark in Hattingen, offering a range of running and walking distances for all age groups. The course follows paths surfaced with paving stones, water-bound gravel and asphalt, passing the park’s ponds. The start and finish are beneath Blast Furnace 3 at the LWL Industrial Museum Henrichshütte. Alongside the sporting competition, there are categories for Bambini, youth, the fun run and the 10 km Sparkasse Run, as well as awards for the largest groups and the fastest Hattingen runners. The event is family-friendly, and all participants can print their certificates online.
course_highlights: Course in HenrichsPark on paths surfaced with paving stones, water-bound gravel and asphalt
Start and finish beneath Blast Furnace 3 at the LWL Industrial Museum Henrichshütte
Course runs alongside the park’s ponds
additional: Late entries are possible up to one hour before the respective start. All Bambini race participants receive a medal. All participants can print their certificates online. Age-group categories are offered, with awards for the largest groups (schools and clubs) and the fastest Hattingen runners. Various running distances, online registration, supporters from the sports and business sectors.

name: Kiel Lauf
description: The Kiel.Lauf is a long-established running event in Kiel, with various competitions for all age groups. The main event is the half marathon, covering 21.1 kilometers through western Kiel and attracting both recreational runners and elite athletes. The 10.2-kilometer fun run is the event’s largest race by participation and offers a lap through Kiel city center with a great atmosphere. There are also shorter races for schoolchildren and Bambinis, making the event family-friendly.
course_highlights: The half marathon runs across western Kiel
The fun run goes through Kiel city center
A range of distances from approx. 0.7 km to 21.1 km
additional: The half marathon starts at 10:50 a.m. and the fun run at 09:45 a.m. Due to construction work, short-notice course changes may occur and will be announced in good time. The event is very popular, with more than 10,000 runners. There are various races for schoolchildren and Bambinis, making the event family-friendly. The event includes street closures and participant information, and offers technical running shirts for most categories.

name: Othaler Gutshof Lauf
distance_verbose: Halbmarathon, 10 km, 5 km, 2 km, 1 km, 0.5 km
description: The Othaler Gutshoflauf is a young but popular running event starting and finishing at the Youth and School Farm at Gutshof Othal. The event offers distances ranging from 0.5 km to the 21.1 km half marathon, which is known as the Intersport Liebig Half Marathon and passes through several villages. The race gives participants the chance to explore the eastern foothills of the Harz on varied routes. Around 350 runners take part each year, highlighting the event’s growing popularity.
course_highlights: Half marathon route through Sotterhausen, Holdenstedt, Klosterrode and Beyernaumburg
Start and finish area at the Youth and School Farm at Gutshof Othal
Distances ranging from 0.5 km to 21.1 km
additional: Start times: 09:00 half marathon, 09:45 10 km run/walk, 10:00 5 km run/walk, 10:05 0.5 km run, 10:15 1 km run, 10:30 2 km children’s race. Routes for children, recreational runners and competitive runners; start and finish area at the Youth and School Farm in Othal; supported by sponsors such as Intersport Liebig and Autohaus Liebe.

name: Rathaus Center Dessauer CityRUN
description: The 26th Dessauer Rathaus-Center CityRUN is a long-standing race in downtown Dessau that has attracted runners from the region and beyond for many years. The route follows a circuit through the city’s central streets, with the start and finish on Zerbster Straße near the Rathaus-Center. The race offers a sporting challenge in an urban setting and is part of a varied sports programme organised by Anhalt Sport e.V., which has been organising major sporting events in the region for decades.
course_highlights: Circuit through downtown Dessau
Start and finish on Zerbster Straße at the Rathaus-Center
Route along Steinstraße, Askanische Straße and Kavalierstraße
additional: Volksbank children’s race for children up to 9 years old over 1,000 metres, free for all children and schoolchildren from Dessau. The organiser is Anhalt Sport e.V., which has been organising numerous major sporting events in the region for over 20 years. Various distances, including children’s races; company race; on-site registration available; finisher medals

name: Volksbank-Münster-Marathon
description: The Volksbank-Münster-Marathon is a major running event organized by runners for runners, largely by volunteers and with great dedication. With around 12,000 participants, more than 300 artists and bands, and over 100,000 spectators along the course, this autumn marathon offers a unique atmosphere. The course is almost entirely flat and runs through the running- and cycling-friendly city of Münster. A red carpet is rolled out in the finish area on Prinzipalmarkt, making the finish a special experience.
course_highlights: Almost entirely flat course
More than 300 artists and bands along the course
Finish on a red carpet at Prinzipalmarkt
additional: The marathon is part of a major event featuring several races, including the Atruvia Staffelmarathon, Wecker-28 (28 km), Stadtwerke-Kids Marathon, Westfalen AG Charity-Lauf (10 km), and H+B technics-Gesundheitslauf (6 km). There is a combined ranking with the Enschede Marathon. The marathon office is open on Mondays, Wednesdays, and Fridays from 9:00 to 15:00. A marathon guide with general information and FAQs is available. The marathon attracts around 12,000 runners, offers qualification opportunities for other races, and is supported by numerous sponsors. There are also accompanying events such as talks and health seminars.

name: Waldlauf des TuS Calle-Wallen - Volksbank Sauerland Laufcup
description: The 46th TuS Calle-Wallen Forest Run is part of the Volksbank Sauerland Running Cup and takes place on September 13, 2026, in Meschede. The event offers 1 km and 10 km races and is open to runners of all age groups. The race runs through the wooded areas around Meschede and promises a varied course in a natural setting. September weather is typically mild and mostly cloudy, ideal for running events.
course_highlights: Run through the wooded areas around Meschede
1 km and 10 km distances
Natural setting and varied course
additional: Typical September weather is around 19 °C, with lows of about 10 °C and an average of 45 mm of precipitation; skies are mostly cloudy. The event takes place in Meschede, where typical weather is around 19 °C with cloudy skies. It is a great opportunity for the whole family to take part in a traditional race.

name: wep-Lauf
organizer: WEP Intersport Engels / Ralf Sester / TuS Jahn Hilfarth
description: The wepLAUF in Hückelhoven is a varied sporting event with a family-festival atmosphere, taking place on September 13, 2026. Distances range from a marathon to short races for children, including a Flexi Marathon where participants can decide after each lap whether to continue. The start and finish area is on Breteuilplatz, and alongside the race programme the event features a lively supporting programme with a bouncy castle, stage entertainment and stalls. The event particularly encourages children and young people to take part through a school competition. Surrounding streets are closed during the races, and free parking is available at Hückelhoven Center.
course_highlights: The marathon course is completed four times, and the half-marathon course twice
Flexi Marathon with an individually chosen distance and a certificate for the distance completed
Start and finish area on Breteuilplatz; streets are closed during the races
additional: The marathon traditionally starts as the first event of the day. Free parking is available at Hückelhoven Center. Registration is open until September 10, 2026, at 11:59 p.m. The varied supporting programme includes a bouncy castle, stage entertainment and sponsor stalls. The schools with the most participants receive awards. Registration is open until September 10. The start and finish area is on Breteuilplatz; free parking, changing rooms and showers are available. Support is provided for young runners and company relay teams.

name: 17. Parklauf Tangerhütte
description: The 17th Park Run Tangerhütte takes place in the idyllic Tangerhütte City Park and is part of the ELBE-OHRE-CUP race series in the north of Saxony-Anhalt. The event offers various distances for all age groups, including 1.1 km for young runners, 2.9 km for youth, and 5.4 km and 10.3 km for adults. The routes pass around Spiegelsee and by sights such as the New Palace and the Mausoleum. In the finish area, SV Germania Tangerhütte provides refreshments for participants, including grilled food, drinks, fruit, coffee, and cake.

name: 21. swb-Marathon Bremen
description: The 21st swb-Marathon Bremen takes place on September 13, 2026, and offers runners a varied running experience through Bremen. The start and finish are on Bremen’s Market Square. The course passes well-known sights such as Werdersee, Weserwehr, Rhododendron-Park, the University, Bürgerpark, Überseestadt and Schlachte, and ends with a run through Weserstadion. In addition to the marathon, there is also an AOK Half Marathon, a HIRSCH 10 km race and an AOK children’s race. The event is aimed at beginners and experienced runners alike and promises an unforgettable day of sport, with a great atmosphere and support from spectators.

name: 43. Internationalen Airport Race
description: The 43rd International Airport Race in Hamburg takes place on September 13, 2026, and offers a varied running experience around Hamburg Airport. The 10-mile race traditionally starts at 11:00 a.m. at the LSV sports facility on Borsteler Chaussee. In addition to the main 10-mile race, there are also 5 km races and the Mini Airport Race. The unique airport setting provides ever-changing views and a special atmosphere.

name: Brachter Depotlauf
description: The Brachter Depot Run is a guided cross-country run through the beautiful Brachter Depot, with different pace groups from 5:00 to 7:00 min/km. Various distances are offered, including a half marathon, 14 km, a 5 km beginner run, a children’s run (max. 2 km), and walking. The event emphasizes experiencing nature and social commitment: participation in the children’s run is free, and a starting donation will be collected on the day of the event. The runs are organized by TSF Bracht and Depotrunners Bracht and offer a varied route in a natural setting.

name: DeisterCrossing Springe
description: DeisterCrossing is a nature-focused endurance event that combines running and walking in the outstanding natural surroundings of the forested Deister mountain range. The event offers 10 km, 21.1 km, and 42.2 km courses for runners and walkers. The challenging routes pass through the Deisterhölle, including a continuous 200-meter elevation gain, and offer a unique nature and mountain experience near Hanover. The event has a relaxed atmosphere, with participants looking out for one another, and offers aid stations, finisher gifts, and an awards ceremony in addition to the sporting challenge.

name: Dübener Heidelauf
description: The Dübener Heide Run is a traditional forest race held at the scenic Obermühle in Bad Düben, a spa town in northern Saxony. The event is organized by SV Bad Düben and offers courses for children, teenagers, and adults. With distances ranging from 500 m to the half marathon (21.1 km), the race appeals to both young runners and experienced long-distance athletes. It is part of the regional athletics structure for northern Saxony and Leipzig and is known for its family-friendly, club-oriented character.

name: Eicklinger Volks- und Familielauf
description: The 1st Eicklingen Community and Family Run is aimed at active families who want to spend an enjoyable day running together. The focus is on fun and the joy of running, without the pressure of competition. The event offers a welcoming atmosphere for all age groups and encourages people to get active together.

name: Garbenteicher Volkslauf
description: The Garbenteich Volkslauf, organized by Sportverein 1928 Garbenteich e.V., is a traditional race in Pohlheim, known as a good training run for the Frankfurt Marathon. The course has been optimized for safety, so it no longer crosses any federal highways or railway lines. There are seven refreshment stations offering water, cola and tea, and excellent refreshments await participants after the race. Race bibs can be collected on the day of the event from 08:00 or the day before at the Sport- und Kulturhalle Garbenteich.

name: Kristall Lauf Weißwasser
description: The Kristall-Lauf Weißwasser is a versatile popular race that welcomes runners and walkers of all ages. The course crosses mixed terrain, including asphalt, concrete, sand paths and forest trails with roots. The race is part of several regional competitions, including the Bezirksrangliste Dresden, the Sachsenenergie Läufer-Cup and the Niederlausitz-Cup. It also offers an official walking competition recognized by the German Athletics Association. A special feature is the traditional team race, which encourages community and team spirit.

name: runroll City
description: The runroll City event takes place on September 13, 2026, in Bielefeld and offers a fast-paced sporting experience on a flat 7.2-kilometer course through the heart of the city. The course is ideal for fast times and is suitable for both intensive running training and a fast race. Participants can enjoy moving through the urban landscape and become part of a dynamic event.

name: Volkslauf TSV Adendorf
distance_verbose: Halbmarathon, 10 km, 5 km, 1.2 km, 0.8 km, 0.4 km

name: Zeuthener Jedermannslauf
description: The Zeuthen Jedermannslauf is a popular community run held every September in Zeuthen. It offers various races for all age groups, from Bambini to adults, with distances ranging from 400 m to 10 km. The event is family-friendly and promotes recreational sport in the region. The races start at Zeuthen S-Bahn station and follow a varied route along the forest promenade.

name: HochRhön-BergTrail
description: The HochRhön Mountain Trail is a challenging trail-running event in the picturesque uplands of the Hochrhön around Hilders. The event offers four trail distances from 7 km to 42 km, with varied routes through forests, along singletrack trails and forest roads, and across meadows. The races feature some steep climbs and wonderful views, particularly from Auerbergsee and Buchschirm. The event also supports a good cause, with part of the entry fees donated to the Malteser Children’s Hospice and Family Support Service in Fulda. The event is part of the regional Trailrunning Cup Rhön and also offers children’s races.

name: II Złotowska Dziesiątka
description: The 2nd Złotów Ten is a road race taking place on September 13, 2026, in Złotów. Participants complete two 5 km laps, for a total distance of 10 km. The event is organized by the Złotów Center for Social Activity and aims to promote an active lifestyle and bring the local running community together. All running enthusiasts are invited to take part.

name: Poznań Track Day 2026
description: Tor Poznań Track Day is a series of exciting automotive events held at the race track in Poznań. Participants can take part in competitive racing, training sessions, and qualifying rounds held throughout the 2026 season. The event is aimed at automotive enthusiasts and also offers car rentals and one-on-one training with instructors. It’s a great opportunity to experience the excitement of motorsport and improve your skills on a professional track.

name: XI Bieg Nadziei oraz VII Mistrzostwa Wielkopolski Prawników
description: The 11th Run of Hope and the 7th Greater Poland Lawyers’ Championships are charity races organized in Środa Wielkopolska, supporting the work of the Piotr Hospice. The event combines sporting competition with an important social cause, engaging the local community and the legal profession. It is an established tradition that promotes physical activity and solidarity.

name: Chyża 10
description: The 12th Chyża Ten is a fast and popular 10 km race organized by the Nowotomyski Chyży Running Club. The event takes place in Nowy Tomyśl and is part of the Nowy Tomyśl County Grand Prix series of running events. The race starts at 9:00, and the race office is open from 7:00 to 8:30. The race attracts both recreational and more experienced runners, offering a friendly atmosphere and a well-prepared course.

name: Festiwal Biegowy Północy XI Maraton Bieg Czterech Latarni
organizer: Ośrodek Sportu i Rekreacji we Władysławowie
description: The Northern Running Festival is a unique running event taking place on September 13, 2026, on the Hel Peninsula, bringing together the Northern Marathon and Marathon Relays under one banner. The course passes through the scenic locations of Hel, Jastarnia, and Rozewie, along Puck Bay, with sea views and four lighthouses that give the race its distinctive character. The event offers a range of distances for runners of all abilities, from the marathon and relays to the half marathon, 10 km, and 5 km, as well as a children’s race—the Little Lighthouse Keeper Run. It is not only a sporting event, but also a journey through the beautiful corners of the coast and an opportunity to connect with nature.

name: Airborne Freedom Run
distance_verbose: 60 km, Marathon, 28 km, Halve marathon, 10 km, 5 km

name: Stratenloop Sevenum
location: Sevenum, Horst aan de Maas, Limburg, Netherlands

name: Crow Mountain Survival
description: The Crow Mountain Survival obstacle race in Bremen is an exciting adventure returning for its ninth edition on September 6, 2026. Distances range from 1.2 km for children to 15 km for experienced runners, featuring challenging obstacles and spectacular water sections, including a swim across Lake Werdersee. The event offers challenges for beginners and experienced OCR veterans, as well as inclusive races for people with disabilities. The varied course runs through forests, meadows and over different terrain, testing endurance, strength and agility. Special untimed races for children and newcomers make it easier to get started.
course_highlights: Spectacular water crossing through Lake Werdersee
Varied course through forests, meadows and over different terrain
Challenging obstacles involving climbing, balancing, crawling and traversing
additional: Wave starts of 10 people every 60 seconds for the 5 km, 10 km and 15 km races; runners are assigned to waves based on their pace at registration; untimed youth and inclusive races; medals and certificates for all participants; start times vary by distance, e.g. the youth race at 09:30 and the introductory race at 12:00; children under 12 require prior approval to participate in certain distances. Distances range from 5 km to 15 km, with water sections, natural trails through forests and meadows, challenging obstacles, and inclusive youth, introductory and inclusive races.

name: B2Run Berlin
description: The B2Run Berlin on September 16, 2026, is a corporate run with a course of around 5.7 km around Berlin’s Olympic Stadium. The race finishes with an emotional finish-line experience inside the historic Olympic Stadium and offers a unique team event for companies and individual participants from Berlin and the surrounding area. The focus is on team spirit, motivation, and fun rather than personal bests, making it ideal for beginners, walkers, and experienced runners. The event combines physical activity with workplace health promotion and a professional supporting program featuring an emcee and music.

name: LöpRallarn
description: LöpRallarn is a running race organized by Bottnaryds IF at Bottnaryds IP. The race offers distances of 7.5 km and 15 km, on a course that includes loops through varied terrain. The event attracts both young people and adult runners and has a wonderful late-summer atmosphere, with energetic participants. The race has a tradition of bringing together a strong field and offers an enjoyable challenge for both competitive and recreational runners.
course_highlights: 7.5 km and 15 km course options with two loops
Varied terrain and surfaces
Start and finish at Bottnaryds IP
additional: The race has two distances: 7.5 km and 15 km. In previous years, the race has had start groups and attracted over 100 participants. Results and contact details are available via christian.wigren@rallarloppet.se. Shorter distances of 1 and 2 km are also available. Bottnaryds IF’s pages list different dates for the 2027 race.
