name: Stadtfestlauf Lüdinghausen
description: The Stadtfestlauf Lüdinghausen is a long-standing running event organized by SC Union 08 Lüdinghausen e.V. It gives runners of different ages and ability levels the opportunity to compete on varied routes through the town and surrounding area. The race is part of the Westmünsterlandlaufserie and attracts numerous participants each year, who value both the sporting competition and the sense of community. The event is open to everyone who enjoys running and is organized by a dedicated club with many years of experience.
course_highlights: Varied routes through Lüdinghausen and the surrounding area
Part of the Westmünsterlandlaufserie
A range of running routes for different ages and ability levels
additional: Runners can register online; the event also includes a market, music, and family activities.

name: Wipperfürther Stadtlauf
location: Wipperfürth, Oberbergischer Kreis, North Rhine-Westphalia, Germany
price_range: ab 4 EUR (Bambini- und Schülerläufe), 9 EUR (4,4 km Lauf), 14 EUR (Hauptlauf)
description: The 20th Wipperfürth City Run takes place on September 18, 2026, and runs through Wipperfürth’s historic town center. The event offers races for all age groups, from the kindergarten run to the 10 km main race, which is officially measured by the DLV. The races are electronically timed, and all participants receive commemorative medals. The event is open to everyone; club membership is not required. Attractive awards are presented to the fastest runners and age-category winners.
course_highlights: Wipperfürth’s historic town center
10 km main race with 7 large laps, measured by the DLV
Various distances from 0.5 km to 10 km
additional: Late registration is available on September 18, 2026, from 4:00 p.m. at the KSK branch on Marktplatz (EUR 3 surcharge). Race packets will be available from 4:00 p.m. at Marktplatz. Changing facilities and showers are available at the fire station at Lüdenscheider Straße 14. Relay exchanges take place in the start area on Lüdenscheider Straße, with the sash or baton handed over there. All participants receive commemorative medals; the top finishers in the Bambini and schoolchildren’s races receive trophies, while prizes are awarded in the 4.4 km race and main race. The city champions are determined from the fastest participants from Wipperfürth. Various race events, medals for all finishers, registration until September 11, 2026, start/finish at the Ohler Wiesen large parking lot

name: SportScheck RUN Hannover
organizer: Motor Presse Hamburg GmbH & Co. KG Verlagsgesellschaft
description: The SportScheck Run Hannover is an evening night run that transforms Hanover’s city centre into a spectacular display of lights. Runners can choose between a 1 km children’s race and 5 km and 10 km courses, which pass through the illuminated city centre and landmarks such as Opernplatz, the Lower Saxony State Parliament, Kröpcke and the New Town Hall. The nighttime atmosphere makes the run a particularly memorable experience. The fastest runners can take part in a 10 km SpeedRUN, with a target time of under 50 minutes. The event welcomes runners of all ability levels and also offers training plans to help them prepare.

name: ONW-Lauf Dannenberg 2025
description: The ONW Run 2026 is a major charity run supporting the Onkologisches Netzwerk Wendland. It takes place on September 18, 2026, in Dannenberg’s old town. There are three race distances—2.1 km, 4.2 km and 10.5 km—all starting at the market square. The event welcomes participants of all ages and supports a good cause while fostering a strong sense of community. The entry fee for schoolgirls is covered; adults pay 6 euros. Groups of four or more can compete in the team ranking and win trophies.

name: Løb Mellem Husene i Aalborg SØ 2026
Black River Run, 100 miles
location: Västerås SOK clubhouse Orientalen, Västerås, Sweden
description: Black River Run is an ultramarathon in Västerås with several distances: 100 miles (161 km), 50 miles (80.5 km), Instegsultra (48 km), 20 miles (32.2 km) and 10 miles. The start, lap point and finish are at Västerås SOK’s clubhouse, Orientalen, which has changing rooms, showers and a sauna. The course consists of a 10-mile loop with varied surfaces, including technical trails, exercise trails, gravel roads, hiking trails and asphalt. Runners who complete 100 miles within 24 hours receive a belt buckle; other finishers receive a medal.
course_highlights: Varied surfaces: technical trails, exercise trails, gravel roads, hiking trails and asphalt
One loop is 10 miles (16.1 km)
The start, lap point and finish are at Västerås SOK’s clubhouse, Orientalen, which has showers and a sauna
additional: Changing rooms, showers and a sauna are available at the clubhouse. Runners can choose to forgo their medal in favour of Médecins Sans Frontières, with 20 kr donated for each medal declined. The race is organised by Västerås Löparklubb. The easiest way to get in touch is via Black River Run’s Messenger. Orientalen has changing rooms, showers and a sauna. Finishers receive a medal; those who complete 100 miles within 24 hours also receive a belt buckle.

name: Lergöksloppet
description: Lergöksloppet is a running race on trails and forest roads in the beautiful Kronoskogen in Ängelholm, offering a nature-rich and inspiring setting for runners of all ages. After the finish, participants in Class 1 are offered fruit and cordial, while runners in the other classes can enjoy coffee or tea. The race welcomes runners young and old and is marked by a wonderful sense of community in scenic surroundings.
course_highlights: The courses follow trails and forest roads
The race takes place in Kronoskogen in Ängelholm
A nature-rich and inspiring setting
additional: After the finish, participants in Class 1 are offered fruit and cordial. Runners in the other classes can enjoy coffee or tea. After the finish, fruit and cordial are served to participants in Class 1; the other classes are offered coffee or tea.

name: Klarälvsloppet Run 21k
description: Klarälvsloppet Run 21K is a fast and scenic half marathon on a gently descending, paved trail from Forshaga Learning Center to Karlstad. The course is completely traffic-free and has no steep climbs, providing ideal conditions for setting personal records. The race follows Klarälvsbanan through the Värmland countryside and offers a unique running experience on 90 kilometers of paved nature trail. There are three official refreshment stations along the course with water and sports drinks, and fruit and refreshments await at the finish. The race starts on Saturday at 10:30, with a group warm-up in the start area.
course_highlights: Gently descending paved trail from Forshaga to Karlstad
Completely traffic-free course with no steep climbs
Three official refreshment stations with water and sports drinks
additional: The start and race-bib distribution take place at Forshaga Learning Center from 09:00 to 10:00 on race day. Participants must finish within the time limit of 2:45. A minibus follows the field and picks up participants who do not meet the time limit. Buses run from Karlstad City Library to the start for those who have purchased bus transport. Fruit and refreshments are available at the finish. On-site payments are accepted only by card or Swish. Medical assistance is available at the start, finish, and refreshment stations. The organizer describes the race as a possible “Scandinavia’s fastest half marathon?”.

name: BMW Oslo Maraton inkl. NM maraton

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Pris for deltagelse på 10 for Grete er 800 kroner. Administrasjonsgebyr på 6,75% + 3 kr er inkludert i prisen. Engangslisens (50 kr) vil komme i tillegg.

description: DNB Oslo Marathon is one of Norway’s largest road races, with over 29,000 participants, and offers distances for all ages and levels, including the marathon, half marathon, 10 km, and the children’s event Extra Oslo Mini Marathon. The race takes place in central Oslo on a varied course with beautiful city and fjord views. It is an inclusive event with dedicated para categories and a wheelchair race, and places great emphasis on a positive participant experience, with aid stations, pacers, and a wide range of services. The race takes place on September 18, 2027, and has a new registration system for 2027.
course_highlights: The marathon course has approximately 350 metres of elevation gain and consists of two laps of the half-marathon course
The half-marathon course has approximately 175 metres of elevation gain and runs through central Oslo
The 10 km course has approximately 50 metres of elevation gain and is suitable for all levels
additional: There are aid stations approximately every 5 kilometres, with Maxim energy drink and water included in the registration fee. Pacers carrying flags guide runners toward various finish times and provide motivation. Group registration is available, with discounts for groups of at least 10 participants and consolidated invoicing. Cancellation insurance is also available when registering. GPX files for the courses are available to download. Previous editions have also offered the half marathon, 10 km, and Oslotrippelen.

name: BERGAN BYGG Brakvatnet halvmaraton + stafett
description: Bergan Bygg Brakvatnet Half Marathon is a traditional half-marathon organized by Osterøy IL Friidrett. The race takes place around Brakvatnet on Osterøy, on a course of eight laps of 2,595 metres plus 337.5 metres, with the start and finish by the bathing area. The event also includes a relay and a children’s race, and provides changing and toilet facilities as well as food in the finish area. It attracts both recreational runners and competitive athletes, offering beautiful scenery and a challenging course in picturesque surroundings.
course_highlights: The course consists of 8 laps around Brakvatnet plus 337.5 metres to the start/finish
Start and finish by the bathing area at Brakvatnet
Course records: Espen Borge Joensen 1.18,02 (2024) and Hilde Aasheim 1.24,29 (2013)
additional: The children’s race starts at 11:00. Changing tents and toilets for women and men are available in the finish area. Food is served in the finish area, with Vipps as the preferred payment method. Parking is limited; parking at Valestrand school or Valestrandsvatnet is recommended. Cars cannot be driven from the start area. The course is 2,595 metres per lap around Brakvatnet. Previous editions have had the half-marathon and relay start at 12:00. Changing tents, toilets and a dining room are listed in the finish area. Parking is recommended at Valestrand school or the car park at Valestrandsvatnet; it is not possible to drive all the way to Brakvatnet.

name: Bryneløpet
description: Bryneløpet is an annual race organized by Bryne Friidrett for primary school children in grades 1 to 7. It has been held since 2013 and takes place during the Potetfestivalen in Bryne. The race starts between M44 and Brynesenteret and follows a route around the lower part of Fritz Røed Park, covering approximately 400 meters. Participants are divided into groups by age and gender for a safe and enjoyable running experience.
course_highlights: The route starts between M44 and Brynesenteret
Around the lower part of Fritz Røed Park
Approximately 400 meters, with the start and finish in the same place
additional: Participants start in groups by grade and gender: girls and boys in grades 1–2, girls and boys in grades 3–4, and girls and boys in grades 5–7. Race numbers are handed out in the play area at the start/finish. The race is held in connection with the Potetfestivalen. For the 2026 edition, race numbers could be collected outside Jordbærpikene in M44; corresponding practical information for 2027 has not been provided.

name: Sandnes Halvmaraton
description: Sandnes Half Marathon takes place on 18 September 2027, starting and finishing at Bogafjellhallen. The courses are officially measured and offer beautiful scenery around Stokkalandsvatnet, Sandvedparken and Bogafjell, with varied terrain including a steep hill up to Bogafjell Church. The event offers distances for everyone, from a children’s race to a half marathon, with drink stations along the way. It is a great opportunity for both recreational and experienced runners to enjoy the scenic surroundings of Sandnes.
course_highlights: Officially measured 21.1 km course with two laps around Stokkalandsvatnet and Sandvedparken
Steep hill up to Bogafjell Church on the 5 km and children’s race courses
Drink stations after approximately 3 km (for the 5 km and 10 km/half marathon) along the course
additional: You can travel to the start by public transport by taking the train to Ganddal station and walking 30 minutes to Bogafjell, or by taking the bus to Bogafjell. The children’s race starts at 12:00 and can also serve as a warm-up for adults who want to run with the children. The half marathon starts at 13:00. The start location may be adjusted due to work at the venue. Ganddal station and the bus to Bogafjell are the stated public transport options.

name: Fýri Trail by Salomon
description: Fýri Trail by Salomon invites you to a unique trail-running experience in the Norwegian mountains at Fýri Resort in Hemsedal. This race is the final event in the Salomon Golden Trail Nordic Series and offers three distances: 29 km, 18 km, and a 56 km ultra. The race combines demanding technical trails with spectacular scenery, including the challenging “Queen of the Hill” climb and the fast “Max Effort” descent. After the race, participants can celebrate at the “Mud & Champagne” party, creating a social and inclusive atmosphere for all runners.
course_highlights: Queen of the Hill: 3 km technical climb with 550 m of elevation gain
Max Effort: 4 km descent with 600 m of elevation loss
Start just outside Fýri Resort on varied surfaces including asphalt, gravel, and wide trails
additional: The race has two start groups based on expected finish time, with an Elite group for the top 50 men and women starting in a separate wave. Shuttle buses run from Fýri Resort before the start. After the race, the “Mud & Champagne” party features live music and a Superhero Celebration Hour to honour the final runners. Fýri Resort is the festival’s meeting point. The programme may include test runs, talks, an awards ceremony, and the Fýri Trail Party.

name: Bergan Bygg Brakvatnet Halvmaraton
description: Bergan Bygg Brakvatnet Half Marathon is a traditional half-marathon held at Brakvatnet on Osterøy. The course consists of eight laps around Brakvatnet plus an extra 337.5-meter section, with the start and finish at the bathing area. The event also includes a children’s race and a relay. Changing and toilet facilities are available in the finish area, and food is for sale. The race attracts both local and visiting runners and offers a scenic, varied route around the lake.
course_highlights: The course consists of 8 laps around Brakvatnet plus 337.5 meters
Start and finish at the bathing area by Brakvatnet
Scenic course approximately 2 km from Valestrandsfossen on Osterøy
additional: The children’s race starts at 11:00, and the half marathon and relay start at 12:00. There are changing tents and toilets for both women and men in the finish area. Food is for sale in the finish area; Vipps or cash is preferred. Parking is limited, and participants are encouraged to park at Valestrand School or by Valestrandsvatnet. Cars are not driven from the start area. The finish area has changing tents, toilets, and a dining room. Parking is at Valestrand School or the parking lot by Valestrandsvatnet.

name: Insellauf Rund um Amrum
location: Norddorf auf Amrum, Nordfriesland, Schleswig-Holstein, Germany
description: The Insellauf Rund um Amrum is a popular fun run for everyone, held annually in late summer in Norddorf on the North Sea island of Amrum. The event offers a sporting challenge amid the unique natural surroundings of the Wadden Sea National Park, a World Heritage Site. Participants can enjoy the varied landscape of dunes, Kniepsand and sea views. The race is an appealing way for both locals and holidaymakers to combine physical activity with experiencing nature.
course_highlights: Run through the varied landscape of Kniepsand and dunes
Course in the Wadden Sea National Park, a World Heritage Site
Start and finish in Norddorf on Amrum
additional: The Insellauf takes place annually in late summer. The event is part of Amrum’s extensive sports programme. The venue is the AOK-Nordseeklinik, Strunwai 23, in Norddorf on Amrum. The event takes place in the Wadden Sea National Park area and emphasises experiencing nature and beach activities. Registration is possible on site or by email, with refreshments and support provided by local partners.

name: Mühlenlauf in Laar
location: Laar, Grafschaft Bentheim, Lower Saxony, Germany
organizer: Verein zur Erhaltung der Windmühle Laar/Vechte e.V.
description: The Mühlenlauf in Laar has been organized by SV Grenzland Laarwald since 1986 and takes place annually on the third weekend in September. Runners of all ages can choose between 2 km, 5 km and 10 km courses. The start and finish are both by the historic windmill, which, together with the windmill association, creates a welcoming atmosphere. Drinks and refreshments are provided for participants and spectators.
course_highlights: Start and finish by the historic windmill in Laar
Course distances: 2 km, 5 km and 10 km
Run through the scenic surroundings of Laar
additional: The Mühlenlauf is organized in cooperation with the sports club. The windmill and the local heritage house can be rented for celebrations. Drinks and refreshments are available on site for runners and spectators. The Mühlenlauf takes place in September, with drinks and refreshments provided. Advance registration is possible; late registration is available on site. The event takes place in all weather conditions.

name: Röderhof-Benefiz-Lauf
description: The Röderhof Charity Run takes place on September 19, 2026, in Diekholzen and offers various running and walking distances for all age groups and ability levels. This traditional charity event focuses on the enjoyment of running and coming together to support a good cause. Distances range from 500 meters to 10 kilometers, including special wheelchair races. Start times are staggered to ensure the event runs smoothly.
course_highlights: A variety of distances from 500 m to 10 km
Inclusive wheelchair races and walking routes
A run through the scenic surroundings of Diekholzen
additional: Online registration closes on 15.09. at 21:00. Late entries are possible on the event day up to 1 hour before the start, subject to a €2 late-entry fee. Payment by direct debit is possible. The event includes several start times for different distances and categories, including special wheelchair races and walking routes. Various running events, wheelchair races, walking, and the option to donate via PayPal

name: Welterbelauf Zollverein 2026
location: Zollverein, Essen-Stoppenberg, Essen, North Rhine-Westphalia, Germany
description: The Welterbelauf Zollverein takes place on September 19, 2026, on the grounds of the Zollverein coking plant in Essen-Stoppenberg. The courses run along the Ring Promenade and past prominent industrial landmarks such as the Doppelbock winding tower, the SANAA building, and the Zollverein spoil tip. Various events are available for all ages and ability levels, including a 10 km run, relays, walking, and Special Olympics categories. The 10 km course is officially measured by the DLV and eligible for rankings. The race combines a sporting challenge with the unique atmosphere of this UNESCO World Heritage Site.
course_highlights: Course along the Ring Promenade and past the Doppelbock winding tower
Passes the SANAA building and the Zollverein spoil tip
10 km course officially measured by the DLV and eligible for rankings
additional: The event offers eight different competitions, including the 10 km Zollverein Run, 3 x 3.3 km Pütt Relay, 5.4 km Kumpel Run and Steiger Walk, 2.7 km Coking Plant Run, 1.2 km Schoolchildren's Race, 600 m Helen Keller Run, and 300 m Bambini Run. Parking on the grounds is free for participants and visitors. The venue is easily accessible by public transport and car. The DLV and IAAF International Competition Rules apply. Registration opens on May 15, 2026; the event includes team relays (Pütt Run) and offers certificates and results online.

name: Jan Schüpp Bürgerlauf Wittmund
distance_verbose: 12.5 km, 10 km, 10 km, 6.4 km, 5 km, 5 km, 2.7 km, 2 km

name: 32. Stadtparklauf
description: The Stadtparklauf Sondershausen is a traditional running event held annually in Sondershausen City Park. It offers various distances from 500 m to 10,000 m and is open to runners of all ages and ability levels. The route winds through the picturesque city park, offering a pleasant running atmosphere in a green setting. The event is organized by SV Glückauf Sondershausen e.V. and is very popular in the region.

name: 6. The Devil's Loop - Langenberg Backyard Ultramarathon
description: The Devil's Loop - Langenberg Backyard Ultramarathon is a challenging ultramarathon held in Enge-Sande, Schleswig-Holstein. The race is part of the Waterkant Cup and offers runners the opportunity to test their endurance on a demanding course. The organizer, Sportverein Enge-Sande von 1959 e.V., is a multi-faceted club offering a wide range of sporting activities. The event is aimed at ambitious runners looking for a special challenge.

name: Altstadt-Run 2026
description: The Altstadt-Run Treysa 2026 takes place on September 19 in Schwalmstadt and is part of the Schwalm-Eder Running Cup. The event offers runners an appealing opportunity to run through the historic old town of Treysa. Organized by ESV Jahn Treysa, the race is for all running enthusiasts looking for a sporting challenge in beautiful surroundings.

name: Duinger Berglauf
description: The Duinger Mountain Run takes place on September 19, 2026, in Duingen, Lower Saxony, and offers races for children and adults. The event starts and finishes at the OBS sports hall and includes short children’s races as well as more challenging 5 km and 10 km mountain runs with around 110 meters of elevation gain. Organized by Duinger Sport-Club e.V., the run has been an accessible local mountain-running event for 19 years. After the run, all participants receive free access to the indoor swimming pool and sauna, with changing rooms, showers, and refreshments available on site.

name: Edeka Ladage-Lauf Wennigsen
description: The EDEKA Ladage Run in Wennigsen offers a varied programme for all age groups, with distances ranging from about 600 m for kindergarten children to 10 km for adults. The races take place on a varied loop course on the grounds of Sophie Scholl Comprehensive School, running through residential areas and along field paths, with a special atmosphere at the start and finish. Alongside the sporting competition, the event also has a social focus, as proceeds from the main race are donated to the Bastlergemeinschaft der Wennigser Wasserräder e.V. The event is a popular community run with a family-friendly atmosphere and a long tradition in the region.

name: Freimarktslauf
description: The Freimarktslauf in Garrel is the region’s largest community race, offering a varied running experience for young and old, beginners and professionals on its flat loop courses. The event features distances ranging from a 400 m children’s race to the 10 km main races, which take place on a flat 2.5 km loop through Garrel. Alongside the sporting competition, community and fun take center stage, supported by RunClub Garrel, which specifically encourages beginners. More than 1,300 participants make the race a popular event filled with unforgettable moments.

name: Klausdorfer Kranichlauf
description: The Klausdorf Crane Run invites runners of all ages to take part in various races through the beautiful surroundings of Klausdorf. Times are recorded using a chip issued with the race number. Every participant receives a certificate and a medal, and the top three finishers in each race are honored separately. Refreshments are provided along the course and at the finish, and changing rooms and restrooms are available at Vorpommernhus. The event offers a family-friendly atmosphere and is suitable for both competitive runners and recreational athletes.

name: Wilstermarsch Lauf
description: The Wilstermarschlauf is a long-established running event in Wilster, taking place for the 34th time on September 19, 2026. The event offers various race distances for children and adults, including 400 m, 2 km, 5 km, and 10 km, through the scenic Wilstermarsch. Alongside the sporting competition, a varied program featuring games, bouncy cushions, a DJ, a barbecue stand, and refreshments provides entertainment and a welcoming atmosphere for participants and spectators. The race is part of the Steinburg Cup and attracts several hundred runners each year, supported by numerous volunteers.

name: Wutzseelauf
description: The Wutzsee Run in Lindow (Mark) is a family-friendly fun run, taking place for the 21st time on September 19, 2026. The varied routes run around Lake Wutzsee through Stechlin-Ruppiner Land Nature Park and offer running opportunities for all age groups, from Bambinis to experienced runners. The event is known for its welcoming atmosphere, professional chip timing and a varied program of activities. Participants can look forward to distances from 600 meters to 22 kilometers, including Nordic walking. Award ceremonies take place after the races, and every finisher receives a certificate to download or print on site.

name: Gontyniec Celtic Trail
description: Gontyniec Celtic Trail is a unique reverse-format race, lasting 6 or 12 hours on loops of approximately 10 km through the scenic Gontyniec massif. Runners cover as much distance as possible, with fully equipped aid stations after each loop. The course offers changing scenery at different times of day, beautiful views of the Noteć Valley, and unique natural and cultural attractions, such as beehives shaped like ancient gods. It’s a special experience for runners seeking a challenge and unforgettable memories.

name: Run in Sopot IV - Opera Leśna
organizer: Miejski Ośrodek Sportu i Rekreacji w Sopocie
description: Run in Sopot Opera Leśna is a 5 km race taking place on September 19, 2026, in Sopot. The start and finish are located in the parking lot by the Forest Opera, and the course runs through the scenic areas around the venue. The race is part of a series of four events held on different dates and at different locations in Sopot, offering participants a unique atmosphere and the chance to compete over a short distance. The participant limit is 250, ensuring an intimate and well-organized event.

name: Damloop by night 2026
description: The Damloop by night is a unique evening run of 5 English miles (8 km), starting in Amsterdam and finishing in Zaandam. The run is known for its festive atmosphere, with great beats and light effects, making it a nonstop party for all participants. The event combines a sporting challenge with a lively atmosphere, ideal for runners looking for a special experience.
course_highlights: Evening run of 5 English miles (8 km)
Starts in Amsterdam, finishes in Zaandam
Festive atmosphere with music and light effects
additional: The Damloop by night is a nonstop party with beats and light shows. There is a special registration procedure for fast runners who finished in the top 3 of the previous edition. Extra products are also available to order, such as the official On Running shirt. The organizers focus on safety and preventing runners from overheating. The event includes various race distances, virtual options, and a festive finale. The 8 km race is known for its festive atmosphere and starts and finishes at the Olympic Stadium.

name: Werkhoven Loopt 2026
description: Werkhoven Loopt is a friendly and sporty running event in the Kromme Rijn region, held annually on the third Saturday of September. The 11th edition in 2026 offers running opportunities for all ages, with distances of 1 and 2 km for children and 5 and 10 km for adults. The event is open to both recreational and competitive runners and is known for its welcoming, accessible atmosphere. Enthusiastic volunteers help make it an unforgettable day.
course_highlights: Run through the beautiful Kromme Rijn region
Distances for children (1 and 2 km) and adults (5 and 10 km)
A friendly atmosphere with activities on the Brink
additional: Race numbers can be collected between 15:00 and 17:15. A warm-up is scheduled for 16:25. The event is suitable for all ages and abilities, with a festive atmosphere and various activities at the Brink hospitality square. Distances: 1 km (kids’ run), 2 km, 5 km, 10 km; advance registration is recommended; the event takes place at De Brink 5 in Werkhoven.

name: 4 Mijl van Assen

tiers.description: € 13,95 bij voor-inschrijving, zolang er startnummers beschikbaar zijn

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: De Univé Kidsrun wordt georganiseerd voor alle basisschoolleerlingen en deelname is GRATIS!

description: The 4 Mijl van Assen is an annual running event held in the Marsdijk district of Assen, starting and finishing at Anne Frank Plein. This ninth edition, on 19 September 2026, combines sport with a lively festival featuring music, attractions, a fair and a sports market. The run is suitable for all ages, with various categories including the main 4-mile distance, a College Run and a free Univé Kids Run for primary school pupils. The race also marks the start of Asser Sports Week and is an important event in the AssenRuns running circuit.
course_highlights: Start and finish at Anne Frank Plein in the Marsdijk district
Course through Assen’s northernmost district
Includes special events for frame runners (2 miles and 4 miles)
additional: The main 4-mile distance has a single start at 14:00, with the front starting pen reserved for the fastest runners. The Univé Kids Run starts at 11:55 with a group warm-up and is free, including a kids’ shirt and medal (while supplies last). Clinics are also offered for different groups to help them prepare for the 4 miles. On race day, a festival featuring music, attractions, a fair and a sports market takes place in Anne Frank Park. Registration is currently closed; the event includes running races, a festival, Kids Runs, a College Run, clinics and a sports market.

name: Nijmegen-Rotterdam
description: The Nijmegen-Rotterdam is the longest continuous walking event in the Netherlands, covering a distance of 160 km. The event starts on Saturday 19 September 2026 at 11.00 in Nijmegen and finishes on Sunday 20 September in Rotterdam. The route was renewed in 2022 and is improved every year, with six refreshments stops and various support stations along the way. The organisers provide a safe and well-supported walking experience, including first aid and foot care. Participants who complete the event successfully receive a certificate and a special keepsake.
course_highlights: 160 km continuous walking route from Nijmegen to Rotterdam
Six refreshments stops and several free support stations along the way
Route renewed in 2022 and improved every year
additional: The event starts in groups from Sporthal De Boog in Nijmegen. Registration is open from 9.30 to 10.30. Wearing a reflective vest is mandatory during the night; one can be rented or purchased at the start. An experienced first-aid and foot-care team will be on hand. A meal is served after approximately 60 km. If you withdraw, the entry fee is refunded minus a €5 administration fee. Discounts may be available for federation members and members of other associations. 160 km route, start in Nijmegen, finish in Rotterdam, including refreshments stops, support stations, a meal and first aid; reflective vests and flashlights are recommended.

name: Run & Roast Eindhoven
description: Run & Roast Eindhoven vindt plaats op zaterdag 19 september en biedt deelnemers de keuze uit een 5 of 10 kilometer hardloopwedstrijd, evenals een kidsrun van 1 kilometer voor basisschoolkinderen. Het parcours is vlak, snel en goed geasfalteerd, met start en finish bij Museumpark VONK in het vernieuwde PreHistorische Dorp in de Genneper Parken. Na het hardlopen kunnen deelnemers genieten van een heerlijke plantaardige burger van Beyond Meat, muziek en een gezellige sfeer met foodtrucks. Er zijn mooie prijzen voor de snelste lopers en speciale kortingsacties voor deelnemers.

name: 11e Kwintelooyen Run
description: De 11e editie van de Kwintelooyen Run vindt plaats op zaterdag 19 september 2026 in het prachtige natuurgebied van de Utrechtse Heuvelrug bij Rhenen. Dit hardloopevenement biedt vier afstanden: een kidsrun van 1 km, en de 5 km, 10 km en 15 km routes die volledig over natuurlijke ondergrond gaan. De run ondersteunt goede doelen die zich inzetten voor kinderen en jongeren met een beperking. Deelnemers ontvangen een exclusief Puma hardloopshirt en een medaille bij de finish, wat het evenement sportief en feestelijk maakt.

name: Woellustrun
description: De Woellust Run is een gezellige en toegankelijke hardloopwedstrijd in Groningen, met afstanden voor zowel jeugd als volwassenen. Het parcours van 2,5 kilometer loopt kris-kras door de wijk met maar liefst 30 bochten en veel enthousiaste supporters langs de route. De jeugd kan deelnemen aan de 500 en 1000 meter, terwijl de volwassenen kunnen kiezen voor 5 of 10 kilometer. Er zijn mooie prijzen te verdienen, waaronder prijzengeld voor de top 3 van de 5 en 10 kilometer en een speciale prijs voor het lopen van een nieuw parcoursrecord.

name: Mini Marathon Zeewolde
description: De Mini Marathon Zeewolde is een laagdrempelig hardloopevenement dat jaarlijks plaatsvindt en waarbij deelnemers van verschillende leeftijden kunnen meedoen aan afstanden van 1,1 km, 2,1 km en 4,2 km. Het evenement heeft een gezellige sfeer en steunt de stichting Conor Cares, die zich inzet tegen kinderkanker. De startgroepen zijn verdeeld op leeftijd en er is een prijsuitreiking voor de snelste lopers per categorie. De inschrijving is gratis tot 17 september, daarna bedraagt het inschrijfgeld 5,50 euro per deelnemer.

name: Condensloop
description: De Condensloop vindt plaats op zaterdag 19 september 2026 in Leeuwarden, startend vanaf de Merodestraat bij de Condensfabriek van FrieslandCampina. De loop biedt diverse afstanden: 1 km Kidsrun/FrameRunners, 2,8 km, 5 km, 10 km en een halve marathon. De routes leiden richting Camminghaburen en de Groene Ster. Na afloop ontvangt iedere deelnemer een tas met producten van Friesland Campina, Dr. Oetker en Royal Koopmans. De Condensloop is een uitstekende voorbereiding op de Marathon van Amsterdam of Eindhoven en deelname is op eigen risico.

name: Open NK trappenloop
description: De Open N.K. Trappenloop in Appelscha is een spannende traploopwedstrijd speciaal voor jongeren van 10 tot 16 jaar. De deelnemers rennen zo snel mogelijk de trappen van de Bosbergtoren op, waarbij snelheid en fitheid centraal staan. De wedstrijd vindt plaats tijdens de feestelijke Bloeiweek en biedt een unieke kans om de Bosberg te bedwingen en je fitheid te testen. Naast de traploop is er een gratis fit-test op de parkeerplaats van restaurant De Bosberg. Deelname is gratis, maar aanmelden is verplicht via Loopsportvereniging Invictus.

name: Run2day Bosloop Veenhuizen
description: De Run2day Bosloop in Veenhuizen is een gezellige en kleinschalige hardloopwedstrijd die vier keer per jaar plaatsvindt. De routes lopen door de bossen en langs de heidevelden van Veenhuizen, met afstanden van 3, 5 en 10 kilometer, elk met een eigen parcours. De start is bij de sporthal aan de Kerklaan, waar ook omkleed- en douchefaciliteiten beschikbaar zijn. De loop is geschikt voor jong en oud en trekt gemiddeld tussen de 40 en 100 deelnemers per editie.

name: Bolloop Lunetten
description: Bolloop Lunetten is een hardloopevenement in de Utrechtse wijk Lunetten, georganiseerd door Bewoners Overleg Lunetten samen met Utrecht Atletiek. Het evenement maakt deel uit van de Wijkdag en biedt een 1 km Kidsrun voor kinderen tot 12 jaar, en 5 km en 10 km afstanden voor oudere deelnemers. De 10 km is toegankelijk vanaf 16 jaar, terwijl iedereen vanaf 4 jaar kan meedoen aan de andere afstanden. Het is een klassieke stratenloop zonder poespas, ideaal voor gezinnen, recreatieve lopers en iedereen die dichtbij huis wil lopen. Het evenement is al enkele jaren een vaste waarde in de Lunettener kalender en viert dit jaar een jubileum.

name: ‘kLEEF Run
description: De ‘kLEEF Run & Walk 2026 is een hardloopevenement georganiseerd door Atletiekvereniging Veluwe in Apeldoorn. Het evenement biedt een sportieve en gezellige sfeer voor zowel hardlopers als wandelaars. De start en finish vinden plaats bij Sportpark Orderbos, een bekende locatie met goede faciliteiten. De loop is geschikt voor verschillende niveaus en leeftijden, waarbij deelnemers kunnen genieten van een mooie route in de omgeving.

name: Run for Care
description: Op zaterdag 19 september 2026 vindt in recreatiegebied Krimpenerhout, bij Krimpen aan de Lek, de allereerste Run for Care plaats. Het is een sponsorloop van 5 of 10 kilometer voor hardlopers en wandelaars, waarbij het niet draait om de snelste tijd, maar om het grootste hart. Deelnemers kunnen individueel of als team meedoen en sponsorgeld inzamelen voor hulp en hoop in Oost-Europa en Centraal-Azië. Naast de loop is er een gezellige fair bij kringloopwinkel De Groene Weg, zodat ook familie en vrienden kunnen genieten van de dag.

name: Trollhättan City Trail
description: Trollhättan City Trail is a trail race through central Trollhättan that began in 2016. Starting at Folkets Park, the race takes runners through varied terrain, including urban surroundings, hilly trails, stairs and scenic areas such as Kopparklinten, Gamle dal, several locks, Olidan and Kungsgrottan. There are several distances to choose from, from a short, child-friendly Mini Trail to longer, challenging courses of up to 22.5 km. The race also offers start classes for running with a dog on certain distances, making it an inclusive event with a strong sense of community.
course_highlights: A trail race featuring hilly paths and pulse-raising stairways
Passes several locks, Kopparklinten, Gamle dal, Olidan and Kungsgrottan
A mix of urban surroundings and nature experiences
additional: Bib distribution opens at 11:30. Start times: 13:00 for Mini Trail 0.8 km; 14:00 for City Trail 8.5, 14 and 22.5 km; and 14:15 for City Trail 8.5 and 14 km with dogs on a leash. The awards ceremony takes place about 30 minutes after the first finisher crosses the line. The race offers dedicated start groups for running with a dog on a leash in the 8.5 km and 14 km races. Mini Trail is a children’s race for ages 0–12, with no timing or competition. Start and finish at Folkets Park. Previous editions have offered 8.5 km, 14 km and 22.5 km, as well as Trollhättan Mini Trail at approximately 0.8 km. The distances and practical details for 2027 have not been confirmed in the sources.

name: Billingehusloppet
description: Billingehusloppet is a traditional cross-country race dating back to 1966, organized by IFK Skövde Skidor. The race has historically featured varying distances, but since 1993 both men and women have competed over 10.5 km. There are also categories for younger participants, such as Knatteloppet and Lilla Billingehusloppet, as well as a Nordic walking category for recreational participants. Over the years, the race has attracted many well-known Swedish runners and is a popular event in Skövde.
course_highlights: A cross-country race with a rich tradition dating back to 1966
A 10.5 km race for both men and women since 1993
Categories for younger runners and Nordic walking
additional: New categories for younger participants are available, including Knatteloppet and Lilla Billingehusloppet. There is also a Nordic walking category for those who prefer it. Course records are documented for men and women over 10.5 km, as well as for older distances. There is also a Nordic walking category for recreational participants.

name: Coop Linköping Runt
description: Coop Linköping Runt is a popular fun run held in Linköping, starting and finishing at Trädgårdsföreningen. The race offers a pleasant course through the central parts of the city and a great running experience for both recreational and competitive runners. The event is known for its friendly atmosphere and good amenities, including changing rooms, showers and bag drop. It is a traditional autumn race that attracts runners of different ages and abilities.
course_highlights: The course passes through central Linköping, with lovely views
Start and finish at Trädgårdsföreningen
Paved surface with gentle undulations
additional: Changing rooms and showers are available. A bag drop is offered. Food and drink, as well as medical assistance, are available on site. Bib numbers and race confirmations are handled according to the terms and conditions. It is possible to transfer an entry and change category. The race also seeks volunteers.

name: Gjesdalmilå
description: Gjesdalmilå is an annual race organized by Gjesdal Idrettslag and held in Ålgård. The event offers distances for children, 5 km and 10 km, as well as a double distance for those who want to run both the 5 km and 10 km. The courses pass through scenic surroundings, with the start and finish at Sentralidrettsanlegget, and feature varied terrain with both easy-running sections and some hills. The event is a natural choice for both recreational and elite athletes in the region and promotes the joy of sport for all ages.
course_highlights: The 5 km course is easy to run, with fewer hills, and consists of several loops around Solås skole and Åfaret.
The 10 km course crosses the E39 through the underpass and follows Edlandsvatnet over varied terrain.
The finish is on the athletics track at the finish line at Sentralidrettsanlegget.
additional: Schedule: The children's race starts at 12:00, the 5 km starts at 12:30, and the 10 km starts at 13:30. The double distance involves running both the 5 km and 10 km. The children's race is 650 metres and takes place in the area around Ålgård Stadion. For 2027, the schedule is: children's race at 12:00, 5 km at 12:30, and 10 km at 13:30.

name: Bedburger Citylauf 2026
description: The GVG Citylauf Bedburg takes place on September 13, 2026, in the town center of Bedburg. The races run through the traffic-free town center, with the start and finish on the market square in front of the town hall. Various distances are offered, from a 300-meter children’s race to the 10 km main race, as well as relay events. The race is suitable for all age groups and offers a great opportunity to experience Bedburg in motion.
course_highlights: Start and finish on the market square in front of the town hall
Routes run through Bedburg’s traffic-free town center
The 10 km main race consists of five laps through the town center
additional: Late registration is possible on race day up to one hour before the respective start, with a €3.00 late-registration fee (except for the Bambini race, which is free to enter). Headphones, MP3 players, jogging strollers, and dogs are not permitted for safety reasons. Multiple race distances; registration online and on site up to one hour before the start; no dogs or headphones on the course.

name: Aerzener twinfit-Volkslauf
price_range: € 5,– bis € 9,– je nach Lauf und Anmeldung

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: 5 km, 10 km und Walking € 8,– bis zum 19.09.2026

description: The Aerzener twinfit Volkslauf is a family-friendly running event offering various distances. It starts and finishes in Aerzen. Events include 5 km and 10 km fun runs, a 5 km company and team run, a 1.8 km schoolchildren’s run, and a free children’s run. The event takes place on September 20, 2026, and offers a pleasant atmosphere with refreshments and an awards ceremony. The races are scored according to DLV rules, and participants can win prizes and enter a raffle.
course_highlights: Start and finish at twinfit, Königsförder Straße 19, 31855 Aerzen
5 km and 10 km fun runs, plus a 5 km company and team run
1.8 km schoolchildren’s run and free children’s run
additional: Late registration is available on September 20, 2026, from 9:00–9:45 a.m.; for the schoolchildren’s run, until 11:45 a.m. Changing facilities with showers are available at twinfit. The awards ceremony is scheduled for around 1:30 p.m., with certificates for places 1–3 and a raffle. Drinks are available along the course and snacks in the finish area. Parking is available at twinfit. Events for children and young people. Registration opens on August 1, 2026; late registration is available on the day of the event. Scoring according to DLV rules, prizes and certificates, company and team run, parking at the event venue.

name: Druffeler Volkslauf
description: The Druffeler Volkslauf takes place on 20 September 2026 in Rietberg-Druffel and offers timed races over 1 km and 10 km. The event supports a solidarity initiative in sport that promotes running and maintains a relief fund for the families of injured runners. laufen.de members can benefit from the “Book smart, pay less!” offer. The course is officially measured and suitable for record purposes.
course_highlights: Timed races over 1 km and 10 km
Start in Rietberg-Druffel
Typical September weather: around 19 °C, with mostly cloudy skies
additional: Registration supports a solidarity initiative in sport and a relief fund for injured runners. Typical September weather is around 19 °C, with a minimum of 10 °C and an average of 45 mm of precipitation; skies are usually cloudy. Discounted registration is available through laufen.de; the event supports charitable causes. Ask the organizer for details before registering.

name: Herbstlauf und 29. Wandertag Fleckenberg
location: Sportplatz auf der Latroper Straße, Fleckenberg, Hochsauerlandkreis, North Rhine-Westphalia, Germany
description: The 39th Autumn Run and Hiking Day in Fleckenberg takes place on September 20, 2026, at the sports field on Latroper Straße. The event is a scoring race in the Volksbank Sauerland Lauf Cup and features a scenic 15 km loop with varied terrain. The route follows forest paths, a paved climb, and some rocky sections, making well-cushioned running shoes ideal. Changing rooms and showers are available, as are food and drink sales. After the race, an awards ceremony will be held, with certificates and trophies.
course_highlights: 15 km loop starting at the sports field, elevation 360 m
Varied route with a paved climb, firm forest paths, and some rocky terrain
The return route follows the final kilometres of the Rothaarsteig Marathon
additional: Indoor changing rooms and showers are available. A wide selection of food and drinks will be on sale. The awards ceremony begins at approximately 12 noon, with awards for the children’s and youth races. Every participant receives a certificate; the fastest runner receives a trophy. Scoring race in the Volksbank Sauerland Lauf Cup; start and finish at the sports field on Latroper Straße; indoor changing rooms, showers, refreshments, and certificates for all finishers.

name: Lauf Rund um den Fühlinger See
location: Fühlinger See, Köln, North Rhine-Westphalia, Germany
price_range: 15€ für 10 km und 5 km, 10€ für Jugend, Kinder kostenfrei, Nachmeldung 5€
description: The Rund um den Fühlinger See Run is a traditional road race in Cologne, taking place on September 20, 2026. The event offers a wide range of distances for runners of all ages: a half marathon, 10 km, 5 km, and a 1 km children’s run. The courses loop around the regatta course used for the 1998 World Rowing Championships and are measured by the DLV, allowing performances to qualify for rankings. The race is an ideal test ahead of the Generali Cologne Marathon and is known for its family-friendly atmosphere, attractive medals, and non-cash prizes for age-group participants.
course_highlights: Course loops around the regatta course used for the 1998 World Rowing Championships
Courses measured by the DLV and accompanied by a course certificate
Road-race routes with little traffic in Cologne-Fühlingen
additional: Timing is provided by a disposable chip attached to the race number, included in the entry fee. Late entries are possible online up to 30 minutes before the start (adults: €5; children/youth: free). Race packets will be distributed on race day from 08:45 at the boathouse on Fühlinger See. Changing rooms and showers are available in the boathouse. Non-cash prizes are awarded to the first three in each age group, and attractive medals to the first three finishers in each race. Measured courses, DLV-measured courses, start times from 09:30, free parking, changing rooms and showers at the Fühlinger See boathouse, music and refreshments on site.

name: Möhnesee-Pokal-Lauf = Mehr als eine Herausforderung
description: The 38th Möhnesee-Pokal-Lauf, under the motto “More than a challenge,” takes place on September 20, 2026, in Möhnesee-Günne. The event offers two distances, 5 km and 30 km, and challenges participants with a demanding course. The race is known for its varied scenery and the special atmosphere at Möhnesee. Runners can look forward to a sporting challenge in beautiful surroundings.
course_highlights: 5 km and 30 km race distances
Venue in Möhnesee-Günne, surrounded by scenic countryside
Typical September weather, with mild temperatures and mostly cloudy skies
additional: The race takes place on Sunday, September 20, 2026. Average temperatures are around 19 °C during the day and 10 °C at night. Approximately 45 mm of precipitation is expected, with mostly cloudy skies. The race is held in September, with typical temperatures around 19 °C; checking with the organizer for further details before registering is recommended.

name: Seidenraupen Cross
location: Hülser Bruch, Krefeld, North Rhine-Westphalia, Germany
description: The Seidenraupen Cross in Krefeld is one of the most interesting cross-country races in North Rhine-Westphalia, organised in a friendly, family atmosphere. Runners can look forward to challenging 6.5 km and 16 km courses through Krefeld’s largest nature reserve, the Hülser Bruch, with tough climbs, fast descents and beautiful natural scenery. Alongside the main races, there are also children’s races at the Hülser district sports complex. The event offers a varied, nature-filled running experience for beginners and experienced runners alike.
course_highlights: Run through the Hülser Bruch nature reserve, with three hills
Tough climbs and fast descents
Children’s races on a variety of surfaces (grass, sand pits and cinder track)
additional: The start for hikers, walkers and Nordic walkers is at 10 a.m. Registration is open until one hour before the race. The course distances are approximately 6.5 km and 16 km, and can also be covered on foot. The children’s races take place at the sports complex on Hölschen Dyk. The event supports social projects every year. Trail and cross-country sections; routes on forest and hiking trails; start and finish at the Hölschen Dyk sports ground; registration until one hour before the race.

name: Kassel Marathon
description: The Kassel Marathon is the largest sporting event in North Hesse and takes place from September 18 to 20, 2026, at the Auestadion Kassel. The event offers a variety of races, including a marathon, half marathon, power walking, relay, corporate run, and children’s races. The marathon course has 200 meters of elevation gain and runs through the city of Kassel. Participants receive a finisher’s medal and a free finisher shirt. Runners are supported by medical care from the German Red Cross and a post-race massage service.

name: 12. PSD Bank Halbmarathon
description: The PSD Bank Half Marathon in Hamburg is a fast, flat running event that takes runners through the Wandsbek district and as far north as Berne subway station. The course then heads back via Rahlstedt and Tonndorf to the start and finish area on Wandsbeker Marktstraße. The race is known for its unique atmosphere, with support from spectators and live bands along the course, and takes place in late summer at dusk.

name: 14. Northeimer Tageslicht Ultra
description: The Northeimer Tageslicht Ultra is a challenging ultramarathon held in Northeim. The course passes through varied terrain and offers a special challenge for experienced ultrarunners. The event has a long tradition, with numerous finishers and records that underscore the race’s high quality and athletic demands. Participants can download the course GPX track to prepare optimally.

name: 28. Hiddestorfer Rübenlauf
description: The 28th Hiddestorf Rübenlauf is a family-friendly running event organized by the running group of Sportverein Eintracht Hiddestorf. The event offers distances of 1.4 km, 5.2 km, 10.1 km, and the Hemmingen Half Marathon (21.3 km). In addition to the sporting competition, participants can enjoy a legendary runners’ breakfast, cake, waffles, grilled food and drinks, as well as a varied program of activities that includes face painting for children. The event is open to all runners; club membership is not required.

name: 8. Altstadtlauf Salzwedel
description: The Altstadtlauf Salzwedel is part of the Elbe-Ohre-Cup and will take place for the eighth time in 2026. The course runs through the historic old town of Salzwedel on a 5 km loop. The longer distances, 10 km and half marathon, are run over multiple loops accordingly. The event is organized by Sportclub Demker ’95 e.V. and offers runners in northern Saxony-Anhalt an attractive racing opportunity.

name: Uentroper Geithelauf
description: The 24th Uentroper Geithelauf takes place on September 20, 2026, and takes runners through the green heart of Uentrop. The event is organized by Turn- und Sportverein 46/68 Uentrop e.V. and offers a sporting community in a natural setting. The routes pass through fields and forest paths in the surrounding area and are suitable for various fitness levels. The event emphasizes fun, community, and a welcoming atmosphere for all participants.

name: CANOSSA Benefiz Berglauf
description: The CANOSSA Charity Mountain Run® in Bad Harzburg is a challenging fundraising run through Harz National Park, taking place on September 20, 2026. Participants can complete the course by running, Nordic walking, or hiking; it ends at the CANOSSA Column on Burgberg. The run supports inclusive activities for children and young people in the Goslar district, combining a sporting challenge with social commitment. After the run, participants can look forward to a festive after-race event with music, refreshments, and an awards ceremony.

name: Citylauf Leer
description: The Citylauf Leer is a traditional running event taking place on September 20, 2026, in downtown Leer at Denkmalsplatz. The event offers races for various age groups and distances, including Bambino, Teeny, 5 km and 10 km races. The course follows closed circuit routes through the town center, with refreshment stations along the course and in the finish area. All participants receive a T-shirt (while supplies last), and attractive prizes and certificates are awarded to the top runners. The event includes individual and team competitions and takes place in all weather.

name: Grebinlauf
description: The Grebinlauf takes place on Sunday, September 20, 2026, in Grebin and offers varied routes for runners, walkers, children, and relay teams. The event is known for its great atmosphere and a special finish at the Grebin sports field. One highlight is the turnaround point at Grebin Mill, which makes the course unique. Registration is via the Davengo platform.

name: Heidelauf Halle am 20.09.2026
description: The 278th Heidelauf Halle takes place on September 20, 2026, in Halle (Saale) and is organized by SV Halle Triathlon. The event gives runners of different age groups and ability levels the opportunity to take part in a traditional race. The course runs around Heidebad and offers varied surroundings. Registration is open until the day of the event.

name: Horster Löwenlauf
description: The 2nd Horster Löwenlauf takes place on September 20, 2026, around Schloss Horst in Gelsenkirchen. This sporting event offers a colorful, community atmosphere for all age groups, with refreshments and entertainment in the castle park. Following the great success of the inaugural event, the race is once again being organized as a sporting highlight for the Horst district. The event takes place on World Children’s Day, which is considered a particularly fitting coincidence.

name: Lohelauf
description: The Lohelauf in Wentorf near Hamburg is a long-standing race, taking place for the 21st time in 2026. The event offers a range of distances for different age groups and ability levels, including runs from 1.5 km to 9 km and a 5 km walking route. The race takes place in the beautiful Wentorfer Lohe conservation area and is known for its family-friendly atmosphere and team spirit. On race day, there is a tent village, with the start and finish at the dog meadow, where participants can collect their race numbers and enjoy the event.

name: Mommelsteinlauf
description: The Mommelsteinlauf in Floh-Seligenthal, OT Hohleborn, is a family-friendly running event organised by SV 1962 Hohleborn. From the Bambini run and youth and beginner courses to the challenging 32 km trail, every runner and Nordic walker can find a suitable route. The routes are marked, with refreshment stations on routes of 8 km and longer. The event offers timing using a bib-chip transponder and medical support. At the finish, participants can enjoy refreshments and a coffee-and-cake buffet.

name: Sparkassen-Küstenmarathon 26
description: The Sparkassen Coastal Marathon in Otterndorf is a long-standing race on the North Sea coast, taking place on September 20, 2026. The event offers various distances, from a Bambini run for kindergarten children to the classic marathon distance of 42.195 km. The courses run through the historic old town, along the Elbe dike and by the water, guaranteeing a varied and scenic running experience. In addition to the marathon, there are also half-marathon, 10 km and 5 km races, as well as relay and walking events. The event emphasizes community, endurance and a family-friendly atmosphere.

name: Weddelbrooker Dorflauf
description: The Weddelbrook Village Run is a traditional race through the village of Weddelbrook and the surrounding countryside. It offers various distances from 900 m to 10 km, so runners of all ages and ability levels can take part. The course passes through scenic areas, including a section around the lake, and has a family-friendly atmosphere with plenty of volunteers on site. The race is known for its good organization and offers the opportunity to compete with other runners or simply enjoy running.

name: Wilscher FUN-RUN
description: The Wilsche FunRun is a longstanding race that has been held annually at the Wilsche sports field in Gifhorn since 2005. It is part of the Gifhorn-Wolfsburg Running Cup and offers an appealing race over a 10 km distance. The race is known for its friendly atmosphere and strong participation, and is an established part of the regional running scene. The race starts promptly at 10 a.m., and the event is supported by local organizations such as the fire brigades and the German Red Cross.

name: Hiddestorfer Rübenlauf
description: The Hiddestorfer Rübenlauf is a family-friendly running event organized by the running group of Sportverein Eintracht Hiddestorf. It offers routes of 1.4 km, 5.2 km, 10.1 km and the Hemmingen Half Marathon (21.3 km). Alongside the sporting competition, participants can enjoy a legendary runners’ breakfast, cake, waffles, grilled food and drinks, as well as a varied supporting program that includes face painting for children. The event is particularly suitable for runners of all ages and places great emphasis on a friendly, welcoming atmosphere.

name: 12 Bieg "Król Parku"
location: Park Miejski w Mosinie, Mosina, Poland
organizer: Ośrodek Sportu i Rekreacji w Mosinie
description: The 12th “King of the Park” Run is an annual running event organized by the Mosina Sports and Recreation Centre. The race takes place in the scenic surroundings of the town park, offering participants an attractive course and sporting competition. It attracts both amateur and more experienced runners, promoting an active lifestyle and bringing the local community together. The organizers provide professional support and a generous race pack.

name: 49 Półmaraton Lechitów
description: The 49th Lechit Half Marathon is Poland’s oldest half marathon, held continuously since 1978. The 21.0975 km race route runs from the Small Open-Air Museum in Ostrów Lednicki to the finish at St. Adalbert’s Square in Gniezno, following the route of Otto III’s historic journey. The race attracts thousands of runners every year and is part of the Polish Half Marathon Crown and the Greater Poland Half Marathon Grand Prix. The organizers provide professional race services, timekeeping, and course safety. Participants receive a race package with a medal and a recovery meal.

name: II Bieg Farmera
description: The 2nd Farmer’s Run is a 10 km road race taking place in Police. The event is a great opportunity to test your fitness on a scenic course, and participants can use training plans tailored to different ability levels. The organizers provide expert support and detailed training instructions to help participants prepare optimally for the race. This sporting event is aimed at runners who value good organization and opportunities for development.

name: VII Bieg Pocztyliona
description: The 7th Pocztylion Run is a 10 km race taking place on September 20, 2026, in Cewice, Pomeranian Voivodeship. Participants can prepare for the race using dedicated training plans tailored to different ability levels. The event is a great opportunity for runners to test their fitness on a scenic course and enjoy sporting competition in a friendly atmosphere.

name: 12 Bieg Ziemi Puckiej
location: Połczyno, Puck County, Pomeranian Voivodeship, Poland

name: NN Dam tot Damloop 2026

price_tiers.distance: The Virtual 40th NN Dam tot Damloop

description: The NN Dam tot Damloop is the Netherlands’ biggest running festival, starting in Amsterdam and finishing in Zaandam. The 10 English Miles route takes you through the unique IJ Tunnel and past lively music and cheering crowds in Amsterdam-Noord. In 2026, the event celebrates its 40th edition with a festive programme and an unforgettable finish on Peperstraat in Zaandam. After the finish, you can enjoy the celebrations at the Dam tot Dam Park during the Finish Festival.
course_highlights: Start on Prins Hendrikkade in Amsterdam
Run through the IJ Tunnel between the city centre and Amsterdam-Noord
Finish on Peperstraat in Zaandam, with a street party on Zuiddijk
additional: Registration opens in stages: Le Champion members can register from 6 April through 17 April, after which general registration opens on 18 April. A Premium Business Package is available for teams. The Business Run is popular with companies, with more than 25,000 participants. A free BackStory race bib is available. After the finish, there is a Finish Festival at the Dam tot Dam Park. Participants can choose from several distances, virtual options and special anniversary activities. The event has a festive, supportive atmosphere, with music and merchandise available.

name: StoneCityRun
description: The DYKA StoneCityRun is an atmospheric running event in Steenwijk, taking place on 20 September 2026. Participants run along the historic ramparts, through Rams Woerthe park and the centre of Steenwijk, with plenty of spectators and entertainment along the course. There are various distances for all ages and abilities, including special events such as the G-Run for people with disabilities and a walking tour. The event celebrates inclusivity and a friendly atmosphere, with the start at Theater de Meenthe and the finish at the Markt.
course_highlights: Run along Steenwijk’s historic ramparts
Through Rams Woerthe park and the centre of Steenwijk
Finish at the atmospheric Markt in Steenwijk
additional: After registration closes, it is possible to collect a blank bib at the start location, De Meenthe, from 13:00 on 20 September, without timekeeping. Children under 6 must be accompanied, and those accompanying children or people with disabilities may participate for free. Changing rooms and showers are available at the start location, and parking is available. The rollator run is specifically for older people, and the G-Run is inclusive, with support and assistive aids permitted. Participants can choose from various distances, including 0.6 km, 1.5 km, 3 km, 5 km and 10 km. The event also offers walks and special runs for people with disabilities, as well as parking, changing rooms and showers. Registration closes on 1 September 2026.

name: LOS Dokkum
organizer: Stichting Promotie Dokkum en stichting Ik ben Wil
description: LOS Dokkum is een uniek 12 uur durend hardloop- en wandelevenement in het Tolhuispark in Dokkum. Iedere uur klinkt het startsein voor een ronde van 6,7 kilometer hardlopen of 3,9 kilometer wandelen. De uitdaging is om te bepalen hoe lang je het volhoudt en telkens opnieuw de vraag te beantwoorden: ga ik nog een rondje? Het evenement combineert sportiviteit met een gezellige sfeer in een mooie natuurlijke omgeving.

name: Preston Palace Almelo Allee Run
description: De Preston Palace Almelo Allee Run is een sfeervol hardloopevenement in de groene omgeving van de Gravenallee in Almelo. Het evenement biedt afstanden voor zowel beginnende als ervaren lopers, waaronder een nieuwe 2 kilometer jeugd- en beginnersrun. De start en finish zijn bij de ijsbaan tegenover het sportpark, met een parcours langs brede lanen en een geliefde, sfeervolle omgeving. Het belooft een sportieve en gezellige dag te worden voor sporters, supporters en bezoekers van alle leeftijden.

name: Freedom Run - Libertyloop
description: Freedom Run - Liberty Loop is een recreatieve loop die plaatsvindt in Geldrop ter viering van 80 jaar bevrijding. De race biedt vier hardloopafstanden, vernoemd naar bekende veteranen, en een halve marathon. Daarnaast is er een gratis Kidsrun voor basisschoolkinderen en diverse wandelroutes langs oorlogsmonumenten en straten vernoemd naar verzetsstrijders. Het evenement benadrukt samen vrijheid vieren en biedt een unieke combinatie van sport en geschiedenis.

name: Rondjes van Pijn
description: Rondjes van Pijn is een uithoudingsloop georganiseerd door IJsvereniging Pijnacker, gehouden op zondag 20 september 2026 bij de Tinteltent in Pijnacker. De wedstrijd bestaat uit herhalende rondjes van 4,2 kilometer die elke half uur starten, met een maximum van tien rondes. Deelnemers kunnen hun tempo bepalen waarbij een snellere ronde meer rusttijd oplevert tot de volgende start. Het evenement richt zich op zowel jeugd als volwassenen en benadrukt uithoudingsvermogen boven snelheid.

name: Maasheggenloop
description: De Maasheggenloop, georganiseerd door Atletiek Vereniging Sporting Boxmeer, vindt plaats op 20 september 2026 in het prachtige Maasheggengebied, het oudste cultuurlandschap van Nederland. De loop biedt voor elke leeftijd en niveau een passende afstand, van de Bambinoloop voor de allerkleinsten tot de Halve Marathon voor de gevorderde lopers. De routes lopen door een unieke en natuurrijke omgeving, met voor de Halve Marathon en 10 kilometer een geldprijs voor het verbreken van het parcoursrecord. De sfeer is sportief en toegankelijk, met leuke herinneringen voor alle jeugddeelnemers en bekers voor de podiumplaatsen.

name: Molenbroekloop
description: Op zondag 20 september 2026 organiseert GAC Gemert de jaarlijkse Bouwgroep van Schijndel Molenbroekloop. De wedstrijd bestaat uit meerdere rondes van 2,5 kilometer door de wijk Molenbroek, waarbij deelnemers kunnen kiezen uit afstanden van 1,1 km (jeugd), 2,5 km (junioren), 2,5 km, 5 km, 7,5 km en 10 km. Start en finish zijn op de atletiekbaan van GAC Gemert. Er zijn ereprijzen voor de beste mannen en vrouwen op de 5 en 10 km en voor de beste jongens en meisjes bij de jeugdlopen. De organisatie draagt bij aan verduurzaming door het gebruik van herbruikbare startnummers die na afloop moeten worden ingeleverd.

name: Rotterdam Half
description: De Rotterdam Half Marathon vindt plaats op zondag 20 september 2026 en start om 09:00 uur bij de Maassilo in Rotterdam. De 21,1 kilometer lange route voert door het authentieke Rotterdam-Zuid, langs iconische plekken zoals Katendrecht, de SS Rotterdam, het havengebied en eindigt spectaculair binnen Rotterdam Ahoy. Het parcours is snel, vlak en officieel gecertificeerd, ideaal voor hardlopers die een snelle tijd willen neerzetten. Na de finish is er een feestelijke afterparty met DJ en diverse faciliteiten voor deelnemers en supporters.

name: Misty Lakes Trail
description: De Misty Lakes Trail is een uitdagende trailrun die plaatsvindt op zondag 20 september 2026 in Gerwen (Nuenen). De routes voeren door prachtige bossen met vele vennetjes en heidestukken, waarbij meer dan 90% van het parcours uit onverharde paden bestaat. De trail kenmerkt zich door korte klimmetjes, slingerende single tracks en het beklimmen van het 'Dak van Brabant', de Gulbergen. De verschillende afstanden bieden voor elk niveau een mooie uitdaging, met een sfeervolle finishlocatie waar bezoekers de lopers kunnen aanmoedigen.

name: 1 v.d. 4 loop Zuiderpark
description: De 1 van de 4 circuit is een hardloopwedstrijd georganiseerd door de Hague Road Runners in het Zuiderpark in Den Haag. Het evenement maakt deel uit van een circuit met meerdere wedstrijden en viert in 2026 het 40-jarig jubileum. De wedstrijd biedt een gezellige en sportieve sfeer voor hardlopers van verschillende niveaus en leeftijden. Het parcours loopt door het mooie Zuiderpark en is geschikt voor zowel beginners als ervaren lopers.

name: Rooise Crosslopen 1e
description: De Rooise Crosslopen 1e is een crossloopwedstrijd die plaatsvindt op zondag 20 september 2026 in Sint-Oedenrode. Het evenement biedt verschillende onderdelen verdeeld naar leeftijdsgroepen, waaronder pupillen, junioren en senioren, met afstanden tot 7,9 km. Voorinschrijving is mogelijk tot en met 19 september 2026. De wedstrijd is geschikt voor lopers van diverse leeftijden en niveaus en vindt plaats in een natuurlijke omgeving in Brabant.

name: Vooruitgangloop
description: De Vooruitgangloop is een hardloopevenement dat plaatsvindt in het prachtige recreatiegebied Oude Veerdam nabij Zuidland. De eerste editie wordt georganiseerd door IJsclub Vooruitgang en biedt een sfeervolle loop door een groen en natuurlijk gebied. De start en finish zijn bij de ijsbaan, met goede bereikbaarheid per fiets en openbaar vervoer. Het evenement is geschikt voor jong en oud, met een kidsrun en een 10 km wedstrijd, en wordt ondersteund door een warming-up en een gezellige sfeer.

name: Voss Løpskarusell 2027, løp 5
description: Voss Running Series 2027 is an inclusive running series for everyone aged 9 and up, with five races throughout the year. The races are held on Mondays, starting at 19:00, except for the fifth race on 20 September, which starts at 18:30. The course is 5 km long, starting and finishing at Voss Sports Ground, and passes through Prestegardsmoen and along the waterfront promenade. This is a friendly recreational race that welcomes both casual runners and competitive runners.
course_highlights: 5 km course starting and finishing at Voss Sports Ground
Route through Prestegardsmoen
Run along the waterfront promenade
additional: A discount is available when registering for all six races before the second race. Registration for all six races opens on 15 November 2026 and closes on 3 May 2027. Registration for individual races is available via eqtiming.no. The races take place on Mondays. Start time: 18:30. Registration takes place online via EQ Timing. You can register for an individual race or get a discount by registering for all six races before the second race.

name: Tien van 't Aogje

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: De inschrijfkosten zijn € 9,50 per afstand bij de voorinschrijving

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: De inschrijfkosten zijn € 9,50 per afstand bij de voorinschrijving

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: De kosten voor de Familieloop bedragen 3 euro

description: De Tien van 't Aogje is a running event in Princenhage, Breda, taking place on 20 September 2026. The event offers 5 km and 10 km races, with a fun family run as an additional event. Race numbers are sent in advance by email, and there is an awards ceremony immediately after each race at the Haagsemarkt. The event attracts many participants and has a maximum capacity for each distance.
course_highlights: 5 km and 10 km races through Princenhage
Awards ceremony immediately after the race at the Haagsemarkt
Fun family run as an additional event
additional: Race numbers are sent by email with additional information. There are two times to collect race numbers. The awards ceremony takes place immediately after each race at the Haagsemarkt. There is a maximum number of participants for each distance. Registration for 2025 is closed; advance registration for 2026 is available until 13 September 2026. The event takes place in Princenhage, Breda, and includes several race distances, with awards ceremonies after each race.

name: Nachtlauf über 7 Meilen und 30. Jedermannlauf über 3,1 Meilen (5 km)
description: The Zonser Night Run offers two exciting races: the 7-mile race and the 5 km fun run. The event takes place in Dormagen-Zons and is known for its unique nighttime atmosphere. The course runs through the historic old town, giving runners a special experience. The race is open to all ages and ability levels and is a popular event in the region.
course_highlights: 7 miles (approx. 11.3 km) through the historic old town of Zons
5 km fun run as a shorter option
Night run with a special atmosphere and lighting
additional: No late registration is possible. The event takes place in the historic old town of Zons. There is an accompanying program and an awards ceremony. Parking and travel information are available on the website. The race takes place at night and offers a special atmosphere. Late registration is not possible. The event is suitable for runners of all levels and offers a great opportunity to experience the historic surroundings.

name: Schülerlauf
description: The Rüppurr Schools’ Students’ Run is a long-standing annual running competition that brings together students from various schools in Karlsruhe. The event has separate categories for girls and boys, and all participants receive certificates and medals. Prizes are awarded for first, second and third place. Registration is through the schools, and late entries are possible on the day of the event. The run takes place around the TUS Rüppurr club grounds and encourages young athletes in the region.

name: Martini Marathon
description: De Martini Marathon in Groningen is een unieke marathon op de atletiekbaan, georganiseerd door Groningen Atletiek. De race vindt plaats op vrijdagavond 25 september 2026 en biedt zowel een solo-marathon van 42,195 meter als een estafette voor teams van 3 tot 5 lopers. De estafette bestaat uit afstanden van 2.195 meter en vier keer 10.000 meter, wat een uitdagende en snelle loopervaring garandeert. De sfeer is gezellig met catering onderweg en na afloop, en alle deelnemers ontvangen een medaille. De winnaars ontvangen de prestigieuze Martini Bokaal.

name: Nedmag Moonlightwalk
description: De Nedmag Moonlightwalk in Veendam is een sfeervolle avondwandeling van circa 6 kilometer die plaatsvindt bij maanlicht. Het evenement is geen wedstrijd, maar een ontspannen wandeling waarbij deelnemers kunnen genieten van diverse optredens en bijzondere belevenissen langs de route. De route is toegankelijk voor bijna iedereen, inclusief rolstoelgebruikers, en biedt een unieke manier om Veendam te beleven. De opbrengst van de wandeling gaat naar het goede doel, dit jaar het Margarethe Hardenberg Cultuurcentrum.

name: DGI Nordjysk Trail Cup 2026/2027 - Lundby Krat Trail
Tour de Fredensborgs efterårsløb i Nivå 2026
Tjurruset
description: Tjurruset is an annual cross-country race in Karlstad, featuring a course of approximately 10 kilometres with both natural and constructed obstacles. The race is known for its muddy, challenging terrain, with water, steep hills and creative obstacles, creating a fun, spectator-friendly festival. In addition to the main race, there are children’s races, Kalvruset and Minikalvruset, with shorter courses and child-friendly obstacles. Tjurruset attracts both experienced cross-country runners and enthusiastic recreational runners, all of whom enjoy a memorable, muddy experience.
course_highlights: Approximately 10 km course with natural and constructed obstacles
Terrain featuring mud, water and steep hills
Spectator-friendly spots near the muddiest and wettest obstacles
additional: Bib distribution starts at 09:00 at Norra fältet. The warm-up starts at approximately 13:45. The race bib and timing chip are handed out together; the chip is attached to the ankle and discarded after the race. Participants should change at home, as there are no changing rooms on site. Medical assistance is available at the finish and along the course. Late registration is available on site until 45 minutes before the start. Food service and Tjurruset tights are available for purchase in the event area. There is a team competition with teams of up to six people, with the five fastest times counting. Participants should be able to run 10 km on road or asphalt in under 90 minutes. The children’s races include Kalvruset, 2.5 km, and Minikalvruset, approximately 200–400 metres.

name: Birken Gateløp 10 km
description: Birken Street Run in Lillehammer is a running festival in the heart of the city, offering distances of 10 km, 5 km and the BarneBirken Street Run. The race is for everyone, whether you’re chasing a personal best, trying your first 5 km race or looking for an active experience with family and friends. Music, cheering crowds and lively support along the course create a festival atmosphere for both fast runners and those taking a more relaxed pace. The start and finish are centrally located at Sigrid Undsets plass, and the 10 km course follows parts of the historic route of the Olympic Dayrun from the 1980s and 90s.
course_highlights: The course runs through central Lillehammer on paved city streets
The 10 km course follows parts of the former Olympic Dayrun route
Music, bands and cheering crowds bring the course to life
additional: Music, bands, drums, majorettes and a DJ create a lively atmosphere along the course. The race welcomes both fast runners and those who prefer a more relaxed pace. BarneBirken Street Run supports a charitable cause by collecting donations for Right To Play. The 10 km distance is open to participants who turn at least 13 in 2027. The course returns to the finish just south of Mesna Bru.

name: Hagemanns rundbaneløp 2027
description: Hagemanns Backyard Festival 2027 is a unique race held on Svelvik Cycling Club’s loop course. The challenge is to complete a 6.7 km loop within one hour, with a start every hour on the hour from 10:00.
