Participants who fail to finish within the time limit are eliminated, and the aim is to be the last one standing. A children’s race is also held, and participants can choose to run a single loop at any time. The festival offers medals for all participants, changing rooms, showers and refreshments. Reflective vests and headlamps are mandatory after 21:00.
course_highlights: 6.7 km loop course, with a start every hour on the hour
Children’s race of approximately 400–500 metres around the school building
Changing rooms and showers at Ebbestadhallen available all weekend
additional: Reflective vests and headlamps are mandatory from 21:00 to 06:00. Pizza is served to participants at 19:30. The kiosk opens at 08:00 and is run by Svelvik Cycling Club. Buying and selling race bibs is possible. Changing rooms and showers at Ebbestadhallen are available all weekend. Children’s races are held on both Saturday and Sunday at 15:05. A children’s race is also held at Ebbestad Primary School. Information about course distance and elevation gain is from the 2025 edition.

name: Nattland Backyard Ultra
description: Nattland Backyard Ultra is a unique ultramarathon held in Bergen, Vestland. The race consists of multiple laps on a set course, with participants running for as long as they can in an effort to be the last one to finish. The event takes place on Saturday, 25 September 2027, and attracts local and international ultrarunners looking for a challenging and social running experience.
course_highlights: The race takes place on a set course repeated every hour
A demanding ultramarathon focused on endurance and tactics
Held in scenic surroundings in Bergen
additional: Registration is via Eqtiming.no. The race takes place on Saturday, 25 September 2027, in Bergen. No specific start times or price details were found on the available pages. Registration via EQTiming.no.

name: Backyard Stavanger Ultra

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Backyard Deltakere kr 750,00 + Adm. gebyr (25 NOK + 3% transaksjonsgebyr)

description: Backyard Stavanger is a unique ultrarunning event held at Dyrsnes Nature Centre in Stavanger. The race consists of a gently undulating loop of approximately 6.7 km, run on the hour every hour, with a maximum of 12 laps in total. Participants must start each lap to continue, and the last person to start wins the race. The event offers a friendly and inclusive atmosphere with a low barrier to entry, welcoming both beginners and experienced ultrarunners. Simple refreshments and places to rest are provided. A headlamp and reflective vest are required for safety.
course_highlights: Gently undulating loop of approximately 6.7 km per lap
Runs start on the hour, with a maximum of 12 laps (80.4 km in total)
Social event with places to rest in a tent and barn
additional: You must bring your own drinking cup, headlamp and reflective vest. Attaching your bib with a race belt is recommended. Simple refreshments include snacks, coffee, tea, broth and water. Support is not permitted indoors or on the course, only in the start/finish area. Everyone who completes 12 laps receives a cup and a wooden medal for the ultradistance (longer than a marathon). Maximum 210 participants. Your own drinking cup, headlamp and reflective vest are mandatory.

name: Gruemila
description: Gruemila is a challenging 10 km race held in Kirkenær as part of the Grue Half Marathon event. The race features technically demanding forest terrain on 6.7 km loops, where participants can compete for the win or finish for a medal and finisher cap. The event also includes a fast, flat half marathon, considered one of Norway’s fastest courses. This is a great race for both competitive and recreational runners looking for a varied and exciting running experience in scenic surroundings.
course_highlights: Technically challenging forest terrain on 6.7 km loops
Medal available for completing a loop
Flat and fast half marathon
additional: The race is run on 6.7 km loops through technically challenging forest terrain, with a new start every hour until only one runner remains. Complete one loop for a medal, or compete for a finisher cap and the win.

name: Neusser Integrationslauf
description: The Neuss Integration Run, organized by DJK RHEINKRAFT Neuss 1914 e.V., takes place on 19 September 2026 at the Ludwig-Wolker-Sportanlage in Neuss. The event celebrates integration in practice, bringing together people of all backgrounds, skin colors and religions, including people with disabilities, to run or walk together. The focus is on community and making a statement for integration, not competition. A colorful program featuring music, children’s activities and food makes the day a celebration for participants and visitors.
course_highlights: An open course for running and walking, with no time pressure
Participants of all ages and backgrounds
A colorful program featuring a bouncy castle, bull riding and music
additional: The run is open to people of all ages, backgrounds, skin colors and religions, including people with disabilities. There are no rankings; the focus is on fun and community. The program offers a range of activities for participants and visitors, including a bouncy castle, bull riding, children’s activities, music and culinary specialties. The event takes place at the Ludwig-Wolker-Sportanlage and is part of SportWoche für Alle 2026, which features inclusive sports activities and taster sessions.

name: Schottener Stauseelauf
description: The Schotten Reservoir Run is organized by TGV Schotten, the largest sports club in the Vogelsberg region. The event gives runners the opportunity to compete on varied courses around the reservoir. The run is part of the club’s extensive sports program, which also includes numerous major running events. Participants and visitors are warmly welcome to enjoy the sporting atmosphere and beautiful scenery.
course_highlights: Running routes around the Schotten Reservoir
Varied terrain in the Vogelsberg region
Organized by an experienced sports club with professional timing
additional: Registration, results and certificates are provided through the club’s own timing service, "TGV SportStar". TGV Schotten is a large sports club with more than 1,300 members and organizes other major events in running and other disciplines in addition to the Reservoir Run. The race is known for its fast, flat course and attracts runners from across the region. Registration is available on the official website, and the event is a popular opportunity for recreational and competitive runners to improve their personal bests.

name: Appelhülsener Landlauf
location: Appelhülsener Landlauf, Nottuln-Appelhülsen, North Rhine-Westphalia, Germany
description: The Appelhülsener Landlauf on September 26, 2026, is a family-friendly running event in the beautiful Münsterland, offering distances for all age groups. The officially measured 5 km and 10 km races are eligible for rankings and combine Westphalian charm with rural scenery. Refreshment stations and a varied selection in the finish area ensure participants are well catered for. The event is part of the Westmünsterland Running Series and offers a welcoming atmosphere for runners and walkers.
course_highlights: Officially measured 5 km and 10 km courses, eligible for rankings
Water stations every 2.5 km
Start and finish area with changing and shower facilities at the sports center
additional: Race packets can be collected at the sports center from 13:00 on race day. Timing is provided by Race-Result using a reusable chip attached to the race bib, which is collected at the finish. Changing and shower facilities are available directly in the start/finish area. The first three male and female finishers in the 5 km and 10 km races will receive awards. All participants in the Bambini and schoolchildren’s races will receive a medal. Nordic walking is untimed, with no awards ceremony. Certificates and results are available online; certificate printing is offered at race-bib collection. Parking is available at Marienplatz 15, 48301 Nottuln. The courses are officially measured. Online registration is open until 24.09.2026; late registration is available on site for a fee. Race packets can be collected from 13:00 on race day. Parking is available at Marienplatz 15, Nottuln.

name: Bahnstreckenlauf
location: Zinhaine, Bad Marienberg, Westerwaldkreis, Rhineland-Palatinate, Germany
description: The Wäller Bahnstreckenlauf in Bad Marienberg is a new running event starting in 2025. From 2026, it will also count as a scoring race for the Wäller-Lauf-Cup. The course is an out-and-back route along the cycle path between Langenbach bei Bad-Marienberg and Nistertal. The start and finish are on Zinhainer Weg, above the Rübsamen company, with a nearby parking lot for participants. The event is organized by TuS Bad-Marienberg Leichtathletik and offers runners an attractive course in the region.
course_highlights: Out-and-back route along the cycle path between Langenbach and Nistertal
Start and finish on Zinhainer Weg, above the Rübsamen company
Parking available right by the start and finish
additional: The event is part of the Wäller-Lauf-Cup from 2026. Certificates and individual results are available online. The course is an out-and-back route on a cycle path, suggesting a flat, fast course. The event offers various age categories and distances.

name: Halveraner Herbstlauf
location: Innenstadt von Halver, Märkischer Kreis, North Rhine-Westphalia, Germany
description: The Halver Autumn Run takes place annually on the last weekend in September in Halver town centre. Organised by SSV Halver together with LGHS, the event offers races for toddlers and schoolchildren, as well as a relay for recreational runners. The main event is a 4 x 900-metre relay with two categories (U100 and Ü100). The event has been a fixture on the local running calendar for over 20 years and takes runners right through Halver city centre.
course_highlights: Relay race with 4 x 900-metre laps
The course runs through Halver town centre
Separate races for toddlers, schoolchildren and youth
additional: Late entries are possible online or at the race office up to 45 minutes before the respective race start. A fee of €1.50 (online) or €2 (race office) applies to entries on the day of the event. Toilets, showers and changing facilities are available at Lindenhof School. The roads will be closed for the race from 12:00. All participants receive a medal; the top three in each age group also receive medals and certificates. Relay race, 4 x 900 m, in Halver town centre, age categories U100 / Ü100

name: Volksbank-Citylauf Telgte
description: The 19th Volksbank-Citylauf Telgte takes place on September 26, 2026, and offers a varied program for runners of all ages. The routes pass through the historic town center, along the Ems and through the surrounding countryside, vividly reflecting the motto “Town, Country and River.” In addition to the 10,000-meter main race, there are other events, including a 5,000-meter race, walking, children’s and Bambini races, and an untimed fun run. The event is suitable for competitive runners, recreational runners and families, and is organized by TV Friesen Telgte e.V.
course_highlights: 10,000-meter main race through the historic town center, the Ems floodplains and the countryside
5,000-meter race with a water station halfway along the course
Varied routes featuring asphalt, a tartan track, paved paths and natural trails
additional: Late entries are possible up to 30 minutes before the respective start, with a €2 late-entry fee (for the Bambini race, charged once per family or group). Changing facilities are available at the old double gymnasium at the school center, close to the start and finish. Medals, trophies and certificates are awarded in various events and age groups. The course is varied, with asphalt, a tartan track, paved paths and natural trails. Photos and video recordings will be taken and published. The start and finish are at the school center sports field; registration is online; changing facilities are at the Old Double Gymnasium; children’s races are not timed.

name: Weezer Staffellauf
description: The Weeze relay race has been held in Weeze in mid-September each year since 1985 and has become a popular relay event, with up to 250 teams taking part. The course follows a scenic 5 km loop along the Niers hiking trail. The event offers various relay categories, including Bambini, school, and regular relays, and attracts runners of all ages. The athletics department of TSV Weeze organizes the event with great dedication and looks forward to welcoming many participants in 2026.
course_highlights: 5 km loop along the Niers hiking trail
Relay event with Bambini, school, and regular relay categories
Held annually in mid-September since 1985
additional: The 40th Weeze relay race will take place on 26 September 2026. The race announcement and registration will follow at the end of July. The event has attracted up to 250 relay teams. The 38th Weeze relay race in 2024 had 32 Bambini teams, 36 school relay teams, and 55 regular relay teams cross the finish line. Participants can register online until the end of July 2026; the event also includes school and community competitions, as well as on-site refreshments.

name: Herbstcross des SSV-MG-Ahlsdorf / 2. Peter Zinke Gedenklauf
Kreuzhorst Ultra
description: The Kreuzhorst Ultra (KRHU) is a family-friendly backyard ultra in Magdeburg-Kreuzhorst, taking place for the third time on September 26, 2026. The 6.7 km course starts again every full hour, and participants run as many laps as they can or wish to. The race is a private invitation-only event focused on community, passion, and the joy of running. The course runs mostly along forest and field paths with no significant climbs, and there are classifications for distances of 53 km, 100 km, and 160 km.

name: VR-Bank Mitte Herbstlauf in Dingelstädt
description: The VR-Bank Mitte Autumn Run in Dingelstädt is a versatile running event taking place on September 26, 2026. It offers courses for all ability levels, from a children’s race for the youngest participants to a half marathon that passes through the impressive 1,530-meter-long Küllstedt Tunnel. The flat, fast courses are measured to DLV/IAAF standards and are ideal for personal bests. The Autumn Run is part of the Eichsfeld Cup and the TLV Running Cup and also hosts the Thuringian State Road Running Championships.

name: Bergzeitlauf Brockenheroes 2026
description: The BROCKENHEROES mountain time trial and mountain race is a challenging individual time trial in the Harz, taking place on September 26, 2026, in Schierke. Participants compete on a range of courses of up to 24 km and up to 900 meters of elevation gain, including road cycling, mountain biking, unicycling, running, roller skiing, and Nordic walking. The event offers a unique challenge against the clock, the mountain, and oneself, starting on Brockenstraße and finishing on the Brocken plateau. The atmosphere is defined by sporting ambition and the impressive natural scenery of the Harz.

name: Böckstiegellauf
description: The Böckstiegellauf is a scenic race through the Teutoburg Forest and the Ravensberg Hills, running from Peter auf’m Berge in Bielefeld to the center of Werther. Distances include 18 km and 10 km, as well as a 2.5 km schoolchildren’s race. The course partly follows the Hermannslauf and passes the Böckstiegelhaus and the Böckstiegel Museum. The event is very well organized, with a shuttle bus from the finish to the start and an awards ceremony in the center of Werther.

name: Cloppenburger Citylauf
organizer: Stadt Cloppenburg, Lauftreff des SV Bethen
description: The Cloppenburg City Run is a popular running event held as part of the Cloppenburg City Festival, which takes place annually on the last weekend in September. The main race starts at the Red School on the market square and runs along Eschstraße to Rathausplatz. In addition to the main race, there is a relay competition in which teams of four each complete a course of approximately 1,000 metres four times. The event is organised by the running group of SV Bethen e. V. and overseen by the NLV district of Cloppenburg.

name: Drei-Täler-Lauf
description: The 3-Täler-Lauf, organized by TV Mettingen 1930 e.V., takes place on September 26, 2026, and takes participants along varied routes through the three valleys of Fahlbachtal, Ölmühlental and Köllbachtal in the Tecklenburger Land. The 14.1 km main race features challenging, hilly terrain and impressive views of Querenberg, Schafberg and Schniederberg. There is also an 8.3 km 2-Täler-Lauf and a Nordic walking option for beginners and experienced athletes alike. Children are warmly welcome to take part in an 800 m schoolchildren’s race and a 400 m Bambini run, where fun takes center stage. The event is family-friendly and offers timing with a disposable chip, as well as showers and changing rooms at Ludgeri-Schule.

name: Hohenlockstedter Pellkartoffellauf
description: The Hohenlockstedter Pellkartoffellauf is a long-standing running event that has been held annually on the Pohl-Boskamp grounds since 2002. With distances of 2.8 km, 5 km and 10 km, the race offers a suitable challenge for both beginners and experienced runners. The event is especially family-friendly, with special Bambini runs for children and a varied program featuring games, a food mile and entertainment. It promotes a sense of community and the joy of being active, and welcomes individuals, school classes, teams and companies.

name: Hotfoot Run Warstein
description: The Hotfoot Run Warstein is a spectacular obstacle race on September 26, 2026, with distances ranging from 5 km (Family Edition) to 20 km, making it suitable for all fitness levels and age groups. The course crosses the Montgolfiade grounds and the ski slope, and passes through the quarry, with plenty of muddy obstacles, water slides, and foam. The event features an exciting start show and a unique atmosphere, and has promoted team spirit and fun since 2007. Whether you’re a fitness enthusiast, part of a fun-loving group, or with your family, everyone can enjoy an unforgettable adventure here in NRW.

name: Höhlerfestlauf
description: The 11th Höhlerfest Run on September 26, 2026, in Gera offers a varied running event with routes for all ages and ability levels. New this year is the 22 km cross-country run with obstacles and 420 m of elevation gain, which passes through the Stadtwald and Hofwiesenpark. In addition to classic distances from 0.8 km to 12 km, there are walking and handicap routes, as well as the popular parent-child run for preschoolers. The event stands out for its special atmosphere, with live music and a family-friendly feel, supported by the City of Gera.

name: Lauf Rund um den Grengel
description: The Rund um den Grengel Run is a traditional fun run in Engelskirchen, held annually by VfL Engelskirchen e.V., Athletics & Triathlon Department. The event offers various distances, including a Bambini run, schoolchildren’s races, a 5 km fun run and a 10 km main race, some of which are held as municipal championships. The course is flat and runs over a sports field, roads and forest paths; it has been measured by the German Athletics Association (DLV). Its family-friendly atmosphere and inclusion of children and young people make the run a special event for all age groups.

name: Oldersumer Appel-Loop
description: The Oldersum Appel-Loop is a popular race that passes through Oldersum’s picturesque parks, along the Rorichumer Tief canal, and through the “alte Seilerei” museum. The course finishes in the apple park, where the Oldersum Apple Market is also taking place and refreshments are available. In addition to the main 5 km and 10 km races, there is a 5 km walking route and 800 m children’s races for various age groups. The race is part of the Ostfriesische 7 running series and offers a lovely atmosphere for runners of all ages.

name: R5K Berlin
description: The R5K Tour Final 2026 is a youth race held as part of the BMW BERLIN-MARATHON, where ambitious runners aged 12 to 22 can compare their 5 km times. The final in Berlin is part of a series of three races, with times added together to determine the overall winners in the U20 and U23 age groups. Alongside the sporting challenge, attractive prize money and training camp grants are available for the top participants. The event supports young athletes and offers a thrilling platform for emerging running talent.

name: Schelder Berglauf
description: The Schelder Berglauf is a challenging mountain run in Dillenburg, held annually by ASC Dillenburg. The course passes through varied terrain with steep climbs, offering runners an athletic challenge in a natural setting. The event attracts both competitive and recreational runners and is a regular fixture on the regional running calendar.

name: Nocna Piątka 2026
location: Polsat Plus Arena Gdańsk, Gdańsk, Poland
description: Nocna Piątka is a unique 5-kilometer race taking place on September 26, 2026, in Gdańsk, the day before the Garmin Gdańsk Half Marathon. The start and finish are located on the illuminated pitch of Polsat Plus Arena Gdańsk, where participants can expect a spectacular show featuring lasers, music, and lighting effects. The course winds through the city, with cheering points featuring music and fire shows creating a one-of-a-kind nighttime atmosphere. This new edition of the well-known half-marathon companion race has been moved to Saturday evening to offer runners and spectators a special experience.

name: Kołobrzeska Odyseja
description: Kołobrzeska Odyseja ’26 is a series of three exceptional races held in Kołobrzeg, combining passion, strength, and a seaside atmosphere. The event offers races over 5 km, half-marathon, marathon, and 10 km distances. The courses are certified by the PZLA, and participants can look forward to generous race packs, a finisher zone with a hot meal and drinks, and valuable prizes. It’s a great opportunity to feel the energy of the seaside and become part of a new running tradition in Kołobrzeg.

name: VIII Bieg Szlakiem Kolejowym
location: Czerwona Woda, Gmina Węgliniec, Lower Silesian Voivodeship, Poland

name: 42e Halve van Katwijk
location: Duinplein, Katwijk aan Zee, Katwijk, South Holland, Netherlands
distance_verbose: Halve marathon, 15 km, 10 km, 5 km, 3000 meter, 2 km, 1 km, 0.5 km
description: The 42nd edition of the Halve van Katwijk takes place on September 26, 2026, and is a popular running and walking festival along the coast. The event is known for its sporty, welcoming atmosphere and beautiful course, which starts and finishes at Duinplein in front of the lighthouse on Katwijk Boulevard. The Halve van Katwijk offers several distances for runners, walkers and children, and attracts many participants each year who enjoy the unique surroundings and friendly atmosphere. The organizers are continually working to improve the event and give everyone an unforgettable day.
course_highlights: Start and finish at Duinplein, right in front of the lighthouse on Katwijk Boulevard
Refreshment stations at Vriezenwei, Panbos and Wassenaarse Slag
Various courses with GPX files available, including special Kidsrun routes
additional: Start and Finish Village at Duinplein with changing facilities, toilets, activities and massage. No on-the-day registration is available. Parking garage on the Boulevard and alternative parking garages nearby. No supervised bicycle parking is available. Business Run with its own start pen, group photo, souvenir and networking drinks afterwards. GPX files for all routes are available. The event also includes a Kidsrun and Business Run; registration is popular and often closes early due to high demand.

name: Thaisner DörpsRun
distance_verbose: Marathon, Halve marathon, 10 km, 6.4 km, 5 km, 1.2 km, 0.6 km

name: De 5 van Bavel
description: De 5 van Bavel is een jaarlijks hardloopevenement in ’t Klooster, Bavel, dat in 2026 haar 10e jubileumeditie viert. Het evenement biedt een gezellige en sportieve dag voor jong en oud met verschillende afstanden, waaronder een 5 km wedstrijd, een 10 km trimloop en een kidsrun. De start en finish zijn centraal gelegen in de Kloosterstraat bij Café-zaal ’t Karrewiel. De 5 van Bavel zet zich ook in voor een goed doel, namelijk onderzoek naar neuro-endocriene tumoren (NET).

name: Run for Hope
description: Run for Hope is een inspirerende hardloopwedstrijd die plaatsvindt op 26 september 2026 in de Dordtse Biesbosch. Deelnemers kunnen kiezen uit afstanden van 5, 10 of 21,1 kilometer en lopen om geld in te zamelen voor cliënten van De Hoop, die ondersteuning krijgen bij het opbouwen van een nieuw leven. De run staat in het teken van hoop en saamhorigheid, waarbij lopers worden aangemoedigd door supporters en samen een bijdrage leveren aan een maatschappelijk doel. Het evenement combineert sportiviteit met een betekenisvolle inzet voor anderen.

name: Spanderswoud Trailrun
description: De Spanderswoud Trailrun is een ontspannen trailrun door het prachtige Spanderswoud en omliggende natuurgebieden in het Gooi. De routes van 10, 20 en 30 km voeren je over kronkelende bospaden, singletracks en open heidevelden, zonder wedstrijdelement of tijdsdruk. De start en finish zijn bij het bezoekerscentrum van Natuurmonumenten op Landgoed Boekesteyn in ’s-Graveland. Er zijn verzorgingsposten onderweg en na afloop kun je genieten van een hapje en drankje bij Café-Restaurant Brambergen.

name: Crob Run
description: De Crob Run is een hardloopevenement in Haaften dat plaatsvindt op 26 september 2026. Het biedt een prachtige loop over de dijken rondom Haaften en de natuur langs de Waal, geschikt voor jong en oud. Er zijn verschillende afstanden, waaronder kidsruns voor kinderen van 5 tot 12 jaar, en 5 km en 10 km voor volwassenen. Het evenement staat bekend om zijn gezellige sfeer met muziek, eetgelegenheden en een bar, en een deel van de opbrengst gaat naar een goed doel.

name: Hill Repeat Madness: 4-uurs trailrunchallenge
description: Hill Repeat Madness is een uitdagende 4-uurs trailrunchallenge die plaatsvindt op Landgoed Gulbergen in Nuenen. Deze trailrun daagt lopers uit om hun uithoudingsvermogen en snelheid te testen op een gevarieerd parcours in een natuurlijke omgeving. De organisatie wordt verzorgd door Trailrunners Brabant, die bekend staan om hun passie voor trailrunning en het creëren van een sportieve en gezellige sfeer. De race is ideaal voor trailrunners die houden van een intensieve en dynamische loopervaring.

name: Mission Run
description: De MissionRun 2026 vindt plaats op zaterdag 26 september in Scherpenzeel en biedt hardloop- en wandelroutes van 5, 10 en 20 km, inclusief een halve marathon voor deelnemers van 18 jaar en ouder. Het parcours voert door het natuurrijke buitengebied van Scherpenzeel, over bospaden en rustige landweggetjes, en is geschikt voor zowel ervaren hardlopers als recreanten en wandelaars. De opbrengst van het evenement gaat volledig naar International Justice Mission, ter ondersteuning van de Muskathlon van Anne & Dianne. De start en finish zijn bij Oud Willaer 74, met tijdregistratie via MyLaps voor de hardloopafstanden.

name: Zevenheuvelentrail & NK Trailrunning
description: De Zevenheuvelentrail & NK Trailrunning vindt plaats in de bosrijke en heuvelachtige omgeving rondom Nijmegen. De trail biedt uitdagende routes met steile beklimmingen, lastige afdalingen en onverharde paden door natuurgebieden zoals de Nijmeegse heuvelrug en Landgoed van Jurgens. Het NK Trailrunning bestaat uit een korte trail van 28 kilometer en een lange trail van 56 kilometer, waarbij atleten met een Atletiekunie licentie strijden om de Nederlandse titel. De organisatie zorgt voor een sfeervol evenement met verzorgingsposten en een professionele aanpak.

name: Roldertoren Run
description: De Roldertorenrun is een hardloopevenement in en rond Rolde met drie afstanden: halve marathon, 10 km en 5 km. De halve marathon voert je door het prachtige Drentse landschap met heidevelden, grafheuvels, beekjes en oude karrensporen, en eindigt bij de Jacobuskerk. De 10 km is geschikt voor geoefende lopers en loopt deels over het Balloërveld en het Wandelspoor. De 5 km is een snelle, volledig verharde route met uitzicht op het Balloërveld en een single track terug naar de finish bij de toren. De start en finish zijn bij de Roldertoren.

name: Schoklandloop
description: De Schoklandloop is een unieke hardloopwedstrijd georganiseerd door AV NOP in samenwerking met Het Flevo-landschap en Museum Schokland. De loop vindt plaats op het prachtige Werelderfgoed Schokland en combineert natuur, cultuur en sport op een uitdagend parcours. De 10 km route voert over het hele eiland Schokland, terwijl de 5 km route over het Zuidereiland gaat. Start en finish zijn op Middelbuurt 2 te Schokland. Deelnemers ontvangen een aandenken, tijdsregistratie en een consumptie bij Restaurant Schokland.

name: Gelderse Poort Ultra
description: De Gelderse Poort Ultra is een uitdagende trail van 50 kilometer die de Dutch Ultra Series waardig afsluit. De route voert door de prachtige uiterwaarden rond Nijmegen, de bossen richting Berg en Dal en de karakteristieke landerijen ertussen. Met tussen de 700 en 1000 hoogtemeters, technische paden en een afwisselend landschap van klompenpaden, heide en bossen, biedt deze ultra een bijzondere natuurbelevenis. De start is bij Hotel Restaurant Oortjeshekken in Ooij, waar deelnemers na afloop kunnen genieten van een smaakvol diner en eventueel kunnen overnachten.

name: Groot Boeschoten Trail
description: De Groot Boeschoten Trail vindt plaats op zaterdag 26 september 2026 in Voorthuizen, met start en finish bij Camping De Zanderij. De routes zijn volledig vernieuwd en bieden een afwisselend parcours over de Veluwe met bos, heide, zandwegen en historische landgoederen. Het parcours voert langs open heidevelden, akkers en bossen richting Speuld, Huinen en Garderen, met historische schaapskooien als herkenningspunt en verzorgingspost. De routes zijn circa 99% offroad en worden duidelijk gemarkeerd, met luxe verzorgingsposten onderweg. Voor de kinderen is er een speciale Kids Trail met medaille en toegang tot het zwembad.

name: Loddefjordløpet
description: Loddefjordløpet is held at Alvøen Sports Park in Bergen and is an annual race featuring distances including a 5 km and children’s races of 2 km or 600 metres. It is a popular event for both children and adults, with a focus on athletics and recreational running in a welcoming atmosphere. Loddefjord IL Friidrett, which organises the race, also offers a range of training activities for children and young people in the area. For the latest information, follow the race’s Facebook page.
course_highlights: 5 km course in Alvøen Sports Park
Children’s races of 2 km and 600 metres
Held in scenic surroundings in western Bergen
additional: Loddefjordløpet includes both a 5 km race and children’s races over shorter distances. The organiser is Loddefjord IL Friidrett, which also offers athletics training for children and young people. Historical results from previous years are available on the website. Previous editions have offered free children’s races for pupils in grades 1–4, with a medal for participants. Information about the 2027 edition is not provided in the sources.

name: Norgesløpet 2027
description: Norgesløpet 2027 is held as a road race at Jessheim Stadium, with distances of 5 km (Norwegian Championships) and 10 km. The race starts on Kanalveien and finishes inside Jessheim Athletics Stadium. Registration is available in an elite start wave, and pacers are provided for the most popular finish times. The event also includes children’s races with multiple waves for different age groups, creating an enjoyable day with a great atmosphere for the whole family.
course_highlights: Start and finish at Jessheim Athletics Stadium
Course along Kanalveien marked with red and white ribbons
Water stations at approximately 5 km and at the finish
additional: Race bibs can be collected at Jessheim Ice and Multi-Use Hall. Bag storage is available with a baggage tag. Toilets and changing rooms are located in several nearby buildings. Train travel is recommended, with several parking areas nearby. Pacers run with visible flags or T-shirts. Children’s races are held at 11:30 and 14:00, with waves grouped by age. Fantorangen and the NRK Super Bus will be there for families. Children’s races are also held. Race bibs can be collected at Jessheim Ice and Multi-Use Hall. Train travel is recommended; parking costs 50 NOK via Vipps.

name: Skoppums Råeste 2027
price_range: 200–400 kr for 10–16 år; 350–550 kr for øvrige deltakere, lisens kan komme i tillegg

tiers.description: Earlybird ut 2026: Kr. 200,- fra 10 opp til og med 16 år

tiers.label: tier_2
tiers.description: Ved påmelding fra 1. janur 2027 til 31. august 2027: Kr. 300

description: Skoppums Råeste is a challenging and fun obstacle-course trail race suitable for everyone, from beginners to experienced OCR runners. The race takes place at Skoppum Idrettsplass and features mud obstacles, climbing over car wrecks, water crossings, muddy streams, tire obstacles, and crawling zones. Participants can choose to run 2.5 km with approximately 15–20 obstacles, or double the distance to 5 km by completing an extra lap. The race is accessible to all and includes timing, but everyone who finishes receives a medal and is considered a winner. There is also a separate MiniRåeste for children under 10, with a shorter obstacle course.
course_highlights: Obstacle-course trail featuring mud obstacles, climbing over car wrecks, and water crossings
Approximately 2.5 km course with 15–20 obstacles; participants can run 5 km by completing two laps
Accessible race with timing and a medal for all participants
additional: Race registration opens at 10:00 for bib pickup. Skoppums MiniRåeste for children under 10 starts at 11:00. Participants can choose a start group based on an expected lap time of under or over 30 minutes. Changing rooms and washing facilities are available, as is a kiosk that accepts payment via Vipps. Parking costs NOK 50 and is paid via Vipps. All participants receive a medal. The course can be walked before the start, but obstacles must not be tested. Timing and medals are provided. Start groups are divided by expected lap time: under or over 30 minutes. The prices found apply to 2027 registration on the page for the 2026 event.

name: 14. Bahrs-Kartoffellauf
description: The 14th Bahrs Potato Run 2026 in Jembke offers runners a varied program with three distances: the 10 km Bahrs Run, the 5 km Potato Run, and an 800 m children’s run. The event takes place on September 27, 2026, and is known for its family-friendly atmosphere, culinary delights, and a colorful program featuring performances by the Jembke Cheerleaders. Race bibs must be returned after the run, and there is no on-site registration. The event is part of the running cup and offers not only sporting challenges but also a chance to socialize over a generous cake buffet and savory dishes.
course_highlights: 10 km course on Komoot
5 km course on Komoot
800 m children’s run
additional: Start times: 10 km Bahrs Run at 10:30, 5 km Potato Run at 12:00, and 800 m children’s run at 13:15. No on-site registration; advance registration only. Race bibs must be returned after the run. Food and drink include potato soup, veggie bowls, potato pancakes with applesauce, burgers, bratwurst, shashlik, and rosemary potatoes. Performances by the Jembke Cheerleaders at approximately 11:45 and 13:00. Award ceremonies take place after the respective races. The event is known for its friendly atmosphere, diverse running options for all age groups, and the opportunity to combine the run with a social gathering.

name: Asse-Volkslauf und Nordic Walking
description: The Asse Run and Nordic Walking event organised by TSV "Vater Jahn" Wittmar is held annually and will take place for the 34th time on 27 September 2026. The event is very popular, with record participation last year. It offers various running and walking routes in the beautiful surroundings of Wittmar and is open to athletes of all ages. Registration opens at the end of June. Late entries are possible up to 30 minutes before the respective start, except for the kindergarten run.
course_highlights: Route distances: 0.3 km and 10.6 km
Nordic walking included
Venue: Wittmar, Germany
additional: Late entries are possible up to 30 minutes before the respective start, except for the kindergarten run. Registration opens at the end of June; detailed information is available in the official race announcement. The event includes running and Nordic walking events.

name: Schusterlauf
description: The Schusterlauf Preetz is a long-standing running event with various distances, taking place on September 27, 2026, in Preetz. The challenging 16 km course leads through forests and meadows and along Lake Lanker, and requires good to very good fitness. Alongside the main race, there are shorter distances, including the Bambini Run for children and the Kirchsee and Wehrberg runs. The event is part of the ZIPPEL’S Kiel.Cup, where participants can earn points toward the overall standings.
course_highlights: 16 km course through forests and meadows and along Lake Lanker
Good, firm-footed trails in the Wehrberg and along the shores of Lake Kirchsee
Challenging course with a changeover point at Gut Wahlstorf
additional: Race number collection is available the day before the event (19:00–20:00) and on race day from 08:00 at the Alte Wilhelminenhalle, Schulstraße 2, 24211 Preetz. Participation in the ZIPPEL’S Kiel.Cup, including points scoring, is automatic. Race number changes are not possible. New service: Bags can be dropped off in a truck on the Marktplatz near the finish. GPX files for the 5 km and 16 km courses are available to download. Courses are available as GPX files; online registration; start and finish in Preetz; bag drop-off service and results downloads.

name: Bergkloster-Lauf
description: The Bergklosterlauf, organized by TuS Velmede-Bestwig in cooperation with Bergkloster Bestwig, takes place on September 27, 2026, in the Sauerland. The 6, 10 and 21-kilometer races pass idyllic streams, run along ridges with magnificent views and through smaller settlements before finishing at Bergkloster Bestwig. In addition to the races, there are children’s and youth races, plus a supporting program featuring live music, childcare, free massages and extensive catering. The event is also part of the Volksbank Sauerland Laufcup organized by LAC Veltins Hochsauerland. The start and finish are easy to reach and offer ample parking, as well as affordable accommodation at Bergkloster.
course_highlights: Routes pass idyllic streams
Ridges with magnificent viewpoints
Finish at Bergkloster Bestwig
additional: Free massages are offered after the finish. Childcare is available for “running parents.” The start and finish are just 600 meters apart and are easy to reach by bus, train or car. There are 500 parking spaces nearby, including spaces for motorhomes. Affordable accommodation is available at Bergkloster. The 10-kilometer race is also open to walkers. The children’s and youth races start at 12:00. The 10-kilometer race and the children’s and youth races are scoring events for the Volksbank Sauerland Laufcup. Routes of 6, 10 and 21 km; children’s and youth races; registration via Race Result; parking and accommodation at Bergkloster; route maps on Outdooractive

name: Bickendorfer Büdchenlauf
description: The Bickendorfer Büdchenlauf is an atmospheric race through the Cologne neighborhood of Bickendorf, offering an extensive selection of different running events so there is a suitable distance for everyone. The event delights competitive runners as well as children and recreational runners. The start and finish are on Venloer Straße in Cologne-Bickendorf. In addition to the sporting event, participants and visitors can enjoy a varied program featuring food and drink stalls, exhibitors, and music.
course_highlights: Race through the Cologne neighborhood of Bickendorf
Start and finish on Venloer Straße in Cologne-Bickendorf
Varied program featuring food and drink and music
additional: The event grounds offer a varied program featuring food and drink stalls, exhibitors, and music. The race offers different events for all ages and ability levels. Various distances, including children’s and dog races; registration opens on February 14; a traditional neighborhood race in Cologne-Bickendorf

name: Volkslauf durch das schöne Alstertal
description: The Volkslauf through the beautiful Alstertal takes place on 27 September 2026 in Hamburg and offers runners an appealing natural route along the hiking trails in the upper reaches of the Alster. The event includes various distances, from the half marathon to 10 km and 4 km, as well as fun runs for children. The route stands out for its natural setting in the heart of Hamburg, with a few small climbs and stairs. The event is part of the 27th Hamburg Laufcup and offers a family-friendly atmosphere, with refreshments and medical care.

name: 52. BMW Berlin-Marathon
description: The BMW BERLIN-MARATHON is one of the largest and most prestigious marathon events in the world and is part of the Abbott World Marathon Majors. The course is known for its flat terrain and takes runners past Berlin’s most beautiful landmarks. In addition to the classic marathon, the event offers a 5-kilometer race, inline skating races, and various ways to take part through charity, tour operators, or running camps. The event is distinguished by its unique energy and international running community.

name: Northeimer Stadtlauf
description: The Northeim City Run is a long-standing running event held in the city of Northeim. The races start and finish at Münsterplatz, a central location in the city. The event is organized by Kreis Sportbund Northeim-Einbeck e.V. and offers a sporting event for runners of all ages. It takes place on September 27, 2026, and includes various race routes through the city.

name: Auricher Spendenlauf
description: The Aurich Charity Run is a charitable running event benefiting various organizations, including Leukin e.V. and the Sandhorst Volunteer Fire Department. The races take place around the Energy Experience Center in Aurich and offer competitions for all age groups, from a children’s race to main races over 5 and 10 kilometers. The event is known for its family-friendly atmosphere and the support of numerous volunteers and sponsors. Award ceremonies take place soon after the races, and certificates are available online.

name: Kienberglauf
description: The Kienberglauf is a traditional running event organized by SV 08 Oehrenstock e.V. and held annually on the last Sunday in September. The event offers various competitions for different age groups and ability levels, including Nordic walking, children’s races, and distances from 2 to 16 kilometers. The course runs through the scenic surroundings of Oehrenstock near Ilmenau and is a highlight of club life. The fastest runners receive trophies, and all participants receive a certificate.

name: Kleeblattultra (100-Meilen-Lauf)
description: The Kleeblattultra is a challenging 100-mile ultramarathon in Schwarme, Lower Saxony, that passes through three districts. The event was conceived with the idea of establishing the first 100-mile race in northern Germany. Organized by TSV Schwarme and a dedicated four-person team, the race offers experienced ultrarunners a unique opportunity to take on a special challenge. The course consists of four cloverleaf loops of 25 miles each, run consecutively. The event places emphasis on professional organization, with timing, live tracking, and aid stations.

name: Marner Kohltagelauf
description: The Marner Cabbage Day Run is a long-standing race in Dithmarschen and an official part of the Dithmarschen Cup and the Dithmarscher Company Cup. The event offers a range of distances, from 400 metres for children to 10 kilometres for adults. The courses are traffic-free, clearly marked, and have markers at every kilometre. Refreshments are available along the course and at the finish, and timing is provided professionally using a chip attached to the race number. The event takes place in almost any weather and offers changing and shower facilities at the Marne swimming pool.

name: Nordahl Grieg Gedenklauf
organizer: Förderverein der Maxim-Gorki-Gesamtschule mit gymnasialer Oberstufe Kleinmachnow
description: The Nordahl Grieg Memorial Run is a long-standing running competition in Kleinmachnow, taking place on September 27, 2026, at Maxim Gorki Comprehensive School. The event offers various competitions for Bambini, schoolchildren, young people, and adults on circuits around the school and Lake Kleinmachnow. All participants can enjoy drinks and refreshments in the finish area and receive medals after crossing the finish line. The event is organized by the Friends of Maxim Gorki Comprehensive School and is held under the patronage of the Norwegian Ambassador and the Mayor of Kleinmachnow.

name: Bleckeder Storchenlauf
description: The 1st Bleckede Stork Run takes place on September 27, 2026, and offers runners and walkers various race distances in the great outdoors around the sports field in Bleckede. The routes pass through wooded areas and open spaces with small to medium-sized hills, providing varied running conditions. Bib numbers and chips must be collected 30 minutes before the respective start. The event is organized by VfL Bleckede von 1862 e. V. and is open to participants of all ages, including a Bambini run for the youngest children.

name: City-Lauf Lübeck
description: The City Run Lübeck 2026 takes place on September 27 and offers a varied program for runners of all ages. Events include a bambinilauf, school races, unicycle races, a 5 km run and walking event, and the 10 km main race. The routes pass through Lübeck’s city center, with current construction work taken into account to ensure attractive and safe running routes. The City Run is open to everyone, including those who are not members of a club, and offers team rankings and a friendly atmosphere for recreational and competitive runners.

name: Crosslauf Friedrichsruh mit Kreismeisterschaft
description: The Friedrichsruh Cross-Country Run with District Championships is a cross-country event in Geestland, Germany, held at the Sportzentrum Nordeschweg. The event is organized by TV Langen von 1908 e.V. and offers various distances, from 0.5 km for the youngest participants up to 25 km. In addition to the district championship races for children, young people, and adults, there are also open supporting races over distances from 2.5 km to 10 km. The event is characterized by a friendly club atmosphere and a focused local running event.

name: Crosslauf und Nordic Walking in Birkenwerder
description: The Cross-Country Run & Nordic Walking event in Birkenwerder takes place on Sunday, 27 September 2026, and is organised by SV Grün-Weiß Birkenwerder e.V. Several race distances are offered, ranging from 400 m to 8.6 km, as well as a Nordic walking competition, in which the use of poles is mandatory. The event is open to various age groups, from Bambini to seniors. All participants receive a printable certificate, and medals are awarded to places 1 to 3. Registration is online, with a limit of 500 entries; late registration is possible through the day of the event.

name: Elmshorner Stadtlauf
description: The Elmshorn City Run is a traditional running event for the whole family in Elmshorn. The officially measured 5 km loop runs mainly along paved roads through the city centre. In addition to the main races over 5 and 10 kilometres, children’s races over 600 m and 1.5 km are also offered. The event is also the SHLV State Championships and offers a lively atmosphere with refreshments and a supporting programme at Rathausplatz.

name: Eper Michaelislauf
description: The Eper Michaelislauf is a long-standing, family-friendly race held around the town festival in Gronau-Epe. It is recognised as a DLV race and offers low entry fees and affordable refreshments. The event is known for its pleasant atmosphere, appealing to both competitive and recreational runners. Due to possible runoff elections, the race is held on Saturday in some years.

name: Herdorfer Götzelauf
description: The Herdorf Götzelauf is a local race in Herdorf, organized by DJK Herdorf and listed in the official German running calendar (laufen.de). The event offers two distances, 500 meters and 10 kilometers, and is aimed primarily at the local community and regional runners. DJK Herdorf is an active sports club with regional partnerships, making the race a down-to-earth, community-focused event. Official DLV rankings may be maintained for some races.

name: Herner St. Martini City-Lauf
description: The Herner St. Martini City Run takes place on September 27, 2026, on Boulevard Bahnhofstraße in Herne. The event offers various races for all age groups, from Bambini to adults, with distances ranging from approx. 400 m to 5 km. The courses are officially measured and held under official supervision. Timing is electronic via easychip, and all participants receive a certificate. The event is organized by IG Herne City e.V. and TV Wanne 1885 e.V.

name: Garmin Półmaraton Gdańsk
location: Polsat Plus Arena Gdańsk, Gdańsk, Pomorskie, Poland
organizer: Arena Gdańsk Operator Sp. z o.o.
description: Garmin Gdańsk Half Marathon is an annual running event held in Gdańsk, featuring a 21.0975 km course. The start and finish are located at Polsat Plus Arena Gdańsk. The race is open to mass participation, with starting corrals assigned according to declared finish time, and participants can also enter 4-person relay teams. The organizers provide professional timekeeping, medical support, refreshments and water along the course. The event promotes physical activity and a healthy lifestyle, and helps raise the profile of Gdańsk in Poland and abroad.
course_highlights: A 21.0975 km half-marathon course in Gdańsk
Start and finish at Polsat Plus Arena Gdańsk
Starting corrals assigned according to declared finish time
additional: The start and finish are located at Polsat Plus Arena Gdańsk. The start is divided into time-based corrals according to declared finish time (red, blue, green and yellow). Relay teams start from the blue corral. The race package includes a waterproof bib with a chip, timekeeping, medical support, water at refreshment points, refreshments after the finish and a medal. The full race package is guaranteed for payments made by 30.08.2026. The bib must be attached horizontally to the front of the shirt. Passing the bib to another person without the organizer’s consent is prohibited. The event includes various distances, including a half marathon and 5 km race, with a participant limit of up to 10,000. Registration takes place online, and fees can be paid via Przelewy24 or by traditional bank transfer. Races for children and teenagers are also available.

name: Tilburg Ten Miles
description: The Tilburg Ten Miles is the most convivial running festival in Central Brabant and has been held annually since 1988. The event attracts thousands of recreational runners and elite athletes, who run through Tilburg’s decorated streets, cheered on by enthusiastic spectators and live music. With distances of 16.1 km, 10 km and 5 km, there is a suitable challenge for every runner. The atmosphere is festive, and the route offers a lovely mix of urban surroundings and distinctive local spots.
course_highlights: Run through Tilburg’s decorated streets with enthusiastic spectators
A varied course through the heart of Tilburg, with wide streets and distinctive local spots
Live music and a festive atmosphere along the course
additional: Race numbers must be collected in advance at the Koepelhal on Saturday or Sunday. Registration by 23 August 2026 includes a race number with your name, medal engraving and a limited-edition running shirt. There is a Run Against Cancer campaign where participants can create a fundraising page and receive a special shirt when donations reach €500 or more. Multiple distances are available, including walking events and children’s races; participation is possible until 16 August; special race numbers and merchandise are available; the event supports charities such as KWF.

name: Rijk Zwaan Loop
price_range: twee tarieven voor alle afstanden, vroegboekkorting tot 8 september 2026
description: The Rijk Zwaan Loop is a running race and recreational run in 's-Gravenzande, celebrating its 25th edition in 2026. The day starts with the Kids Run at 13:00, followed by various distances, including a revamped 5 km and 10 km course. This year also features a new walking event with distances of 7, 14 and 21 kilometres, with proceeds going to Team Westland. The organisers invite runners of all levels to take part in this festive and sporting day.
course_highlights: Revamped 5 km and 10 km course, starting on Langestraat
Water stations along the route and post-finish refreshments including fruit, vegetables, sports drink and water
Walking event with route directions and a coffee stop; proceeds go to Team Westland
additional: The Kids Run starts at 13:00 and is limited to 450 participants. Race numbers are distributed in advance for those who register early. SAW chips are used for timing the 5 km and 10 km. Changing facilities are available at ISW College, at your own risk. Post-finish refreshments include fruit, vegetables, sports drink and water. The Kids Run has separate categories by primary school year group and age. The walking event is at participants' own risk and includes a coffee stop along the route. The Kids Run starts at 13:00, with a maximum of 450 children; location near Sand-Ambachtstraat and ISW College; no on-site registration.

name: Geuzenloop Zoetermeer

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Voorinschrijving is mogelijk tot zaterdag 26 september 2026, 18:00 uur

description: Geuzenloop Zoetermeer is an annual running event taking place for the 22nd time on Sunday, September 27, 2026. It is Zoetermeer’s largest running race, with distances ranging from a half mile to a half marathon. The start and finish are at Pilatusdam in Zoetermeer’s historic center. The courses pass through both Old and New Zoetermeer, including the former Floriade site and Balijbos. There are also Geuzen walking tours of 6 to 25 kilometers, organized by Road Runners Zoetermeer and Sportief Wandelgroep Zoetermeer.
course_highlights: Start and finish at Pilatusdam in Zoetermeer’s old center
Courses pass through Old Zoetermeer, New Zoetermeer, the former Floriade site, and Balijbos
Walking tours of 6 to 25 kilometers through natural areas with historical significance
additional: Geuzenloop is inclusive and accessible: buddies accompanying visually impaired runners and walkers can participate for free after registering. All running routes and the 6 km walking tour are wheelchair accessible. Each distance has a cut-off time to ensure the course remains clear. Finishers receive a unique medal made from a tree trunk slice by people distanced from the labor market. The finish closes at 15:00. Registration opens on May 1, 2026; medal made from pruned wood; option to change distance; closing run and after-party on September 30; no medal option for all participants.

name: 42 ste Joustermerkeloop
distance_verbose: 16.2 km, 10 km, 7 km, 1500 meter, 1 km, 0.5 km

name: Jasperloop
description: De Jasperloop is een maandelijkse hardloopwedstrijd die plaatsvindt in het mooie bosgebied nabij het Keelven in Someren. De loop is toegankelijk voor iedereen, jong en oud, en biedt een ronde van 2,5 km over half verharde en zandpaden. Deelnemers kunnen zelf bepalen hoeveel rondes ze lopen, met een maximum van zes. De start is om 10:00 uur en inschrijven kan vanaf 9:30 uur bij de startlocatie. De Jasperloop is een gezellige en laagdrempelige loop die al vele jaren wordt georganiseerd.

name: Sport 2000 Sparta Westvlietloop op zondag 27 september 2026
description: De Sport 2000 Sparta Westvlietloop is een hardloopwedstrijd georganiseerd door AV Sparta in Voorburg, gehouden op zondag 27 september 2026. De loop biedt verschillende afstanden, waaronder jeugdlopen van 1 en 2,5 km, en volwassenlopen van 5 en 10 km. De start vindt plaats vanaf de atletiekbaan op Sportpark Westvliet. Het parcours voert door een afwisselend gebied met routes langs de Westvlietweg, het Schrepelpad, een fietsbrug, het ADO-stadion en fietstunnels, waarbij de 10 km-lopers twee ronden afleggen. De organisatie nodigt zowel leden als niet-leden uit om deel te nemen en kennis te maken met de vereniging.

name: Runway Run for KiKa - Twente Airport
organizer: Stichting Runway Run voor Run for KiKa
description: De Runway Run for KiKa op Twente Airport is een uniek hardloopevenement dat plaatsvindt op de start- en landingsbaan van een voormalige vliegbasis. Deelnemers ervaren een bijzondere combinatie van sport, beleving en betekenis, terwijl ze rennen over het asfalt omringd door vliegtuigen en muziek. Het evenement biedt verschillende afstanden, waaronder een Kidsrun, 5 km en 10 km, en is een mooie gelegenheid om samen in actie te komen tegen kinderkanker. De vlakke parcoursen zijn ideaal voor zowel beginnende als ervaren hardlopers die hun grenzen willen verleggen.

name: Marathonblokken - Run Your City
description: Marathonblokken is een serie hardlooptrainingen georganiseerd door Hardloopnetwerk in samenwerking met PUMA, gericht op het voorbereiden van lopers op hun marathon. De trainingen vinden plaats in verschillende steden zoals Amsterdam, Soest en Utrecht, waarbij deelnemers samen lopen op marathontempo en halve marathontempo. Tijdens de sessies kunnen deelnemers PUMA-schoenen testen en sportvoeding proberen. Het evenement biedt een energieke en sociale sfeer, ideaal voor zowel beginnende als ervaren marathonlopers die hun prestaties willen verbeteren.

name: Heyu VathorstRun
description: De Heyu VathorstRun vindt plaats op zondag 27 september 2026 in Hooglanderveen. De loop biedt drie afstanden: 5 kilometer voor beginners, de klassieke 10 kilometer gesponsord door MONI, en een nieuwe afstand van 10 Engelse mijl (16,1 km). De route voert door de Vathorst, een mooie omgeving om hard te lopen en samen met anderen te genieten van sportiviteit en gezelligheid. De organisatie nodigt iedereen uit om mee te doen en biedt een speciale korting via Heyu.

name: Uiterwaarden Run Nederasselt
description: Op zondag 27 september 2026 vindt de Uiterwaarden Run Nederasselt plaats, een hardloopevenement in de prachtige uiterwaarden van Nederasselt. Deelnemers kunnen kiezen uit drie afstanden: 1,5 km, 5 km en 10 km, waarbij de routes onder andere over de Maasdijk, door de natuur en langs de sluis lopen. De start en finish zijn bij het Dorpshuis van Nederasselt, waar faciliteiten zoals toiletten en een horecagelegenheid aanwezig zijn. De sfeer is sportief en gezellig, geschikt voor jong en oud, beginner of gevorderde, met een professionele tijdregistratie en prijzen voor de snelste lopers op elke afstand.

name: Vechtstreek in Beweging Lopen
distance_verbose: Halve marathon, Halve marathon, 15 km, 10 km, 5 km, 2.5 km
description: De Vechtstreek in Beweging Lopen is een gezellige en goed georganiseerde hardloopserie in de regio Utrecht, georganiseerd door atletiekvereniging OSM’75 Atletiek & Recreatiesport Maarssen. De wedstrijden vinden plaats in het bosrijke recreatiegebied van de Maarsseveense Plassen, met een volledig verhard en autovrij parcours rondom de grote plas. Deelnemers kunnen hun eigen afstand en tempo bepalen, waardoor het evenement geschikt is voor zowel beginnende als geoefende lopers. Er zijn haaslopers beschikbaar op verschillende tempo's om iedereen te ondersteunen.

name: HooilandRun
description: De HooilandRUN is een gezellige hardloopwedstrijd in en rond de wijk ’t Hooiland in Lichtenvoorde, geschikt voor zowel beginnende als gevorderde lopers, kinderen en volwassenen. Het parcours bestaat uit een mix van halfverharde wandelpaden en verharde ondergrond, met glooiende paden en twee klimmetjes. De wedstrijd biedt verschillende afstanden, waaronder 1 km en 2 km voor kinderen, en 5 km en 10 km voor volwassenen. De organisatie zorgt voor tijdregistratie met chips, drankposten en prijzen voor de snelste lopers.

name: Dobbeloop
distance_verbose: Halve marathon, 15 km, 12 km, 10 km, 5 km, 5 km, 3.2 km, 1500 meter, 0.8 km
description: De Dobbeloop is een maandelijkse recreatieve hardloopwedstrijd georganiseerd door de Nootdorpse IJsclub, gehouden in het natuurgebied rondom de Dobbeplas tussen Pijnacker en Nootdorp. Het parcours is vrijwel geheel autovrij en verhard met asfalt, met begeleiding door fietsers, pijlen en bemande posten. De start is bij het clubhuis van de Nootdorpse IJsclub aan de Oudeweg 74 in Nootdorp. Er zijn diverse afstanden voor kinderen en volwassenen, met inschrijving ter plaatse en een gezellige sfeer in het clubgebouw.

name: HeteRUN
description: De HeteRUN is het hardloopevenement van Heteren dat plaatsvindt op zondag 27 september 2026. Het evenement biedt voor jong en oud diverse afstanden, waaronder kidsruns van 500 en 1000 meter, en uitdagende 5 en 10 km hardlooproutes. De routes zijn geschikt voor zowel geoefende als gevorderde hardlopers en vinden plaats in het hart van Heteren. De organisatie zorgt voor een gezellige sfeer met goede faciliteiten zoals kleedruimtes en EHBO ter plaatse.

name: Euromast Trappenloop
description: De Euromast Trappenloop is een unieke sportieve uitdaging waarbij deelnemers de 589 treden van de iconische Euromast in Rotterdam beklimmen. Deze tweede editie op 27 september 2026 biedt een onvergetelijke ervaring met een officiële tijdregistratie, een exclusieve medaille en een spectaculair uitzicht over de stad. De race is geschikt voor zowel atleten die voor een persoonlijk record gaan als voor iedereen die de uitdaging wil aangaan. Na afloop is er de mogelijkheid om te ontspannen in de Brasserie en vrienden en familie kunnen met een kortingscode ook van de Euromast genieten.

name: Raamvallei Duomarathon
description: De Raamvallei Duomarathon is een uniek duo-evenement waarbij teams van twee deelnemers samen het marathonparcours van ruim 42 kilometer afleggen op één fiets. De ene partner rent terwijl de ander fietst, met vrije wisselmogelijkheden. De route voert door het prachtige Land van Cuijk, langs de Raam en diverse karakteristieke locaties zoals Landgoed de Barendonk, bossen, weilanden en historische molens. Het evenement staat in het teken van samenwerking, plezier en beleving, zonder tijdwaarneming of wedstrijdklassement. Onderweg kunnen deelnemers genieten van streekgebonden hapjes, drankjes en livemuziek, met een feestelijke finish inclusief een rode loper en een traditioneel Brabants worstenbroodje.

name: Broekstaclerun
description: De Broekstaclerun is een uitdagend en gezellig obstacle run evenement in Broekland, met een unieke mix van hardlopen, modder en hindernissen. De run heeft een kneuterig karakter met een afwisselend parcours door de natuur, waarbij afzien en plezier hand in hand gaan. Het evenement is laagdrempelig en duurzaam georganiseerd, geschikt voor deelnemers van verschillende leeftijden en niveaus. De sfeer is altijd feestelijk en de run wordt ondersteund door enthousiaste vrijwilligers en lokale grondeigenaren.

name: 100 Bruggenloop
description: The 100 Bridges Run in Leiden is a unique walking and running event in which participants cross 100 bridges, ranging from centuries-old stone arch bridges to modern bridges in Singelpark. The route follows rivers, canals, tow canals and waterways, passing some of the most beautiful places in the historic city centre, including the Netherlands’ oldest university, Hortus Botanicus and various monuments. The walking event takes place on Saturday 26 September 2026, and the running event on Sunday 27 September 2026. Several distances are available, so both recreational walkers and runners can take part.
course_highlights: Cross 100 bridges over rivers, canals, tow canals and waterways
Pass historic sights such as the oldest university and Hortus Botanicus
Route through Singelpark, harbours, city gates and distinctive architecture
additional: Walkers start on Saturday between 08:00 and 11:00 from Van der Werfpark. Runners start on Sunday from 08:00 at Stadhuisplein/Vismarkt. The walking time limit is 16:15 and the running time limit is 11:15. Support is available along the route, with checkpoint stations, first aid and a commemorative medal. Dogs are allowed on a leash, except in Hortus Botanicus. Children under 12 may participate only when accompanied. The city is not closed to traffic; the route runs along pavements and pedestrian areas. Late registration is possible on the day, with a €2.00 surcharge. The event provides practical information about registration, times and facilities. The route includes a variety of surfaces, such as gravel, shell paths, brick, cobblestones, wood, concrete and asphalt, and is accessible to people with reduced mobility.

description: The Ehrmann Posbankloop is a unique running event through the beautiful natural surroundings of the Veluwezoom, with challenging elevation and a breathtakingly beautiful course. The 30th edition takes place on Sunday, 27 September 2026, in Velp and offers several distances, including a 15 km main distance, a 6 km race and a walking tour. The route passes iconic places such as the Posbank and the Emmapiramide, with the challenging “Muur van Aalbers” as a special competition within the competition. The Posbankloop is suitable for both recreational and dedicated runners and is known for its lively finish with large crowds.
course_highlights: Beautiful natural surroundings of the Veluwezoom with plenty of elevation
Climb of the Posbank and the “Muur van Aalbers” (Emmapiramide)
Start and finish in the centre of Velp, near the station
additional: Race numbers must be collected well before the start at Gezondheidscentrum Velp, Rozendaalselaan 34. The time limit is 55 minutes for the 6 km race and 120 minutes for the 15 km race. The “Muur van Aalbers” is a special segment, with watches awarded to the first man and woman to reach the top. For registrations made before 17 September, the participant’s name will be printed on the race number. Water and fruit are available at the finish, along with a discount voucher for running shoes at Run2Day Arnhem/Nijmegen. The start/finish is close to Velp station and easily accessible by train and bicycle. Anniversary edition featuring a walking tour and children’s clinics; location: Velp; event date: 27 September 2026.

name: 7-loop Zevenhoven
location: SV Zevenhoven, Zevenhoven, Nieuwkoop, South Holland, Netherlands
description: The 7-Loop is a running event with a rich tradition spanning more than 35 years in the Municipality of Nieuwkoop. It takes place in Zevenhoven and is known as a true autumn classic, with scenic courses through the polders of the Green Heart. The 7-Loop is part of the Nieuwkoops Circuit and brings the circuit to a close with an exciting final ranking. There are various distances for both children and adults. Children can take part for free and receive a shiny medal.
course_highlights: Scenic courses through the polders of the Green Heart
Children’s races of 400m and 800m around the football fields
The 7-Loop is the final event in the Nieuwkoops Circuit
additional: The start and finish area is at Stationsweg 23, Zevenhoven. Free parking, changing rooms, showers and catering facilities are available. The children’s races start between 11:30 and 12:00, and the adult races start between 12:30 and 13:00. The children’s races are free and take place around the finish area and football fields. The 7-Loop is a compulsory race in the Nieuwkoops Circuit, and participants must register online in advance to score points in the circuit. Course through the polders of the Green Heart, including children’s races and various distances, free participation for children, registration through 24 September 2026.

description: CityRun Nijverdal is a fun running event for all ages, taking place on Sunday, 27 September 2026. The event offers four distances: KidsRun, 2.5 km, 5 km and 10 km, plus a G-Run for participants with disabilities. The fast course is KNAU-certified and runs right through the centre of Nijverdal, with plenty of music and encouragement from spectators. The organisers are committed to making it a sporting event that brings participants and spectators together.
course_highlights: Fast, KNAU-certified course through the centre of Nijverdal
Precisely measured 5 km and 10 km routes with multiple laps
Music and encouragement along the course
additional: Start times by distance: G-Run at 12:45, KidsRun from 13:00 in age groups, 10 km at 14:30 and 5 km at 16:00. Race numbers include a transponder for timekeeping. Post-finish refreshments include water, sports drink and fruit. The Red Cross will be present with 6 staff members and 2 cyclists. There are no showers, but an unsupervised changing area is available. A special running shirt can be ordered for €12,95. The school with the most participants wins free ice cream. The course is fast and KNAU-certified; start time 16:00. Registration is open until 13 September 2026, with a discount. A medal and race number are included. A special running shirt can be ordered. Parking is available at the market square and at Albert Heijn. Train connections run from Zwolle and Almelo. Refreshments include drinks and fruit. There are no showers. Timekeeping is by transponder.

description: The Texel Half Marathon is a unique running event with a nautical character, taking place on Sunday, 27 September 2026. The start is special: runners set off from the TESO ferry, with the ship’s horn signalling the start. There are three distances: the half marathon, quarter marathon and eighth marathon, all finishing in the centre of Den Burg. A Kidsrun organised by Sportstichting Texel takes place beforehand for younger runners. Participants receive an original T-shirt, a medal and refreshments along the way.
course_highlights: Start from the TESO ferry, with the ship’s horn signalling the start
Choose from the half marathon, quarter marathon or eighth marathon, all finishing in the centre of Den Burg
Nautical character and a unique island setting
additional: All distances start at 12:25 when the TESO ferry’s ship’s horn sounds. The half and quarter marathons can start either from the ferry or from the island. The eighth marathon starts in Den Hoorn. All distances finish in the centre of Den Burg. A Kidsrun takes place in the centre of Den Burg before the half marathon. Cycling is not permitted on the beach or in the forest; bike rentals are available on the island. Every participant receives an original T-shirt, a medal and refreshments along the way. Registration details can be changed via a personal dashboard until 20 September 2026. T-shirt changes can be submitted until 31 May. Registration opens on 1 February 2026 via the website, with payment by iDEAL, Bancontact or Sofort. Minimum ages range from 12 to 18 years, depending on the distance. Overnight accommodation and team registration are available. The start is at 12:25; participants can choose to start from the ferry or from the island.

name: Áskorun ársins 2026 / We Challenge the Year 2026
Runfest
description: Runfest is an ambitious three-day road-running festival in Sandnes, the hometown of Olympic champion Jakob Ingebrigtsen. The festival will be held for the second time from 30 September to 2 October 2027, with race days on Friday 1 October and Saturday 2 October. Runfest combines elite competition with the joy of running and focuses on public health, physical activity and community. Participants of all ages and abilities are welcome to take part in a wide range of races and activities in beautiful surroundings.
course_highlights: Run in Sandnes, on the edge of Norway, with start locations suited to the 1500 m, 5 km, 10 km and 21 km distances
Aid stations with sports drink and water approximately every 5 km
Pacers available for several distances to help runners reach their goals
additional: Race numbers can be collected before and on race day; collecting them the day before is recommended to avoid queues. Changing facilities and bag storage are available at Thon Senter Sandnes. The official AfterRun, with a bar, street food, live concert and DJ, will be held on Saturday 3 October. Runfest Summit takes place on 30 September as a professional gathering focused on public health. Runfest Summit takes place on 30 September 2027. All finishers receive a medal.

name: Oslo Trail Challenge
description: Oslo Trail Challenge is a trail ultramarathon that takes place in the forest areas of Lillomarka, Nordmarka and Romeriksåsen, north of central Oslo. The race offers demanding and scenic trails suited to ultrarunners looking for a challenging experience in varied Norwegian forest terrain. The organizer, Langt og Lenge, has extensive experience with ultramarathons and offers a race focused on enjoying nature and the joy of running.
course_highlights: Trail ultramarathon in the forest areas of Lillomarka, Nordmarka and Romeriksåsen
Varied and demanding forest terrain north of central Oslo
Scenic trails with challenging sections
additional: Previous editions have used GPS navigation on unmarked courses.

name: Nightrun SAV en SSV
description: De Nightrun op vrijdagavond 2 oktober is een sfeervolle sponsorloop georganiseerd door SAV en SSV ter ere van de opening van de gerenoveerde atletiekbaan in Grootebroek. De baan wordt verlicht met kaarsjes, LED-lampjes en sfeerverlichting, terwijl een DJ zorgt voor muziek en energie. Elke deelnemer krijgt één uur de tijd om zoveel mogelijk rondjes te lopen, waarbij deelnemers zich kunnen laten sponsoren per ronde of met een vast bedrag. De Nightrun is geschikt voor jong en oud, met speciale startgroepen en een unieke beleving van sport, gezelligheid en clubgevoel.

name: Westenholterun
description: De Westenholterun 2026 vindt plaats op vrijdagavond 2 oktober in Sportpark de Weidesteen te Zwolle. Het evenement biedt een gezellige en sportieve sfeer met verschillende afstanden, waaronder een Kidsrun, 4 Engelse Mijlen, 10 kilometer hardlopen en een 10 km Powerwalk. De opbrengst van de inschrijvingen gaat volledig naar Hospice Zwolle, een kleinschalig huis voor mensen in de laatste levensfase. De start en finish zijn bij WVF, waar ook na afloop een prijsuitreiking en verloting plaatsvinden.

name: Rya Åsar Trail Run 2025
location: Rya Åsar Nature Reserve, Borås, Sweden

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: 745 kr 28 september – 3 oktober – i mån av plats!

description: Rya Åsar Trail Run is a popular trail race in Borås, offering beautiful and varied terrain in the Rya Åsar Nature Reserve. The race has several distances to suit both beginners and experienced trail runners, with challenging hills and lovely views. The start and finish area has a great atmosphere, with music, exhibitors, food and a runners’ lounge. The event has a family-friendly feel, with children’s races and a festival atmosphere in the forest that attracts many participants every year.
course_highlights: Varied trail running on beautiful paths with challenging hills
Djävulsbacken—a 300 m-long hill with 75 m of elevation gain
Beautiful views at Rya Klint, Fjällsjön and Hestrastugan
additional: Start and finish on the plateau at Rya Åsar, with music, exhibitors, a runners’ lounge and food service. Bib collection on Friday and Saturday. Chip timing, with start groups for elite, fast runners and recreational runners. Bag drop available. Toilets, changing facilities and showers at Borås Camping. Aid stations with Umara sports drink on the 24 km and 12 km courses. Children’s races of 800 m and 1.8 km are available. Children’s races and sanctioned competitions are offered.

name: John Bauer Trail Run
description: John Bauer Trail Run is a tough, very hilly trail race held at the IKHP cabin on Huskvarnaberget in Huskvarna. The race offers several distances for both adults and children, with a varied course that follows trails and, in places, untamed terrain. Participants can enjoy beautiful views over Lake Vättern and challenging hills, including the famous Strutsabacken, where the Bergatrollet competition takes place. The event has a family-friendly atmosphere, with activities and a sense of community around the IKHP cabin.
course_highlights: Tough, hilly terrain with both trails and untamed sections
Passage through Ulvadalen, with abundant flora and opportunities to experience nature
Strutsabacken—a steep ski slope where the Bergatrollet competition is decided
additional: Race bibs with timing chips must be collected from the IKHP cabin by 11:15. Timing is done using the chip in the race bib and provides both total time and Strutsabacken hill time. Changing rooms with showers and toilets are available at the IKHP cabin. Water stations are located at several points, depending on the distance. Late registration is available on race day between 9:00 and 11:00, if places remain. IKHP members receive half off the fee with a discount code. The event is described as family-friendly, with refreshments and activities at the start and finish, as well as changing facilities and showers at the IKHP cabin.

name: Broloppet Motala

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Priser fram till 28/9 (nästa höjning) - passa på!

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Priser fram till 28/9 (nästa höjning) - passa på!

description: Broloppet Motala is a popular running race organized by Motala AIF Friidrott, with the start and finish in Stadsparken in Motala. The race features a newly revived course that runs through central Motala, offering a pleasant running experience in an urban setting. There are two distances, 5 km and 10 km, with a separate lane for runners completing the first lap of the 10 km race. Water stations are available at the bridge and at the lap point to provide runners with the best possible support.
course_highlights: Start and finish in Stadsparken, in central Motala
Newly revived course through the city centre
Water stations at the bridge (approx. 3 km) and at the lap point
additional: Late registration is available on race day, 3/10, from 10:00 to 12:30 at Team Sportia. Bib numbers can be collected at Team Sportia from Friday 2/10, 10:00–18:00, and Saturday 3/10, 10:00–12:30. Changing facilities are available at Actic Stora Torget. Bag drop-off is by the stage. The 10 km race has a separate lane for runners completing the first lap.

name: Avesta Night Sky Run
description: Avesta Night Sky Run is an autumn event organized by Dalaportens OL in Avesta. The race offers an exciting running experience in scenic surroundings and is part of Dalaportens orienteering activities. Participants can register via MittLopp and enjoy a well-organized event with good service. Together with Backyard Ultra, it creates a unique running weekend in October.
course_highlights: Running in scenic surroundings around Avesta
Part of Dalaportens OL’s autumn event
Backyard Ultra with 6.7 km laps and a mass start every hour
additional: Backyard Ultra starts at 11:00 on October 3, on a 6.7 km course that is mostly on a shared walking and cycling path.
