A new lap starts every hour, with a mass start, and the competition continues until only one participant remains. A refreshment station with drinks and energy supplies is available at the lap point. Registration for Backyard Ultra is by email to AvestaUltra@outlook.com, with an entry fee of 350 kr. Maximum 80 participants. Previous editions have been held together with Avesta Backyard Ultra.

name: Austevollsløpet
description: Austevollsløpet hosts a flexible relay for businesses, with up to five participants per team and a total course of approximately 21 km. The race runs from Kalve to Austevoll Sports Ground, and participants can divide the distance as they wish, making the relay accessible to many. The event creates a festive atmosphere, with spectators cheering along the course, and all participants receive a specially designed medal. Proceeds from the event go towards the athletics group’s activities and training camps in Austevoll.
course_highlights: A relay course of approximately 21 km from Kalve to Austevoll Sports Ground
Up to five participants per team, with flexible leg distribution
Spectators along the course with flags and music, and changeover points at food stations approximately every 5 km
additional: A bus leaves Austevoll Secondary School at 11:45 and stops at the changeover stations for drop-off and pick-up. All participants receive a medal. The event is supported by Austevoll Kraftlag as its main sponsor. Teams may have fewer than five participants if they wish. Distance options have varied between editions. In 2026, the business relay cost NOK 1,000 per team, and the Mini-Mini Marathon was free.

name: Nesbyen Backyard 2027
description: Nesbyen Backyard takes place on the first Saturday in October, featuring 6- and 12-hour Backyard Ultra races in beautiful Nesbyen, Hallingdal. The race offers a flat, fast 6.7 km loop that runs mainly on asphalt, with some sections on gravel and trail, challenging runners to complete one loop every hour. This unique race combines endurance, tactics and community in a social and motivating atmosphere, with prizes for everyone who completes the race and door prizes from local sponsors. The race starts at Nesbyen Sports Hall at 10:00 and is suitable for both beginners and experienced ultrarunners.
course_highlights: 6.7 km loop with less than 30 metres of elevation gain
The course runs mainly on asphalt, with some sections on gravel and trail
Flat, fast course through Nesbyen town centre amid beautiful autumn scenery
additional: Start and finish at Nesbyen Sports Hall, with changing rooms, showers, toilets and an indoor lounge. A kiosk with food and drinks is available. The race’s Backyard area serves as a social gathering place between loops. More than 20 door prizes from local sponsors. The train station is a 20-minute walk from the start area. The course is Norway’s flattest Backyard loop, with less than 30 metres of elevation gain. Accommodation is available along the course, including at Hagaled Guesthouse. Starts at Nesbyen Sports Hall on 2 October 2027 at 10:00. Registration via EQ Timing. Prices increase in stages as the registration deadline approaches. Prizes for everyone who completes at least one loop, as well as placement prizes and door prizes.

name: Korschenbroicher Waldlauf
location: Waldstadion Korschenbroich, Korschenbroich, North Rhine-Westphalia, Germany
description: The 21st Korschenbroich Forest Run takes place on October 3, 2026, at the Waldstadion Korschenbroich. The event offers races over distances from 400 to 10,000 meters, as well as walking, and is open to all age groups. It includes a new 2,300-meter race for young people in age groups U14 to U18. Alongside the sporting competition, there will be a cafeteria and a raffle in aid of the youth department. Held on German Unity Day, the race combines sporting commitment with a good cause.
course_highlights: Distances from 400 to 10,000 meters, plus walking
New 2,300-meter race for age groups U14 to U18
Event at the Waldstadion Korschenbroich on German Unity Day
additional: Cafeteria and raffle in aid of the youth department; NEW-Group is the new main sponsor; registration opens in early 2026; the event takes place on German Unity Day. Courses run across the sports field and forest paths; spikes are not allowed. Registration opens in early 2026; sponsored by the NEW-Group.

name: RheinEnergie Kinderlauf Köln
description: The RheinEnergie Children’s Run Cologne takes place on October 3, 2026, at Roncalliplatz by Cologne Cathedral. The event offers several child-friendly races over distances from 500 m to 2,000 m. Most of the course is closed to traffic and secured by course marshals. Before the run, there is a children’s church service at Cologne Cathedral, after which the children start their races together. Children born between 2015 and 2021 are eligible to participate. There is no timing; the focus is on having fun and taking part.
course_highlights: The route passes Cologne Cathedral
Start and finish at Roncalliplatz
Closed course with course marshals
additional: Race bibs can be collected on October 3, 2026, from a tent at Roncalliplatz. On-site registration is also available on race day from 9:00 to 12:15. Depending on the number of participants, the children start in several waves, divided by age group and/or gender. There is no timing, and children should be able to complete the course without parental accompaniment. Several races with different distances; no timing; participation open to children born in 2015 or later; limit of 1,000 children; online registration available; race bibs collected on race day.

name: Rothaarwaldlauf
location: Rothaargebirge, Bad Berleburg-Aue, North Rhine-Westphalia, Germany
description: The Rothaar Forest Run organized by TSV Aue-Wingeshausen is a popular, scenic forest run in the Rothaar Mountains, taking place on 3 October 2026. The event offers a range of distances, including loop courses and point-to-point routes, appealing to both competitive athletes and recreational runners. The races are part of the Rothaar-Laufserie AOK-Cup, which is celebrating its 25th anniversary this year. The course passes through beautiful woodland with moderate climbs. Excellent refreshments and bus transfers to the start points of the longer routes are provided.
course_highlights: A range of distances from 400m to 28km, including loop courses and point-to-point routes
Start and finish at the Aue-Wingeshausen sports ground, with bus transfers to the start points of the longer routes
Scenic forest routes with moderate climbs and good refreshments
additional: Start times vary by distance; for example, the main race starts at 13:30. A bus transfer runs from the Aue-Wingeshausen gymnasium to the start points of the longer routes (15km and 28km). Race packs can be collected at various locations until shortly before the start. Showers and changing facilities are available at the gymnasium. Late entries are possible at the start points until 30 minutes before the start. The event is part of the Rothaar-Laufserie AOK-Cup, which is celebrating its 25th anniversary. Participants can enjoy shuttle bus transport and refreshments including cake, waffles and fries, as well as an established tradition on the running calendar.

name: Saerbecker Kirmeslauf
price_range: Bambinilauf € 1,00; Schülerläufe 1,2 km und 2 km € 3,00; 5 km Jedermannlauf € 8,00; 10 km Hauptlauf € 10,00
description: The Saerbeck Kirmes Run takes place on October 3, 2026, at Sparkassen Stadium Saerbeck. The course is entirely paved and flat, and runs along well-maintained secondary roads, allowing for fast times. The event offers races for various age groups, with transponder timing and results determined by finish order. Children receive medals, and awards are presented for the overall and age-group results. Participants can print their certificates online.
course_highlights: Well-maintained, fully paved course
Flat secondary roads for fast times
Start and finish at Sparkassen Stadium Saerbeck
additional: Timing is recorded using a transponder attached to the back of the race bib. Finish order determines the results. Online certificates are available to all participants. The course is monitored by volunteers, but traffic rules must still be observed. Every child receives a medal in the children's races. Liability for theft is excluded. Participants must confirm that they are in a healthy state of training. Online registration is available; late entries are accepted on the day of the event for a fee; the event is held under official supervision in accordance with DLV/IWR rules.

name: 16. Köhlbrandbrückenlauf
description: The Köhlbrand Bridge Run is Germany’s largest bridge run and crosses the landmark in Hamburg’s port. The event gives runners the unique opportunity to cross the impressive Köhlbrand Bridge and experience the port atmosphere up close. The run attracts numerous participants every year and is known for its distinctive course and great atmosphere along the route.

name: 26. Bismarck-Gedenklauf
description: The Bismarck Memorial Run is an annual road and forest race in Schönhausen (Elbe), Saxony-Anhalt, held on German Unity Day. Organized by SV Preussen 27 Schönhausen, it is part of the ELBE-OHRE-CUP and offers 6.5 km and 13 km distances, as well as shorter races for children and young people. The course starts at the club’s sports center and follows paved roads into the forest, past Kollerberg. The longer distance is run twice. The event honors Otto von Bismarck, Schönhausen’s most famous son, and concludes with an awards ceremony and refreshments at the sports center.

name: 28. Alfelder Leinetal-Lauf
description: The 28th Alfelder Leinetal Run takes place on Saturday, October 3, 2026, in Alfeld, Lower Saxony. Various distances are offered for adults, including 5 km, 10 km, and a half marathon, all finishing at the Hindenburg Stadium, which serves as the shared finish area throughout the day. The flat, signposted courses are ideal for maintaining a steady pace. There are also races for children and young people, making for a varied program.

name: 49. Warburger Oktoberwochen Volkslauf
description: The 49th Warburg Oktoberwochenlauf takes place on October 3, 2026, at the Diemelaue Sports Center in Warburg. The event offers a 5 km company competition and is also open to young people and students. Registration is by SEPA direct debit via RaceResult. Further details about the race regulations will be provided to participants later.

name: Alfelder Leinetal-Lauf
description: The Alfelder Leinetal-Lauf takes place on Saturday, October 3, 2026, in Alfeld, Germany. Distances include 5 km, 10 km, and a half marathon, all finishing at Hindenburg Stadium, which serves as the shared finish area throughout the day. The flat, signposted courses are ideal for maintaining a steady pace. There are also races for children and young people, making for a varied program.

name: Burgentrail Unterfränkische Traillaufmeisterschaften
description: The Burgentrail in Ostheim is a challenging trail-running event that will host the Lower Franconian Trail Running Championships on October 3, 2026. The course follows varied forest and meadow trails, passing historic castle ruins such as Lichtenburg and Königsburg, and features technically demanding trails with roots and steep descents. The scenic surroundings, with views across the Grabfeld, make this a special experience for trail-running enthusiasts of all ability levels. SC Ostheim/Rhön warmly invites everyone who loves running to take part in this sporting highlight.

name: Cross der deutschen Einheit
description: The Cross der Deutschen Einheit in Weißensee is a traditional cross-country race organized by the sports club Blau-Weiß 1921 Weißensee e.V. This race is being held for the 35th time and offers various competitions for all age groups, including Bambini races, youth races, a 3.5 km race, a 10.5 km race, a half marathon, and walking/Nordic walking. The course runs around the Gondelteich, with varied sections including climbs and stairs, and offers a sporting challenge for runners of all ability levels. A jubilee relay race rounds off the program and requires no registration or entry fee.

name: Duvenstedter Dorflauf
description: The Duvenstedt Village Run is a traditional race around Alt Duvenstedt, held annually on German Unity Day. With several distances for children, teenagers, and adults, it offers a suitable challenge for all age groups. The event is known for its friendly atmosphere, volunteer involvement, and wonderful village community. The course is clearly marked and offers varied running scenery in and around Alt Duvenstedt.

name: Herbstlauf TuS Ofen
location: Ofen, Bad Zwischenahn, Lower Saxony, Germany
description: The TuS Ofen Autumn Run is a family-friendly race taking place for the 35th time on October 3, 2026. The event offers distances for all ages and ability levels, from 800 m for the youngest participants, a 3 km schoolchildren’s race, a 5 km walking and fun run, to the 10 km EDEKA-Böse Run for ambitious runners. The start and finish are at the TuS Ofen sports field. A large cake buffet in the sports hall will provide refreshments, and all participants will receive a gingerbread heart at the finish as a special gesture.

name: Krautsander Insellauf
description: The Krautsand Island Run is a long-standing running event on the Elbe island of Krautsand near Drochtersen. Organized by SV Dornbusch and TV Wischhafen, the race offers an attractive route in a natural setting. The event is open to runners of all ability levels and takes place annually on October 3. It is organized by the Kehdingen Athletics Association, which ensures everything runs smoothly.

name: Langeooger Sanddornlauf 2026
description: The Langeoog Sea Buckthorn Run takes place on October 3, 2026, on the island of Langeoog and offers races for various age groups. The main distances are 5 km and 10 km on paved paths and roads, ideal for island residents and visitors. There are also dedicated races for young participants: 400 m (Bambini) and 1,000 m (youth). The event marks the end of the island running series and is supported by the island school. The awards ceremony takes place in front of Haus der Insel, where runners gather after crossing the finish line.

name: Stimberg-Haardlauf
description: The Stimberg-Haardlauf is a long-standing race in Oer-Erkenschwick, starting and finishing at Stimbergpark. Various distances are offered for children, young people and adults, including 500 m, 4.9 km and 9.4 km. The adult courses feature elevation changes, offering a varied alternative to flat road races. The event includes individual and team competitions and is open to club runners, local teams, and young and adult athletes.

name: Strausseelauf
description: The Straussee Run in Strausberg is a traditional annual running event. It gives runners of different ability levels the opportunity to compete and enjoy the beautiful surroundings of Lake Straussee. The event is organized by Kultur- und Sportclub Strausberg e.V. and takes place at Theodor Fontane Gymnasium in Strausberg. It is known for its friendly atmosphere and good organization.

name: 4 Moore Ultratrail-Marathon
description: The 4 Moore Ultratrail Marathon is a non-commercial 53-kilometer ultratrail run through the countryside around Langenhagen. The route passes through a variety of moorland and heathland areas, including Kananoher Forst, Schwarzes Moor, Otternhagener Moor, Helstorfer Moor, Große Heide and Bissendorfer Moor. The course is unmarked and navigated by GPS; the final GPS track and a briefing are sent by email in advance. Three aid stations provide drinks and snacks. Participants must bring their own hydration containers and cups. Entry is limited to 50 runners, and the time limit is 9 hours.

name: XXXVII Oskie Biegi im. Krzysztofa Malinowskiego
Pieken+Dalen Festival
description: Op zaterdag 3 oktober 2026 vindt het allereerste Pieken+Dalen Festival plaats bij RCN het Grote Bos in Doorn, georganiseerd door Stichting DiabetesPlus. Dit unieke evenement combineert wandelen en hardlopen over diverse afstanden, van een 5 kilometer rondje tot een marathon, op de prachtige Utrechtse Heuvelrug. Na de inspanning wacht een warm ontvangst op het festivalterrein met ontmoetingen, muziek, een Buddy Tent, Q&A met diabetesonderzoekers, een TechTent en diverse foodtrucks. Het festival biedt een bijzondere gelegenheid om samen met vrienden, familie en sportvrienden de pieken en dalen van bloedsuikers te trotseren in een sfeervolle en verbindende omgeving.

name: 11e Molenloop (Molensmooiste) Alblasserdam-Kinderdijk
description: Molensmooiste is een unieke hardloopwedstrijd die plaatsvindt op zaterdag 3 oktober 2026 in het UNESCO Werelderfgoed Kinderdijk. Deelnemers lopen langs alle iconische molens van het gebied, waarbij de 10 Engelse Mijl twee rondes omvat en de 5 Engelse Mijl één ronde. De start en finish liggen middenin het molengebied, wat zorgt voor een bijzondere en sfeervolle beleving. Met een limiet van 1.500 deelnemers en een organisatie onder auspiciën van AAA Atletiekvereniging Alblasserdam, is het een evenement voor zowel recreatieve als fanatieke lopers.

name: Kûbaarder Hurdrindei
description: De Kûbaarder Hurdrindei is een bekende hardloop- en trimloop in Friesland, die jaarlijks op de eerste zaterdag van oktober plaatsvindt. De loop voert over rustige, autoluwe paden en wegen, waaronder de historische Slachtedijk en de 'griene dyk' uit 1200. Er zijn drie afstanden: 5 km, 11,2 km en een halve marathon van 21,1 km, plus een gratis Kidzzrun voor kinderen van 1 en 2 km. Na afloop is er gelegenheid om bij te komen met een kop warme bouillon en gezellig na te praten. De loop trekt jaarlijks 120 tot 140 deelnemers en staat open voor lopers van alle niveaus, inclusief minder validen.

name: Midden Drenthe Loop
description: De Midden Drenthe Loop is een jaarlijks terugkerende hardloopwedstrijd georganiseerd door Loopgroep Westerbork, met de 36e editie gepland op zaterdag 3 oktober 2026. De loop biedt twee afstanden, 5 en 10 kilometer, en start en finisht op Camping Midden Drenthe in Zwiggelte. De routes voeren door de mooie natuur van Midden Drenthe, waarbij de 5 km volledig verhard is en de 10 km een klein deel zandpad bevat. De wedstrijd is toegankelijk voor deelnemers vanaf 12 jaar en biedt een medaille bij de finish.

name: Molens Mooiste
description: Molensmooiste is een unieke hardloopwedstrijd die plaatsvindt op zaterdag 3 oktober 2026 in het UNESCO Werelderfgoed Kinderdijk. Deelnemers lopen dwars door het iconische molengebied, waarbij de start en finish middenin dit prachtige landschap liggen. De race biedt twee afstanden, 5 Engelse Mijl (8 km) en 10 Engelse Mijl (16 km), waarbij de routes dit jaar echt langs alle molens van Kinderdijk gaan. De start vindt plaats in waves vanwege het smalle startpad, zodat iedereen optimaal kan genieten van de molenbeleving. Het evenement wordt georganiseerd onder auspiciën van atletiekvereniging AAA Alblasserdam en trekt ongeveer 1.500 deelnemers.

name: Rondje om de Koepel
organizer: Marijke Steenbergen, Henk van Voorst, Alwin Grubben, Gert van Dalen
description: Rondje om de Koepel is een geliefd hardloopevenement in Lunteren en omgeving, dat deelnemers meeneemt langs het Middelpunt van Nederland, over de Goudsberg en door het Lunterse Buurtbos met zijn karakteristieke Koepel. De wedstrijd biedt drie afstanden: een Kidsrun van 1 km, een 5 km loop en een uitdagende 10 km loop, waarbij het parcours voornamelijk over bospaden gaat met klimmetjes en afdalingen. Het evenement wordt professioneel ondersteund met warming-up sessies en verzorging door het Therapeutisch Centrum Lunteren. Daarnaast draagt het evenement bij aan lokale goede doelen, wat het een sportieve en maatschappelijke belevenis maakt.

name: Hoge Veluwe Wandeldag
organizer: Het Nationale Park De Hoge Veluwe
description: De Hoge Veluwe Wandeldag vindt plaats in het prachtige Nationale Park De Hoge Veluwe, een groene schatkamer van Nederland met afwisselende landschappen, unieke flora en fauna, en bijzondere kunst en cultuur. Tijdens deze dag kunnen wandelaars genieten van diverse wandelroutes die het park rijk is, waaronder speciale jubileumroutes en de historische Grenspalenroute. Het park biedt een unieke combinatie van natuurbeleving en cultuur, met iconische plekken zoals het Kröller-Müller Museum en het Jachthuis Sint Hubertus. De Hoge Veluwe Wandeldag is een ideale gelegenheid om de natuur te ontdekken en te genieten van een dag vol rust en inspiratie.

name: Hostruset

price_tiers.distance: 5 km Män, Kvinnor, PF19, Veteraner 50+ och Motion

description: Hostruset is a fast 5 km race and fun run held in Örebro, starting and finishing at Björkhagaskolan. The course follows cycle paths around Varbergaskogen and has been officially measured by the Swedish Athletics Association. The race is part of the Södra Svealand Running Series and offers both competitive and recreational classes. There is also a 700-metre children’s race for the youngest participants. Changing rooms and showers are available on site. Due to limited parking, the organisers encourage carpooling or cycling.
course_highlights: Fast 5 km course on cycle paths around Varbergaskogen
Starts and finishes at Björkhagaskolan in Örebro
Officially measured by a course measurer in accordance with the Swedish Athletics Association
additional: Start groups are being tested for the 5 km race: runners expecting to finish in over 25 minutes start at 12:30, and those expecting to finish in under 25 minutes start at 12:45. Race numbers are distributed on race day. Timing is done using transponders, which must be returned after the race; otherwise, a charge of 400 kr applies. The prize ceremony takes place in the start/finish area, with honorary prizes for the top 5 in Men/Women and the top 3 in PF19 and Veteran 50+. Changing rooms and showers are available at Björkhagaskolan. Parking is very limited; carpooling or cycling is recommended.

name: Vånga Mountain Xtreme
location: Villands Vånga, Kristianstad Municipality, Skåne County, Sweden
description: Vånga Mountain Xtreme is a challenging trail race offering three distances: 8 km, 16 km and 40 km, with 300, 600 and 1,500 metres of elevation gain respectively. The races take place in a wilderness setting, with winding trails, small tarns and deep quarries, and feature beautiful views and demanding hills. Participants get to experience the different sides of Vångaberget, with the longest distance taking runners up the mountain five times. FK Göingarna welcomes runners and spectators to a memorable and demanding trail-running experience in Villands Vånga.
course_highlights: Winding trails in untouched wilderness
Beautiful views by small tarns and deep quarries
Challenging climbs: 300 m (8 km), 600 m (16 km), 1,500 m (40 km)
additional: Late registration is available on site until approximately one hour before the start, with payment via Swish. There is also a children’s race, VMX Kids, with free on-site registration. The races are sanctioned by the Swedish Athletics Federation. Transfer of a race entry is possible under the terms listed on the website. The listed distances are 8, 16 and 40 km, plus VMX Kids. Trail running shoes are recommended. The website describes the 2026 edition and does not confirm details for 2027.

name: Perseløpet 5 km, 10 km, halvmaraton, maraton
description: Perseløpet is a race at Ås School in Eidsvoll, offering a simple and efficient race format focused on fast times. The course is a flat, measured 2,633-meter loop, with distances ranging from 3 km to 100 km. Participants can set up their own nutrition table, which they pass each lap, making it easy to manage nutrition in a personal way. The event offers good facilities, with race bib pickup, changing rooms and toilets inside the school, as well as free parking. Perseløpet is known as a race where many participants set personal records, and runners are encouraged to celebrate by ringing the bell at the finish area.
course_highlights: Flat, measured 2,633-meter loop
Your own nutrition table, passed each lap
Race from Ås School with facilities including changing rooms and toilets
additional: Race bibs are collected via self-service at the school approximately two hours before the start. Free parking, changing rooms and toilets are available at the venue. At selected races, 9th graders from Feiring School staff an official drink station to raise money for their school trip. The weather forecast is updated four times daily using satellite data for the area around Ås School. The race has a lap-time calculator for planning split times. All distances take place in the same area and use the same weather forecast. Registration is via RaceDays. Race bibs are available for self-service pickup at the school from approximately two hours before the start. Free parking, changing rooms and toilets are available at the venue. The course is AIMS-certified.

name: RE-MILA 2027
description: RE-MILA is a fun run for all ages, starting and finishing in central Revetal. Distances include 600 metres for children, 2.5 km for youth, and 5 km and 10 km for adults and youth. The event has wave starts with pacers and follows Kondis’s recommended age-group categories. All participants receive a medal, and prizes are awarded to age-group winners and the top runners at each distance. Race numbers can be collected the day before or on race day in Revetal.
course_highlights: Start and finish in central Revetal, by the Sport1 store
Wave starts with up to 8 waves and pacers
Free parking in nearby parking garages and open-air parking spaces
additional: Race numbers can be collected at the Sport1 store in Revetal on the Saturday before the race from 12:00 to 15:00, or on race day from around 12:00. All participants in the children’s race receive a free T-shirt and medal. Wave starts are 15–30 seconds apart, with the fastest wave first. The official website states that all participants receive a medal. A free T-shirt is mentioned for children’s race participants. Details for the 2027 edition have not been confirmed in the sources.

name: Perseløpet ¤7 - 2027
description: Perseløpet is a simple and efficient running event at Ås school in Eidsvoll, designed to help runners achieve good times. The race takes place on a flat, officially measured 2,633-metre loop, with seven distances from 3 km to 100 km. Participants have their own nutrition table, which they pass each lap, giving them full control over their nutrition without the need to manage aid-station logistics. The event has a welcoming atmosphere, where personal records are celebrated by ringing the bell at the finish area. Perseløpet is organized by Feiring IL and attracts both recreational and competitive runners.
course_highlights: Flat, officially measured 2,633-metre loop
Your own nutrition table by the course for personal refuelling
Seven distances from 3 km to 100 km, with opportunities to achieve good times
additional: Race bibs are collected on a self-service basis at Ås school approximately two hours before the start. Free parking, changing rooms and toilets are available at the venue. At selected races, ninth-grade students from Feiring school staff an official drinks station to raise money for their school trip. The event has a lap-time calculator to help plan split times. Weather forecasts and the course elevation profile are available via the website. Race bibs are collected on a self-service basis at the school from approximately two hours before the start. Free parking, changing rooms and toilets are available at the venue. Registration is via RaceDays.

name: 25. Benther-Berg-Lauf
location: VSV Benthe Sportplatz, Am Hammfeld, Ronnenberg-Benthe, Lower Saxony, Germany
description: The Benther-Berg-Lauf takes place on 3 October 2026 in Ronnenberg-Benthe and is part of the Sparkassen-Laufpass der Region Hannover. The event offers various race distances for all age groups, from Bambini and children's races to a half marathon over 21.8 km. The course runs through the scenic surroundings of Benther Berg and offers an enjoyable running experience for both competitive runners and recreational athletes. Race numbers and transponders can be collected from 8:30 a.m. in the VSV Benthe gymnasium. Late entries are possible up to 45 minutes before the respective start.
course_highlights: 21.8 km long-distance race (half marathon) through Benther Berg
A variety of distances, from the 550 m Bambini race to the 21.8 km long-distance race
Part of the Sparkassen-Laufpass der Region Hannover
additional: Race numbers and transponders can be collected from 8:30 a.m. in the VSV Benthe gymnasium. Late entries are possible on the event day up to 45 minutes before the respective start, with an additional late-entry fee of €5 (€2 for the Bambini and children's races). Parking is available in a designated car park behind the sports facility; access on the event day is only possible as far as the cul-de-sac. Groups of 5 or more people can request a discount by email. Course map, online registration until 02.10.2026, parking behind the sports facility, participation in the Laufpass possible, various race distances, children's and Bambini races

name: 31. Geiseltalseelauf
description: The Geiseltalsee Run is a long-standing running event in Braunsbedra that welcomes runners of all ability levels. The route passes through the scenic surroundings of Lake Geiseltal and offers a sporting challenge across varied terrain. The event is very popular and attracts numerous participants every year. Alongside the competition, the sense of community is also a central part of the event.
course_highlights: Route around Lake Geiseltal
Varied terrain with scenic views
Half marathon with a course record set the previous year
additional: Late entries are possible on race day up to 1 hour before the start. The event also includes children’s and youth races as well as walking events. It takes place in Braunsbedra at Lake Geiseltal and is part of the Landescup. The exact start and finish locations can be found on the official website.

name: Essener Seelauf 2026
description: The Essen Seelauf is a traditional running event at Lake Baldeney in Essen. The 14.2 km course follows well-marked cycle paths and passes through the bird sanctuary. There are two refreshment stations, and the race starts at 10:00 a.m. The event is held in accordance with the guidelines of the German Athletics Association (DLV) and is open to runners with or without a DLV competition licence. Late registrations are possible up to one hour before the start, subject to availability.
course_highlights: 14.2 km course at Lake Baldeney
The course passes through a bird sanctuary and over Lantermannsfähre
Two refreshment stations at km 5 and km 9.5
additional: Late registration is possible up to one hour before the start, with a late-entry fee of €3, payable in cash. Changes of registration are possible only until 30.09. by email to teamessen@gmx.de. Race numbers must be worn visibly on the chest. The use of technical devices such as smartphones with headphones is prohibited. The course is not measured by the DLV, but every kilometre is marked. The 14.2 km race is not measured by the DLV. There are two refreshment stations at km 5 and km 9.5, manual timekeeping, race numbers worn on the chest, parking at the Regattaturm, and changing rooms and showers in the Regattahaus.

name: NRZ Klosterlauf
location: Kloster Kamp, Kamp-Lintfort, North Rhine-Westphalia, Germany
description: The NRZ Kloster Run takes place on German Unity Day, 3 October 2026, around Kloster Kamp in Kamp-Lintfort. With races over 5,000 metres and the half marathon, the event offers suitable competitions for runners of all abilities. The detailed race information and schedule will be published once planning is complete. The run is an established event organised by SV Alemannia Kamp-Leichtathletik and warmly invites runners to take part on this special day.
course_highlights: Run around the historic Kloster Kamp
Races over 5,000 metres and the half marathon
Event on German Unity Day
additional: The race information and schedule will be published online once the final planning is complete. Competitions are held over 5,000 metres and the half marathon. The event is part of SV Alemannia Kamp-Leichtathletik and takes place annually on 3 October. Distances include 5 km, 10 km and the half marathon; the event takes place on 3 October 2026; on-site registration is available; part of the regional running events in the Lower Rhine region.

name: Ortsstraßenlauf
description: The TV Marienhagen Ortsstraßenlauf has been held annually on German Unity Day since 1990 and is the club’s largest sporting event. The routes run along roads inside and outside the village, as well as paved forest and field paths. The event is part of the Waldeck-Frankenberger Laufcup and offers categories for Bambini, schoolchildren, young people and seniors. The event is open to everyone; club membership is not required. Advance registration is no longer available—registration is only possible on site. Refreshments are provided during and after the event, and every participant receives a certificate.
course_highlights: Routes on roads and paved forest and field paths
10 km run and 7.5 km Nordic walking on out-and-back courses
Part of the Waldeck-Frankenberger Laufcup
additional: Registration is only possible on site, no later than 45 minutes before the start. The event takes place in all weather conditions. Every participant receives a certificate. Children and young people may not enter more than one event. Refreshments are provided during and after the race at the village community centre by the sports field. The route passes through the village; advance registration is not available. Refreshments are available on site, and all participants receive certificates.

name: Sparkassen-Phoenix-Halbmarathon
description: The Sparkassen-Phoenix Half Marathon in Dortmund is a popular half marathon held annually on October 3. The 21.1 km course runs through southern Dortmund, past Phoenix Lake, Phoenix-West, Westfalenpark and Rombergpark. It is officially measured, making it suitable for personal bests. In addition to the individual half marathon, there are relay races and a KNAX Fun Run for children. The event offers a family-friendly atmosphere, with refreshments, cheer zones and a rendezvous point for relay runners shortly before the finish.
course_highlights: The course passes Phoenix Lake, Phoenix-West, Westfalenpark and Rombergpark
Officially measured 21.1 km course, eligible for rankings
Relay exchange zones at kilometers 7 and 14, with shuttle bus connections
additional: Bib pickup on October 2 from 14:00 to 17:00 and on race day from 8:30. Bibs are printed with participants’ names and sent by post. Online late registration is available until October 3 at 10:00; after that, registration is possible on site for a fee. Relay teams receive a timing baton, which can be collected on race day upon presentation of ID. Refreshments are available at kilometers 4, 11 and 17, as well as in the finish area. Changing rooms, toilets and bag drop are at the Sparkassen Academy by Phoenix Lake. Shuttle buses take relay runners to the exchange zones. A rendezvous point for relay runners is located approximately 150 m before the finish. Course through parks and industrial areas, registration, advertising opportunities, race on October 3

name: Treiser Volkslauf
description: The Treis Volkslauf will take place for the 34th time on October 3, 2026, in Staufenberg-Treis. The event welcomes runners, walkers, and hikers of all ability levels and offers a family-friendly atmosphere, with a large cake buffet and delicious pea soup. The race is part of the Mittelhessen-Cup, a popular running series in Hesse and the surrounding area. Registration opens on August 1, 2026, via Race Result.
course_highlights: Part of the Mittelhessen-Cup, a regional running series
A variety of routes for running, walking, and hiking
Large cake buffet and pea soup
additional: Registration for the Volkslauf opens on August 1, 2026, via Race Result. A large cake buffet and pea soup are available for participants. The race is part of the Mittelhessen-Cup running series, which includes several events in the region. The club also offers regular running and walking meetups, as well as beginner courses. Running, walking, and hiking event; community activities; refreshments including a cake buffet and pea soup

name: Volks - und Feuerwehrlauf Rhede
price_range: 2,00 EUR (zusätzliche Gebühr bei Voranmeldung bis Limit)
description: The Volks- und Feuerwehrlauf Rhede is a traditional running event organized by the Rhede Fire Department. Held annually, it gives runners the opportunity to take part in a friendly and safe atmosphere. The races start at Rhede School Center and follow a varied route through the town. Prizes are awarded to the first four finishers in each category, and certificates and live results are available on site and online.
course_highlights: Start and finish at Rhede School Center, Büssingstraße 14
Varied route through Rhede
Live results on monitors in the finish area and online
additional: Late registration is possible for a fee of 2.00 EUR until 30 minutes before the relevant start. Registration is available on 02 October from 18:00 to 19:00 and on 03 October from 09:00 at the registration office. MP3 players are prohibited for safety reasons. Baby joggers and dogs are not allowed. Prizes are awarded to the first four finishers (male/female). The event takes place at Rhede School Center. Registration is on 2 and 3 October. Participation rules include safety requirements such as not using MP3 players and not bringing strollers or dogs. Results are available live and online.

name: Bismarckturmlauf
location: Neustadt an der Orla, Thuringia, Germany

name: 26. Generali Köln Marathon
organizer: Kölner Marathon Veranstaltungs- und Werbe GmbH
description: The Generali Cologne Marathon is a unique running experience that combines elite and recreational sport with carnival, a street festival and a running festival. The course passes through lively Cologne neighbourhoods such as Rodenkirchen, Lindenthal, Ehrenfeld and Nippes, and finishes spectacularly at Cologne Cathedral. With up to 15,000 participants, the marathon offers an exhilarating atmosphere, supported by thousands of spectators along the course. The event also places great importance on sustainability and offers a varied programme of activities.
course_highlights: Start in Deutz at Ottoplatz, with panoramic views of Cologne Cathedral and the Old Town
Pass Rudolfplatz three times, with strong spectator support
Course through diverse neighbourhoods such as Südstadt, Ehrenfeld and Nippes
additional: The marathon starts in Deutz at Ottoplatz and passes several relay and school-marathon changeover zones. There are 11 refreshment stations for the marathon and 6 for the half marathon. The marathon is limited to 15,000 participants. The course passes well-known Cologne landmarks and neighbourhoods, and the finish is at Cologne Cathedral. The event values sustainability and offers a varied programme of activities featuring carnival and a running festival. Registration is open; various race disciplines, limited entries, special competitions for students, sustainable event

name: Soester Stadtlauf
price_range: abhängig von der Distanz (Infos im Anmeldeportal)
description: Experience the traditional Soest City Run, a sporting highlight for young and old in the historic city centre of Soest. Whether you’re a recreational runner, a competitive athlete or running with your family, together you’ll make the day an unforgettable experience, with a unique atmosphere along the course. The event offers various race distances, an appealing supporting programme, and refreshments for all participants and guests.
course_highlights: Start and finish in the heart of the historic old town
Atmospheric run through Soest city centre
Commentary, music and refreshments along the course
additional: Race distances: children’s races 475m (start 12:00), school races 950m (born 2016–2018, start 12:45) and 1450m (born 2006–2015, start 14:15), main races 4km (start 15:00) and 10km (start 15:45). Parking available on the outskirts of town, with a shuttle service. Drinks and snack stands for participants and guests. An appealing family programme and on-site commentary. Various race distances, start and finish in the heart of the old town, refreshments, shuttle service, awards ceremony immediately after the races.

name: 14. Burgdorfer Spargel-Lauf
description: The Burgdorf Asparagus Run is an annual running event held as part of the Oktobermarkt town festival in Burgdorf. On 4 October 2026, the 14th edition of this popular event will take place, welcoming recreational runners of all ages. The courses run along the Aue and through the city centre, with the start and finish at the Aue Bridge, Poststraße / Braunschweiger Straße. The event offers 2.5 km, 5 km and 10 km runs, as well as Nordic walking and a children’s run.

name: 23. Mitteldeutscher Marathon
description: The 23rd Central German Marathon on October 4, 2026, offers a unique running experience through the Central German metropolitan region, starting in Leipzig and finishing in Halle (Saale). The route passes through two federal states and two cities. The marathon starts at the Sportforum in Leipzig and finishes in Halle, a cultural capital with a history spanning more than 1,200 years. Other events include the Händel Run Half Marathon, the half-marathon relay, the 10 km run, 10 km walking, the Salzwirker Run, and the AOK Fun Run. The event combines a sporting challenge with cultural highlights and green running paths in the city of Händel.

name: Boitzer Herbstlauf
description: The Boitzer Autumn Run is a local autumn race with walking in Walsrode, Lower Saxony, organized by the SV Kirchboitzen sports club. In 2026, the event will be held in person for the 19th time and is open to runners and walkers of all ages. Participants can get the key information directly from the organizing team on site. Further practical details are provided by SV Kirchboitzen.

name: Cottbuser Oktoberlauf
description: The Cottbus October Run is a traditional running event held at the Cottbus Sports Centre, in the athletics stadium and mainly in the forest on firm paths and cycle paths. The event offers various distances ranging from 400 metres to the half marathon (21.1 km), with routes that include both paved and unpaved paths. Children and young people can take part in special races with obstacles and varied course sections. Participants receive a commemorative medal and can access their certificates online. The event is part of the Sparkassen Running and Walking Cup and offers trophies and prizes to the top runners in various age groups.

name: Gaudilauf 14
organizer: Lauf- und Walkingverein 05 Bad Liebenwerda e.V.
description: The Gaudilauf is a traditional race taking place on October 4, 2026, in Bad Liebenwerda. The route leads from Munich via Bad Liebenwerda and back to Munich, offering a scenic course along the Elster. The event is known for its friendly atmosphere, with the competitive aspect taking a back seat. Refreshments are provided every 5 kilometers, and a relaxed celebration with drinks and grilled food awaits participants at the finish. A bus transfer from the finish back to the start is available on request.

name: Herbstlauf
description: The Ovenhausen Autumn Run is a traditional race held annually on the first Sunday in October and organized by TuS Ovenhausen. The event offers various distances for different age and performance groups, including a challenging 20.8 km tour through forests and hills, as well as shorter races for young athletes. The course is varied, with sections on cycle paths, in the Grubestadion, and through the forest. The race is suitable for both competitive runners and recreational athletes, and usually takes place in pleasant autumn weather.

name: Luftschifflauf
description: The TURCK Airship Run at Essen/Mülheim Airport offers a unique running experience on the airport runway. The flat, fast course, with no tight turns or elevation gain, is ideal for setting personal bests. The highlight is the spectacular finish inside the impressive WDL airship hangar, making the race an unforgettable event. This family-friendly event offers various distances for children, teenagers, and adults and takes place in all weather conditions.

name: Mitteldeutscher Marathon
description: The Central German Marathon is a unique running experience in the heart of Germany, connecting the Central German metropolitan region on a fast course between Leipzig and Halle (Saale). The classic marathon course, which hosted the first German marathon in 1925, runs from the city of Bach, Leipzig, to Halle, the cultural capital. In addition to the marathon, other events include the Händel Run Half Marathon, the half-marathon relay, the 10K run, 10K walking, and the Salzwirker Run. The event offers a varied program and is suitable for runners of all ability levels.

name: 25 Poznań Maraton
description: The 25th Maciej Frankiewicz Poznań Marathon is the jubilee 25th edition of the classic 42.195 km distance, taking place on October 4, 2026, in Poznań. For a quarter of a century, the race has brought together thousands of runners and spectators, offering a new, attractive course that starts and finishes at the Poznań International Fairgrounds. The organizers provide professional medical support, timekeeping, and a generous race pack. It is a unique sporting celebration, backed by enthusiastic support from Poznań’s spectators and a rich tradition.

name: [UITVERKOCHT] Rottemerenloop Bleiswijk 2026

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Kosten inclusief medaille: Kwart marathon: 15,00 euro

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Kosten inclusief medaille: Halve marathon: 20,00 euro

description: The Rottemerenloop 2026 takes place on Saturday, 3 October in Bleiswijk and offers a varied programme with a Kids Run of approximately 1,600 metres, a quarter marathon of 10.5 km and a half marathon of 21.1 km. The start and finish are at ‘De Sneeuwbal’, Lange Vaart 17a. Participants receive a timing chip in their race number for electronic timekeeping and can receive a medal after the race. The course has water stations and offers a scenic running experience in a green setting.
course_highlights: Kids Run of approximately 1,600 metres for the youngest runners
Quarter marathon of 10.5 km and half marathon of 21.1 km
Water stations at 5 and 16 km for the half marathon and at 5 km for the quarter marathon
additional: Race numbers will not be sent out; details will be communicated by email on 2 October. Kieviten youth members can take part in the Kids Run and quarter marathon for free, provided they register as a Kievit. Time limits: 1 hour 30 minutes for the quarter marathon and 2 hours 40 minutes for the half marathon. Every participant who finishes will receive a medal. No late registration is possible. Water stations are available along the course. If you need extra water, bringing your own hydration belt is recommended. Terrain: route through Bleiswijk, water stations available, chip timing, medal at the finish.

name: TREK Singelloop Utrecht
price_range: €27 voor het limited edition hardloopshirt, inschrijfgeld niet expliciet vermeld
description: The TREK Singelloop Utrecht is the oldest road race in the Netherlands and an annual running celebration in the beautiful city of Utrecht. The race offers a fast, fully traffic-free route along Utrecht’s canals and through Wilhelminapark, where thousands of runners enjoy the course from start to finish. In addition to the 10 km and 5 km, there are also Kids Runs, Business Runs and a half marathon. The organisers support KWF Cancer Control and encourage participants to raise funds for this good cause.
course_highlights: Flat, paved and fully traffic-free roads
Route along Utrecht’s canals and through Wilhelminapark
Officially measured courses for the 5 km, 10 km and half marathon
additional: Start waves are used to ensure a smooth and safe start, with waves approximately 15 minutes apart for the 5 km and 20 minutes apart for the 10 km. Race bibs can be sent to your home for €4.50 if you register before 31 August; otherwise, they must be collected at the event grounds. A unique limited-edition running shirt can be ordered for €27. Refreshments are available along the course and after the finish. The organisers encourage participants to raise funds for KWF Cancer Control through their own fundraising page. Participants can register via the official website, with options to fundraise for KWF Cancer Control and take part in different distances.

name: Prevox Startbaan-loop
description: De Prevox Startbaanloop is een maandelijkse hardloopwedstrijd die plaatsvindt op de atletiekbaan van AV Startbaan in Amstelveen. De wedstrijd biedt afstanden van 1, 3 en 5 kilometer, waarbij de 1 kilometer ook toegankelijk is voor jeugdige lopers. Met elektronische tijdwaarneming worden nauwkeurig de rondetijden en eindtijden geregistreerd. Op zondag 4 oktober 2026 vindt de 55e editie van deze populaire loop plaats, waarbij voorinschrijving mogelijk is via Inschrijven.nl.

name: Hema Volksloop 4 oktober
description: De HEMA IJzeren Man Volksloop is een laagdrempelige en ontspannen hardloopwedstrijd die elke eerste zondag van de maand plaatsvindt in Weert. Hardlopers van alle leeftijden en niveaus lopen samen een prachtige route langs het water en door het groene landschap van de IJzeren Man. De Volksloop richt zich op bewegen en genieten, waarbij iedereen op zijn eigen tempo kan deelnemen. Er zijn verschillende afstanden beschikbaar, met speciale jeugdafstanden en een tijdslimiet voor de senioren. De start is bij het strandje voor het Hertenkamp aan de Geurtsvenweg.

name: 0522 RUN – Urban City Run Meppel
description: De 0522 RUN - Urban City Run Meppel is een unieke verkenningsloop van 5,22 km door de binnenstad van Meppel, georganiseerd door JCI Meppel-Reestmond. Het is geen wedstrijd, maar een beleving waarbij deelnemers de mooiste straten, bedrijven, pleinen en bezienswaardigheden van Meppel ontdekken, ondersteund door verrassend entertainment onderweg. De loop heeft geen tijdregistratie of prestatiedruk, maar draait om plezier en het beleven van de stad. Na de finish is er een gezellige afterparty in het hart van Meppel. De opbrengst van het evenement gaat naar Stichting De (W)arme Kant van Meppel, die praktische hulp biedt aan stadsgenoten die het financieel moeilijk hebben.

name: Bridge2Bridge Run
description: De Bridge2Bridge run 2026 is de 19e editie van deze jaarlijkse hardloopwedstrijd georganiseerd door Orion Venlo. De race vindt plaats in Blerick, Venlo, en biedt afstanden van 5 km, 10 km en jeugdloopjes van 500 m en 1000 m. De wedstrijd kenmerkt zich door een sportieve en recreatieve sfeer, met startnummers die op de wedstrijddag vanaf 9:00 uur kunnen worden afgehaald. De Bridge2Bridge run is een mooie gelegenheid voor zowel beginnende als ervaren hardlopers om hun conditie te testen en te genieten van een goed georganiseerd evenement.

name: Hoge Veluwe Loop
description: De Hoge Veluwe Loop is een sfeervolle hardloopwedstrijd in het hart van Nationaal Park De Hoge Veluwe, met routes over onverharde paden van 5,5 km, 12,5 km en 20 km. De 20 km trailrun biedt een uitdagend parcours met meer dan 200 hoogtemeters en natuurlijke verzorgingsposten, ideaal voor de geoefende loper. Voor beginners is er de Bosloop van 5,5 km met mooie paden en een optie voor een uitdagender alternatief. Kinderen kunnen meedoen aan de Moeffie Run in drie leeftijdscategorieën. De start en finish zijn bij het Park Paviljoen in het centrum van het park, waar ook diverse faciliteiten zijn.

name: Kanonsloop
description: De Kanonsloop Groenlo is een sfeervol hardloopevenement dat op zondag 4 oktober 2026 voor de 38e keer wordt georganiseerd. De wedstrijd biedt een vernieuwd 10 km parcours langs bekende plekken in en rondom Groenlo, zoals Bommelwereld, Camping Marveld, de Groenlose gracht en stadspark De Grolse Weiden. Naast de 10 km is er ook een vertrouwde 5 km afstand, en er is een speciale bedrijvenloop met een gezellige afsluiting bij Brouwernös Proeflokaal. De start en finish zijn bij de Muziekkoepel aan de Maliebaan / Wheme in Groenlo. De organisatie zorgt voor een veilige en sportieve sfeer met verkeersregelaars en tijdsregistratie via Race Result.

name: Klaverblad van Noordenveld
description: Het Klaverblad van Noordenveld is een sfeervol wandelevenement dat plaatsvindt op zondag 4 oktober 2026 bij het Ronostrand in Een. De routes variëren van 4 tot 30 kilometer en voeren door natuurgebieden met een mix van verharde en onverharde paden. Uniek is dat alle afstanden, behalve de Beleefroute, langs de zandwinning lopen, een normaal gesloten gebied dat speciaal voor deze jubileumeditie toegankelijk is. Voor kinderen is er een speciale Beleefroute van 4 km vol spel en avontuur. De start en finish zijn centraal gelegen bij het Ronostrand, wat zorgt voor een gezellige en toegankelijke sfeer voor alle wandelaars.

name: Lexis Crossloop Zuidwolde
description: De Lexis Crossloop Zuidwolde is een uitdagende crossloop die jaarlijks plaatsvindt op de eerste zondag van oktober in het Faliebergbos, met start en finish bij Camping De Entekoele. Het parcours voert over onverharde paden en bevat de pittige beklimming van de Falieberg, geschikt voor zowel beginnende als ervaren lopers. Naast de 5 en 10 km crosslopen zijn er ook een canicross, kidsruns en een nieuwe wandeltocht van 5 km over het parcours. De sfeer is laagdrempelig en geschikt voor alle leeftijden, met na afloop gelegenheid voor een kop koffie en een koek in de kantine.

name: Coevorder Crossloop
description: De Coevorder Crossloop vindt plaats op 4 oktober 2026 rondom de Klinkenvlierse Plas in Coevorden. De start en finish zijn op het terrein van de ijsbaan. Deelnemers kunnen kiezen uit afstanden van 1,5 km (jeugd), 3 km, 6 km en 9 km. Het parcours bestaat uit uitdagende rondes van 3 km en biedt een mooie gelegenheid om samen met andere lopers te trainen en te genieten van de natuur rondom de plas.

name: AV Spirit Wintercup
description: De AV Spirit Wintercup is een laagdrempelig recreatief hardloop- en wandelevenement in Lelystad, dat plaatsvindt op de eerste zondag van elke maand van oktober tot en met maart. Iedereen kan meedoen, jong of oud, hardlopend of wandelend. Het seizoen 2026-2027 start op 4 oktober met nieuwe routes voor de 5 en 10 kilometer. Er is een klassement voor de 5 en 10 kilometer waarbij de beste vier van vijf prestaties meetellen, en er zijn speciale KidsRuns met thema's en medailles. De Wintercup combineert sportiviteit met gezelligheid en is toegankelijk voor iedereen, ook niet-leden.

name: Halve Marathon Oldenzaal

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Voorinschrijving 1 mei tot 1 september 2026: € 23,00 (startbewijs wordt thuisgestuurd)

tiers.label: tier_2
tiers.description: Inschrijving 2 september tot en met 4 oktober 2026, 10.00 uur: € 28,00 (startbewijs ophalen in het Twents Carmel College)

description: The Oldenzaal Half Marathon is a popular running race held in the rolling Twente countryside. The half-marathon route passes several highlights, including Tankenberg, Wilmersberg, Hakenberg and Paasberg. It is mostly paved, with drink stations every 5 kilometers. The race is suitable for both individual runners and corporate teams, and has a time limit of 2 hours and 30 minutes. Alongside the half marathon, there are also 10-kilometer and 5-kilometer races, a corporate race and school races, making the event accessible to a wide audience.
course_highlights: Route through the rolling Twente countryside, with highlights including Tankenberg, Wilmersberg, Hakenberg and Paasberg
Mostly paved course with drink stations every 5 kilometers
Time limit of 2 hours and 30 minutes for the half marathon
additional: The half marathon has a time limit of 2 hours and 30 minutes. If you arrive at the Bisschopstraat/Oostwal intersection after 13:55, you will be directed off the course. Race bibs for pre-registered participants are sent to their homes; those registering later must collect theirs at Twents Carmel College. There are also several other distances and a corporate race. Young participants have separate start times for the 1 km and 2 km school races. Information about course changes, start times, registration tips and safety. The event is popular with local and recreational runners.

name: 43e Tata Steel Marquetteloop
distance_verbose: Halve marathon, 14 km, 7 km, 3.3 km, 1.3 km
price_range: tegen verhoogd tarief op de dag van het evenement
description: The Tata Steel Marquetteloop is an annual road running event in Heemskerk, organized for the 43rd time in 2026. The race offers several distances, including 3.3 km, 7 km, 14 km, and a half marathon of 21.1 km, making it suitable for recreational and more experienced runners alike. The event takes place on Sunday, October 4, 2026, and is organized by AV Dem. The atmosphere is sporty and challenging, with a playful theme that lets participants compete to become the “ruler of Heemskerk.”
course_highlights: Road race in Heemskerk, starting and finishing on Marquettelaan
Distances ranging from 3.3 km to a half marathon (21.1 km)
Includes a kids’ run for young runners
additional: There are currently no race entries available. The event is organized by AV Dem. It has a playful “Speel Run Risk” theme, with participants competing for the title of “ruler of Heemskerk.” Distances for all ages, running clinics, a schools championship, volunteer opportunities, family-friendly event

name: 8 van Drachten
description: De 8 van Drachten is an annual running event in the heart of Friesland, suitable for all ages. With various distances, including an 8 km race, a KidsRun and a Business Run, the event offers a suitable challenge for every runner. The scenic course and sporting community make this a festive and professionally organised running experience in Drachten. The 22nd edition takes place on Sunday, 4 October 2026.
course_highlights: Scenic course in the heart of Drachten
Distances for all ages, including the KidsRun and Business Run
Sporting community and professional organisation
additional: Registration closes on 12 September 2026 at 12:00 and is available online only. Late registration is not possible. Race numbers can be transferred via a resale platform. The prize-giving takes place immediately after the race events. The KidsRun starts at 14:00, and the 8 km and Business Run start at 15:00. Registration is available via the website, and the event is supported by an active online community on Instagram.

name: Rondje Bergen
price_range: early bird korting vanaf mei 2026, exacte prijzen niet vermeld
description: Rondje Bergen is a friendly running event held annually on the first Sunday of October in Bergen (NH). The event offers several distances, including a 1 km junior run and races of 5 km, 10 km and 10 English miles. It is known for its enthusiastic atmosphere and is organised entirely by volunteers. Participants receive a commemorative medal, and prizes are awarded to the best runners in various categories.
course_highlights: Distances range from a 1 km junior run to 10 English miles
The junior run starts in age groups at 1-minute intervals
Prize-giving takes place shortly after each distance next to the finish
additional: Individual registration closes on 30 September 2026 at 23:59. Registration on the day of the event is not possible. Race bibs can be resold through the official platform until 20 September 2026. The junior run is for children up to and including 13 years old and starts in age groups at 1-minute intervals. All participants receive a commemorative medal. Prize-giving takes place shortly after each distance next to the finish. Registration opens on 8 May 2026; prizes for top runners; medals for all participants; volunteers wanted

name: 57e Langs de Gouweloop
description: The 57th Langs de Gouweloop takes place on Sunday, October 4, 2026, in Waddinxveen, with the start and finish at Gouweplein by the shopping centre. This annual family running event, organised by Sportclub Antilope, offers something for everyone: a 1.3 km Kids Run for children up to 12 years old and 5 km and 10 km races for runners aged 12 and over. The route is a 5-kilometre loop, run twice for the 10 km. The event is known for its friendly atmosphere and sporting achievements, and welcomes both beginners and experienced runners.
course_highlights: A 5-kilometre loop, run twice for the 10 km
Start and finish at Gouweplein at Winkelcentrum Waddinxveen
Suitable for all ages, with a Kids Run and races
additional: Race numbers can be collected at Sporthal De Dreef, opposite the shopping centre. On-the-day registration is available until half an hour before the start. There is no electronic timekeeping; times can be read from a clock at the start and finish. Parking is available at Sporthal De Dreef and in the car park beneath the shopping centre, with the first two hours free. Course along Gouweplein, discounted registration, family-friendly event

name: Warburger Stundenlauf 2026
description: The 34th Warburg Hour Run takes place on October 7, 2026, in Warburg. The competition is aimed at adults and offers both individual and team categories. The course is flat and the event lasts one hour. There are also competitions for children and young people; details can be found in the organizer’s official announcement.
course_highlights: Flat course
Duration: 1 hour
Individual and team categories available
additional: A competition for children and young people is also offered. The start and finish are at Hüffertsportplatz; exact location details require RUNME Premium. The event is part of the RUNME race calendar. Participants receive certificates and trophies; registration is online; the event takes place in October, weather permitting.

name: Herbstcross auf dem Bergfried
description: The Herbstcross auf dem Bergfried is a short autumn cross-country race held on the grounds of the Bergfried in Saalfeld, Germany. Distances range from 800 m to 4.8 km and are designed for fast off-road running rather than long road races. The race takes place outside the stadium and is classified as both a hill race and a cross-country race. The Saalfelder Leichtathletikverein has organized the event for many years, with separate races for children and adults and various age groups.

name: NightRun Borne
description: Op vrijdag 9 oktober 2026 vindt de eerste editie van de NightRun Borne plaats, een sfeervolle avondloop door het centrum van Borne. Deelnemers lopen of wandelen een route van ongeveer 7 kilometer, met een optie voor 5 kilometer, waarbij ze door winkels en bijzondere panden gaan die speciaal voor het evenement hun deuren openen. De NightRun Borne is geen wedstrijd; er is geen tijdsregistratie en iedereen is een winnaar. Het evenement draait om beleving, plezier en samen genieten in een magische sfeer vol licht en energie.

name: Lysfald Løbet 3. oktober i Fårup Sommerland 2026
Bohusläns Bästa
location: Havstenssund to TanumStrand, Tanum Municipality, Sweden
description: Bohusläns Bästa is a 22 km trail race from Havstenssund to TanumStrand and the final race in the Outnorth Trailtour. The race offers a scenic course with cliffs, jetties, the scent of seaweed and views that soothe the mind while the body works hard. Sweden’s trail-running elite gather here for exciting races in a unique setting where mountains, forest and sea meet. Participants can also extend the experience with accommodation and a banquet at TanumStrand Spa & Resort.
course_highlights: 22 km of trail running from Havstenssund to TanumStrand
Scenic views featuring cliffs, jetties and the scent of seaweed
Part of the Outnorth Trailtour, featuring Sweden’s trail-running elite
additional: Accommodation and a banquet are offered at TanumStrand Spa & Resort to round out the weekend. Subscribers get access to a newsletter with current information and offers, including 20% off Asics trail shoes at Outnorth. The organizer’s text recommends accommodation and a banquet at TanumStrand.

name: Skrylle Challenge
location: Skryllegården, Södra Sandby, Lund Municipality, Sweden
description: Skrylle Challenge is a running event held at Skryllegården in Södra Sandby. The race offers a challenging 25 km course for both women and men, where participants can experience beautiful scenery and varied terrain in the Skrylle area. The event brings together runners from different clubs and towns, creating a sense of community and competition. Skrylle Challenge is a popular race for both experienced runners and enthusiasts looking to test their endurance in a scenic setting.
course_highlights: 25 km of running on varied terrain
Scenic views in the Skrylle area
A challenging course for both women and men
additional: Participant lists show separate bib numbers and clubs for women and men in the 25 km class.

name: Bromöllamilen
description: Bromöllamilen is a running race organised by Ryssbergets IK in Bromölla, with the start and finish at Sparbankshallen. The course is clearly marked with arrows, lines and tape, and marshals are on hand to guide participants. Runners can expect water stations serving water and sports drink, as well as a pleasant atmosphere with coffee and grilled sausages served after the race. Prizes are awarded to the top finishers in each class, and medical staff are available in the start and finish area. By registering, participants consent to the publication of their names and results and to the use of photographs and videos from the race.
course_highlights: The course is marked at every kilometre with arrows, lines and tape
Water stations serving water and sports drink at the lap point and finish
Start and finish at Sparbankshallen in Bromölla
additional: Bib numbers must be collected from Sparbankshallen no later than 30 minutes before the start and worn on the front of the chest. The prize ceremony begins at 12:30. Registration is primarily by advance entry, but late registration may be available on site. Medical staff are available at the start and finish. The event follows the Swedish Athletics Association’s rules for road races. Race information states that prizes are awarded to the top finishers in each class. Bib numbers must be collected no later than 30 minutes before the start. The published information applies to the 2026 edition and does not confirm the date 9 October 2027.

name: Göteborg Marathon
description: Göteborg Marathon is a traditional race being held for the 52nd time, offering both a marathon and a half marathon. The course is flat and straight, with the start and finish at the historic Slottsskogsvallen in Göteborg. It follows an out-and-back route along the old coastal railway embankment, with beautiful views of the sea and archipelago. The race is well organised, with aid stations every four kilometres and a friendly atmosphere welcoming runners of all abilities. It’s a perfect race for anyone looking to run fast and enjoy a scenic course near the sea.
course_highlights: Flat and straight course along the old coastal railway embankment
Turnaround at the Lilla Amundön boat storage area after approximately 10.5 km
Aid stations every four kilometres with water, sports drink, Coca-Cola, bananas and raisins
additional: The start and finish are inside Slottsskogsvallen. Marathon start group 1 starts at 10:00; half-marathon start group 2 (finish time under 1 hour 45 minutes) starts at 10:30; and half-marathon start group 3 (finish time over 1 hour 45 minutes) starts at 10:45. After finishing, participants are offered a drink and a sandwich. You can have your own fluids or energy products transported to the aid stations. You can sell or transfer your entry place until 2026-10-07 via the marketplace on MittLopp.se for a fee of 100 kr. The bib number must be worn visibly throughout the race. The race offers a marathon and a half marathon. The course was officially measured in 2024.

name: Running Lights Alingsås 2026
description: Running Lights is a magical running event held during the famous Lights in Alingsås festival. The race offers distances for all ages and levels, from the Knatteloppet for the youngest runners to 10 km for more experienced runners. Enjoy a running celebration amid magical lighting, through beautifully illuminated areas in central Alingsås. Running Lights is also part of the Västsvenska löparcupen, offering extra competition opportunities for club runners.
course_highlights: Start and finish at the top of Stora torget (Kungsgatan)
Routes through beautifully illuminated areas during Lights in Alingsås
Distances from 300 m to 10 km, with varied loops around squares and parks
additional: Start times by distance: Maxi-Knatte 300m at 16:00, Energiloppet 600m at 16:30, Ungdomsloppet 1660m at 16:45, Stafetten 3 x 1660m at 17:05, 5 km at 18:00, 10 km at 19:00. The routes are loops around Stora torget, the river, the squares and Museiparken. The relay is for teams of 3 people, each running one lap. Bib pickup and the running expo are held at Estrad, Bryggerigatan 2. The race is part of the Västsvenska Långloppscupen and Västsvenska löparcupen.

name: Borgen Outdoor Run
description: Borgen Outdoor Run is a challenging trail race held in the Alandsryd terrain at Friluftsgården Borgen in Värnamo. The race offers a fun and varied course featuring a ski slope and forest trails, giving participants a wonderful nature experience. The event is well established and attracts runners who appreciate both a challenge and a sense of community in a scenic setting.
course_highlights: Trail race in the Alandsryd terrain
Passage through the Alandsrydsbacken ski slope, with elevation changes
Scenic and varied course with forest trails
additional: Groundwork is underway at the Alandsrydsbacken ski slope (between 2–3 km) to increase the vertical drop, which may lead to minor course adjustments in that area. According to the event information, the race is open to all ages, and participants can run individually or as part of a pre-registered team. Information about the distance and format refers to a previous edition; details for 2027 have not been confirmed in the sources.

name: Bergensløpet høst

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Er du under 15 år betaler du 200kr for et løp

tiers.label: tier_2
tiers.description: Er du under 15 år betaler du 350kr for to

tiers.label: tier_3
tiers.description: For andre er prisen 400kr for et løp

tiers.label: tier_4
tiers.description: For andre er prisen 700kr for to

description: Bergensløpet celebrates an anniversary with a double running festival in beautiful surroundings in Bergen. The race starts and finishes in historic Nygårdsparken and runs along Store Lungegårdsvann, Fløen and Møllendal. Two distances are offered, 5 km and 10 km, both on a fast, officially measured course. A free children's race is also held for children up to 11 years old, with a medal for every participant.
course_highlights: Start and finish in historic Nygårdsparken
The course runs along Store Lungegårdsvann, Fløen and Møllendal
Fast, officially measured 5 km course; the 10 km runners complete two laps
additional: Race bibs can be collected from 09:45 at Vitalitetssenteret by Møhlenpris sports ground. Toilets are available at the collection point and in the clubhouses. The children's race starts at 12:00, the 5 km at 13:00, and the 10 km at 14:00. The children's race is approximately 500 metres, free, and has no timing or rankings; all children receive a medal. The autumn edition is listed as taking place on Saturday, 10 October. The date for the 2027 edition matches the race date of 9 October in the listing.

name: Flisa Backyard
description: Flisa Backyard is a friendly autumn event held at beautiful Myrmoen in Flisa. The race welcomes everyone who wants to challenge themselves, test their fitness or simply enjoy a fantastic day in beautiful surroundings. The event is open to everyone born in 2013 or earlier and offers an inclusive, magical atmosphere. The race is organised by Flisa Allianseidrettslag, which has a long tradition as a sports club in the area.
course_highlights: The race takes place at beautiful Myrmoen in scenic surroundings
Open to everyone born in 2013 or earlier
One of the autumn’s friendliest events, with an inclusive atmosphere
additional: Everyone born in 2013 or earlier may participate. The event is organised by Flisa Allianseidrettslag, which has used Rubic as its membership system. Registration is via racetracker.no. Flisa Backyard is an inclusive, social race in the scenic surroundings of Myrmoen. The listed registration price is 450 kr, increasing to 550 kr from 18 January, 650 kr from 1 April and 750 kr from 1 August. Registration includes a choice of single-event or annual licence, and camping can be reserved.

name: Gausta Challenge
location: Gausta Fjellresort, Gausta, Tinn, Telemark, Norway
organizer: Rjukan IL – Friidrett & Triathlon og Gaustablikk Fjellresort
description: Gausta Challenge is a low-key race held on Saturday, October 9, 2027, at Gausta Fjellresort. The race runs around Kvitåvatn on an approximately 6 km gravel road, starting and finishing by the paddle tennis courts. The race is suitable for all ages and levels, with wave starts and timing, and participants can run, walk, or take it easy. The event is a collaboration between Rjukan IL - Friidrett & Triathlon and Gaustablikk Fjellresort, and aims to promote physical activity in beautiful autumn surroundings.
course_highlights: Approximately 6 km gravel course around Kvitåvatn
Start and finish at Gausta Fjellresort, by the paddle tennis courts
The course is hilly, with a long downhill section and flat stretches
additional: Wave starts with timing. The children’s race for ages 0–10 starts at 14:00. The 6 km race is open to participants aged 10 to 99. The start and finish are by the paddle tennis courts near the floating saunas. The course is run counterclockwise. Gausta Challenge 2027 takes place on Saturday, October 9, at 13:00. The children’s race starts at 14:00. The 6 km course is for participants aged 10 and over.

name: BKK Walking am Baldeneysee mit Mini-Marathon
description: BKK Walking at Lake Baldeney is part of the Westenergie Marathon weekend in Essen and offers a varied program for walkers, Nordic walkers and runners. The main marathon runs twice around Lake Baldeney, with an additional turnaround section, and features a flat profile and fast cycle paths. The marathon has been held annually since 1963, making it Germany’s oldest event of its kind. The event is organized by the athletics department of TUSEM Essen with the support of numerous volunteers. The number of participants is limited to 3,000 to avoid bottlenecks on the course.
course_highlights: Flat course around Lake Baldeney
Two laps, with an additional turnaround section on the first lap
Fast cycle paths and early autumn weather
additional: The number of participants is limited to 3,000 because of bottlenecks on the course. The walking program offers routes of up to 14 km. The event takes place annually on the second Sunday in October. Organized by the athletics department of TUSEM Essen with support from volunteers. Distances: 1.1 km, 7 km, 42.2 km; participant limit of 3,000; October weather around 14°C, cloudy; registration with the organizer recommended.

name: Coesfelder DJK - Citylauf
description: The 32nd Coesfeld City Run takes place on October 10, 2026, in Coesfeld. The event is organized by DJK Eintracht Coesfeld e.V. and gives runners of all ages the opportunity to take part in sport. The city run combines recreational, competitive, health and rehabilitation sports and is an established event in the region. Online registration is available via the official website.
course_highlights: Measured, flat city courses through the historic town center
A variety of race distances for all age and ability groups
Attractive prizes, certificates and trophies for top runners and teams
additional: The organizer’s office is open Monday to Friday from 08:00 to 12:00 and 14:30 to 18:00. The office is closed on December 24 and 31 and on public holidays. The website credits photos to photobello and provides entry lists for the individual races. Road/cross-country run, registration open, various race distances, start and finish in Coesfeld town center, age categories for children, recreational runners, club members and older participants

name: Wadersloher Volkslauf
description: The Wadersloh Volkslauf is a long-standing running event in Wadersloh, welcoming runners of all ages and ability levels. Officially measured 5 km and 10 km courses are available and are eligible for rankings until 2029. There are also shorter races for children and walking routes. The event takes place at the Sportpark on Winkelstraße and offers a family-friendly atmosphere, with a start-number deposit and timekeeping.
course_highlights: The 5 km and 10 km courses are officially measured and eligible for rankings until 31.12.2029
600 m Bambini run and 1000 m schoolchildren’s race on the synthetic track at the Sportpark
7.5 km walking and Nordic walking route available
additional: A start-number deposit of 2.00 EUR is collected by SEPA direct debit when registering online and refunded in cash on the event day when the start number with chip is returned. The 5 km and 10 km races are officially measured and have DLV approval until 2029. Photos and videos are taken and published as part of the event. Measured courses, online registration, start numbers with chips, sponsors

name: Vorlauf zum Harz-Gebirgslauf
description: The Harz Mountain Run warm-up is a free test run held one week before the main race. It gives runners the opportunity to check their fitness and get to know the Harz Mountain Run courses. The event starts together at 9:30 a.m. in Himmelpforte, Wernigerode, and offers distances of 2 km, 5 km, 11 km, and 22 km. At the finish, participants are welcomed with tea and bread with lard. No registration is required, but the courses are not yet marked.

name: 25. Volkslauf um den Altwarmbüchener See
description: The Volkslauf around Lake Altwarmbüchen is part of the Sparkassen-Laufpass der Region Hannover, one of Germany’s largest running series, with 43 events in 2026. The race gives runners the opportunity to discover the Hannover Region on foot and take part in a varied range of running events. Each participation earns a stamp in the running pass, which is available both digitally and in a traditional format. The event is aimed at recreational athletes and promotes active movement in the region.

name: Brakelsieker Volkslauf "Am Fuße des Mörths"
description: The Brakelsiek fun run “At the Foot of the Mörth” is a classic local running, walking, and Nordic walking event in Schieder-Schwalenberg, held on a Saturday afternoon in October. Various distances are offered for adults and young people, including 5 km, 9 km, and 15 km runs, as well as 5 km and 9 km walking and Nordic walking. The start and finish are at the Brakelsiek sports field, and the route runs around the village sports field, with a gently rolling rural profile at the foot of the Mörth. The event offers a lovely opportunity to enjoy the autumn landscape in a relaxed atmosphere.

name: Parforceheide Crosslauf
