description: The Parforceheide Cross-Country Run has been organized by RSV Eintracht 1949 in Stahnsdorf since 2008, giving recreational runners in the region the opportunity to discover the varied landscape of the Parforceheide. The course starts at the sports ground on Heinrich-Zille-Straße and passes the Südwestfriedhof cemetery, continuing through woods and natural surroundings with small climbs, sandy sections, and stretches of asphalt and cobblestones. Races are offered over 1 km (Bambini), 3 km (schoolchildren), 5 km, and 10 km for young people and adults. After the run, the organizer provides food and refreshments, and football matches are often held at the sports ground, making for a lovely day of sport for participants and their companions.

name: Solvay Lauf
description: The Solvay Run Bernburg is a 5 km race in Bernburg, Saxony-Anhalt, taking place on October 10, 2026. The race starts at Krumbholzallee 8 at 10:00 a.m. It is part of the Solvay Cup and combines cross-country and road running, so it is not an easy, flat city course. It is aimed primarily at local clubs and usually attracts 100 to 300 runners. The event offers professional timing, online results, certificates, showers, changing rooms, parking, free bag drop-off, and refreshments at the finish.

name: Volkslauf mit Walking um den AWB See
description: The 25th Volkslauf with Walking around AWB Lake is a local running and walking event in Altwarmbüchen, a district of Isernhagen. The event offers short, flat distances around Altwarmbüchener See, with one lap measuring approximately 3.66 km. There are various running and walking routes for adults, as well as races for children and young people, making it a community running experience for the whole region. The start and finish are at Seestraße 23, and the races take place in the afternoon.

name: XIV Cross Centaura
location: Biały Bór, West Pomeranian Voivodeship, Poland

name: Janlouterloop
description: De Janlouterloop is een jaarlijks hardloopevenement in de Vlaardingse Broekpolder, georganiseerd ter nagedachtenis aan Jan Louter, een gepassioneerde hardloper en trainer die in 2024 overleed aan alvleesklierkanker. De loop biedt deelnemers de keuze uit drie hardloopafstanden (5, 10 en 15 kilometer) en een wandeltocht van 10 kilometer. Het evenement wordt georganiseerd door AV Fortuna en steunt het goede doel 'Support Casper', onderdeel van de Stichting Overleven met Alvleesklierkanker. De Janlouterloop combineert sportiviteit met saamhorigheid en natuurbeleving in een unieke polderomgeving.

name: 1 MIJL IN LINE
description: De 7e editie van de Mijl in Line wordt georganiseerd door Atletiekvereniging Cromstrijen op zaterdag 10 oktober 2026. Het is een unieke wedstrijd over 1.609 meter in een rechte lijn op de Lange Biesakkersweg, halverwege Klaaswaal en Numansdorp. Deelnemers kunnen genieten van een snelle en rechtlijnige route met een leuke beker voor iedere deelnemer en prijzen voor de winnaars. Inschrijven kan tot en met 9 oktober via inschrijven.nl, met mogelijkheid tot na-inschrijving op de dag zelf vanaf 16.00 uur.

name: 10e Oosterhoutse Trail
description: De Oosterhoutse Trail viert op zaterdag 10 oktober 2026 haar 10e jubileumeditie. Dit unieke trailrunning evenement biedt al tien jaar prachtige routes en uitdagende onverharde paden in een gezellige sfeer. Deelnemers kunnen kiezen uit drie verschillende afstanden, passend bij diverse niveaus. Speciaal voor deze jubileumeditie ontvangen de eerste 100 inschrijvers een exclusief jubileumshirt. Na de race wordt het jubileum gezamenlijk gevierd met een feestelijke afsluiting.

name: Mijn City Run Ede
description: Mijn City Run Ede is een uniek hardloopevenement dat plaatsvindt in het centrum van Ede op 10 oktober 2026. De wedstrijd bestaat uit een snelle en spectaculaire 1 kilometer door de binnenstad, met een laagdrempelig programma voor jong en oud, waaronder kidsruns, een familierun en een business run. De dag wordt afgesloten met een finale waarin de snelste recreanten het opnemen tegen (inter)nationale topatleten. Het evenement combineert sportiviteit met een feestelijke sfeer en is toegankelijk voor iedereen, ook voor sporters met een beperking.

name: Hernense Stratenloop
description: De Hernense Stratenloop is een kleinschalige, recreatieve hardloopwedstrijd die plaatsvindt in het pittoreske dorp Hernen. Op zaterdag 10 oktober 2026 wordt de 17e editie georganiseerd met vier afstanden: 600 meter, 1200 meter, 5 kilometer en 10 kilometer. De routes voeren door het dorp en het mooie buitengebied, langs het middeleeuwse kasteel, de korenmolen, het Hernense bos en het landelijke Leur. Het evenement is geschikt voor jong en oud en biedt een sportieve en gezellige middag met een warme sfeer en veel publiek langs de route.

name: PrattenburgRun
description: De PrattenburgRun is een hardloopwedstrijd die plaatsvindt op Landgoed Prattenburg in Veenendaal. De 11e editie wordt gehouden op zaterdag 10 oktober 2026 en trekt een breed publiek van hardloopliefhebbers. Er zijn drie afstanden: 5 km en 10 km, die gemarkeerd zijn, en een uitdagende trailrun van 15 km met ongeveer 178 hoogtemeters, waarbij deelnemers een GPX-bestand ontvangen voor navigatie. De opbrengst van het inschrijfgeld wordt besteed aan het beschermen van jonge loofbomen op het landgoed.

name: Venoseloop
description: De Venoseloop is een jaarlijkse hardloopwedstrijd die plaatsvindt op de tweede zaterdag van oktober in Vollenhove. De loop biedt afstanden van 5 en 10 kilometer en start om 11:00 uur vanaf vakantiepark 't Akkertien. De route voert door de prachtige natuur rondom Vollenhove, waardoor deelnemers kunnen genieten van de omgeving terwijl ze lopen. De Venoseloop staat bekend om zijn gastvrije sfeer en goede organisatie, met faciliteiten zoals kleed- en doucheruimtes, EHBO en tijdregistratie met IPICO-chipsysteem.

name: Run2Day Vlinderloop
description: De Run2Day Vlinderloop in Houten is een maandelijkse prestatieloop die plaatsvindt elke tweede zaterdag van september tot en met mei. De route voert door het buitengebied van Houten, langs onder andere kasteel Heemstede en het Amsterdam Rijnkanaal, en biedt een mooie mix van natuur en cultuur. De loop kent diverse afstanden, van 5,2 km tot de halve marathon, en is geschikt voor zowel jeugd als volwassenen. De start is bij Korfbal Vereniging Victum en de sfeer is gezellig en sportief, met aandacht voor samen lopen en plezier.

name: AVW 3bossentrail
description: De AVW 3Bossentrail vindt plaats op 10 oktober 2026 in Wieringerwerf en voert door drie bossen in de Wieringermeer. De routes variëren van 14 tot 28 kilometer en lopen over wandelpaden, singletracks en plankenpaden, waarbij het parcours zoveel mogelijk onverhard is. Er is ook een 14 km canitrail met aanlijnplicht voor honden. De trailrun legt de nadruk op het genieten van de natuur zonder wedstrijdelement, en er wordt gewerkt met startvakken voor een rustige start in het bos.

name: Eremitageløbet
description: The Eremitage Run is a cannonball race in hilly terrain north of Copenhagen. The recreational race always takes place in early October and is the only race in Dyrehaven, north of Copenhagen.

name: DGI Nordjysk Trail Cup 2026/2027 LIUF Trail
Royal Aarhus City Marathon 2027
location: Vester Allé ved ARoS, Aarhus C
description: Royal Aarhus City Marathon is the first city marathon in Aarhus since 2008. The route is one lap of 42.195 km, starting and finishing on Vester Allé by ARoS. You’ll run through the Marselisborg Forests, along the bay and past the Infinite Bridge, across the harbour and out to Aarhus Ø, past Dokk1 and the Cathedral, and around Brabrand Lake before returning to the city centre. The highest point on the route is 60 metres, and around 20 km are car-free paths and pedestrian streets. The time limit is 6 hours. The entry fee includes chip timing (RACE RESULT), a medal, a running shirt, aid stations every 5 km with water and sports drink, baggage storage and a digital certificate. Early bird price: DKK 695 through 24 December 2026; afterwards, DKK 795. The organiser is Strata Endurance Events, which also organises Royal Copenhagen City Half and Ørestad Half Marathon.
additional: Start at 09:00 on Sunday 10 October 2027 on Vester Allé by ARoS; finish at the same location. Interactive route map: https://racm-map.vercel.app · Strava route: https://www.strava.com/routes/3550794644934219702. The route is provisional pending final approval from Aarhus Municipality and the police.

name: Fredrikstadmarka Rundt 2027
description: Fredrikstadmarka Rundt is a traditional forest race that has been held since 1974. The course is 20 km long and is considered one of the true classics among Norwegian forest races, with a runnable route featuring pleasant trail sections and good gravel roads. The start and finish are at FIF-huset in Fredrikstad, and the course includes both flat terrain and some steep climbs, especially in the final section toward Skihytta. A shorter distance called Markatier'n is also held, using the same start and finish area and sharing the 20 km route for the first 5.5 km.
course_highlights: 20 km forest race on a runnable route of trails and gravel roads
Three drink stations along the route at approximately 5.5 km, 10 km, and 14 km
Steep climbs and challenging terrain, especially between 9 and 14 km
additional: There are 3 drink stations with water and cordial along the route, as well as drinks at the finish. The start and finish are at FIF-huset, Ilaveien 132, Fredrikstad. Markatier'n is a shorter distance that uses the same start and finish area and shares the 20 km route for the first 5.5 km. The course has remained largely unchanged since 1974. Course records are 1:07:08 for men and 1:16:17 for women. The start and finish are at FIF-huset at Ilaveien 132, Fredrikstad. Registration and results services are stated to be provided in cooperation with EQ Timing.

name: Büdelsdorfer Eiderlauf
description: The Büdelsdorf Eiderlauf is a traditional autumn race in Büdelsdorf, Schleswig-Holstein, organized by SG Athletico Büdelsdorf. It offers classic local road-race distances, including 5 km and 10 km, on flat, manageable courses that are ideal for recreational runners and beginners. The start and finish are often at Eiderstadion, giving the event a friendly, informal atmosphere. The race attracts children, young people, and local club runners, and is a fixture on the regional autumn running calendar.
course_highlights: Flat road-race distances
Start and finish at Eiderstadion
Family-friendly local club race
additional: The race takes place in typical October weather, with daytime temperatures around 14 °C and mostly cloudy skies. Distances range from 1.5 km to 11.1 km, including children's races. After a break during the COVID-19 pandemic, the format was adjusted to incorporate the start and finish in the stadium. Distances: 1.5 km, 5.3 km, 5.8 km, 10.9 km, 11.1 km; flat courses; autumn event; start and finish in the stadium; open to all age groups

name: Thänhuser Schloss Erbhof-Lauf 2026
location: Schloss Erbhof, Kirchwiehe, Thedinghausen, Niedersachsen, Germany
description: The Thänhuser Schloss Erbhof Run takes place on October 11, 2026, in Kirchwiehe, directly opposite Schloss Erbhof in Thedinghausen, Lower Saxony. Organized by TSV Thedinghausen, the road race has welcomed children, young people, active adults, and masters since 2016. Distances offered are 10 km, 5 km, and an 800 m children’s run, which takes place in the tree park near the start and finish. The course is a measured, flat 5 km loop that is also suitable for Nordic walking.
course_highlights: Measured, flat 5 km loop
The 10 km course completes the loop twice
800 m children’s run in the tree park directly by Schloss Erbhof
additional: The 5 km course is also suitable for Nordic walking. October weather is typically 14 °C, with lows around 6 °C and mostly cloudy skies. The children’s run, “Löwenlauf,” is designed specifically for the youngest participants and takes place near the start and finish area. Start and finish in Kirchwiehe opposite Schloss Erbhof; children’s run in the tree park; October weather with temperatures around 14°C low and 6°C high, 40 mm of precipitation, mostly cloudy.

name: Westenergie Marathon
description: The Westenergie Marathon in Essen is a traditional race around the picturesque Baldeneysee. In addition to the classic marathon, the event offers the Westenergie Seerunde, the AllbauTeamStaffel, a mini-marathon for children, and a Walking Day. The course is known for its scenic beauty and proximity to the lakeshore, making the race a special experience for runners of all ages. The event is very well organized and attracts numerous participants every year.
course_highlights: A run around the Baldeneysee with picturesque lakeside scenery
Start and finish at Seaside Beach in Essen
Sections with lake views and through the Heisinger Aue nature conservation area
additional: The start and finish are at Seaside Beach on the Baldeneysee. Late registration on the event day is paperless and uses a QR code. Children can take part in a 1.1 km mini-marathon, with a prize and medals for all participants. Photobello offers race photos. The Walking Day routes include various distances with beautiful lake views and also pass through the Heisinger Aue nature conservation area. The marathon is Germany’s oldest continuously held marathon, with a flat, fast course, several race disciplines, and support for the region. Results and certificates are available online.

description: The Stadtwerke Lübeck Marathon on 18 October 2026 offers runners a varied choice of distances in the historic Hanseatic city of Lübeck. In addition to the classic marathon, the event includes a duo marathon, half marathon, relay and other shorter races suitable for all ages and ability levels. The course runs through the picturesque city and offers a sporting challenge with regional championship scoring. The event is approved by the German Athletics Association and emphasizes community and a passion for sport.
course_highlights: Marathon with Schleswig-Holstein state championship scoring
Duo marathon relay point in Travemünde on the Baltic Sea
Course through the historic Hanseatic city of Lübeck
additional: Free medal engraving is available for registrations by 31.01.2026, with name, distance and finish time. A preferred race number can be selected free of charge during the early registration phases, subject to availability. Relay event with 10 x 4.2 km. Handbike half marathon on the same course as the runners’ half marathon. Duo marathon relay point in Travemünde on the Baltic Sea. On-course refreshments include honey gels; Schleswig-Holstein state championship scoring. Registration by 30.09.2026. Various race number and medal options.

name: Berliner Morgenpost Great 10K
description: The Berliner Morgenpost Great 10K is Berlin’s fastest 10-km race, starting in front of Charlottenburg Palace. The course runs through Berlin Zoo and offers a unique running experience in the capital. In addition to the classic 10-kilometer course, there is also a 2 x 5 km relay and a 4.2 km short course from the zoo to Charlottenburg Palace. The event is suitable for all abilities and age groups and offers a large running festival for the whole family.

name: 19. Burger-Rolandlauf
description: The Burger Rolandlauf is a traditional race that normally takes place in Burg and is jointly organized by Rolandgymnasium Burg and LG Ihleläufer Burg. The course runs through the town along the Ihle, through the forest and past the Bismarckturm, finishing in the school courtyard. Alongside the sporting competition, participants can enjoy a varied supporting program with music, activities for children and refreshments. The 2026 event in Burg was cancelled due to a lack of permits; instead, a replacement event will take place in Tangerhütte City Park.

name: Frühstückslauf
description: The breakfast run in Wernigerode is a group run without timekeeping, leading from the market square up to Wernigerode Castle. The route is about 3 kilometers long, with an elevation gain of 100 meters. The run takes place as a group and is free of charge. A light snack is served afterward, making it a sociable event.

name: H/21 Halbmarathon
description: The H/21 Hannover Half Marathon is a new running event on the national events calendar, combining urban flair, modern beats and green sections of the course. The start and finish are in the heart of Hannover, and the route passes notable hotspots throughout the state capital. The event takes place in autumn and offers a special running experience in a vibrant urban setting. Join the prologue as Hannover begins a new chapter in running history.

name: Bad Hersfelder Lollslauf
description: The Bad Hersfeld Lollslauf is a traditional running event held annually in Bad Hersfeld, attracting runners of all ages and ability levels. With distances ranging from the Bambini Run to the 10 km individual race, the Lollslauf offers a sporting challenge in beautiful surroundings. Alongside competition, the event also emphasizes community and the joy of running. It is a regular fixture on the running calendar and draws participants from across Germany.

name: Porta Volkslauf
organizer: SC Nammen / SC Porta Westfalica Nammen e.V.
description: The Porta Fun Run 2026 is a long-standing running event in Porta Westfalica and has been a fixture on the regional running calendar for more than three decades. The event attracts runners of all ages, from competitive athletes to those running for enjoyment. The route follows roads and field paths around the Nammen sports ground and through the Nammer Unterholz nature reserve, offering varied, flat sections with magnificent panoramic views of the Porta. The run is part of the Mühlenkreisserie and takes place at the local sports facility in Nammen. The warm atmosphere and sense of community make the day a special experience.

name: Sebastian Fredrich Gedenklauf (LM/LC/NLC)
description: The Sebastian Fredrich Memorial Run is a long-standing running event in Lubmin, organized by the triathlon and running group of HSG Uni Greifswald. The event offers a sporting challenge in a friendly, well-organized atmosphere, supported by many volunteers. The route passes through scenic sections and is suitable for both competitive runners and recreational athletes. The event is part of an active running and triathlon community in Mecklenburg-Western Pomerania.

name: Storkower See Lauf
description: The Storkower See Run is a long-standing running event organized by Triathlonverein Fürstenwalde 1990 e.V. and approved by the Brandenburg Athletics Association. On October 11, 2026, runners of various age groups and ability levels can take part on courses of different lengths around Lake Storkow. The event offers a fair competitive atmosphere and is open to running enthusiasts of all ages. Online registration opens in January 2026, and participants are listed in an official start list.

name: Wendlandmarathon
description: The Wendlandmarathon Kolborn is a traditional road race in Lüchow, Lower Saxony, held since 1993. The event offers a wide range of distances, from the marathon and half marathon to short children’s races, appealing to both long-distance runners and families. The course is measured to AIMS/IAAF standards and has kilometre markers and aid stations. Practical facilities for participants include parking, showers, changing rooms and certificates, as well as finisher medals for children.

name: Piwna Mila
description: The Beer Mile is a unique race over a flexible distance of 1,700 to 2,000 metres and the highlight of the third day of the Sun Festival in Wąsowo. Participants start by drinking one beer, and beer refreshment stations are placed along the course approximately every 500 metres. This sporting celebration brings together runners, spectators and families, offering a one-of-a-kind atmosphere and a special finisher’s medal.

name: XIV Biegi Przyjaźni
description: The Friendship Run is one of the events in the Kaszuby Biegają series, the largest running event in northern Poland. The race takes place in the picturesque area around Skrzeszewo, giving participants the chance to spend time actively and discover the charms of Kashubia. The running series attracts runners of different ages and skill levels, promoting a healthy lifestyle and bringing the local community together.

name: Grand Prix CITY TRAIL
description: The CITY TRAIL Grand Prix is a nationwide series of 5 km cross-country races held in the beautiful woodland settings of city parks. In Poznań, the course loops around Lake Rusałka, starting on Św. Wawrzyńca Street and finishing at the city beach by the lake. The races are open to runners of all abilities, from beginners to advanced athletes, who can regularly check their results on the same course. Races take place throughout the 2026/2027 season, and participants can compete in both local and national rankings.
course_highlights: A 5 km course through woodland around Lake Rusałka
Start on Św. Wawrzyńca Street, finish at the city beach
Suitable for beginner and advanced runners
additional: The race office opens at 8:30 and closes at 10:30. A group warm-up with the CITY TRAIL Ambassadors takes place before the 10:45 start. The event also includes races for children in various age categories. The course remains the same throughout the season, allowing runners to compare results across months and years. The series also includes children’s races. The official calendar lists the dates for the 2026/2027 season but does not confirm a race in Poznań on 10 October 2027.

name: Pielgrzymi Półmaraton o Memoriał Jana Pawła II
ASML Marathon Eindhoven
description: The ASML Marathon Eindhoven is the largest two-day sporting event in North Brabant and takes place annually on the second weekend of October. The event offers a wide range of running distances, including the marathon, half marathon, quarter marathon and various other runs for all ages. The course is flat, wide and atmospheric, with a finish in the center of Eindhoven, making for fast times and a unique experience. The city is entirely focused on sport, innovation and connection, with enthusiastic supporters lining the course. This makes the ASML Marathon Eindhoven a festive and internationally acclaimed running event.
course_highlights: Flat, wide course with a finish in the center of Eindhoven
Atmospheric course with enthusiastic crowd support
Route past iconic spots in the city
additional: Participants receive a unique medal. A limited-edition running shirt is available. Special “Run Against Cancer” initiatives allow participants to raise funds and receive a unique shirt. Race bibs for participants from the Netherlands are available until September 1. The finish is on the lively Vestdijk in the center of Eindhoven. This two-day event offers registration for various distances, with the start and finish in the center of Eindhoven, and includes an urban walk and children’s activities.

name: Veluwepoortloop - najaarseditie 2026
description: The Veluwepoortloop is a road running event in Nijkerk held annually, with an autumn edition on 10 October 2026. Participants can choose between distances of 5 km and 10 km. The event is organized by AV Nijkerk and combines a sporting challenge with a playful element, allowing participants to compete for the title of “ruler of Nijkerk.” The race takes place on a Saturday and offers a great opportunity to meet running friends and achieve your personal goals.
course_highlights: Road race in Nijkerk
Distances of 5 km and 10 km
Organized by AV Nijkerk
additional: The event features a game element called “Run Risk,” in which participants can compete to become ruler of Nijkerk. No entry tickets are currently available. Participants can register in advance via the website, and the event takes place in the rural countryside of Nijkerk. No information is available about entry fees or the prize schedule.

name: 640e Conditio Trimloop
description: De 640e Conditio Trimloop wordt georganiseerd door Atletiekvereniging Generaal Michaëlis en vindt plaats op 11 oktober 2026 in het bosrijke gebied bij het Joe Mann Natuurtheater in Best. Het is een crosswedstrijd met afstanden van 3 km en 6,7 km, waarbij deelname gratis is voor AVGM-leden. Deelnemers kunnen zich op de dag zelf inschrijven en ontvangen praktische informatie over het parcours ter plaatse. De wedstrijd heeft een lange traditie en biedt een uitdagende loopervaring in een natuurlijke omgeving.

name: Oostvaardersrun
description: De Oostvaardersrun is een recreatief hardloopevenement dat plaatsvindt in de prachtige natuur nabij de Oostvaardersplassen bij Lelystad. De negende editie vindt plaats op zondag 11 oktober 2026 en biedt uitdagende parcoursen van 10, 16 en 21 kilometer. Door werkzaamheden in het gebied zijn de routes dit jaar aangepast, maar ze blijven een unieke ervaring door het Nationaal Park Nieuw Land. Het evenement trekt jaarlijks veel sportievelingen die genieten van de natuur en de sportieve uitdaging.

name: Kranenbroeker Bosloop
distance_verbose: 10 km, 8.5 km, 6.5 km, 5 km, 2.5 km, 1 km
description: De Kranenbroeker Bosloop is een jaarlijkse hardloopserie die plaatsvindt in het prachtige natuurgebied Kranenbroek in Echt. De wedstrijden worden georganiseerd door Recreatiesport Vereniging Kranenbroek en zijn toegankelijk voor iedereen, van beginnende lopers tot wedstrijdatleten. Het parcours loopt over goed begaanbare bospaden en landwegen en biedt deelnemers de mogelijkheid om hun prestaties over meerdere lopen te volgen. De start en finish zijn op dezelfde locatie, en er zijn verschillende afstanden beschikbaar, variërend van 1 km voor kinderen tot ongeveer 10,5 km voor volwassenen.

name: Vestingloop Edam
description: De Vestingloop Edam is een traditionele hardloopwedstrijd die plaatsvindt over de oude vesting van Edam. Sinds de eerste editie in 1954, waarbij een afstand van 5 kilometer werd gelopen, is de route altijd een vast onderdeel gebleven, ondanks aanpassingen in de afstanden. De wedstrijd biedt diverse afstanden, waaronder jeugdloopjes, een 3 mijl trimloop en een 10 km wedstrijdloop. De finish is gelegen op de Baandervesting nabij de kettingbrug, terwijl de langere afstanden starten op de Noordervesting. De Vestingloop staat bekend om zijn wisselende weersomstandigheden en een gezellige sfeer voor zowel recreatieve als wedstrijdlopers.

name: Culture Run Woerden
description: De Culture Run Woerden viert haar eerste lustrum en is een unieke funrun waarbij sport, cultuur en de rijke historie van Woerden samenkomen. Tijdens deze gezellige run ontdek je de binnenstad op een verrassende manier, waarbij je niet alleen langs bekende plekken loopt, maar ook dwars door iconische en culturele gebouwen gaat. De combinatie van beweging, cultuur en de typische Woerdense gezelligheid maakt dit evenement geliefd bij zowel inwoners als bezoekers. Met twee afstanden van 5 en 10 kilometer, geschikt voor wandelen en hardlopen, is het toegankelijk voor jong en oud. De start en finish zijn bij Technohub Woerden, en het parcours wordt extra feestelijk aangekleed met acts en entertainment.

name: De 15 van Wassenaar
description: De 15 van Wassenaar is een sfeervol hardloopevenement dat plaatsvindt op zondag 11 oktober 2026. Deelnemers kunnen kiezen uit een afstand van 15 kilometer of 7,5 kilometer, die door de dorpskern, landgoederen en villawijken van Wassenaar lopen. Het evenement combineert sportieve uitdaging met een feestelijke sfeer, inclusief verzorging onderweg, een medaille, en een afterparty om de prestatie te vieren. De loop is opgezet met aandacht voor goede doelen en een betrokken publiek langs het fraaie parcours.

name: Rondje Bussloo
description: Rondje Bussloo is een sfeervol hardloopevenement rondom het recreatiegebied Bussloo, georganiseerd door het team achter Rondje Oeken. Het parcours van de twee afstanden voert over verharde paden door een afwisselend landschap van water, bos en open vlaktes, geschikt voor zowel recreanten als gevorderde lopers. De start en finish zijn bij Strandhuys De Enk in Wilp, waar ook gezellige horeca aanwezig is. Het evenement staat bekend om zijn sportieve en gezellige sfeer en vindt plaats op zondag 11 oktober 2026 om 10:30 uur.

description: The Pink Ribbon Run in Kristiansand is an annual event held to support the breast cancer cause. The run starts and finishes at Aquarama in the city centre, and the course passes through beautiful areas around Kristiansand. Participants can choose between a short course of approximately 3.4 km or a long course of approximately 5.5 km. There is also a separate children’s race for children aged 3 to 9. All participants receive a race pack with a bib, neck warmer, bag and medal, and the event brings together thousands of people in a sea of pink for a good cause.
course_highlights: Start and finish at Aquarama in central Kristiansand
Short course of approx. 3.4 km without timing
Long course of approx. 5.5 km with timing
additional: The race pack includes a bib, neck warmer, bag and medal. The Mini children’s race is free and approximately 400 metres long, with activities in the start area. The short course is untimed, while the long course is timed. Race numbers can be collected in the start area from 2 hours before the start, or in advance to avoid queues. Participants in the short and long courses are insured through a licence with the Norwegian Athletics Association, which also supports the cause. Companies can register using separate registration forms and manage participants through My Page. The race pack contains a bib, neck warmer, bag and medal. NOK 250 of the race entry fee goes in full to the Pink Ribbon campaign.

name: 90e Sloterplasloop
description: The Sloterplasloop is a traditional road running event in Amsterdam, taking place for the 90th time in 2026. Participants can choose between the 5 km and 10 km distances, with special kids’ runs also available for young runners. The race is part of Rondje Mokum and is organized by AAC Amsterdam. The event takes place around the Sloterplas and offers a scenic running experience in an urban setting.
course_highlights: Road race around the Sloterplas in Amsterdam
5 km and 10 km distances available
Kids’ runs for young runners
additional: The event is organized by AAC Amsterdam and is part of Rondje Mokum. No entries are currently available. Participants can register for prizes and records, with start times from 9:30 a.m. The event is easy to reach by public transport and takes place in Amsterdam Nieuw-West.

name: MHB Overbetuweloop

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Inschrijven is mogelijk tot en met zaterdag 20 juni 22.00u. Let op: vol=vol!

price_tiers.distance: AH Driessen KidsRun (400 m, 800 m, 1300 m)

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Inschrijven is mogelijk tot en met zaterdag 20 juni 22.00u. Medaille inbegrepen.

description: The MHB Overbetuweloop is the Betuwe’s running event, held in Elst on Sunday, October 11, 2026. The event offers five distances, including the challenging MHB 5 km and Rabobank 10 km, both certified by the Atletiekunie. There are special KidsRuns for children over 400 m and 800 m, as well as a new 1300 m teen run. The course passes through Elst’s picturesque centre and the beautiful countryside along the Linge, making it suitable for the whole family. Start times have been moved earlier to avoid running during the hottest hours of the day.
course_highlights: Flat, fast course through Elst’s centre and the countryside along the Linge
5 km and 10 km certified by the Atletiekunie
Safe, fast KidsRun course named after Olympic athlete Femke Bol
additional: Race bibs can be collected on Sunday, June 21, 2026, from 09:00 at the Town Hall, Dorpsstraat 67. First aid is available, and there are water stations along the course. After the finish, participants receive water and something to eat. Physiotherapists/sports massage therapists will be present. The 5 km and 10 km start together, with an extra-wide start area and space at the front for competitive runners. Electronic timing is used. Children aged 4–7 may run the 400 m KidsRun with a parent/guardian. Medals are included for children; adults can order a medal when registering for €2.50. Dansstudio Kerima will lead a KidsRun warm-up. Extra cooling will be provided in extremely hot weather. The course is certified by the Atletiekunie; medals and prizes for top finishers; sustainable medal options; start and finish in Elst; registration until June 20; volunteers wanted; sports clinics and facilities such as first aid and physiotherapy.

name: Loopavond Gemzen
description: Loopavond Gemzen is een hardloopevenement dat plaatsvindt op 13 oktober 2026 in Heerde, Nederland. De wedstrijd wordt gehouden op de Lambert Dijkslag Atletiekbaan en biedt deelnemers de keuze uit afstanden van 3 km en 5 km. Het evenement vindt plaats bij typisch koel en helder herfstweer, ideaal om te presteren. De organisatie nodigt lopers van alle niveaus uit om deel te nemen en te genieten van een sportieve avond.

name: 5e Duin en Bollen Vierdaagse
description: De Duin en Bollen Vierdaagse is een gezellige wandeltocht in de herfst door de prachtige landschappen van Zuid-Holland. Deelnemers kunnen kiezen uit vijf wandelafstanden en lopen 1 tot 4 dagen door kleurrijke bossen, duinen, dorpen en langs de Hollandse kust. Onderweg worden wandelaars verrast door muziek, theater, sfeervolle chillplekken en gezellige tussenstops met lekkernijen. De routes voeren langs iconische plekken zoals Keukenhof, de Amsterdamse waterleidingduinen en historische dorpen, waardoor het een sfeervol en afwisselend wandelavontuur is voor iedereen.

name: Geopark Hondsrug Crosscircuit
organizer: Stichting De Hondsrug UNESCO Global Geopark
description: Het Geopark Hondsrug Crosscircuit is een uitdagend crosscircuit dat plaatsvindt in het prachtige Hondsruggebied, een uniek ijstijdenlandschap en UNESCO Global Geopark. Het circuit bestaat uit meerdere crosslopen georganiseerd door verschillende lokale loopgroepen, waarbij deelnemers actief kunnen bewegen in een natuurlijke en afwisselende omgeving. Deelnemers van verschillende leeftijden en niveaus kunnen meedoen, met speciale regels voor junioren. Het circuit stimuleert sportiviteit en verbondenheid met het landschap.

name: Vistakulle Backyard
description: Vistakulle Backyard is a running event in the Vistakulle area near Gränna, organised by Rudu Friskvård in collaboration with Bauer Activities. The race is aimed at people who are a little adventurous and interested in fitness, and places as much emphasis on the experience of nature as on performance. The event takes place on 16 May 2026 and offers a memorable course through hilly terrain close to nature.

pipeline_log.message: New race date found on official site (https://baueractivities.se/loppen/vistakulle-backyard/): 2026-10-17 — "17 Oktober 2026 07.00-19.00" (was estimated 2027-05-15)

name: Växjö Marathon
description: Växjö Marathon is a fast, flat marathon course run over eight laps around the beautiful Växjösjön. The course is mostly paved, with a short section of fine gravel, and has very little elevation change—about 3 metres per lap. The event welcomes both experienced runners and beginners, and also offers relay races for teams. This is the 32nd edition of the race, which is known as Sweden’s fastest marathon course. The course is marked and has a lead cyclist and course marshals, but it is not closed to traffic during the race.
course_highlights: Eight laps around Växjösjön
Flat, fast course with about 3 m of elevation change per lap
Mostly paved, with about 300 metres of fine gravel
additional: The course is marked, with a lead cyclist and course marshals. It is not closed to traffic during the race. Relay races are also available for teams, and a children’s race is held. Sports drinks, dietary supplements, and energy and protein bars are available. The organizer is Växjö Löparklubb. The marathon relay has teams of four, with each runner completing two laps. The course is not closed to pedestrians, cyclists, or motor traffic. Sources do not confirm the details for the 2027 edition.

name: Åhus TrailRun
description: Åhus TrailRun is a challenging trail race through the coastal forests and along the sea south of Åhus in Skåne. Participants can choose from four distances: 2.5 km, 6 km, 11 km and 17 km, as well as an untimed children’s race. The courses feature gently rolling terrain with a mix of trails, sand dunes, hills and running on sand by the sea, providing a unique running experience. The race is part of Skåne Trailcup and also offers a team competition with great prizes. The event is open to everyone and has a friendly, welcoming atmosphere.
course_highlights: Gently rolling terrain with varied surfaces
A mix of trails, sand dunes and challenging hills
Running on sand along the sea
additional: Participant limit: 1,000. The children’s race is approximately 350 m long, has individual starts and is free to enter. Start times: 2.5 km and 6 km start at 12:30, 11 km and 17 km start at 12:40, and the children’s race has individual starts between 13:00 and 15:00. The time limit for the 17 km race is 2 hours and 50 minutes. Parking is limited; follow the instructions of event staff. Valuables storage is available for a fee of 20 SEK. Toilets are 200 metres from the event venue. The venue at Strandridaregården is approximately 100 metres from the sea. The children’s race is approximately 350 metres and is untimed. Prices are reported for the 2026 edition.

name: Jönköping 10K/5K
description: Jönköping 10K/5K is a race for everyone, from elite runners to recreational runners, offering a completely flat and fast course in central Jönköping, starting at Lillsjöplan. The course has been officially measured by the Swedish Athletics Association and is eligible for seeding at many races in Sweden and internationally. The race offers a great atmosphere, pacers for different finishing times, and the opportunity to take part in team competitions with friends. It’s a perfect chance to set a personal best or simply enjoy a pleasant run with colleagues or friends.
course_highlights: A completely flat and fast course in central Jönköping
The 5K runs one lap; the 10K runs two laps
A water station with UMARA sports drink along the course
additional: Pacers carrying flags for 40-, 45- and 50-minute times in the 10K. Team competition with a 10% discount when registering with two friends. Warm-up with Fitness24Seven at 10:40 in the start/finish area. Limited bag drop in the start area in the morning. Parking is available in nearby parking garages for a fee. Register three people as a team for a 10% discount on the entry fee and a chance to win prizes. Up to five runners can be registered at the same time.

name: Ivar Formos Minneløp 2027
description: Ivar Formos Minneløp is a traditional cross-country race in Oslo, offering scenic and challenging courses in Nordmarka. The race has distances for both children and adults, including a tough 17 km course that follows the terrain where Ivar Formo trained to become an Olympic champion. The start and finish are at Sognsvann Snøpark, and the courses feature beautiful trails, panoramic views of the city, and several aid stations along the way. The event is a sweaty pleasure for everyone who enjoys running in the forest, with a new 10 km course that is undulating and challenging without steep climbs or descents.
course_highlights: 17 km course starting and finishing at Sognsvann Snøpark, with panoramic views of Oslo from Vettakollen and Frønsvollen
The course passes well-known places such as Båntjern, Skjennungstua, Ullevålseter, and Lynhytta, with aid stations
New 10 km course on beautiful forest trails, with challenging, undulating terrain and no steep hills
additional: Start and finish at Sognsvann Snøpark. Timing chip included in the race bib, except for the children's race, which is untimed. Late registration is available on race day via the EQ Timing app. Registration is binding, with no refunds in case of illness or injury. Race bibs can be resold via EQ Timing. No T-shirts will be sold in 2027 due to low interest. In 2027, the race will be held for the 15th time. Late registration is available on race day via the EQ Timing app. The timing chip is included in the race bib, and the children's race is untimed. Registration is binding, and a one-off licence from the Norwegian Athletics Federation is required if you do not have an annual licence.

name: Furumomila 2027
description: Furumomila is a traditional cross-country race held for the 44th time at Furumo Idrettspark. The event offers several distances, including a 10 km cross-country race, MiniMil, a recreational walk and SpareBank1 Modum’s cross-country race. Participants can look forward to generous cash prizes, gift cards, medals and pins. This autumn adventure welcomes both recreational runners and competitive athletes.
course_highlights: 10 km cross-country race over varied terrain
Several distances: 10 km, 5 km, 1.5 km, MiniMil and a recreational walk
Start and finish at Furumo Idrettspark
additional: Race numbers can be collected in the tent by the clubhouse before the start. Showers and changing rooms are available. Parking and a shuttle bus are provided. Prizes are awarded shortly after the finish for the various distances. A one-time licence is required for those without an annual licence, in accordance with the rules of the Norwegian Athletics Federation. Previous editions have distributed race numbers by the clubhouse. Distances and practical information for 2027 have not been confirmed.

name: Hytteplanmila
description: Hytteplanmila is an annual fun run held at Svensrudmoen in October. The race features a fast, gently undulating 10-kilometre course, known as one of Norway’s fastest 10K road race routes. Participants can experience a varied course with both easy and challenging sections, including a demanding finish on Pulsbakken. The event attracts both recreational runners and elite athletes, with separate start groups for the elite field.
course_highlights: Fast, gently undulating 10-kilometre course
The race’s challenging finish on Pulsbakken
Great views over Steinssletta and historic sites such as Mo gård
additional: Registration opens in November. Entry fees are non-refundable and cannot be transferred. Those who register by the deadlines receive a buff and running socks, distributed on race day. It is possible to pre-order a race pack with energy products. Elite athletes can register by email for separate start groups. Buses to the race are arranged from Oslo and Gardermoen. The time limit is 1 hour and 40 minutes. Registration for 2027 opens in November; information about the entry fee has not yet been published.

name: Viersener Herbstwaldlauf Rund um den Bismarckturm
description: The 79th Viersen Autumn Forest Run Around the Bismarck Tower takes place on 10 October 2026 in Viersen. The event offers a 5 km run for adults on a hilly course, with a time limit of one hour. There is also a 7.25 km Walking & Nordic Walking event. The age limits are 14 to 99 for the run and 10 to 99 for walking. This traditional event is aimed at runners and walkers looking for a challenging course through autumn woodland.
course_highlights: Hilly course
Around the Bismarck Tower
One-hour time limit for the 5 km run
additional: There are events for children and young people; further information is available in the organiser’s official race announcement. All events share the same start and finish, but the exact locations are only shown with RUNME Premium. Results are listed by age category, with categories assigned according to year of birth. There are several events with different distances, age categories and start times; young people aged 14 and over may participate. Results will be published on the website.

name: Falke-Rothaarsteigmarathon
location: Schmallenberger Sauerland, Hochsauerlandkreis, North Rhine-Westphalia, Germany
description: The 23rd FALKE Rothaarsteig Marathon takes place on 17 October 2026 in the Schmallenberger Sauerland. The event offers marathon, half-marathon, walking, Nordic walking and a 12.5 km AOK run. The course passes through the scenic Rothaar Mountains and is recognised by the DLV as an officially authorised popular race. More than 1,000 runners take part each year, enjoying the varied trails and forest scenery.
course_highlights: Scenic course in the Rothaar Mountains
DLV-recognised, officially authorised popular race
A range of events: marathon, half-marathon, walking, Nordic walking and 12.5 km AOK run
additional: Registration opens on 01.05.2026. Late registration is available until half an hour before the start of the respective event. Start times are staggered: marathon at 11:00, half-marathon at 12:00, walking and Nordic walking at 12:15, and the AOK run at 11:45. The event venue is Latroper-Str. 57392 Fleckenberg in the Schmallenberger Sauerland. Registration opens on 01.05.2026; no dog runs. A detailed course description is available, along with start times and organisational information on the website.

name: Hachenburger Löwenlauf
description: The Hachenburg Löwenlauf is a long-standing race with a family-friendly atmosphere, taking place on October 17, 2026, in Hachenburg. The event offers various distances, including a half marathon, a 10.5 km race, a 6.3 km fun run/team race, and children’s races. The courses pass through the varied landscapes of the Westerwald, with challenging climbs and wonderful views. Since 1989, proceeds from the race have been donated to social projects, giving the event special social significance.
course_highlights: The half marathon reaches its highest point at Gräbersberg (513 m) and features varied climbs and descents.
The 10.5 km race runs mostly along forest paths, with its highest point at 439 m above sea level.
The start and finish area is at the Rundsporthalle in Hachenburg, which has changing rooms and showers.
additional: Electronic timing without a chip; certificates for all finishers; prizes for category winners; special prize for the largest team in the team race. Late registration is available on October 16 from 17:00 and on race day from 09:00. Refreshments including electrolyte drinks, water, tea, cola, and fruit are available on the course and at the finish. Changing rooms and showers are available at the Rundsporthalle. Distances include a half marathon, 10.5 km, a 6.3 km team and fun run, and children’s races. The start and finish area is at Lohmühle, Hachenburg. Electronic timing without a chip; certificates for all finishers; prizes for category winners; refreshments on the course and at the finish. Registration is online only.

name: Herbstlauf des LSV Porz
organizer: LSV Porz / Kölner Lauf- und Nordic-Walkingteam
description: The LSV Porz Autumn Run is Cologne’s oldest road race and takes place in the picturesque Leidenhausen recreation area. The event offers distances from 1 km to 10 km, measured in accordance with the German Athletics Association (DLV) regulations and eligible for rankings. Both competitive runners and recreational joggers can enjoy the autumn scenery as they run. The 5 km loop is considered one of the fastest running routes in Cologne and the surrounding area, and is often used by top runners to assess their form.
course_highlights: Running routes through the Leidenhausen recreation area amid autumn scenery
The 5 km loop is one of the fastest running routes in Cologne
Routes measured in accordance with DLV regulations and eligible for rankings
additional: Race numbers must be worn on the chest. Timing is provided by time-and-voice.com. Late registration is possible on the day of the event for a fee of €2; school students are exempt from the fee. No liability is accepted for theft, accidents or other damage. Payment is by SEPA direct debit a few days before the event. No entry fee will be debited if the event is cancelled. Courses measured, registration until 14.10.2025, start times from 11:00, parking nearby, participation in running and Nordic walking events

name: TeutoMarsch
location: Grundschule Hohne, Lengerich-Hohne, North Rhine-Westphalia, Germany
description: The Teutomarsch is a unique hiking and running experience through the Teutoburg Forest and surrounding area. Organized by Turnverein Hohne von 1911 e.V. in Lengerich, the Teutomarsch offers two routes designed to delight participants. The event is very popular, and starting places fill up quickly. The exact route is still being finalized, but promises to be a fantastic and unique course. Participants must be at least 16 years old, and dogs are allowed on a leash.
course_highlights: A unique route through the Teutoburg Forest and surrounding area
Two different routes for a special experience
A nature experience in the Lengerich-Hohne region
additional: Registration for the 2026 Teutomarsch sold out within 30 minutes, with 500 starting places. There is a waiting list. Participants consent to being photographed and filmed and to the publication of the resulting images and footage. Entry fees are non-refundable. Minimum age: 16. Dogs are allowed on a leash. The organizer accepts no liability for personal injury, property damage, or loss or theft. Trail running, no timekeeping, refreshment stations along the route, start and finish at Grundschule Hohne, participant limit: 500.

name: Panoramalauf Niedenstein
description: The 24th Niedenstein Panoramic Run takes place on October 17, 2026, in Niedenstein. The event is organized by SG 1898 Chattengau e.V. and Lauftreff Niedenstein. The run offers an attractive course around the Hessenturm Stadium and the clubhouse, set amid the beautiful landscape of the region. Participants can look forward to a well-organized running event as part of the Schwalm-Eder Running Cup.

name: Prignitzer Moormeile
description: The Prignitzer Moormeile in Bad Wilsnack is a traditional race taking place for the 26th time on October 17, 2026. The event offers various distances from 1 km to 12.4 km, running through the Wilsnack forests, the Kurpark, and around the Karthanehalle. The races are suitable for children, young people, and adults, and are part of the Prignitz Cup and the Brandenburg Cup. The event is known for its family-friendly atmosphere, good on-course refreshments, and professional timing.

name: Coconaut Pomerania ULTRA Trail
description: Coconaut Pomerania ULTRA Trail is a trail running series held on the hilly trails of Pomerania and Kashubia, with the event base at KJ Barłomino. The event offers five distances: 100 km, 65 km, 42 km, 21 km and 11 km, providing a range of challenges for trail runners. The race showcases the beauty of the Kashubian landscape and regional attractions, and participants can look forward to excellent aid stations along the route. The event is supported by the #AktywnaWieś program and organized by the Pomerania Sports Association.

name: 50e Jan Koudstaal Dijkloop - Halve Marathon Schoonhoven
description: De 50e Jan Koudstaal Dijkloop in Schoonhoven is een hardloopevenement met meerdere afstanden, waaronder 1,5 km, 6 km, 10 km en de halve marathon van 21,1 km. De wedstrijd is aangesloten bij de Atletiekunie en biedt een gevarieerd parcours voor zowel recreatieve als meer ervaren lopers. Het evenement staat bekend om zijn gezellige sfeer en de mooie omgeving van Schoonhoven. De prijzen variëren van €3,00 tot €15,00, afhankelijk van de afstand.

name: A. Vogelloop
description: De A.Vogelloop is een sfeervolle hardloopwedstrijd die plaatsvindt op 17 oktober 2026 in 't Harde. De wedstrijd wordt georganiseerd door de Wallenloop en Havenloop samen met A.Vogel, waarbij het goede doel stichting Opkikker wordt ondersteund. De route loopt over het prachtige landgoed Zwaluwenburg met een onverharde ronde van 5 kilometer door bosrijke omgeving, start en finish in de fraaie A.Vogeltuinen. Er is aandacht voor zowel recreatieve als professionele lopers en voor kinderen zijn er speciale jeugdafstanden met medailles voor alle deelnemers.

name: Boerbos cross
organizer: Stichting De Hondsrug UNESCO Global Geopark
description: De Boerbos Cross in Rolde is een uitdagende crossloop door het unieke landschap van het Boerbos, onderdeel van het UNESCO Global Geopark De Hondsrug. De route voert over onverharde paden, heuvels, heide en zandverstuivingen, met afstanden voor junioren, senioren en masters. De cross wordt georganiseerd door Loopgroep SGO, Gieten en Vomos en maakt deel uit van het Hondsrug crosscircuit. De tijdwaarneming gebeurt zonder chip, en er is een beperkt aantal deelnemers toegelaten.

name: Dutch Backyard Ultra Zeewolde
description: De Dutch Backyard Ultra is een unieke ultraloop waarbij deelnemers elk uur starten aan dezelfde ronde van 6,706 km. Er is geen vaste finish; wie binnen het uur de ronde voltooit, start precies een uur later opnieuw. Het evenement duurt zo lang als de deelnemers volhouden, met slechts één winnaar: de laatste loper die een ronde voltooit, de 'last man standing'. De route in Zeewolde loopt over het Scoutinglandgoed en voert voornamelijk door de natuur met weinig hoogtemeters.

name: Täljemilen
description: Enhörna IF presents Täljemilen—perhaps autumn’s fastest officially measured 10K, at Geneta Sportfält in Södertälje. The course runs entirely on cycle paths and footpaths and is fully paved, making it very fast and suitable for those chasing a personal best. Water is available at 5 km and at the finish. Instead of medals, the organizer donates a sum to the Swedish Childhood Cancer Fund for every registered runner. Prizes are awarded to the top 3 in both the women’s and men’s categories, and there is also a draw for approximately 20 prizes.

name: Skövdeloppet
description: Skövdeloppet makes a comeback in 2026 with a new, city-adjacent course that mainly follows walking and cycling paths through several of Skövde’s residential areas. Race day is October 18, and the races are designed as easy-to-run urban courses suitable for both recreational and competitive runners. Three distances are offered (21.1 km, 10 km and 5 km), with a shared start and finish at Lillegårdens Fritidsområde.

name: Gjesdal Trailrun
location: Gjesdal IL athletics facility, Solås, Ålgård, Gjesdal, Norway

description: Gjesdal Trailrun is a true trail race held in beautiful natural surroundings in Ålgård, starting from Gjesdal IL’s athletics facility at Solås. The race mainly follows trails in the terrain northeast of the facility, climbing Kodlifjellet and Håfjellet. It suits both those looking for an enjoyable mountain hike and those who want to compete. Three distances are offered: 10 km, 6 km, and a 1.3 km children’s race. The course follows regular hiking trails that can be challenging, with rocky and slippery sections, so good trail shoes are recommended.
course_highlights: Trail race on paths in the terrain northeast of Gjesdal IL’s athletics facility
The main course climbs Kodlifjellet and Håfjellet
Challenging sections with rocks and slippery areas
additional: Race bib collection opens at 10:00 at the Gjesdal IL clubhouse. The children’s race starts at 11:30. Both timed and untimed starts are available for the 6 km and 10 km distances. The 10 km has a time limit, with participants required to pass Kodlifjellet within approximately 35 minutes and the junction between the 6 km and 10 km courses within 40 minutes. The online registration fee of NOK 20, plus any NFIF one-time licence, is additional. Previous editions have featured 10 km, 6 km, and a 1 km children’s race. Good trail shoes with good grip are recommended. The 2027 distances have not been confirmed in the sources.

name: Neskollen Frontyard 2027
